zhu kha da pa sku yi da/ 41'di ni sa chu'i rang bzhin lci la bsil// stod na gnas kyang smad du lhung bar byed// grang ba'i nad kun 'di las ma skyes med// rlung ni tsha grang gnyis ku'i khyab byed de// nyi mar ldan na bsreg pa'i grogs byed cing // zla bar ldan na bsil ba'i grogs byed la// stod smad phyi nang ma lus khyab par rgyu// tsha grang gnyis ka 'khrug cing slong bar byed/ de bas rlung ni nad kun ma lus rgyu/zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las nad kyi rgyu bstan pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// / /

42le'u dgu pa/ nad kyi rkyen bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / rgyu la skyed par byed pa'i rkyen gsum ste// skye mched gsog lda nga slong rkyen rnam pa gsum// skye zhing mched par byed pa skye mched dang // gsog cing lda nga bar byed pas gsog ldang zhes// bsags pa slong bar byed pa slong rkyen yin// skye mchen dus dang dbang po spyod lam rnams// dman lhag log pas nad rnams skyed par byed// dus ni tsha dus grang dus char dus gsum// dman pa tsha grang char pa chung ba ste// lhag pa che drags log pa med pa'o// dbang po lnga dang de yi yul lnga po// chung ngam de la mi sbyor dman pa ste// shas cher gtad pa lhag pa'i sbyor ba yin// shin tu nye dang ring ba che 'am chung // 'jigs dang mi sdug log pa'i sbyor bar bshad//spyod lam lus ngag yid dang gsum yin te// chung ngam mi sbyor 'jug pa dman pas dman// rtun ngas 'jug pa lhag pa'i sbyor ba ste// shugs bkag btsing bcus mi dge log sbyor ro// gsog ldang zhi gsum rgyu dang ngo bo dus//rgyu ni tsub sogs dro ldan rlung gsog la// grang bas ldang zhing snum dros zhi bar 'gyur/ de bzhin rno sogs bsil ldan mkhris pa gsog / tsha bas ldang zhing rtul sogs bsil ldan zhi// lci snum bsil ldan bad kun gsog 'gyur gyi//dro bas ldang zhing tsub sogs kyis zhi 'gyur// ngo bo rang gnas 'phel ba gsog pa yin / rgyu las 'khrug byed mi mthun yon tan 'dod ldang ba log pa'i lam zhugs rang rtags ston// rang gnas mnyam gnas nad med zhi ba yin// dus ni so ga sogs gsum rlung gi ste/ mkhris pa dbyar dang bad kun

sa kha da pa sku yi da 43dgu nas da do// so ga'i dus su yang la tsub pa yi// yul dang lus dang zas spyod kun mtshungs pas// rlung gsog byed kyi dro bas ldang mi 'gyur// dbyar dus char rlung grang ba skyes pas ldang // ston dus snum la dro bas zhi bar 'gyur//dbyar dus snum bsil mkhris gsog ldang mi 'gyur// snum dros ston ldang dgun stod bsil bas zhi// dgun smad bsil snum lci bas bad kun gsog /bsgongs pas lda nga min dbyi dus nyi ma'i 'od// dro bas ldang zhing so ga yang tsub zhi// 'on kyang 'byung ba'i dus la ma bab kyang / zas spyod dbang gis 'phral la 'byung ba yod// khyad par slong rkyen thun mong khyad par gnyis//nad kun slong bar byed pa'i thun mong rkyen// 'byung ba'i dus dang gdon dug mi 'phrod zas// gso ba log dang las ngan sad las 'byung // khyad par kha dang yang tsub bsten drags dang // chags pas dub dang lto chag gnyid chag dang // lto stong lus ngag bya ba drag shul dang // khrag mang zags dang 'khru skyug drag pos btab// bser bus bus dang ga chad ngus pa dang // mya ngan sems las kha las ches pa dang // bcud med kha zas yin la gtad pa dang //drag shul bkag dang nan gyis btsir ba yi// rkyen de rnams kyis rlung nad lda nga bar byed tsha ba'i ro dang rno tsha snum bsten drags// rgyud la zhe sdang drag po skyes pa dang // tshad gung gnyid log 'dug rjes drag shul byas// mi theg khur dang sa sran bskos pa dang // gzhu sran bkang dang 'dzing ga bkye pa dang //bang dang 'gro las dag gis nyen pa dang / rta yis brdabs dang g.yang la lhung ba dang // 'thibs 'og tshud dang rdo dbyug brdungs pa dang // sha mar bu ram chang sogs bza' btung drags// rkyen de rnams kyis mkhris tshad slong bar byed// kha mngar lci bsil snum bsten drags pa dang // 'grangs rjes dal bar 'dug dang nyin gnyid log / rlan steng nyal dang chur zhugs gos srab 'khyags// gro sran gsar thog ser can sums pa dang ku ra skom sha rin

44 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'i tshil bu 'bru mar dang // rtsi mar dul pa lo bshur la phug ras// ri gog la sogs rjen zas mtha' dag dang // ma 'tshos 'tshig dang khengs po'i zas rnams dang // ra yi 'o rlon zho dar chu grang ja// bza' btung ches te tshad las 'das pa 'am// snga ma ma zhu phyi ma zos pa yi// rkyen de rnams kyis bad kun grang nad slong // de dag 'dres las ldan 'dus nad du 'gyur// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las nad kyi rkyen bstan pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// / /

45le'u bcu pa/ nad 'jug tshul/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / de ltar rgyu la rkyen gyis bskyed byas nas/'jug pa'i tshul ni 'phang bya'i yul de la// 'phen par byed pa'i rkyen ni rnam bzhi yis// 'phen bya gcig la phog dang 'brel pas dpag / de yang rlung ni nus pa la gnas te// mkhris pa khrag dang rngul la gnas pa yin// bad kun lhag ma rnams la gnas pa 'o// de ltar phan tshun rten dang brten pa'i tshul//nyes pa 'khrugs pas lus zungs nyen byas te// gnyis gas dri ma la ni gnod par byed// de yang nad dang rgyu mthun zas kyi bcud// khyab byed rlung gis bu ga rnams su gtor// de tshe dngas ma gang du chags gyur pa// bu ga'i skyon dang de dus spyod lam gyis// mkha' la sprin 'dus char pa 'bab pa bzhin// rang rang gnas su 'phel 'ing gsog par byed// bsags pa rkyen phrad nges pa kho nar ldang // lam drug zhugs nas bde med nad 'byung 'gyur// de ltar zhugs nas gang du brten pa'i gnas// zhu ba'i gnas dang dpyi mig rus tshigs dang // reg bya rna ba rlung gi gnas yin te// khyad par zhu gnas long na gnas pa yin// mkhris gnas lte ba pho ba khrag dang rngul// dngas ma chu ser mig dang pags pa ste// khyad par zhu dang ma zhu'i bar na gnas// bad kun brang dang mgul pa glo ba mgo / dngas ma sha tshil rkang khu bshang gci dang //sna lce khyad par ma zhu'i gnas la gnas/ zhes gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las nad 'jug tshul gyi le'u ste bcu pa'o// //

46le'u bcu gcig pa/ nad kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / nyes pa'i mtshan nyid 'phel zad 'khrugs pa gsum// 'phel zad nad zungs dri ma rnam gsum ste// de la rgyu dang mtshan ma rtags bstan pa'o// dang po nyes pa 'phel dang zad pa'i rgyu// zas spyod mi 'dod slong dang mi 'phrod 'phrad// spangs byin de dang de 'phel zad par 'gyur// gnyis pa lus kyi me drod rang gnas 'dug / cha shas lus zungs kun la gnas pa de// bri dang 'bar bas 'phel dang zad par 'gyur// dang pos phyi ma rgyas dang 'grib byed yin// dri ma thogs dang zhin tu 'byung las shes// de rtags rlung 'phel skem nag drod la dga'// lus 'dar lto ba sbo zhing bshang ba sri// smra mang mgo 'khor stobs gnyid dbang po nyams//mkhris pa 'phel bas bshang gci pags mig ser// bkres skom lus tsha gnyid chung 'khru bar byed// bad kun 'phel bas drod nyams zas mi 'ju// lus lci mdog dkar khong stom yan lag lhod// mchil mang lud pa gnyid che dbugs mi bde// dngas ma 'phel bas bad kun dang 'dra la// khrag 'phel me dbal khong 'bras mcher pa'i nad// mdze skran khrag mkhris nad dang mig ser dang //rnyil nad skyod dka' mig dang gcin pags dmar// sha 'phel lba ba then bu sha rgyas 'gyur// tshil 'phel ngal dang nu ma bsus tshil skye// rus pa 'phel bas rus lhag so lhag 'byung // rkang 'phel lus lci mig g.yung tshigs kha sbom//khu 'phel khu ba'i de 'gyur bud med dad// bshang 'phel lus lci lto sbo rgyu ma

spro blo shad pa yi rgyud/ 47'khrug / gcin 'phel chu sor zug cing ma gcis sem// jul 'phel rngul che dri log pags nad 'byung // phra mo 'phel bas lci zhing g.ya' 'drul byed//rlung zad rtsol chung smra nyams lus mi bde// dran pa mi gsal bad kun 'phel rtags 'byung // mkhris zad drod mdog nyams pas grang dang nag / bad kun zad pas rang gi gnas stongs shing / mgo 'khor snying 'dar tshigs mtshams lhod par 'gyur// dngas ma zad pas sha skam zas mid dka' pags tsub sgra cher mi bzod na bar 'gyur// khrag zad rtsa lhod pags tsub bsil par dad// sha zad lhu tshigs na zhing rus pags 'byar// tshil zad gnyid chung sha skam sngo sbyar 'gyur// rus pa zad pas skra 'byi so sen 'byung ⑪rkang zad sgrubs stong mgo 'khor mig 'grib 'gyur/ khu ba zad pas khrag 'byung 'dzig gam sem// bshang zad sgyu ma'i nang du sgra bcas 'khyil// gyen du 'gro zhing rtsib logs snying ga na// gcin zad mdog 'gyur sri dang nyung ngur 'gyur// rngul zad pags 'gas ba spu 'greng dang 'byi// phran bu rang gnas stongs dang yang las shes// lus zungs dri ma la ni brten pa'i phyir//'phel dang zad pas stobs la gnod pa yin mdangs ni sems la sdug bsngal gyis zad de// dngangs rin nyams chung mi dga' gzi mdangs nyams 'tsho byed 'o ma sha khu de sman yin// 'khrugs rtags rlung gi rtsa ni stong la rkyal/chu ni chu 'dra dngas la log rjes sla/ 'gro 'dod shus 'debs shes pa yang la 'phyo// mgo bo zi 'khor rna ba 'ur la 'khrog / lce skam dmar tsub kha ro bska ba bro// gzer 'pho grang 'dar 'gul rgyab zug dang rnyong // rengs 'khums bye chag 'byin dang dkris snyam byed// 'gul na zug che spu rtse phrum ser khyer//gnyid med g.yal 'dar brkyang 'dod tshig pa za// dpyi skad rus tshigs ma lus brdungs snyam byed// ltag pa brang dang mur 'gram zug cing gzer//rlung gsang rnams ni kha bye mnan na na// stong skyugs byed cing tho rangs spu

48 sa /grwa nga byu sog lu// sbo 'khrog sgongs dang tho rangs zhu rjes na// mkhris pa 'khrugs rtags rtsa rgyas phra grims mgyogs chu mdog dmar ser dri dugs rlangs pa che// mgo na sha tsha kha ro skyur la kha// lce steng bad kun che la sna sgo skam// mig sprin dmar ser gzer ba gcig tu 'dril// nub gnyid chung la nyin par gnyid mi thub// lud pa dmar ser tsha bro skom dad che// khrag mkhris 'khru skyug rngul che dri ma mnam// kha dog dmar ser smin dang 'drul bar byed// nyin gung mtshan gung zhu ba'i dus na na/ bad kun 'khrugs rtags rtsa ni bying rgud dal// chu ni mdog dkar dri dang rlangs pa chung // kha mngal lce rnyil skya la mig dkar spang // snabs lud mang ling mgo 'thom lus sems lci// dang ga mi bde drod med 'ju stobs chung // mkhal rked na zhing lus sbo lnga ba bskye//kha zas bad kun skyug cing 'khru ba dang // dran pa mi gsal gnyid che sgyid pa skyur// g.ya' mkhrang tshigs dam sha rgyas las mtha' ring // nam zhod srod dang snga dro zos thog ldang // de ltar mtshan nyid 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum gyi /ji ltar bshad pa'i rtags kyis nad kun khyab// ldan 'dus 'dres pa'i rtags las shes par bya// 'dir ma 'dus pa'i nad rtags yod mi srid// ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las nad kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// / /

49le'u bcu gnyis pa/ nad kyi dbye ba bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / nad kyi dbye ba rgyu yi dbye ba dang // rten dang rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye ba gsum// dang po rgyu yi sgo nas dbye ba ni// tshe 'di'i nyes dang sngon gyi las las byung // de gnyis 'dres las byung dang rnam pa gsum// dang po rgyu rkyen 'dzom las 'byung ba ste// las skyes rgyu med pa la dkyil che ba// rgyu chung dkyel che nyes las 'dres pa yin// dang po tshe 'di'i nyes pa rnam gnyis te// rang bzhin gnas pa khong gi nyes pa dang // phyi rkyen las byung blo bur nyes pa gnyis// dang po rlung mkhris bad gan gsum yin te//gnyis pa dug mtshon gdon dang rnam pa gsum// rten gyi sgo nas dbye na skyes pa dang // bud med byis pa gas pa'i nad rigs bzhi/ kun khyab thun mong pa dang rnam pa lnga// skyes pa'i nad la khu ba zad blugs gnyis// rlig blugs pho mtshan bdun dgu bco brgyad bshad// bud med nad la tshabs bcu mngal skran dgu// mngal gyi srin bu langs 'khros rnam pa gnyis// rtsa nad bco lnga sum cu rtsa drug go / byis pa'i nad la phra rags zhib tshegs brgyad/ rgas nad 'byung ba'i lus stobs 'gribs pa yin// kun khyab thun mong nad la nyes pa dang // gtso bo gnas dang rigs kyis dbye ba 'o// nyes pas dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun gsum// rlung gi nad la spyi dang bye brag gnyis spyi la rigs dang gnas kyis dbye ba gnyis// rigs kyis dbye na rlung nad nyi shu ste//gnas kyis dbye na 'jug sgo rnam pa drug / dbang po lnga la me tog shar dang

30 ༄/grwa thang dab /bdun// bye brag srog 'dzin la sogs rnam gyur lnga// bad kun mkhris par 'dres pas bcu ru 'dod// dbye ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rlung gi nad// mkhris pa'i nad la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la rigs dang gnas kyi dbye ba gnyis rigs kyi dbye ba thang la lhags pa dang // gnas gyur kha lud rtsa rgyug rnam pa gsum// gnas kyis dbye na sgo drug dbang po bdun/ bye brag 'ju byed la sogs rnam gyur lnga rlung dang bad kun 'dres pas bcu ru 'dod spyo dbye ba nyi shu rtsa drug mkhris pa'i nad// bad gan nad la rang rgyud ga 'an rgyud gnyis//rang rgyud can la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyi la rigs dang gnas kyis dbye ba gnyis// rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na snyen sogs drug / gnas kyis dbye na sgo drug dbang po bdun// bye brag rten byed la sogs rnam gyur lnga// rlung dang mkhris par 'dres pas bcu ru 'dod/ gzhan rgyud can la ser po sprug po gnyis// sprug po byer rgyas rdol dang 'gyings pa bzhi/ dbye ba sum cu rtsa gsum bad kun na dka brgya dang rtsa gcig nyes pa'i dbye bar 'dod// gtso bos dbye na rang rgyud gzhan rgyud can/ rang rgyud can ni rkyang pa rang rtags ston 'phel dang rab 'phel mchog 'phel zad par sbyar// gzhan rgyud can la lda na 'dus bla gnyan gsum// ldan pa mnyam gsum cig rab lhag pa drug /'dus la mtshungs cig rab 'bring gsum sbyar drug / gnyis gcig lhag pa la drug go zlog zad// 'phel zad 'dres la mnyam 'phel zad sbyar drug / cig zad gnyis 'phel go bzlog bcas la drug / 'phel zad dbye ba bdun cu rtsa bzhi 'o// bla gnyan nad kyi steng du nad gang ig / byung ba de yang dbye ba gsum 'gyur te// zhugs dang log dang 'dom pa zhes su bshad / gcig gi //kā di /spya / 'tha ba /kā lda / dī /na rlom ma// zhi zlo /zha rtsa / cig gtso bo'i / /dbye bar 'dod// gnas kyi sgo nas dbye na lus dang sems// sems la

sto/bshad pa sku yi da 51gnas pa smyo byed brjed byed gnyis// lus la gnas pa stod smad phyi nang bzhi//phyi nang kun khyab nad dang rnam pa lnga// lus stod dbang po mgo la gnas pa ni//ma rgo mig rna ba sna dang mchu so lce// rkan dang gre ba lnga ba nam tshong nad// gre bar gnas pa nad dang gag pa dang // mgul 'gags nad dang skad 'gags rnam pa bzhi// nam tshong spyir gnas skom dad skyigs bu dang // dbugs mi bde dang yid 'chus rnam pa lnga// spyi ru sdoms pas dbye ba bco brgyad bshad//don snod nang la gnas pa'i nad bstan pa// snying dang glo ba mchin mtsher mkhal ma dang // pho ba mkhris pa rgyu long sgang pa dang // bsam se'i nad dang rnam pa bcu gcig go / don snod spyir gnas ma zhu glang thabs skran// sur ya tshad 'khru rgyu gzer rnam pa drug / snod sbyir gnas pa 'khru skyug rnam pa gnyis//spyi ru sdoms pas nad rigs bcu dgu 'o// smad nad gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol ba dang // rtug 'gags gcin 'gags gcin snyi rnam pa lnga// phyir gnas pags pa sha dang rtsa rus te// pags pa'i nad la sha bkra bas ldogs dang // g.yan pa glang shu za kong shu ba dang // reg pa'i dug dang mdzer pa ngo khab dang // nad gzhan pags la gram dang bcu ru bshad// sha yi nad la wa ba men bu gnyis// nad gzhan sha la rgyas dang rnam pa gsum// rtsa yi nad la rtsa dkar rtsa nag gnyis/ nad gzhan rtsa ru rgyug dang rnam pa gsum// rus pa'i nad la dreg dang rkang bam gnyis// nad gzhan rus la zhen dang rnam pa gsum// sha rus kun la gnas pa grum bu'i nad// spyi ru sdoms pas nyi shu tham pa 'o// phyi nang kun tu khyab pa'i nad rigs la/ mkhris pa sprug po dmu 'or skya rbab gcong // tsha ba sde drug 'grams 'khrugs rims nad dang // 'brum bu lhog pa sbyar dug rdzi zer dug / rlangs dug sha dug mi 'phrod pa yi dug /btsan dug khyi dug srin bu sbrul gyi dug / 'byung po gza' dang mdze 'bras me dbal srin// mgo dang byang khog yan lag ske yi ma spyi ru sdoms pas sum cu

52 sto/grwa nga rgyud ba /rtsa bdun te// brgya dang rtsa gcig gnas kyi dbye bar 'dod// rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na khong nad dang // rma dang tshad pa thor bu'i nad rigs bzhi// dang po khong nad sgo nas dbye ba la/ ma zhu rgyu dang 'bras bu gcong nad gnyis//ma zhu ngo bo rigs grogs dus kyis bzhi// 'bras bu gcong nad dbye ba gsar rnying gnyis// gsar pa bad kun skya bo smug po dang // mkhris pa'i nad dang dug gcong rnam pa bzhi// skya bo lhon dang lcags dreg me nyams dang // mgul 'gags grum bu dkar po 'ju skems drug / sprug po byer rgyas rdol ral 'gyings dang 'dril// gab 'thab thor lhung grang ba snying chad bcu// mkhris pa kha lud rtsa rgyug gnas gyur gsum// dug gi gcong la tsha sbyor grang spyor gnyis// rnying pa skran dang dmu 'or skya rbab bzhi// gcong chen zad byed nad dang rnam pa lnga// skran la khrag mkhris nyen dang rdo yi skran// rlung srin rtsa chu'i skran dang brgyad du bshad// dpu chu byer zags 'khyims chu rdol chu bzhi//'or la tsha 'or grang 'or rnam pa gnyis// skya rbab glo snying mchin mtsher chu ser lnga// za byed rlung mkhris bad kun bla gnyan bzhi// khong nad spyir sdoms ba'i bcu rtsa brgyad do// rma la lhan cig skyes dang blo bur ba// lhan skyes 'bras dang men bu sur ya dang // me dbal gzhang 'brum rkang bam mtshan bar rdol// blo bur rma la gnas dang rigs kyis dbye// gnas ni mgo rke byang khogs yan lag la// rma rigs bshus bcad rnam par bcad pa dang // 'phyang lhung phug bshags grugs pa rnam pa brgyad// spyi ru sdoms pas dbye ba bcu drug go / tsha ba ma smin rgyas stongs gab rnyings rnyogs// 'grams 'khrugs rims nad dug tshad rnam pa ba'i// 'grams la phyi 'grams nang 'grams rnam pa gnyis//'khrugs la rgyas 'khrugs stong 'khrugs 'jam 'khrugs gsum// rims la bal nad rgyu gzer 'brum pa dang // gag lhog cham pa'i nad dang rnam pa lnga/dug la sbyar dug gyur pa dngos dang gsum// thor bu skad 'gags skyigs bu

zhus shad pa sku yi da/ 53yi ga 'chus// skom dad dbugs mi bde dang glang thabs srin// 'khru skyug dri ma gcin 'gags gcin snyi dang // tshad 'khru dreg thum chu ser rtsa dkar dang //pags pa'i nad dang thor bu bcu dgu'o// brgya dang rtsa gcig rigs kyi dbye bar 'dod// de ltar nyes pa gtso bo rigs gnas bzhi'i// dbye ba bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad yod de// de la gzhan dbang bcos kyang 'chi ba dang // kun brtags gdon nad rim gros grol ba dang // yongs grub ma bcos 'chi la bcos na 'tsho// ltar snang ma bcos rang bzhin 'tsho ba bzhi// gcig la'ang bzhi sbyar bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir 'gyur// rnam pa'i sgo nas dpag tu med par dbye// nyes pa gnod bya nyi shu rtsa lnga la// rkyang pa ldan 'dus du ma'i rigs 'byung bas// grangs dang ming gi nges bstan yod ma yin// 'on kyang nyes pa gsum las nad mi 'da'// gnod bya bcu las nad kyi gnas mi 'da'//dper na 'dab chags bya yis gar 'phur yang // nam mkha'i mthongs las 'phur sa med pa bzhin// bad rlung grang la khrag mkhris tsha bas na/ du mar phye yang tsha grang gnyis su 'dus so so'i don la rgyu dang sngar tshul dang // tshul phyed pa dang dkyel du gyur pa bzhi// rgyu ni rang rang skyed pa'i rkyen yin te/sngar tshul zhes bya bye brag gsal min pa// nad rtags gsal bar gyur pa tshul phyed yin// rang gnas mthar phyin shugs rdzogs dkyel gyur to// de la rnam grangs brtag pa gtso bo stobs// rnam grangs nad rigs nang tshegs dbye ba ste// brtag pa de rnams ma 'dres phyed pa yin// gtso bo rang rgyud can dang ga 'an rgyud can// de la sngar skyes bla gnyan bcas pa'o// nad stobs yul dus rang bzhin na tshod dang / nad khams zas spyod dbang gis gnyis su 'gyur// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las nad byi dbye ba bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //

54le'u bcu gsum pa/ nyin re bzhin rgyun du spyod pa de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// bya ba spyod lam gnas la ci ltar bslab par bgyi / 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bzhud du gsol/ zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / nad la gso bar byed pa'i gnyen po yi// bya ba spyod lam gnas la bslab bya na// rgyun spyod dus spyod gnas skabs spyod lam gsum// de la nyin re rgyun du spyod pa'i las// tshe rkyang 'jig rten pa dang dam pa'i 'o// dang po tshe rkyang pa yi spyod lam ni// rtag tu bde gnas 'dod cing tshe bsring phyir// sman ma chog rin chen grub pa'i gsang sngags bcang // nad slong rkyen gnyis dran pas rtag tu spang // lus ngag yid las nyes spang yang dag bsten// lce sogs dbang po mnar dang nyams bder min// the tshom gru 'am mi srun bzhon pa dang //gsod sa chu chen me yi phung po dang // gad steng shing rtser dbyar rgun 'dzeg 'gro spang / sdod na sa brtag 'gro na lam brtag cing // mtshan mo don chen dbyug thogs grogs ldan bya// mtshan nyid ma log tsub pas ci bder log /ma log nang par snang bya phyed gnyid log / ra ro stobs zad mya ngan rtsol bas dub// smra mang rgas dang 'jigs pa'i mi rnams la// so ga tsub cing mtshan mo thung bas na// lus kyi stobs 'phrog rlung 'phel 'gyur ba'i phyir nyin par gnyid log snum rtsir 'gyur bas phan// gzhan du nyin gnyid bad kun skyed cing skrangs// rmongs bag mgo na gyid myur rims 'debs 'gyur// gnyid 'phel gas dang snang bya bud med bston// gnyid yer 'o ma zho chang sha khu btung // mgo bo bsku zhing rna ba snum gyis dgang // nyal po skye gnas mi

sa bshad pa sku yi da/ 55mthun bdag po can// mi sdug sgrum ma shugs zhan nyen pa dang // zla mtshan ldan dus bkan byed 'khrig pa spang / dgun dus ro tsas dregs tshe bkag pa med/ ston dpyid zhag gnyis dbyar sos zla phyed spyad// gzhan du bud med la zhugs dbang po nyams// mgo 'khor dus min 'chi bar byed pa yin rtag tu bsku byug spyod byed rgas ngal rlung / 'joms byed mgo rkang rna ba la bsten bya// lus yang tshil 'bri skabs phyed me drod skyed// mkhregs dang las nus yang rag rtsol spyad 'byung // thal drags log pas de las ma rungs 'gyur// rgan byis rlung mkhris nad can de spang bya// stobs ldan snum za dgun dang dpyid dus dang // bad kun can gyis rtsol bcag bsten par bya//dril phyis bad kun sel zhing tshil 'ju byedaka pags gsal yan lag brtan par byed pa'i mchog / khrus ni ro tsa drod stobs tshe mdangs skyed/ g.ya' rngul dri nga snyom skom lus tsha sel// chu dron mgo bkrus skra mig stobs 'phrog yin// tshad 'khru lto sbos cham pa ma zhu dang // sna mig nad can zos ma thog la spang / mig ni me yi rang bzhin bad kun 'jig / mchi ma 'dzag phyir mig sman skyer khaṇḍa// rtag tu 'ag bdun lon tshe nyin re blug / blo bur nad lnga'i dgra la skyel ma bsten// rtag tu gcig la ma yin kun snyoms spyad/ de ltar bdag ni nyin mtshan gnas 'gro zhes// rtag tu dran pa nyer 'jog sdug bsngal bsring // 'jig rten mi chos spyod pa yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ chad don btsan par bya zhing tshig rjes don gyis bas bka ngan las chad kyang bzlog cing bzang las bshol yang brtsam// gzhig pa sngon la btang zhing phyis kyi legs 'phen bca'// zer dgu bden par mi bzung legs par dpyad la bzung / smra dgu bsams la smra zhing rang gi mdo don bsdam// bud med ngag la mi nyan sbad kha lci bar bya// byams ltos mi la tshig dron mi gzhug lhug par smra/ cam la brling zhing phral la 'grogs pa bde bar bya// dgra bo yan par mi btang

56 sto/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/'dam ring thabs kyis gdul// nye 'khor sha tshas skyang zhing sngar drin mig ring blta// slob dpon pha khu la sogs rgan rigs phud du khur// yul mi mdza' bshes 'grogs dgos rnams dang blo sems bstun// so nam zhib mor bya 'ing dgos dus rtsing por spyad// mi bden 'pham ngos blang zhing rgyal na tshod zin bya// mkhas na dregs pa skyung zhing phyug na chog shes bya/ mi bran khyad du mi bsad mtho la phrag dog spang // mi ngan bsten rdzi mi bya ban bon dgrar mi bslang // gzhan gyi nor la mi rlom la yogs mna' la 'dzem// mi 'gyod rdog gtad bya zhing ngan la dbang mi bskur sems kyi stobs drang ngang ring yangs shing gzhi bskyed la// las rnams phal cher zla tshod dus su blang ba gces// de 'dra gcig pur skyes kyang gzhan la dbang mi 'chor// bran gyi lus kyang skye bo mang po'i dpon du 'gyur// de nas dam pa lha chos spyad pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba 'dod pa'i phyir// rtsom pa kun la 'jug kyang chos med na//bde nyid sdug bsngal rgyu phyir chos la 'bad// mos pas bshes bsten cig thos ring du spang // srog gcod rku dang log par g.yem pa dang // rdzun dang ngag 'khyal tshig tsub g.yen sbyor dang // brnabs sems gnod sems lta ba phyin ci log / sdig pa'i las bcu lus ngag yid kyis spang // mya ngan nad 'phongs sdug la nus phan gdags/ 'bu srin sogs kun rtag tu rang 'drar blta//bsru med des pas 'dzum zhing drang por smra// gnod brtson dgra la'ang phan gdags gtsor byas te// byams pas byang chub mchog gi sems gnyis bskyed//lus ngag yid dul phangs med gtong sems ldan// gzhan gyi don la'ang rang gi 'drar sems pa// de dag dam pa'i spyod pa mthar thug go / zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las nyin re bzhin rgyun du spyod pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// / /

57le'u bcu bzhi pa/ dus su spyod pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / gnyis pa dus su spyod pa'i spyod lam ni dgun ston dgun smad dpyid dang so ga dang // dbyar ston dgun zla ra sogs gnyis rim bzhin// skad cig la sogs thangs cig yud tsam la//nyin zhag zla ba dus dang lor 'gyur te// nyi ma brgyad gsum dbyar rgun dbus su'ang bzlog / gsum ni lho dang byang du 'gro zhes bya// nam dang nyi ma phyed na mnyam pa yin// brgyad dang bcu na sgra sgrogs chad par 'gyur de la dgun zla tha chung la sogs pa// nyi ma byang du 'gro ba'i dus kyi tshe// shin tu rno tsha tsub pa'i ngo bor 'gyur// rlung dang nyi ma dag gi nus stobs kyis// zla ba sa yi yon tan zad par byed// 'dir ni tsha bska kha ba'i ro stobs che/ mi rnams byi ni mthu stobs nyin re 'phrog / char dus lho phyogs 'gro tshe slar stobs skyed// bsil ba zla ba'i stobs ldan nyi ma 'bri/ char bab rlung gis sa steng tsha ba zhi// skyur dang lan tsha mngar ba'i ro stobs skyed dgun che sos dang dbyar chung ston dpyid 'bring // de ltar bgrod dus rnam pa gnyis bstan nas// da ni nam zla dus drug spyod lam ni// dgun stod grang bas ba spu'i sgo bkag ste// me yi stobs ldan rlung gis sbar ba yis// zas nyung gyur na lus zungs 'grib bar 'gyur// de phyir dang po'i ro gsum bsten par bya/ de tshe mtshan mo ring bas bkres gyur te// de yis lus zungs 'grib par 'gyur ba'i phyir// til mar gyis byug sha khu snum pa bza' pags pa'i gos dang lham ni

58 zhu/grwa thang da ba /rtag tu bsgo dugs dang me nyi'i 'od la ran par bsro// sa yi khang pa nyis rim nang du bsdad/ dgun smad dus na lhag par grang bas na / der yang spyod lam 'di nyid spyad par bsngags// dgun dus bad gan khog tu gsog pa ste// dpyid dus nyi 'od dros pas me drod nyams/ bad kun ldang zhing tha ma'i ro gsum bsten/ nas rnying skam sa'i sha dang sbrang rtsi dang // chu bskol sga thang btang zhing tsub pa bsten/ rtsol bas bcag dang dril phyis bad kun bsal//dri zhim skyed mos tshal gyi nyi grib 'dug / so ga nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha bas//stobs 'phrog phyir na mthor yang snum bsil bza'/ lan tsha tsha skyur rtsol ba nyi 'od spang // bsil chus lus bkru chang chu bsres pa btung rab phra'i gos bgo bsil khang dri bzang bsten// shing grib rdzi char bser bu ngan ldan bya/dbyar dus mkha' la spyin 'dus chu yis rlan// rlung dang grang ba sa rlangs chu rnyog can me drod gnod pas me drod skyed pa bsten// dang po'i ro gsum yang dro snum bcas bza'// skam sa'i chang btung khang steng bsil spangs gnas/ dbyar bsil phral du lus la nyi zer gdungs// char dus bsags pa'i mkhris pa ston na ldang / de bsal phyir na mngar kha bska ba bsten// ga bur tsan dan mu shir dri ldan pa'i/ gos bsgo khang pa chag chag btab par 'dug / mdor na zas skom dbyar dgun dro ba bsten// dbyin rtsub sos dang ston ga bsil bar bya/ dbyar dang dgun ni dang po'i ro gsum bsten//dpyid ka tha ma'i ro gsum so ga mngar/ ston ga mngar kha bska ba bsten par bya// ston dbyin bshal phyugs gtar ga 'jam rtsi bsngags dman lhag log na de dang 'tsham par dpyad/ ces gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dus su spyad pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //

59———le'u btso lnga pa/ gnas skabs kyi spyod lam bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang sro nga chen po nyon cig / gsum pa gnas skabs spyod pa bstan pa ni//bkres skoms skyug pa g.yal dang sbrid pa dang // dbugs gnyid lud pa mchil ma ba ming ba 'phyen// gcin dang khu ba'i shugs ni dgag mi bya/ bkres bkag lus zhig nyams chung yi ga 'chus// mgo 'khor de zas yang snum dro chung sbyar// skom bkag kha skam mgo 'khor snying nad 'byung // myos 'gyur de bsil cho ga thams cad phan// skyugs bkag dang ga 'gag dang dbugs mi bde// skya rbab me dbal g.yan pa 'bras dang mdze// mig nad lud pa rims nad 'byung bar 'gyur// smyung gnas dud rnon kha bkang dbo bar bya/ sbyin bkag dbang po mi rno mgo bo na// gnya' ba rengs dang kha yo 'grum chag 'gyur// dud non sna sman nyi ma blta bas bsal g.yal bkag de 'dra cho ga rlung 'joms phan// ngal dub dbugs bkag skran dang snying nad 'byung |myos 'gyur der ni ngal so rlung 'phel phan// gnyid bkag g.yal mang lus rnyong mgo bo lci// mig 'grib kha zas mi 'ju sha khu dang // chang btung bsku mnye bya zhing gnyid log phan// lud pa bkag pas lud 'phel dbugs mi bde// sha skem skyigs bu snying nad yi ga 'chu der ni lud pa bsal pa'i cho ga bya// mchil ma bkag pas snying dang mgo bo na// sna chu 'dzag cing mgo 'khor yi ga 'chus// de la chang btung gnyid log gtam snyan phan 'phyen bkag rtug skams 'phyen dang bshang ba 'gag / skran gzer mig rtul drod

60 zhug thang dba'i/chung snying nad 'gyur// bshang ba bkag pas kha ru mi gtsang 'byung // glad pa na zhing nya 'gyur cham pas 'debs// sngar bshad nad 'gyur gcin bkag lde'u nad dang // chu so pho mtshan dku nad sngar nad dbyung // de sman reng bu mas btang lus bcing dang // bsku byug dugs dang sman mar bsten par bya//khu ba bkag pas de 'dzag pho mtshan na// chu 'gag rde'u 'phel dang ma ning 'gyur// mas btang lus bcing bud med spyad par bya// til mar 'o ma khyim bya sha chang btang / de ltar shugs ni bkag dang btsir ba yis// nad kun 'byung 'gyur phral du rlung 'khrug pas// de phyir de yi zas dang sman skom sbyar//nad gang smyung dang zhi bas bzhu byas kyang // ro ma ldang 'gyur legs sbyangs slar mi 'byung // de phyir dgun bsags grang nad dpyid dus sbyang // sos bsags dbyar sbyang dbyar bsags ston dus sbyang // legs par sbyangs pas ro thon nad med 'gyur// rtag tu phan pa'i zas dang spyod lam rnams//nyams ldan bsten par byed na nad mi 'byung // nad kun mi skye skyes pa'ang zhi bya'i phyir// gnas skabs spyod pa'i cho ga 'di nyid bsngags// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gnas skabs kyi spyod lam bstan pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// //

61le'u bcu drug pa/ zas kyi tshul shes par bya ba/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// 'tsho ba zas kyi gnas la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol/ zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / nad la gso bar byed pa'i gnyen po yi 'tsho ba zas kyi gnas la bslab pa ni// zas skom legs spyad lus dang srog 'tsho zhing // dman lhag log gyur nad bskyed phral srog 'joms// de phyir zas sgom sbyor ba mkhas pa gces// 'di la spyi sdoms zas tshul shes pa dang // zas bsnam zas tshod ran par bza' ba gsum// zas kyi tshul shes pa la zas skom gnyis zas la 'bru sha snum ngad g.yos sbyar lnga// 'bru la gnyis te gra ma gang bu can// de la gra ma can gyi 'bru yi sde// 'bras khre khra ma gro nas so ba dang // sred de la sogs ro dang zhu rjes mngar// ro tsa rlung 'joms lus stobs bad gan skyed// de la 'bras ni sdum 'jam bsil la yang // nyes pa gsum sel ro tsa 'khru skyug gcod// khye ni snyi bsil rtas byed chag thugs sbyor// khra ma bsil yang tsub cing yi gar 'phrod/gro ni lci bsil 'tsho byed rlung mkhris sel// nas ni lci bsil bshang 'phel stobs skyed mchog / so ba srid de bsil yang bad mkhris sel gang bu can 'bru sran ma mon sran gnyis// bska mngar bsil yang skya la rtsa sgo 'gag /bad kun tsha ba sel zhing 'khru ba gcod// snum sel khrag mkhris tshil la byugs na phan// rgya sran bad rlung lud pa dbugs mi bde gzhang 'brum khu ba'i de 'joms khrag mkhris skyed// ma sha rlung 'joms bad mkhris khu stobs 'phel sran chung bska mngar nyes pa gsum ga skyed/ skyo mas me dbal dreg nad khrag

62 zhu/grwa thang rgyud bzhi/nad sel// til 'bru lci dro ro tsa rlung nad 'joms// zar ma mngar kha snum 'jam rlung la phan// bra bo bsil yang rma 'jigs nyes gsum skyed// 'bru kun gsar thog rlon pa snyi ba ste// smin gyur skams dang rnying pa yang ba yin//rjen pa btsos dang g.yos su byas pa kun rim bzhin yang zhing 'ju bla 'phrod par 'gyur/ sha ni sde brgyad skam gsher thun mong gnas// rma bya gong sreg skyung ga bya nag dang // ri bya rnams ni khron gyis rko ba'i sde// ba tso khu byug thi ba kye ga dang // 'jol mo byi'u mchu yis sko ba'i sde// sha ba gla dgo rnyan dang ri bong dang // gtsod kyi sha rnams ri dwags sde tshan yin// rgya dang kha sha ra rgod phag rgod dang // ma he bse sprug rkyang dang g.yag rgod dang // mdzo rgod la sogs ri dgas che ba'i sde// stag gzig dom dred bsa' dang spyang gi dbyi//wa dang 'phar ba sbre sogs gcan gzan sde// bya rgod khu rlag ba le bya rog dang // 'ug pa bye'u khra rtsal mthus za ba'i sde// mdzo g.yag rnga mo rta bong ba lang dang // skom po ra lug khyi dang phag pa bya| byi la la sogs mi yis bdag byed sde// phyi ba byi thur sbal sbrul gum pa dang // migs pa rtsangs pa sdig pa khung gnas sde/ khrung khrung ngang ngur so bya skyar mo dang // sram dang nya sogs rlan la gnas pa'i sde// sde brgyad sha rnams ro dang zhu rjes mngar// thog mtha' bar ma skam gsher thun mong gnas// skam sa'i sha rnams bsil zhing yang la tsub// rlung dang bad kun ldan pa'i tsha ba sel// rlan gnas sha rnams snum zhing lci la dro// pho ba mkhal rked grang rlung nad la phan// thun mong gnas pa nus pa gnyis dang ldan// bya gcan rtsal mthus sha rlon za ba rnams// rtsub yang rno bas pho ba'i me drod skyed// skran bsheg sha 'phel grang ba'i nad kun sel// lug sha snum dro stobs 'phel lus zungs skyed// rlung dang bad kun sel zhing dang ga 'byed// ra sha lci bsil nyes pa gsum slong zhing // bse dug 'brum nag mes tshig rma la phan/ ba lang bsil snum rlung ldan tsha ba sel rta

sa kha da pa yi da/ 63rkyang bong bu la sogs bshul sha rnams/ rnag gcod mkhal rked grang ba chu ser sel// phag sha bsil yang rma 'jig srug po sel/ ma nye'i sha yis gnyid dang sha 'phel byed// g.yag sha snum dro grang sel khrag mkhris skyed// khyim bya byi'u khu 'phel rma la phan// g.yag rgod pho mchin grang sel me drod skyed// ri dgas bsil yang ldan tshad sel bar byed/ ri bong sha tsub drod skyed 'khru ba gcod// phyi ba snum lci dro zhing 'bras la phan/ grang rlung pho ba mkhal rked mgo nad sel// sram sha ro tsa mkhal rked grang ba sel// nya sha pho ba'i nad sel dang ga 'byed// mig gsal rma 'bras bad gan bshig par byed/ sha kun pho mo'i stod smad phyed lci ste// sbrum ma kun lci rkang bzhi mo yi yang / bya rnams kun ni pho yi yang ba yin// mgo dang ro stod brang rgyab dpyi rten ci/ lus zungs bdun po phyi ma phyi ma lci/ sha gsar bsil zhing sha rnying dro la bcud//lo sha khyad par rlung gnon me drod skyed// rlon pa 'khyags po bsregs pa 'ju dka' bsil// skam dang btsos pa yang zhing 'ju ba bla sdum ni mar dang til mar rkang mar tshil// ro mngar phyi ma rtsi bsil khong 'khru snum rtul dang phra la mnyen zhing rlan pa yin// gas byis stobs chung speg tsub khu khrag zad/sbyang byas sems las rlung gis nyen la bsngags// de la mar gsar bsil zhing ro tsa la// mdog stobs skyed cing mkhris tshad sel bar byed/ mar rnying smyo dang brjed byed rgyal rma 'tsho// zhun mar blo rno dran gsal drod stobs skyed/tshe 'phel snum pa'i mchog ste las stong byed phum gsar sbri dang chur ba la sogs pa// dang ga len zhing tsug skems bad ken 'phel zo mar bad rlung sel zhing me drod skyed 'bri dang lug mar de bzhin grang rlung sel/ mdzo snyoms ba ra bsil bas rlung tshad sel til mar tsha rno skem po sha skyed cing ⑪sbom po 'bri la mkhregs te bad rlung sol/ yungs mar rlung gnon bad mkhris skyed pa yin// rkang mar rlung 'joms khu stobs bad kun skyed/ tshil gyis

64 sa /grwa nga dab /nus tshigs na dang mes tshig dang // rlung dang rna glad mngal nad sel bar byed// skyes bu snum la brten par byed pa rnams/ nang gi drod 'bar khong pa dag pa dang // lus zungs phral rtas stobs dang mdog bzang ldan// dbang brtan rgas sra lo brgya thub par bshad// sngo ngan sgog btsong la sogs tsha ba dang 5 khur mangs rgya khur la sogs kha ba dang // skam dang gsher ba'i gnas su skyes pa dang / skam dang rlon pa g.yos byas rjen pa rnams// dro yang bsil lci grang ba tshad nad sel// tsong sgog gnyid 'phel zas len bad rlung sel//sgog skya lci bsil srin nad tshan rlung sel / la phug gzhon nu yang dro me drod skyed// nar son lci bsil bad kun skyed par byed// nyung ma de bzhin dug nad ma lus bsrung // ri sgog thams cad 'ju dka' zas len lci// lcam dang chu los bad gan dang ga 'byed// sngo kun rtsa sgo 'gag cing sman nus 'joms//de la g.yos su byas pa'i zas sde la// 'bras thug sla dang ska dang gar ba dang //'bras chan rnams ni snga ma snga ma yang // sla ba skom snya nyes pa lhag ma 'joms//'ju zhing zungs snyoms drod skyed rtsa sbubs mnyen// ska ba drod skyed bkres skom nyams chung snya// nad 'ju byed cing dri ma 'gags pa sel// thug gar 'khru gcod yid 'ong skom pa sel// de phyir rim pas nyams chung khrus rjes bsngags// 'bras chan legs btsos tsha ba'i sman dang bskol// yang zhing 'ju bla sha khu 'o bskol lci// 'bras pos 'khru ba gcod dang rus chag sbyor// srus thug nas thug rgyun 'gag me drod 'joms// yos dral yang zhing 'jam dro pho bar 'phrod tsam pa grang mo stobs skyed snyi ba yin// btsos zan yang la 'jam pas 'ju ba bla// khengs po thams cad pho ba'i me drod 'joms// a sbyar 'ju bla stobs 'phrog nyes kun sel// zan chang rlung sel khong pa'i drod la phan// skyur po zas len nyes sel rnyings zhabs dmad// sha khu nyams rtas tshim byed rlung la phan zan skam tshod ma rlung la mchog tu bsngags// zwa tshod

sa kha da pa sku yi da/ 65rlung 'joms drod skyed bad mkhris slong // lcam pa bee khur drod skyed 'khru ba gcod// do tshod rlung 'joms rma skems bad mkhris skyed// sno tshod mig la gnod cing rtug skam sel// pon sne dmar pos nyes pa gsum ga sel//skyabs dang khur tshon bsil te tsha ba sel/ sngo sga'i tsha ba mkhris tshad mgo nad sel// sran tshod kha zas len zhing bad rlung skyed lus kyi snum 'don 'bru mar ma zhu sel// lo gsar snyoms shing bshur bas bad rlung skyed// yungs mar lo ma bad mkhris 'khrug par byed// lca ba ra mnye'i tshod mas bad rlung sel// la phug tsha ba drod skyed 'khru ba gcod// sgog skya sgog sngon tsha ba rlung la phan// lan tsha kha zas kun gyi bro ba skyed// drod skyed 'ju ba bla zhing bshang ba 'byin// g.yer mas rtsa sgo 'byed cing bad rlung skyed// sga yis drod skyed shing kun rlung nad 'joms// spod kun zas kyi bro skyed yi gar 'ong / btung ba 'o ma chu dang chang la sogs// rim bzhin nad sel bzlog pas de rab skyed// 'o ma phal cher ro dang zhu rjes mngar// snum rtsi zungs 'phel mdangs skyed rlung mkhris sel// ro tsa bad kun skyed bsil snyi ba yin// ba yi 'o ma glo rdol gcong la phan// rims rnying gcin snyi yid gzhungs 'tsho byed yin// ra yi 'o mas dbugs mi bde ba sel// lug gi 'o mas rlung 'joms snying la gnod 'bri yi 'o ma bad mkhris nad la gnod// rta bong 'o ma glo gso rmongs par byed//'o rlon lci bsil srin dang bad kun skyed// bskol na yang dro bsdus na 'ju dka' lci// bzhos thog 'o ma dron mo bdud rtsir mtshungs// 'o ma snying po bton pa'i zho skya yis ma snyoms rims cham 'grams 'khrugs 'khru ba sel zho thun ro dang zhu rjes skyur bsil snum// rtug skem rlung tshad sel zhing yi ga 'byed// dar gsar bska skyur yang zhing me drod skyed// skran mtsher gzhang 'brum mar ma zhu ba sel// zho kha chu 'khru bshang sla rtsa sgrubs sbyong // chur khus rlung mkhris mi skye bad kun sel// zho btsos tug skem tshad pas 'khru ba sel//

66 sa /grwa nga da bzhi/dkar rnams lug dang 'bri yi dro la bcud/ ba ra bsil yang mdzo yi snyoms pa yin// chu ni char chu gangs chu chu klung chu// chu mig khron pa ba tsha shing gi chu//rim pas dang po mchog yin phyi ma dman// mkha' las 'bab pa ro mi gsal la zhim/ 'tsho ngoms bsil la yang bas bdud rtsir mtshungs/ gangs can las byung shugs drag brdabs pa'i chu shin tu bzang bas me yis thub par dka'// brtan g.yung srin bu rkang bam snying nad skyed// sa gtsang nyi 'od rlung gis phog pa bzang // 'dam rdzab nya rtsibs rtsa lo shing grib phog / ba tsha srog chags khu bas nyes kun skyed chu bsil rgyal ngal chang nad mgo 'khor skyug / skom dad lus tsha khrag mkhris sel bar byed// chu bskol drod skyed zas 'ju skyigs bu sel// bad zhan lto sbos dbugs mi bde ba dang // cham pa rims gsar phral du zlog par byed// bskol grangs bad kun mi skyed mkhris pa sel// zhag gcig lon nas dug 'dra nyes kun skyed// chang ni mngar skyur kha la zhu rjes sgyur// rno dro tsub phra cung zad thur du 'khru// drod 'bar spobs skyed gnyid 'phel bad rlung sel// thal drags sems bsgyur bag med ngo tsha 'jig / ra ro dang po bag med gnas la gnas// rnam rtog ngan bcom bde ba yin snyam sem// ra ro gnyis pa glang chen spyon pa ltar// kha na ma tho tshul khrims 'chal pa'i gnas/ ra ro tha ma sems med ro ltar nyal// gang yang mi shes mun pa'i gnas su 'gyur// gsar pa lci zhing rnying pa yang ba yin//gsar 'jam pho ba'i drod skyed 'ju ba bla// gro chang 'bras chang nas chang gong ma lci// so ba sred de yos chang yang ba yin// tsha ni khrag mkhris bad kun sel bar byed// ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las zas kyi tshul shes par bya ba'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //

67le'u bcu bdun pa/ kha zas bsdam pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / zas skom bsdam bya dug ldan mi 'phrod zas//phral du srog 'dor nyes pa 'khrug phyir bsrung // rgyal po'i pho brang srog mtsho'i slob dpon bzhag / des ni zas skom dug las thar bar 'gyur// dug ldan zas de kha dog dri ro ldog / mes tshig du ba rma bya'i mgrin 'dra 'byung // me lce gcig tu 'khyil zhing me stag rgal// mthong na bya rog skad 'don rma bya dga'//khyi la byin na lto ba dros nas skyug / sha la dug yod dmar la lcags mi len/sbos shing chang sbyar mig bdugs tsha zhing 'khrug / dug ster chag tshang mi de kha skam zhing // rngul zhing 'dar la skrag cing 'dug mi tshugs// gnong bag gis ni phyogs su lta bar byed// shes nas kun la gnod par 'gyur phyir dor// kha zas mi 'phrod zos pas sbyar dug mtshungs// zho ma langs dang chang gsar mi 'phrod de// nya yi sha dang 'o mar 'phrod pa min// de bzhin 'o ma shing thog gnyis mi 'phrod// bya yi sgo nga nya yi sha mi 'phrod// sran ma'i tshod ma bu ram zhor mi 'phrod// sha mo yungs kur mar la brngos pa dang // khyim bya'i sha dang zho bsres za ba dang // mar gsar 'khar ba'i snod du zhag bcu las// skyer pa'i me la ha ri tra sha bsregs// cong zhi zos rjes sha mo khur ba za// zhun mar zos rjes chu grang 'thung ba dang // sha la dkar skyur tsam dris phog pa dang //btsos pa'i rlangs bsrubs zhag bdun lon pa dang // skyur dang 'o ma lhan cig za ba dang 5 snga ma ma zhu phyi ma thos pa yis// kha zas mi 'phrod zos pas

68 sto/grwa thang rgyud ba /'thab pa dang // ma goms dus min zos pas dug tu 'gyur// rtsol bcas snum bston drod che dar la bab// stobs ldan goms par zos la gnod mi 'gyur// mi 'phrod 'phrod pa bsten nam spong byed na// 'dris goms sgo nas cha yis bslab par bya// phral du spang bsten nyes pa myur du 'khrug / gnod pa gnod bya'i bdag nyid nyer gyur pas/ phan med gnod par byed pa mkhas pas spang // zhes gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las kha zas bsdam pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //

69le'u bco brgyad pa/ kha zas bsrung ba dang zas chod ran par bza' ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dus kun tu ni zas tshod ran par bza'//zas rnams lci yang tshad las dpags bya ste// yang la 'drangs shing lci la phyed 'drangs tsam// bde blag 'ju bla tshod zin zhes su bshad// de ni lus 'tsho me drod skyed byed yin// gal te zas tshod ma zin chungs gyur na// stobs mdangs mi 'phel rlung nad ma lus 'byung // tshad las thal na ma zhu bee snabs skyed// de yis me mnyam rlung rgyu'i rtsa sbubs bkag / pho ba'i drod nyams nyes pa ma lus skyed// de phyir zas dang pho ba'i me drod sbyar// lto ba'i cha gnyis zas la cha gcig skom// cha ba'i pa ni rlung gi gnas su bzhag / zas zos rjes su skom 'thungs ngoms dang khyab// zas 'drul 'ju zhing lus rtas stobs 'phel byed// skad 'gags glo rdol lud pa cham pa dang // nam tshong yan chad nad la gnod pa yin// me drod chung la sha zos chang 'thung bya// mi 'ju sbos na zos rjes chu bskol btung // skem po rgyas par byed na chang btung bya/ sbom po dbri la sprang rtsi'i chu btung ngo // zho chang dug sbags sbrang rtsi zos pa la//rjes su chu bsil 'thungs na phan pa yin// zas zos bar mtha' thog mar skom 'thungs na// nyams tshag ran zhing sbom dang skem por 'gyur// nyes pa lam min mi 'gro me drod 'bar/ lus yang dang ga bde la dbang po gsal//stobs che bshang gci 'og rlung bde bar rgyu zas tshod legs par zin las

70 ༄tsho/grwa nga dba'i/'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las kha zas bsrung ba dang zas tshod ran par bza' ba'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// / /

71ri le'u bcu dgu pa/ ro dang zhu rjes bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so/ kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// sbyor ba sman gyi gnas la ji ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / nad la gso bar byed pa'i gnyen po yi// sbyor ba sman gyi gnas la bslab bya na// ro dang zhu rjes nus pa sbyar thabs ba'i// dang po ro la rten dang dbye ba dang ⑪ngo bo sde tshan las dang rnam pa lnga// rten ni 'byung ba lnga las skye 'gyur te/ sa yis gzhi rten chus rlan me yis drod// rlung gis skyod byed nam mkhas go phye bas// des bskyed gyur kyang shas cher ro gcig min/ sa chu me sa chu me chu dang rlung // me rlung sa rlung gnyis kyis ro drug skyedaka sa sman lci brtan rtul 'jam sdum la skam// mkhrang zhing rten dang sdud byed rlung nad sel/ chu sman sla bsil lci rtul snam la mnyen// brlan 'ing 'jam la sdud byed mkhris nad sel// me sman tsha rno skam tsub yang snum g.yo// drod skyed smin cing mdog byed bad gan sel// rlung sman yang g.yo grang tsub skya la skam// sra zhing skyod dang khyab byed bad mkhris sel// nam mkha' 'byung gzhi'i sman la spyir khyab ste/khong stong yangs pa'i go 'byed 'dus nad sel// de bas dngos dang sbyar ba'i dbang gyur las// sa steng sman min ci yang yod ma yin// gyen 'dren sman ni pe dang rlung yin te// thur 'gro sa dang chu las byung ba'i phyir// bkru sman phal cher dang po'i ro las 'byung / ro ni mngar skyur lan tsha kha tsha bska// go rim

72 ༄gyi grwa nga da bzhi/bzhin du 'tsho byed stobs chen yin// ngo bo lce la gsal bas ro zhes bya// de yang mngar ba'i ro de myangs pa'i tshe// kha la chags shing zhim pas sred pa skye//skyur ba so brtse bzhin sdud kha chu 'dzag / lan tsha reg na tsha zhing mchil ma 'du//kha ba kha yi dri sbyong yi ga ldo ga / tsha ba kha lce bsreg cing mig chu 'dzag / bska ba lce rkan la chags tsub snyam byed// ro drug so so sman gyi sde bstan pa// shing mngar rgun 'brum gur gum cu gang dang // dong ga ra mnye nye shing lca ba dang //ka ra bu ram sgrang dang sha mar sogs// de dang de 'dra mngar ba'i sman sde yin//se 'bru star bu bse yab skyu ru ra// rgya shug da trig zho dar chang dang rtsabs//de dang de 'dra la sogs skyur ba'i sde// rgyam tsha rgya tsha lce myang tsha dang ni// rwa tsha kha ru tsha dang rtsabs ru tsha// ze tsha lnga tsha mdze tsha thal tsha dang / shing tsha ya ba'i ra bul rtog rnams// de dang de 'dra la sogs lan tsha'i sde/ nim pa tig ta bong nga dkar po dang // hong len gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung // gla rtsi mkhris pa skyer pa ba sha ka/ brag zhun kyi lce re skon la sogs pa// de dang de 'dras ba'i sman sde yin// na le sham dang bca' sga pi pi ling // sge gsher shing kun srub ka lce tsha ba// do ba tsong dang sgog skya la sogs pa// de dang de 'dra tsha ba'i sman sde yin// tsan dan a ru ra dang ba ru ra// utpal ga dur smag dang mon cha ra// 'om bu la sogs de 'dra bska ba'i sde// ga bur chu ma tsi la sogs pa yi// ldan pa'i ro rnams de las sgros te dpyad// nad gang sel ba ro yi las bstan pa// mngar skyur lan tsha tsha bas rlung 'joms thing // la dang mngar dang bska bas ma khris pa sel // tsha skyur lan tshas bad kun sel bar byed// khyad par mngar bas 'phrod cing zungs stobs skyed / rgas byis skem po gre ba glo la phan// lus rtas rma 'byor mdangs bkra dbang po bzang // tshe ring 'tsho byed dug dang rlung mkhris sel// bsten drags bad kun tshil skyed me drod 'bri// lus sbom gcin nad lba ba then bu skyed// skyur bas drod skyed yi ga

༄gyi bshad pa sku yi rgyud/ 73'byed pa dang // tshil 'drul gcod byed 'ju zhing reg pa bsil rlung 'gags rgyu 'i dza bsten drags khrag mkhris skyed/ lus lhod rab rib mgo 'khor skya rbab 'or// me dbal g.yan pa thor bu skom rims skyed// lan chos sra 'khyil 'gags pa 'byin pa dang // dugs kyis jul dang drod skyed yi ga 'byed// bston drags skra 'byi skra dkar gnyer ma mang // stobs 'bri skom mdze me dbal khrag mkhris skyedaka kha bas yi ga 'chus dang srin skom dug /mdze dang rgyal dang rims rlon mkhris pa 'joms// 'drul dang tshil zhag rkang mar bshang gci skom// yid gzhungs nu ma'i nad dang skad 'gags sel//bsten drags zungs 'dzad rlung dang bad kun skyed// tsha bas lkog nad gag pa mdze 'or sel// rma 'jig drod skyed 'ju byed yi ga 'byed// tshil dang 'drul bag skem sbyor rtsa sbubs 'byed// bsten drags khu ba stobs zad lus 'khums 'dar// brgyal zhing rked pa rgyab sogs na bar byed// bska bas khrag mkhris tshil dang 'drul bag skem// rma 'tsho tshil dang pags mdog dngas par byed//bsten drags bee snabs 'khyil dang bshang ba sri// lto sbo snying nad skem dang rtsa sgo 'gag / mdor bsdus mngar ba'i ro yis rlung mkhris sel// nas snying skam sa 'i sha rnams ma gtogs pa// phal cher bad kun skyed par byed na yang //g.yag rgod nya lug sha dang sbrang rtsi phan// myur bas bad gan sel byed mkhris skyed kyang / skyu ru ra yis khrag mkhris tsha ba sel// lan tshas rlung dang bad kun sel byed cing // lce myang rgyam tsha ma gtogs mkhris pa skyed// ha cang thaladrags lci bas bad kun skyed// kha bas mkhris sel bad rlung skyed na yang // ka rañdza dang sle tres bad rlung sel// tsha bas rlung dang bad kun sel byed la /sgog skya pi pi ling min mkhris pa skyed// ha cang thal drags yang tsub rlung yang skyed// bska bas mkhris sel a ru ba ru ra// ma gtogs phal cher bad rlung gnyis la gnod// zhu rjes pho ba'i me dang phrad pa'i tshe// bad mkhris rlung gis

74 ༄7/grwa nga rgyud ba /rim par zhu ba las// mngar dang lan tsha'i zhu rjes mngar bar zhu skyur ba ro mtshungs kha tsha bska gsum kha// nyes pa gsum po gnyis gnyis re res sel//zhes gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las ro dang zhu rjes bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// / /

75le'u nyi shu pa/ sman gyi nus pa bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / sman gyi nus pa ro nus ngo bo gnyis// spyi dang bye brag ces su gsungs pa yin dang po nus stobs yon tan gsum du bshad// nus pa lci snam bsil dang rtul ba dang // yang tsub tsha dang rno ba rnam pa brgyad// dang po bzhi pos rlung dang mkhris pa sel// 'og ma bzhi yis bad gan sel bar byed// yang tsub bsil ba gsum gyis rlung skyed cing // tsha rno snum pa gsum gyis mkhris pa skyed// lci snum bsil rtul bzhi yis bad kun skyed// yo na tan ma lus snying por gyur pa dang // nus pa'i khyad par ldan pas mthu zhes brjod// gangs can 'bigs byed nyi zla'i stobs can las// tsha bsil phul du byung bas stobs zhes bya// de la tsha bas grang ba'i nad rnams sel// bsil bas tsha ba'i nad rnams sel bar byed// yo na tan 'jam dang lci dro snam dang brtan// grang dang rtul ba bsil mnyen sla dang skam// skya dang tsha ba rmi nga dang rno tsub g.yo// bcu dang bdun gyis rme tshan nyid nyi shu 'joms//de phyir yon tan tshes su bshad pa yin// de dag phal cher ro las rjes 'byung ste/ ro ni sa sogs rnam sa la brten pa'i phyir// byu snum la sogs de las 'byung ba yin// lan tsha bska mngar rnam gsum rim ba'i na lci// de bzhin lan tsha skyur mthar snum pa yin// bska kha mngar bsil kha bska mngar ba rtul//skyur tsha kha ba rnam gsum yang la rtsub / tsha skyur lan tsha rnam gsum tsha la rno//ro sogs ma bcos gang yang stobs can yin// ro mnyam nus pa so so rten stobs dang // gyur pa sbyar ba'i dbang las 'byung 'gyur te// mi mthun 'og

76 grwa nga da bzhi/mas gong ma zil gyis gnon// thams cad mthun na ro yis las byed la// ro bzhin mi gnod zhu rjes las byed de// ro las go bzlog nus pas las byed pas// ro sdebs nus sdebs zhu rjes sdebs te sbyar// ngo bo rdzas re'i nus pa bstan pa ni// rin po che yi sman dang sa rdo'i sman shing sman rtsi sman thang sman sngo sman dang // srog chags sman dang dbye ba brgyad du bshad// dang po rin po che yi nus pa ni// gser gyis tshe ring rgas sra dbyig dug sel// dngul gyis chu ser nad dang rnag khrag skem// zangs kyis rnag skem glo mchin tsha ba sel// lcags kyis mchin dug mig nad skya rbab sel// g.yu yis dug dang mchin pa'i tsha ba sel// mu tig glad pa 'dzag gcod dug nad sel// nya phyis nus pa mu tig khyad par med// dung gis rnag skem 'gyings 'bigs rus tshad sel// byu rus mchin tshad rtsa tshad dug tshad sel// mu men dug dang chu ser mdze nad sel// rdo yi sman gyi nus pa bstan pa ni// smug po sbal rgyab pho sbal mo sbal gnyis// chu ser 'phul 'dren skem zhing lha ba 'dzin// rus pa chag pa sbyor zhing glad pa sdom// dkar po sbal rgyab dkar po chig thub dang // srug po chig thub la sogs de dang 'dra// gangs thigs de bzhin mchin pa'i tsha ba sel// khab len mde'u 'byin glad rus rtsa nad sel// bee snabs rus sbyor then gcod sha 'u skyed// ma rdzi ra yis nus pa'i tshad pa sel// phag mgos rus pa gso zhing chu ser 'dren// bye mgo de bzhin sha 'u skyed pa dang // gser rdo dngul rdo chu ser 'dren par byed smo stang zil gser zil dngul zil rus mdog 'byin// gru bzhi glad pa gso zhing chu ser 'dren// cog la ma yis rtsa dang lha ba 'dzin/ rdo glad glad pa sdom zhing sha 'u gso// li gris rul gcod ༵ shā/ )pa snru la / //ga/ /khri/ ṭwāṃ rdo rdo /mas tā/zhi nga gā pyi sdo//ma/ldong / zlo sdo rgyus mthing rgyus chu ba gso/ ti tsha ser po rma 'drub mig la phan/ mtshal gyis

sa kha da pa sku yi da/ 77rma 'drub glo mchin rtsa tshad sel// lig pu mig dang tsag yug rnam la sogs/mig nad rus tshan sel zhing chu ser skem// cong gis 'khru gcod bad kun tsha ba sel/ rdo thal pho ba'i bad kun 'dril ba gcod// ha shig rtsa sbyong mo de de nad sel// sa yi sman gyi nus pa bstan pa ni// gser gyi bye mas mkhal nad chu 'gags sel// sin rgya ra yis rtsa tshad don rma gso// rnag khrag skem zhing mes tshig rma la phan ze tshas rdo 'ju de'u rdo skran bshig / ya bakṣa ra drod skyed skran nad sbyong / bul tog rul gcod tsam pa myags par byed// mu zi ser po gdon 'joms rnag khrag skem ka nag mtshur ser mtshur rul gcod skran la bsko// big pan 'bras gcod skran bzhig ling thog len/ rdo dreg dug dang tshad pa rnying pa sel// brag zhun tshad pa'i nad rnams kun la phan//khyad par pho mchin mkhal tshad sel ba'i mchog / shing sman rtsa ba sdom bu sdong po dang // yal ga rkang dang shun pa thang chu dang // lo ma me rtog 'bras bu bcu ru 'gyur// rtsi sman rtsa shing srog chags las byung ba// thang sman rtsa ba ngar pa lo ma dang // me tog 'bras bu lnga ru 'gyur ba yin// de dag gang la gang phan nus pa ni/ ga bur tsha ba rgyas pa thog babs gsod// rnyings shing zhen pa'i tsha ba rtsad nas 'byin// tsan dan dkar pos glo snying 'khrugs tshad sel// tsan dan dmar pos khrag gi tshad pa sel// a ga ru yis snying srog tsha ba sel/ gi waṃ rims dug mchin tshad snod tshad sel// cu gang glo nad kun sel rma tshad gcog / gur gum mchin nad kun sel rtsa kha sdom/ sug sprel mkhal nad grang ba ma lus sel// dzā nyis rlung 'joms snying gi nad rnams sel/ li shes srog rtsa'i nad dang grang rlung sel/ ka ko la yis pho mcher grang ba sel gla rtsis dug srin mkhal mchin gnyan nad sel/ dom mkhris rtsa sdom rul gcod sha 'u skyed// utpal glo mchin tshad pa ma lus sol// nā ga pu khri na ga ge sar dang // padma ge sar glo mchin snying tshan sel/ zi ra dkar pos glo yi tshad pa

78 ༄ / hwa thang rgyud ba'i sel zi ra nag pos ma chin pa'i grang ba sel// la la phud kyis pho nad grang ba sel// so ma ra dzas pags nad chu ser sel // thal ka rdo rje dag kyang de bzhin no/ gser gyi me tog snod tshad mkhris tshad sel / gser gyi phud bus mkhris pa gyen du 'dren// dug mo nyung gis mkhris sel tsha 'khru gcod// rgun 'brum glo nad sel mang tshad pa sbyong / 'u sus pho ba'i bad kun tsha ba sel //star bus glo bzo khrag 'ju bad kun gcod / bse yab bad kun tsha ba sel bar byed// se 'bru pho ba'i nad rnams ma 'u sa sel // me drod skyed cing bad gan grang nad 'joms // na le sham gyis bad kun grang ba sel pi pi ling nas grang nad ma lus sel// sman sgas drod skyed zas len bad rlung 'joms//sga skyas bad rlung sel zhing khrag 'khyags 'ju// tsi tra ka stobs me 'dra me drod skyed// 'or nad gzhang 'brum srin nad mdze nad sel// shing tshas pho mchin grang rlung sel bar byed// ka rañdza yis pho ba'i me drod skyed// thing kun srin 'jom sa grang nad snying rlung sel // byi tang ga yis srin sel me drod skyed// ma ru tse yis srin nad sel bar byed// go gyes srin gsod rus gcod pho rims sel / spos dkar chu ser sbyong zhing skem par byed// gu gul sa gdon lhog pa gnyan gzer 'joms// shel tas lha rus chu ser btson du 'dzin// rgya tshas dug dang srin gso da rtsa nad sbyong // gag pa sha ro gcod cing chu 'gags 'jigs / rgyam tshas bad rlung ma zhu grang ba sel// lce myang tsha yang de bzhin mig la phan// kha ru tsha dang tsabs ru tsha gnyis kyis// drod skyed sbo sgreg 'gyings dang bad rlung 'joms/ rwa tsha thal tshas snod kyi grang ba sel// mdze tshas khrag 'ju rma yi chu ser 'dren// tsha las rma 'drub khrag 'ju sbyong bar byed//lnga tshas lnga ba 'joms par byed pa 'o// a ru lan tsha ma gtogs ro lnga ldan//'tsho byed drod skyed zas 'ju 'phrod par byed// rlung mkhris bad kun las gyur nad kun 'joms// de la rigs lnga rnam rgyal 'jigs med dang // bdud rtsi

sa kha da pa yi rgyud/ 79'phel byed skem po lnga yin te// rnam par rgyal ba ku ba'i mjug ma 'dra/ rlung mkhris bad kun 'du ba'i nad rnams sel// khyad par bkra shis don kun 'grub pas bzang // 'jigs med zur lnga mig nad gdon la bsngags bdud rtsi sha mthug skem po sha 'phel byed// 'phel byed skum po bum 'dra rma la bsngags// skem po sul mang byis pa'i mkhris nad sel// ba ru ra yis bad mkhris chu ser sel// skyu ru ra yis bad mkhris khrag nad sel/ snying dang mkhal ma gla gor zho sha gsum// snying tshad mkhal tshad mcher tshan sel bar byed// a 'bras sra 'bras 'jam 'bras mkhal nad sel/ 'bra gos bad kun sprug ser pho nad sel ma nu pa tras rlung khrag tsha ba sel// puskar sku las bad kun tsha ba sel// ru rtas rlung khrag pho ba sbos pa sel// glo nad gag pa sha ro gcod par byed// yung bas dug sel rul gcod gnyan nad 'joms// shu dag ma zhu drod skyed gag lhog sel// pu shel skyugs gcod bad kun tsha ba sel// khyung sder dkar sprug dug tshad sel bar byed// dpa' bo dkar ser dpa' rgod de bzhin no// bong nga dkar pos rims dug mkhris tshad sel/ bong nga dmar ser sha dug btsan dug sel// shing mngar glo nad rtsa nad sel bar byed// sle tres kuṇḍa ka ris rlung tshad sel// ga bra dag kyang de bzhin rims la phan/ tig tas mkhris pa'i tshad pa ma lus sel// ba sha ka yis khrag tshad ma lus sel// ba le ka yis glo mchin snod tshad sel// ga dur rims dang glo tshad rtsa tshan sel// stab seng rus chag sbyor jing rus tshad sel//sgron shing bad rlung chu ser grang ba sel// skyer pa se rgod dug sdud chu ser sel//seng ldeng khrag dang chu ser skem par byed// so chas nad kun gyen 'dren skyugs sman mchog / dan rog shi ri khan da drag por sbyong / dong gas mchin nad sel zhing 'jam por 'khru// ka ped da trig smag dang mon cha ras// 'khru ba'i nad rnams tsha grang med par gcod/ sngo yi sman gyi nus pa bstan pa ni//

80 zhu/spu nga rgyud ba /hong len skrag skem 'khrugs tshad don tshad sel // spang rtsi do bos rims dug rnyings tshad sel / re skon khrag skem smug po rtsa tshad sel / kyi lces snod tshad mkhris tshad sel bar byed/ sum cu tig gis mchin mkhris tsha ba sel pyi yang ku yis pho ma chin tsha ba sel // zangs tig lcags tig mkhris pa'i tsha ba sel// hro lo sug 'dras glo yis chod pa sel// g.ya' skyi ma yis mkhris pa 'i sbyong byed// gang ga chung gis dug dang chod 'khru gcod// bya rgod spos kyis gdon dug rim sa tshad sel // sro la gong pa yis ma go chag dug tshad sel/ yu mo mde 'byin bu ro zug ju 'byin// dar ya gan gyis byang khog chu ser skem//ma so bo'i rus chag sbyor nga lha ba 'dzin/ rta pags lha ba 'dzin zing chu ser 'dren// a bi ṣa yis rma go chag dug tshad sel// stag shas rma 'drub gnyan gsod dug nad sel/ spang rgyan dkar pos gre ba dug tshad sel// yu gu shing bis rma sbyor dug tshad sel/ rtsad dang rgu thub ldum stag dug nad sel// a byag mgo chag gso 'ing chu ser skem// tsher sngon rus chag gso zhing lha ba 'degs// smug chung mdan yon dag kyang de ba'i na no// gser skud glo mchin rtsa tshad dug tshad sel// lug ru skug pos dug sdud sha dug sel/ lug ru ser po chu rug chu 'thung byed// se ba'i me tog mkhris sel rlung kha gnon//'bu su hang gis rma 'drub glo nad sel// sgong thog pa yis sha dug 'khrugs tshad sel// a krong glo yi tshad pa sel bar byed / tshar bong gre ba'i tshad pa glo nad sel// tang kun snying gi tshad pa dug nad sel// se rgod 'bras bus dug tshad mchin tshad sel// shug pa tsher can mkhal tshad lhog pa sel// skyer pa'i me tog 'bras bus 'khru ba gcod / thang phrom lang thang tse yis srin nad sel srin shing sna ma'i 'bras bu de bzhin no dres ma'i ge sar srin gsod glang thabs 'joms// dkar po chig thub dug sdud gnyan srin 'joms // a wa byang khog rma dang mig la phan// khyim jig le yis mig gi ling thog len// par

wu ba da pa sku yi rgyud 81pa ta yis rims dang dug tshad sel// do ba'i rtsa bas srin gsod rus mdzer 'gogs// 'dam bu ka ras glo mchin rtsa tshad sel// 'bri ta sa 'dzin rnag khrag chu ser 'dren// bya po tsi tsis bud med zla mtshan gcod// shu mo za yis glo rnag 'khru ba gcod// snyi bas blo bur brang tsha cham pa sel// ga ler thing pa yis 'brum pa'i tsha ba sel// me rtog ser chen rma 'drub rtsa rul gso// brag skya ha bos dug sel tshad 'khru gcod// brag spos rma 'drub rnag skem lha ba 'dzin//rgya spos spang spos tshad rnying dus tshad sel / mya nga rtsi bras kyis chu 'thung rims tshad sel / rgu drus rma 'drub rtsa 'thun rgyu gzer sel// 'bam pos skrangs 'joms khong 'bras bshig par byed/ me tog lug mig dug dang rims nad sel// mkhan pas khrag gcog yan lag skrangs pa 'joms// chu ma rtsi yis chu ser dmu chu sbyong // byi tsher rim sa dug mkhal ma'i tsha ba sel// de bas rims sel rtsa mkhris mkhris nad sel// re ral 'om bus sha dug sbyar dug sel// zhu mkhan tshos btsod glo mkhal 'grams tshad sel// lcam pas chu 'gags skom dad 'khru ba sel// brag lcam rma 'drub rti mig rtsa sgo 'geg / bra ma'i rtsa bas sha tshad rtsa tshad sel// mdzo mos khrag 'khyags 'ju jing khrag tshad sel// phang ma'i 'bras bus snying tshad mo nad sel// srad dkar ba yis dmu chu skya rbab sbyong // byi dug rma yi 'bu srung srin phol sel// mtshe sdum rtsa yi khrag gcod mchin tshad sel// bre gas glo dang mkhal ma'i tsha ba sel// lug chung rims dug smug po rtsa tshad sel// lug ngal dug sel yan lag skrangs pa 'joms//zangs tsi ba yis mkhris nad mig ser sel// rnya los rgyu long snod kyi tsha ba sel//tho mang rma yi tsha ba sel bar byed// pa rmi ga rtsa bas blo gso glo rnag 'dren// bye 'u la phug ya dug sel bar byed// mug chos rna ba'i nad sel sbos pa sbyong smoskyi ba'i 'bras bus mkhris pa gyen la 'dren// sa rdzi ka yis pho ba'i me drod skyed//srub ka rul gcod drod skyed chu ser 'dren// lce tsha dbyi mong gnyis kyang de

82 zhu/grwa nga rgyud bzhi/bzhin no// ba lus bad kun tsha grang 'thab pa sel/ go stod rlung tshad dug dang mig nad sel// tha ram na ram bya rkang 'khru ba gcod// sogs ka ba yis skyug pa ma lus gcod// dbang po lag pas lus stobs khu ba skyed/ ri thos mkhris pa spyang tsher bad kun 'dren// dur byin thar nus tsha grang nad kun sbyong // sngon bus chu ser khron bus mkhris pa sbyong // lham rtsas dug tshad snod chod bad kun sbyong // chu rtsas gnyan sbyong rma yi skam rtsi byed// re cag pa yis 'bras 'dul gnyan nad sbyong // lca bas chu ser mkhal rked grang ba sel// nye shing ra mnyes tshe bsring chu ser sel// a sho gcas smad grang chu ser sel//gze mas gcin sri grum bu mkhal nad sel// srog chags las byung rwa dang nus pa dang / sha khrag mkhris tshil glad pa pags sen sru// chu brun bubs ril lus dang bcu gsum 'byung // de dag gang la gang phan nus pa bstan// bse dus byang khog rnag khrag chu ser skem// kha sha zhe ba'i rwa yang de dang 'dra//gtsod dang dgo ba'i rwa yis 'khru ba gcod// rgya ru lug thug rwa yis bu 'byin byed// rgod g.yag rwa yis drod skyed skran nad bzhig / gnyan gyi rwa yis rims nad sel bar byed// mi yi dur thod chu ser skem// mi dus btsa' ma sogs thal gyis// tshan rnying lus la zhen pa 'gogs// mi yi dpyi nus lhog pa gsod// 'brug rus dul gcod men pa 'dub stag gi dus pas lha ba 'gus sa// 'gron bu khrag gcod rnag chu skem// thog gis bsad pa'i rus pa dang // rgyu gzer thod pas rgyu gzer 'joms// phag pa'i dus pas smug po sel// lug gis rus pas rlung nad sel// ser ba rus kyis chu 'gags sel//zer mo'i rus pas khrag shor gcod// spre 'u'i dus pas bu 'byin byed// 'bu skyogs srin sel dpu chu sbyong // bshul chags nus pas chu ser sel// mi shas 'bras 'dul rlung dug gnyan nad 'joms// sbrul shas 'dril bshig 'gags 'byin mig la phan// bya rgod slo yis drod skyed lnga ba 'jig / rma bya'i

sto ba da pa sku yi rgyud 83sha yis mkhris pa dug nad 'joms// da byin mi yis mal la rked grang ba sel/sram gyi mchin pas chu 'gags sel bar byed 'phyi ba'i mchin pas rus pa gas pa sbyor// ra yi mchin pas mig la mchog tu phan// glo snying mchin mcher ma khal shas rang nad sel// spyang ki'i pho bas drod skyed ma zhu 'ju// spyang ki'i lce yis lce skungs 'jom sa// phag pa'i lce yis dus 'dzer 'bogs// khyi yi lce yis rma rnam sa 'drub// bong bu'i lce yis 'khru ba gcod// thug 'bras ro tsa khyi rlig bu rogs 'byin// wa dang khug rta'i glo bas glo rdol gcod// bya wa nga sha yis skyug pa gcod par byed// mchil pa nas zan rtsangs pas khu ba skyed//ngur pa'i sha yis nya log sel bar byed/ sha ba'i khrag gis srin sel mngal khrag gcod// ra yi khrag gis reg dug 'brum nag sel// g.yag sod khrag dang gtsod khrag 'khru ba gcod// phag khrag dug dang skug po byer ba sdud//bong khrag grum bu tshigs mig chu ser sel// bya yi ze khrag sha gso lha ba 'dzin/ mngal khrag rtsa sdom sha 'u skyed par byed// mkhris pa'i rigs rnam sa thams cad rtsa kha sdom// rul gcod sha gso dug sel mig la phan// sbrul gyi tshil bus mde'u 'byin// sha tshil srin sel dug nad bsrung // phag tshil dug sdud shu thor sel// mi tshil rlung 'joms shu thor sel // ra glad chu rgyus chad pa gso//lug glad mgo 'khor mtsho 'khyoms gso / ri dwags glad pas 'khru ba gcod//ri bong glad pas rgyu gzer sel/ mi glad skrangs 'joms chu ser 'jig /sbrul pags sha bkra glang shu sel// bse ko glang ko 'brum nag sel// byi ba'i pags pas rnag sna 'dren// chu srin sder mos rus tshad sel/ bong bu'i mig pas chu 'gags sel// rta yi mig pas skran nad sel / rta bon po yis nya lhog 'joms// rma bya'i mdongs dug glo rnag sel// so bya'i sgro yis chu 'gags 'bigs// 'ug pa'i sgro yis dmu chu sel// bya ma byi'i sgros mngal nad 'byin//rna ba'i spu yis dug nad sel// ra thug rmongs spus lhog pa 'joms// mi chus

84 zhu/grwa nga dab /gnyan srin sel rims bsrung // ba chus chu ser tshad rnying sbyong // rgod brun drod skyed skran bshig skrangs pa 'gugs// phag brun ma zhu gnyan rims mkhris skran sel// mi brun mkhris skran dug sel skrangs pa 'joms// rta sbang srin sel mkhris rlung skyug pa gcod// ri bong brun gyis dmu chu sbyong bar byed// khyi spyang gong po'i brun gyis spangs pa 'joms// bye brun byi brun gnyis kyis rnag sna 'dren// phug ron brun gyis skrangs pa rnag tu 'gugs// byang pas rtsa yi nad rnams sbyong bar byed// sdig srin chu sbyar gnyis kyis chu 'gags sel /bse thur bying bying thu lus glang thabs 'joms// spru ma'i 'bu yis rtsa khrag shor ba sdom// na bun bu mos glad pa 'dzag pa gcod// chu byi rba byi'i sha yis sha dug sel// migs pas srin nad dug nad sel bar byed// sman rta bu ram grang rlung sel ba'i rta// ka ra khrag mkhris tsha ba sel ba'i rta// sprang rtsi chu ser bad gan sel ba'i rta// de dag so so'i sman gyi nus pa ste// drang srong rnams kyis 'di la gces par zung // zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las sman gyi nus pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// / /

85le'u nyer gcig pa/ sman gyi sde tshan dang zir thabs bstan pa/de ni yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / sbyar thabs sde tshan ro sbyor nus par sbyar/nad gang sel ba sman gyi sde bstan pa/ ga bur tsan dan dkar po gi waṃ dang //cu gang gur gum utpal sngon po rnams tsha ba thun mong spyir 'joms sman sde yin// tig ta gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung / bong nga dkar po rtsa mkhris g.ya' kyi mo// kyi lce skyer pa mkhris pa sel ba'i sde// tsan dan dmar po mdzo mo seng ldeng dang / hong len ba sha ka dang skyu ru ra// re skon spang rtsi do bo btsod dang tshos// khrag nad sel bar byed pa'i sman sde yin// gi waṃ gser gyi me rtog bong nga dkar// ga dur byi tsher de ba par pa ta// khrag rkang rims nad sel ba'i sman sde yin// gla rtsi bong nga dkar ser dmar po gsum// khyung sder dkar sprug dpa' bo dkar ser tsad// rnam par rgu thub stag sha a bo dang / yung ba gang ga chung dang re ral dang // 'om bu spang rgyan spang rtsi do bo dang / se god skyer pa'i bar shun dug sman sde cu gang shing mngar rgun 'brum star bu dang 5 ru rta ga dur a krong sro lo dkar/ sug 'dra la sogs glo sman sde tshan yin// sle tres kuṇḍa ka ri a ga ru// go snyod ru rta gu gul sgog skya rnams// rlung dang tshad par ldan pa'i sman sde yin// bse yab ma nu 'u su star bu dang // utpal se 'bru sga skya skyu ru ra/ bad kun tsha ba sel ba'i sman sde yin sman sga sga skya shing kun kha ru tsha// tsong sgog bad rlung sel ba'i sman sde yin|se 'bru pho ba ris dang pi pi ling // sman sga tsi tra ka dang ka ko la// sug sprel shing tsha 'jam 'bras byi tang ga / da lis zi ra nag po la la phud/ dbyi mong srub ka lce tsha tsabs ru tsha// rgya tsha rgyam tsha rwa tsha thal tsha rnams/ bad kun grang

86 zhu grwa thang dba'ir /// ba sel ba'i sman sde yin// dzā ti bu ram nus sna rlung sman yin/ spos dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma ra// seng lding skyer pa chu ser sman gyi sde// gla rtsi shing kun sgog skya ma ru tse// thang phrom la nga tang tse dang byi tang ga / dres 'brum 'bu skyogs phur thal srin shing 'bru// do ba g.yer ma spru ma srin sman sde// ka ped bil ba da trig mon cha ra// smag dang tha rams na rams rgya skyegs shing / btsod dang bya long 'khru gcod sman sde yin// rgya tsha rgyam tsha gser gyi bye ma dang // sdig srin sug sprel nyi dga' chu sman sde// son cha ri tho sbyang tsher shu dag dang // gser phud 'bri ta sa 'dzin skyi 'brum dang // g.ya' skyi yungs kur la sogs skyugs sman sde// a ru dan da dong ga shi ri khan// dur byin thar nu lhum rtsa sngon bu dang // khyon bu tsi stag re cag chu rtsa rnam sa // 'khru bar byed pa'i sman gyi sde tshan yin// sbyar thabs ro sbyor nus par sbyor ba gnyis//ro sdebs sbyor ba lnga bcu rtsa bdun te / gnyis par sbyar la mngar lnga skyur ba bzhi// lan tsha gsum la la gnyis tsha ba gcig gsum du sbyar la mngar bcu skyur ba drug / lan tsha gsum la kha ba gcig pu nyid// bzhi sbyar mngar bcu skyur ba'i lan tsha gcig / lnga sbyor mngar ba lnga la skyur ba gcig / bzhi pa gnyis pa bco lnga lnga pa drug / gsum pa nyi shu drug tu sbyar ba gcig / rkyang pa drug ste drug cu rtsa gsum mo// 'phel zad bdun cu rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por sbyor//nus par sbyar la 'i dang sbyang ba gnyis// 'i byed sman sbyor sde tshan lnga 'am bdun// thang phye ril bu lde gu sman mar lnga// sman chang 'bri ta gnyis te bdun du bshad// sbyong byed 'jam rtsi bshal skyugs ni ru ha// sna sbyongs nyes gsum 'dus pa mgo nad 'byin// ba'i brgya rtsa bzhi nad kyi gnyen por sbyor// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtse snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag cu rgyud las sman gyi sde tshan dang sbyar thabs bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o / / /

87le'u nyer gnyis pa/ gnyen po cha byad bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong yin las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so/ kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// cha byad dpyad kyi gnas la ci ltar bslab par bgyi / 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / nad las gso bar byed pa'i gnyen po yi// cha byad dpyad kyi gnas la bslab pa ni//dpyad dang dpyad kyi cha byad rnam pa gnyis// lus kyi phyi nas nad rnams 'byin pa dang // zhi bar byed pa gang yin dpyad yin te// de yang 'jam dang rtsub dang drag po gsum ka 'jam po'i dpyad la dugs lums byug pa gsum//tsub pa'i dpyad la gtar bsreg dbug pa gsum// drag po 'dral gcod 'drud dang 'byin pa bzhi// de yi cha byad zug rngu brtag pa'i dpyad// skam pa btsags bu thur ma phran bu 'o// de la dang po zug ju brtag pa'i dpyad// rtse 'bas med pa'i skum po srid sor drug / khab mgo zhes bya mgo bo'i rus chag brtag / mgo zlum bra 'o rtse kyog rtse gug pa// sbrul mig zangs dung kha 'dra sor bcu gnyis// phra la 'jam pas yan lag zug ju brtag / sor brgyad dbal ldan rtse mo dkar khung can// skrangs pa rnag tu smin nam ma smin brtag /sgrubs can ba nu 'dra ba sor gsum pa// sbom sor pho la lnga ste mo la drug /nad lta ba la bu ga gnyis par bya// las la bu ga gcig pa glo dkar can// de 'dra gzhang 'brum blta dang bcad la sbyar/ zug ju 'byin pa skam pa'i sde tshan ni// seng ge kha dang gang ka bya rog mchu// srid sor bco brgyad 'brel

88 ༄7grwa nga dba'i ———————— —mtshams gzer btab pa// rtsa ba lca gas kyu'i dbyibs lda na a lo nga bta sa //rus la zug pa'i zug rngu 'byin la sbyar/ de 'dra sor brgyad thing ril mchu 'dra ba// shin tu phra bas sha rgyus zug ju dbyung // srubs ldan srid sor bcuganyis gsang la mkhang // nang nas sdom pa 'dam bu'i mchu zhes bya// rma gting las pa'i zug rngu dbyung la sbyar// so phra rtsa ba gdu bus bsdam sa pa ni//tsu mo ti ste rtsa ro rgyus pa dbyung // sha 'dral khrag dbyung btsags bu'i sde bstan pa// byi'u sbu gu'i sgro 'dra sor drug pa// 'a gseb khrag rtsa rkyang pa 'debs lasbyar// ltag nyal rtse rno snod ka rtse chung gtar// sta re kha 'dra nus steng rtsa la gtar// chu gri 'dra bas skrangs la zhal 'al bya// so ra brgyad zor ba'i dbyibs kyis lce skrangs bshag / btsags 'dra brang ba can gyis mgo rma 'dra//dbug pa'i thur dpyad srid sor drug pa la// mgo 'og lus thong thur 'bas sdig par bya// sbubs thur sbal mgo glo dkar yo da pa yis// rlangs 'khyims gseng dang snying chu mchin chu btsag / sbubs thur smyu gu kha yis dpu chu btsag / byin po'i mchu 'dras byang khog rnag gsang dbye// nas 'dra'i thur ma rgal tshigs skran la sbyar// glo snying rgyu long mkhal mar sbal mgo bsngags//zangs bur bra 'o 'dra bas mig sprin dbug / mtho gang 'bri rtse kha yis bcur phyin bya// mdung rtse'i so yis yan lag rnag chu dbug / gzhan yang cha dpyad phran bu'i sde bstan pa// ste kha so gnyis pa dang bee le kha// ko ma'i mchu 'dra sor drug yu ba can// lcags bzang ngar ldan mgo yi rus pa 'brud// sog le zheng du sor gnyis so zhib pa// srid sor bcu pas dus pa lhag pa breg / chan pa rno bas rma yi rtsa rgyus bcad// sgrubs can sor lnga gsog le'i kha 'dra ba//'khor lo ldan pa rus pa 'bugs pa'i gsor// sor bcu be le kha 'dra rtse gug pa / rna ba sna dang gre ba'i 'brum pa bcad// mngal thur mtho gang rtse gug bu thi dbyung // cha dpyad sgrul mgos rdo 'u dbyung bar bya / gro sog 'bring tshad

༄cu/bshad pa sku yi rgyud 89mkhrang gsang 'jam pa la// sor bcu gnyis pa'i 'phrul thur chu 'gags btsag / rtse khyog srid sor bcu pas so srin bsreg / sor bcu rtsa ba'i bu ga sor mo lnga// rtse mo kha dbrag kha snar du ba rngub// thabs can sor bcu them bu lta bu'i kha// gre bar sman gdab lce chung bsreg la sbyar// rtsa ba'i sbubs la mthe bong thong ba la// rtse bug sran rme thong tsam sor brgyad pa// rked pa rtsa bar 'khor lo dkyis pa yi// gce 'u zhes byas 'jam rtsi ni ru btang // de 'dra phra mo rma bkru ba la sbyar// rngabs ra spangs su sor lnga kha sor gsum// rtse bug yu ngas kur thong bas chu ser drang // bum pa 'khyud 'khor sor ni bco brgyad la// srid sor bcu gnyis kha skum sor ba'i pa// phyi skran 'ju 'ing 'dren la sbyar bar bya/ me long spu gri zla tshes lta bu yis// mgo bo'i sku bzhar yog thod mgo lta bu// srid sor bcu pa tel pa zhes bya ste// 'bras dang lhog pa skrangs pa bsreg par bya// dbal ldan phra 'jam gug po sha yi khab// sha dang pags pa ral ba btsem la sbyar// de ltar cha dpyad nad dang gang mkho sbyad// ces gsungs so//bdud rtse snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gnyen po cha byad bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// / /

90le'u nyer gsum pa/ mi na ba gnas par bya ba/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// nad med tha mal gnas la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / rnam par ma gyur tha mal lus po la// mi na gnas dang ring du 'tsho bar bya// dang por mi na gnas par bya ba ni// nad kun rgyu las rkyen gyis bslang las 'byung //rkyen med rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung mi srid// de phyir nad rnams kun gyi rkyen spang bya// dus dang dbang po spyod lam ro nus rnams// dman dang log pa lhag pas nad skyed la// yang dag sbyor ba nad med gnas pa'i rgyu// de phyir spyod lam zas sman rnam gsum po// yang dag bsten pas nad med bder gnas 'gyur// lo zla 'das te lus zungs stobs 'grib pa// tshe zad rgas pa'i nad las bsring ba ni// bcud len phan yon gnas rten bya thabs bzhi//phan yon tshe ring na tshod dar la 'jog / lus mdangs stobs skyed dbang po gsal bar byed// gnas gtsang dben dga' bar chad med pa der// rten ni ha cang rgas pa ma yin pas// chags spang brtson pas gza' skar bzang dus 'jug / bya thabs gtsor blang zhor spyad rnam pa gnyis// gtso bor spyad pa sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gnyis// sngon 'gro snam 'chos rjes la khrus byas la//'bras bu gsum dang rgyam tsha pi pi ling // bca' sga shu dag yung ba byi tang ga /bu ram ba chu sbyar bas khong pa sbyang // ma sbyangs dri bcas tshos ltar don med

༄cu/bshad pa yi rgyud/ 91—'gyur// dngos ga'i sgog skya zhun mar sbyar byas la// nas snod bdun gsum ba 'ag la 'ag grangs bsten// rlung gi nad sel tshe 'phel byed pa yin/ brag zhun legs brtul gser dngul zangs lcags dang // lcags snod 'phrod sman sbyar ba rims bskyed bza'// nad 'joms tshe 'phel mon sne rgya sran spang //tsi tra ka dang mar sbrang sbyar ba bston// tshe ring lus rgyas me drod 'bar bar byed ba gcin sbyar bsten sha bkra mdze nad sel// a ru bar skyur 'bras bu'i sman mar gyis // dbang bo gsal zhing stobs skyed rgas ka sra// kun la nad dang gang 'phrod zas spyod bsten// rul skyur sngo ngad mi 'phrod spang bar bya// zla ba gsum drug lo yis 'bras bu 'grub// de ma lcogs na 'ar la spyad byas pas / gnas skabs 'bras bu 'byung bar nus pa yin// zhes gsungs so / bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mi na ba gnas par bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// / /

92le'u nyer bzhi pa/ nyes pa dngos su ston pa brtag pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so/ kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// ngos bzung rtags kyi gnas la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol//zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig /ngos bzung rtags la bslab pa ni// me dang du ba ji bzhin du// nad kyi ngos ni rtags la bzung // brtag thabs med pa'i sman pa yis// rtags nyid rtags su mi shes te// du ba rlangs par 'khrul dang 'dra// sprin 'dus char 'byung zer ba ltar// ma nges rtags su byed pa yod// de phyir ngos 'dzin brtag thabs man ngag gces pa ste// kha mar bcos la dgos phyir nyes pa dngos ston brtag pa dang // skye bo mkhas zer mgu phyir ngan g.yo skyon gyis brtag pa dang // gso tshe blang dor bya phyir spang blang mu bzhir brtag pa'o//nyes pa dngos su ston pa'i brtag pa la// slong ba rgyu yi sgo nas brtag pa dang //mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas brtags pa dang // phan gnod bston pa'i sgo nas brtag pa 'o// slong ba rgyu rkyen zas dang spyod lam rnams// gang thos gang byas nad kun rtogs par nus// khyad par slong ba'i rkyen gyis shes par bya//ci phyir rgyu las 'bras bu 'gal mi srid// mtshan nyid rtags la brtag gzhi brtag yul dang // brtag sgo brtag pa'i tshul dang rnam pa bzhi// gzhi ni rlung dang mkhris pa bad gan gsum// mtshan nyid 'phel zad gsog ldang 'khrugs pa'i rtags// tsha grang gnyis su dril la brtag par bya// brtag yul dbang po
