sa bshad pa sku yi rgyud/ 93yul lnga dri ma lnga// dbang po mig dang rna ba sna lce dang // yul ni gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga// dri ma lud pa 'khru skyugs chu khrag brtag / brtag sgo yul dus rang ba'i na na tshod dang // nyin zhag zas zos gnas las ma 'khrul rtogs brtag tshul blta dang reg pa dri bas brtag / blta ba mig yul bongs dbyibs kha dog brtag / khyad par lce dang chu la brtag par bya// 'di ni mthong ba yul rig brtag pa yin// reg pa lus yul tsha grang 'bur 'jam brtag / khyad par brda sbyor zin pa rtsa la brtag / 'di ni dpyod pa don rig brtag pa yin/dri bas brtag pa rna ba'i yul kun te// gang gis gang ltar gang na gang du gang // khyad par rgyu gnas mtshan nyid dris la brtag / rgyu la nyes pa gnas la 'jug pa'i sgo// mtshan nyid nad rigs bye brag phyed par 'gyur de phyir brtag pa kun la dri ba gces// 'di ni thos pa sgra rig ces su bshad// phan gnod bsten pa zas spyod sman dpyad ba'i/ rgyu dang nad kyi ngo bor mthun mi mthun// 'phrod mi 'phrod las nad kun shes par 'gyur ltar snang ma yin bsrings pas rtogs 'gyur te/ sman pas nyams rnyed nad pa'i gso don shes/ zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las nyes pa dngos su ston pa brtag pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o/ //

94le'u nyer lnga pa/ ngan g.yo skyon gyi sgo nas brtag pa/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / ngan g.yo skyon gyi sgo nas brtag pa ni// mtshan nyid shes bya 'tshang 'bru de dus bsring // sngar rjes bcad dang bcud la bor ba dang // kha bcing spo la gdon dang thabs 'og gzhug / dang po mtshan nyid shes par bya ba ni// nad kun spyi dang khyad par rtags shes pas// 'di na tsam las 'di 'ong rtogs par 'gyur// de phyir 'di la goms thing 'dris pa gces// rin chen la sogs bzang ngan shes pa yang // bstan bcos ma yin de med par yang min// 'tshang 'bru pho nya 'brel ba thabs kyi phyir// ci na ji ltar gang btang su yin dang // zhag grangs dpyad pas mi smra mngon par shes//dus bsring rings stabs ma yin thangs cig gnas/ de bar lus ngag yengs ma gtam la dpyad// rjes bcad gtar bsreg sman sbyor ci byas btsal//brnyed pa tsam gyis tsha grang phyogs mthun rtogs// bcud la bor ba mi smra ma rtogs na// sgrog phyir ngan pa mi bya gdon bcos dgos// sman cig sbya ra na phan zhes byings por smra// ngang gis mi thub 'di na ci bya 'byin la bcing zhes pa kha cig phrad pa dang // smra bar byed pa smos pas tshud byas te/ ci na sman pas shes kyi ba da mi dgos// gsal bar brjod pas skye bo ngo mtshar zer// spo la gdon pa thabs kyis rtogs gyur na// gzhan dag rtsa chu na lugs mang brtag dgos// nga la ma yin gcig la kha mar gdags/ mig bltas tsam gyis chog ces grags pa 'byung // yang na 'ib tu dbya da pas rtogs

sa bshad pa sku yi da 95mkhas zer// thabs 'og gzhug pa kun gyis skad mi ster// rnam pa'i kha mar btags la rdzong la bros// dang po zas spyod mi 'phrod gdon gyis rkyen// rul skyur drag shul rjen zas gnod ces bya// gnyen po phan gnod med pa'i snyoms pa dbog / rdzong la 'bros pa nad dang sman gyi ming // snga na ma grags mi shes ngo mtshar brjod// de yis ma rtogs gyur kyang mkhas khyad 'byin/ zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las ngan g.yo skyon gyi sgo nas brtag pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o/ //

96le'u nyer drug pa/ spang blang mu bzhir brtag pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / spang blang mu ba'i 'i sgo nas brtag pa ni// gso bla gso dka' gso tsam spang ba bzhi// gso bla ba ni yan lag ldan pa dang //gang zag nad kyi sgo nas gso bla ba// yan lag sgo nas gso bar bla ba ni//sman pa sman dang nad g.yog rnam pa gsum// sman pa mkhas pa'i btegs la 'dzegs pa dang // gzhung gi don shes las rnams mthong zhing gtsang // sman ni cho ga yon tan mang du ldan// phun sum tshogs shing 'phrod par sbyar ba'o//nad g.yog sgrin brtse gtsang sbra blo dang ldan// yan lag bcu gnyis lda na na gso ba bla// gang zag nad pa skyes bu gzhon 'ing dul// snying stobs lda na 'ing sman kun bzod pa'i lus// rdzas phyug bsgo ba nyan la shes par nus// dris pa'i nad rtags zlos mkhas gso bla'i yul// nad kyi sgo nas sa po bar bla ba ni//rgyu dang sngar tshul mtshan nyid chung ba dang // gnod bya yul dus rang ba'i na mi mtshungs dang // gnod med lan cig rkyang pa gsar gso bla// 'on kyang rims la yul dus mtshungs pa dang // chu 'gags nad la gnod bya mnyam pa dang // khrag skran rnying pa gso ba bla zhes bya / gso dka' ba ni bla ba de dag 'dres / thabs mang yun ring gso ba dgos pa'o// de las go zlog gyur la goms phan nyid// tshe yi lhag ma lus srid gso ba tsam// spang bar bya lagaso thabs yod med gnyis// rgyal po dge ba'i bshes dang 'gro la lda nga / sman pas byas pa mi bzo brnyas pa byed// brel dang 'byor pa mi lda na nyan mi btub

stobashad pa sku yi khyud/ 97tshe zad mya ngan la gnan bstan pa bshig / skye bo'i ya ga ngan pa 'byung ba'i phyir// gso thabs yod kyang spang bar bshad pa yin// gso thabs med pas spang bar bya ba ni// shin tu phyin ci log dang 'chi ltas snang 1 srog gcod nad dgus de lus bzung ba spang // zhes gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las spang blang mu bzhir brtag pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// / /

98le'u nyer bdun pa/ gso tshul spyir bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so/ kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// gso byed thabs kyi gnas la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol//zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig /nad de rtogs nas ji ltar gso ba'i phyir/ gso bar byed pa'i thabs kyi gnas bstan pa// de la gso ba'i tshul dang gso thabs gnyis// dang po nad kyi gso tshul bstan pa ni// nad la gso thabs dpag tu med mod kyang // gso tshul med na mun par mda' 'phen 'dra// de la gsum ste spyi yi gso tshul dang kabye brag pa dang khyad par gso tshul lo// dang po ji ltar gso dang gang gis gso/sos pa'i tshad dang rnam pa gsum gyis bstan// dang po rlung la sogs pa ji snyed nad// rang gnas gsog pa'i dus su bsal bar bya// langs shing rgyas nas nad gzhan 'khrug byed phyir// gzhan la gnod pa med pa'i sbyor bas gso// nad gzhan skyes na nad stobs gang che bcos / gso ba'i gnyen po 'i dang sbyang ba gnyis/ gsog dus zhi la langs nas sbyang bas bcos// zhi dus zas spyod gzab cing mi 'khrugs bya// 'on kyang phral rkyen dus min gsog ldang nang // dus 'das gso dkar 'gyur phyir phral du bsal// sman yang nyin zhag zas dus rigs pa yis// nad dang sbyar te btang tshul bcu ru bshad//zas ma zos dang zas sdun dbus dang mtha'// zas kham zas mtshams dus med tse gur dang // zas bcas zas mnan mtshan mo btang ba'o// nad dang mi sbyor kun la zhu dus gtong // rmongs pa'i lugs te nad thog 'bab pa

sa〉bshad pa sku yi rgyud 99dka'// dus las ma 'das de'u ngos 'dzin 'dra// nad gang gso dpyad sbyar yang mchil snabs mang // lus lci dang ga mi bde zas mi 'ju// rgyu skam khong 'drul bshang gci dus min 'byung // shed chung skad dma' nad rtse ma jil rtags// nad gang zhi dus gong las ldog rtags 'byung // ma zhi bcos shing zhi nas lhag mi sbyar bye brag gso ba'i tshul la rnam pa gsum// ma zhur bcas dang rang rgyud gzhan dbang ngo // dang po drod chung zas skom ma zhu ba//de nyid rlung sogs gnod byar 'dres pa rnams// smin dang drod skyed sman gyis rtse bcil la// rtags thob gang dang nye ba'i gnas nas sbyang // steng 'og rang byung sman gyis dgag mi bya// ma smin mi sbyang zhen phyir lus zungs 'joms/dper na ma langs chan la chu bsings bzhin// ma zhu med pa'i rang rgyud nad rkyang de// nad kun skyed par byed pa'i rgyu bsten pas// thog mar rlung 'jug de nas ga 'an 'jug ste/ de dag zas spyod slong ba'i dus ma 'dzom rang gnas gsog cing ring sdod shugs mi phyin// dper na 'khrug pa byed pa'i shi bo bzhin// btsir yang mi zlog bar du mi ldang zhing // rkyen phrad nus pa rnyed de gnas las ldang // de dag thog mar rlung zhugs nad 'khrugs phyir//'jig cing 'ju byed zas kyi smin byas pas// nad 'thor rlung de tshar gcod khong par bsdu// dper na char pa 'bebs pa'i rlung gnon 'dra// de nas gang dang nye ba'i lam nas sbyang // yan lag phyir gnas khong du ma 'dus na//rtsa sgo phyi dang nang nas sbyangs la dbyung // gzhan dbang bla gnyan bcas pa'i nad yin te// rang i gnas nas langs nas gnas gzhan phyin// phyin nas rang gnas snga ma la gnod 'khrug / de stobs chung na rang gnas snga ma gso//phyi ma stobs che bla gnyan de bcos pas// rang gnas gnas pa bcos mi dgos par 'tsho// dper na rkun mo bsten pa'i rje bo bzhin// khyad par gso ba'i tshul la rnam pa dgu// ma rtogs dogs bcas gdengs ma thob pa'i nad//

100 sa grwa thang da bzhi/byi la 'jab pa lta bu'i sad mdas bcos// ngos zin nges pa rnyed cing gdeng thob na// spo la dar 'phyar lta bur dngos su bcos// gnyen po thog tu mi 'bab nad lam gzung // rta rgod dkyus su 'dzud pa lta bur bcos// sngar gtses nad la dman lhag log pa gsum// brtags la skyar mo nya len bzhin du bcos// stobs chen nad la sman dpyad zas spyod ba'i// lag gtod mi sha phrang phrad lta bur bcos// stobs chung nad la spyod lam zas sman dpyad//mas gdang lta bur mas 'jog rim pas bcos/ rkyang pa'i nad la dpa' bos dgra 'dul bzhin// de gzhil gzhan la gnod med sbyor bas bcos// ldan 'dus nad la 'du ba cha snyoms gces// gtso bos the thor 'khrugs zlums lta bur bcos// kun la gnod bya la sogs chos bcur sbyar// mdzo khal lug khal lta bur 'tsham pas bcos/ zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gso tshul gyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //

101le'u nyer brgyad pa/ khyad par gyi bcos tshul rgyas par bshad pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// khyad par gso tshul mdor bstan rnam dgu po// de dag rgyas par bkrol na ci ltar lags// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa//kye srang srong chen po nyon cig / khyad par gso tshul rgyas par bshad pa ni//dang por nad rtags dpyad la the tshom na// rlung gi nad la sad mda' sre long thang // mkhris pa'i nad la sad mda' tig ta'i thang // bad kun nad la sad mda' rgyam tshwa gsum// pho long gnyan srin sad mda' bya khyung lnga/ khrag 'khrug rlung gzer sad mda' ma nu ba'i// sbyar ba'i dug la sad mda' sdud sman btang // tsha grang 'dres pa'i sad mda' goms pa bsten/ bshal gyi sad mda' sna sel 'khrog thang btang // me btsa'i sad mda' snum ldan drod dugs dang // gtar ga'i sad mda' rdo grang chu lcag bya/ rnag gi sad mda' me thur mig can bdeg / gzhan yang nad de 'di yin snyam pa yi// gnyen po'i sbyor ba chung bu'i sad mda' bsten// 'phrig dang ldan pa'i 'drar snang kun sdur la// gnyen po gang len de nyid bcos pa gces// kha mar mi smra kha bcol chung bar 'gyur// 'di dus gsal bar mi sgrog byings por smra// nad la nges pa brnyed cing gdengs thob na// nad de 'di yin rgyu rkyen 'di yis skyed// da lta 'di na mtha' gzhug 'di ru 'gyur bcos ka 'di byed dus

102 kho〉/grwa thang rgyud ba /tshod 'di nas sos// yang na mi thub 'chi ba'i dus tshigs bor// spo dar 'phyar bzhin kun gyis go bar smra// gnyen po thog tu mi 'bab lam gzhug dka'// ma smin tsha ba'i gnyen po grogs thog 'bab// grogs 'phel bas ni tsha ba nyid 'phel byed// de phyir bad rlung grogs de thang gis dbye// nad khrag zungs khrag 'o ma chu 'dres 'dra// 'bras bu gsum gyis khrag ngan phye la gtar//de ltar ma phyed nad lus zungs la gnod/ bad kun dug tshad byer ba bsdus la bsad// ma 'dus gnyen pos mi gsod slar 'grams 'gyur// gab tshad grang ba'i mgo phur drod kyis bsha// ci phyir grang bas gnyen po len mi 'gyur//ma zhu'i nad kun smin dang drod skyed sman// rtse bcil rtags thob gang nye'i lam nas sbyang // bshal gyi sngon 'gro sman gyis nad kun slong // nad ma lhongs na 'khyag thog chu 'beb ba 'dra// sman pa gzhan gyis sngar gtses nad de la//dman nam log gam lhag gam legs brtags la// dman pas nad ma zhi na gnyen po bskyed// log nas nad stobs skyes na sbyor ba bsgyur// lhag nas nad ga 'an langs na gang langs ma nan// tsha ba stobs can nad la chu bzhi phob// ga bur rtse chung sman dang dpyad kyi chu// kha zas yon la gtan pa zas byi chu// bsil sar sdod pa spyod lam chu yis bcos// grang ba stobs can nad la me ba'i spor/ drod dgu sbyar ba sman gyi me yin te// me btsa' dpyad me drod bcud zas kyi me// gnas rgos dro ba spyod lam me yis bcos / de ltar ma bcos nad rgyas srog lagatod// stobs chung nad la dang po spyod lam gzab/ des ma 'i na phan gnod zas kyi bcos// des ma 'i na bsil drod sman gyis bcos// gsum gas ma non dpyad kyis nad yul dbyung // rlung dang mkhris pa bad kun nad rkyang la// de nyid zhi bya gzhan ma langs par bcos// de ma shes na ldo ga rgyu bcu gnyis 'gyur/ log pas rang ma 'i bar gzhan skyed de//rlung gi nad la kha tsha'i ro bsten na / rlung ma 'i bar bad gan mkhris par

༄bshad pa sku yi rgyud/ 103ldog / mkhris pa'i nad la lan tsha tsha ba bsten// mkhris pa ma zhi bad rlung gnyis su ldog / bad kun nad la kha dang lan tsha bsten// bad gan ma 'i rlung mkhris gnyis su ldog / mi 'phrod rkyen gyis 'dus par ldog pa yod// lhag pas nad de zhi nas gzhan slong ste// mngar dang lan tshas rlung zhi bad mkhris skyed// tsha skyur bad kun 'i nas rlung mkhris skyed// mngar khas mkhris pa khyi nas bad rlung skyed// ldan 'dus nad la 'du ba cha mnyam pa// a ru brag zhun 'du ba spyi ru snyoms// gnas dang nad gzhi so so'i kha 'dzin ni// snying la dzā ti glo la cu gang ste// mchin par gur gam srog rtsar li shi btang // mkhal mar sug sprel mcher par ka ko la// pho ba'i kha 'dzin se 'bru pi pi ling //mkhris pa'i kha 'dzin tig ta gser me tog / rlung la kha 'dzin sle tres rus bcu dgasum// bad kun ma nu 'u su se yab btang // khrag la ba sha ka dang hong len te// chu ser spos dkar thal rdor so ma ra// gnyan dang gdon la gla rtsi gu gul nag / de dag gang dang gang dgos rtags dang sbyar// thams cad 'dus na kun la kha gnon btang // ldan 'dus cha mnyam gang shas che ba la/gnyen po'ang de dang bstun la gang mtho mnan// yang na snga phyi re mos bcos pa 'am// yang na ltag pa sprad la dus gcig gzhom// nyin gung mtshan gung mkhris pa'i tsha ba bsad// bsil sman bsil zas tsha ba'i dus der bsten//srod dang snga dro pho ba'i me drod gso// drod sman drod zas bad kun grang ba gzhil// sgongs dang tho rang rlung la brngan pa sbyin// drod bcud zas sman thor bu'i rlung sna bslan// lhag na gang lhag dgrar ldang pha spun 'dra// chad na gang chad skyong dgos mo ngan 'dra// des na 'du ba lhag chad med par mnyam/lus zungs bzo rgyu 'dra bas chud mi gsan// pho ba zhing sa 'dra bas me drod gso// de ltar shes na 'tsho byed sman par 'gyur// gnod bya yul dus rang bzhin na tshod dang sgo nad khams gnas dang me drod nyams stobs dang //

104 sa grwa nga dba'i/goms pa 'di bcus phra mo yan chad brtag / thams cad mtshungs na gnyen pos non par btang // de ma yin na 'tshams tshad bsten par bya zhes gsungs thetsu//par gyi bcas tshu /sbyi sdi pa/ pa/ dpa'i le /ste nyi dī rtsab rnyi/ gā // las khyad

105le'u nyer dgu pa/ gso thabs gnyis bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / gang gis gso ba'i gso thabs mang yod kyang //thun mong ba dang khyad par gnyis kyis gso// thun mong gso yul gnyis phyir gso thabs gnyis// stobs skyed brta bya nyams dmad sgyung ba 'o// brta bar bya ba yu la dang gang gis brta// phan yon drags skyon de yi bcos thabs lnga//de yul rlung che zungs zad khyim gsar dub// sbrum ma btsas rjes khrag zags glo jol gas// gnyid med mya ngan dka' thub rtsol bas dub// so ga'i dus rnams phal cher brta bas gso// de zas lug sha bu ram ka ra mar// 'o ma zho chang la sogs bcud kyis brta// sman sbyor nad dang gang 'phrod sman mar bsten// dpyad du 'jam rtsi khrus dang bsku mnye bya// spyod lam gnyid log dal dang sems dga' brta// de yis stobs 'phel nad kun zil gnon nus//dper na kha nyen po yis nus brnyed bzhin// thal drags 'tsho ches nad dang men bu dang // rmongs bag gcin snyi lud pa bad kun 'phel// de la bad tshil zad byed zas sman phan// gu gul brag zhun skyer pa'i khaṇḍa dang // sbrang sbyar 'tsho ches nad kun sel bar byed// 'bras bu gsum dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba 'am//bca' sga ya bakṣa ra byi tang ga / skyu ru nas phye sprang sbyar 'tsho nad sel// 'tsho bas skem bzang brta ba tshod zin bya// sgyung bar bya la yul dang gang gis dmad// phan yon drags skyon de yi bcos thabs lnga// de yul ma zhu snum zos rla rengs nad rims dang gcin snyi khong 'bras dregs grum mtsher// lkog

106 sa grwa nga da ba glad snying nad tshad 'khru skyug pa dang // lus lci dang ga mi bde bshang gci 'gas sa// 'tsho ches chu ser bad mkhris rgyas pa'i nad// stobs ldan dar bab dgun dus snang bas bcos// de yi sman du zhi dang sbyang ba gnyis// ma snyoms snyoms par byed pa zhi ba ste// sbyor ba zas sman spyod lam dpyad kyis bcos// nyams stobs chung la zas kyi bkres skom bya// de 'og yang zhing 'ju bla cung zad bsten// nyams stobs 'bring la thang dang phye ma sogs// drod skyed smin byed sbyor ba gang yin bsten// stobs ldan nyin mtshan rtsol bcag rngul dbyung zhing / me btsa' dugs lums gtar ga dpyad kyis bcos sbyang ba nad blong phyir 'byin byed pa ste// sbyor ba ma zhu'i gnas la skyugs kyis sbyang // zhu ba'i gnas la ni ru ha yis drang // lus spyir bshal la rtsa nad rtsa sbyongs bya// 'i sbyang nyam dmad phan yon dbang po gsal / lus ngag yi ga bde la bya byed brtson// bkres skom dus 'byung bshang rlung bde bar rgyu//drags na zungs 'dzad sha skem mgo bo 'khor// gnyid med mdangs shor skad gdangs dbang po nyams// kha skom dang ga 'gag dang byin pa brla// gzhug to rtsib logs snying ga glan pa na// rims 'debs skyug 'dod rlung nad skyed par byed// de la rtas par byed pa thams cad phan// khyad par sha za'i sha dang 'jam rtsi dang // zas 'grangs gnyid log phag 'drar lus rgyas 'gyur//lus rgyas 'tsho byed sha 'dra gang yang medaka mdor na brta bya'i yul la nyams mi dmad// gal te sbyang ba dgos la 'jam pos bya// nyams dmad dgos la rtas bar byed pa spang rlung 'phel nad gang zad pa brta bas gso// rlung zad bad mkhris 'phel ba snang bas bcos// rten dang brten pa 'phel zad bcos thabs gcig / ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gso thabs gnyis bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// / /

107le'u sum cu pa/ gso thabs dngos bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / khyad par nyes gsum so sor bcos pa ni//zung 'jug rlung la til mar mchog yin te// bu ram chang dang mar rnying lug sha yib// 'phyi ba rta bong mi sha sgog tsong sogs rtsi snum 'jam dro'i zas kyis bcos par bya// spyod lam mun khung dro ba'i gnas su bsdad// yid 'ong tshig snyan gnyid log gos dron bsgo// sman du rus bcud gsum gyi khu ba dang kalug mgo rnying pa'i mgo 'khrol sbyor ba bya// bcud bzhi'i thang dang shing kun gsum thang btang // phye ma dzā ti shing kun cur nis bsten// dkar 'don sha 'don sgog 'don skyur 'don dang // dzā ti sgog skya btsan dug rus chen dang //'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba'i sman mar sbyar// mdor na mngar skyur lan tsha snum dros bcos// khyad par mar rnying drod kyi 'jam rtsi bsngags// dpyad du lo mar rnying pa'i bsku mnye bya// snum ldan dugs kyis gzer ba'i gnas su bdug / spyi gtsug la sogs rlung gsang me yis mnan// mkhris pa'i nad la ma ra gas ra mchog yin te// ba lang ri dgas sha gsar chu bsil ja// ba ra'i 'o dar skyabs dang khur tshod dang // chag tshe phye thug bsil ba'i zas kyis bcos // spyod lam bser bu shing grib ni'u bsing bsten// chu 'gram bsil gnas ma 'khrugs dal bar bsdad// dri bzang bsil zhing yid du 'ong bas byug / sman du sngo thang la sman thun mong gsum// ga bur tsan dan ji waṃ tsha stobs sbya ra// ma dor na mngar kha bska bsil sman gyis bcos// khyad par

108 sto nga dba'i/mngar ba'i bshal gyis sbyang ba bsngags// dpyad du rngul dbyung chu yi 'phrul 'khor bskor// gang rgyas rtsa la gtar zhing bsil gyis bdug / bad gan nad la sbrang rtsi mchog yin te// nya lug g.yag rgod g.yi dang bya rgod sha / 'bru rnying zan dron chang nar phyin pa dang // chu bskol sga chu la sogs yang zhing tsub /dro la chung ba'i zas kyis bcos par bya// spyod lam me nyis sro zhing gos dror g.yog / skam sar lus sems rtsol spyad gnyid mi log / sman la lan tsha tsha ba'i bsdus thang btang // phye ma se 'bru da lis thal sman sbyar// mdor na tsha skyur yang rtsub rno ba bsten// khyad par rno la tsub pa'i skyugs sman bsngags//dpyad du tshwa dang thong ba spu dugs bsten// shin tu rgyas la me btsa' thur ma bya//mdor na rlung nad 'jam rtsi bcud kyis bcos// mkhris pa'i nad la bshal dang bsil gyis bcos// bad kun nad la skyugs dang drod kyis bcos/ rlung dang mkhris par ldan la bsil bcud bsten// bad mkhris ldan la bsil la yang bas bcos// bad rlung ldan la dro la bcud pas bcos / 'dus pa'i nad la bsil bcud yang bas bcos// mdor bsdus tsha ba thams cad bsil gyis bcos// grang ba'i nad gzhi thams cad bad gan ltar// rlung ni tsha grang gang 'brel snum dros bcos// zhes gsungs so//bdud rdzi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gso thabs dngos bstan pa'i le'u ste sum cu pa'o// / /

109le'u so gcig pa/ gso ba po sman pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// bya byed sman pa'i gnas la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes// de ltar gso bar byed pa'i gso ba po bya ba byed pa sman pa'i gnas bstan pa//rgyu dang ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba dang // las dang 'bras bu rnam pa drug gis bstan// rgyu ni blo ldan bsam pa dkar ba dang / dam tshig ldan zhing rnam pa bzo ba dang / bya ba la brtson mi chos mkhas dang drug / de la dang po blo dang lda na pa ni// blo che blo brtan blo gzeg gsum ldan pas// gso dpyad mdo rgyas ma lus khong du chud// lag len kun la thogs rdugs nyams nga med// rig pas dpyod shes mngon shes phra mo 'char// de nyid rgyu yi nang nas mchog ces bya// bsam pa dkar ba byang chub sems ldan pas// sbyor ba dngos gzhi mjug las dang po ni// sdug bsngal mthong dang phan 'dogs dad pa dang //bzang ngan byams sdang zhe nas snyoms pa yis// snying rje byams pa dga' ba btang snyoms bzhi// smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de// dngos gzhi 'jug pa tshad med nyams su blang // 'jug pa bsngags par blta zhing 'khon 'dzin med// de ldan gso bla 'tsho mang grogs su 'gyur dam tshig ldan pa blo bzhag rnam pa drug / bzung bya gnyis dang shes bya gsum du ba 'ad//dang po slob dpon gsung dang gso dpyad dang / mched dang nad pa rnag khrag rnam drug la// sangs rgyas drang srong gsung dang bka' rgyud dang 5

110 zhu grwa thang dab dpun grogs bu tsha khyi phag lta bur ni// blo bzhag pa yi dam tshig drug bsrung bya//gnyis pa sman gyi rig 'dzin cha dpyad rnams// bka' bsrungs phyag cha lta bur bzung zhing bsrung // sa sum pa sman rnams nor bu bdud rtsi dang // mchod rdzas shes par bya ba gsum yin te/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bur shes par bya nad rnams sel ba'i bdud rtser shes par bya// phud kyis rig 'dzin mchod pa'i rdzas su shes// dang po rin po che de btsal la bcang //gnyis pa legs par sbyar la byin gyis brlab// rang nyid bee zu yo 'od rgyal po dang // sman gyi snod ni bdun rtsi lhung bzed bsam// sman bla drang srong rnams kyis shes pa brjod// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po bcom lda na 'das / dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// sku mdog mthing ga bee ḍūdma yi 'od//sprul pa'i sku la mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// rlung mkhris bad kun nad kyis gdungs pa la// nad kyi gnyen po phyag g.yas a ru ra// phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed par pu bsnams// bee zu yo yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa'i gnas mchog bco brgyad thugs su chud// tshe la dbang ba'i bcud len dngos grub brnyes// mngon shes snying rjes 'gro mchog 'du ba snyoms// drang srong rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha rnams kyi ni bdud rtsi lta bu dang //drang srong rnams kyi bcud len lta bur ni// khyed la sman 'di nye bar gnas gyur cig / rlung mkhris bad kun bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad// tshe la bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang // gnod pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang //ye 'grogs sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa// bsam pa'i bar du gcod pa i bar mdzod// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te lha ṣa pyo gu ru bee ḍūrla pra lha rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā kṣiṃ ṭwāṃ rdo rdo sa/ khri byā mu kṣiṃ /te /rdo/thā/ba// / rdo stab/rdo /rtsi/ /shāX rdo/ ri/ 'dzin mchod// dngos grub blangs pas rang gi nad gdon bsal// nad pas

sa blo da pa yi da/ 111bsten pas 'chi ba sos par bsam smo dam ldan byin 'bebs bkra shis bsod nams 'byung / rnam pa bzo ba lus ngag yin dang gsum lag pa bzo bas sman dpyad bzo la mkhas// ngag tshig snyan pas nad pa spro skyed nus/ rig pa bkra bas yid la ma rmongs gsal/ de shes gso rnams kun gyi dpon du 'gyur// bya ba la brtson bdag dang gzhan gnyis te/ bdag nyid bya ba brtson pa rgyu la bslab rkyen bsten grogs la brtson bya goms mthar dbyung //rgyu ni 'dri klog mtha' ru phyin par bslab// chod dang mi chod de la brten par snang / de rkyen slob dpon bsten te mtshan nyid dang // bsten pa'i thabs dang bsten pa'i dgos pa gsum/ mtshan nyid rgya che mkhas dang man ngag ldan// ngang ring gsog chung brtse la bskur 'os bsten/ bston thabs dogs pa med par blo gtad la// ngo lkog med par bya ba bsgrub par bya// spyod pa thams cad de yi yul dang bsnan// drin du tshor bas rgyun du bsring bar bya//dgos pa myur bar lobs dang mkhas par 'gyur// grogs la brtson bya zhu dang dri ba dang // bzung dang bsam pa le lo bya ba min// ci yi phyir na de nyid bar gcod dgra// goms pa mthar dbyung mthong thos blang ba ste// thams cad zhin 'dris the tshom spong bar byed/ gzhan gyi bya ba la brtson nad pa de// de don phyi bshol bar du ma chod par/ byang thog mar por bo na gsod bsdigs ba'i na// sman dpyad dus las ma 'gyangs brtson pas sgrims// mi yi chos lugs mkhas par bya ba ni// mi chos pa dang dam pa thun mong gsum// dang po mkhas par bslab la gnyan gyis btsa'// spyong gis 'dul gsum ldan na 'dod pa 'grub// dam pa'i chos lugs sna dul 'grogs pa bde// chog shes gyur na rang gzhan phan thogs 'gyur// thun mong phongs pa rnams la snying rjes bzung // mthon po rnams kyis rang gis mdo don sgrub tshogs pa drug ldan 'bras bu the tshom med// nyes pa gnod bya gnyen po'i mtshan nyid rnams/ ci

112 lta/grwa nga rgyud bzhi/rigs khong du chud pa ngo bor 'dod// nges tshig nad gso lus la phan phyir sman// nad stengs dpyad dpa' 'gro la pha ltar skyob// rgyal po rnam sa kyis rje ru 'khur bar byed// dbye ba sman pa bla na med pa dang // khyad par can dang pal pa gsum yin te// dus gsum rgyu 'bras nad sel gong na med / gal na rig mngon shes byams lda na drang por srong // gnang rigs rjes sbya ngas las soms 'gro ba'i gnyen// 'dod pas phral du cha bzung srog gi gshed// 'on kyang rma chog dang tha mar grags pa ste// gdung btsun blo dang ldan zhing dam la gnas // gzhung sgye don mkhas man ngag gnad du rdeg / soms thog gtso bor chos gnyer 'dod pa spangs// dul ling bzo mkhas 'gro la byams sem sa che// g.yel med ga 'an gyi don la rang don sems// gso dpyad kun la rmongs med sman pa mchog / 'gro ba nad pa rnams kyi mgon gcig du // rig 'dzin drang srong rnams kyi rgyud 'dzin sras// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po'i sprul par ba da// de ltar mi ldan tha ma'i skyon// rigs rgyud med pa'i sman pa de// wa yis rgyal sa bzung ba ltar// kun gyis spyi bor bkur mi 'gyur//gzhung don mi shes sman pa de// dmus long dag la rdzas bstan ba'i na// nad rigs bcos thabs shan mi phyed// mthong goms med pa'i sman pa di// rgyus med lam du zhugs pa ba'i na// nad rtags dpyad la the tshom 'gyur// brtag thabs mi shes sman pa de// gnyen med gyes su 'khyams pa 'dra// nad ngo shes pa gcig mi 'byung // rtsa chu mi rshas sman pa de// bya pas bya gtong mi shes 'dra/ tsha grang nad kyi skad mi ster// kha mar mi shes sman pa de// gtso bos smra ba mi shes 'dra// rang skyengs grags pa ngan pa 'phog / bcos tshul mi shes sman pa de// mun khung 'ben la brdog pa 'dra// gnyen po nad thog 'bab mi 'gyur//zas spyod mi shes sman pa de rang srid dgra la 'o ga pa 'dra// nad kyi stobs skyed lus zungs 'jom sa / zhi sbyor mi shes sman pa de/ so nam mi shes zhing pa

sa bshad pa sku yi rgyud 113'dra// dman lhag log pas nad skyed 'gyur/ sbyong byed mi shes sman pa de//bye ma'i ri la chu 'bebs 'dra// nad dang lus zungs ma rungs byed// cha dpyad sman med sman pa de// go mtshon med pa'i dpa' bo 'dra// nad kyi dgra dpung choms mi 'gyur// gtar bsreg mi shes sman pa de// nang yan med pa'i rkun mo 'dra// nad dang dpyad du 'dzol bar 'gyur// de phyir sman pa ngan pa ni// lci yang log par rtogs pa yis// gso ba log pa dag tu 'gyur//bdud nyid sman pa'i cha byad can// gzhin rje'i 'gas pa thogs pas na//srog gi gzu ba yin pa'i phyir// 'brel pa mi bya 'khor rnams phung // sman pa'i las la thun mong khyad par gnyis// dang po lus ngag yid kyi bya ba'i las//lus kyis sman dang cha dpyad tshos sa par bsag / nad pa'i bya ba gang yin don du gnyer// ngag gi las ni kha mar gdags pa ste// rtogs na khrom du dung 'bud lha bur gdags// 'tsho bar khas spangs 'chi bar dus btab gces /nyams ma longs na sbrul lce lta bur gdags// gnyis pa zhon nas gang bzang steng du bros// yang na mthun par snang ba gsal gdab cing // blo yis chod pa yul dang bstun pa dang // srid pa'i sgo mi dgags par rdzong la bros// dang po nad pas dogs dang sman pas rtogs / gcig par mthun na de nyid gsal por brjod// gnyis pa nad pas dug tu dogs pa la// ga 'an bzung thog tu ma byung zer srid phyir// blo bstun der btags nad gang yin pa bcos//gsum pa 'tsho 'chi nyen che nyen chung rnams// klung rta las dbang bsod nams rkyen dbang gis// ji 'dra 'chi la ji 'dra 'tsho ba'i phyir// kha mar ha cang gsal ba smra mi btub// nyen cher yod kyang gso ru yo da par smra// nyen chung tshor yang bya ra dgos par smra// lar yang mi chos 'jig rten dag dang bstun//yid las ma 'khrul brtson pas bsam zhing gzhig / khyad par las ni lta sgom spyod pa gsum/ lta ba chos rnams kun la dbu mar gtogs// dman mtha'

115 sa /grwa thang rgyud ba'i/lhag mtha' log pa'i mtha' spangs pa'i// yang dag dbu mar lta ba lta ba'i mchog / sgom pa tshad med bzhi yi ngang du gnas// log pa'i gol sa bzhi ru ma shor gces// spyod pa blang dor gnyis las mi dge spang // smyo 'chal tho co sdig pa ngan spyod dor// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus spyad// sman pa'i 'bras bu gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis// gnas skabs 'bras bu tshe 'dir skyid pa dang // dbang dang longs spyod dga' bde ldan par 'gyur//de dag sgrub par byed pa sman yin pas// de yang rang gi yo na tan mi la 'phyar//'tshe ba'i mi la'ang srun bzhin bag phab la// brtag cing tshod blang spyod pa bsnan la bcos// de yis bsod nams grags pa thob par 'gyur/ 'dod pa'i zas dang longs spyod shugs las 'byung // 'di dus bag dang lda na pas btsa' bar bya// brin pa'i dus su zas nor gsher zhing blangs// 'gyangs na drin byas brjed nas lan mi khyer// mthar thug 'bras bu g.yo sgyu 'dod pa rnams// spangs nas nad pa gso ba la 'jug pa// bla med sangs rgyas sa la bgrod 'gyur zhes// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad pa yin// zhes gsungs nas rig pa'i ye shes de sman pa'i rgyal po'i dbu'i gtsug tu thim par gyur to//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gso ba po sman pa'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa gcig pa'o//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las bshad pa'i rgyud ces bya ba rdzogs so// / /yar rgyab chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal ja de// blo gros rgyal po'i dbyug grus bskul ba'i tshe// gso rig bstan pa'i lo thog rgyas byed pa'i// mi zad chos kyi char ba 'di bab bo// shu lha
༄khya//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dum bu gsum pa man ngag rgyud ces bya ba bzhugs so//

116le'u dang po/ man ngag rgyud zhus pa/denas ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'tsho mdzad sman gyi bla bee ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po des ting nge 'dzin de las bzhings te dgos 'dod 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i sman gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu sku'i lte ba las 'od zer kha dog brgya stong du ma phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba sems can kyi 'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal bsal// phyi nang gi nad thams cad i bar byas te slar sku'i lte bar 'dus pa las/ sprul pa'i ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba zhig yon tan las sprul te mdun gyi bar snang la bzhugs pa la sa/ gsung cu sprul pa drang srong yid las skyes zhes bya ba des ston pa la phyag dang bskor ba byas nas 'di skad ces zhus so// kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// rgyas par bshad rgyud de ltar gsungs lags na// man ngag rgyud la ji ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa dang / yon tan las sprul pa'i drang srong rig pa'i ye shes des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes// gsum pa man ngag rgyud la bslab pa ni//'gro mchog gtso bor gyur pa'i mi lus kyang / ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gas 'khor bar 'khyam// gti mus dbang gis skyon yon rgyu ma shes// 'dod pa'i dbang gis sdig pa'i las mang spyad// zhe sdang dbang gis ga 'an la gnad du btsugs// phrag dog dbang gis mtho la 'gran sems bskyed// nga rgyal dbang gis dma' la khyad du bsad// rig pa sbyang bas rtsom pa kun la 'jug mdo

khanang g.yon rtan gyi da/ 117don chung bas yun gyi srid ma rnyed// las ngan bag chags rgyun 'khrigs bsags pa yis/ 'khor ba'i kha brgyud lus ngan sna tshogs blangs// de phyir las dang nyes pa las byung ba'i// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad du grags pa yis//bde ba'i bar skabs med par lus sems gdungs// de la nyes pa khong nad tshad pa dang // lus stod don snod gsang ba thor bu'i nad// lhan skyes rma brgyad lus spyir gso ba ston// byis pa mo nad gdon mtshon dug nad dang ⑪gas pa ro tsa yan lag brgyad po yis// spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil yan chad kyi// nad kyi rigs su gyur pa'i bcos thabs kun/ lag len man ngag rgyud chen 'di nang du// brtse ba'i sems kyis drang srong khyod la bshad// gus pas nyon la yin la zin par gyis/ dregs med byams pa'i sems kyis nad pa gsos// kye drang srong chen po yin las skyes// blo rab don du rtsa rgyud mdor bstan bshad/ blo 'bring don du bshad rgyud rgyas par bshad// tha ma'i don du shin tu rgyas pa yi/ dmar khrid lag len gcig tu khrigs sdebs pa'i/man ngag rgyud 'di bco lnga'i skabs kyis dbye// de la rlung mkhris bad kun sna drangs nas// nad rigs gang la gso thabs gang dgos pa// khyod kyis dris shig nga yis bshad lung sbyin// zhes gsungs pa dang / drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags khyod ni 'gro kun dpal du shar bas na// dang por mdo gnas rtsa rgyud bsdus par gsungs// des ma khrol la bshad rgyud rgyas par gsungs// da ni de yi lag len man ngag rgyud skabs kyi dbye ba bco lngar gsungs pa las// nyes gsum gso ba'i skabs la ji ltar bslab// rlung dang mkhris pa bad kun rnam gsum gyi// rgyu rkyen dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs rnams// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// kye ho 'gro ba'i don du bshad du gsol/grogs kyi dam par dgongs la bshad du gsol/ zhes zhus so//
rgyu/ zhu kyis rdo 'i le ༵ rdo ༷kā 'o pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las man

119le'u gnyis pa/ drung gi nad gso ba/de nas ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dang po nyes gsum gso ba'i skabs bstan pa//rlung dang mkhris pa bad kun gsum du bshad// de la rlung ni nad kun 'khrug pa'i rgyu// sna 'dren mjug sdud 'thor dang khyab par byed// rang rgyud gdug cing nad mang tsub pa'i phyir// thog mar rlung gi bcos thabs bshad par bya/kye drang srong chen po ma yengs gus pas nyon// rlung gi nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa lnga yis bshad// rgyu ni ma rig las byung 'dod chags kyis// bskyed rlung mtshan nyid drug ldan tha mal gnas//de rkyen kha dang yang tsub bsten drags dang // chags pas dub dang lto dang gnyid chag dang / lto stong lus ngag bya ba drag shul dang // khrag mang zags dang 'khru skyugs drag pos btab// bser bus bus dang ga chad ngus pa dang //mya ngan sems las kha yi las ches dang // bcud med kha zas yen la brtad pa dang // shugs bkag pa dang nan gyis btsir ba yi// rkyen des dang por rang gnas 'phel zhing gsog / rang gi nus stobs rgyas nas rkyen phrad slong //rkyen drag gsog ldang dus gcig byed pa'ang yod// langs nas 'jug sgo drug zhugs rang rtags ston// bde med rlung nad drug cu rtsa gsum 'byung // de la dbye na spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la dbye na rigs dang gnas su sbyar//rigs ni ga 'an rgyud log pa'i lam zhugs pa/ rlung nad a warta dang da rgan gnyis// 'gram pa nyams dang lce ldib phyogs gcig gug / rtsa 'dzin gzhogs

120 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'iphyed skams dang lus kun skams// shing rengs dpung 'ja' bi sha tse dang ni//sra 'theng dang ni brla rengs lce spyang mgo / tsher ma gzugs 'khums kha li rkang brtse dang // rkang pa tsha ba zhes bya nyi shur bshad// mdor bsdus rengs 'khums skams dang sbos pa dang // 'phyes gzer 'phyos dang bog pa brgyad du bsdu// gnas ni rang rgyud gnod bya la zhugs pa// pags gram shar rgyas rtsa ru rgyu ba dang // rus la zhen dang don babs snod du lhung // dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba'o// de la gnyis pa sha dang tshil zhugs gnyis// gsum pa rtsa chu khrag la zhugs pa gsum// bzhi pa nus tshigs rkang dang bcud zhugs bzhi//lnga pa glo snying mchin rma cher mkhal zhugs lnga// drug pa zas dang ma zhu zhu ba'i gnas// mkhris pa bshang gci mthal du zhugs pa bdun// dbang po mgo mig rna ba sna so dang // kun la zhugs dang nyi shu brgyad du bshad// mdor bsdus mgo rlung snying rlung glo rlung dang // mchin rlung pho rlung long rlung mkhal rlung bdun// bye brag dbye ba srog 'dzin gyen rgyu dang // khyab byed me mnyam thur sel kyang pa lnga// bad kun mkhris par 'dres pas bcu ru bshad//brtag pa'i thabs la rnam pa gsum yin te// slong ba rgyu yi sgo nas brtag pa dang // mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas brtag pa dang // phan gnod soms pa'i sgo nas brtag pa'o// dang po slong ba rgyu la brtag pa ni// gong gi zas dang spyod lam rkyen rnams kyis// bslang nas na na rlung las gzhan mi srid// de phyir dang po rgyu brtag gces pa yin/ mtshan nyid rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi rtags rtsa ni stong la rkyal ba dang // chu ni chu 'dra gdang la log rjes sla// 'gro 'dod shus 'debs shes pa yang la 'phyo// mgo bo zi 'khor rna ba 'ur la 'khrog / lce skam dmar rtsub kha ro bska ba bro// gzer 'pho grang 'dar 'gul khyab zug dang snyom// rengs 'khums bye chag 'byin dang dkris snyam byed// 'gul na zug che spu rtse phrum bser khyer// gnyid med g.yal

sa blonang ga yon tan gyi da 121'dar thung 'dod tshig pa za// dbyi skad rus tshigs ma lus brdungs snyam byed// ltag pa brang dang mur 'gram zug cing gzer// rlung gsang rnams ni kha bye mnan na na// stong skyugs byed cing tho rangs sbu gsog lu// sbo 'khrog gongs dang tho rangs zhu rjes na/ bye brag brtag pa rlung gis dgur por bsdus// 'khun zhing dran med mig har dbugs 'byin dka'// de min rlung nad a warta nar bshad ta da rgan phyir dgye brang 'bur gnya' ba brtungs ltag pa dgye la so 'cha' sbya bar skyug / mgo dang 'gram pa rgyab na skad mi phyin//mig har g.yal 'byung rtsib logs gnyis su zug / da rgan nang gug na tshul de 'dra la// ge btungs brang du bsdus te ro stod 'bur// 'gram pa nyams pa 'thams 'phyang 'byed 'dzums nyams// lce ldib bza' btung smra dka' lkugs ldib then// gzhogs gcig gug pa la yo mgo bo 'dar// tshigs thogs mig rengs dran nyams gnyid log dngangs// rtsa 'dzin rlung khrag spyi bo'i rtsar zhugs te// nad tshabs drag la spyi gtsug sha mdog nag / gzhogs phyed skams pa tshor med bya ba nyams// lus kun skams pa thams cad de dang 'dra// shing rengs dgye dgu mi shes shing ltar rengs/ dpung 'ja' phrag zhugs 'degs sogs bya nyams na// bi sha tse ni lag sor bya ba nyams// sra 'theng brla nang chu ba la zhugs pas// 'gro 'dar tshigs lhod 'theng zhing rkang pa 'phyes// brla rengs bad kun tshil 'phel brla dus zhen// grang zhing tshor med 'degs da 'a lci ba'o// rlung khrag pus por skrangs pa lce spyang mgo /long mor zhugs pa rlung nad tsher ma ste/ rting chur zhugs na byin rengs gzugs 'khums yin// gzugs 'khums bi sha tse 'dom kha lir bshad//rkang pa brtse ba rkang brtse zhes bya ste rkang pa tsha ba drod bcas 'gro tshe tsha//mdor bsdus rengs 'khums dgye dgu brkyang bskum nyams// skams pa tshor med bya nyams 'a pags 'byar// sbos pa g.yo zhing skrangs la 'phel 'bri byed//

122 zhu/grwa thang rgyud bzhi/'phyes pa smad bshal rkang pa snyi la bem/ gzer ba kur zug nad drag nges med 'pho// 'phyos pa gnyid med mang smra ngu 'bros rgod// lkugs pa stobs dang dran nyams smra mi shes// gnas dang sbyar na pags la rlung gram pa// gas snyam reg pa tsub la brtse ba yin// shar zhugs spangs tsub mdog 'gyur 'brum pa 'byung // tshil zhugs yid 'chus lus skrangs then bu skyed// rtsar zhugs rtsa de stong la sbom por skrangs// khrag zhugs gnyid che rtsa dmar mdog mi sdug /chu bar zhugs pa zha rengs 'theng par byed// rus zhugs zug che sha skams nyams stobs 'dzad// tshigs zhugs stong sbob skrangs na da rgan 'gyur// rkang zhugs gnyid med dkris sem btsir na phan// khu bar zhugs pa skam mam mdog 'gyur lug / snying zhugs stod gang shus 'debs shes pa 'byo// glor zhugs byad skrangs mi khogs spu gsob lu// mchin zhugs bkres dus g.yal mang 'phyongs nas na// mcher zhugs lus skrang sbo 'khrog steng du gzer//mkhal zhugs mkhal rked na zhing rna ba 'on// zas la rlung zhugs kha zas zos rjes na// ma zhu'i gnas zhugs sgrog skyug yi ga 'gag / sbo 'khrog skom dad che la dbugs mi bde// zhu ba'i gnas zhugs gzer zhing sbo 'khrog byed//bshang 'gag chu sri rked pa mjug to na// mkhris zhugs sbo gzer 'ju dka' mig sprin ser// bshang zhugs rlung 'khyil rtug skam sgra bcas 'khru// gcin zhugs lhang pa bsil sbo sri'am snyi// mngal zhugs 'bur 'dril mngal khrag sdom mam 'dzag / mgor zhugs mgo 'khor zi 'khyom brtan mi tshugs// mig zhugs rtsa dmar lug snyam bser bu gnod// rna bar zhugs pa 'ur 'khrog stong snyam gzer// snar zhugs sna 'gag chu 'dzag dri mi tshor// sor zhugs ber ba langs nas na zhing skrangs// lus kun zhugs pa kun khyab spyi rtags 'dra//mdor bsdus mgo rlung mgo 'khor rna ba 'ur// skyug cing langs na 'gyel bub phyi yul 'khyom// snying rlung lus 'dar stod rgyangs shes pa 'khrul// smra 'chal

zhu nang ga yon tan gyi rgyud 123mgo 'khor gnyid chung shu yis 'debs// glo rlung gnyid chung khogs dka' sbru gsob lu// lus rgyangs skyug dang mig spangs nub glo mang // mchin rlung sgrog cing stod gzer gshum sha na// kha zas yi gar mi 'ong mig mi gsal// gongs dang tho rangs mchin pa 'phyong thag chad/ pho rlung dbugs rgod sbo la stong sgrog byed// pho ba 'brab snyam zlas rjes bde bar mngon// long rlung sbo 'khrog 'khru dang 'og rlung mang // mkhal rlung mkhal rked na zhing rna ba 'ur// nang tshegs rlung nad rnam lnga nad gyur rtags// srog rlung zas tsub snang dang drag shul lam// shugs bkag btsir bas 'khrugs te mgo bo 'khor// snying 'phyos dbugs sdud dka' zhing min mi thub/ stong rgyu sgrig skyug bkag dang ngu rgod drags// khur lci bteg pas 'khrugs te deg cig lkugs smra dka' stobs chung kha yo dran pa nyams// khyab byed 'gro 'dug rtsed mo drags pa dang ku'ajigs dang yi mug kha zas tsub pas 'khrugs// snying bcugs brgyal 'bog mang du smra ba dang // 'gro 'dod 'jigs skrag mi snyan tshig gis slong // mnyam gnas 'ju dka'i zas dang nyin gnyid kyis// 'khrugs pas pho ba grang zhing zas mi len// skyug cing kha zas mi 'ju bsus khrag 'dres// thur sel bshang gci gyen dang khu ba yi// shugs bkag btsir bas 'khrugs te rus mig 'khol// yan lag 'khrul 'phyes dbugs ngan dri chu sdom// de dag gang yang mkhris par 'dres pa yis// tsha ba skye zhing mig chu ser bar byed/ bad kun 'dres pas byu bsil rmongs par 'gyur// phan gnod bsten pa'i sgo nas brtag pa ni / sha chang bur mar drod bcud bsten pa dang // bsku mnye me nyis dros thing 'grangs na bde chu grang ba dar lo shur g.yer ma ja// bkres skom grangs dang smra rjod nyal po dang ta gnyid chag sems las gnod pas rlung du shes// mdor bsdus dang po zas spyod gnod pas bslang // bar du rtsa stong chu dngas g.yal 'dar rnyong // spu brtse sgongs dang tho rangs zhu rjes na// tha ma

124 sa /grwa nga da bzhi/bsil gnod drod bcud phan 'gyur ba// nad gang yin yang rlung gi mi 'gyur rtags/ bcos pa'i thabs la sbyi dang bye brag gnyis// sbyi la bcos thabs zas spyod sman dpyad ba'i/ dang po zas kyi sgo nas bcos pa ni// zwa dang tsong sgog zan skam rus tshod dang // lug sha rta thong 'phyi ba mi yi sha / lo yib bu ram mar rnying 'bru mar dang / zan dron 'o ma chang dang bur chang sogs// dro zhing snum bcud zas kyis bcos par bya/ g.yeng ba med pa'i mun khung dro ba'i gnas gos mthug gnyid log snyan tshig smra ba dang // yid du 'ong ba'i grogs kyis bcos par bya// gnod cing skyed pa'i zas spyod dus kun spang //sman ni khu ba chang dang 'don sbyor dang // phye ma sman mar lnga las dang po ni/sre long sogs yu gzhug chung bsdus khu dang // rus pa sna tshogs bsdus khur spod btab btang // rlung nad ma lus kun la phan pa yin// sha mar bur rnying chang du bsdus pa'i thang 5 rlung nad kun sel mchog tu so la phan// dza ti kha ru tsha dang shing kun btab// snying dang srog rtsar zhugs pa'i rlung rnams sel/lug mgo lo gsum lon pa'i bsdus khu la// shing kun sga dang rgyam tsha kha tshar btab// rlung nad kun 'joms khyad par mgo rlung sel// sga dang thing kun bsdus pa'i khu ba la // kha ru tsha btab rlung nad kun la phan// khyad par pho long rlung dang snying rlung sel// sga dang go snyod dzā ti bsdus pa'i thang / rlung nad ma lus 'joms shing dran pa gsal chang ni lca ba ra mnye zan chang la/gro yi chang bsings rlung nad ma lus 'joms// mchog tu mkhal rked smad kyi rlung la phan// 'di la sogs te spyor ri'i sman ming po por ma na bus mi gsal brnams gyi rgyud bzhin rtogs par bya'o/ bu ram chang gis rlung nad thams cad 'joms// de bzhin mar chang grang rlung sel bar byed gze ma'i chang gas rus rlung mkhal rlung sol// thong tsher rus chang rus pa'i rlung la phan// 'don la dkar 'don dmar 'don skyur 'don dang // sgog 'don bzhi las dang po rtseg

༄gyi/man nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 125bcad mar// choms phye 'ol skom sbyar ba 'o mar btsos// sga dang rgyam tsha btab pa dkar 'don yin// lug sha'i khu bar sbyar ba dmar 'don no//skyur 'don khugs pa'i glum la nye 'u byas// mar rnying bu ram sga btab btsos pa 'o// sgog 'don sgog skya tshos par btsos la bsnur// mar dang rus khu rgyam tsha'i phye btab btso// de rnams gang yang rlung nad ma lus 'joms/ lus kyi stobs skyed dbang shes gsal bar byed// ri thang mtshams kyi rlung la bdud rtsi 'dra// phye ma dza ti shing kun kha ru tsha// rtsa ru tsha dang rgyam tsha tsha ba gsum//shing tsha se 'bru sug sprel a ru ra// sle tres sgog skya bur dkar brgyad 'gyur sbyar// dzā ti thing kun gang rung gtso bor btang // dus bcud gsum mam bcud bzhi'i khu bas dbul stod smad phyi nang rlung kun 'di yis 'joms//sman mar la ru tsha dang pi pi ling // 'i ru 'bri mar rlung nad stong la phan// se 'bru 'u su sga dang tsi tra ka/ pi pi ling dang 'bri mar rlung rnams 'joms me drod skyed cing skem po rgyas par byed// sgog skya bur mar sbyar ba nas gseb mnan// rlung nad ma lus 'joms pa'i sman mchog yin// dza ti kha ru tsha dang shing kun dang // a ru ra dang 'bri mar rlung rnams 'joms/ de bzhin btsan dug rus chen 'bras bu gsum// rtsa ba lnga yi sman mar sbyar bar bya/dpyad du mar rnying drod kyi 'jam rtsi btang // a ru ra dang sgog skya rgyam tsha dang / zhun mar sbyar ba'i reng bus smad rlung sel// nad gzhan gegs byas snum lda na 'jam pos sbyang // 'bru mar rnying pas lus kun byugs la mnye/gzer sar 'ba' cha rus rnying btsos pas bdug / sna tshogs rus pa btsos pa'i rlangs lums bya// de yi zhag gis lus kun byug cing mnye/ snum 'chos /// /kā /// da bas byā 35 // /'a/ bsdi rim ma 'a ཿ/sdu ༵ //sdo ji // ga 'an 'dres na de ltar ma yin spang / spyi gtsug yan stong tshigs pa dang po

126 sto/grwa nga dab /dang // drug bdun bcu drug dkar nag mtshams rnams bsreg / de ltar cho ga 'di rnams bsten gyur na// rlung nad du ma ma lus 'joms par nges// bye brag gso thabs rigs gnas nang tshegs gsum// rlung nad rigs kyi sgo nas bcos pa ni// a warta la snum dugs byas pa'i rjes// sna sbyongs rno bas dbugs rgyu'i bu ga bsal/ de yi rjes la rgya shug 'o ma zhi sha khu mar khu bskol ba'i dngas ma bsrud// rgya shug thang shing slo tres rtsa ba lnga// ru rta rgya spos kuṇḍa ka ri dang // sha khu 'o ma bur rtsabs snum ba'i bskol// mar de byug bdug sna sman 'jam rtsir btang // rlung de bad kun 'dres na snying ga dang //rtsib logs na la g.yer ma a ru ra// shing kun rgyam tsha shing tsha kha ru tsha// ma nu nas bskol khu ba sbrang sbyar bslud// thing kun bca' sga se 'bru kha ru tsha// ru rta bskol ba'i khu ba bsrud par bya// rme khris par 'dres na sna sman khrus kyis sbyang // dgan phyir dgye nang gug 'gram nyams dang // phyogs gcig gug dang dpung pa 'ja' ba la// sna sman brta ba btang jing spyi bo dang // mig dang rna bar til mar bsku zhing dgang // skrangs nas skyugs btang dmar tsha gtar ga gdab// brla rengs ma zhu bad tshil skyes pa'i phyir// de la snum 'chos spangs la rtsub bcos bya// nas dkar so ba sre zan skam sa'i sha sbrang rtsi skyur rtsabs tshod ma tsha med sbyin/ 'bras bu gsum dang tsa bya pi pi ling //hong len sbrang dang sbyar ba'i lde gu btang / tsa bya tsi tra ka dang a ru ra// sgron shing sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i lde gu btang // gu gul brag zhun a ru ba gcin bslud//gla sgang tsi tra ka dang tsha ba gsum// gu gul 'bras bu gsum dang byi dang ga cha mnyam phye mas tshil dang bad kun sel// ka rañdza dang yungs kur ba gcin byug / tshil dang bad kun zad bya'i drag shul brtsam// zad nas la zas glod de snum 'chos bya// gzugs 'khums sra 'theng bi sha tse sogs la/ ra sna sna la dong gra tsi tra ka/ pi pi ling dang zur pa ma nu yi// phye ma mar bskol thogs

wu/mnang ga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 127med 'gro nus 'gyur/ bi sha tse dang gzugs 'khums gar yod ngos//mthe'u chung srin lag rgyab kyi rgyus pa la// ser po snal ma 'dra ba yod de bcadakasra 'theng la sogs phyi ma'i rlung rnams kun// rgyu las brtags la snum dugs gtar ba dang // sbyang dang byug sogs ci rigs sbyar bar bya rgya spos ru rta sug spel shu dag gnyis// tsan dan dmar po rdo dreg spang spos dang / shu ti til mar ka ra sbyar ba'i mar// rtsa 'dzin shing rengs sra 'theng la sogs pa'i//rlung nad lhag ma ma lus 'joms par byed// smyo rjed skran dang rlig blugs sel bar 'gyur// gnas kyi sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni// sha pags la zhugs bsku mnye byug dugs bya// tshil zhugs brla rengs phyug po'i rlung ltar gso//nus dang zang zhugs snum dugs bya ba dang // snum bzhi bza' dang byug dang 'jam rtsi btang // bcud la rlung zhugs da byid skyin gor sbyar// rgyus pa tshigs dang rtsar zhugs snum dugs dkri/ chu ba 'khums la mon sran dre'u dang // rgyam tsha til mar sbyar te bskol ba byug / khrag la rlung zhugs snum 'chos byas la gtar// khrag zags rjes su tshor med gyur pa la/ dud pa rgyas tsha til mar sbyar bas byug / don babs snying rlung shing kun gsum thang btang ku 'bras bu'i mar dang sman chen sman mar sbyar// glor zhugs star bu cu gang zi rad ra po sug sprel)bzhi pa'i phye ma dang / a ru 'bri rkang sur phug sman mar sbyar// mchin zhugs ting khrol mchin pa spod bran btang ta mcher zhugs tsha ba gsum dang zhun mar sbyar// mkhal zhugs rtsa ba lnga dang gze chang byin// kun la rgyab kyi tshigs pa'i rang gsang bsreg / zas dang ma zhu'i gnas zhugs skyugs sman btang // 'ju byed me drod skyed byed zas sman sbyar//zhu gnas 'jam rtsi zas sngon zhun mar btang ta mkhris zhugs la rgod ma khag ra gyi rtog tig ta rgya tsha'i ces drod bskyed bshal dang me btsas bcos/ mngal du rlung zhugs mo nad lta bur gso// bshang zhugs daṇḍa'i mar sbyar 'jam rtsi

128 sto/grwa nga da ba /btang // gcin zhugs snum ldan dugs dang chu sman sbyar// mgor zhugs byug pa me bca' mgo khrol bsten/ rna bar zhugs na dugs bya zhun mar dgang // mig dang snar zhugs zhun mar dngas ma blug / sor zhugs dugs dang me btsa' bcud bzhi'i thang // dbang po kun la 'bras bu'i sman mar mchog / lus kun la zhugs spyi bcos rang gis 'thems// de nas nang tshegs rlung lnga'i sgos bcos la// srog 'dzin rlung la til mar bsku mnye bya/sna sman 'jam po btang la rlung gsang bsro// stod rgyu brang dang sdud sgor snum gyis bdug / sman mar rus thang btang zhing gsang gsum bsreg / khyab byed dzā ti zho sha'i sman mar btang // bur chang lo sha sha chen tsha ba bsten me mnyam dugs bya shing kun sa ru tsha sa 'bru'i cur nis sbyar// bcu gsum pa dang me mnyam gsang la bsreg / thur sel rlung la 'jam rtsi bsku mnye dugs//drod bcud zas bsten bcu drug mdo ru bsreg / mkhris par 'dres la sbyongs dang bsil bcud bsten// bad kun 'dres la skyugs dang yang dro sbyar// kye drang srong chen po ma yengs gus pas nyon// rlung nad mdor bsdus bcos thabs 'di ltar bya// rengs 'khums snum 'chos bya zhing lums kyis gdul//skams pa snum dugs rtsa bshal chu lums bya// sbos pa snum 'chos rjes la bshal gyis sbyang // 'phyes pa snum 'chos spangs la tsub bcos bya / gzer ba snum ldan dugs dang me yis bcag / 'phyos pa bcud ba'i 'i sman ma ra me thur mnan// lkugs pa snum 'chos 'jam rtsi dang gtsus in stong song mo gyi /sros pa smosabyed rnams la me btsas bsal/ mgo rlung til mar zhing kun sna sman btang / so ma ra dza sgog skya kha ru tsha mar sbyar byugs la drod gtum sa dkris mas bsdam// sga dang shing kun bsdus pa'i rlangs lums bya// sna tshogs nus khu lo mar lug tshil rkang // bu ram sha khur sbyar bslud rngul dbyung bya// ltag khung kha gsum tshigs pa gsum pa bsreg / snying rlung zho sha gsum dang 'bras bu

sa khan nga g.yon tan gyi bad/ 129gsum// 'bri mar bu ram sbyar ba'i sman mar la tsha ba gsum dang tsha sna gsum btab btang // rus sna'i zhag dang lo mar bu ram la drod sman tshwa sna tshogs tshad sbyar la btang / drug bdun dkar nag mtshams dang bya mig bsreg / glo rlung star bu cu gang zi ra dkar// sug sprel kha ru tsha dang ka ra sbyar// bzang po bzhi dang tshwa gsum sbrang sbyar btang // se 'bru bzhi dang nā ga zi ra dang // pa tra 'u su la la phud dang sga// na le sham dang kur sbyar gsar 'jam dbul// ba'i lnga bya rog mig dang ske stong bsreg / yib ma gar chang mi btang gsar sha dang // gro chang sro los bsings dang gsar 'jam btang spyomachin rlung mchin sna skams phye'i sman mar la// kha ru tsha dang gur gum btab la btang // brag zhun sman mar 'bri rkang sman mar sbyar rus sna'i lums bya dgu pa rtsib steng bsreg / pho ba'i rlung la bu ram ting khrol btang // se 'bru shing tsha drod gsum tshwa sna gsum// zi ra dkar nag gnyis dang tsha ba gsum//la la phud dang bu ram chang gis dbul/ bur chang sbyar btang pho dkyil bcu gsum bsreg / long gi rlung la se 'bru tsha ba gsum// kha ru tsha dang gro ma 'bos lo dang // bu ram sbyar btang sgog skya'i sman mar byin// sle tres kuṇḍa ka ri shu dag dang // btsod dang dzā ti sug sprel pi pi ling // yung ba shu mo za dang ra mar gyi// 'jam rtsi btang zhing long phugs g.yas g.yon bsreg / mkhal rlung mgo tshod shu mo za btab btang // dus sna'i khu ba bu ram sbyar bsdus sam//bong sha sum sha bur chang zan chang dang // rtsa ba lnga yi mar sbyar bcu bzhi bsreg / de la sogs te rlung nad du ma yang // nad gzhan 'dres na de yi kha 'dzin gces// rkyang pa rnams la spyi bcos khog phub la// rang rang nad kyi gso thabs mde khar gdags// snum bcud drod kyis mi sel rlung gzhan med//rlung ni tsha grang gnyis ga'i zung du 'jug / mkhris tshad 'bud cing bad kun grang ba 'khyag / dmu 'or skya rbab g.yo zhing skran rnams sgong // bsags pa'i

130 sa /grwa thang da ba /nad rnams thams cad rlung gis slong // byer ba'i nad kun sna 'dren rlung gis byed// tshad gzhug phal cher thor bu'i rlung gis 'bud// de phyir rlung gi nad la bya ra gyis// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rlung gi nad gso ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// / /

131le'u gsum pa/ mkhris pa'i nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / mkhris pa'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rjes bcad drug gis bstan// rgyu ni nad gzhi snod kyi mkhris pa la// slong rkyen gnad du mtshon bsnun 'grams pa dang // zas skom tsha skyur mi 'phrod ma zhu dang // zhe sdang mi gtsang lha bsnol 'dre g.yos pas//gso dka' mkhris nad bzhi bcu bdun du 'gyur// de la dbye ba spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la rigs dang gnas kyis dbye ba gnyis// rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na rnam bzhi ste// nad ga'i 'i mkhris pa thang la lhags pa dang // me drod mkhris pa gzhan gyi gnas gyur dang // snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud kha shor dang //thun mong mkhris pa rtsa ru rgyu ba 'o// dang po rkyen bzhis mkhris pa 'phel ba ste//tshad pa gso ba'i skabs su rgyas par ston// gnyis pa bad rlung ma zhu khrag la sogs// 'ju byed mkhris pa'i yul du zhugs pa yis// mkhris pa'i go 'phrogs phyi ru byer ba'o// gsum pa pho mchin skran gyis mkhris pa bcar//yang na mkhris pa rang la skran zhugs pas// mkhris pa dbang med phyi ru kha lud dam// 'grams sam rlung gis mkhris kha shor ba'o// ba'i pa snod mkhris 'ju byed gang yang rung // 'grams 'khrugs rims rkyen mkhris pa 'phel ba'amaspuzas spyod rkyen gyis 'phel te rtsar lud pas// sha ser mig ser rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur// mkhris nad bcu gsum rigs kyi dbye bar 'dod// mdor bsdus thog mtha' rang rgyud tsha ba'i nad// bar ma gnyis po gzhan dbang ldan pa

132 sto/grwa nga dba'i/yin// gnas kyis dbye na pags la gram pa dang // sha la rgyas dang rtsa ru rgyu ba dang // rus la zhen dang don babs snod du lhung // dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba'o// don ni glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma lnga// snod ni pho long rgyu ma sgang pa mngal// dbang po mgo mig rna ba sna lce'o// de ltar bcu dgu gnas kyi dbye bar 'dod// bye brag 'ju byed sgrub byed mdangs sgyur dang // mthong byed mdog gsal rnam lngar gyur pa'o// rlung dang bad tan 'dres pas bcu ru 'gyur// kun kyang mdor bsdus tsha grang gnyis su 'dus// khrag dang mkhris pa 'phel ba tsha ba ste// ma zhu bad rlung yul phrogs grang ba'o// de yi rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi rtags mig sprin bzhin pags chu mdog ser/ lto che mkhris pa 'khru skyug za 'phrug byed// de yang mkhris pa tsha ba skom dad che//rtsa grims chu yi rlangs che ku ya mthug / kha kha lus tsha gnyid chung bshang pa ser/sha chang mar rnying bu ram drod bag gnod// mkhris pa grang ba de las go log ste//me drod 'ju stobs chung la bshang pa dkar// bye brag tsha ba rgyu brtag goms pas brtag / rlung gi gnas gyur sbo 'khrog rtug pa skam// g.yal mang drod bcud zos rjes bde bar mngon/ ma zhu bad kun gang gi gnas gyur kyang //lus lci gnyid che sgyid skyur 'dug snying 'dod// zas skom spyod lam bsil gnod dro na bde// khyad par dri ma skya la sob pa yin// khrag gi gnas gyur thug po'i rgyu byas te// dri ma nag skug skam la sha ril 'dra// mchin pa'i skran nam mchin pa rgyas pa yis// mkhris yul phrogs na myangs pas dngos su gsal// pho ba'i skran gyis yul phrogs zas skom 'khren/ mkhris pa'i steng du sra zhing mnan mi bzod// mkhris pa rang la skran zhugs lus shed chung // lus kyi mdog ser za 'phrug dang ga 'gag / bshal dang gtar la nad thon bcos skyed med// nad de 'chi bdag kha ru tshud dang 'dra kha shor shed med mkhris pa 'khru skyug byed// mkhris pa 'grams sam 'khrugs tshad mkhris par babs

zhu/mnang g.yon tan gyi da 133rims nad mkhris par babs pa'i rtsar rgyug gsum/ de rtags bcos thabs rang rang le'ur blta / rang ba'i na zas spyod rkyen gyis mkhris 'phel ba'i//rtsar rgyug dag la sha ser mig ser gnyis// mkhris pa sha ser shed chung gnyid mi thub// lus lci zho dar chu sogs gang yang kha// sha mdog gser 'dra rdzas dkar ser por mthong / snga dro bsil phebs bde la nyin gung na// mkhris pa mig ser min spyin sen mo ser// lus rngul nyam chung khong tsha mig nus na// kha zas yi gar mi 'ong skom dad che// skyug pa snyam byed mig sngar sngo dmar mthong //kun kyang yun ring rgyas nas smin pa'i dus// kṣa ya nag por gyur nas za 'phrug byed// pags mdog sngo nag skra dang smin ma 'byi// shed med sha skam sen mo nag thig chags// 'di dus mkhris pas sha nus thams cad khyab//gshin rje'i zhags pas zin pas 'tsho mi 'gyur// 'di la bcos thabs mi brtsam tshogs gsog bskul// mkhris pa pags la gram pa za 'phrug byed// sha la rgyas pa shu ba 'thor pa 'byung // phrugs na chu ser khrag dang mkhris pa 'dzag / rtsa ru rgyu ba tshigs gzhi nya ga'i dang // dro sar za zhing rgyas nas lus kun za// rtsa mig mkhris pas gang phyir pags mig ser// gtar na khrag med mkhris pa zang mar 'ong // rus la zhen pa tshigs pa thams cad na/ khol bur na zhing sha skam tshigs thog skrangs// snying la zhugs na glo snying ston mi bde// lce ser gnyid chung snying la grang mo 'dod// glo la zhugs na snabs lud ser por 'ong / mchin par zhugs na sha sngo mchin steng na// mgo na mig tsha mchil ma ska la 'dril// mcher par zhugs na lce khra khrag rlan 'khru// sbo rjing rkang pa g.yon skrangs lhu tshigs na// mkhal mar zhugs na rkang pa snyi la sbrid// mkhal rked na zhing rna rgyab ser por 'gro// pho bar zhugs na mkhris pa 'khru skyug byed//long dang rgyu mar zhugs na mkhris pa 'khru// sgang par zhugs na chu kha sri'am snyi//mngal du zhugs na mkhris pa 'dzag gam 'dril mgo la zhugs na 'tshogs ma

134 ga /grwa thang dab /glan pa na/ nyi ma phog dang zho 'thungs ston dus ldang / mig zhugs mdog ser tsha zhing mchi ma mang // rnar zhugs zug che tsha la chu ser 'dzag / snar zhugs snabs kyi mdog ser mtshul pa 'gag / lce la zhugs na lce ser ro kun kha// kun la mig chu ser na mkhris par brtag / bye brag mkhris pa lnga las 'ju byed ni// nad du gyur na lce ser skom dad che// kha zas mi 'ju dang ga 'gag par 'gyur/ mdangs sgyur nad gyur chu ser pho ba ltem lus po lci la shed nyam chung ba yin// sgrub byed snying bcugs dbugs rgod skom dad che// dang ga mi bde lus 'dar glo snying tsha// mthong byed nad gyur mgo na chang 'thungs gzer// mig ser mig gis nye mthong ring mi mthong // mdog gsal nad gyur lus kyi sha drod che// sha pags sngo nag tsha la tsub pa'o// rlung dang bad kun gang 'dres de rtags ston// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis//spyi bcos mkhris nad tsha grang gnyis su bsdu// gnyen po sman dpyad zas dang spyod lam bzhi// mkhris nad tsha ba'i sman ni tig ta dang // gser gyi me tog kyi lce ba sha ka/ bong nga dkar po bskol grangs thang du btang // drod chung 'ju ba dka' na drod sman bsnan// de 'og gser gyi me tog tig ta gsum// bong nga dkar po ru rta par pa ta// rtsa mkhris hong len skyer shun ka ra sbyar// phye ma chus 'phul mkhris nad ma lus 'joms// ru thung gsha' ring snod ka gang babs gtar// des ma zhi na bsdu sbyang zhi gsum sbyar// dang po brag zhun nim pa ba sha ka/ spa 'brum tig ta a ba rgyan 'brum dang // lhum rtsa shing mngar skyer shun ka ra sbyar// gser gyi me tog ba chur sbangs khus dbul// 'dus rtags mig chu bzhin mdangs sngar bas dkar// skom snyeg dang ga 'gags na sbyang bar bya// khron bu tsha la gser gyi me tog phye// dri chur sbyar btang ba chu'i lcag gis bskul// 'bras thug rjes gcod zas skom bsil ba gces// de rjes nad lhag rol du bsad pa'i phyir// gser gyi me rtog spyi zhur ka ra sbyar//

sa khanang g.yon tan gyi da/ 135ba 'os 'phul bsten de rjes tig ta gsum// gser gyi me tog lcags gye bong nga dkar/ sku bzangs byi tang ga dang ka ra sbyar// phye ma gangs chus 'phul la sum yar btang / de rjes tsha ba'i lhag ma lus srid na// khrag mkhris shas che nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar// rlung shas che na tig ta'i sman mar shis kha zas ba lang ri dgas sha gsar dang // mar gsar khur mangs 'bras dang nas sngon zan gangs chu ba ra'i zho dar chab tsha sogs// bsil la yang ba'i zas skom btang bar bya// spyod lam me nyi zhe sdang drag shul spang // yid 'ong snyan tshig bsil gnas dal bar 'dug / khrus bya mgo bkru gos gsar dri med bsgo grang mkhris sman la se 'bru shing tsha dang // skyu ru ra dang nim pa star bu dang // phag ril thal ba bur dkar chu bskol dbul// des ma zhi na cha mnyam bzhi pa'i stong // tig ta bsnan la dar sbyar chu bskol dbul// de yis mkhris pa bad kun sdud dang 'drul/ de nas gser gyi phud bu ri sho ba// rgyam tsha pi pi ling dang dur byin rnams// zhib btags 'o ma sbyar btang nad kun 'dren//yang na rgyam tsha a ru mchu skung dang // lcam rtsa zangs rtsi ba dang pi pi ling //gser gyi me tog thang gi rgyun sbyongs btang / rjes la zas skom drod kyis bcad pa gces// de 'og se 'bru sga skya pi pi ling // tig ta gser gyi me rtog dug mo nyung // ma nu ka ra sbyar ba chu bskol dbu me/ rjes gcod nad rnams mal du 'jug par byed// gso dka' brgyad dgu bcu gnyis long ther bsreg / kha zas ba ra mdzo mar gsar pa dang / lug sha gsar pa nya sha sha rnying skam// zan dron sgog skya'i tsha mig gsar 'jam bsten// spyod lam rlan grang bser bus grangs pa spangs/ skam sar mi jul tsam du bcag par bya/de nas bye brag bcos thabs thang la lhags// tsha ba spyi bcos le'ur bstan par bya// rlung gi gnas gyur lus/ sha mar gsar chang // drod bcud zas bsten se 'bru pi pi ling // tig rta/ shing kun bca' sga kha ru tsha/ a ru bu ram

136 zhu/grwa thang rgyud bzhi/sbyar ba chu bskol dbul// mar gsar 'jam rtsi bdud rtsi lta bur bsngags//tshigs pa dang po dgu pa me yis bsro// ma zhu bad kun gang gi gnas gyur kyang // se 'bru bzhi'am rgod ma kha yi phyes// ma zhu 'ju zhing pho ba'i me drod skyed// de rjes skyugs bshal gang 'tsham gong bzhin bsten// de 'og tig ta gser gyi me tog dang // rgyam tsha gong la bsnan pas nad lhag gdon// gsum pa bcu gsum me mnyam nyen gsang bsreg / khrag gi gnas gyur bad kun srug por bcos// rjes la brgyad dgu me yis mnan pa gces// mdor na zhugs pa'i nad de bcos pa yis// rang gnas mkhris pa rang sor 'gyur ba yin//rgyu ma bsal bar 'bras bu khegs mi srid// mchin pa rgyas sam mchin skran kha lud na// cu gang brgyad sbyar de rjes ru thung ngam// snod ka gsha' rings mang gtar khrag stobs dbri// de 'og sbyangs te me yis bcad par bya// skun gyi kha lud 'gron bu'i thal ba dang // mda' rgyus shu dag spyang tsher rgyam tsha dang //thal sman sbyar ba'i ril bus bzhig la sbyang // ru thung gsha' rings cung zad gtar bar bya// rjes la nyen gsang dgu pa kha gsum bsreg / mkhris skran mi dang phag brun bsregs thal la// ka ra se 'bru lnga sbyar chu bskol dbul skabs su tig ta brgyad sbyare cung zad gtar// rjes spyad brgyad dgu bcu gnyis pho gsang bsreg / mkhris pa sha ser tig ta dug mo nyung // gser gyi me tog hong len ba mi ka / bong nga dkar po ba le ka thang btang // rtse chung drug mgo g.ya' ring gsum ga gtar/ tig ta'i dug mo zhung kyi dur byid bshal bya phyi rjes bsil shas bcad / gur gum bdun pa sbyar btang zho dkrugs sbyin/ mkhris pa mig ser tig ta'i grang thang btang // 'bras bugasum du ra byidadong sa snam rtsa kyi rgun 'brum hong len zang nga tresa'i thang gis mkhris chod 'or du skyur/ mchin mkhris 'dom rtsa rtse chung gsha' ring gtar/ sle tres tig ta sga skya a ru ra// hong len dug mo nyung dang ka ra sbyar// ga bur cugang gur gum tsandan bsha ka

༄gyim nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud 137hong len padma sar )bdun pa ka ra sbyar ba btang // mkhris pa sha pags gnyis la rgyas pa la// kha lud la sogs nad gang yin yang rung / rgya spos spang spos brag spos a ru ra// shug pa lca ba tang kun ba lu dang // shu dag ru rta ba chur sbyar ba'am/ yang na sngon bu srub ka zho sbyar byug / des ma sos na zo mar sgog skya tsha// chu dron bkrus rjes byugs la nyi mar bsreg / sen mos brad pas mkhris pa zang mar thon / shug tsher spa ma srad ma'i lo ma gsum tshwa sbyar byugs bsregs sen mos brad cing bzhar// yang yang bskyar bas chu ser cod nas 'don// des kyang ma sel dur byin sngon bu dang // a ru ra gsum bsdus pa'i dngas ma la// chu ser sman gsum btab pa'i rgyun sbyongs bya// mchin mcher chu ser mkhris rtsa mang du gtar// chu lums byas rjes seng ldeng sman mar phan// rtsar zhugs tig ta dug nyung ba le ka/ ba sha ka dang kyi lce gser me tog / 'om bu tig ta'i thang btang rtsa mang gtar// de 'og sbyangs rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar// rus la zhin na tig tagasum dang 'bras bu gsum khron bu lha rtsa ba ngabasdus pa'i rgyun sbyongs btang // nyi shu rtsa lnga mkhris sman kha bsgyur sbyar// kha zas bsil bsten chu 'u mas mchog tu bsnga gas// sha khrag rgyus pa skams pa gso ba'i phyir// sa bur tsan dan dkar dmar the sa ra gsum// utpal ba mar kur sbrang lde gu btang // mdor na mkhris pa phyir byer chu ser bcos// don lngar mkhris pa zhugs pa'i spyi sman du// tig ta gsum dang gser gyi me rtog dang //dug nyung thun 'brum kyi lce bong nga dkar snying la dzā ti ru rta a ka ru// glo la shing mngar cu gang a krong bsnan// ma chin pa ra brag zhun gur gum ba sha ka/rma tsher pa ra ru rta se 'bru pi pi ling / mkhal ma ra shug tsher sug smel dmar po gsum// 7 ra sbyar btang rang rang rtsa la gtar / tsha ba choms nas tshigs gsang me yis bsdam// snod lhung gang yang bshal las lhag pa med// mgo la la lud bshal skyugs gtar ba dang // tig tabargyad pa'i phye mchu lcag sdud sa sum

138 ༄cu dwa thang rgyud ba /— — la me btsa' 'bras bu gsu ma gyi sman mar bcos/ mig la dpral rtsa gtar 'ing skyer lan byug / rna bar ru rta sran ma'i me rtog dang / gser gyi me tog ar bar khu ba blug / sna la sna sbyongs btang rjes gur gum blug lce la sgab rtsa sa tar dang mngar bas dasang // khyad par mkhris pa 'ju byed rnam gyur na// rgyam tsha'i su ma pa thang btang gser phud skyus sa kyis drangs/ mdangs sgyur ba la rjes bod ma la phye la tig ta bsnan btang mkhris rtsa mang du gtar/ sgrub byed a ker dzo rti gur gu tig ta 'i ru ra nā sa se sa ra ka ra nga drug sbyar rtse chung bsnol1mkhris pa'i rtsa gtar snying gar chu lcas bdeg mthong byed nad la tig ta'i lde gu sbyar / gser mdung gtar la chu lcag mang du bdeg / ma dog gsal nad la tsan dan gur kum byug / gser gyi me tog tsan dan so ma ra// rwa gsum kur sbyar chus bran rtsa bran gtar bad rlung gang 'brel de yi gnyen po bsten// spyir na nad 'di gdon che bcos sngon du// sku mdos sngo mdos gser mdos la sogs bsngags/ tha ma mi ldog phyi rjes bcad pa'i thabs/ nad lhag cung zad lus kyang lo ga 'gyur bas// ba la gyis rjes bcad mi dom nya mkhris gsum// gur gum ka ra sbyar la ba 'os 'phul/ de rjes ka ra spyi zhur gser me tog / ba dmar 'o mas 'phul bas phyir mi ldos / bcu gsum bcu dgu kha gsum me yis bsreg / zungs ngan rlung che cig ta'i sman mar sbyar/ 'o gcis/ zas spyod gzabs pas brtan par 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba ma na ngag sge rgyud las mkhris pa'i nad bcos pa'i le'u ste gsu ma pa'o smo /

139le'u bzhi pa/ bdakan gyi nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsung ri so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / bad ken nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang smosu snyo da ri bcos thabs rnam pa lnga yis bstan/ myu ni ma rig gti mug las nga bad rkun tha mal mtshan nyid bdun ldan de/ slong rkyen kha mngar snyi bsil snum bsten drags/ 'grangs rjes dal bar bsdad dang nyin gnyid log / rlan steng nyal dang chur zhugs gos srab 'khyags/ gro sran gsar thog bser can sungs pa dang spyo ra skom sha rin tshir bu 'bru mar dang // rtsi mar rul ba lo shur la phug ras ri sgog la sogs rjen zas mtha' dag dang //ma tshos pa dang 'tshig po khengs po'i zas/ ba ra'i 'o ma zho dar chu grang ja//bza' btung ches te tshan las 'das pa'am// snga ma ma zhu phyi ma zos pa yi/rkyen de rnams kyis bad kun grang nad slong / dbye ba rang rgyud can dang gzhan rgyud can/ rang rgyud can la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la rigs dang gnas kyi dbye ba gnyis rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na bad gan nyen bad gan lcags dreg me drod nyams pa dang // bad kun mgul 'gags grum bu dkar po dang // bad kun 'ju skem nad dang rnam pa drug / gnas kyis dbye na pags gram sha la rgyas// rtsar rgyu rus zhen don babs snod du lhung / dbang po lnga la me rtog shar ba'o/ don ni glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma lnga/ snod ni pho long rgyu ma mkhris pa dang / lhang pa mngal du zhugs dang rnam pa drug /dbang po mgo mig rna ba sna lce'o/ bye brag nang tshegs rten byed phyag byed dang ⑪

140 ra 8 spu thang dba'i/ —myong byed tshim byed 'byor byed rnam pa lnga// rlung dang mkhris par 'dres pas bcu ru 'gyur// bzhi bcu rtsa gcig rang rgyud dbye bar 'dod// gzhan rgyud can la ser po srug po gnyis// de yi rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi rtags slong ba rgyu la brtag pa dang // mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas brtag pa dang // phan gnod goms pa'i sgo nas brtag pa gsum// dang po slong byed rgyulas brtag bya na// gong gi bad kun skyed pa'i zas spyod rnams// bsten rjes na na bad kun yin par bshad// nad rtags rtsa ni bying gud 'ar ba dang //chu yi mdog dkar dri dang rlangs pa chung // la mngal lce rnyil skya la mig dkar skrangs// snabs lud mang zhing mgo 'thom lus sems lci// dang ga mi bde drod med 'ju stobs chung // mkhal rkyen mi bde lus sbo lnga ba skye/ tsam pa bad rkan skyug cing 'khru ba dang // gtar na khrag mdog dmar skya 'byar bag can// dran pa mi gsal gnyid che sbyin pa skyur// g.ya' mkhrang tshigs dam sha rgyas las mtha' ring // nam zhod srod dang snga dro zos thog ldang phan gnod zas spyod tsub yang dro ba 'phrod / rtsi bsil bsten pas khyad par na las gsal// bye brag rigs kyi sgo nas brtag pa la / dang po bad kun snyen zhes bya ba ni// rten dang ma goms mi 'phrod ngo bo bzhi'i rkyen gyis ma zhu bad kun be snabs 'phel// bee snabs nyen sna'i 'og tu tshogs pa la// nyen zhes bya ste nyams la 'dril snyam byed// ltong nge na la mnan na 'dril ba med/ dang ga mi bde kha zas 'ju ba dka' zos dus na zhing ltogs na bde bar mngon//lcags dreg ces bya gong ltar ma zhu bas/ bee snabs 'phel te pho ba'i nang sul la// lcags dreg chags pas pho ba'i me drod nyams// sgrog 'tshing pho ba thams cad hrem me na// dang ga mi bde sha skam sdod snying 'dod// be snabs bad kun kha zas zos tshad skyug / bad kun me nyams grang rlung shas che la/ kha zas 'ju dka' bsil phyogs tshad las thal/ gos srab lus grangs chu yi las mang

zhu/man ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 141byas// tshad gzhug bsil thal sbyongs gtar drags pa yis/ mkhris pa 'ju byed me mnyam rlung mthu nyams// lus kyi drod chung kha zas 'jur mi 'dod//sbo 'phrog 'tshing sgrog kha zas ma smin 'khru// stobs chung sha skam mjug tu dmu skran 'gyur// bad kun mgul 'gags zhes pa pho ba dang / brang dang glo bar bad gan rgyas pa yis// bad gan rlangs pa glo yu mid par chags// dper na dong pa'i logs la zo chags 'dra// des skyen mid pa 'chus nas zas mid dka'// dbugs rngub mi bde sha skams lus stobs 'chor// zas skom med pas pho ba cha nas rub// mjug tu min pa 'gags nas 'chi ba yin / bad kun grum bu dkar po zhes bya ba/ ma zhu rang gnas bad kun 'phel ba yis/pho ba mchin pa gang yin cha med na/ kha zas ci zos mi zhim 'khru skyug byed//nya gzhi mig rus na khying chu tshan 'byung / mjug tu yan lag la byer grum bur 'gyur// bad kun 'ju skems zhes bya 'grangs pa med// stobs chung sha skam bsus pa shin tu che// byin pa 'dar la gyid pa skyur ba yin// bad kun pags gram drod bral bas ldags g.ya'// sha rgyas drod med sbo sob dreg pa chags//gnyid che lus lci gyid skyur men bu 'ong // rtsar zhugs rtsa rgyud grang bsil gyong la lci// rus la zhen na nus pa grang zhing na/ tshigs kha g.yo zhing brkyang bskum 'gro 'dug gyong // snying la babs na dran pa rmongs par byed// dang ga mi bde stod rgyangs lus sems lci( glor babs stod rgyangs mgo 'khor zas mi 'dod//be snabs sngo ljob mang du lu bar byed// mchin par babs na zos rjes mchin pa na// srin bu ldog cing kha nas chu sngon 'dzag / mcher babs gnyid che dbugs rgod khong pa sbo// bsnya zhing sgyid pa skyur la zas mdog 'khru// mkhal babs mkhal rked na zhing dri chu sri// rna ba 'thib cing rlan grang khyad par gnod// pho bar lhung na pho ba mi bde ci brang tsha chu tshan 'byung zhing zas mi 'ju// long lhung sbo 'khrog byed cing zos tshe na// rgyu mar lhung na bee snabs 'khru

142 ༄cu/grwa thang rgyud ba 'ing lci// mkhris pa ra lhung na mig ser 'ju ba dka' lus lci sgyid pa skyur la gnyid du 'bying // lhang bar lhung bas bad kun za khur 'gyur/ ma ngal lhang smad grang zla mtshan gcin bag 'dzag / bad kun mgo la zhugs na ma so bo lci/ gnyid che dang ga mi bde yi sa 'gag / mig la zhugs na skrangs shing rma chi ma 'dzag / rna bar zhugs na grang zhing lci la 'thib// sna la zhugs na sna 'gag mtshul pa lci// lce la zhugs na lce gyong ro mi tshor/ bye brag bad kun rten byed nad gyur na// dang ga mi bde stod rgyangs mdun rgyab gzer// brang tsha chu skyur 'byung zhing dang ga 'gag / bad gan myag byed 'ju dal 'a bcud mi len//kha zas mi 'ju sgrog cing pho ba gyong // myong byed kha zas bro med skom dad chung //lce grang mchu na skad 'dzer zas mi len// tshim byed mgo 'khyom mig zi rna ba 'gag / sbrid pa snabs mang cham 'debs 'tshogs ma lci// 'byor byed brkyang bskum dka' zhing tshigs mgo sbom// zang lag lhu tshigs na zhing tshigs kha g.yo// rlung dang mkhris par gang 'dres de rtags ston// bad kun ser po mkhris pa'i kha lud yin// rtsa ni dal la stong zhing chu mdog ser// pho ba ltem zhing zas la dang ga zhan// chang mthungs dros tshe 'tshogs ma mig rus na//brang tsha chu skyur 'byung 'ing mkhris pa skyug / sa rlan dul skyur zos rjes 'khru yang srid// gro yos ra sha mar rnying chang skyur gnod// mjug tu smyug po'am mkhris pa'i nad du 'gyur// bad kun smug po khrag gi snyigs ma yin// pho mchin ro stod na zhing rgya bshal skyug / lus lci sbyin pa skyur la snying mi dga'//'grangs ltogs grang dang dro ba gang yang gnod// don med na zhing byas med bde bar mngon// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// dang po bad kun ngo bo bsil pa'i phyir// sman dpyad zas spyod rnam bzhi drod du sprug / sa 'dra gnyen po'i kha na lci ba'i phyir// lan res mi sel yun du bsten pa gces//dang po zas kyi sgo nas bcos pa ni// 'bru rnying zan dron chang nar smin pa

zhu na ngag yon tan gyi da/ 143dang // chu bskol sga chu lug dang nya sha dang // g.yag rgod bya rgod dbyi dang spyang gi'i sha / dro zhing yang la tsub pa'i zas skom rnams// 'grangs ches ma yin 'ju bla nyung zad bsten// spyod lam me nyi dro zhing gos dror bsgo skam sar lus ngag rtsol bcag gnyid mi log / slong bar byed rkyen zas spyod dus kun spang // sman du rgyam tsha gsum dang bzhi thang btang // rgyam tsha bri ga pi pi ling gi thang // tsha ba gsum dang rgyam tsha'i thang la sogs// bsdus pa'i khu ba tshan mo btang bar bya// phye ma se 'bru bzhi dang brgyad pa dang // da lis bdun dang rgod ma kha rnams sbyar// tsha ba lnga dang kha ru tsha yi phye// ma zhu snyen dang lcags dreg dang ga 'grib// me drod nyams dang grang nad stong la phan//se 'bru bzhi steng zi ra kha ru tsha// bca' sga'i phye mas drod skyed yi ga 'byed//zas 'ju sgrog dang pho ba'i zug gzer 'joms// tsha ba lnga dang se 'bru bzhi pa dang // byi dang ga dang rgyam tsha kha ru tsha// phye mas bad gan grang ba ma lus 'joms// kun la bur dkar rta sbyar chu bskol dbul// sman gyis mgo non rtsa ba ma thon na// gyen thur gang nye'i lam nas sbyang bar bya/ de rjes nad lhag gang 'phrod phye mas gdon// dpyad du tshwa dang bong ba sru dugs bsten//grang ba shin tu rgyas na me thur bya// bye brag bcos thabs rigs gnas nang tshegs dang // gzhan dbang ba'i las rigs kyis bcos pa ni// dang po bad kun nyen la tsha ba gsum// rgyam tsha kha ru tsha yi bskol thang btang // tshwa 'am bong ba bsregs pa'i dugs kyis bdug / des ma sel na tsha bsreg sbyor ba bya//sman rjes skyugs drang nyen gsang kha gsum bsreg / gal te nyen de rgya chags 'dril ba na// mnan na sra zhing 'phar la bzod pa chung // kha zas len du mi ster zos tshad skyug / 'di nyid bad kun nyen skran zhes bya ste/ cong zhi sol ba'i me la 'tshos par bsreg / dar bar ngad bsad thal ba bya god brun// a ru ra dang pi pi ling du sbyar// ka ras rta byas chu bskol 'phul la btang sgo ma

144 sa grwa nga byu zhu nyen skran thal bar rlog par byed// yang na thun gsu ma tsha ba'i ril bus ba'i ga 'ig nas nad ro bshal lam skyugs kyis sbyang / lcags dreg chags na cong zhi'i thal sman sbyar// yang na thal sman rnon po bsten la brko// de 'og ba la kyugs sbyangs rjes se 'bru sbyar// zhi dka' pho gsang mdun rgyab me yis bsreg / me nyams rgod ma kha yi phye ma sbyar/ se 'bru tsha ba lnga dang bzang po gsum// byi tang ga dang srub ka ka rañdza// rgyam tsha kha ru tsha dang bu ram sbyar//chu bskol 'phul bas pho ba'i me drod skyed// rgyam tsha la la phud dang a za mo//pi pi ling dang sga rnams rim pas bskyed// kun dang mnyam pa'i a ru'i thal sman sbyar// me ni mngon sum nyid de drod skyed mchog / shing kun kha ru tsha dang tsha ba gsum// sgog skya mar rnying reng bus me drod skyed// bcu gnyis me mnyam gsang la me thur bya// bad gan mgul 'gags nad la tsha ba lnga// bzang po ba'i dang rshang kun byi tang ga / rgyam chos sna drangs tshwa sna tshogs tshad dang //srub ka lce tsha'i phye ma sbyang rgod sbyar// cong zhi sod btul thal sman rnon po dang // nang nub ltag pa sprad la chu bskol dbul// nya sha ol gong tsha ba khong du bsten// sman rjes bshal skyugs srugs la sbyang bar bya// nyen gas nga ske stong tshigs pa bzhi pa bsreg / bad kun grum bu dkar po bcos pa ni/ rdo 'am bya bra bsros pa'i dugs kyis bdug / shing kun rgya tsha dbyi mong bskol thang btang // sug sprel ru rta rgyam tsha pi pi ling / gla rtsi byi tang ga yi phye ma bsten// se 'bru tsha ba gsum dang a ru ra// rgyam tsha ma nu 'u su da trig dang //mdu rtse dang bu ram srung sbyar btang // khyad par rlan med dro sar bcag pa bsngags// bad kun 'ju skems bca' sga kha ru tsha/ a ru skyu ru bur dkar sbyar ba btang // spyang tsher skyugs bya nyen gsang me yis bsres / kun la zas skom ya nga dro chung bas bcos// pags gram tsha ba gsum dang zo mar sbyar// nyi mas bsreg cing mnye byug 'them par bya / shar rgyas ol gong pa yi tsha ba
