sa༅/mnang g.yon tan gyi rgyud 145btang // se 'bru brgyad sbyar lho dgug rtsol ba spyad// rtsar rgyu tshwa sna'i thang btang me dugs bsten// rus zhen bur chang tsha ba gsum sbyar btang // bya bra bsros pa'i dugs bya bong sha bza'// zo mar byugs mnye tshigs dmigs grang sar bsreg / glo snying gang la babs kyang skyugs kyis drangs // de rjes se 'bru ba'i pa gtso bo la// snying la dza ti shing kun kha ru tsha// glo la star bu li shi cu gang ste/ srung dang bur dkar rta byas chu bskol dbul// yang na snying la dzā ti tsha ba gsum// sug sprel zi ra nag po ka ko la bur dkar sbyar btang glo la se 'bru dang // tsha ba gsum dang zi ra dkar nag gnyis// shing tsha sug smel bu ram sbyar la btang // de rjes tshigs pa ba'i lnga drug bdun bsreg / mchin babs tsha ba gsum dang se 'bru dang // shing tsha kha ru tsha dang gur kum dang ka ra sbyar btang dgu pa me yis bsreg / mcher babs se 'bru rgyam tsha tsha ba gsum// thal tsha kha ru tsha dang lce myang tsha// bur dkar sbyar btang bcu gcig me yes bsreg / mkhal babs tsha dang bye ma spu dugs bsten// tsha ba gsum dang sug smel rgya tsha dang // lcam pa sdig srin gser gyi bye ma dang // 'bras sna gsum dang bu ram chang gis dbul// gsa' dang spyang ki sram dang bong sha bsten// rjes la tshigs pa bcu bzhi spra bas mnan// pho bar lhung na se 'bru lnga pa 'am// kha ru tsha dang da trig thing kun sbyar// rjes la mdun rgyab gang babs gsang du bsreg / rgyu long lhung na shing tsha tsha ba lnga// byi tang ga dang shing kun kha ru tsha / bu ram sbyar btang mdun rgyab gsang la bsreg / mkhris par lhung na se 'bru bzhi pa dang // rgyam tsha gser gyi me tog sga skya sbyar// sbyongs bya tshigs pa dgu dang bcu pa bsreg / lhang par lhung na rgya tsha tsha ba gsum// sug spel lcam pa chang dang sbyar la btang / mngal lhung thun gsum tsha ba'i ril bu sbyar// drod dugs me btsa' chang dang bong sha bsten// mgor zhugs skyugs bya se 'bru brgyad pa sbyar / mig la ra gan dud byugs nya sha btang // rna bar

146 ༄cu/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/—zhugs na shing kun rgya tsha blug / sna la sna sbyong dud pa rnon pos bdug / lce la zhugs na tsha ba'i mkhur bkang bcang // bye brag nang tshegs bad kun rten byed la// spyang tsher skyugs bya se 'bru lnga pa'am// cong zhi drug sbyar tshigs pa brgyad pa bsreg / myag byed se 'bru rgyam tsha'i tres sam sbyar// bcu gsum dgu pa pho gsang gang rigs bsreg / myong byed nad la 'bras bu gsum thang btang // star bu sge gsher shing mngar 'bras bu gsum// sbrang dang sbyar btang ske stong dang po bsreg / tshim byed sgyugs bya sna sman zhi ba btang //'tshogs ma'i gsang dbye 'dus so gsum du bsreg / 'byor byed a ru'i bla gi bo bo khrag phye ma btang bar bya// thal ka rdo rje zo mar bsku rma nye dang // chu ser mer sar rngabs ru me thur bya// rlung mkhris gang 'brel de yi gnyen po bston// ga 'an dbang can gyi bad man ser po la// cha mnyam bzhi thang se 'bru brgyad pa sbyar// gser phud skyugs dang ma nu'i lta ru tres tsho ri dong sa lham drod bshal btang // gser mdung gtar 'ing cong zhi drug pa sbyar// sha gsar mar gsar ba mdzo'i 'o ma bsten// bad gan smug po se 'bru bse yab dang // star bu skyu ru ra dang sga skya dang // ma nu 'u su utpal pi pi ling // ka ra sbyar la chu bskol 'phul la btang // spyir na bad kun lci rtul bsil ba'i phyir//khong nad kun gyi rtsa ba bad gan byed// sha pags rtsa tshigs phyi ru byer ba nyung //rang gi gnas las gzhan du zhugs pa dkon// phal cher ma zhu pho bar rgyas pa'i sa// de phyir pho ba'i kha 'dzin gces pa yin// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las bad kun gyi nad bcos pa'i le'u ste ba'i pa'o// //

147— le'u lnga pa/ 'dus nad bad gan sprug po bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// rlung mkhris bad kun bcos thabs de ltar na// 'dus pa'i nad la gso thabs ji ltar bgyi// mtshon byed ming dang dbye ba ji ltar lags// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol//zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po yid la skyes//'dus pa'i nad la gsum gas bcos pa ste// 'on kyang rang bzhin rgyu yis 'dus pa dang // byung tshul dus kyi sgo nas 'dus pa dang // 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas 'dus pa gsum// phyi ma ma smin tsha ba dug nad de// dang po mtshon byed bad kun srug por btags// de la rgyu rkyen gnas dus rigs dang rtags// bcos pa'i thabs dang rjes bcad brgyad du bshad// rgyu ni bad kun khrag mkhris rlung dang bzhi// nad kun 'dus phyir 'dus nad rtags bcos dka'// de la skyed pa'i rkyen ni tsha grang gnyis// tsha rkyen 'grams khrag lhag dang mtshon khrag lus// de nyid mchin pa'i steng du lhung ba'am// tsha skyur zas kyis khrag 'phel mchin pa rgyas// de dag zungs su 'gyur du ma 'dod par// mchin gnas pho bar babs pas bad kun 'dres// khrag dang bad kun rul nas rgyu mar lhung // mkhris par 'dres pas kha dog dud khur 'gyur//de nyid long du 'chugs pas rlung dang sdongs// de la srug po yas babs zhes su 'dod// grang rkyen 'ju dka' mi 'phrod zas bsten pas// pho bar ma zhu de yis bee snabs 'phel// me mnyam 'ju byed rlung gi mthu nyams pas// dngas

148 sto/grwa nga rgyud bzhi/snyigs ma phyed mchin pa'i gnas su shor// zungs su ma gyur khrag ngan mchin par rgyas// kha lud gong bzhin pho bar lhung ba de// ma zhus rgyu byas bad kun grang shas che// srug po gab pas wa ltar gzha' bar byed// de la srug po mas chags zhes byar 'dod// smug po'i gnas la rang gnas gzhan gnas gnyis//rang gnas pho mchin rgyu long rnam pa bzhi// pho bar gnas pas bad kun nad dang 'dra// mchin par gnas pas khrag gi nad dang 'dra// rgyu mar gnas pas mkhris pa'i nad dang 'dra// long du lhung bas rlung gi nad dang 'dra//gnas ga 'an byer la phyi nang rnam pa gnyis// phyi gnas shar rgyas pags gram sa bdag 'dra// rtsar byer dug 'dra tshigs la grum bur byed nang gnas srog rtsa mchin lam khrag la zhon// srog rtsa rdzong la tshigs pa mkhar du 'dod//yar la mgo la 'phyur bas mgo nad byed// glo la glo nad snying la snying rlung byed//mcher par mcher nad mkhal mar mkhal nad byed// sprug po'i dus gsum dang po tsha ba'i dus bar du tsha grang 'thab pa'i dus yin te// tha ma grang ba nying chad pa dang gsum// dang po smug po tsha ba skyes pa las// khrag mkhris 'phel bas rgyas te tsha ba'i dus// grang ba skyes na dang por rang gnas gab//bar du khrag mkhris tsha la bad rlung grang // de dag shed snyoms tsha grang 'thab par byed// tha mar khrag mkhris tsha ba'i stobs zad nas// bad rlung rgyas pas grang bar 'gyur ba yin// sprug po'i rigs la byer rgyas 'gyings 'dril bzhi//byer la phyir byer ba dang nang byer gnyis// smug po rgyas la rdol dang ma rdol gnyis// sprug po 'gyings la gab dang ma gab gnyis// smug po 'dril la gsar dang rnying pa gnyis// de rnams brtag thabs sbyi dang bye brag gnyis//spyi la rtsa chu nad rtags lo ma dang // phan gnod bsten pa'i sgo nas brtag pa bzhi// rtsa la ngos bzung sbom khengs kun rtsa zhar// grang bas bskyed na phal cher phra la gud/ chu mdog srug dugs ska la rnyog ma can// yang na dmar sprug

wu/man ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 149ljang yang srid pa yin na lugs pho mchin kha 'khor ro rgyab pag / lus snyi byin pa mi theg sgal tshigs na// dang ga mi bde kha mngal nya dri bro// brang tsha skyug snyam byed cing skyug pa dka'// skabs su khong tsha mgo dang mig rus na/jul grangs rjes la glang thabs ldang ba dang // dri ma sprug la skam zhing sha ril 'dra// 'grangs kyang na la ltogs kyang na ba dang // grangs kyang na la dros kyang na snyam byed// don med na la byas pa med par 'drag / phal cher ston dpyid dus na ldang ba yin// 'di la dus kyi lo ma rnam gsum 'byung / dang po 'jug dus chu tshan chu skyur skyug / bar du smin nas ser po rgya bshal skyug / tha mar rgyas nas khrag rul dud khur skyug / ra thog 'bru dang gro yos phye sungs zan// mar rnying khrag tshod 'bru mar ra sha dang // gnag sha rul sungs nya phag sha bem dang // chang skyur sgog skya zho ma langs la sogs// snum ci'i zas dang bsil drod drags pa gnod// rna dgo ba lang 'a gsar rnying pa'i 'bru sran ma ba ra mdzo zho dar ba dang // nya sha phag sha sol ba la sogs pa// zas skom yang tsub bsil drod snyoms pa 'phrod// bye brag gnas sa yul la brtag pa dang // gnas skams dus dang nad rigs sgo nas brtag / dang po gnas sa pho mchin rgyu long bzhi// pho bar gnas tshe sgrog skyug zos rjes na// 'ju dka' chang rgan chang gsar shi sha gnod// ha cang drod drags rlan grang dus na ldang //mchin par gnas tshe mchin dri ro rgyab na// tshigs pa bkan zhing mnyes na phan snyam byed// me nyi drod bcud dul skyur dag las ldang // mchin par rgyas na sra khengs skran ltar na// rgyu mar gnas tshe na zhing 'gyu ba dang // 'dril nas na zhing mig dang chu mdog ser// long du gnas tshe sbo 'khrog 'ur ba dang //sgongs dang skyur 'thungs dus na khyad par sbo// thur rlung dri che drod 'phrod grang ba gnod// dus kyis brtag pa dang po tsha ba'i dus// rtsa grims chu mdog srug la dri rlangs che// lce skam gyong la kha kha dang ga 'gag / lus lci gnyid che

150 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'i —gdong snum mig sprin dmar// mchin dri ro rgyab gnyis su sbrag cing gzer//mgo dang mig rus na zhing 'tshogs ma lci / me dang nyi mas dros tshe khyad par na/ rul skyur drag shul rjes la ldang ba yin// de nyid sprug po'i tsha ba rgyas zhes bya 'thab pa sprug pos ma nyam gnas lam bsgags pas// mnyam gnas snod kyi rtsa nang kun tu zhugs// rlung khrag phar 'bor tshur 'bor 'ded cing rgyu// dus med rgyun du zug che glang thabs ldang // nyin mo cung bde mtshan mo rgyun du na//ltogs shing dugs byas dus na bde snyam byed// sha zhu pags pa skams la rtsa rnam sa rgyas// bsil drod zas sman cis kyang phan gnod chung // 'di ni srug po 'khrugs pa zhes bya ste// gso dka' phal cher 'chi ba mang ba yin// tha mar lus grang nyam chung zas mi 'ju// sgrog skyug 'grangs rjes na la 'khru yang srid//sbo 'khrog 'gying zhing chu dang sing gleg gnod// rigs kyi sgo nas brtag na byer ba ni// mgo dang mig dus na zhing lus kun brtse// lus lci sbyin pa skyur la shed nyams 'bri// mchin dri ro rgyab rtsib logs gzer zhing 'khyug / sgal tshigs brdzis na phan snyam shul sha khrid// lud pa khrag bcas sprug po lu bar byed// mkhal zhed brla sul tshigs gzhi byin nya na// nges med 'pho ling na la skyug snyam byed// khyad par mgo la byer na 'tshogs ma lci// mig rus na zhing sna khrag mi chod 'dzag / snying la byer na smyo 'dar snying mi dga'// gnyid med chang 'thungs dus na sran mi bzod// stod rgyangs drod bcud me btsas phan skyed med// glor byer ro rgyab tsha lci dum re na// lud pa khrag bcas sprug kham yun du 'byung // gtar sman glo bcos skyed med drod bcud gnod// mcher par byer pa g.yon gzer dros tshe na// zhe 'khun byed cing gdong pa srug por 'gro// mkhal byer zhed pa 'khor 'ing rkang pa lci// brla sul mkhal rtsa khrid cing chu mdog dmar// bsam ser byer na pho mo'i mtshan ma nas// khrag rnag mi chod rgyun du 'byams pa yod// sha pags la byer ko ler tsha mang na// rtsar

zhu/man ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 151byer rtsa rgyas mdog nag sbrid cing skrangs// tshigs byer brkyang bskum dka' zhing tshigs mgo sbom// lci 'ing drod che bcud gnod grum thabs na// mkhar byer tshigs pa'i rgyud na bshul sha khrid// kha bye mnan btsir bkan na phan snyamakhyed// de ltar byer rtags sna tshogs ci 'dra yang // mdor na pho mchin nad dang sdongs pas shes// re mos na 'am sngar dus pho mchin na// gyis ga 'an nad byung sngar nad med na nges// sprug po rgyas la rdol dang ma rdol gnyis// ma rdol sprug po'i khrag tshad rgyas pa'i rtags// dang po tsha ba'i dus kyi skabs su bstan// shin tu rgyas na khrag rul rdol 'gyur te// de yang ma zhu'i gnas rgyas dud khu skyug / zhu ba'i gnas su rgyas na khrag nag 'khru// bar du rgyas na gnyis kur rdol bar 'gyur// gyen thur gnyis po gang du rdol gyur kyang // de la khrag lam chod dang ma chod gnyis// ngo bo zad dang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// lam chod zungs khrag ma shor nad khrag thon// zug med lus yang dang ga bde na 'tsho// khrag lam ma chod mang du skyugs khrus rjes//khrag nag dud khu ma zad bde stobs med// dang ga 'gags na phal cher gso ba dka'/ ngo bo zad pa phal cher zungs khrag shor// chu dmar sbu ba che la rtsa stong rgyug / glo snying mi bde dbugs 'deg skra 'dab 'dar// lce mchu sen po'i bkrag thor gdong pa ser// sko rtsa sprug cing bol gong cung zad g.yo//skom dad che la snying la grang mo 'dod// phal cher 'chi la 'tsho ba 'ga' 'byung srid// srug po 'gyings la gab dang ma gab gnyis// ma gab rtags dang bcos thabs khyi dang 'dra/ grang bas mgo byibs snod tshad gab pa ni// rtsa rgyud phra la bying zhing chu mdog ljang / lus lci sbyin pa skyur la dang ga 'gribakamachin dri ro rgyab na zhing sgreg pa 'byung / kha dri mngal la skyugs na phan snyam byed// jul grangs zho dar grangs rjes glang thabs ldang // zas dang spyod lam dro na bde bar mngon/ 'ju dka' pho ba 'tshing la dri ma skam// smug po skran

152 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/du 'dril na mchin pa dang // mcher pa pho long rgyu ma'i gnas su 'byung // sra 'dril gzer zhing na la mnan na 'phar// gnas de tsha ling stobs 'dzad dngag 'gag / rtsa rgyud phra mgyogs chu mdog dmar bar 'ong // gsar dus chags mod mchin pa lta bur gnyan// rnyings shing dul nas gso bar bla ba yin// 'dril ba zags na gdong dang rkang bol g.yo// bsus pa lci ldir bsus pa'i rtsa rnam sa bkra// smug po zags pa'i tsha chu mi 'tsho spang // ci phyir skran ro bzhig tshad chu ru gsog / bskams pas mi skoms rgyu las 'dzag pa yin// khong nad phal cher smug po'i rgyu yis skyed// mi mkhas rmongs pas dug tu 'dzin pa yo da// la las tsha ba la las grang bar 'dzin// la las sa bdag gdon du 'dzin pa'ang yo da / de phyir skus po'i nad la bya ra sgrims// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// sbyi la bcos thabs zas spyod sman dpyad bzhi// dang po zas spyod sgo nas bcos pa ni// nya dang phag pa gra ma'i sha gsar dang // mdzo yi zho dar rna dgo ba lang sha / sra na ma ja dang bskol grangs chu la sogs// skug po tsha ba rgyas pa'i zas su bshad// drod bcud drag shul kun tu spang bar bya// gtsang nya rgod g.yag sha dang lug ya gas ra//gsar 'jam skam sa'i zan dron la sogs pa// smug po grang rkyen gab pa'i zas su bshad// 'ju dka' rtsi bsil nyin gnyid grang ba spang // rlan med dro sar rngul ma thon tsam bcag / sman gyis bcos pa rtsi rdo sngo dang gsum/ rtsi sbyor a ru brag zhun 'du ba snyoms// cu gang gur gum glo mchin kha gnon yin//se 'bru bse yab star bu 'u su dang ma nu utpal pi pi ling dang bdun//bad kun tsha ba 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin// tig ta ba sha ka yis khrag mkhris gsod// tsha stobs che na gi wam tsan dan bsnan// grang ba che na da lis sge gsher bsnan// stod smad bar gnas bur dkar sbrang rtsis bsgyur// smug po ma lus 'joms pa'i spyi sman yin// khyad par smug po tsha ba rgyas la bsngags//

zhu na nga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 153rdo sbyor a ru brag zhun rgyal po la btsun mo ba sha ka dang re skon pa/ cong zhi sras la blon po gnyen po mnu'u su star bu gsum// smug po ma lus gso ba'i spyi sman yin// dzā ti a ga ru dang tsan dan bsnan/ skug po snying dang srog rtsar byer ba 'joms// gi waṃ tsan dan dkar po bsil gsum bsnan// skug po gsar dus tsha ba rgyas pa sel// cu gang rgyan 'brum shing mngar dom mkhris bsnan// smug po glo la byer ba 'joms par byed// bong nga dom mkhris gser gyi me tog bsnan// sprug po tsha ba snod du gab pa 'joms// ldum bu phag khrag skyer pa'i bar shun bsnan// rtsa tshigs byer ba dug dang 'dra ba 'joms/ rgya skyegs pu shel 'bras yos gyen rdol gcod ta da trig bya rkang dug nyung thur ral sdom/ star bu rgyam tsha sbrul shas 'dril ba 'jig / da lis se 'bru drod sman gab pa sel// sman rta ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsis bsgyur// 'dus nad gso dka' smug po 'joms pa'i mchog / sngo sbyor pri ya sku dang khur mang dang // se rgod bar shun star bu yung ba lnga// gong ma cha bskyed gtso yin de yi 'khor//da lis shing tsha sug spel ra mnye ba/ sle tres zhib btags ka ras rta byas la tsha grang chu bsil bskol bas 'phul la btang // skug po kun 'joms khyad par 'thab pa sel // tsan dan cu gang gur gum ma nu dang // 'u su ka ra sbyar ba ltag pa sprad// srug po khrag tshad rgyas pa sel bar byed// cha mnyam bzhi thang ltag sprad sbo sgrog 'joms/ gur gum dom mkhris rgya skyegs pu shel rtse 'bras yo sa ka ra sbrang gis skyug pa gcod// cong zhi re skyon da trig dug mo nyung // pyi yadku rnams 'bras thug la btab ste// ltag pa sprad pas thur du 'khru ba gcod// 'dus nad sprug po'i grong khyer 'joms par byed// me tog dang po chu skyur skyug dus su// se 'bru ma nu gur gum pi pi ling // sug sprel cong 'i ka ras kha slangs btang // yang na se 'bru star bu skyu ru ra// da trig skyer 'brum chu rkang sbyar ba btang // ser po mkhris thabs skyug dus dug mo nyung //

154 ༄/grwa thang rgyud bzhi/tig ta shing mngar 'u su ka ko la/ dom mkhris ka ra sbyar bas 'i bar 'gyur//yang na shing mngar gser gyi me rtog dang // tig ta se 'bru dmar po gsum thang btang / rgya bshal tsa dmar skyug dus gur gum dang // cu gang tig ta utpal ba le ka / skyu ru ra dang skyer shun ka ra sbyar// rgya skyegs khu bas 'phul btang zhi bar byed// khrag rul dud khu skyug dus se 'bru dang ta btsod dang 'u su sug smel pi pi ling // bse yab shing mngar dom mkhris sbrang sbyar btang //dpyad du gtar ga bshal dang me btsa' dugs// gang dgos nad kyi skabs dang sbyar te bcos// de nas bye brag bcos thabs rnam gsum ste// gnas dang dus dang rigs dang sbyar te bcos// dang po gnas dang sbyar te bcos pa ni// pho bar gnas tshe bad kun gtso bor bcos// dang po ma nu bzhi thang gtong ba bsngags// khyi sman se 'bru bzhi dang ltag pa sprad// yang na se 'bru bzhi dang gur gum dang // ma nu 'u su star bu sbyar la btang // mchin par gnas tshe khrag nad gtso bor bcos// dang po tig ta ru rta ba sha ka / ma nu pu shel tse yi bskol grangs btang // phyi ma gur gum bdun dang cu gang brgyad//ru thung snod ka khrag tshod sbyar la gtar // phye ma gtar gyis ma li dur gyid dang // hong len tsha la'i ril bus zungs sbyar sbyang // rgyu mar gnas tshe mkhris pa gtso bor bcos// tig ta ma nu dug nyung bskol grangs btang // yang na ind+ra bzhi thang rshas pa yin// phye ma brag zhun dug nyung bong nga dkar// dom mkhris ma nu 'u su a ru ra// ga dur ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma bston// zhi bar ma nus gong ltar bshal gyis sbyang // long du gnas tshe rlung nyid gtso bor bcos//dang po ma nu bzhi yi bsdus thang btang // se 'bru tsha ba gsum dang bzang po gsum// gur gum shing tsha zi ra a ru ra// rgyam tsha kha ru tsha dang bu ram sbyar//chu tshan 'phul bas sbo 'khrog long rlung 'joms// smad du zug che 'gags na mas 'dren bya// sprug po dus kyis bcos pa tsha ba'i dus// ru rta tig ta ba 'a ka pu

༄blonang ga yon tan gyi da 155shel mnu lnga thang sprug po'i phral zug bcog / phye ma tsan dan gi waṃ gur gum dang // cu gang ma nu 'u su ba sha ka / utpal re skon tig ta brag zhun rnams/ka ra sbyar la sum yar btang bar bya// yang na a ru brag zhun re skon pa// kyi lce bong nga spang rtsi pyi yi ku// ka ra sbyar btang yang na tsan dan dkar// gi waṃ bsil gsum tig ta ba sha ka / ru rta brag zhun a ru ka ra sbyar/ chu grang 'phul bas smug po rgyas pa 'joms// snod ka ru thung long rtsa gnas sbyar gtar// phye ma gtar gyis ma zhi gong ltar sbyang / bar du 'khrugs te rlung khrag 'thab pa'i dus// ma grangs bcag cing bsil drod khre 'ur btang // se 'bru ma nu star bu pi pi ling // ba sha ka dang ka ra sbyar ba bsngags/ yang na cu gang bde byed chung ngu la// ma nu 'u su star bu sdebs te bsten chu ba a bo'i dugs kyis phral zug bcag / de la bde skyed chung yang stobs bzang na//sngon 'gro yun bsring 'jam rtsis rlung bsal la// dur byid star bu dung thal sbrul gyi sha / rgya tsha bu ram sbyar ba'i bshal gyis sbyang // sbyang ba'i zungs med 'jam rtsi ni ru spel// lan grangs bdun dgu ci rigs btang byas na// rlung mal gzhug cing long phugs khrag skam dbyung // ru thung rtse chung long rtsa kha phye la a na stong bcu gsum long gsang me yis mnan// de yis 'thab pa gnas su zhi bar 'gyur// tha ma grang ba nyi chad bcos pa ni/ rgyam tsha gsum dang bzhi pa'i thang mang btang // phye ma se 'bru bzhi steng pho ba ris// ma nu 'u su sga dang ka ra sbyar/ yang na ma nu 'u su rgyam tsha bsnan// bu ram sbyar ba chu tshan 'phul la btang // 'jam rtsi ni ru ha spel skabs su bsngags/ pho ba long gsang drug bdun brgyad pa bsro// gtar bshal bsil phyogs rlan grangs bser bu spang //dro la bcud pas bad rlung 'i bar bya// rigs kyis bcos pa srug po byer ba la/gur gum cu gang utpal ba le ka / tig ta skyu ru skyer shun ka ra sbyar// gang babs rtsa gtar byer chung de yis sel byer tshabs che na bsdu bsad sbyang

156 mi/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/bar bya// bsdu ba phag khrag ma nu 'u su dang // star bu ka ra sbyar bas byer ba sdud// yang na se 'bru se rgod bar shun dang / re ral phag khrag ka ra ba 'os dbul// yang na tsha la 'o ma sbyar bas bsdu/ de dag kun gyis srug po khyi ru sdud// ser po gsum thang ston du byer ba sdudaka tsha la tshos gsum thang gis smad byer sdud// 'dus rtags lus snyi kha skam dang ga 'gag / pho ba na la rtsa chu'i tsha ba skye de dus spyi sman rtsi sbyor bsten te bsad// de rjes dur byin hong len tsha las sbyang // nad stobs che na rim pa ci rigs bskyar// chung na sbyangs rjes phye mas bsad par bya// ma 'dus byer ba rang sar bsad pa ni//sprug po smyu sman bar pa'i mde kha sbyar// yang na rgyas pa'i skabs kyi phye ma la//mgor byer dom mkhris tig ta tshe sdum bsnan// snying la spos dkar dzā ti a kur bsnan// glo la cu gang zhing mngar mtshal dkar bsnan// mchin par brag zhun gur gum ba sha ka / rgya skyegs sbangs pa'i khu bas 'phul la btang /mcher par li shi gser men pi pi ling // mkhal mar gla rtsi sug sprel lcam pa bsnan// bsam ser tshos gsum bsnan te byin long gtar / don lnga rang rang rtsa la gtar ba ste// mgo la gser mdung 'tshogs gsang rtse chung gtar//nang rtsar byer na rtsa lho sbrags la sbyar// sha pags rtsa rus phyi ru byer ba la//khong nad bsal la de rjes chu lums bya// srug po rgyas la rdol dang ma rdol gnyis// ma rdol rgyas pa'i bcos thabs gong du bstan// shin tu rgyas te mtsho rdol gyen thur gnyis// gyen rdol stobs ldan kha zas tshud pa la// mi bcad byug bdug nus khu bur chu sogs// lus zungs bsrungs la nad khrag skyug tu gzhug / khrag lam ma chod zungs med bcad dgos na// 'bras bkrus khu bar skyu ru pu shel tse// sprang rtsi sbyar btang tsan dan pu shel rtse// ba le ka dang ga dur par pa ta// bskol grangs thang btang pri yi ku bsregs pa'i// thal ba zhun mar sbyar te btang bar bya// cu gang gur gum dom mkhris ba sha ka / zab

lta nang g.yon rtan gyi da/ 157thal 'gron thal sran ma'i me tog sbyar// tsan dan dmar po ra khrag pu shel rtse//stang zil 'bras yos phye dang ka ra sbyar// ma chod log non dur byin pri yo ku khu ba sbrang dang sbyar bas sbyang bar bya// yang na dur byid 'bras gsum pri tha ku//pi pi ling dang sbrang sbyar sbyang ba mchog / rjes la se 'bru skyu ru 'bras yos phye/mar dang sbyar ba'i skyo ma blud par bya// thur du ral ba zungs yod gong ma bzhin// bcad dgos tha rams bya rkang rgya skyegs bsdus// khu bar da trig dom mkhris pri yi ku// re skon ka ra btab la btang ba'am// 'bras thug re skon cong zhi kur sbyar btang // yang na ba sha ka dang pri yi ku// nag mtshur seng phrom skyer pa'i khaṇḍa yi bsdus thang grang mo sbrang dang sbyar la btang //'bras sna gsum dang ka ped mon cha ra// 'bras yos phye dang ka ra sbyar la btang // byin nya chus bgrang long gsang mdun rgyab bsro// ma chod log non son cha 'o ma sbrang // skyugs byas rjes la se 'bru pu shel tse/ seng phrom tsan dan dmar po 'bras thug bsrud// ba 'am ra yi 'o ma gson khrag la/ pu shel btab pa'i 'jam rtsi btang ba bya// ngo bo zad pa'i rtags byung ba ra yi 'o ma ka ra mar bskol rlung dus btang // gsar bcud gsum dang mngar gsum ting khrol byin// dkar 'don sbyor ze cu gang bde byed sbyar// srug po gab cing 'gyings na bzang drug dang // cong zhi tsha sbyor bshig la de rjes sbyang spyoyang na a ru brag zhun re skon gsum/ rim pas phyed skyungs skya ru ba sha ka /ru rta bong nga kur bur sbrang gis bsgyur// phye ma brid de chu bskol 'phul la btang // 'ju dka' se 'bru bzhi dang ltag pa sprad/ yang na gangs thigs a ru brag zhun dang // gi waṃ tsan dan mi rus btsa' ma dang // dom mkhris yung ba khur rtsa dri chen dang // bzang drug kur sbyar rim pas bskyed de btang ku'akhrog 'gyur 'khru snyam byed na kha zas dbri// sman thun bskyed la chu bskol tshan mos dbul// nad 'gyings zho ltar chags pa thur du sbyong // 'khrur ma

158 sa /grwa nga da bzhi/'dod kyang rang gi gnas su 'joms/ yang na ltar bu zho gsum rgyam tsha gnyis// ma nu 'u su thun re ka ra sbyar/ chu tshan 'phul bas smug po 'gyings pa bshig / dur byin star bu tsha la bu ram gyi// ril bus sbyangs te rgyam tsha star bu dang / dus khu'i lcag bsten bsil drod spel te bcad// sprug po'i khrag skran 'dril na tsha bsregs sbyar// yang na cong zhi tsha sbyor bsten te bsko//yang na ze tsha zho gsum mtshal gyis bsgyur// lug gi klad pa btsos te sbyar la btang ma kha zas phag sgrul nya shas ba thig par bya// zhig na ngo bo cung zad rnyi ru mngon// dang ga 'gag cing rtsa chu'i tsha ba skye// dur byid rgyam tsha ltar bu sbrul sha dang // bu ram sbyar ba'i ril bus skran ro sbyang // shin tu rnyings shing bshig dka' sman gtar sbyongs// tsha ba bsal la thur rjes bshal gyis sbyang //lar ni skug po 'dus pa'i nad yin pas// sa 'dra gso dka' nad sdur rtsi ba'i phyir// lan res zhi bar mi 'gyur bcos rnams bskyar// zungs ma bsrungs par sman dpyad btud drags na// gser zad g.ya' zad nad zungs dus gcig 'dzad// de phyir nad stobs cung zad bri ba'i skabs//gsar bcud zas kyis lus zungs bsrung zhing bcos// tha ma mi bzlog nad rjes gcod pa'i thabs// bshal dang phye mas nad lhag med par sbyang // srog rtsa pho long mchin gsang me yis bsdam/ mi 'phrod zas spyod lo dus bar du bsrung // de yis mi bzlog brtan par 'gyur ba yin// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las 'dus nad bad kun skug po bcos pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// / /

159le'u drug pa/ khong nad thams cad kyi rgya ma zhu ba bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong yin las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags/ dmar khrid lag len man ngag rgyud 'di yi// khong nad gso ba'i skabs la ji ltar bslab// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pas// ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / khong nad gcong la rnam pa gnyis yin te// sde bzhi gcong gi rtsa ba ma zhu dang // 'bras bu gcong nad gsar rnying rnam gnyis so// ma zhu gcong gi rgyu la spyi don drug / rgyu dang rkyen dang gyur tshul bstan pa dang // dbye ba rtags dang de yi bcos thabs so/ rgyu ni bad kun lci zhing bsil ba la de rkyen rten dang ma goms mi 'phrod dang / ngo bo mi 'ju ba yi rkyen bzhi yod// dang po rten ni grang rlung can gyi mi/ zungs ngan speg dang kha zas skya ba za// dal bar 'dug dang mya ngan sems las dub/ gas dang zas kyis mnar shul 'ju mi nus// ma goms nam phyed kha zas ma myong za/ mi 'phrod dkar skyur sngo ngad 'o ma nya// snga ma ma zhu phyi ma zos pa dang // 'dres par zos pas mi 'phrod 'ju mi 'gyur// zas kyi ngo bo 'bru gsar bser can rul// sha rid tshil bu 'o rlon rjen pa dang / ma tshos 'tshig dang kheng po chu bsres rnams// dus med zas tshon ma zin 'ju ba dka'// gyur tshul rgyu dang rkyen du ldan pa yis// bad mkhris rlung gis 'ju ba'i mthu nyams te/ myags byed bad kun dag gis myag ma nus/ 'ju bar byed pa'i mkhris pas 'ju ma nus// me mnyam rlung gis dngas snyigs 'byed ma nus/ de las ma zhu zhes su

160 zhu /mi thang rgyud bzhi/brjod pa yin// ma zhu'i dbang gis pho ba'i bad kun 'phel / bee snabs de yis rlung rgyu'i rtsa sbubs bkag / nyen dang lcags dreg me drod nyams la sogs// gcong nad ma lus skyed par byed pa yin// dar la bab cing stobs lda na me drod che// lus ngag brel zhing snum bag rgyun du za// mi 'phrod zas la goms sam brid nas slob// de la dus kun ma zhu 'byung mi 'gyur// dbye ba rdzas dang ngo bo rigs grogs dus// rdzas kyis dbye na gyong rlan snam dang gsum// gyong ni tsam pa sngo dang sha rid do// rlan ni chang chu 'o ma 'o dar ja//snum ni rtsi mar 'bru mar tshil zhag rkang // rlan snam ma zhu phal cher nyes pa che//ngo bos dbye na snyigs ma dngas ma gnyis// de la snyigs ma ma zhu zhes bya ba//kha zas ma zhu rang sar pho long las// bad kun be snabs 'phel bas btums nas gnas// rnyings nas snyigs ma 'dril ba'i zas skran 'gyur// mnyam gnas rlung gis dngas snyigs ma phyed pa'i// snyigs ma dngas ma'i rtsa mig shor ba yis// mdangs sgyur mkhris pas zungs khrag ma smin te yu na ring mchin gnas dngas ma ma zhu yin// rnyings nas dngas ma 'dril zags byer 'gyings ba'i// 'dril bas skran rnams skyed par byed pa ste// zags pas skya rbab dmu chu skyed par byed// byer bas dug mdze me dbal 'or du lhu nga / 'bras dang sur ya dreg dang grum bu dang // mig ser rtsa skran rkang bam du mar 'gyur//'gyings pas skug po rgyas gab mcher pa'i nad// nad rnams phal cher dngas ma ma zhus skyed// rigs kyis dbye na be snabs bsud nad dang // ma zhu thing 'dra dug 'dra rnam pa bzhi// grogs kyis dbye na rlung mkhris bad gan gsum//dus kyis dbye na gsar rnying gnyis su 'gyur / ngos 'dzin rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi rtags dri ma 'gag gam dus min 'byung / 'og rlung 'gyu dka' 'khyil cing khong pa sbo// skabs su 'gyings rjes bungs cher 'tsho bar 'gyur// dngas snyigs 'dres pas bshang gci 'ag can 'khru// khong snyoms

༄khan nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 161lus snyi yi ga ldog par byed zos dus na zhing sgrog la mgo bo na// bye brag rtags la snyigs ma ma zhu na// kha mngal pho ba 'tshing la sgrog cing skyug / gang ma zhu ba'i zas de khyad par gnod// goms par zos sam rnyings nas de ltar min// mig dang gdong pa rkang bol g.yo bar byed// dngas ma ma zhu khong snyoms yi ga 'gag / sgrog mang sha skam snying ga rtsib logs na/ ma zhu be snabs bad kun 'phel ba yis// steng 'og me mnyam rlung rgyu'i lam bkag pas/khong sbo zer zug na la 'og rlung sdom// sgrog pa mi thon ma zhu kun gyi rgyu// ma zhu bsud nad ces bya bee snabs des// thur sel lam bkag gyen du log pa yis//dbugs ngan sri zhing dri ma skam pa dang // brang tsha chu tshan 'ong zhing sgrog pa bsud// mchin dri na zhing mjug tu srug por 'gyur/ ma zhu shing 'dra zhes bya bee snabs des// steng 'og rgyu ba rlung gi lam bkag pas me mnyam mchin mcher rtsibs logs rtsa nang zhugs// dgye dgu mi shes nang du shing bcug 'dra// gar zhugs gzer zhing glang thabs 'byung ba yin// dug 'dra dngas ma ma zhu rtsa mig byer// rtsa nang kun tu dngas ma chags shing zhen// dug nad lta bur sha lus sngo zhing skam// shed chung zos rjes mi bde dang ga 'an// tsha ches grang ches gnyis ka mi bzod na// ma zhu'i rnam pa gang yang rlung lda na tshe//khong sbo 'dar dang mgo 'khor yan lag rengs// mkhris ldan khong tsha dri che 'khru ba ser// sgrog skyug skom dad che zhing rims kyis 'debs// bad gan ldan pa mchil ma 'byar bag mang // lus lci sems bying sgrog skyug zas mi zhim//dus kyis dbye na gsar dang rnying pa gnyis// gsar pa'i dus na ma zhu ba zhes bya// rnyings nas ma zhu'i rgyus bskyed gcong nad 'gyur// bcos pa'i thabs la gsar rnying rnam pa gnyis// gsar dus bcos thabs spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la sman dpyad zas dang spyod lam bzhi// ma zhu chung 'bring chen po nad stobs sbyar// ma zhu chung ngu zas kyis bkres skom bya// nang nub dus na

162 ༄ thang da bzhi/rgyam tsha'i chu bskol btung // rnyings ma rang sar las pa'i ma zhu 'ju// bad kun be snabs rtsa sbubs 'gags pa sbyong // kha zas 'ju dka' grang mo ches pa spang // phye thug sga btab lug sha yib ma dang // nya dang rgod sha chang dang zan dron sogs// yang dro 'ju bla rgyu srung nyung shas bsten// spyod lam rlan grang bser bu nyin gnyid spangs// skam sar lus dro rngul phyin rtsol ba spyad/ 'on kyang gsar dus smyung bya nyin gnyid phan/ kha cig ma zhu gsar rnying thams cad la// bcags pa phan zhes rmongs pa'i mun tshig smra// snyigs ma ma zhu gsar pa bcags phan te/ dang ma ma zhu rnying pa'i dug tu 'gyur// ci phyir dngas ma mchin gnas mkhris ldan tsha// snyigs ma pho long bad rlung sdongs pas grang // ma zhu 'bring po rgyam tsha bzhi thang btang // rgyam tsha kha ru tsha dang tsha ba gsum// bsdus thang tshan mos drod skyed ma zhu 'ju// zhi dka' rgod ma kha yi phye ma 'am// se 'bru tsha ba lnga dang tshwa sna gsum// bur dkar sbyar phye thun skyungs chu tshan dbul// thun ches 'ju dka' be snabs grogs su 'gyur rdo dang bong ba tshwa yi drod dugs bdug / khyi spyang dbyi sogs spu dugs rked par dkri//ma zhu chen po sman gyis bzhus rjes sbyang // stod gnas skyugs la smad gnas ni ru ha// bar du gnas na bshal gyis sbyang bar bya// rjes la zas spyod bsten nyes slar 'phel byed// de phyir rjes kyi spyod lam shin tu gzab// des kyang zhen che rtsa ba ma thon na// pho gsang gang babs me 'am thur ma sprug / bye brag bcos pa snyigs ma ma zhu la// pho ba'i drod skyed se 'bru tsha ba gsum// ma zhu 'ju byed rgyam tsha kha ru tsha// rgya tsha bur dkar sbyar ba'i phye ma la// tsam pa ma zhu phabs dang bul tog bsnan// sha ma zhu na sbyang ki'i pho ba 'am// so bya rgod kyi gre ba bsnan la btang // sha khu sogs yu'i thang dang ltag pa sprad// sngo ngad ma zhu zwa dang dbyi mong bsnan// chang ma zhu la phabs dang chang bskol bsnan//yang na sogs tshigs thang gis 'ju bar byed// ja chu ma zhu tshwa bsnan dri chu

sa khan ngag yon tan gyi da/ 163btung / zho dar 'o ma ma zhu chur khus 'ju// mar tshil ma zhu cong zhi ma brtul bsnan// 'bru mar ma zhu sran phye ltag sprad bsnan/ rdo ma zhu la mtshur dang ze tsha bsnan// sman ma zhu na dug ril ltag pa sprad// sman rjes pon cha shu dag pi pi ling // sga skya ra yi 'o mas gyen du drang / nad che dang por skyugs byas rjes la sman// khyad par tsha dugs rtsol spyad chu bskol mchog / dngas ma ma zhu cha mnyam bzhi thang btang / byer na 'o ma lan tsha btab pas bsdu// ma byer 'dus nas dur byin shi ri khan// ru rta rgyam tsha shu dag bu ram sbyar/ chu tshan skyur rtsabs 'bras kyis phyi rjes bcad// se 'bru lnga pa chu bskol 'phul la btang // ma zhu be snabs son cha shu dag sga/ rgyam tsha chu bskol sbyar ba'i skyugs kyis drang // skyugs rjes lto bar dugs bya chu bskol btung // lham rtsa son cha bul tog pi pi ling ) tshwa dang mar sbyar reng bus smad rlung sbyong / de steng dur byid phabs sbyar mas 'dren btang / srod kyi dus su rkang mthil rdo yis bdug / bsud nad rting pa'i theg mtshams me btsa' gdab// de nyin smyung byas steng rlung drag tu bsnan// 'og rlung glod la bar rlung drag tu sprug /de 'og bshal rjes lta bur zas spyod gzab// ma zhu shing 'dra thang dugs rtse bcil la// sbyongs skyugs sbrags btang lho bar chu tshan bdug / long rtsa ru thung gtar la kha zas dbri// dug 'dra rus rnying rlangs dugs chu tshan bya// de 'og dug gam smug po lta bur bsdu// 'dus rtags thob nas lto dang rtsa nas sbyang // rjes la ga bur nyi shu rtsa lnga dang // se 'bru lnga pa ltag pa sprad la btang //mjug tu 'ba' sam sman mar phyi rjes bcad// ma zhu rlung ldan dugs dang 'jam rtsi btang // mkhris ldan sbyang zhing bad kun ldan pa skyugs// rang rang kha 'dzin zas sman 'tsham pas bcos// ma zhu rnyings nas nad ga 'an gyur pa la// dang po ma zhu'i rgyu las skyes pa'i phyir// se 'bru lnga pa tsha grang kur bur bsgyur// chu bskol 'phul bas pho ba'i me drod skyed// ma zhu'i nad 'byang

164 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/dngas ma rang gnas 'jog / 'bras bu nad gzhan gso bla'i grogs su 'gyur /rgyu ma bcos par 'bras bu gso 'dod pa// dug rtsa ma phyungs lo ma bcad skyur 'dra// khong nad thams cad ma zhus skyed pa'i phyir// ma zhu'i gso dpyad mkhas pa shin tu gces/ rgyu nyid grol na 'bras bu ga la 'byung // zhes gsungs so// de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis zhus pa/ kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// ma zhu'i rgyus bskyed 'bras bu gcong nad du// de dag rgyu rkyen gyur tshul dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rjes gcod ci ltar lags// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol//zhes zhus pa dang / ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / ma zhu'i rgyus bskyed 'bras bu gcong nad la// gsar pa nyen dang lcags dreg me drod nyams// dug sa chong bad kun smug po mkhris pa'i nad// rnying pa skran dang skya rbab dmu 'or ba'i// gcong chen zad byed rnam pa lnga ru bshad// dug nad phyis 'byung gsar gzhan sngar brjod pas// skabs 'dir rnying pa'i gcong nad sde lngar bstan/ zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las khong nad thams cad kyi rgyu ma zhu ba bcos pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// / /

165le'u bdun pa/ gtsong chen skran nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / gcong chen skran la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //gnas sa gyur tshul rtags dang bcos thabs drug / rgyu ni ma zhu bad kun khrag mkhris rlung // srin dang chu ser sru las 'byung ba yin// rkyen ni sngon las gdon dang ma zhu ba / 'grams 'khrugs mtshon dang bu btsas rlan grangs bskyed// dbye ba bad kun zas nyen rdo yi skran// rlung gi snying skran khrag mkhris rtsa skran dang // spu srin chu skran rnag skran bcu gcig go / gnas ni glo snying mchin dri mchin mtsher mkhal// mkhris pa pho long rgyu ma lhang pa mngal//snyigs ma ma zhu'i zas skran pho long 'byung // nyen skran pho ba rdo skran pho ba lhang //snying skran pho ba long dang mngal du gnas// khrag skran pho long mchin mcher mngal du 'byung // mkhris skran snod mkhris rgyu ma'i nang du gnas// rtsa skran pho mkhal mchin dri rgyu grog mang // spu skran pho long rgyu ma lhang par gnas/ srin skran pho long gnyis kyi nang du 'byung // chu skran nges med gar yang 'byung srid de// glo snying mchin pa rgyu long bar du mang // rnag gi skran la gar 'ong nges pa med// mdor bsdus phyi skran nang skran bar skran gsum// phyi skran snod kyi phyi dang sha pags bar// bar skran snod kyi nang 'debs don gyi legs// nang skran don snod kun gyi gting na gnas// gyur tshul kha zas gyong tshil sbang ma sogs// ma zhu rang sor gnas pas bee snabs 'dril// snyigs ma ma zhu zas kyi skran du 'gyur// ma zhu'i rkyen gyis bad kun bee snabs 'phel/ rlung gis

166 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/bsgril bas nyen skran zhes byar 'gyur spyo dngas ma ma zhu pho bar yun ring gnas// bad kun grang bas rgyu byas rlung gis bsgongs// yang yang g.yogs shing sra bar smin pa ni// dngas ma ma zhu rdo skran zhes byar 'gyur// dngas ma ma zhu mchin par khrag ngan rgyas// mchin pa'i bsham du khrag gi zil pa chags//'phel zhing rgyas pas mchin pa'i khrag skran 'gyur// de 'dra mtsher par zhugs pa mtsher pa'i skran// mchin khrag pho bar lhung bas bad kun bsrul// khrag btsos 'dril bas srug po'i skran du 'gyur// de nyid long phugs 'dril ba long skran yin// de bzhin rgyu mar lhung ba mkhris par 'dres// sra bar 'dril ba rgyu ma'i mkhris skran yin// dngas ma ma zhu mchin gnas mkhris par lhung //mkhris pa'i rtsi chags 'dril ba snod mkhris skran// dngas ma ma zhu ngan khrag rgyas pa de// mchin dri glo mkhal rgyu grog pho ba'i rtsar// 'grims pa sa gcig 'dril ba rtsa yi skran// mtshon lam mtshon khrag 'khyims pa'ang de bzhin no//dngas ma ma zhu sgang pa'i rtsa mig 'grims// chu yi drod kyis btsos bsgril de 'ur 'gyur// bud med bu btsas nad lhag mngal du 'dril// de nyid bu btsas mngal gyi khrag skran yin// pho ba long du srin bu gru gur 'dril// srin skran zhes bya pho ba lhang pa'i nang // spu 'thums 'dril bas sru yi skran du 'gyur//dngas ma ma zhu rtsa mig byer ba yis// don snod logs la chu ser phur mar chags// chu skran zhes bya rnag skran rnag bums yin// pho long mngal du skran gang rlung gis bskyod// 'phyo lding 'phel 'bri byed pa rlung gi skran// rkyang pa'i rlung las skran du 'gyur ba med// mdor bsdus skran kun tsha grang gnyis su bsdu// khrag dang mkhris pas rgyu byas tsha ba'i skran// bad rlung grang bas rgyu byas grang skran yin// de yi rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// skun kun spyi rtags rtsa rgyud zhan cing zhar// chu la skran thigs nya mig 'byung ba dang // gang la skran yod steng du dreg pa chags// kha zas mi 'ju grangs rkyen sgrog cing skyug / khyad

zhus na ngag yon tan gyi da 167par sha rid mar rjen sing gleg skyug / dri ma sri skam 'khru yang srid pa yin//sha skam shed chung 'grangs dang grangs rjes na// drag shul nad ldang 'di rtags phal cher 'byung // bye brag snyigs ma ma zhu zas kyi skran// pho ba 'tshing sgrog zos thog glang thabs ldang / gang ma zhu ba'i zas de mchog tu gnod// gdong pa mig snyibs rkang bol g.yo ba yin// lten skran rdzi ba'i sran che ci zos skyug /rlan grangs zos rjes na zhing ltogs na bde// sgrog pa mi thon shed chung 'phel 'bri med// dngas ma'i rdo skran de 'dra shin tu sra// mchin pa'i khrag skran 'phel rkyen g.yas nas chags// mig ser chu dmar rtsa rgyud phra la mgyogs//grang dros ro rgyab mchin dri sbrag cing na// sha mdog sngo skams mchin sha sings sleg skyug / skran rgyas mkhris yul phrogs te mig chu ser// mtsher pa'i khrag skran de 'dra g.yon du 'byung // sbo sgreg zas skom len yang sbru ba skyug / tsha ba shas chung gdong pa sbod por g.yo// pho long sprug po'i khrag skran tsha zhing gzer//mnan na 'phar zhing bsil drod gnyis ka gnod// 'grangs ltogs grang dang dros pa gang yang na// snod kyi mkhris skran sha mdog sngo la skam// zas len gyur kyang shed bral mig chu ser// smin nas lus kun za 'phrug byed pa yin rgyu ma'i mkhris skran lus lci mig chu ser// rtsa grims dang ga mi bde nad zug che//skom dad che la dri chu sri bar mngon// long gi rlung skran sbo 'khrog tha ba 'khru/mi brtan 'pho 'gyur 'phel 'grib byed pa yin// mngal skran tshigs pa rgyu zhabs ldang dub gzer// 'grangs tshe na 'ing skabs su khrag can 'dzag /lhang pa'i rdo skran chu dgag zug gzer che// glo ba'i rtsa skran glo mang 'gogs pa dka'// skad 'dzer sha lus sngo skam zos rjes skyug / mkhal ma'i rtsa skran thog mar na zug chung // smin nas ltar mngon sha skam dgye dgu dka'// chu mdog dmar la lus lci chu 'thungs skyug / mchin dri'i rtsa skran tshigs pa brgyad pa na//dgye dgu mi bde sgrog cing skyug snyam byed/ mchin pa mchin dri'i sha zos skyug

168 zhu/grwa nga rgyud ba'i/par 'gyur// rtsa skran phal cher ril tsam rtsa chu tsha// srin skran 'dril dus zug che zhi dus bde// spu skran gang du byung sar gnas rtags ston// snying gi chu skran brang la srin thor 'ong // shes pa rgod cing smyo tshul ston pa'am// khro tshig sems tsub chu tshan 'tshed snyam byed// chu skran phal cher mig lcibs rkang bol g.yo//ngo bo sra mer zug chung rdzi ba bzod// rnag skran reg na brtse la mnan mi bzod//rtsa chu phyi yul cung zad tsha ba skye// de ltar skran rnams phal cher lto stong la//langs bub gan rkyal zur la gnas te myang // bar gnas sra 'dril lag 'og gzung bar nus/ phyi na gnas pa dngos su gsal bar ston// gting na gnas na rtags la nad ngos bzung // glo mchin mtsher skran gsang sar gzer ba yin// mdor bsdus tsha skran rtsa chu phyi yul tsha// gnas der 'phel rkyen tsha zhing mnan na 'phar// kha zas drod bcud mi 'phrod bsil pa 'phrod// de las go ldo ga grang ba'i skran du brtag / zug che skyug cing zungs gsum shor na spang // stobs ldan zug med zas tshud 'tsho bas bcos// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la bcos thabs sman dpyad zas spyod ba'i// tshaskran grang skran phyi nang bar gsum sbyar// dang po nang na gnas pa'i tsha skran la//tig ta gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung // bsil gsum brag zhun ru rta pi pi ling // tsha la 'gron thal a ru ra dang ni// cong 'i drag por brtul ba'i thal ba dang // ldo nga ros hong len da lis thal ba rnams / ka ra sbyar btang gang nye'i rtsa la gtar// rtsa lto gang rigs sbyangs la chu lums bya// bar gnas tsha skran bzang drug a ru ra// tsan dan dkar dmar utpal bong nga dkar//tig ta gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung // ru rta tsha la rgyam tsha pi pi ling // spos dkar seng ldeng mu zi bse ru dang // rta mig btsa' ma gcan gzan rus pa dang // g.yag rgod rwa dang rus pa ser tsam bsreg / cong 'i rgod brtul ka ra sbyar la btang / gtar sbyongs chu lums song bzhin shes par bya// phyi yi tsha

zhu khan ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 169skran mkhan pa spyang tsher rtsa// lce tsha 'ol mo go stod byi ba'i brun// sbang lums byas pas phal cher rnag tu 'gyur// ma khugs gong ltar sman dpyad tsha bas sbyang // tsha thur rgyab la 'bras ltar rul gcod sbyar// yang na byi shang dkar mo go phye mtshal// ze tsha gla rtsi sbrang rgod reng bu gzhug / tsha ba mi tshor chu bur byung na thebs/ klad pa byugs la shog bus kha bkab bzhag / pho bar zan dron dugs kyis bag re bdug / de rnams zas spyod ri dgas lug sha gsar// ba mdzo'i zho dar mar gsar la sogs pa// bsil yang bsten zhing rul skyur 'ju dka' sngo// grang dang drag shul me nyis gdungs pa spang // zabs su zhugs pa'i grang skran bcos pa ni// thang shing dur byid da rdo ya bakṣa// tsha ba lnga dang tshwa sna rnam pa lnga// sa rdzi ka dang pa tra 'bras bu gsum// ru rta dang ni zi ra dkar nag gnyis// hong len phye ma til mar 'ag dang zho / mar gyis sbrus la rdza ma kha sbyar bsreg / de nyid rgyal po rgod ma kha dang sbyar// se 'bru brgyad dang nang nub ltag pa sprad// de yis drod skyed dang ga 'byed par byed// de rjes rgyam tsha tsha la la la phud// tsha ba lnga dang a ru'i thal sman sbyar// bya rgod go bo spyang brun pho ba dang // zi ra nag po kha ru rtsa ru tsha// tsha ba gsum dang sbyar la ltag pa sprad/ yang na za byed che chung thal sman sbyar// se 'bru bzhi dang nang nub ltag pa sprad// de yis drod skyed dang ga 'byed pa dang // grang skran ma lus thal bar rlog bar byed// 'ig nas snyir mngon zug che rtsa chu tsha//gcod byed bshal gyis sbyangs rjes me yis bsreg bar gnas grang skran sgron shing 'bras bu gsum// tshwa sna tshogs tshad se 'bru pi pi ling // bzang po gsum dang tsha la spos dkar dang // dur byid sngo yi tsha gsum rgod g.yag rwa// phye ma chang sbrus sla ngar nus ldan bsreg / thal ba bu ram sbyar ba chu bskol dbul//zig nas sbyongs btang ma zhig thur ma bdeg / thur rjes skran ro bshal gyis sbyang bar bya / brang dang rtsib logs skran thag gang gzer dang // sbrul mig

170 ༄ grwa thang rgyud bzhi/gang la bab pa'i tshigs gsang bsreg / phyi yi grang skran snum 'chos dugs byas la// snyir gyur bum pa tshad ldan me btsa' bya// thebs 'ga' bsten pas 'ju zhing phyi ru 'dren// 'bur na 'jag gis mtha' nas bsdams la btsir//btsags bus dras la skran dbyung rma ltar gso/ da rdo yungs gar zar ma til sbyar byug / ma 'drongs tsha thur rgyab la 'bras ltar bcos// de rnams zas spyod lug dang g.yag rgod dang // gcan gzan gong sreg khyim bya bye'u'i sha /'bras chan smod bcas zan dron zhun mar bsten// chang gi dngas ma sga chu bskol ba btung // bcud med 'ju dka' bsil phyogs thams cad spang //bcag dang rtsol ba sru dugs rdo yis mnye// bye brag bcos thabs snying gi chu skran la// bse ru dom mkhris dzā ti zangs thal dang // sha ru dur thod 'gron thal sprang sbyar btang // des ma skems na de stengs dngul chu dang // star bu dbyi mong la mkhar bsnan pa yi// ril bu byas la snying chu bskam par bya// des kyang ma skems snying chu thur mas btsag / glo mig rtsa skran thog mar chu lums bya/de nas star bu skyu ru pi pi ling // chu rta shing mngar bul tog sbrang sbyar btang //star bu bul tog skyu ru ra dang sprang // ril bu mur bas glo skran 'joms pa yin// mchin pa'i khrag skran rtsa skran sbyor bas gdul// yang na gur gum cugang utpal tigatabrag zhun ru rta dom mkhris bshaka tsa rtse mtshal dkar gyi spyor ba dang se 'bru ltag pa sprad// yang na se rgod 'bras bu brag zhun dang / tsan dan gur gum chang sbyar zhag gsum mnan// langs nas bu ram sbyar ba'i lde gu btang // mchin khrag rgyas dang mchin skran 'ju zhing skem/ ru thung snod ka mang gtar nyung du dbyung // tsha ba skye srid brag zhun gur gum cu gang ya ru tigata dom mkhris ling bdun pa dang / ltag pa sprad de phyi rjes bshal gyis sbyang // mcher skran de 'dra'i rjes la me yis bsreg / mkhal tshil rtsa skran dang po chu lums bya// zug chung snyi dang bder song byin long gtar// skyed med bya bra ha bo'i lums byas te/

lta na nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 171rnag tu bkug la me yis phyi rjes bcad/ ma khugs tshad pa sbyangs la thur mas bcos// ma zhu'i zas skran nyen skran rdo skran la// gsar pa'i dus na rdo yis mnye bar bya/ rgyam tsha la la phud dang a za mo/ pi pi ling dang dong gra cha re bskyed// a ru kun mnyam phye ma me dang 'dra/ ma zhu bad rlung grang skran 'joms par byed ku bi ṣa a ru bcu 'gyur pho 'gron bdun// cu gang gur gum tsha ba rnam pa lnga// tshwa sna lnga dang rgya tsha pri yi ku// thal sman zho gsum dri chus 'dam btags bya// ril bu byas bsten rgyam tsha sum thang btang // rdo yang thal bar 'gyur srid skran ci smos/ tsha bsregs ze tsha go thal sbyor ba yang //man ngag ldan na skran bzhig sman mchog yin// zhig pa'i skran ro gcod byed bshal byas la// ma zhig thur ma'i rjes la slar yang sbyang // snod kyi mkhris skran tshe sngon las nad yin// 'on kyang gsar dus byams pas 'bad de gso// mi dang phag brun nus ldan bsregs thal ba// tsha la dom mkhris ka ra pi pi ling //se 'bru lnga dang nang nub ltag pa sprad/ chu bskol 'phul bas skran de 'ju jing skem// gtar drangs rjes la chu lums sbyongs kyis bcos// rgyu ma'i mkhris skran tsha la dom mkhris dang // hong len kur sbyar zhu mkhan dugs kyis bdug / de rjes man ngag bshal dur byin tsha la dom ma khris hong len gyis khong nas dbyung // yang na tig ta brgyad kyis brtul rjes sbyang // pho ba long du srug po'i khrag skran chags// star bu ma nu 'u su rgyam tsha ba'i// bur kur sbyar ba chu bskol 'phul la btang / chu ba ha bo tsha btab dugs kyis bdug / dom mkhris hong len dur byin tsha las sbyang // yang na tsha bsregs se 'bru lnga pa gnyis// ltag sprad zhig nas drag po'i bshal gyis sbyang // zungs ngan 'jam rtsi ni ru ha spel drang / rlung gi snying skran sgog skya'i sman mar dang // bu ram sbyar ba bza' 'ing 'jam rtsi btang / de 'og shing kun se 'bru tsha ba lnga// ma nu rgyam tsha rtsa ru kha ru tsha// zi ra go snyod 'u su la la phud// sug sprel star bu shu

172 grwa nga dab dag zur pa dkar// bul tog bye rig zho dang mar la btso// dren mor bsten rjes me yis 'joms pa yin// sgog skya srang ba'i chu bo brgyad 'gyur bskol//chu bsdus 'o ma las 'thungs rlung skran 'joms / rlung rims bi sha tse sogs rlung kun sel// zhing kun shu dag ru rta kha ru tsha// dong gra a ru rma nu la la phud / dan da dur byid phye mas rlung skran sbyong // srin skran rgya tsha dong gra byi tang ga / phur thal bu ram ril bus nang nas bzhig / rta sbangs phur mo sgog skya sru dugs bdug / zhig dka' sgog skya'i sman mar srin sman ldan// bza' zhing 'jam rtsi btang bya zhig na 'tsho// mngal skran bya bra byi brun pa yag rtsa//nad ma sbang sbyar bsros la mang du bdug / za byed thun gsum ril bus skran bshig la// phyi nang khrus gsher sbyor bas khrag ro gdon// khrag rnag ba rul sha skyo thon na 'tsho// lca ba til bskol khu ba tsha ba gsum// bu ram mar btab mngal skran gsar pa 'jig / thang shing rtsa ba pi pi ling gi rtsa/ ka rañdza dang pi pi ling gi phye// til bskol lde gas mngal skran 'joms par byed// zhig nas yig 'dzag mi bcad lus zungs bsrung // rjes la rtsa ba lnga yi sman mar sbyar// zas skom spyod lam shin tu dro bas bcos// lhang pa'i skran la ze tsha zho bzhi dang // rgya tsha zho gnyis sdig srin tsha ba gsum// lcam pa bu ram sbyar la chang gis dbul// rdo'u zhig nas chu lam 'byung bar nges/ mdor bsdus rlung skran snum 'chos btang bar bya// mkhris skran sbyang zhing khrag skran gtar gyis drang / rtsa skran rnag tu 'gugs shing chu lums shis// rdo skran bur ma nyen skran sman gyis bzhig / chu skran rnag skran gsang du dbyung bar bya// nang skran sman la bar skran bur mas bzhig / phyi skran bum par drangs la dmar 'byin bya// de ltar shes na 'tsho byed mkhas pa yin// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gcong chen skran nad bcos pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// / /

173le'u brgyad pa/ skya zab bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / skya rbab nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang / rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen zas dang spyod lam mi 'phrod pas// ma zhu'i dngas ma mchin gnas zungs ma gyur// ngan khrag chu ser rgyas pa rlung gis gtor// lus kun khyab pas skya rbab dag tu g.yo de nyid glo mchin mtsher par zhugs pa dang // chu ser rlung dang ldan phyir dbye ba lnga// glo ba skya rbab khrag shas che ba ste// mchin pa mkhris ldan mtsher pa bad kun ldan// chu ser skya rbab sha pags mtshams su khyab// rlung nad skya bab snying dang srog rtsar gnas// de rtags spyi dang bye brag gnyis su gsungs// spyi rtags dang po kha gdong mig lcibs dang // skang bol ngar gdong sbod por g.yo 'ing skrangs// 'gul na jam 'degs snying sprug dang ga 'gag / kha zas mi 'ju lce mchu rnyil skrag 'chor// stobs chung rtsa bying chu ser shin tu ngal// bye brag glo ba skya rbab glo mang zhing // lud pa khrag can sbu gsob lu ba yin//mchin pa mig sprin sha mdangs dri chu ser// mtsher pa khong sbo shig mang lce mchu skya// chu ser za 'phrug byed cing chu so skrangs// rlung ni gnyid chung skrangs gsob 'phel 'bri che// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis spyi bcos dang po rlung gis sna khrid phyir// mngar gsum ting khrol lug sha lo yib dang // zhun mar chang dang bsku mnyes zhi bar nus// des ma zhi na sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi// de sman skya rbab rlung shas che ba'i phyir/ dang po tig ta ba yi

174 ༄ grwa nga rgyud ba'i/rnam lnga yi// sman mar gang shis mas btang bza' dang byug / de yi rjes la skyugs sman rnon pos sbyang // sla ra yang gong gi snum 'chos byas rting la / bkru sman dur gyid sgro na zhing lcags phye ba gcin sbyar bas sbyang // de rjes 'bras bu gsum dang li ga dur/ byi tang ga dang tsi tra tsha ba gsu ma / cha mnyam kun dang lcags phye mnyam byas te// sbrang sbyar lde gas skya rbab 'jom sa par byed//ta bya thang shing skyer shun tsha ba lnga// pi pi ling gi sku la 'bras bu gsum// kun gyi nyis 'gyur lca gas phye ba gcin brgyad/ so sor bskol bsres ril bu zos pa'i rting // dar ba 'thungs pas skya rbab 'jil bar nus// ta bya brag zhun dngul chu lcags dreg dang // rwa gsum tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka byi tang ga dang sbrang rtsi'i lde gu yis / skya rbab dbyig dug rjed byed 'joms par byed//gla sgang go stod pa tra tsha ba lnga// stag tsher skyer shun chu bskol 'phul byas na//'or dang skya rbab 'dus gyur tshabs che sel// rjes la dang po bcu gsu ma bco brgyad bsreg / de yis rlung dang chu sgo 'gegs par byed// 'bras thug lug sha mar gsar dar ba bsten// nya phag rul skyur zho dang bur rlon tshwa// yos dang sha skam rjen zas 'ju dka' dang // nyin gnyid nyal po bzhon pa rlan grang spang // bye brag glo nad skya rbab cu gang dang // gur gum sug sprel da lis se 'bru dang lcags phye ka ra sum 'gyur sbyar te btang // tsha ba che na ga buratsan dan bsil sa sum ga dur tig ta ba sha ka tshos a ru pi ling bcu gcig sbyar// de rjes rtse chung sgang rtsa drug mgo gtar// des ma zhi na a ru'i da dur byin zhing mngar bong nga bu rtog mar dang sbyar 'khrus sman btang // rjes la gro yi chang bsten bzhi lnga bsreg / mchin pa skya rbab gur gum g.yu rnying dang // lcags phye ta bya mkhris chen ra mar sbyar// yang na nim pa rtsa mkhris ba 'a ka / tig ta sle tres hong len 'bras bu gsum// bskol ba'i khu ba sbrang dang sbyar la btang / de yi rjes la rtse chung ru thung gtar// ma zhi gur gum dan da dur byin pi lingagi

cu na nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 175bshal gyis sbyangs rjes la// bcu gsum dgu pa mes mnan de 'og tu/ lug ru hong len srol gong rtsa mkhris dang // shing tsha rwa tsha sga dang pi pi ling // bu ram ril bu byas bsten babs che la// chu sor 'or sgo rnams su thur mas bseng / mtsher pa skya rbab lcags phye bcu pa dang // da lis bdun pa ltag pa sprad pas 'joms/ kha zas drod bsten bcu gcig bcu gnyis bsreg / chu ser skya rbab spos dkar 'bras bu gsum// brag zhun sbrang sbyar lcags phye bcu pa dang // ltag sprad sprang rtsi bu ram ting khrol dang // bshul sha btang zhing ma zhi ru dur byin ri khan shu zur pa trab chu'i bshal gyis sbyang // rjes la chu gsang rnam gsum me yis bsdam// skya rbab rlung la shing kun sga spa ling la du tsha shing tsha rtsi tra ka dza tisug sprel te brgyad pa bsten// sgog skya rtsa ba'i sman mar snum 'chos bya// rus pa sna tshogs khu ba spod bran btung // lug sha bshul sha chang bsten drug bdun bsreg / skya rbab rnyings pa 'or nad 'chi chur 'gyur// 'or nad rnyings pa dmu chur 'gyur ba yin// de phyir 'or nad skya rbab gang yang rung // ma thub rnyings nas dmu chu'i bcos thabs sbyar// zhes gsungs so//bdud ci snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las skya rbab bcos pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //

176le'u dgu pa/ 'or nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs po kye drang slong chen po nyon cig / 'or nad gso ba rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa ba'i yis bstan// rgyu rkyen zas dus rkyen gyis bskyed pa gsum// dang po kha zas ma zhu dngas snyigs 'dres// ma chin gnas zungs su ma gyur khrag ngan rgyas // de nyid sha pags byer bas chu ser skyed// chu ser 'or du lhung ste g.yo bar 'gyur// dus bskyed skya rbab rnyings las 'byung ba yin// rkyen bskyed nad kun bcos nyes 'khrugs las 'byung // dbye ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun dang // gnad dang dug las byung ba drug tu bshad/ rtags la spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis/ spyi rtags rtsa rnams thams cad tsha zhing 'khyug / lus dang yan lag snyom la ngal ba ste// drod chung kha zas mi 'ju dang ga 'gag / de rjes lu sa kun g.yo zhing skrangs pa ste// khyad par gdong bol brang bsus chu so skrangs// sha dang pags pa'i bar rnams chu ser khengs / 'og tu gang bcug yon por skrangs pa yin// bye brag rtags la rlung 'or lus 'dar brtse// skrangs rtsub gsob la nyin che mtshan mo chung / mkhris 'or mig chu pags ser dros na skye// khrag 'or rtsa rnams gzer 'khyug mig chu dmar// bad kun lus grangs grangs na mi bde la // skrangs pa nyin che mtshan mo chung ba yin// gnad 'or mtshon lam la brten tsha la dam ra// dug reg khong song dug rtags ldan pas shes// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis / spyi bcos gsar dus smyung bya 'ju bla bsten// bong nga thang rshang dug

sne gun nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 177nyung byi tang ga / pho ba ris bskol khu bas 'or nad sel// se 'bru lnga pas pho ba'i me drod bsrung // 'bras bu gsum thang hong len tsha ba gsum// dur byin ba chu lcags snod bskol khu la// spos dkar srung rtsi sbyar ba'i khrus kyis sbyang //spos dkar brag zhun 'bras gsum thang gis bsdus// sbe tres thang shing spos dkar a ru ra// ba spru ba chur sbyar bsrud 'or kun 'joms// khyad par rlung la ba yi rnam lnga'i mar// bza' dang byug dang 'jam rtsir btang ba dang // kha ru tsha dang zhun mar sga sbyar byug / mkhris 'or sbyangs rjes bzang drug 'gron thod thal// tsha ba gsum thal brag zhun so ma ra// ka ra sbyar bas mkhris 'or skem par byed// khrag 'or sbyangs rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga la// chu ser sman bsgyur seng ldeng khu bas dbul// rtsa kha phye tsam mang du gtar bar bya// bad kun grang 'or sbyangs rjes thal sman bskam// gnad pa'i 'or la khrag dbyung bsil bas byug / dug bskyed pa la dug gi gso ba sbyar// ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las 'or nad gso ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o / / /

178le'u bcu pa/ gcong chen dmu chu bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so /kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / gcong chen dmu chu'i rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //gyur tshul gnas dang rtags dang bcos thabs dang // phyi rjes bcad dang spyi don brgyad kyis bstan rgyu ni rlung mkhris bad kun chu ser khrag / de rkyen ma zhu bshal rjes zas spyod log / tsha ba'i rjes la gtar dang bsil sbyor thal//ngal dub rjes la chu mang 'thungs pa dang // rlan steng nyal ba la sogs me drod nyams// sngon las gdon rkyen dbang gis dmu chur 'gyur// dbye ba nad gdon dug las gyur pa gsum// nad chu byer zags 'khyims chu rgyu rdol bzhi//byer chu khrag byer mkhris byer chu byer gsum zags chu don zags snod zags skran zags gsum/ don zags mchin mcher glo ba zags pa gsum// snod zags pho ba long ga zags pa gnyis// skran zags khrag skran rtsa skran chu skran zags// dbye ba chu rigs bco lngar 'gyur ba yin// gyur tshul ma zhu pho ba'i bad kun 'phel// de yis dri chu thur sel rgyu lam bkag / rlung log dri chu dngas ma'i rgyu lam sor// pags 'og snod kyi phyi rol chu yis khengs// de ni rtsa kha log pa'i 'khyims chu yin// byer chu dngas ma ma zhu mchin lam brgyud//zungs su ma song ngan khrag chu ser rgyas// sha pags rtsa mig byer ba khrag byer yin// mchin rgyas ngan khrag mkhris par zags pa yis// mkhris 'phel kha lud sha pags chu ser rgyas// de nyid dngas ma mkhris byer chu zhes bya// rlan grangs sbyongs gtar bsil sbyor thal ba yis// pho ba'i me shi chu grang sing sleg

zhus nangs yon rta gyi rgyud 179— 40—— ———— ——dang // lo dar ja so gas 'thungs pa ma zhu bar// dngas ma'i lam thor zungs su 'gror ma 'dod// rtsa la byer bas chu ser grang ba skyed// dngas ma chu byer zhes bya grang chur 'gyur// gong ltar pho ba'i me drod thor ba yis// ma zhu bad kun dngas ma'i rtsa mig bkag / dngas ma ma zhu pho bar yu na ring gnas // pho ba'i drod thor rdza gsar chus bkang 'dra// rngul zhing zags pa pho ba'i zags chu yin// gong gi dngas ma ma zhu long du lhung / long khengs zags pa long gi zags chu yin// dngas ma ma zhu 'grams khrag mchin thog lhung // mchin pakhrag gis khengs shing rgyas pa yis// mchin pa'i drod thor rul ba mchin zags yin// de 'dra mtsher las byung ba mtsher pa'i chu// dngas ma ma zhu ngan khrag glo sgrubs 'grims// glo sbubs chu ser khengs nas dus pa de// mchin dri'i steng du lhung nas snod steng zags// de nyid glo ba zags pa'i chu ru bshad// dngas ma ma zhu ngan khrag rgyas pa de// mchin mtsher mchin dri rgyu ma la sogs pa'i//rtsar zhugs rtsa mig khrag rlangs rtsa skran 'dril// rnyings nas khrag zhu rdol te rtsa la bye// de nyid rtsa skran zags pa'i chu zhes bya// dngas ma ma zhu 'grams khrag mtshon khrag gas// mchin mtsher rgyas te khrag zil skran du chags// rnyings nas skran zhu khrag skran zags chu yin// dngas ma ma zhu'i ngan khrag chu ser rgyas//rtsar 'grims rtsa mig chu ser skya rbab byed// de nyid rdol ba chu skran zags chu yin// rgyu ma 'grams sam rgyu gzer rus pa zug / rgyu ma'i rtsi nyams rnyings nas rul zhing rdol// dri chu phyir 'dzag rgyu rdol chu zhes bya// ga 'an yang spyod lam skyon gyis gdon dang 'gras// sbyar dug rkyen gyis chu ru 'gyur ba yod//'on kyang nad kun bcos nyes skya rbab dang // 'or du 'gyur la 'or rnying dmu chur 'gyur// mdor bsdus rlung dang mkhris pa bad kun chu// de yang tsha chu grang chu gnyis su 'dus// chu yi gnas sa phyi nang bar dang gsum// phyi chu sha mdangs bar na gnas pa ste/ nang snge rgyu long snod kyi steng na 'phyo// bar chu ni

180 ༄/grwa thang rgyud bzhi/pags 'og sha steng khyab par gnas// de rtags spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis//spyi rtags dang po 'jug dang bar du smin// tha ma rgyas dus 'tsho 'chi brtag pa'o// dang po 'jug dus shed chung pho ba stem// dbugs sod snying 'degs zas kyi 'ju stobs chung // lce mchu rnyil dkar 'gro 'dug bsus pa ldig /bol gong ngar gdong chu so bcu drug mdo// pho ba brang zhol kha gdong mig rtsibs dang // chu yi mkhar brgyad g.yo zhing skrangs pa yin// bar du chu ru smin nas bsus pa khengs// bem tol rgyab na thol thol zig zig 'ong // tha ma rgyas dus tsha chu grang chu gnyis// tsha chu rtsa grims chu mdog dmar ram ser// glo sor mig ser nyen sna slog pa chags// bsus pa che la rtsa yi dra bsru khyab// yan lag phra la skam pas yi dgas 'dra// grang chu rtsa dal chu sngo skom dad chung // pho ba sbo 'khrog byed cing skabs su 'khru// ma so lus yan lag skrangs che mnan rjes 'ong // sbom la rags pas mgon po lta bur bshad// grang chu yu na lon chu rgyas glo snying dang // mchin pa chus nub tshos te myur du 'chi// tsha chu rgyas thebs mi skye tshe ring ste phug na srog yin myur du 'chi bar 'gyur// 'chi rtags dang ga mi bde skyug pa dang glo mang mig ser dbugs thung skom dad che// dri chu dmar ser ska la nyung ba dang // zungs zad lus stobs thor na spang bar bya// dbugs dal dang ga bde la skom dad chung // zug med lus yang mig dkar dri chu sngo// rtsa rgyud snyoms la shed che 'tsho bar 'gyur// bye brag brtag pa dngas ma khrag byer chu// rtsa grims chu dpar lus lci dang ga 'gag ro stod rtsib logs rnams su gzer phran ldang // gtar na khrag ngan sla la chu ltar ser// dngas ma mkhris byer rngam 'degs glo snying sprug / dang ga mi bde 'grangs na pho ba rdzing // mig chu ser la 'khrus na mkhris pa 'byung // dngas ma chu byer lder tsho lta bur skrangs// rtsa bying chu sngo snying sprug pho ba rdzing // de gsum dang po phyi chu 'or yin te/ snyings par gyur na nang du chu ru smin//

༄༅ mi na nga g.yon rtan gyi khyud/ 181mchin pa dang po zags pa g.yas nas 'phel// rtsa grims chu dmar phug na rgya bshal 'byung // bsus pa che la rtsa bkra yan lag skam// mtsher pa zags pa g.yon nas 'phel ba la/ chu yi nang na mtsher pa rdo ltar su pho ba sbo 'khrog 'ju stobs chung ba yin// glo ba zags pa glo mang glo snying sprug / zos rjes pho ba mi bde skrag mdangs 'chor// pho long zags pa sbo 'khrog pho ba rdzing // dang ga mi bde shin tu 'ju stobs chung // 'grangs dang grangs rjes glang thabs lta bur na// khyad par pho ba long yul che ba yin// skran zags gsog pa bul zhing yod ngos mang // rtsa kha bye nas gsog rkyen zug gzer che// 'khyims chu 'og rlung ldo ga la chu babs chung // sbo 'khrog byed la myur du skye ba yin// rgyu rdol rgyu smad mi bde smad nas skye// 'dre chu sha sna 'gul zhing snying mi dga'// gdong la chu bur 'ong zhing sna khrag 'dzag / 'phar rtsa mi sgrung ldang dub 'dre kha rgod/yang na shes pa bying la tshig pa za// me long nang du bying bying thu lu 'dra// dug las gyur pa dug gi nad rtags 'byung // mdor bsdus rlung mkhris bad gan 'dus pas sgyur// rlung gyur 'khrog 'ur zug che 'phel 'bri byed// chu sngo dri ma sri la dbugs ngan sdom// mkhris pa mig ser sha sngo chu babs chung // rtsa grims chu mdog mar khu tsod khu 'dra// bad kun dbugs 'deg spangs che 'ju stobs chung // lus lci gnyid che rtsa bying chu mdog sngo// de la 'dre chu 'khyims chu pho long zags// byer chu gsor rung phyi ma khas mi blang // mkhris pa las gyur tsha chu mi 'tsho spang // bad rlung las gyur grang chu gso bar nus// gso thabs dang po sngon tshul zhugs dus su// se 'bru brgyad dang rgod ma kha yi phye// lug sha gsar 'jam zhun mar drod bskyed la// 'jam bshal chu ser sbyangs pas zhi bar nus// bar du chu ru rgyas te smin pa'i dus// de la bcos thabs spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi ru dmu chu bcos thabs rnam lngar bshadaka dang po chu bo 'ol kha bsgyur ba dang // gnyis pa rgya mtsho gnas su bskam pa dang // gsum

182 sa༅grwa nga byu pa rdzing sge 'or khung brtol ba dang // bzhi pa mtsho mo yu ra du drang ba dang // lnga pa rtsa la 'gag mig gzhug pa 'o// chu bo'i 'ol kha rma bsgyur na / rdzing ji skye chu gsog pa 'dra// rgya mtsho gnas su rmi bskams na// lu ma can gyi chu mig 'dra/ rdzing gi 'or khung ma brtol na// chu yis lhong mo 'gengs pa 'dra// mtsho mo yu ra du ma drangs na// rdzing gi 'bod ka med pa 'dra// rtsa la 'gag mig ma bcug na// zhing pas than gar bzhag pa 'dra// de phyir bcos tshul lnga ldan gces//dang po chu bo'i 'ol kha sgyur ba ni// ma zhu me drod nyams las 'byung ba'i phyir grang ba'i chu la se 'bru ba'i pa ste// tsha ba'i chu la de stengs gur gum bsnan /bur dkar sbyar ba chu bskol 'phul la btang / pho ba'i me drod skyed cing ma zhu 'ju// bad kun be snabs rtsa sbubs 'gags pa sel// dngas ma ma zhu lus zungs rang sor 'jug / de rjes thing mngar 'u su lcam pa dang // srub ba'i 'bras bu lug sgro'i thal ba rnams// zhun mar sbyar btang skom la shin tu 'dzem// dngas ma dri chu rang lam 'jug par byed// de yis dang ga bde la skom dad chung // dri chu'i bungs che pho ba bde bar 'gyur// de nas rgya mtsho gnas su skem pa la// sman dang dpyad dang zas dang spyod lam bzhi// sman gyis skom pa thod sbyor thal spyor dang // bi ṣa rus sbyor dngul zangs sbyor ba drug / thod pa'i sbyor ba mi dang phag pa dang // rta dang 'phyi ba dur thod gtso byas la// a ru ba ru'i rus pa wa yi snying // byang sems dkar dmar byang pa shing kun dang // rgya tsha dbyi mong srub ku'i 'bras bu rnams// 'o ma mar dang 'ag la 'dag pa bya// nus ldan bsregs thal sug sprel pi pi ling se 'bru sdig srin lcam pa sum gyi brun// kha tshar btab la 'du ba'i rta dang sbyar// dpu chu rgya mtsho tsam yang skems par nus// thal sbyor thal sman 'jam po sum gnyis la// btsan dug a ru bcu gcig pho 'gron bdun// cu gang gur gum tsha ba rnam pa lnga// tshwa sna tshogs tshad ya ba kha ra dang / sa rdzing ka dang sha ru dur

sto khanang ga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 183thod thal/ spru yi ku rnams dri chus 'dam thags bya// ril bu sran tsam khyi sus rim pas bskyed// zla ba gcig gis rgya mtsho skems par nus/ bi ṣa'i sbyor ba btsan dug cha gcig la// a ru sum gnyis so sor nus ldan bsreg / 'gron bu dur thod bur dkar ril bu bya// grang chu'i steng du me bdun bskal pa 'dra rus sbyor dung dang 'gron bu dur rus dang // nya sram chu bya'i rus pas gtso byas la// mu zi zangs thal cong zhi a ru ra// ru rta tsha ba gsum dang dbyi mong dang // ze tsha thal tsha rgya tsha kha ru tsha// rgyam tsha byang tsha zhib btags nus ldan bsreg / dmu chu ma lus skems pa'i gdams pa ste// khyad par skran zags chu la bsngags pa yin// dngul chu mu zi star bu tsha ba gsum// tshwa sna bu ram ril bu skoms kyi mchog / khyad par tsha chu skoms pa'i pha lam yin// zangs thal sbyor ba zangs thal sum gnyis la// lcags thal sum cha sha dus thod 'gron thal// a ru rdo dreg ta bya tsha grang gi / rta yis bsgyur bas rgya mtsho skems par byed// khyad par don zags chu la bsngags pa yin// yang na zangs lcags dngul thal ya bakṣa// mu zi rgya tsha dbyi mong tsi tra ka / a ru tsha ba gsum dang ka ra sbyar// tsha grang thun mong skems par byed pa yin// kha zas lug sha zan dron g.yag rgod sha / tsho khu smod bran mar zan chang 'jam bsten 'ju dka' sngo ngad zas ngan bsil zas spang // tsha chu drod bcud ha cang drags pa dang //spyod lam bser bu rlan grang drag shul spang / dro ba'i gnas 'dug mi rngul bag tsam bcag / dpyad du dbyi spyang pags pa'i spu dugs bya khyi yi pags pa dro yang dang ga 'grib// lte ba bzhi sgrom nyen sna'i rtse mo dang // sgrog rus gshong dang dang po bcu gnyis bsreg / gang la babs pa'i gsang sgo me yis bsdam// tsha ba'i chu la ru thung snod ka gtar// gsum pa'i rdzing gi 'or khung bsal ba ni// chu bshal chu sbyongs 'phrul 'dzag rnam pa gsum/ dmu rdzing bu ga 'gags las 'byung ba'i phyir// 'di la gnyen po sbyong 'dra gzhan na med//

184 ༄cu/grwa nga rgyud ba'i chu bshal a ru mchu skung zangs dreg dang // dan da dur byid dong ga thi ri khan// thar nu khron bu re cag lhum rtsa dang // sngon bu chu ma rtsi dang pi pi ling /rgya tsha bu ram ril bu chang gis dbul// sngon 'gro phyi rjes las lnga spyi dang mthun//de yis rtsa kha 'byed cing chu rnams sdud// de rjes se 'bru shing tsha pi pi ling //sug sprel gur gum gla rtsi bong nga dkar/ brag zhun spos dkar 'u su lcam pa dang // rgya tsha rgyam tsha sdig srin gser bye ma// a ru byang pa bu ram ril bu bya//chang gis 'phul bas chu rnams gsang bar 'dren// chu 'drongs chung na nyi dga' pi pi ling // shing tsha bsdus pa'i khu ba lcag tu btang // yang na chu ma rtsi dang a ru ra// se 'bru sug sprel shing tsha sbi yo ku// gla rtsi brag zhun gur gum bong nga dkar// mon lcam rgyam tsha rgya tsha sdig srin dang // spur mgyogs 'u su byang pa chang gis dbul// yang na sngon mo chab 'dren snyim pa gang // rag 'a mig med bcu rnams rtsi bzhin btags// drod sman ril mo chu bre gang la bsdu//phyed 'dus rgyun du skom du btang bar bya// yang na bong mig g.yas bzhur 'o gsum dang // bu ram zho gnyis rgya tsha zho gcig rnams// ril bu byas btang de dag thams cad kyis// gsang ba'i lam du rgya mtsho 'drongs par nges// kun gyis 'drongs dka' gnyen po'i chu sbyongs ni// rgya tsha sdig srin sug sprel gur gum mtshal// gla rtsi tsha la spos dkar pi pi ling // gze ma lcam pa 'bu skyogs byang pa rnams// rtsi bzhin btags la bur kur phyed dang sbyar// srad dkar thang gis snga dro gongs mo dbul// yang na rgya tsha dur byid a ru ra// zangs dreg byang pa bu ram ril bur dril// na ma lnga bdun chu bskol 'phul la btang //rgya mtsho tsam yang 'drongs par the tshom med// 'phrul 'dzag rnon po dand dur gyid dong gsum dang sbyong byed sngon bu 'bron bu ra nu gsum// ser po gsum dang chu lam 'dzud pa rgya tsha sdig srin gla gsum// sna sel tshab gsum dang 'dren par byed pa tshal li shi pon ra gsum// mi gdug pa yi sman byang pa zhing mngar ma pa

༄gyi khan nga g.yon tan gyi khyud/ 185gsum sman rta gsum// zhib btags chang 'phul rtsa lto gnyis nas sbyong ⑪lus zungs bzang na zhag re sman gyis sbyang // zhag re zas kyis lus zungs gso bar bya// zungs ngan zas la 'ag gnyis sman la gcig / de ltar spel ba'i chu sbyongs lcag gis bskul zas sman ma spel chu lam zas kyis 'gag /de phyir zas sman 'theng 'gros shes par gyis bzhi pa mtsho mo yu ra du drang ba ni// rtsa nas btsag dang gsang nas btsag pa gnyis/ dang po sha ru mgo dus ya bakṣa// rtsa bya spen thal ba chus rtsa lam sbyang // chu ser gdong rtsa rgyun tu gtar bar bya// rkang pa'i skrangs che sbang gar bag phye sbyar// pus mo man chad byugs la deb btang bcing // mthe bo bor ba'i sor mo gsum gyi bar//mtshon gang bcal bar phug la chu ser dbyung // chu thag chod nas rma de spra bas bsreg / thams cad brdugs na gsang nas btsag par bya// gsang ni rgyab kyi rtsib thung gnyis kyi mchan// mdun gyi nyen gsang lte ba yan chad du// chu mtshams pags pa srab pa'i 'bri dmigs yin / rked par chu 'chings snam bus mas yar bsdam// skyil dkrungs lad mnyam stan 'dug lus po bsrang //rjems dang ldems 'dzin rtsa stengs ma yin par// sgrubs thur sgyu gu kha yis sor gnyis dbug / bre phyed phul do chu bongs sbyar la dbyung // 'don pa mangs na chu tshab zug gzer skye// phug shul dung dang 'gron bu rtsib bsregs glan// phying pa bag 'dag sbyar ba snam bus bcing 5 chu kha blugs na chus bor srog dang 'bral / des na snga ma'i men pa ma brtas par// phyi ma mi dbug phug na gshed ma byed// de nas nas re rim pas je dma' dbug / btsag dang skem pa sbyongs su spel la bcos// btsags pa'i chu spra chu dang 'dra na 'tsho//ljang gu ser po 'tsho dka' dmar smug 'chi/ lnga pa rtsa la 'gag mig gzhug pa ni// dom mkhris glas dang brag spos gur gum bzhi// sbrang dang sbyar bas rtsa kha sdom par byed// skems kyi skabs bshad me dmigs bsreg pa bskyar// khyad

186 ༄gyi/grwa thang rgyud ba /par steng 'og bar dang po bco brgyad bcu gsum gyi chu sgo bsdam// de nas dmu chu bye brag bcos pa ni// byer chu rnam gsum se 'brus pho ba bsrung // de rjes khrag byer nyi shu rtsa lnga yis// dngas snyigs phye la 'jam pa'i bshal gyis sbyang // rtsa kha mang du phye la nyung du gdon// zas sgom bsil drod spel la snyoms par bcos// mkhris byer dan da dur gyid spos dkar ba chu'i sbyongs btang pho gsang bsreg / dus thal sig ni'i sbyor ba bzang drug tshab sa sum 'gron thod la ba brag zhunapospre gar sa rang sar skem// zas skom gong bzhin dngas ma chu byer la// me yis stod sman bar gyi chu gsang bsdam// zas skom drod bsten nus thal sbyor bas bskam// de rnams dang po phyi chu'i dus su bsten// ma thub rnyings na sbyi bcos rnam lnga gces// mchin pa'i zags chu brag zhun gur gum so ma ra dza dom mkhris zangs la 'gron la ba ring drug sbyor bas bsdam// ru thung rtsa gtar dngul chu'i spyor bas bskam// mtsher zags ru thung g.yon gtar byi tang ga / shu dag rgya tsha 'o mar bskol ba bslud// shi kru bskol bar rgyam tsha pi pi ling // tsi tra ka btab mtsher zags dmu chu skem// glo zags se 'bru lnga pas pho ba bzung // zangs thal skems bsten rjes la drug bdun bsreg / pho long zags dang 'khyims chu zas drod dang // thal sbyor bi ṣa'i skems sbyor bsten par bya// thing kun tsa bya sgog skya rtsa ba lnga// sman mar 'jam rtsi btang bas skems grogs 'gyur// skran zags 'bras gsum tsha ba gsum po dang // byi tang ga dang lcags phye tsi tra ka /thal sman sbrang dang sbyar te btang bar bya// thal sbyor rus sbyor bshig skems dus gcig byed// rgyu rdol mi 'tsho gdon chu rims gros bcos// dug las gyur na skems sbyor gnyen por bstun// rlung mkhris bad kun gang shas che ba'i chu// sman dpyad zas spyod de yi gnyen por sbyor// mi ldog rjes gcod sngo dang 'ju dka'i zas 'jig zas rta zhon nyal po 'gro 'dug dang // rlan grangs zas spyod mi 'phrod lo dus bsrung // skems kyi sman rnams nang re rgyun mi

zhu/man nga g.yo na tan gyi rgyud/ 187bcad// bong sha rtsa ba lnga yi sman mar dang // da byid skyin gor lus zungs gso bar bya// de yis 'chi bdag dmu chu zlog par nges// zhes gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gcong chen dmu chu bcos pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// / /

188le'u bcu gcig pa/ gtsong chen zad rgyad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / glo gcong chen po zad byed rgyu dang ni dbye ba rtags dang de yi bcos thabs bzhi// rgyu ni bshang gci gyen dbugs bkag pa dang // dngas ma la sogs lus zungs snum zad dang // drag shul zas skom mi mthun bsten pa yis// rlung mkhris bad kun nyes pa 'khrugs gyur te//lus kun khyab cing bu ga 'khrug pa dang // me drod nyams pas dngas ma ma smin te// dri mar gyur pas lus zungs zad par byed// de phyir gcong chen zad byed ces byar bshad// dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun rnam gsum ste// gcong chen nad kyis bla gnyan drug tu bshad / de yis rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi rtags dang po bar dang tha ma gsum// dang po sngar tshul cham 'debs sbrid pa mang // kha mngal nyams stobs zhan la me drod chung // zos kyang stobs med snying 'phar dang ga zhan// skyug 'dod rkang bol gdong skrangs mig mdangs dkar// bud med chang dang sha la shin tu sred// mgo zang nyi ma mi bzod 'gebs par byed/ zas skom rngul 'du skra dang sen mo ring // rmi lam mi bzang sna tshogs mthong bar 'gyur// de rjes bar du gcong chen stod na gnas// cham 'debs lud pa mang la dbugs mi bde/ phrag pa mgo na skad 'gag yi ga 'chu// smad du gnas na pho ba rgyu long 'bab// skyug cing 'khrul ma rtug skam nad du 'gyur// bar na gnas na rtsib logs gzer zug byed// tshigs gzhir gnas na rims gyis 'debs pa ste// de ltar gcong chen nad tshul bcu gcig ldan// bye brag rlung gyur glad pa rtsib logs na//

cu khan ngas yon tan gyi rgyud 189yan lag na 'gyur skad 'gags 'gul pa sub// mkhris gyur rkang lag phrag pa tsha ba dang // 'khru skyug kha sna rims kyis thebs 'dra na// bad kun lus lci skyug cing yi ga 'chu// mchil snabs mang la cham 'debs me drod nyams//gcong chen gnod pa ma zhu 'khru dang skyug / cham pa lud pa skad 'gags yi ga 'chu// de dag gcong chen nad kyi bla gnyan yin// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis // spyi bcos dang po snam 'chos dugs byas la son cha 'o ma sbyar bas slon du gzhug / dur byin dong ga ka ra mar sbyar sbyang / de rjes drod skyed sman dang zas skom btang // yid du 'ong zhing rlung 'joms yang ba bsten// 'bru rnying ra yi 'o ma sha khu mar// spyang ki bya rgod sbrul dang bong bu'i sha / sha za'i sha nyid gsangs byin zungs 'phel mchog / shes na skyug cing spong bas stobs mi skye// 'jam rtsi btang 'ing sha chang bur mar bsten// bye brag rlung gyur gcan gzan chur gnas sha / mar brngos khu ba spod bran btang bar bya// ra sha mar du btsos pa'i khu ba de// pi pi ling ngam sga'am se 'bru'am// nas thug dang sbyar gnod pa drug sel byed// mkhris gyur chang bsrun 'u su sga thang btang // shing mngar dug nyung bya kro rgyan 'brum dang //ma nu zur pa utpal byi tsher ba// gze ma pa la go snyod pi pi ling / kyi lce'i sman mar gcong nad sel bar byed// bad kun tsha ba lnga dang ya bakṣa// lde gu'i sman mar gcong nad dmu skran 'joms// khyad par chang rnying dngas ma mchog tu bsngags// mdor na gcong chen me drod nyams pa yi// 'khru ba lus zungs 'joms phyir bsrung ba gces// 'di dus bshang ba dag la brten pas na//tsha 'khru'i skabs bshad sman bsten gso ba sbyar// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gcong chen zad byed bcos pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// / /

190le'u bcu gnyis pa/ tsha ba sbyi bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// tsha ba gso ba'i skabs la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// tsha ba'i nad rnams rgyu rkyen gang las byung // tsha ba'i ngo bo ji ltar gnas pa lags// tsha ba zhes bya'i ming du ci phyir btags/ tsha ba'i nad la dbye na du zhig mchis// tsha ba'i rtags dang bcos thabs ji ltar lags// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pas/drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes des 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drangasrong chen po yid las skyes// tsha ba gso ba'i skabs la bslab bya na// nad gzhi'i dbye ba rnam pa dpag med kun// mdo ru bsdus pas tsha grang gnyis su 'dus// tsha ba'i nad dar sna mang 'khrul so che// ngos bzung bcos dka' rgyas bla myur srog 'phrog / 'di shes grang —nad 'ar la shes 'gyur bas// de phyir khyod kyis zhus pa shin tu legs// kye drang srong chen po ma yengs gus pas nyon// dang po tsha ba'i nad de'i rgyu bstan pa// ring ba'i rgyu dang nye rgyu rnam pa gnyis// ring rgyu ma rig las byung zhe snang ste// ma rig dbang gis nyon mongs dug lngar smin// de las zhe sdang mkhris pa skyed rgyu yin// ci phyir ma rig med na nyon mongs med// nyon mongs med par zhe sdang mi 'byung ste// zhe sdang med par tsha ba 'byung mi srid// nye rgyu rnam par ma gyur mkhris pa nyid// ci phyir mkhris pa tsha la rno ba de// thang la lhag pas gnod bya sreg pa'i phyir// tsha ba kun gyi rgyu ni mkhris pa yin// mkhris pa med par tsha ba 'byung mi srid// de ltar rnam par ma gyur mkhris pa de// 'phel byed rnam par 'gyur ba'i rkyen
