༄gyis na ngag yon tan gyi da/ 191bzhi ste/ dus dang gdon dang zas dang spyod lam mo/ spyi ru dus bzhi dman lhag log pa dang // khyad par ston tshad dpyid tshad tsha ba'i rkyen// gdon ni drag po khros pa dpral ba'i mig / ma mo mkha' 'gro rbad 'khrugs rgyu las byung spyozas ni tsha skyur lan tsha bro ba'i ro// sha chang bu ram drod bcud bsten drags slong // spyod lam 'dug rjes drag po'i las byas shing // tshad khung gnyid log bang 'gros nyen pa dang // mi theg khur dang sa sran brkos pa dang // gzhu sran bkang dang 'dzing ga bkye ba dang // rta yis brdabs dang g.yang du lhung ba dang // thibs 'og tshud dang rdo dbyug brdungs pas slong // de rnams tsha ba spyi yi rkyen gyur kyang // dus gdon gnyis kyis ma bskyed rims mi 'byung //zas spyod gnyis kyis ma bskyed 'khrugs mi 'byung // spyod lam dag gis ma bskyed 'grams mi 'byung // kha zas khyad par dug tshad rkyen du 'gyur// de dpe me la zhing bsnan rlung bskyod 'dra/ rkyen bzhis mkhris tshad bskyod pas tsha bar 'gyur// de la tsha ba zhes bya'i ngo bo ni// mkhris pa'i me drod thang la lhag pa yin// ci phyir mkhris pa snum bcas rno zhing tsha// yang zhing dri mnam 'khru zhing gsher ba de// thang la lhag pas tsha ba'i rtags su 'byung // gdong snum myur smin drod che zlog dka' yang // dri che 'khru zhing gtar khrag lud pa sla/'di rtags 'byung phyir tsha bar shes par bya// tsha ba'i rgyu mtshan gnod bya sreg pa ste// gnod bya lus zungs bdun dang dri ma gsum// 'di dag thal bar sreg pa ma yin kyang / tsha ba'i drod kyis bsrul bas srog 'dor byed/ de phyir sreg ces bya bar bshad pa yin/ tsha ba'i dbye ba rten dus nyes pa dang kaganas sa rgyu dang gnas skabs rigs kyis dbye/ rten gyis dbye ba byis pa dar ma rgan// dus kyis dbye na gsar dang rnying pa gnyis/ nyes pas dbye na rlung mkhris bad kun dang // khrag dang chu ser tsha ba rnam pa lnga/ gnas kyis dbye na phyi nang bar dang gsum// sha pags rtsa rus don snod la gnas pa'o/

192 zhu grwa thang da ba rgyud kyis dbye na rang rgyud gzhan rgyud can// rang rgyud can de rkyang pa rang rtags gsal// gzhan rgyud can la ldan tshad 'dus tshad gnyis// gnas skabs dbye ba rnam pa drug yin te// ma smin rgyas stongs gab rnyings rnyongs pa'o// rigs kyis dbye na 'grams 'khrugs rims dug bzhi// tsha ba'i rtags la 'gyur med ngos bzung dang // spang blang mu bzhi la mar gdags pa'o//dang po ngos bzung spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi yi rtags la phyi nang gsang ba gsum// phyi rtags slong ba rgyu rkyen sgo nas brtag / nang rtags mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas brtag / gsang rtags phan gnod sgo nas brtag pa'o//slong ba rgyu rkyen sgo nas brtag pa ni// gong rkyen zas spyod rjes las shes par bya//mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas brtag pa ni// tsha ba'i rtsa ni mgyogs rgyas grims pa yin// chu mdog dmar ser dri dugs rlangs pa che// mgo na sha tsha kha ro skyur la kha// lce steng bad kun che la sna sgo skam// mig sprin dmar ser gzer ba gcig tu 'dril// lud pa dmar ser tsha bro skom dad che// khrag mkhris 'khru skyug rngul che dri ma mnam// nub gnyid chung la nyin par gnyid mi thub// nyin gung mtshan gung zhu ba'i dus na ldang / de dag mkhris pa'i me drod 'phel rtags yin// phan gnod bsten pa'i sgo nas brtag pa ni// zas spyod sman dpyad chu ba'i bsten pa yis// 'phrod dang mi 'phrod goms pas nges pa bskyed// tsha ba bye brag so po'i mi 'gyur rtags// spyi rtags de dag kun la khyab stengs su// rten gyi tsha ba na so'i rim pas shes// dus byi tsha ba yun gyis shes par 'gyur// nyes pa'i tsha ba sdongs zla'i rtags las dpag / g.yal 'dar gnyid yer brtse na rlung tshan de kha kha mig chu ser na mkhris tshad yin// lci rmongs 'ju dka' bad kun tsha ba la// mig chu dmar la gzer 'dril brag tshad yin// g.yo skrangs za 'phrug shu thor chu ser tsha// gnas kyi tsha ba 'jug sgo gar gnas gsal// rang rgyud can de rang rtags gsal bas shes ldan

lta na nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 193tshad rlung ldan gcig grogs gcig gis byed// dper na gnyen bshes mthun pa las byed 'dra// bad kun tsha bar ldan pas 'thab par 'gyur// mi mthun mi gnyis sa gcig 'tshogs dang mtshungs// 'dus pa'i tsha ba dus ngan shar po 'dra// kho bas nga drag gcig 'og gcig mi tshud// de dag bsil drod gnyen po gang 'os bsten// phan snyam byed kyang btud na gnod pas shes// ma smin phrum ser tshigs gzhi srod dus na// rgyas pa'i tsha ba tshad rtags rdzogs par 'byung // stongs tshad bsil gyi gnyen po bsten gyin 'phel// gab tshad drod bcud bsrings kyin gnod par tshor// rnyings pa'i tsha ba yun lon gyur pas shes// rnyongs tshad rngul brtse sna khrag g.yo las gsal// rims tshad mgo na za zi grang shum byed// 'khrugs tshad gzer dang lud pa dbugs la gsal//'grams kyi tsha ba spyod lam drags rjes na// dug tshad ma nges khol bur nad sna mang // 'di dag mi 'khrul so so'i ngos 'dzin yin// spang blang mu bzhir kha mar gdags pa ni// rtsa rgyud sbom zhing mkhrang la 'gyur ldog chung // chu mdog gdang gsal lce rlon gtar khrag phyed// lud pa 'gogs bla gzer chung rngam pa bde// zas len shed che sman dpyad ngo len na// nad gang yin yang gso ba bla bar bshad// 'chi ltas med kyang nad kyi stobs che la// bla gnyan 'gyur ldog mang na gso ba dka'/ 'chi rtags rtsa chu lud pa khrag dang dbugs// nad stobs gzer sa lus stobs dbang por brtag / rtsa rgyud 'dar spun sdod dang tshub pa 'chi// chu ni khong log sri 'chor sangs na 'chi// lud pa dud khu sha skyo 'dra ba la// mang du 'byung zhing gre bar gsog na 'chi// khrag med mtshal 'dra chad po nag rtsigs 'chi// dbugs ni ma bskyod gnyid du song gyur kyang //rngam pa mi bde thung la rtseg na 'chi// nad stobs khong 'thems gnyen po mi len cing // ldog 'gyur mang la 'dre kha rgod na 'chi// gzer sa thog ma kho nar snying ga gzer// gzhan du mi 'pho phur pa btsugs 'dra 'chi// lus shed

194 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba /chad ngal stan la 'byar na 'chi// dbang po mig ldog khong du bros pa dang //rna ba mnye la sna skam ba skya chags// mchu brjes so nag lce skams phugs su bros//gdong la sa chags smra mang gsal cha chung // zas dang skom gyis bor na nges par 'chi/ de yang 'dra snang phyogs mthun bcos skyed blta// 'chi ltas snang yang gnyen po len gyur na// ma nges 'dra snang yin srid gso bar brtsam/'chi ba'i rtags gcig nad kun la mi 'byung // nad gcig la ni 'chi rtags kun mi 'byung // de phyir ltas mang gnyen po mi len na// las dbang 'chi bdag zhags pas zin te spang // tsha ba de dag bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa//spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis su 'dod// spyi la bcos thabs rnam pa gsum yin te// nad dang gnyen po sprod pa'i bcos tshul dang // dus las mi 'da' gnad kyi gdam pa dang // tsha ba'i dngos po gzhom pa'i gnyen po 'o// bcos tshul nor na gnyen po mi len pas// gang la gang 'tsham sgo nas bcos par bya//tsha grang 'dres na gnyen po mi len pas// 'dres pa phye la nad dang gnyen po sprad// byer zhing 'grams na gnyen po mi len pas// byer ba bsdus la nad kyi ngo bo gzhom// dang po nad dang gang 'tshams bcos pa yi// lus zungs na tshod sbyar la bcos pa ni// zungs 'bring byis pa'i tsha ba gnyen ltar bsten//zungs bzang dar ma'i tsha ba dgra ltar bsad// zungs ngan rgas pa'i tsha ba bu ltar gso// nad stobs dus dang sbyar la bcos pa ni// stobs ldan gsar pa'i tsha ba thog babs bsad// stobs chung rnyings pa'i tsha ba ngang gis gdon//nyes pa'i sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni// rlung gi tsha ba 'bros 'den tshul du bcos/ mkhris pa'i tsha ba zags bcad tshul du bcos// bad kun tsha ba mgo sgrur tshul du bcos// khrag gi tsha ba shed dmad tshul du bcos// chu ser tsha ba sbyang skem tshul du bcos/ gnas kyi sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni// sha pags tsha ba jul dang chu yis bcos// rtsa yi tsha ba rtsa khrus gtar gyis bcos// dus pa'i

sa khan nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 195tsha ba dugs dang lums kyis bcos/ don gyi tsha ba phye ma gtar gyis bcos|snod kyi tsha ba sbyongs kyis bcos par bya// gtso bo'i sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni/rang rgyud can de rkyang 'ded tshul du bcos// gzhan rgyud can de gang mtho gnya' nas mnan// gnas skabs sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni// ma smin tsha ba smin byas lam du gzhug / rgyas pa'i tsha ba 'bar ba'i me dpung bsad//stongs pa'i tsha ba rlung 'bud bcud kyis gso/ gab tshad mgo spur bshus la sman nad sprad// rnyings pa'i tsha ba zhen pa'i rtsi dang dbral// rnyongs pa'i tsha ba chu ser rang sar skam rigs kyi sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni// 'grams kyi tsha ba lus zungs rang sor gzhug / 'khrugs gyi tsha ba dbye bsad dbyung bas mnyam// rims kyi tsha ba bya ltar spur la gdon// dug tshad 'du ba cha mnyam gnyen pos bsad// tsha grang 'dres pa dbye ba'i bcos tshul ni/ ma smin 'dres pa phye la lam du gzhug / 'di dus gnyen po bsten na grogs thog 'bab// grogs 'phel bas ni tsha ba nyid 'phel byed// ma smin chang bslang chang du mi rung ltar ka lam du mi tshud 'chi 'am gso dkar 'gyur// de phyir bad rlung gnyis kyi grogs gcil la// mkhris tshad mi 'phel lam du gzhug pa gces// smin byas rnyings pa'i tsha ba 'dres pa rnams// phyogs gcig chu bo gzhung du bsrangs la dbye// de la skyon yon rnam pa gnyis yod de// tsha bcos grang bar 'phul na skyon yon gnyis// yu na du sbyong ste srog la rgol mi 'gyur//grang bcos tsha bar 'phul na skyon yon gnyis// gso ba bla ste dus 'da' srog la 'bab// de phyir sna la tsha bcos grang bar 'phul// gab tshan grang ba'i mgo spur ma bshus na// gnyen po nad kyi thog tu mi 'bab pas// mgo spur bshas la nad dang gnyen po sprad// stongs tshad rlung la brngan pa ma byin na// rlung gis tsha ba bus nas la chen 'da'// de phyir zas kyis brid la tshad gzhug gdon// grang rnyongs dang po pho ba'i me drod gso/ gzhi 'dzin ma shes me shi tsha

196 zhu/grwa nga rgyud bzhi/ro lus// tsha rnyongs 'dres pa sbyang ba 'jam pos dbye// 'dres pa'i nad kun gnyen po bsten pa dka'// bcos ngo gang len nad de gdong la bcos//bsil drod gnyis ku'i gnyen po mi len na// phying dril bcos sam yang na ltag sprod bya// gang yang mi len sngon gyi las nad yin// tshogs gsog 'chi bslus 'tsho ba 'ga' 'byung srid// de ltar 'dres pa'i dbye thabs ma shes par// tsha ba bad rlung sra bsres bcos byas pas// gang du ngos mi zin cing skyed med 'gyur/ de phyir 'dres pa'i dbye thabs shes pa gces// byer ba'i tsha ba rnam pa gsum yin te// rang bzhin byer dang rkyen gyis byer ba dang //dus las 'das pa'i byer ba rnam pa gsum// dug dang smug po rang bzhin byer ba ste// ma smin ri thang mtshams su bcos nyes rkyen// tsha ba byer te rnyogs pa zhes byar 'gyur// gsum pa nad 'dus dus su ma sbyangs pas// dus las 'das te rtsa mig kun tu byer// de ltar byer kun sna khrid rlung gas byer// rtsa mig kun tu zhugs nas lus kun khyab// byer ba ma bsdus gnyen po bsten byas kyang // ri dgas thang 'ded 'dra ste gsod mi 'gyur// 'di la thang dang gye ma zas spyod kyis// rlung gzhil nad de khong du bsdus byas nas// gnyen po bsten na me steng chu blug 'dra// 'dus dka' rtsa sbyongs rgyun sbyongs chu lums bsngags / de yis ma 'dus byer ba rang sar 'don// dus las mi 'da' gnad kyi gdams pa ni// tsha ba dus las 'da' ba'i nad bzhi ste// ngo bo nyid kyi dus las 'da' ba dang // sbyor ba dman lhag log pas dus 'da' ba//dang po gnad du babs pa'i tsha ba ste/ thog ma'i dus nas srog la nges par rgol// de la nad kyi tshod blangs dus las 'da'// de phyir chu bzhis srog la thob sha bya// dman pa bcos kyis nad mgo mnan pa yis// bde bzhin byed kyang gting tshad ma thon pas// tsha bas zungs zad dus las 'da' ba'i phyir//gnyen po mi bcad stobs bskyed bsrings la btang // log pa gab tshad grang

sa khanang g.yon tan gyi da/ 197bar 'khrul pa yis/ me bzhi bsten pas tsha ba dus las 'da' lhag pa nad chung gnyen po drags pa yis// bad rlung dgrar langs grang bas srog la rgol//'di gnyis ltar snang ngos 'dzin shes pa gces bya ras nam tshor dus na brtson pas zlog / de dag shes na dus las 'da' mi srid// tsha ba'i dngos po gzhom pa'i gnyen po ni// zas dang spyod lam sman dpyad rnam bzhis bcos//dang po zas la phan bsten gnod pa spang // phan pa'i zas skom bsten thabs bcu gcig ste// ma smin tsha ba lam du gzhug pa'i zas// rgyas pa'i tsha ba yin la gtad pa'i zas// thor bu'i rlung la brngan pa byin pa'i zas/ the tshom nges pa skyed pa sad mna'i zas// stongs pa'i tsha ba bcud kyis dgang pa'i zas//tshad rlung 'dres pa kha yan dgug pa'i zas// gab pa'i tsha ba mgo spur bshu ba'i zas// rnyings pa'i tsha ba zhen pa dbral ba'i zas// grang ba kha thal me drod gso ba'i zas// rlung 'phyos kha thal bcud kyis gnon pa'i zas// zungs zad tshad pa lus stobs bskyed pa'i zas// de ltar 'phrod zas skabs dang sbyar la bsten// gnod zas ma smin smin du mi ster dang / rgyas pa'i tsha ba me dbal skyed pa dang // rlung tshad 'bud cing tsha ba 'byer ba dang / gab rnyongs tsha ba'i me drod 'joms pa dang / rnyings pa'i tsha ba ston la gnon pa dang //ngo bo nyid kyis mi 'phrod zas dang drug / mi 'phrod zas rnams dug 'dra spang bar bya// spyod lam bcos pa mthun dang mi mthun gnyis// ldan tshad rnams la bsil drod snyoms pa mthun// rkyang pa rnams la bsil ba kho na bsngags//gnas dang gos dang bya ba'i spyod lam gsum// bsil drod snyoms pa'i gnas ni nyi grib mtshams// rlan steng kha yeng ma yin dben par 'dug / ma 'khyags ma rngul dro zhing yang ba bsgo/ drag shul dal ches ma yin mi rngul bcag / bsil gnas no'u bsing steng dang chu yi 'gram// shing grib bser bu khang stengs bsil khang gnas/ ras gos la sogs yang zhing bsil ba

198 ra /grwa nga da ba /bsgo// lus ngag bya ba ma yin nyin gnyid bsrung // yid 'ong grogs dang sems spro kun la shis// de las bzlog pa mi mthun spang bar bya// sman gyis bcos pa zhi dang sbyang ba gnyis ka 'i byed sman la thang phye mar dang gsum//thang la smin thang dbye thang sdud pa'i thang / gsod thang sad thang dgug thang skam thang bdun// smin par byed pa'i thang la rnam gsum ste// ma nu ba'i pas bad rlung smin par byed// tig ta gsum pas mkhris tshad smin par byed//'bras bu gsum gyis khrag tshad smin par byed// dbye ba'i thang la rnam pa gsum yin te// sle tres chig thang rlung tshad 'byed par byed// skyu ru'i chig thang khrag nad 'byed par byed// se 'bru mnu 5sbyagasum thang bad kun tsha ba 'byed// sdud thang ma nu ba'i dang 'bras bu gsum// ga bra btso dab shaka gsum pa'i thang la bu ram btab// tshad pa rlung gis byer ba sdud par byed// gsod pa'i thang la tsha ba gsar rnying gnyis// tsha ba gsar pa gsod pa'i thang gsum ste// de ba pa tol par pa ta gdur lta ru lnga thang rims nad rgyas pa 'joms// hong len bsha rim ra spang rtsi ru lnga thang 'grams 'khrugs rgyas pa 'joms// 'om reral rnam pa ra nga ra bo gang chung sro la gong spang rgyan bong spang rtsi byi tsher se bod skyer pa skrabazangs ma ra thang bco lngas dug tshad rgyas pa 'joms// thang chen 'bras gsum tres ba le ba sha hong len tig rta bong da ra gdur bcu pas rnyings tshad rol du gsod//sad thang sre long pa yi chig thang dang // rus bcud gsum dang go stod gsum pa'i thang // ri thang mtshams kyi nges pa ster bar byed// dgug thang bcud bzhi'i thang gis rlung 'phyos 'gugs / skam thang seng lding 'bras gsum tres skyer pa ser na gsum dgu pas rnyongs tshad skems// de rnams tsha ba 'joms pa'i thang sbyor yin// phye ma sngo sbyor rtsi sbyor 'dres pa gsum// sngo sbyor rgyal po sa mi' kyibatsun mo rim ra sras sro lo dang ni// blon pyi ya 'bangs par pa tad ma gdapon rims la pa ra pa ta 'khrus sa la spang khrig la hong len mkhris pa ra tigata pos sa sa gang che lo por

sa /mnang g.yon tan gyi da/ 199btang dmag mi sum cu tig rnam par gang chung dar ya zhan tsher na khrug rkang spang rgyan nga rtog khur pa'o ma bu zhur byi tsher bya rgod spos dang bcu gsumachibs par gangs chul ba sa grangs sam kha bcas/ tsha ba kun la me thog chu blug 'dra/ rtsi sbyor tsha ba rab 'bring bye brag gis// ga bur tsan dan gi waṃ gtso bo la// 'bar ba'i tshad stobs bsad pa'i phye ma dang / ldan tshad dus gcig 'joms pa'i phye ma dang // rnyings tshad rtsad nas 'don pa'i phye ma dang / 'du ba kha snyoms byed pa'i phye ma'o// 'bar ba'i tshad stobs bsad pa'i phye ma la/ tsha ba rab la ga bur rgyal blon gsum de steng tsan dan waṃ hong len tig ta ste bdun pa de stengs ba sha bong dkar dgu pa gsum gyis bsad pa gces/ tsha ba 'bring la tsan dan dkar dmar cu gang gur gum utpalastong len sa gdur tig tab shaka bcu pa ste// tha ma gi waṃ cugang gur gum utpal ba sha ba hong len tig ta ga dur bong dkar )bcu pas 'joms par 'gyur// ldan tshad dus gcig 'joms pa'i phye ma ni/ tsha ba rlung ldan a kur bzang drug ru rta tshe sa gathal ka ra ste bcu pas 'joms// bad gan ldan la cu gang bde byed sbyar//rnyings tshad rtsad nas 'don pa'i phye ma la/ rab la ga bur nyi shu rtsa lnga ste/'bring mi tsan dan tha ma gi waṃ ngo // sngo rtsi 'dres pa'i sbyor ba gtso bo brgyad//'khrugs la tsan dan dmar po shing mngar ru rta ru rims la ga ra me bzang gdur deb spang bong dkar babs mde kha gnyan gla gu gul snying la dzā ti a gar glo la mi krong shing mngar rma chin par utpal brag zhun mcher par spa ling mkhal mar sug sprel pho bar bong dkar mkhris par gser chu so la gla rtsis bsgyur la sbyar// tsha ba'i nad rnams mi sel gang yang med//sman mar tsha ba'i nad rjes bcad pa ste// 'bras bu gsum gyis stongs pa'i tshad rjes gcod// tig ta'i mar gyis tshad rnying rlung ldan gdon/ ba yi rnam lnga seng ldeng sman mar gyis// tshad rnyogs phyi rjes chu ser skem par byed// zhi byed thang phyes tsha ba ma sel na/ sbyong byed bshal gyis mkhris tshad 'or du skyur//tsha ba kun la smin dus khrus pa mchog / snod babs bcos kyi gtso bo sbyang ba

200 sa /grwa thang dab /yin// bcos jugs log gnon sbyongs min gzhan na med// ci phyir rgyu nyid rtsad nas 'byin pas so// de yang rung dang mi rung nad ga'i brtag / ran dang mi ran dus chod brtag pa dang / thub dang mi thub lus shed legs par brtag / mkhris pa'i nad la sbyongs las mi 'da' yang ta ma smin tsha ba mi sbyang byer te 'gro// rlung 'bud che dang 'dre kha rgod la min// smin dang snod babs bcos rdugs dus chod du// rtsa shed ma shor shed kyi thub dus sbyang // de la sngon 'gro dngos ga'i phyi rjes gsum// sngon 'gro ma smin smin par bya ba dang /byer na bsdu zhing rlung kha gnon pa dang // gab pa'i mgo bslang me drod nyams na gso// nad kyi rtse bcil rgyas tshad ma yin pa'i rnying pa rnams la khrus dang bsku mnye bya// dngos gzhi rgyal po thar nubatsun mo smon bu sras hong len dang blon//snam gser / mtshon pa rtol chibs su ka ra bcas pas nad yul 'don// tsha ba na dus ga bur gi waṃ bsnan// snod du babs na brag zhun dug mo nyung spyobacos thugs tsha la gur gum mde kha bsgyur// dri che kha dog dmar ser nad thon rtags// tsha grang chu lcag brabs la dag pa sbyang // sbyang ba ma dag bskyar la sbyang ba gces// ma 'byongs nad bslang tsha ba slar 'phel 'gyur//'byongs rjes chu grog 'bras sam phye thug gam// zho phrul la sogs bsil gyis bshal rjes bcad// de ltar ma yin rjes la drod bsten na// bkru bshal byas rjes snod du dug g.yos 'dra/ rnyings tshad rnams la rgyun sbyongs bsngags pa yin// dpyad kyis bcos thabs rnam pa drug yin te// gtar gyis khrag ngan rtsa lam sbyang ba dang // rngul gyis tshad rlangs ba sgrur dbyung ba dang // dugs kyis 'phral gyi zug gzer bcag pa dang // lums kyis tsha ba byer ba gdon pa dang // chu yis phyi tshad me dbal bcag pa dang // me yis tsha ba 'bros phrang bsdam pa'o// dang po gtar gyis rtsa lam khrag sbyang ba// rung dang mi rung nad gzhi brtag pa gces// khrag mkhris nad la gtar bar gsungs na yang // tsha

sa gyi/man ngag yon tan gyi da/ 201ba gtar du mi rung rnam pa bdun// ma smin tshad pa gtar na rnyogs par 'gyur// khyad par rims la gang gtar don la 'bab// 'khrugs sogs ngan khrag ma phye gtar ba yis/ zungs khrag shor bas rlung skye tsha ba byer nad khrag lus pas tsha ba'i ro mi thon// stongs tshad gtar na rlung 'phyo zug gzer skye/gnyan tshad gtar na khrag shul srog rtsar 'jug / dug tshad gtar na byer te ro mi thon// zungs ngan tshad pa gtar na srog rten chad// gtar du rung ba'i tshad pa smin rgyas dus khyad par 'grams 'khrugs khrag gzer gtar ba shis/smin long med pa'i tsha ba lag gtod ltar// rgyas pa'i tsha ba khrag la thob sha bya//stongs pa'i tsha ba bsil bcud gso zhing gtar// gab tshad gar gab rtsa la gtar la bslang // rnyings tshad phangs pa bzhin du nyung du dbyung // rims dug gnyan gzer rtsar babs rlangs thon gtar/ gtar ba'i dus tshod ran dang mi ran dang // sngon 'gro snyal thabs gdab thabs rtsa dmigs dang //khrag spra dbyung tshad log non la sogs pa/ phyi rgyud gtar ga'i le'ur shes par gyis// rngul gyis tsha ba ba spur dbyung ba ni// ma smin stobs chen nad la rngul mi dbyung // byungs kyang rngul med nad 'khrugs slar yang 'byer zungs zad rngul bton rlung skyes lus stobs 'joms// ma smin stobs chung lam nas ldog pa dang // rgyas pa'i tsha ba rlangs par 'don pa dang // stongs pa'i rlung tshad dus gcig dbyung ba dang // rnyings pa'i tsha ba rtsib sha dgag pa dang / khyad par rims kyi tsha ba bya ltar spur// sha pags rus tshad rngul du dbyung bas bcos// dbyung dus phal cher rngul dri thon dus yin// sbyor ba 'phul 'dren gnyis su shes par bya// dugs kyis 'phral gyi zug gcog bsil drod gnyis// chu rdo rmon lcags tshan zho bsil ba'i sngo// grang mos gsor bdugs khrag gzer zug gcog mchog / chu dugs gre ba rgyu gzer mig tshad 'joms// bsil dugs ma smin rlung dang ldan la spang // drod dugs rgyas

202 sto/grwa nga dba'i/tshad rkyang la mi rung ste// mkhar gong chang bran bsros pas rlung gzer gcog /hor gyi me btsas kor ler gzer 'khyug 'joms// so phag bsros pas pho bar dugs byas na// ma smin gab rnyong pho ba'i me drod gso/ lums ni bdud rtsi lnga yi chu lums sam// bcing lums rlangs lums 'byung ba'i chu lums kyis//tsha ba sha pags rtsa rus byer ba 'joms// chu yi 'khor los phyi tshad bcag pa ni/ma smin ldan tshad rnams la byar mi rung / stobs chung tsha ba lam nas bzlog pa dang // byer ba'i tsha ba khong du bsdu ba dang // rgyas pa'i tsha ba me dbal bsad pa dang // rnyings pa'i tsha ba zhen pa gdon par bya me yis tsha ba 'bros 'phrang bsdam pa ni// tsha ba'i nad kun bsreg par ma bshad kyang // tsha ba bsreg pa'i nad rigs rnam pa drug / mkhris pa rtsar rgyug nad la 'bros 'phrang bsdam// rtsa stongs tsha ba 'phrang kha so pas bcad// tsha gzhug rlung 'bud sbyad pa me yis mnan// rlung rims 'dar bu yer bu mal du gzhug / lhog pa'i tsha ba gnyan thog snyan dbab cing // tsha rjes grang bar log na me drod gso// de dag tsha bas tsha ba bcos zhes bya// de nas tsha ba bye brag bcos pa'i thabs//bla gnyan thor bu'i nad sna bsal ba ni// smyo skugs yer 'thibs mgo gzer 'khyoms pa dang // mig tshag rna ba 'on dang sna khrag 'dzag / lce skam skom dad che dang dang ga 'gag / skyigs 'byams gzer che glo mang mi khogs dang //'khru skyug dri chu 'gag dang khrag tu 'dzag / rngul 'byams lus drod phyi ru thor ba dang // rkang lag na 'khums phol 'bras la sogs pa// ngo mtshar tshegs med nad kyi sgos bcos bstan// snyo ba chal chol smra zhing khro tshul ston// lkugs pa dran pa nyams nas smrar mi 'dod/ yer ba nyin mtshan gnyis ka gnyid mi 'byung // spyo ba tsha spyo grang gnyis su yod// skugs pa tsha lhags grang skugs gnyis su dbye// yer pa tsha yer rlung yer rnam pa gnyis// ngos bzung rtsa chu lce dang sngar rjes bcad// goms pas bsten la tshad rlung la shan dbye// tshad spyo

༄ /man ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 203gzhug chung lnga bdun chang bsdus khur// ga bur rgyal blon sbyar btang rngul mang dbyung / yang na ga bur chang dang sbyar la btang // tshigs pa drug pa yan stong me yis bsreg / de rjes thong tsher dang ga'i bal 'dab gcig / rus bcud gsum gyi khu bas bal tshi btsir// tshal gla sa du ga'adon rdo dreg gisang ra btags rlung dus btang bar bya// yang na bal tshir dzā ti ka ko la// dus khu sbyar btang ma mchu'i dkyil du bsreg / grang bas spyo na bur dkar chang sbyar btang // ma non bcud bzhi'i thang la dza ti dang // shing kun jig pan kha ru tsha btab btang // yan stong drug bdun dkar nag mtshams su bsreg / sha rnying mar rnying rus chen khu ba btang // tsha bas lkugs na ga bur rgyal blon gsum// btang la rngul dbyung de rjes chu lcag bya// sgab rtsa thong rtsa ru thung rtsa la gtar// de la skyed med spyi gtsug 'tshogs kha bsreg / grang bas lkugs na srog rtsa myos byed dang // spyi gtsug yan stong de rjes nyi shu bsreg / sha 'don la sogs bcud kyis bcos par bya// tsha bas gnyid yer gla rtsi mar dkar byug / gla rtsi 'o mar bsdus dang sgog thal btang // rlung yer sha chang bu ram sgog tshod byin// drod sman 'o ma bu ram 'jam rtsi bya// gnyid kyis myos na bal bu rdo dreg dang // shug 'brum thang btang spyang snying sdig pa'i mgo waṃ bu po stag lo pa'i srin lag na mo chur sbyangs kyi sbyor ba bya// byi ba nya mig gang rnyed mig la byug /mgo gzer gser phud g.ya' kyi ri sho'i rtsa// kyi 'bras bong nga dkar po'i skyugs kyis drangs// zug ma chogs na de rjes bshal gyis sbyang spyo dpral rtsa 'tshogs gsang gtar la chu bcag bya// mur gong 'phar rtsa ltag pa'i bsdud sgo bsreg / dom mkhris tig ta gur gum bong nga dkar// a byag gangs thigs gser gyi me rtog dang // ka ra sbyar btang mgo bo 'khyoms pa la/ mgo khrol sbyor ba shing kun sga btab byin mar gsar rgyam tsha sbyar ba'i sna sman btang //mig tshag ga bur dom mkhris skyer khan byug / gla rtsi skyer pa'i bar shun thang du

204 sa grwa nga da ba'i/btang // rna ba 'on na tshigs pa bcu bzhi bsreg / rjes la 'bras bu rtsa ba'i sman mar sbyar// sna khrag 'ong na mkhan skyer khu ba la// rdo dreg gur gum dom mkhris sbyar la btang // yang na gur gum dom mkhris mtshe yi thal// rdo dreg snya lo srad dkar kyi lce ba// ka ra sbyar btang mgo stod chu yis bgrang // kha lce skams la star bu nyi dga' dang // chu dug pa dang ka ra sbrang sbyang mur/ skom dad che na nyi dga' ka ra sbyar// 'u su bskol khur ka ra sbyang btab byin/yang na so phag bsdus pa'i khu bas dbul// dang ga 'gag la ka ra rgun 'brum dang / skyu ru ka ra sbrang sbyar khur bkang btang // tig ta skyu ru rgyam tsha'i grang thang btang // de rjes snod ka thong rtsa mkhris rtsa gtar// se 'bru bzhi dang cu gang bde byed sbyar// snying la gang 'dod zas dang sbyar la btang // skyigs bu 'byams la tsha dang grang ba gnyis// tsha bas skyigs na mgo lus chu bcig bya//de rjes tshigs pa drug bdun 'tshogs kha bsreg / tsan dan dkar po nu zho sna ru blug / yang na ga bur rgyal blon btang rjes la// mtheb chen srin lag sen mo spra bas bsreg / grang bas skyigs na tshwa sna chang sbyar btang // zan dron zhwa mo byas la mgo la bkon// 'tshogs gsubs ske stong pho ba'i dkyil du bsreg /gzer la khrag gzer gnyan gzer rlung gzer gsum// khrag gzer ma nu ru rta zhib btags la/ ka ra sbyar ba chu bskol 'phul la btang // gnyan gzer gu gul nag po'i sgrungs thang blud// rlung gzer spru rtsa gla rtsi chos sman dang // gur gum sbyar ba sre long thang gas dbul// yang na dzā ti sug sprel pi pi ling // pu shel tse dang sle tres shing tsha dang // ka ra sbyar ba sre long thang gis dbul// glo mang cu gang shing mngar ka ra sbyar// ra 'am ba 'o dron mos 'phul la btang /yang na pho rog mig gi rtsa ba dang / cu gang ka ra sbyar la ba 'os 'phul// yang na cu gang shing tsha pi pi ling // ka ra sbrang dang mar sbyar lde gu btang // yang na cu gang a krong ru rta dang // pi pi ling dang ka ra sbyar la btang // 'gogs

cu khan nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 205dka' star bu ru rta pi pi ling // shing tsha skyu ru ra dang zing sbyar btang // 'khru la tsha 'khru grang 'khru rnam pa gnyis dud khu dmar ser dri che chu gting 'bying //tsha 'khru yin pas mkhris phye bdun pa sbyar// ind+ra bzhi thang bil ba btab pas gcod// tsam pa sbru chur 'khru ba grang ba ste/ se 'bru bzhi dang 'khru gcod ba'i sbyar btang // lte 'og mtshon gang mtshon do bcal bar bsreg / skyug pa'i nad la tsha dang grang ba gnyis// khrag dang mkhris pa skyug pa tsha ba ste// khrag tu skyug na rgya skyegs khu ba la// dom mkhris gur gum ka ra sbyar la btang //mkhris par skyug na rta sbangs chang sbyar btang // yang na 'bras bkrus khu bar pu shel tse// sbrang rtsi btab ste lde gur btang bas gcod/ chu dang tsam pa skyug pa grang ba ste// 'bras yos khyor gang se 'bru pi pi ling // bca' sga sbrang rtsi sbyar btang nyen gsang bsreg / stong skyugs sre long thang btang drug pa bsreg / tsha bas chu 'gags so bya'i sgro thal dang // bong thor lag mig g.yas kyi rtsi bzhur la/ chu sbyar nyi dga' ka ra sbyar la btang // yang na zho sha skyer zhun rgya tsha'i thang / des ma sel na long rtsa gnyis la gtar// ze tsha sdig srin gze ma chang sbyar btang // khyad par rims tshad chu 'gags sel bar byed//dri chu khrag tu 'dzag na brag zhun dang // gur gum dom mkhris sbyar btang byin long gtar// dri ma 'gags na la phug thal ba dang // mug bcos 'bras bu a ru mchu snang dang // 'o ma sbyar la ltor btang ni rus bsu// kyi lce'i bsdus thang mar dkar btab la byin// yang na sne rgod bul tog thang du btang //jul 'byams da lis lug mig thang btang la// rjes la sga skya chang dang sbyar ba 'am// hong len tsan dan bong nga mar gsar byug / lus drod phyir thol chu bcag byas rjes la// skyu ru utpal mar dkar sbyar ba dang // se rgod skyer shun so ma ra dza byug / tsha rjes rkang lag zha rengs na ba dang / kha mig yo na rtsa sbyongs chu lums bya// 'bras yos thang gis phye la gang nye gtar// de ltar bla

206 sto/grwa thang dba'i/gnyan thor bu'i nad sna tshogs// tsha ba kun la phal cher 'byung 'gyur te /khyad par bal nad rims la mang ba yin// de phyir kha thor gnyen pos nad sna bsal // zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las tsha ba spyi bcos pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// / /

207le'u bcu gsum pa/ 'khrul gzhi bsal ba tsha grang gal mdo/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la// drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus// tsha grang gnyis su ma 'dus nad med kyang // tsha grang nor bar bcos na gzhan srog 'dor// de yi ngos bzung 'khrul so ci ltar bsal//mtsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa// tsha grang 'khrul gzhi gal 'gag rnam bzhi ste// rtags dang ngo bo gnyis ka tsha ba dang // rtags dang ngo bo gnyis ka grang ba dang // phyi rtags tsha yang ngo bo grang ba dang / ngo bo tsha yang phyi rtags grang ba yin// rgyu rkyen yul dus rang bzhin na tshon dang // gnas sa nyin zhag zas zos goms pa bcu// 'di bcu'i sgo nas 'khrul med ngo yis bzung // mkhris pa skyed pa'i slong rgyu des bskyed nas skam sa tsha gdung yul dus sos ka ston// dar ma mkhris shas che dang bar na gnas// nyin gung mtshan gung zhu dus na ba dang //kha zas drod bcud yun du srings bsten pas// chu dmar ska la dri dugs ku ya mthug / de la mkhris pa 'phel ba'i rtags byung na// rtags dang ngo bo gnyis ka tsha ba yin// de la bad rlung 'phel ba'i rtags yod na// phyi rtags grang yang ngo bo tsha bar gnas/ bad rlung skyed pa'i slong rgyu bston pa dang // ngad can bser bu rlan can dbyar rgun dus// gas dang byis pa bad rlung che ba dang //stod smad gnas shing nyin 'ag thog mthar na// zos thog zhu rjes dus na ldang ba dang // bcud med bsil zas rgyun du bsten pa yis/ chu sngo dri rlangs chung la ku ya srab// de la bad rlung 'phel ba'i rtags byung na// rtags dang ngo bo

208 sa grwa nga rgyud bzhi/gnyis ka grang ba yin// de la mkhris pa 'phel ba'i rtags yo da na// phyi rtags tsha yang ngo bo grang bar gnas// gal te de dag phan tshun 'dres gyur na// tsha grang 'dres pas ltar snang nad 'byung ste// tsha ba grang ba lta bur snang ba dang /grang ba tsha ba ltar snang gang yang rung // nad dang rtags dang bcos thabs goms pa dang // bcos skyed ltar snang lnga yis 'khrul so bsal// dang po nad gzhi ming gi ltar snang ni dngas ma ma zhu tsha ba bad skug dang // tsha skran tsha chu tsha ba'i chu 'gags dang // ma zhu glang thabs bad gan dpu skran dang // chu 'gags zhes pa'i ming la brten byas nas// drod kyis bcos pas tsha bas de srog 'dor// dbyig dug rdo dug dug ming la brten nas// bsil gyis bcos pas grang bas srog 'dor byed// de phyir ltar snang ming la mi brten par// tsha grang 'khrul so rtags kyis bsal bar bya// de yang rtags la ltar snang 'byung srid de// rlung gis kha dang lce skam gzer ba dang // mi 'gyur bad kun stod gzer chen po dang // mkhris pa rlung gis bus pa'i mgo nad dang //ma zhus mkhris yul phrogs pa'i mig ser dang // tshad gzhug rlung gas bus pa'i stongs tshad rnams// ngo bo grang yang phyi rtags tsha bar 'khrul// rtags byi rjes 'brangs gso ba 'o ga par 'gro// bsil gyis bcos pas grang bas srog 'dor byed// pho mkhal snying la tsha ba gab pa ni / pho ba zas 'ju byed pa'i gzhi yin pas// de phyir gnas der tsha ba'i nad zhugs na// 'ju byed me des log pa'i las byed pas// gzer rdzing mi 'ju sgrog sogs grang rtags 'byung //mkhal ma bad gan grang ba'i gzhi yin pas// tshad nad zhugs kyang dros na phan pa dang // chu sri grangs na nar mngon grang rtags ston// snying ni rlung dang bad kun ga'i yin pas// de phyir sems 'phyo brjed ngas gnyid med cing //spyo 'bog 'dar ba la sogs 'byung bas na// pho mkhal snying gi tsha ba grang rlung 'dra// ngo bo tsha ya nga phyi rtags grang bar 'khrul// gzhan yang gnyid yer skyug

zhum na nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud 209dang dus tshigs na// g.yal 'dar smyo lab skyigs bus btab pa rnams// tsha ba yin yang grang ba'i rtags ltar snang // rtags la brten na gso ba log par 'gro// drod kyis bcos na tsha bas srog 'dor byed// de phyir ltar snang rtags la mi brten par// bcos thabs 'phrod mi 'phrod kyis 'khrul so bsal// de yang 'phrod 'phrod 'dra la mi 'phrod dang / mi 'phrod 'dra la 'phrod par gsal ba yi// bcos skyed ltar snang zhes bya 'byung srid de// tsha ba grang ba'i rtags ltar snang ba la// bsil sbyor 'phrod kyang phral du mi 'phrod 'dra// drod sbyor gnod kyang phral du 'phrod ltar snang 5 tsha ba grang ba'i rtags can de las bzlog / de yang sman nad 'thab pas mi 'phrod 'dra// ltar snang rtags kyis mgo mnan 'phrod pa 'dra// ltar snang rjes su 'brangs na srog la rgol// de phyir ltar snang bcos la mi brten par// goms pa yun du bsrings pas rtogs par 'gyur// de yang nad pa'i rtog pa zhen phyogs kyis// phan no gnod do'i ltar snang 'byung srid pas// nad pa'i yid rtog ma yin 'phrod mi 'phrod// rtsa chu bcos skyed dag gis 'khrul so bsal/ de la'ang bcos skyed ltar snang ba'i yod de// phyi rtags log la ngo bo ma log dang // ngo bo log la phyi rtags ma log pa// rtags dang ngo bo gnyis ka ma log dang // rtags dang ngo bo gnyis ka log pa'o/ dang po bad kun can gyi tsha ba la/ bsil sbyor gtugs pas gting tshad ma thon kyang // pho ba'i me shi grang rtags ston par byed// grang ba rgan po gting nas 'khar ba la// me bzhi lus la yun du bsten byas pas//drod kyi rlangs pas rtsa thabs kun khyab ste// mgo na rtsa rgyug chu mdog dmar la sogs// ngo bo grang yang rtags kun tsha bar ston de yang grang ba gan po tsha ba 'dra// tsha ba rgan po grang ba 'dra bas na// 'dra 'dra nor nas tsha grang nor nyen yod// de phyir rtags kyis ngo blan gting nad gdon// gnyis pa 'og 'grims kun bu'i nad gsum ste// grang ba'i nad la drod sbyor bsten drags

210 sto grwa nga rgyud ba'i/na// gnas dus rang bzhin tsha ba'i rkyen phrad pas/ khrag mkhris tsha ba 'phel ba'i rkyen byas te// tsha ba grang ba'i 'og 'grims rkun bur skye// 'og 'grims ma tshor drod sbyor bsten pa yis// me 'bar thing bsnan bzhin du lus zungs bsres / de la chu ba'i brtson byas myur du zlog / tsha ba'i nad la bsil sbyor bsten drags na// gnas dus rang bzhin grang ba'i rkyen phrad pas// bad rlung grang ba 'phel ba'i rkyen byas te// grang ba tsha ba'i 'og 'grims rkun bur skye// 'og 'grims ma tshor bsil sbyor bsten pa yis// pho ba'i me shi skran dang dmu chur 'gyur// de la me ba'i brtson byas myur du zlog ga 'an yang tsha ba'i nad la bsil gtugs pas// gnas dus rang ba'i na rlung sga rkyen phrad de//thor bu'i rlung skyes tsha ba'i lhag ma bus// lus la me btang 'dra jing kha lce skam//dbugs thung rtsa rgod gzer 'byung skom dad che// de ni rlung gis tsha ba'i 'og 'grims yin// 'og 'grims ma tshor bsil sbyor bston pa yis // me la rlung bskyod ba'i na de bud shing bsreg / de phyir zas kyis ngo blang tshad lhag gdon /rtags dang ngo bo gnyis ka ma log na// sbyor ba dman cing log pas bskyed cing bsgyur// gnyis ka log na de la 'khrul so med / nad gzhi'i ltar snang 'khrul so rtags kyis bsal/ rtags byi ltar snang 'khrul so bcos kyis bsal//bcos kyi ltar snang 'khrul so goms pas bsal// goms pa'i ltar snang 'khrul so skyed kyis bsal// bcos skyed ltar snang 'khrul so chu yis bsal// chu mdog ltar snang 'khrul so ku yas bsal// de la nor ba nam yang 'byung mi srid / de dag ltar snang lnga phrugs zhes bya ste// 'khrul med tsha grang gnad kyi gal mdo yin// de ltar man ngag ldan pas rtogs 'gyur gyi dkyus tsam 'dzin pa rnams kyis shes mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs so //bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las 'khrul ga'i bsal ba tsha grang gal mdo'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// / /

211le'u bcu bzhi pa/ tsha ba'i ri thang mtshams bstan pa//drang srong yid las skyes kyis yang gsol ba// sman pa'i rgyal po rig pa'i ye shes lags// tsha ba'i nad rnams gnyen pos zlog bla yang | tsha ba bcos rjes grang ba skyes pa yis// tsha grang 'khrul nas gzhan gyi srog 'dor bas// ri thang mtshams kyi ngos 'dzin bcos pa'i thabs// 'khrul med gnad kyi man ngag bstan du gsol// rig pa'i ye shes de yis lan gsungs pa// ri thang mtshams kyi phrang la rnam pa gsum rlung gi zhu 'khyags sdun nas bsu ba dang //mkhris pa'i zhu 'khyags phrang la bsgug pa dang // bad kun zhu 'khyags phyi rjes bcad pa'o/ de ltar mi shes so mtshams gcig tu 'dod// rmongs pa'i lugs yin gzhan srog 'dor bas na// de rjes phrang gsum 'di ltar shes par gyis// gas dang rlung che'i tsha ba rlung gnas 'bab// mya ngan sems las phral gyi rlung rkyen 'dom// ga bur gtar bshal tsha ba brna drags sogs// de rnams rigs la tshad gnya' chag dus su// rlung gis sna bslang thor bu'i rlung rtags 'ong / thor bu'i rlung gis tshad gzhug bus pa yis rtsa rgyug chu dmar drod dang skom dad che// lce skam jam pa rgod la sogs pa yi// tsha ba'i rtags ston 'khrul ba'i sa cig yin// ltar snang tsha ba'i rjes 'brangs ded pa na// kha thal rlung gis tsha ba srog rtsar 'phul// rtsa stongs zhes bya 'di la gso thabs dka'// de phyir zas kyis sdun bsu rlung sna brlan// ha cang bsu ba lngas na tsha ba'i gzhug / zas kyis bzung nas rnyings tshad skyed pa yod// rlung gi zhu 'khyags mi gsal 'khrul so che// de phyir ngos bzung phyi nang gsang gsum ste/tshad gzhug rlung gis bus pa'i phyi rtags su/ rtsa rgyug gyur kyang stong la mnan

212 zhu/grwa nga dab mi bzod// chu mdog dmar yang gdang la tha ba che// gzer ba yod kyang ma nges gar yang 'pho// lce steng skam yang dmar la shin tu rtsub// skom dad che yang ma 'thungs sran par tshugs// rngam 'degs dbugs rgod gyur kyang sna bug har/ rlung gsang brdzis na na ste sran mi bzod// bsil gtar bsten gyin tshad pa slar yang skye bur zho dus thang bsten gyin tshad rtags nub//nang gi brtag pa rtsa ni stong la myur/ chu mdog dmar la gdang mang sgru ba che//lce steng dmar la skam zhing tsub pa ste// de gsum phrugs na kha zas glod pas chog / lce skam phan chad rlung 'bud yod pa yin// skam la rin na rlung las tshad kha mtho// skam la nag na rlung tshad phyed mar yod// dmar la skam rgyub rlung nyid zad ma yin// gser la ska ma khog rlung dang mkhris par ldan// skya la skam khog bad rlung tsha ba yin/ skya sleg mdog med tsha ba byer zhing rtogs//dmar 'jam rlon zhing mnyen na nad dang bral// man ngag ldan pas zhu 'khyags mthong bas gsal/ gsang ba phugs 'tshol sman gyis brtag pa ste/bu ram go stod sga skya bsdus thang ngam rus bcud gsum mam bur zho gang rung ba// khyor gang srod la btang pa'i de nub tu/ gnyid che zug chung zab 'chol nyung ba dang // nang par lce rlon shes pa gsal na nges// jam rgod 'dar 'thog smra 'chal 'bros pa na// phral du mthil bzhi tshigs pa bsku mnye bya// tshil bu bu ram phye bsur du bas bdug / gong gi sna lon mtshams su phebs par nges / nges pa rnyed na bsil sha gsar pa yi// tsho khu me ma phrad dang gsar 'jam chang // ba sha btsos khengs sgog skya'i chab mig dang / ba ra'i mar gsar ka ra sprang sbyar rnams// rgongs dang tho rangs rlung dus bsten par bya// de las rgyas pa tshad stongs bcos dang mthun// kha zas sngar glod bsil sman gzhug bsrings la// zas kyis rlung bsnan bsil gyis tshad lhag gdon// dar ma nad khams khrag mkhris che ba dang // mkhris pa'i gnas su tsha

zhus na ngag yon tan gyi rgyud 213ba babs pa dang / sha chang gnyid dang drag shul tshad rkyen 'dom// tsha ba bcos phyis tsha ba kha thal dang // tshan pa bad rlung grogs med rkyang pa rnams/tshad pa zad kyang bad rlung rtags mi 'byung / de la zas glod yen la gtad rjes kyi// rtsa sgrubs stongs pas zas tshad skyed 'gyur bas// rtsa 'degs drod che kha skam shes pa 'thib// tshad lhag yod zer 'khrul pa'i sa yin te// rmongs pas de la bsil gyis ded pa yis zungs zad rlung las gyur pa'i tsha bar ldog / de srog gshin rje'i lag tu gtad dang mtshungs// zas glod sngas na rgyas pa'i tsha bar ldog / gang yang mi shes rmongs pa mgo bo 'khor// ma sngas ma phyis phrang la bsgug pa gces// ngos bzung rtags la don med rngul 'byung zhing // dang ga mi 'gag skom dad chung ba dang // gnyid dus za zi mi 'ong jam pa bde// sna rdog gnyen 'ing chu mdog dmar ser dang // rtsa rgyud phyi grims khong lhod tha mal grangs// lce stengs ser la skam khog mtha' ma dmar//sha rnying mar rnying bu ram chang la sogs/ btud drags pa dang ha cang tshad las thal// zos 'grog tsha ba skye yang zas mi bcad// de las thal nas zungs zad rlung gyur na// sha 'tshar mdog ser lce yis ro mi tshor// jam rgod ba spu ldang zhing skom dad che// skra rtsa seng la sku 'dab bag tsam 'dar/ mkhris pa'i zhu 'khyags mi 'gyur ngos 'dzin yin// de la bcos thabs tshad rtags nub pa dang // grang rtags mi sgug bur zho tsho khu dang // chang 'jam chu bsres cha yis brid la btang // de yis tsha ba mi skye 'khrul mi srid// nad zad zas kyis tsha ba skyer mngon na// bsreg pa'i nus med thal tshan drod dang 'dra// gal te tsha ba bda' drags kha thal na// zungs zad rlung gyur tsha bar ldog pa'i phyir// rus rnying bsdus khur shing kun spod sna dang // big pan thal ba dro 'jam khye sus btang / yang na kha ru tsha dang dza ti dang / mar rnying sbyar ba sum yar btang bar bya/ des ma thub na dza ti gsum mam lnga/ kha ru tsha la zho bzhi bur srang

214 ༄7/grwa thang rgyud pa —gcig / mar rnying srang bdun sde gur byas te btang // mi nus bsdus khur sgog skya zhing kun bran// mthil bzhi tshigs pa rlung gsang sku mnye dang / rlung gsang ba'i bsro mar rnying 'jam rtsi bya// sha chang mar rnying bu ram drod bcud bsten// byis pa bad kun grang shas che ba dang // bad kun yul du tsha ba babs pa dang / ma smin gtar bsil tsha ba byer rkyen 'dom// tshad gzhug mi mngon grang rtags kha yar 'ong // rtsa dal chu mdog sngo la dang ga 'gag / lce rlon gdong skya kha zas 'ju ba dka'// bag la nyal bas grang bar 'khrul ba yod// de la brten nas zas glod tsha bar ldog / ha cang thal drags dmu chur 'gyur ba yod// de ma yin pa 'di la thal skyon chung // de phyir tsha ba zad nges phyi rjes bcad// ngos bzung rtsa rgyud bying dal lhod par 'phar// chu kha snyi la mdog sngo shin tu gdang // sngar gyi gos byis mi dros skra rtsa seng // kha zas 'ju ba'i stobs dang skom dad chung // mig phugs brang dang bsus pa rkang bol skrangs// de dus tsha ba med ngos rtags yin pas// gong dang mi 'dra kha zas brid mi dgos// sha chang drod bcud lhag par btang bas chog / 'ju dka' sbo sgrog kha mngal mchil ma mang // rgyam tsha gsum thang se 'bru ba'i pa 'am//rgod ma kha yi phye mas me drod bskyed// ces gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las tsha ba'i ri thang mtshams bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// / /

215le'u bco lnga pa/ tsha ba ma smin pa bcos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la// drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus// ma smin tsha ba'i rgyu rkyen ngo bo gang // ma smin tsha ba'i ming du ci phyir btags// dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bshad du gso la// de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa// ma smin tsha ba'i rgyu ni bad rlung yin// de la rkyen gsum rang bzhin ma smin dang // nad khams rkyen gyi sgo nas ma smin pa'o/ rang bzhin rgyu yis ma smin zhes bya ba// de rgyu bad rlung sdongs pa ci zhe na / dper na rlung mkhris bad kun pha spun 'dra// gcig la rkyen byung gnyis kyang mi bde ltar// rkyen ba'i mkhris pa la phog des bslang bas// 'ar la bad rlung gnyis kyang mi bde 'khrug / de phyir ma smin tsha ba 'byung ba yin// de yang khyad par rims la mi 'byung med// nad khams yul dus rang bzhin na so dang // gnas dang nad khams zas spyod rkyen dbang gis// bad rlung ldan pas smin pa dka' bar 'gyur// rkyen ni ma smin tsha ba byung dus su// zas spyod gnyen po sngas bas byer ba yin// des bskyed ma smin tsha ba zhes bya ba// tsha ba bad rlung sdongs zlar bcas pa yis / rlung gis tsha ba zungs la khyab par gtor// bad kun tsha ba'i mgo mnan skyer mi ster// shing rlon me sngon du ba 'byung ba ltar// sdongs zla ma phyed nad shugs ma rdzogs pas/ skye phro ma chad ma smin 'es su brjod// 'di dus tsha ba zungs dang dbyer med 'dres// nad khrag zungs khrag 'o ma chu 'dres 'dra/ yungs kur mar bzhin de lus khyab par gnas// dbye ba rang nyid smin dang smin long med/ smin du mi 'dod tsha ba rnam pa gsum// rang nyid smin la stobs chen stobs chung gnyis// smin

216 zhu thang da ba'i/long med la gnad du babs pa dang // sbyor ba log pas smin long med pa gnyis / tsha ba smin du mi 'dod rkyen gsum ste// rlung dang bad gan rkyen gyis byer ba'o// de la ma smin gnyen po bsten sngas pas// bya thor byer sdigs rnyogs pa bzhi ru 'gyur// ma smin rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// phyis 'byung kha dmar smin pa'i rtags dang bzhi// spyi rtags rtsa rgyud phra zhing g.yo la mgyogs// chu mdog dmar ser ska la rnyog ma can// lce skya steng du rlung 'brum dmar rtsim 'byung // lus drod mi snyoms srod la sha drod che// g.ya' mang nyid pa skyur la bya snyang byed// kha kha mgo dang byin nya tshigs gzhi na// grang shum byed cing me dang nyi ma snyeg / mi lam za zi mang la sems las ches ma smin tsha ba kun la rtags de 'byung // bye bras rang nyid smin pa'i tsha ba de// nad khams khrag mkhris shas che'i mi rnams la// tsha ba khrag mkhris jul gnas babs pa yi// zas dang spyod lam tsha grang ma log pas// lugs su 'byung ba rkyang pa'i tsha ba yin// zhag gsum lnga bdun dus na rang nyid smin// rtsa chu dang ga mgo dang tshigs gzhi na// grang shum dag las nad stobs che chung dpag / gnad du babs pas smin long med pa ni// 'grams 'khrugs rims dug mod du don snod babs// don snod 'drul phyir smin dus sdod long med// sbyor ba log pas smin long med pa ni// tsha ba bad rlung gnyis la babs pa las// zas spyod mi chang shugs drag 'dom pa yis// smin pa'i long med srog la myur du rgolasade rtags lus stobs dbang po'i gzi mdangs 'chor// na ma thog nas zug che car la thebs// nyal dang mnyes dang tsog pur 'dug la sogs// gang yang bde med smin long med pa yin// rlung gis tsha ba smin du mi 'dod rtags// rtsa 'khrug lus kun brdungs snyam stong skyugs byed// g.yal 'dar mig dpangs mtho la mchi ma 'dzag / tsha ba bad kun dag gis ma smin na// kha mngal mchil snabs mang la pho ba rdzing // dang ga mi bde skyug cing lus drod chung // chu grang

zhu khan nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 217zho dar gtar bshal rngul thang sogs// rkyen gyis byer bas lus rngul shed nyams chung // grang shums res yod res med me nyi 'don// de yang rlung shas che na bya shor te// bcos su mi 'dod tsha ba lam nas 'khyog / chu dmar rtsa rgyud phra grims stong la mgyogs// glo gsor gnyid chung g.yal mang rus tshigs na// bya thor ma brlan stongs te rlung ltar 'tshub// khrag mkhris shas che'i tsha ba byer 'gyur te rtsa rgyud phra mgyogs chu dmar tshigs gzhi na// glo 'bud rngul kha snyi la pags pa brtse// byer te ma bsdus rnyings nas rtsi ltar zhen// bad kun shas che tsha ba'i mgo sdigs te// pho mchin mkhal 'khor mgo dang tshigs ga'i na// dang ga mi bde 'ju dka' stong skyugs byed// sdigs pa ma bsengs gab nas mun ltar 'thib/ chu ser shas che tsha ba rnyogs par 'gyur// rtsa rgyud phra mgyogs chu mdog dmar la sprug / snying sprug mig lcibs rkang bol cung zad g.yo // glo chung 'degs shing ro stod gzer phran 'ong // rnyogs pa ma bsal 'ong lhur chu ltar 'phyo// ma smin tsha ba phyis kyi 'byung tshul ni// nad stobs che la smin dka' phal cher 'chi// smin dka' nad stobs chung yang yun du sbyong //stobs che smin bla 'chi rkyen 'tsho rkyen nad// stobs chung smin pa bla na myur du 'tsho// de bzhin yul dus rang ba'i na na so dang // nad khams khrag mkhris can la zas spyod log / tshad stobs chung na rang shugs smin 'gyur te//stobs lda na tsha ba rgyas pa phal cher 'chi// de bzhin bad rlung grang ba'i nad gzhi la// zas dang sman dpyad spyod lam bsil bsten pas// tsha ba ma smin yu na du sbyong bar 'gyur// de la sha chang drag shul nyin gnyid shor// nad stobs chung na smin pa bla ba ste// stobs che smin long med pa'i tsha bar 'gyur//smin rtags lce steng dkar ser rlung 'brum med// rtsa stod rgyug cing rtsa smad dma' la grims// chu mdog dmar ser ku ya ling gis 'dril// bsil 'dod lus la dri 'byung dbang po g.yung // khyad par grang shums chad na smin

218 sa /grwa nga dab /pa ste// 'bud byed me shing zad pa'i me dang 'dra/ gso ba'i dus yin de las thal mi bya// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la bcos pa'i tshul dang gnyen po gnyis// bcos pa'i tshul la rnam pa gnyis yin te/ rims kyi tsha ba chang ltar smin par bya// 'grams 'khrugs tsha ba dgra zin lta bur dbye// bcos pa'i gnyen po sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi// sman du ma nu bzhi thang dro 'jam bsten// tsha ba mi 'phel bad rlung 'i bar byed// khrag mkhris shas che slo tres 'bras bu gsum ta bsdus 'jam bston pas tsha ba dngas snyigs 'byed// yun du smin dka' big pan thal ba dang // bzang po gsum dang sle tres pu shel rtse// da lis byi tsher phye ma dus khus dbul// dpyad du pho bar dugs bya mthil ba ra byug / zas spyod phye tshod dral thug bskol grangs chu// de sogs bcud med 'ju bla dro 'jam bsten// nang nub dus su chu bskol tshan mo btung // spyod lam gos dro nyi grib mtshams su bsdad// drag shul me nyis gdungs dang nyin gnyid log / sha chang drod bcud mkhris tshad skyed phyir spang // grib 'khyags sa rlan bser bu grang ba dang / zho dar chu grang rjen zas 'ju dka' rnams// bad rlung grogs la phog pas spang bar bya//bshal gtar rngul dbyung bsil thang phye ma rnams// 'di dus mi bsten tsha ba lam nas 'khyog / de ltar smin byed sbyor ba mi shes par// kha cig smin pa bla zhes drod sbyor bsten// nad kyi stobs bskyed srog la nges par rtsol// kha cig ma na tsha ba bsil gyis bcos// kha drag skyel ma'i 'gron po bcom pa 'dra//gnyen po grogs kyi thog tu babs pa na// mkhris tshad mi gsod bad rlung skyed byed pas// grogs 'phel bas ni tsha ba nyid 'phel byed// de phyir smin byed bsil drod snyoms bsten na// phyi nas mi skye sngar skyes 'byed cing sel/ bye brag rang nyid smin pa'i tsha ba la// stobs che smin byed gnyen po tshul bzhin bsten// stobs chung nad la tsha ba bya ltar spur 'bras bu gsum dang tig ta

zhu/man nga g.yo na tan gyi rgyud/ 219li ga dur// ba le ka dang utpal sle tres bskol// phul phyed rtse 'jam btang la dro sar bsnyal// sman zhu lus rngul gyur nas gdong pa byib rngul thon bal dang phyes phyi rlung gnon btang // gal te thon dka' sne'u'i rlangs dugs byasakha cig sman ma zhu bar gdong pa byibs// sman nus ma thon nad pa'i sdug sran zad// rngul med nad 'khrugs nyes pa phyir la che// de ltar rngul 'don kun la shes par gyis// de bzhin nyi ma gsum du rngul bton la/ de rjes skar chu rdzi'u gang do gsum// rim pas nyi ma gsum du lus la bran// de nas gi waṃ bsil gsum phye ma bsten// de yis tsha ba lam nas zlog par nges// smin long med pa'i tsha ba bcos pa ni// bad rlung dus su smin byed thang bston zhing // mkhris pa'i dus su bsil gyi gnyen pos bsad// smin dus brgyags na la 'da' srog 'phrog 'gyur// de bas byer zhing rtogs la mi lta bar// nad dang sman dpyad sroga'i thob sha bya// bad kun ma smin se 'bru skyu ru ra// sga skya pu shel rtse yi bsdus thang btang // yang na se 'bru skyu ru byi tsher ba// yang na rgyam tsha gsum pa'i bsdus thang btang // rlung gis ma smin sle tres bur rnying thang / yan na rus bcud gsum gyi bsdus thang btang // rkyen gyis byer na jig pan chang sbyar sbyin// spu mo pus mo man chad chu yis bran// phyi de nang par dpyi dpung man chad la// de yi phyi de nang par lus kun bran// de nas 'bras gsum tig ta'i bsdus grangs bsten// bcos sngas ma smin tsha ba bya shor na sre long thang btang mthil bzhi rlung gsang byug / khol bur na'am gzer sar dugs kyis bdug / ma nu bzhi yi bsdus thang tshan mo bsten// sha gsar mar gsar yos chang bya shor brlan// ma smin byer la sre long dus thang btang / de nas 'bras bu gsum gyi bsdus grangs blud/ de rjes bzang po drug gi phye ma sbyar// brtse phro chad nas ya ru lum pa'i 'jam bshal btang bas 'tsho/ kha zas bsil bcud bsten pas byer ba sdud// ma smin mgo sdigs se 'bru bzhi pa sbyar// sre long sga

220 ༄/grwa thang rgyud bzhi/bsregs thang btang 'jam bshal bya// bcud med dro 'jam zas bsten mgo sdigs seng // ma smin rnyogs la sle tres pi pi ling // 'bras gsum thang btang ru thung snod ka gtar// de nas tsan dan gi waṃ gur gum gsum// tshad stobs sbyar te rwa gsum ba sha ka / spos dkar so ma ra dza brag zhun phye// thun smyungs yun bsrings seng ldeng thang gis dbul// 'bras gsum rgyu rtsa sngon bu spos dkar ba chu'ibashal btang rjes la tshis sa pa dang po bcu gsum bco brgyad ba nyam sa sang rnams la mes bcad rnyogs pa bsal// de ltar ma smin pa yi tsha ba de// tsha ba kun gyi sngon du 'byung ba ste// khyad par rims la ma smin shas cher 'byung // ma smin rtags dang gang ldan smin bya gces / dus tshod smin rtags ma shar bar du bcos//smin legs tsha ba choms bla 'tsho ba rkyen// bcos nyes gab rnyings rgyas stongs rnyogs 'gyur ba des na 'di dus bcos ka gzab par bya// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las tsha ba ma smin pa bcos pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// / /

221le'u bcu drug pa/ rgyas pa'i tsha ba bcos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la// drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus// tsha ba rgyas pa'i rgyu rkyen ngo bo gang / tsha ba rgyas pa'i ming du ci ltar btags// dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bshad du gsol de ltar zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa// rgyas tshad rgyu ni gnod byed mkhris pa ste//ngo bo tsha 'ing rno la dri mnam pa'o// de la rgyas rkyen rang bzhin rgyas pa dang //dus kyis rgyas dang rkyen gyis rgyas pa'o// rang bzhin ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa dang // ston dpyid tsha sgo'i yul dus 'dzom pa dang // sha chang la sogs zas skom drod bcud drags// spyod lam drag shul rkyen gyis 'khrugs pa las/tsha ba rno dro'i me drod thang la lhags// lus zungs khrag dang dri ma rngul la rgyas//dus ni smin dang tsha ba'i sgang la babs// rkyen ni ma smin tsha ba yul dus dang 5rang bzhin na so gnas dang nad khams rnams// mkhris par 'dom la zas spyod log pa yin// nad smin shugs rdzogs rkyang pa'i tsha ba des// lus zungs sreg par byed phyir rgyas zhes bya// dper na shing skam me yi phung po 'dra// dbye ba rigs dang stobs dang babs sgos dbye// rigs kyis dbye na rims rgyas 'khrugs rgyas gnyis/ stobs kyis dbye na stobs chen stobs chung gnyis babs sgos dbye na spyi dang bye brag gnyis// bye brag snying srog blo mchin mcher mkhal drug / pho ba mkhris pa brgyad la rgyas pa'o// rgyas pa'i rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyi rtags rtsa ni sbom la drag pa dang // 'bur 'dril mkhrang grims myur la mgyogs par 'phar// chu mdog dmar ser dri mnam rlangs pa che// lud pa dmar ser dud kha mang du lu// dbugs thung gzer drag kha skam

222 zhu/grwa thang da bzhi so grig chags// lus lci dang ga mi bde skom dad che// snying la bsil 'dod lus la rngul dri mnam// khyad par rims rgyas mgo na za zi mang // stobs chen stobs chung nad kyi stobs las dpag / bye brag snying la tsha ba rgyas pa ni// myos ldan dran pa mi gsal gos la sdang // lce skam gzhung nag gnyid dang skom dad che// dang ga 'gag la nu pa'i steng du gzer/ srog rtsar babs pas khus 'debs shes pa 'khrul// gos kyi rdul sel mig dmar gnam la blta slo la rgyas na dbugs thung brang rgyab gzer mgo 'khor dbugs jam skad 'gag glo snying rdung // mtshan mo nyal khar glo mang kha gdong skrangs// mchin par rgyas na mig dmar lud pa ser rtsib logs g.yas kyi steng dang mchin dri gzer//mtsher rgyas khong sbo g.yo na gyi rtsib logs gzer dbugs rgod lce skya mchu nag pus mo skrangs// rkang lag sbrid cing rked pa chag snyam byed// mkhal rgyas chu sri rkang bshal mkhal skad gzer// chu dmar tsha rlangs mgo 'thom rna ba 'on//pho bar rgyas na glang thabs na jing skyug / grang dro gnyis ka na la ltag mig lta/ mkhris par rgyas na kha kha mig chu ser// dang ga 'gag la mkhris pa skyug par 'gyur// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis / spyi la bcos pa'i tshul dang gnyen po'o// bcos tshul stobs chen dar drag thog babs bsad//stobs chung tsha ba 'jam la zhi bas bcos// dang por rlangs bsad bar du lo ma brab// tha ma rtsa ba bcad pa'i tshul du bcos// gnyen po sman dpyad zas dang spyod lam bzhi// sman gyis bcos pa 'i dang sbyang ba gnyis / zhi byed sman la thang dang phye ma ste// thang la dbye ba'i thang dang bsad thang gnyis// dbye thang tig ta sle tres skyu ru ra// ba sha ka yi bskol grangs nad khrag 'byed//bsad thang sle tres skyu ru ba le ka / de gsum gzhir bzhag tsha ba rab 'bring gis// hong len tig ta ba sha ka sbyar ba/ bskol grangs khu ba rgyas tshad 'joms pa'i mchog / yang na sle tres byi tsher 'bras bu gsum/ tig ta hong

sto/man nga g.yon tan gyi bad/ 223len bong nga dkar po dang / rgya skyegs ba sha ka dang 'bras bu gsum// ma nu puskar rwa gsum utpa la/ ga dur kun la bsres pa'i bskol grangs thang //rlung mkhris khrag dang bad gan tsha ba 'joms// phye mas bsad pa tsha ba stobs rgyas la// ga bur rgyal blon gsum gur gum hong len ba ka tig ta ba ldan pa'i bdun ga bur gtso brgyad 'a ba na pa'i dgu pa sbyar/ tsha ba 'bring la gi waṃ bsil gsum tsan dan glartsi bong dkar rukar tsan dan bsil gsum ga dur utpal tigata shing ma ngar gar brgyad/tsha ba tha ma cu gang gur gu sug la brag zhun tig ta ma ru mtshal spa ling ka ra brgyad pa dang /gur gum cu gang ba da utpal ba ru ra mtshal tig tab dun dang thang chen tig ta dug zhung ga ra me gdur ru hong dab sha ka rkar bdun pa sbyar/ sbyang ba tsha ba smin dang snod du lhungs// mchin mkhris la babs bcos skyed chung ba dang // rtsa shed ma shor lus zungs bzang ba la/ a ru mchu skung lcam rtsa gser me tog / hong len ba chur bskol te grangs pa btang / skyug na bsrung zhing thags nas lcag gis bskul// rjes la chu grog 'bras dang zho yis bcad// nad dngos 'don byed gso dpyad gtso bo yin// dpyad kyis bcos pa gtar rngul chu dugs bzhi//sman gyis ma choms gtar gyis dbyung ba ste// gang rgyas rtsa dang gang babs rtsa lagatar// sngon 'gro dngos ga'i phyi rjes sbyi dang mthun/ 'grams 'khrugs khrag ngan rtsa dang don la brtag / de phyir gso dpyad gtso bo gtar ba yin//tsha ba ba srur 'dren byed rngul du dbyung / ra dkar rwa rtse g.yas gzhob bal tshi sbyar// 'jam bsros lus po kun la khyab par byug / de skams rjes la ga bur rgyal blon gsum// sha bal khu bas 'phul btang ba spur 'don// yang na a ru dza ti byi tsher thang // dro 'jam btang la jul dbyung bal phyes phyi dral thug dro 'jam btang zhing rlung kha mnan// rims ni mkhris tshad rngul gnas ba spur lhag / gtar ba mi bzang dpyad mchog rngul du dbyung // chu lcag skar chus nyi ma kha dros la// pang leb thog tu gcer bu tsog pur 'dug / phul phyed khong

224 sa༅/grwa thang da ba /btang lus kun kha chus bran// mi dngang ba yi chu rgyun tshugs tshad blug / de yis tsha ba'i rlangs 'don tshad mgo gcog / dugs kyis bcos pa gzer stengs chu rdo dang // rmon lcags byang ma bsil ba'i sngo sna 'am// mtshan dang kyi lce zho sbyar grang mo yis// yang yang gsor te bdugs pas phral zug gcog /zas kyis bcos pa 'bras dang chag tse dang // rgya khur khur tshod ba yi zho dar gsar// gangs chu ba tsha med pa'i chu bsil btang // pho ba zhan na de yang bskol grangs shis// lan tsha sha chang sgog pa tsha ba'i sngo// snag lug zho dar drod bcud dug 'dra spang // spyod lam bser bu grib ma chu yi 'gram ni bsing sa gtsang zla 'od bsil gnas 'dug / lus ngag yid gsum zhi dal des par bya// me tshan nyi tshan lud steng nyin gnyid dang // 'gro 'dug ldang nyal lus ngag rtsol ba spang // de nas rgyas tshad bye brag bcos pa la// thang gtar 'gam phye gsum du shes par bya// rnyings tshad skyu ru'i ba sha ka tsan dan gur gu sbyar bzang btang snying rtsa gtar// ga bur cusang gur kum utpal sa ta hong len yag ru larabadun dgu tsan dan gnyis ga ru cus tigata utpal gla pu shel sa ra tsan dan tigata ba le ka bo da ra ka rko la ma ru na ga ge sar du rta ka ra ste brgyad pa sbyar// srog rtsar shor na thang gtar snying bzhin bcos// phye ma a gar nag po tsan dan dkar dmar dza ti lizhi snying no sha gur gum na gis ra ru rta ka ra dgu sbyor bya// spyi bo'i gtsug dang rkang mthil gtar la bsreg / gzhug chung lnga bdun ga bur sbyor ba bya// zug bri dran pa gsal na thub pa'i rtags// glo 'khrugs ba le'i sro lo ba tsan dan tig tathang btang glo rtsa gtar// thing mngar cu sang gur gum dza ti sa blo la rgun 'brum tigata.utpal brgyad dang cu gang gur gumadzati li rsha su ga sprel zang dkar tigata ker bdun 'i ru gesar dgur sbyar// mchin tshad ba sha'i ba le gur gum tigata bang btang ru thung gtar// phye ma gur gum cu gang sug sprel ko lab le ka gser mi tig ta ka ra bdun dang hong len dug zhung dang dgu pa sbyar// mtsher pa'i tsha ba gser gyi me tog tsan dan li

wu/mnang g.yon tan gyi da/ 225shi'i thang / mtsher rtsa gtar zhing sug spel sa la li gur gum tigata )tres gser me kur bdun pa sbyar// mkhal tshad gur gum bragazhun sug sprel gyi thang btang byin long gtar shug tsher sdig srin su tshe nyi dga' ru tigatagur gum ka ra bdun pa tsan dan gla gur gum tis ta bragazhun bong dkar sug sprel lta ru mkhal ma zho shaka ra dgu pa sbyar// pho ba'i tsha ba byi tsher tig ta sbya ru ma nu'i thang btang la// snod ka gtar zhing brag zhun ma ru sug smi gur gum glasgang du dug zhung dom mkhris ka ra bdun pa sbyar//mkhris tshad tig ta'i gser theb sha da thang btang mkhris rtsa gtar// phye ma gser gyi me tog tigata du ga nyung gur gum skyer pa do mkhris bshaka ka ra bdun pa sbyar// spyi bcos gong la blos brtags mde khar gdags// de ltar bcos pas pos pa'i mtshan ma ni// rtsa bying khar thon phra ba sbom du song // drag pa dal la grims pa lhod pa dang // stongs pa mkhrang la pun pa ring du song // chu mdog gdang la dri chung ku ya srab// zug chogs snying rtsa seng la zas ro rnyed// dbugs bde nyin gnyid chung la nub gnyid che// bya ba'i las la lus sems 'jug par 'dod// de ltar bcos rjes zhu 'khyags sa mtshams ni// dbyar mtha' rgun bzhin rgyas rjes stongs pa 'gyur// de phyir ri thang mtshams kyi gso thabs bstan// mi rigs gnas dang nad khams rkyen dbang gis// rlung mkhris bad kun zhu 'khyags rnam pa gsum// rlung gi zhu 'khyags sdun nas bsu ba dang //mkhris pa'i zhu 'khyags phrang la bsgug pa dang // bad kun zhu 'khyags phyi rjes bcad pa gsum// ri thang mtshams kyi le 'ur shes par bya// tsha rjes ma log zas spyod mtha' ru gdon// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rgyas pa'i tsha ba bcos pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// / /

226le'u bcu bdun pa/ stongs pa'i tsha ba bcos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la// drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus tsha ba stongs pa'i rgyu rkyen ngo bo gang // stongs pa'i ming du ci phyir btags pa lags// dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bshad du gsol /de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa// stongs pa'i tsha ba'i rgyu ni rlung yin te// skyed byed rkyen gsum rang bzhin stongs pa dang // rkyen gyis stongs dang gnas kyis stongs pa'o// rang bzhin stongs pa rlung rims stongs 'khrugs gnyis// yul dus rang bzhin na so nad khams gnas/ rlung rkyen 'dom pas rims sam 'khrugs 'byung bas// dang po rang gnas tsha ba rlung 'bud bcas// rkyen gyis stongs pa rlung shas che ba yi// tsha ba bsil thang phye ma tsub mo dang / gtar bshal rngul dang zas skom yin la gtad// tshad gnya' chogs nas rlung skyes tshad gzhug 'bud/ gnas kyis stongs pa srog rtsar rlung gnas babs// gnas kyi dbang gis tsha ba rlung gis 'bud// rkyen des rlung tshad 'thab pa'i nad du 'gyur// rlung gis tsha ba bus kyin tshad rtags 'phel//rlung nyid grang bas tshad rtags 'gal zhe na// stongs pa'i tsha ba mgar gyis so mal 'dra// sbud pa grang yang me yi grogs su 'gyur// 'bud byed ma bcad tsha ba ches cher 'phel// de phyir stongs pa'i tsha ba zhes su brjod// dbye ba spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// spyi la tsha ba stongs dang rtsa stongs dang // rlung stongs zhes bya rnam pa gsum du bshad/ bye brag rims stongs khrag stongs mkhris pa stongs// bad kun chu ser glo snying stongs pa drug / de rtags dang po tsha ba stongs pa ni// gnya' chogs tshad gzhug rlung gas 'bud pa ste// chu mdog

cu khan ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 227dmar zhing gdang la sbru ba che// rtsa rgyud stong la rtsa stod rgyug pa dang ⑪dbugs thung rngam pa rgod la phyi tshad che// mig sprin dmar zhing lce ni dmar la tsub/ gzer 'pho skom dad che la mig rtsa grung / sna bug har la gnyid chung skabs su dngang // ba spu langs nas rlung gsang mnan na na// skabs su gtam la co 'phrul bag re 'ong // 'di ni ltar snang rlung gi tsha ba ste// bsil gtar ded na gshin rje'i lag tu gtod// rtags la the tshom bsur byug rus thang sad// lce rlon rngam pa bde la skom dad chung // gnyid che dbang po gsal sogs tshad rtags nub// mkhas pas de la som nyi mi bya'o// srog rtsar tsha ba babs pa'i rtsa stongs rtags// rtsa chu gong 'dra mig dmar gnam du blta//khus 'debs shes pa 'khrul la gos rdul sel// gnyid med shes pa yang mang 'bros tshul ston// skabs su 'dar la drung gi mi la 'dzin// so 'tham so 'cha' snang pa log par mthong // snying srog gnas su rlung khrag 'thab pa ste//rtags rnams tshang na mi 'tsho spang bar bshad// tshad gzhug rlung du log pa'i rlung stongs rtags// g.yal mang rlung gsang na zhing stong skyugs byed// gnyid med shes pa 'phyo la zhe sa mkhas// stong 'dod mig dpangs mtho la skra 'dab 'dar// gting gi dbang po ma 'khrul chal chol smra// lce stengs dmar tsub rtsa chu'i tsha ba med// ha cang thal na smyo bar 'gyur ba yod// bye brag rims stongs rkang lag rengs shing na// kha bla gnyid med skra 'dar gdong dbal skya// khrag stongs kha bla gnyid che dang ga 'gag / mkhris stongs gnyid med kha bla mig lce ser// bad stongs rngul che gnyid dus za zi mang // chu ser stongs pa mig gis za zi mthong // gnyid med dbang po 'khrul zhing spyo tshul ston// glo snying stongs pa gnyid dang zug gzer chung // lus rengs so 'tham blab 'tshal byed pa'o//stongs tshad bcos pa spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la bcos pa'i tshul dang gnyen po gnyis// bcos pa'i tshul la rnam pa gsum yin te// tsha stongs kha

228 zhu grwa nga rgyud ba /drag dpung pa gnya' tshul bcos// rtsa stongs phrang kha so pas bcad pa'i tshul//rlung stongs smyon pa mal 'jug tshul du'o// gnyen po sman dpyad zas spyod rnam pa bzhi// tsha ba stongs la gzhug chung rus pa lnga// chang bre phyed du sum gnyis bsdus khu ru// ga bur cu gang ka ra btab la btang // sman zhu rngul 'don rngul rjes rlung sna bslan// de nas thong tsher bal tshi nus khur btsir// big pan shing kun bur sbyar rlung dus btang // yang na big pan thal ba a ga ru/dza ti ru rta spos dkar bu ram sbyar// gongs dang tho rangs rus khus 'phul la btang // rlung dang tshad pa dus gcig 'joms par byed// tsan dan bsil gsum utpal sle tres dang / se 'bru pi pi ling dang big pan thal// bur dkar sbyar ba gung gnyis rus khus dbul// dpyad du gongs ka nyi ma nub pa dang // tshigs pa drug bdun an stong me yis bsreg / gzer sar 'ba' cha dus rnying 'ol kom mam// 'khar gong srin can chang bran bsros pas bdug /kha zas lug sha nye'u nang nub dang // ba lang ri dgas sha gsar nyin gung btang // skom du sle tres bur rnying bsdus pa'am// gsar 'jam 'o ma bskol grangs bur dkar btab// mkhas pa'i rig pas sad cing nyams sbyar bsten//spyod lam bser bu kha yed mi snyan gtam// drag shul ca co 'du 'dzi spangs byas la// yid 'ong grogs bsten dro ba'i gnas su bsdad// bcos ka mi len tsha ba cher 'phel na// zas kyis sna blang bsil gyis tsha ba bsad// rtsa stongs tsha ba bsil gtar mi gsod pas// dang por spyi gtsug drug pa mtheb snying bsro//a gar dza ti spos dkar utpal bzhi sbyor bur dkar rus khus dbul// ma thub sdud sgo bdun pa dkar nag mtshams// spra ba lngas bsreg phrang sdom 'bros sgo 'gegs// ga bur tsan dan dzā ti snying zho sha / cu gang na ga ge sar ka ra sbyar/gung gnyis btang rjes sbang skam rus rnying bdug / chang btsos lus kun dril la rngul mang gdon// de rjes gong bzhin rtsa phrang bsdam pa gces// zas dang

sa khan ngag yon tan gyi da/ 229spyod lam gong ma ji bzhin no/ rlung stongs tsha ba rlung du ldog 'gyur bas zas skom chang 'jam bur dkar lug sha dang / 'don gyi sbyor ba byas te nang nub btang / ma non lo sha mar rnying sha chen sprug / rlung gsang bsku mnye yos sam spa lus bdug / shing kun sga dang dzā ti kha ru tsha/ big pan sle tres bu ram rus khus dbul drug bdun dang po sdud sgo me yis mnan// mi dang mi lab mun khung bsnyal la bzhag / bye brag bcos pa rims stongs gtar ga spang / lug sha chang 'jam bsku mnye gnyid kyis bcos big pan sbe tres ka ra dus khus dbul/ khrag stongs chang dang nyin gnyid me btsa' spang / byug pa sha gsar 'jam thang btang bar bya mkhris pa stongs na sha chang mchog tu gnod/ bsku mnye 'jam thang btang zhing gnyid mi bsrung / bad kun stongs na mar dang gtar ga spang / chu bskol sha gsar btang zhing bsku mnye bya/ 'bras bu gsum gyi thang btang rngul mi phyi/ chu ser stongs na mar nag spang bar bya// sha chang rnying pa btang zhing gnyid mi bsrung / 'bras gsum mar sbyar lnga bdun me yis bsro/ glo snying stongs na bsil thang gtar ga spang /rus thang sha gsar bsku mnye chang 'jam btang / spyi la bye brag bcos pa'i mde khar gdags/ zhes gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las stongs pa'i tsha ba bcos pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o/ //

230le'u bco brgyad pa/ gab pa'i tsha ba bcos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la// drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus// tsha ba gab pa'i rgyu rkyen ngo bo gang / gab pa'i tsha ba'i ming du ci phyir btags// dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bshad du gsol// de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa// gab pa'i tsha ba'i rgyu ni grang rlung yin//de la rkyen gsum rang bzhin gab pa dang // gnas kyis gab dang rkyen gyis gab pa'o// yul dus rang bzhin na tshod nad khams rnams// grang rlung can la tsha ba phran bu byung // dang po rang gnas bad rlung 'og tu gab// de phyir rang bzhin ye nas gab ces bya// gnas kyis gab pa pho mkhal snying dang gsum// tsha ba zhugs kyang grang rlung gnas yin pas// tsha ba gting gab spyi rtags grang rlung ston// rkyen gyis gab pa ma smin bcos sngas dang // bad kun ri thang mtshams su bcud sngas pas// grang ba'i 'og tu tsha ba gab pa yin//gab pa'i tsha ba sbas pa'i me dang 'dra/ grang rlung gnyis kyis tsha ba'i mgo byibs pas// bad rlung thog tu tshad rtags bag la nyal// phyi grang nang na tsha bas gab ces bya// dbye ba spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// spyi la tsha stobs can dang grang stobs can// bye brag snying la tsha ba gab pa dang // pho bar gab dang mkhal mar gab pa'o// brtag thabs bzhi ste rtags la nad ngos bzung //rtsa chus mtshang 'bru gtar gyis phugs btsal te// zas dang sman gyis mgo phur bshu bar bya// rtags kyis ngos bzung spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la tsha stobs can dang grang stobs can// tsha stobs can de rtsa spangs dma' la grims// chu mdog dmar la ldog dka' shes pa lci// ngo snum gnyid log rjes la kha lce skam//kha kha dang ga mi bde skabs su rngul// lus byu mig dmar mgo lce sna khrag

zhu na ngag yon tan gyi da/ 231'dzag / nub gnyid chung la nyin gnyid che ba dang / me nyis phog na khams lci gyen la ngal/ bsil drags dros drags gnyis ka gnod par tshor// grang stobs can de rtsa rgyud bying la bul/ chu sngo ldog tu mi 'dod gdong pa skya//lus gyong dang ga mi bde sna chu 'dzag / shes pa bying la zas spyod dro na 'phrod//bye brag snying la gab na sen mo dkar/ srod la gnyid yer nyin mo sgrub ma snyeg / brang rgyab gdong pa srin thor rgyun mi 'chad// chang 'thungs rjes la dran pa mi gsal 'phyo// pho bar gab na tsha grang gnyis ka gnod// khyad par drod drags phur pa btsugs ltar na gsar sha mi 'phrod zas skom dro 'jam phan// mkhal mar gab na zags chu khrag tu 'byung // chang 'thungs 'gro 'dug rjes la rkang pa rtsi/ mkhal rtsa gar khrid sa nas gzer ram na// de ltar nad kyi rtags la the tshom na// rtsa dang chu yi sgo nas mtshang 'bru ste/ rtsa rgyud ma nges ji ltar 'dug kyang rung / gting na cung zad grims la mkhrang bar 'ong //chu mdog ma nges ji ltar 'dug gyur kyang // rlangs pa sangs bul ku ya ling gi 'ong // de ma rtogs na gtar gyis phugs 'tshol te/ snying la gab na snod ka gtar bas gsal// pho bar gab na ru thung gtar bas shes// mkhal mar gab na byin gzhug gtar bas gsal// lus spyir gab na gsum ga gtar bar bya'o// rnag mkhris lcags g.ya' chags na gab par nges/ nges shes ma skyes zas sman mgo phur bshu/ dang po kha zas drod bcud phyogs gcig bsten//thog mar grang ba 'i bas bder mngon zhing / bar du phan dang gnod pa gang yang med// mjug tu gting tshad slob nas gnod par tshor// de rjes sman gyis mgo phur bshu ba ni/ spyi ru gab na cu gang bde byed sbyar/ se 'bru bzhi pas bad rlung mgo phur bshu/ gur gum cu gang utpal tsha ba 'joms/ khyad par sna khrid nang yan phugs 'tshol gsum/ rang gnas sna khrid bzang po gsum po la ku nang yan kun la pi pi ling gis byed/ phugs 'tshol gtso bo

232 sto/grwa nga da bzhi/tsan dan gi waṃ dang / gur gum gsum la 'khor gyis kha sgyur bku snying la ru rta smos dkar a ga ru/ mkhal mar brag zhun gla rtsi a ru ra/ pho bar bong nga dkar po li ga dur/ brag zhun gser gyi me tog ka ra sbyar// thun skyungs chu tshan 'phul te brid la btang / dang por bad rlung la phog mi 'phrod 'dra bar du grang ba thal nas gnod pa med tha ma tsha bar slob nas phan par tshor/de dag gsum 'gyur sman gyi mang ngag yin// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyi la bcos pa'i tshul dang gnyen po gnyis/ bcos tshul dang po rkun chen phugs su gzhug / bar du dud khung rgya skar dbye ba dang / tha ma me lhag chu yis bsad tshul gsum/ gnyen po sman dpyad zas dang spyod lam bzhi/ sman gyis bcos pa thang dang phye ma gnyis// thang sbyor 'bras bu gsum dang ba le ka / utpal slo tres tig ta bong nga dkar/ ga dur ba sha ka yi bsdus grangs btang / tsha ba khong gsod phyir 'phul khrag ngan 'byed/ de rjes phye ma ga bur a ga du bsil gsum tig ta bong nga li ga dur/ ka ra dkar po'i rta la skyon la btang / gi waṃ tsan dan bsil gsum a ru ra gla rtsi bong nga dkar po ka ra sbyar/ gur gum cu gang tig ta a ru ra/ brag zhun utpal mtshe tshigs ba le ka / ka ra sbyar ba tsha ba rab 'bring tha snying mkhal pho ba gnas dang sbyar te bsten/ yang na gong gi nang yan bzhag pa yi/ sna khrid phugs 'tshol sbyar bas tsha ba 'phul/ kha zas 'bras dang ba lang sha gsar dang / chag tse mar gsar zho dkrugs mkhas pas sbyar/ spyod lam bsil gnas dal 'dug gnyid mi log / de yis tsha ba khong nas phyir 'phul te/ grog tshang bsheg 'dra phyi tshad skyes pa na dpyad du gang rgyas rtsa gtar bshal gyis sbyang / rus babs bdun rtsi lnga yi rlangs lums bya/ sha dang pags la bab pa rngul du dbyung / mkhal ma nang rtsar babs na rtsa nas sbyang spyode dag tsha ba rang sar dbyung ba ste// du ba 'khyims la rgya skar 'byed bzhin no/

ji ngag yon tan gyi da/ 233tha mar tshad gzhug ma thon ro ma las/ rkyen dang phrad na me stag spra ba 'dra/de phyir gi waṃ tsan dan bsil gsum dang / shing mngar rgyan 'brum dzā ti pi pi ling / se 'bru shing tsha ka ra sbyar ba yis/ pho ba'i me gso tsha ba'i lhag ma 'don bal tshi'i chu lums tig ta'i sman mar sbyar// tshad lhag med pa'i rtags thob kha zas glod/ de rjes bye brag gang babs gsang kha bsdam bye brag snying la tsha ba gab pa la/ ga bur tsan dan dkar dmar a ga ru bsil gsum dzā ti zho sha ge sar dang / ya ru ra dang ka ra sbyar la btang smotshad stobs chung na tsan dan dkar po dang / utpal nā ga ge sar a ru ra/dza ti skyu ru ka ra sbyar la btang // rtse chung snod ka rtse rtsa mthong rtsa gtar/ tsha ba choms nas nu dbrag drug bdun bsreg/ kha zas phyis na snying rlung 'jug pas na/ snga ru zas glod 'bras gsum sman mar sbyar/ pho bar gab na se 'bru lnga pa'am da lis bdun pas pho ba'i gzhi bzung la/ gur gum gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung / brag zhun dom mkhris ga dur ba le ka/ ka ra sbyar ba gung gnyis bskol grangs dbul/ yang na bde byed chen po dus bzhir bsten ru thung snod ka gtar la chu chung ba bsus la dur gyid mi ling kha tshar btab pa'i thang khrus bya/ kha zas khre'u rjes la pho gsang bsreg/ mkhal mar gab na dmar po bzhi thang btang / phye ma tsan dan gur gum sug thel dang / tig ta brag zhun shug tsher a ru ra/ yang na tsan dan gla rtsi a ru ra/ sug sprel li shi gur gum tig ta dang / 'jam 'bras ka ra sbyar btang byin long gtar/ gzer sar gla ril dri chur btsos pas bdug/ rjes la sbrang chang bong shas mkhal zungs gso/ rtsa ba lnga sbyar tshigs pa bcu bzhi bsreg/ de ltar gab pa'i tsha ba rnam pa gsum tsha rjes drod kyis ma bcos grang bar ldog/ ces gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gab pa'i tsha ba bcos pa'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o/ //

234le'u bcu dgu pa/ tsha ba rnyings pa bcos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la// drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus// rnyings pa'i tsha ba'i rgyu rkyen ngo bo gang // tsha ba rnyings pa'i ming du ci phyir btags// dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bshad du gsol//de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa// rnyings tshad rgyu ni lo zla lon pa ste//de rkyen rang bzhin rnyings dang rkyen gyis rnyings// sbyor ba dman pas rnyings pa rnam pa gsum// rang bzhin rnyings pa bad kun srug po dug / lo dang zla ba zungs dang ye nas 'dres// rkyen gyis rnyings pa tsha ba phran bu la// zas spyod ma bsdams phyogs med btang ba yis// rgyu chung ba yis rgyas par ma nus kyang //zas spyod rkyen gyis tsha ba zhir ma ster// ma smin mkhris shas che la bcos sngas pa'am// sbyor ba dman pa rims chung cham 'khrugs sam// 'grams chung gnyen pos ma non yun du lus/ de ltar rkyen des lo dang zla ba ru// nad de zungs su 'dres shing zhen pa yis// lcags la btsa 'am ras la sdum zhen nam//shing la sra rtsi btang 'dra gting 'don dka'// yun ring lon phyir tsha ba rnyings zhes bya// rnyings tshad dbye ba spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la rnyings tshad rlung ldan rlung med gnyis/ rlung med sbyor dman rkyen gyis rnyings las byung //rlung ldan ma smin rlung shas che ba la// bcos pa sngas pas nad la bya shor te//gcig bcos gcig skyes tsha ba ma gsod pas// rlung tshad 'thab cing yun du lus pa'am// rlung gi ri thang mtshams su bcud sngas pas// tshad gzhug lus pa nga dang sdongs las byung / bye brag dbye ba sha la rgyas pa dang // rtsa ru rgyu zhing dus la zhen pa 'o// rtags la spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// spyi yi

༄gyi khan nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 235rtags la rnyings tshad rlung med de// rtsa rgyud phra grims chu dmar rlangs yun ring / gdong snum kha 'byar rkan phugs skam la gyong mig rtsa dmar la tshag cing mchi ma 'dzag / sha mdog sngo la skam zhing dreg chung chags/ 'gul na glo snying 'phar la ro stod tsha yan lag bzhi dang ro smad lci la sbyid// snying la grang mo 'dod cing bsil grib snyeg / nyin gung srod la na zhing jul kha snyi/gnyid tshe drod bag rjes la ldang zhing na tsha ba gzhan pas dang ga bag tsam bde// rlung ldan de 'dra khyad par lus shed chung // skabs su phrum ser khyer zhing ba thi brtse// don med thul 'ong gzer 'gram rus tshigs na// bye brag sha la rgyas na khol bur skrangs// dmar sra btsir na na la rnag chu 'dzag / rtsar rgyu nag por gsal la rtsa thog spangs// nus zhen khol bur na zhing so mdangs nyams// sngo skams tshigs pa g.yo zhing gyid pa 'khums// bcos pa'i thabs bye dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la bcos pa'i tshul dang gnyen po'o/ bcos tshul dang po gyong po rlan gyis sbang // bar du thal tshan chu yis bran par bya//tha mar dug gi sdong po rtsad nas gdon// gnyen po sman dpyad zas dang spyod lam bzhi/ tsha rgan lus spyir gram zhing zhen pa de/ bsdu zhing nad khrag lus zungs dbye ba'i phyir// 'bras bu gsum dang tig ta sle tres gnyis// bskol grangs yun du bsrings pa'i brlan gyis sbang // rngul chad lus yang khams dang dang ga bde// gzer ba zhi'am 'dus na gang babs rtsa// mang du rlangs thon kha dbye nyung du 'don// de rjes tig ta hong len 'bras bu gsum// spang rtsi bskol grangs tsha ba rol du gsod/ phye ma ga bur nyi shu rtsa lnga pa// 'bras bu gsum mam seng ldeng thang gis dbul// de rjes a ru bar skyur lhum rtsa dang //dur byin ba chur sbangs la sbrang gis bskyur// lto stong btang bas nges med rgyun du 'khru// nad dang lus shed sbyar la dus babs bcad// tshad zhen rtsad nas 'byin pa'i dpyad mchog yin// de nas gi waṃ tsan dan bsil gsum
