236 sto/grwa nga rgyud bzhi/dang / utpal sle tres brag zhun ka ra sbyar/ rlung dang ldan la tig ta'i sman mar shes de ltar bcos kyang tsha ba slar 'phel na/ stongs tshad 'byung bas zas kyis rlung sna bslan des kyang ma zhi lus zungs tsha bar log / cis kyang ma chogs la chen 'da' bar 'gyur// des na tsha ba rnam gsum brtag pa gces/ kha zas ri dgas ba lang sha gsar dang / ba ra'i zho dar mar gsar chag tse btang / yos chang sro los bsings pa rig pas sbyar spyod lam me nyi lus ngag rtsol ba spang / bsil sar nyin gnyid mi log dal bar bsdad// de ltar bcos rjes tshad lhag med par bda'/ cung zad lus kyang nyung ma'i rma dang 'dra/ de phyir zas spyod zla ba'i bar du bsdam/ nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar zhing chu lcag bran sne dmar srad dkar stab nga 'bras gsum ci ba na ma 'ga' btang la// rngul dbyung tsha ba cung zad lus mi srid/ de nas zas dang spyod lam cha yis glod/ bye brag shar rgyas nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar// mchin tsas gtso byas rtsa kha mang du dbye rngul dbyung chu lcag rgyun sbyongs bsngags pa yin// rtsa ru rgyu na tsan dan dkar dpar gnyis ba la gsum ga dur dom mkhris mu thal pom ra dzamatshal hong lenabacu gcig sbyar// gang rgyas rtsa gtar skyed chung rtsa sbyongs bya// rus la zhin na shing sna tsan dan gnyis nga nga skyer pa de bad ru cag shad spyo zhur ru rta kur brgyad pa sbyar/rus rnying bdud rtsi lnga yi rlangs lums bya/ mkhal rtsa gtar zhing rgyun sbyongs shis pa yin// zhes gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las tsha ba rnyings pa bcos pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o/ //

237le'u nyi shu pa/ tsha ba snyogs pa bcos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la// drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus tsha ba rnyogs pa'i rgyu rkyen ngo bo gang / rnyogs pa'i tsha ba ming du ci phyir btags// dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bshad du gsol// de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa tsha ba rnyogs pa'i rgyu ni chu ser yin//rkyen ni rang bzhin rtogs dang rkyen gyis rnyogs/ rang bzhin chu ser shas che'i tsha ba rnams/ bcos rjes nad gzhi'i thog tu lhung ba yin/ rkyen gyis rnyogs pa bcos sngas kha thal gnyis bcos sngas ma smin tsha ba'i rigs gang yang kusman dpyad zas spyod gnyen po bsten sngas pas/ bad gan skyes te pho ba'i me drod shor/ rlung nad skyes pas tsha ba rtsa mig byer/ rlung gis khrag g.yos chu ser skyed pa yin/ kha thal ba ni bad kun ri thang mtshams// bsil drags pho ba'i me shi grang chur 'gyur// ngo bo rlung khrag chu ser 'dus pa'i nad// chu mig rnyogs sam bye chab g.yos pa bzhin/ bcos nyes rnyogs phyir rnyogs tshad ming du btags/ 'jug sgo drug zhugs lus kun khyab par byed de la dbye ba spyi dang khye brag gnyis// spyi la tsha bas rnyogs dang grang rnyogs gnyis rgyu rkyen dag gis nad stobs che chung yin// bye brag pags la gram dang sha la rgyas// rtsa ru 'grims dang rus la zhen pa dang / don la babs dang snod du lhung ba drug / rtags la spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// spyi rtags tsha rnyogs chu dmar rgya bshal 'dra/ rtsa rgyud phra la mgyogs shing gting na rgyug / gdong pa ser sbos lce snyil sen skrag 'chor/ 'gul na rngam pa rgod la glo snying 'phar/ shed chung rngul kha snyi la kha lce skam/ gnyid che glo mang mig snyibs rkang bol g.yo

238 sto/grwa nga rgyud bzhi/lus po brtse zhing ro stod gzer phran 'ong // nad stobs che na don la rnag chu gsog / grang rnyogs rtsa rgyud phra zhing stong la mgyogs// chu mdog dmar ser rnyog cing gdong pa sbo// brang dang bsus pa ngar gdong rkang bol g.yo// lce dang snyil skya lus rngul rngam pa rgod// pho ba rdzing la kha zas 'ju stobs chung //nad stobs che na tsha chur 'gyur ba yin// bye brag pags gram skra dang ba sru 'byi//za phug chu gong me dbal shu thor yong // sha rgyas khol bur na zhing 'bar 'bur skrangs// dmar srab brtol na rnag khrag chu ser 'dzag / rtsar 'grims rtsa rgyas nag por gsal ba dang // rtsa 'khyug rtsa steng spangs shing yan lag sbrid//rus zhen sha skam sngo la khol bur na// gdong skrangs tshigs kha g.yo zhing sgyid pa 'khums// so dang sen mo'i skrag 'tshar skya glog 'gro// gror babs dbugs thung skad 'dzir brang rgyab gzer// mig mchu bol spangs dbugs rgod rnag khrag lu// snying babs 'thibs myos dran nyams grang mo 'dod// mchin babs mig ser lus lci dang ga 'gag / lce bkra snyil dkar lus spyi ser por 'gro//mcher babs g.yon gzer mchu spangs sbrid pa mang // mkhal babs rked pa na mang ro smad lci// snod du lhung na dang ga 'gags pa dang // 'khru skyug dri ma 'gag gam 'tshing zhing 'byung // gso ba'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis//spyi la bcos pa'i tshul dang gnyen po gnyis// bcos tshul dang po rlan chen bye ma skam// bar du chu bo ska ru drang ba dang // tha ma dgra bo gnyen du bzlums pas bcos// gnyen po sman dpyad zas dang spyod lam bzhi// dang po tsha rnyogs chu ser skem pa'i sman// sdud thang gsum gyis byer ba bsdus byas nas//nyi shu rtsa lnga rus thang 'phul btang bas// tsha ba 'dus shing rlung kha snyoms par byed// de nas tsan dan dkar dmar 'bras bu gsum// brag zhun spos dkar so ma ra dza dang // bsil gsum pi pi ling dang ka ra sbyar// seng ldeng khu bas 'phul bas chu ser skem// de rjes gang rgyas rtsa kha mang du dbye// 'bras

༄༅khanang ga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 239bu gsum gyi rgyun sbyongs dag par sbyang / grang rnyogs dang po se 'bru lnga pa 'am/cu gang bde byed chung ngus pho ba bzung // de rjes thang gis bsdus la rgyun sbyongs bya// bzang drug chu ser sman gsum 'bras bu gsum/ sha ru dur thod 'gron bu tshwa gsum thal se 'bru lnga dang ltag spyod chu ser skem// nad stobs che na dpu chu'i sbyongs skems bya/ tha mar chu ser tshad lhag zungs su sgyur/ de yi sbyor ba sbrang chang rkyang khug gam// gze ma sro lo 'bras bu gsum gyi chang ⑪chu ser rlung mkhris bad kun gzhi dang bstun/ 'ba' sam sman mar sbrang dang sbyar la bsten de yis chu ser khrag ngan zungs khrag tu// dngul la gser 'gyur rtsi bzhin sgyur bar byed/ zas dang spyod lam rnyings tshad ji bzhin no/bye brag sha pags gnyis la babs pa la mchin mcher rtsa gtar 'bras bu'i rgyun sbyongs bya/ chu lcag deg cing nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar/ ba sru'i kyi khrus rdul 'don mchog tu bsngags// tsan dan chu ser sman gnyis ba chu byug / rtsar babs phyi rtsa gtar la nang rtsa sbyang / tsan dan dkar dpar ga dur dom mkhris so par dza cu gang li utpal mtshal hong len gar bcu pas rtsa yi tsha ba skem/ nus zhen mi rus bdud rtsi'i rlangs lums bya rgyun sbyongs skyi khrus mkhal rtsa gtar ba dang //shing sna brgyad pas nus pa'i tshad pa skem// glor babs tsan dan gi waṃ a ga ru/cu gang gur gum shing mngar rgun 'brum dang // sro lo spang rgyan 'bu sug ka ra sbyar// rnag mang star bu pañtsa sa gyen du drangs// rjes la nyi shu rtsa lngas rnag tshad skem// tsha ba choms nas dmar gsum bsil gsum 'dam bu shing mngar ka ra pang ragasar gyi lde gu sbyar// snying babs a ga ru dang tsan dan dkar// dzā ti cu gang gur gum li shi dang // zho sha skyu ru ra dang ka ra sbyar de rjes gtar la zho sha'i tsan dan gnyis ma ru ra gur gu spos dkar kar sman mar sbyar dkar nag mtshams dang drug pas nad rjes bcad// mchin babs brag zhun gur gum bdun pa sbyar// ru thung snod ka gtar zhing 'jam khrus bya/ mcher babs gur gum se

240 ga /grwa nga da bzhi/'bru ltag pa sprad rjes la pho gsang tshigs pa bcu gcig bsreg / mkhal babs gur gum tig ta ru 'jam 'bras gla gag tsher tsan dan zhar bdun dang brag zhun tig ta mi spos dkar po ma ra gur gum ga tsher spang ker brgyad/ rjes la gtar la rtsa nag bcu bzhi bsreg / sbrang chang rkyang khug bshul shas mkhal zungs gso/ snod lhung bshal bya cu gang bde byed sbyar tsha ba che na gur gum gser me rtog / dom mkhris tig ta brag zhun a ru ra/ glas dang ka ra sbyar bas snod tshad sel/ zhes gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las tsha ba rnyogs pa bcos pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o //

241le'u nyer gcig pa/ 'grams spyi tsha ba bcos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus 'grams kyi tsha ba'i rgyu rkyen ngo bo gang / 'grams kyi tsha ba'i ming du ci'i phyir btags dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bshad du gsol de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa 'grams tshad rgyu ni nad dang lus zungs la/ de rkyen lus kyi bya ba drag shul gyis bang mchongs rtsal dang pha yong 'degs pa dang / mi theg khur dang gzhu sran bkang ba dang / sa sran bskos dang g.yang kung rta yis brdabs/ thibs 'og tshud dang rdo dbyug brdungs pa yis/ lus zungs 'grams pas khrag 'khrugs mkhris tshad bslang kude phyir 'grams kyi tsha ba zhes su brjod/ dbye ba nang gi don snod 'grams pa dang / phyi yi yul bzhi 'grams pa rnam pa gnyis dang po don lnga snod drug 'grams pa dang / yul ni sha rus rtsa dang chu rgyus bzhi/ 'grams pa'i rtags la spyi dang gye brag gnyis/ spyir rtags gang 'grams na zhing gzer zug ldang kurtsa ni phra la grims te chu dmar dugs/ gdong snum jam 'degs lus kyi bya ba dka'/ bye brag snying 'grams kha skugs 'gul na 'bog / dran pa mi gsal gnyid log sad tshe dngang / nu 'jing sogs dbrag gzer la mig rtsa har/srog rtsar 'grams na mig har khu yis 'debs dran pa mi gsal zug che sa la 'brad/ glo 'grams ro rgyab zhi zhing nyal mi shes// sna 'bud dbugs mi bde la gre ba shu glo lu mi shes thal gong mnan snyam byed/ brang dang rgyab tu gzer la dgye dgu dka' lud pa 'gogs dka' khrag dang rnag tu lu/mchin 'grams rtsib sgang mchin snar gzer zhing na/ lud pa khrag tu lu zhing

242 zhu/grwa nga da bzhi/sna khrag 'dzag / glo snying mi bde stod rgyangs dbugs kyis 'deg / mig sprin dmar smo mi gsal pho ba sgang / mchin grir 'grams na sha sngo ro stod rgyangs//glo sor 'gul na snying rdung 'gro mi nus/ lus po gyong la nyung bsregs gcus pa 'dra/ mig dmar mchin dri 'khor la rtse chung rgyangs// mcher 'grams pho ston sbo zhing g.yon ngos gzer/ gdong pa dro bo sbo 'khrog skabs su 'khru g.yon ngos rtsib sgang rtsib snar gzer zhing 'a zig / mkhal 'grams tshang ra mi theg dgye dgu dka'/ mkhal khung sne sa dbyi mig brla sgang zug / 'bras bu skrangs shing dri chu khrag tu 'dzag / pho bar 'grams na sgrog pa drag po 'ong |pho stod sbo 'khrug zas skom ci zos skyug / glang thabs pho ba bsgangs nas nyal mi shes// long 'grams long phugs gzer sgang sbo 'khrog mang // glo 'deg ro stod gang zhing grang snyam byed// dbugs ngan rjes la phyi sa mi thub 'chor// rgyu mar 'grams na tsha 'brab 'khril snyam byed sne sar lhung snyam chu sdom rgyu glang ldang / mkhris 'grams mig ser sha sngo mgo bo zhi mchin pa skrangs snyam mkhal ma mchin dri na ro stod gang snyam chu dmar glang thabs 'ong // sgang par 'grams na rgyu 'bas mkhal khung na// chu kha snyi zhing sne sa tsha 'brab byed bsam ser 'grams na dbyi mig brla sul na sta sha chad snyam byed cing langs mi shes/ rkang pa bshal sbrid tshang ra 'brel mtshams na/ skabs su dri chu sdom pa snyam du byed// phyi yi sha 'grams nya dang sha gzhan gnyis// nya 'grams nya sna skrangs shing bya ba nyams// sha gzhan rdungs snyam byed cing na dmar skrangs rus la tshigs rkang mgo srubs rtsib ma bzhi/ tshigs 'grams 'gul dka' zug che gong 'og skrangs// rkang 'grams 'gul dka' gting nas lhang lhang byed// srubs 'grams dran pa mi gsal skyug cing 'khyom/rtsib mar 'grams na zug che mnan mi bzod// rtsa la mgo dang byang khog yan lag gsum mgo yi rtsa 'grams rtsa rgyud khrid cing na// rtsa stong spangs shing rtsa

lta na ngag yon tan gyi da/ 243'brum 'byung ba yin// byang khog rtsa 'grams glo lu gang 'grams gzer// tsha ba skye zhing spangs rjes rnag tu 'gyur// yan lag rtsa 'grams rtsa yi rgyud kun skrangs// dmar zhing tsha 'khyug brkyang bskum bya ba dka' chu rgyus 'grams pa dgye dgu mi shes skrangs// chu ba rgyab yin rgyus pa mdun na gnas// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis sbyi la bcos thabs sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi// dang po thang sbyor hong len ba sha ka / spang rtsi kyi lce rnam par btsod dang drug / tsha ba'i stobs sbyar gnyis bzhi drug bsdebs la// bsdus grangs khu bas 'grams tshad 'joms par byed// yang na skyer pa mtshe zlum seng ldeng btsod// bsdus grangs 'grams tshad kun la bdud rtsi 'dra// phye ma tsha ba rab 'bring bye brag gis// ga bur tsan dan gur gum gtso bo la// dom mkhris ga dur rnam par a ru ra// a byag stab seng ka ra drug 'gyur sbyar// rjes la 'bras bu gsum dang dmar po gsum// seng lding rtsa ba lnga la sogs pa yi /gang 'phrod sman mar sbyar bas phyi rjes bcad// dpyad du gtar bshal dugs lums mas btang dang // chu lcag phyi nang 'grams la mkhas pas sbyar// kha zas spyod lam bsil zhing dal bar bya// rtas brdabs g.yang du lhung dang thibs 'og tshud// byang khog 'grams nas tsha ba rgyas pa la// ga bur bdun dang dgu pa sbyar bar bya// rngul dbyung gang rgyas rtsa gtar bshal gyis sbyang //bye brag bcos pa snying 'grams gtso bo bzhi// a gar dgu dang dza ti cur ni sbyar// snying rtsa kun gtar dben gnas mi bsgul bsnyal// bsil bsten chang spang rjes la drug bdun bsreg / srog rtsa 'grams pa'i bcos thabs snying dang 'dra// khyad par spyi gtsug rkang mthil gtar la bsreg / glo 'grams ga dur gsum pa'i thang btang la ga bur gsum dgu cu gang lnga pa sbyar// tsha ba'i shugs sbyar gtar gyis zug gzer bcag / rnag tu lu na srin bya'i klad pa btang // ba ra'i 'o ma dron mo lto stong blun// tsha ba bri nas sro lo'i bsings

244 sa〉/grwa nga dba'i/chang dang // cu gang lte gu sbyar la tshad ro bcag / rjes la bzhi lnga brang skas che chung bsreg / mchin 'grams thog mar ga bur dgu pa sbyar// rjes la gur sum g.yu rnying ting sag kyung lta ra mar sbyar bskol rlangs yal khong du btang //rtse chung ru thung mkhris rtsa rim pas gtar// de rjes dgu pa mchin pa'i zur gsang bsreg / mchin dri de bzhin rjes la rtsa ltos sbyangs// bzhi bzhi'i steng dang brgyad pa kha gsum bsreg / 'bras bu'i sman mar sbrang rtsi bur ldan bsten// mcher 'grams bzang drug shing tsha mon cha ra// ga dur dong ga pi pi ling dang ni/ ka ra sum gyur chu bskol 'phul la btang / srin lag rgyab rtsa rta 'thur gnyis la gtar// de nas rgyam tsha tsha la lce myang tsha ka ra mar sbyar pho mcher gsang la bsreg / mkhal 'grams dang po tsan dan gur gum sug sprel gla 'jam 'bras du rtam ru bdun pa sbyar// bar du zho sha'i phye ma byin long gtar tha ma shug skyer pa spa 'brug ma lcam pab sru ba ra'i par la sdig srin gur gum bu ram pa'i mar sbyar dugs lums bya// rjes la zas skom drod bsten mkhal gsang bsreg /pho bar 'grams na spyang tsher chig skyugs bya// mcher 'grams 'ol se so cha 'o sbyar btang // rgyam tsha tsha la la phug sa bon dang / cong zhi tsha gsum sbrang la ril bu sbyar/ ru thung snod ka gung srin bar rtsa gtar/ rjes la pho gsang mdun rgyab rim pas bsro// long 'grams shing kun kha ru tsha dang ni/ pi pi ling gi bskol grangs thang du btang / yang na la phug sa bon kha ru tsha/ shing tsha bu ram chang ngam phye ma shing kun cur ni sbyar/ long rtsa gtar zhing gur gum ma ru dgyi mong bsnus khur dur byin btab pa'i bshal gyis sbyang // skabs su 'dren bya rjes la long gsang bsreg / rgyu mar 'grams na gur gum pi ling dur gyid mar bur ma sbyar ba'i bshal gyis sbyang / long rtsa rgyu ma'i rtsa gtar snam snyi nga tsha par gyi ring bu bya/tsha dugs bya zhing rjes la bcu bdun bsro/ mkhris 'grams tig ta'i thang btang ga dur bzang drug ga ra mi mi dom pal gyi mkhris phye sbyar// mkhris rtsa kun gtar

stong na nga g.yon tan gyi da 245pa to la yis sbyang / rjes la tshigs pa bcu pa bsreg par bya/ sgang par 'grams na mkhal ma'i bcos dang 'dra// skabs su chu sman bsten zhing bco brgyad bsreg / dkur 'grams mkhal ma'i bcos 'dra byin skyog gtar/bkru 'jam btang zhing bcu gsum dpyi steng bsreg / de nas phyi yul 'grams pa bcos pa ni// nya 'grams nya sna a sa 'ba' chas bdug / gang nye'i rtsa gtar rnag shor spyi dang 'dra sha 'grams lums gtar de bzhin deb tu btsal// tshigs 'grams drod bcas spangs dmar chu lcag brdeg / mtshan mo bye rlon ba ci'i lums su gzhug / skabs su phying ba chur bcug tshigs kha bsdam// gang rgyas rtsa gtar rjes la phying deb btang // drod med na tsha chung zhing skrangs pa gsob phying pa snam ldan glan la chu rdos bdug / a sa 'ba' dugs rjes la deb tu btsal dang po dal la phyi dus bcags pa phan/ rkang 'grams skya sbyor byas la phying deb bcing / srubs 'grams rgya 'chings tshan rdo me btsa' dang // rtsib ma sgrog rus chag 'grams snum nan bya/ chag tshabs che na bsregs rjes chas su gzhug / mgo bo'i rtsa 'grams spang rtsi ba sha ka / stab seng skyu ru'i thang rjes gar 'grams gtar 'bru sna bdud rtsi lnga yis rgya cher bdug / sdud sgo rtsa sgo gar 'khyug me yis mnan/ byang khog rtsa 'grams ga dur ba sha ka / tig ta skyu ru'i thang rjes gong bzhin gtar/ gang gzer dugs dang bdud rtsi'i rlangs lums bya/ yan lag rtsa 'grams dugs dang me yis mnan/ stab seng skyu ru hong len ba sha ka / kyi rtse dkar po'i thang btang gang nye gtar mdor bsdus khrag rtsa gtar la 'phar rtsa bsreg / hong len tig ta kyi lce zho sbyar mnan chu rgyus 'grams na sug pa nye shing pa/ mkhan pa bul tog phabs sbyar chu 'jam bsro// bzod tshad chur sbang bdud rtsi'i rlangs lums bya/ chang dang lo mar bsku mnye me nyis bsro gla sgang thal ba dom mkhris rdo rgyus dang // mthing shun bag phye sbang gar rgyus pa'i sha / tsha khu

246 zhu/grwa nga dba'i/sbyar byugs phying deb btang la bcos/ mdog dmar skrangs dang drod che gang nye gtar// sbos na chu sgo dbye zhing jab ras drang // cog ge mi bzhag dal bus brkyang bskum bslab// ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las 'grams kyi tsha ba bcos pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gcig pa'o// / /

247le'u nyer gnyis pa/ 'khrugs tsha ba bcos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus 'khrugs zhes bya ba'i rgyu rkyen ngo bo gang / tsha ba 'khrugs pa'i ming du ci phyir btags/ dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bshad du gsol/de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa/ rgyu ni mkhris pa tsha ba'i rang bzhin la// de rkyen dus gdon zas spyod rnam bzhi yis nyes pa 'khrugs pas khrag tshad bskyed byas nas// lus zungs tsha bas bsre ka phyir 'khrugs zhes bya/dbye ba rgyas 'khrugs stongs 'khrugs 'jam 'khrugs gsum// rgyas 'khrugs yul dus rang bzhin na so dang / nad khams khrag mkhris can gyi mi rnams la/zas skom sha mar chang sogs bcud drags dang / spyod lam lus ngag drag shul zhe snang gis mkhris 'tshogs tsha ba khrag la rgyas pa yin// stongs 'khrugs yul dus rang bzhin na so dang smo nad khams la sogs rlung shas che ba'i// spyod lam mya ngan sems las gnyid chag dang / nyal po dka' thub shed med lto stong dus// lus ngag drag shul rkyen gyis rlung khrag 'khrugs/mkhris tshad skyes pa rlung gis bus pa'o/ 'jam 'khrugs yul dus rang bzhin na so dang // nad khams bad kun can la 'khrugs byung ba// khrag mkhris tsha ba bad kun mgo mnan pa'o// de la dang po rgyas 'khrugs dbye ba ni// nad rigs babs sgo lud pas dbye ba gsum// nad rigs tsha 'khrugs tsha 'grams tsha rims gsum/ khrag mkhris 'khrugs tshan rkyang pa tsha 'khrugs yin/ dbye ba tsha rgyas tsha lhags dug thabs gsum// 'khrugs tshad 'grams la brten pa tsha 'grams yin// de la dbye ba tsha rdol tsha thugs gnyis// 'khrugs tshad rims

248 sa /grwa nga da bzhi/dang sdongs pa tsha rims yin// de la gnyan dang 'du ba'i tsha rims gnyis/de ltar 'khrugs rims rnam pa bdun du 'gyur/ babs sgo glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma dang / mkhris pa rtsa dang rlung la babs pa brgyad/ lud pa'i kha dog de bzhin shes par bya de rtags spyi dang bye brag skag dus gsum/ spyi rtags rtsa rgyud sbom drag mkhrang la mgyogs chu mdog dmar ser dri dugs rlangs pa che/ phrum ser yun thung gzer drag dgye dgu dka'/ dbugs rgod lud pa dmar ser dud khur 'ong / bye brag tsha rgyas nad stobs rgyas pa la don la babs na shin tu gzer ba drag / snod du babs na mig chu lud pa ser/sman gtar mi len pho mchin rdzi mi bzod// tsha skugs lud pa mi thon thengs por lu/ khogs na dmar ser dud khu sran tsam 'byung / dug thabs na ma thog nas bcar la thebs lud pa dud khu nyung bsregs khu ba 'dra glo mchin tsha bas thug cing 'dul bar byed/ tsha rdol lud pa dmar ser khrag tu 'byung / rtsa kha rdol nas mang du skyug na 'chi tsha thugs dang po glo ba khrag gis rgyas// lud pa gyen du ma rdol don la thugs mjug tu phal cher rnag tu 'gyur ba mang // de rtags mgo na lus zhi dang ga 'gag / rnag khrag lu zhing stod rgyangs gsang sa gzer/ 'du ba'i tsha rims phrum ser khyer ba dang spyotshigs gzhi mgo na za zi rims dang 'dra/ gzer dang lud pa glo tshar 'byung ba yin/ gnyan tshad rims ni gzer thung zhes bya ste/ gzer 'pho lud pa 'gyur ldog mang ba la/ lce mchu skya ser lus dang shes pa yang / gnyid chung ba spu ldog cing yams thabs 'byung / snying la babs na mig dpar nu 'jing gzer/ lce skam dran pa mi gsal zab chol smra glo la babs na lud pa rnag khrag lu dpung mig sgrog rus sogs dbrag brang mdo na// mchin babs g.yas kyi rtsib logs mchin stengs na shin chung langs 'dod shul sha snyi ba yin// mcher babs 'bur tshugs blta zhing sbrid pa mang / rtsib thung g.yon

ga khan ngag yon tan gyi da/ 249gzer lus la 'brum chung 'ong / mkhal babs mkhal sked na zhing dgye dgu dka' rtsa 'khrugs lus sbrid mig dmar smra ba 'tsher// kha skam chu 'dod lce thung gre ba tsha/ mkhris babs kha kha lus ser skra 'dab rngul/ rlung 'khrugs kha skam 'phyo 'dar g.ya' skyigs 'byung / lud rigs skya gsob dmar po ser sprug dang / sprug nag sre 'o dmar thang ser la gdang / sngon po sbya ba can dang brgyad du brtag/ zhag skag glo tsha dug thabs bdun yin te/ gzhan rnams dgu yin bcu gcig 'das 'tsho mang / glo bu snying mchin babs pa srog la rgol/ mcher mkhal nyen che glo ma mkhris babs 'tsho mod nas lus kyi stobs shor gzi mdangs nyams/ lud pa dud khu gzer la bcos skyed med/ dbugs zung lud pa gsog cing 'dre kha rgod nad ldog mang na gnad du babs pa yin/ zhag skag 'das kyang 'tsho ba ga la srid/ nad la ldog chung dbugs dal lud pa khogs/ sman gtar gzer lud tsha ba bcos skyed che 'tsho bar nges kyi le lo spongs la 'chos de nas stong 'khrugs tsha stongs grang stongs gnyis/ sbyi rtags g.yal dang 'dar dang gzer ba 'pho snying ga shes pa mi bde brang rgyab na/ dang ga mi bde brtse zhing phrum ser khyer khams ngan mgo 'khyom rus tshigs na ba dang / lud pa skya gsob theng po khogs pa dka'/ khyad par rtsa stongs rtsa ni stong la mgyogs chu dmar tha ba che la rlangs pa 'tshub/ mig dmar lce skam lus kyi phyi drod che/ skom dad che la za zi chal chol 'ong / grang stongs chu mdog sngo la sbya ba gsog / rtsa ni stong la dal zhing lus shed chung / gnyid med snying 'dar shus 'debs stong phyugs byed/ 'jam 'khrugs lud pa mig gtsang gzer phran 'byung // rtsa dang chu yi tsha ba bags kyis skye/ mdor na 'khrugs phran nad stobs chung bar brjod/bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyi la bcos pa'i tshul dang gnyen po gnyis bcos tshul tsha 'khrugs mkhris thog babs pa'i phyir/ zhi

250 sa /grwa nga da ba /sbyang mkhris pa'i gnyen pos bcos pa gces// tsha 'grams don la khrag tshad rgyas pa'i phyir// tsha rlangs bsad cing rtsa nas drang ba gces// tsha rims mkhris tshad rngul la babs pa'i phyir/ tsha ba rol bsad ba spur dbyung ba gces// gnyan gzer chu ser dri mar bcas pa'i phyir/ gnyen pos bsad cing rjes la sbyang ba gces// stong 'khrugs khrag mkhris rlung gis 'bud pa'i phyir// rlung brtul mkhris tshad bsad la tshad ro gdon// 'jam 'khrugs tshad 'go bad kun mnan pa'i phyir/ 'jam la 'i bas bcos pa rngul du dbyung //gnyen po sman dpyad zas dang spyod lam bzhi/ rgyas 'khrugs tsha ba rgyas phyir smin mi dgos// tig ta sle tres spyo ru ba sha ka / skol grangs thang gis khrag dbye mkhris tshad bsad// rtse chung drug mgo snod ka gang rgyas rtsa mod nas nyin zhag btud gtar bungs cher dbyung / phye ma ga bur rgyal blon lnga bdun dgu/ tsha ba'i stobs sbyar dungs bskyed bskud la btang // skabs su rngul dbyung gzer steng bsil bas bdug / tsha ba'i stobs rgyas skyed chung mchin mkhris babs// sbyong byed rgyal blon ra nu cum khron bu stong len gser mi dri chur sbyar bas sbyang / kha sgyur tsha ba stobs rgyas lag bur gi bcos thugs la tsha la gur gu dang // tsha 'khrugs mchin mkhris gnyis la babs pa na bragazhun du ga zhung dang // dud khu ma 'gyur ga bur se rul tsha lhags phyir ma 'drongs ra bu du rta tshal/tsha rdol ma chod na tshal rgya skyegs ba sha da tsha rims ma chun pa la tig ta bong nga ga dur 'i//gar dgos stong du rgyal blon chibs kha bsku ri/ dri che kha dog ser na nad thon rtags// lcag gis brabs la tsha ba dag par sbyang / 'khrus rjes mi bde shes pa zi ba 'am dag par 'byongs na bshal rjes bsil gyis bcad// zungs bzang nad stobs che na sbyang ba bskyar// sman gtar sbyongs kyis gzer byer bcos jugs na bur chang byer bsdu 'dregs pa bskog la bsad// kha zas chag tse ba ra'i zho dar dang // khur mang skyabs tshod chu grog bsten par bya

sa man ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 251lan tsha sha chang la sogs drod bcud bsdam/ spyod lam me dang nyi ma drag shul spang // bser bu sgrub ma bsil sar dal bar bsdad// de ltar bcos rjes tshad stobs cung zad chag / rtsa dal lud pa 'gyur la gzer ba chogs/ de nas tsan dan gi waṃ bsil gsum dang // tig ta ba sha ka dang ka ra sbyar/ glo mang shing mngar 'gogs dka' star bu bsnan// gzer med lud pa gtsang la dang ga bde// lus dang shes pa yang la snying rtsa seng // ri thang mtshams su sleb pas gsar bcud glod// bye brag rigs dang babs sgo lud pa sbyar tsha rgyas don babs sman gtar bskud la bcos// snod du babs na bshal las lhag pa med/ tsha skugs ltar bu nā ga ge sar dang // ru rta tsha la dud pa bya bal ma// ka ra sbyar la thun skyungs grangs mang btang // gzer steng mtshan dkar 'tshar bong dro 'jam bdug / des ma thon na man ngag snar bu ru rta tshal rgyal blonabashal gyis sbyang smo dag thabs rgyal blon gsum sbyar rtse chung bsnol// nad dang sman dpyad srog la thob sha bya// skyed med ga bur rul khu bas khong sbyangs ga bur gi tsan dan ba ru gur gum mi mkhris mtshal lha len ka rag dur zang gis dbul brgyad pa sbyar// ga dur se rul khu ba skom du bsten// dud khu rnag tu 'gyur na thub pa yin tsha rdol gur gum dom mkhris sran ma'i pus// gar sbyar tshos khus 'phul la chu lcag bran// khrag ma chod na man ngag tsha la chos ba sha ba'i bshal gyis sbyang // khrag thag skyu ru ba sha ka thang dang // ga bur tsan dan gnyis cu gang gur gum dom mkhris ti tabashamatshal ka ra dgu sbyar yang yang bsud la btang // tsha 'grams 'di gnyis gtso bo gtar yin pas// nad dang dpyad gnyis khrag la thob sha bya// rnag rmugs bse ru tsan dan gnyis bsal gnyis gdur shing mngar dom mkhris karabargyad pas khrag tshad bsad/ star bu pañtsa sa glo rnag rgyan du drang // rjes la dmar po gsum gyis glo ba gso// 'du ba'i tsha rims dang po thang gis dbye//rin chen zhags pa'i phye mas rol du bsad/ yang na gtso bo brgyad pa shis pa

252 ༄7 grwa nga dba'i/geyin// skabs su rngul dbyung gzer sbyar ci rigs gtar// tsha ba choms dka' man ngag tigatabong nga ga dur bshal gyis sbyang // gzer thung thog mar sle tres a ru ra// btson kyi thang gis smin sdud 'byed par byed// de nas gzer sman gnyen po thar nu rtsar dug na rtog ya byag sha chen lnga sbyor gyi// dri chu sbyar te thun skyungs yang yang btang 5 yang na gzer sman chen mo bzang drug gla gu gul ming can sha chen dug pus shud gdakar po ra nu chu rtsa re cag dri chur sbyar bshis pa yin sbyangs rjes gi waṃ tsan dan cu gang dang // gur gum dom mkhris gla rtsi bong nga dkar/btsod khus 'phul btang gzer stengs spru tshan bdug / gnyan ma sod par ga bur gtar ga spang spyo dkar dang mngar bag mi btang dug dang mtshungs/sod rtags gzer dang lud pa so zin nas/ gtar dang ga bur gzer dang tshad stobs sbyar// babs sa gnas dang sbyar te bcos pa ni// bsil gsum tsan dan dkar po kun la gces/ dzā ti ge sar gsum ya ga ru khris gas gye skurabadun pa sdebs pas snying 'khrugs sel// shing mngar ya ru sgron 'brum ba spu bzhi pas glo yi 'khrugs tshad sel// utpal tig ta ba sha dug nyung pa rto la lnga pa sdebs pas mchin 'khrugs sel/ a ru tig ta ba sha par pa tabazhi sdebs pho mcher 'khrugs tshad sel brag zhun ba sdig srin ma ru skyir shun lnga pa sdebs bas mkhal tshad sel dom mkhris gdur ma gsum pa sdebs pas rtsa 'khrugs sel/ tig ta ga ra me drug nyang sum cu ga bzhi pas mkhris pa'i 'khrugs tshad sel// dzā ti sug la sa pu shel nga spyi ling drug pas rlung 'khrugs tsha ba sil kun la ka ra dkar po'i rta la skyon gang la babs pa'i rang rang sgos rtsa gtar rlung 'khrugs gtar spang rtsa 'khrugs gang rgyas gtar lud pa'i mdog dang sbyar te bcos pa ni lud pa skya gsob snying gi gab 'khrugs yin dza ti tsan dan snying na cu gangabazhi pa skyu ru'i thang gis dbul/ snod ka thong rtsa gnyis la gtar bar bya/lud pa dmar na glo yi gab 'khrugs yin/ cu gang gur gum tsan dan shing mngar dom

sa khan nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 253mkhris lnga pa tshos khus 'phul la btang / sgang rtsa drug 'go gnyis la gtar bar bya/ lud pa dmar ser mchin pa'i gab 'khrugs yin/ gur gum shi dug zhung dom mkhris skyer pa zag zhun pa rtol bdun pa ba sha gas 'phul btang / lud pa sprug nag mcher pa'i gab 'khrugs yin/ gi waṃ gur gum ba le mtshal ma ru lnga pa se dul thang gis dbul mchin mcher gnyis la ru thung g.yas g.yon gtar lud pa sre'o mkhal ma'i gab 'khrugs yin btsod khus brag zhun gur sum sug sprel ma ru mu spal bong dkar tig tabargyad 'phul byin gzhug gtar/ rtsa 'khrugs lud pa dmar la theng por lu/ dom mkhris shi gur gum ga dur stong len mtshal drug pa ga dur thang gis dbul/ gzer ba gang nye gang rgyas rtsa la gtar/ ser la gdang na mkhris pa'i gab 'khrugs yin/ tig ta gser mi dug zhung dom mkhris ba sha ka snyer pa drug pa gi waṃ thang gis dbul// mkhris rtsa bsha' ring gser mdung gtar bar bya// lud pa sngon po sbu gsog rlung 'khrugs yin/ rus khus a gar dza ti mug zel )tres pu shes gu gul dkar po ru rta bdun 'phul gtar mi bya dang po tsha ba stobs rgyas spyi bcos te/ tsha stobs bri nas sgos bcos mde khar gdags// de nas stongs 'khrugs bcos thabs bstan pa ni/ tsha stongs rlung dang tsha ba phying dril bcos/ rwa gsum ma nu bzhi thang bsres pa btang //gzer steng spru ma 'khar gong bsros pas bdug / ba zho ba dar sha gsar rlung kha mnan smo gzer 'dus ngan khrag rtso kha bya tsam gtar tshigs kha bye na na sar me yis mnan/ ga bur nyi shu rtsa lnga nus khus dbul/ tsha ba choms dka' snum ldan 'jam pos sbyang / rjes la tig ta'i sman mar bsten par bya/ grang stongs nus bcud gsum gyi khu ba bsten/ ma nu bzhi thang dro 'jam rgyun du bsngags rus rnying dugs dang zhun mar bsku byug bya/ sha gsar chang gsar mar gsar bur dkar btang / 'bras bu gsum gyi mar sbyar rlung gsang sreg / mdor na rlung zhi tsha ba mi 'phel bcos chags pa smra brjod

254 sa glu nga da ba'i/sems las bser bu dang / zhe sdang drag shul dul skyur bcud drags spang //'jam 'khrugs bcos pa rwa gsum bsdus pa'i thang // yun bsten khrag dbye gzer dmigs sbyar la gtar gtso bo brgyad kyi phye mas tsha ba bsad//skabs su bad kun tsha ba jul du dbyung // phye thug ba zho ba sha chu grog btang ⑪skyed chung sbyangs rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar/ ma lhag ma chad rtsa ba thon par bcos//zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las 'khrugs kyi tsha ba bcos pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gnyis pa'o// //

255le'u nyer gsum pa/ rims kyi tsha ba bal nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags/ rims zhes bya ba'i rgyu rkyen gang las byung // ngo bo rgyu mtshan ci las ming du btags/ rims la dbye ba'i nad rigs du zhig mchis// sngon tshul mi 'gyur rtags ni ji ltar 'ong // de la bcos thabs rnam pa du yis bcos// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa las// drang srong rig pa'i ye shes des 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po yin las skyes rims zhes bya ba'i nad 'byung rgyu rkyen ni/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha mar gyur tsa na// mi rnams 'dod pa'i dbang gis log par spyod sngags pa rnams ni rdo rje'i nang spe dar// dge 'dun btsun pa rnams ni sde 'khrug byed// mu stegs ban bon rnams ni zor kha 'phen// skye bo rnams ni mna' thab shan dmar byed// de dus ma mo mkha' 'gro kun 'khrugs te/ nad kyi kha rlangs spyin du chags pa las// bal nad rgyu gzer gag lhog 'brum nag 'byung // gzhan yang dus bzhi'i 'byung ba dman lhag log / drag shul dri dugs khro 'jigs mya ngan 'don/ kha zas ma snyoms pa yis rims su 'gyur// rgyu rkyen de yis mkhris pa'i me drod bslang / rngul la babs nas bad gan mkhris pa rlung // 'jug sgo drug tu rim pas 'jug pa'am// dris phog yams su rims kyis 'gos pa'i phyir/ rims zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ming du btags/ dbye ba bal nad 'brum bu rgyu gzer dang ⑪gag lhog cham pa'i rims dang rnam pa lnga/ de la phyi ma bzhi po 'og tu ston/

256 zhu/grwa thang dba'i bal nad dbye ba rnam pa gsum yin te/ babs sa gnas dang sbyar te dbye ba dang / rim pa dus dang sbyar te dbye ba dang ku nad gzhi rigs dang sbyar te dbye ba gsum/ de la rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa dang / gnyan rims zhes bya rnam pa lnga ru bshad// 'dar bu yer bu rlung gi rims yin te// leb rgan glad gzer zhes bya mkhris pa'i rims/ rmongs bu skugs pa bad kun rims su bshad 'dus rims dbye ba rgyun rims rtag pa'i rims/ nyin gcig nyin gsum nyin bzhi rnam pa lnga/ mkhris pa rtsar rgyug rims dang klad gzer dang / rims smyon tre tre hos su btags pa gsum/ don mthun gnyan rims ming gi rnam grangs yin// rtags la spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// spyi la ma smin rgyas dang stongs pa gsum/ dang po ma zin rims kyi sngon tshul ni/ phrum ser yun ring mgo rkang tshigs gzhi na/ lus kyi snyed skyur mi'i ma za zi mang ku g.yal mang rna ba 'jibs la shes pa myos/ nyi ma snyeg cing khyad par srod la na kha kha mgo bo na zhing dang ga 'gag / rtsa rgyud phra mgyogs g.yo zhing chu mdog rnyog / bar du rims rgyas lus lci jul dri mnam//mig mdangs dmar ser lce mchu so dreg chags// mgo na skom dad che la shes pa g.yung // chu dmar dri ma dugs la ku ya mthug / rtsa rgyud phra la grims shing myur du 'phar tha mar zhu 'khyags mtshams slob stongs pa'i rtags/ dpyi dang rked pa rus rkang khyad par na/ lus rngul gnyid chung mgo 'jom rna ba 'ur/ lce ni dmar tsub skam la stong skyugs byed// smra 'chal skabs su 'dar zhing sbyi drod che bye brag rtags la rnam pa gsum yod de dang po babs sa gnas kyis brtag pa ni thog mar skyi dang ba spur 'bab pa ste/ shed chung sbyin skyur lus brtse ba spu ldang / de nad pags la babs te phrum ser khyer mgo kang tshigs gzhi na zhing nyi ma snyeg / de nas rtsa la babs te rtsa tshan skye rtsa 'khyug shes pa bying la skom dad che kha kha chu mdog dmar la rnyog pa'o/

mi na ngag yon tan gyi da/ 257de nas sha la babs te mgo bo 'jom lus kyi sha tsha bsil 'dod shes pa nyog/ de nas snod du babs te dang ga 'gag/ dri ma 'khru skam lce la bad ken chags/ de nas don la babs te rtsa chu tsha rtse skam za zi smra la skom dad che/de nas gzhug tu rus la babs pa'i rtags/ sna bug kha rtse skam la so dreg chags// rtsa stongs rna ba 'on la shes pa nyog/ rim pa dus kyi sgo nas brtag pa ni/ dang po zhag gsum bad kun dus yin te/ tsha ba mgo la babs pas mgo bo na/ nya dang tshigs gzhi na zhing phum ser khyer/ g.yal mang gyid myur skyug cing nyi ma snyeg/ tsha ba ma smin dngas snyigs dbye ba'i dus/ de nas zhag gsum mkhris pa'i dus yin te/ tsha ba dbang po'i sgor babs kha kha la/ lce la bad che so mchu dreg pa chags/ rna skam rna ba mi gsang mig nag che/ chu dmar rtsa grims chu ltar skem pa'i dus de nas zhag gsum khrag dus khrag la babs/ rtsa dang chu yi tsha ba gong bas che/ lce skam skom dad tshe la rngul dri mnam/ lus snyi tsha ba dgra ltar bsad pa'i dus de nas zhag gsum rlung khrag 'thab pa'i dus tshad pa don la babs pas blab chol smra/ dran pa mi gsal tshabs che srog rtsar 'chor shed chung rtsa bying ngo nag lce skam tsubakuyang na snyo 'bros gnyen ltar bsten dus yin/ de nas zhag gsum ri thang mtshams kyi dus/ rus la babs pas dpyi rten dus rkang na shed chung gdong skya mgo 'thom rna ba 'ur gnyid chung lus jul bu ltar gso dus yin/nad gzhi rigs kyi sgo nas brtag pa ni/ dang po rlung rims brla dang skad pa na/ mgo lus yan lag lus kun brdungs snyam byed g.yal mang mgo 'khor rna ba sgra dang bcas gnyid yer mu 'gram mgo bo zug cing gzer/spu ldang pags pa brtse la jul mi 'byung / rkang lag mgo bo 'dar zhing blab chol smra/ kha zas mi 'ju bshang gci sri ba yin/ khyad par 'dar bu phrum ser yun ring 'dar/ yer bu gnyid med g.yo zhing 'bros tshul ston/ rlung

258 sto/grwa thang da bzhi/rims babs sa rus yin rus kun na// rgyas sa don yin lce skam za zi mang //tha mar srog rtsar lam don smyo 'bros byed mkhris rims bsil 'dod mgo na khas zhing / lus tsha 'khru zhing bshang gci pags mig ser rtsal dbyung dri mnam myos shing skom dad che lud pa khrag bcas kha la thor pa 'ong smo khyad par leb rgan stod gzer lud pa dmar// sna khrag 'dzag cing tshad rtags che ba yin// klad gzer tsha ba rgyas la mgo zug che/ mu 'gram ltag rtsa 'khyug cing 'tshogs ma myi mkhris rims dang po babs sa rtsa yin pas// rtsa chu tsha la rtsa rgyas rtsa rnams 'khyug / bar du rgyas pa'i sa ni khrag yin pas// chu dmar ro stod tsha zhing sna khrag 'ong / tha ma phal cher pho bar lam dod pas// mkhris pas pho ba'i me drod phyir bton te/ lce skam mchu thung kha skam so dreg chags/dang ga mi bde stong skyugs byed pa'o// bad rims myos shing tsha ba dal bus skye//skyug cing mchil ma lud pa mang ba dang / lus snyom lci zhing gnyid che dang ga 'gag / bshang gci lce dang sen mo pags mdog dkar// khyad par rmongs bu za zi nyag nyog mang // dran pa mi gsal shes pa 'thib pa yin skugs pa mi ngo mi shes smra ba lkugs/ dri chen dri chu mi 'khyol mal du 'chor/ bad rims dang po babs sa dang ga ste// kha mngal zas mi 'ju la dang ga 'gag /bar du rgyas pa sha dang klad pa ste// lus snyi myos dang lkugs par 'gyur ba yin/tha mar 'chor sa mkhal mar lam don pas/ chu sri mkhal rked na la rna ba 'on/'dus rims rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi rtags dang po bar dang tha ma gsum// 'dus rims thog ma dngas mar babs pa'i phyir// dngas ma bad mkhris gnyis kyi gnas yin pas// bad gan shas che ma smin rtags mi gsal// de 'og ma zhu sprug po lta bur snang / mkhris shas che na ma smin rtags 'ga' gsal// de 'og mkhris nad lta bur mig chu ser// bar du rgyas dus sems rmugs rna ba 'on/ gnyid log dus na za zi blab chol 'byung // lud pa

spro nang ga yon tan gyi da/ 259dmar ser dkar po 'byar bag lu// rkang dang rked pa dus tshigs ma lus na/gre ba tsha 'dzer sbyin pa sna chu mang // mig dmar rtsib logs na zhing skom dad che/ tsha ba bshang gci rngul dang gnyid mi snyoms// thor pa 'brum phran dmar nag 'byung yang srid// dngas ma khrag sogs zungs kun la gnas phyir/nad rtags mi 'dra sna tshogs cir yang srid// ngos bzung smin bsad 'byang dka' sa 'dra snyi// nges shes rna ba mi gsang za zis shes// tha mar lus zungs zhu bas jul mang 'byung // smra mang phyi rtsa 'dar srid stong skyugs 'ong / lus grang ham pa skya'am mgo rkang na// de dag ri thang mtshams su phebs rtags yin// bco brgyad nyi shu gnyis na 'tsho 'chi phyed// bye brag rtags la rgyun rims dngas mar babs// bad mkhris ldan pa'i nad rtags 'byung ba srid//khrag la babs pa rtag pa'i rims yin te/ ro stod pho mchin mi bde sna khrag 'dzag / glo mang lud pa mi gtsang mig chu dmar// zhag gcig tsha ba'i zug gzer min gnyis ldang // sha la babs pa nyin gcig pa zhes bya// rngul mang drod che lus dang shed pa lci// tsha ba nad zug nyin re lan re ldang // tshil la babs pa nyin gsum pa yi rims/ khyad par gnyid che lus po shin tu lci//rlung mkhris shas che dang po mgo la 'bab// bad mkhris shas che ske dang phrag par 'bab// rlung dang bad kun shas che rked par 'babasgo nyin re bde la nyin gnyis gtud nas na rus la babs pa nyin bzhi pa yi rims/ khyad par rked pa rkang rus tshigs gzhi na/ klad par babs tshe mgo 'khor cham pas 'debs// stobs che kha yo mig sle gza' phog mtshungs// bad kun che na byin pa na bar byed// rlung shas che na khyad par klad pa na/ zhag gnyis bde la zhag re na res byed// gnyan rims mkhris pa rtsar rgyug ces bya bta nad 'di klu bdud byang sman rkyen byas nas/ mkhris tshad phyi rol rngul gyi sgor zhugs te// nang du mchin mkhris don snod gnyis la babs/ rang sar mi

260 ga /grwa nga da bzhi/gnas rtsa mig kun tu rgyug / yar la mgo dang klad par bad yul 'phrog /mar la mkhal ma rgyungs par chu yul 'phrog / don la glo dang snying la rlung yul 'phrog / pho long rgyu ma snod du mkhris yul 'phrog / sha pags phyir shor stobs dang kha dog 'phrog / mjug tu mkhris gnas rlung gis spyad byas nas// rang gnas srog rtsar 'chor bas 'tsho ba nyung / de rtags grang shum byed cing rgyu ba zhan/ rtsa ni stong la myur zhing chu ser nyog / mgo dang tshigs gzhi na zhing za zi 'ong // bar du nad rgyas chu ni mar nag 'dra/ mig sprin lce 'og mur gong sha mdangs ser/ kha kha lus tsha gnyid chung dang ga 'gag / sen mo rnyil dang lce mchu dkar ser 'ong // mgo gzer lce mchu 'gas shing so dreg chags/mchin mkhris steng du 'dril ba mnan mi bzod/ nad kyi dri dugs stobs dang gzi mdangs 'tshar/ smin pa'i long med bdun dgu'i dus na 'chi blun po 'ga' zhig smin byed dus la sdod/ rtsa srun shes pa yang la lus stobs shor/phyi yi drod chung pags mdog gser ltar ser// dus 'das rang gnas slob pas zlog thabs med/ de phyir ma smin dus na bya ra sgrims/ khyad par mgor bros klad gzer sna khrag 'dzag / glor babs ro ston gzer la lud pa ser/mkhal babs mkhal skad na zhing dri chu sdom/ pho bar babs na kha kha mkhris pa skyug / rgyu mar babs na zug che tshan can 'khru/ de dag mi 'gyur 'khrul med nad rtags yin/ bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyi bcos ma smin dus su ma nu bzhi/ yang na sle tres lnga thang smin par bya/ zas dang spyod lam bsil drod snyoms par bcos rgyas par ma smin spyi bcos le'ur blta/bar du zin rgyas tig ta gser me tog / stu ba par pa ta dang li ga dur/ a ru ra yi thang btang jul mang dbyung / tsha stobs che na de steng ga bur dang /gi waṃ cu gang gur gum bong nga dkar tig ta ka ra sbyar la thang gis dbul/sman zhu rngul dbyung rims tshad kun la shes/ skyed chung mig chu ser na bshal

lta nang ga yon tan gyi da/ 261gyis sbyang // 'bras bu gsum dang dur byid pi pi ling // nā ga ge sar sprang rtsi ka ra sbyar// rims kun gsar rnying med pa sel bar byed// chu lcag brabs la nad dag bsil gyis bcad// zas dang spyod lam rgyas tshad spyi dang 'dra/khyad par rims so cog la zho gnod de// bcu gsum 'das nas 'o ma bdud rtsir mtshungs// tha ma ri thang mtshams su sad mda' btang / kha zas glod cing tshad gzhug gdon pa'i thabs// ri thang mtshams kyi le'ur shes par bya//jig pan srad dkar snya lo kyi lce bzhi/ tsha ba'i stobs sbyar du ba ma shor bsregs// thal bar mgo na a ru zur lnga sdeb// sna khrag 'dzag na mtshe yi thal ba sdeb// glo lu ba la rgya skyegs thal ba sdeb// rtsib logs gzer na ma nu'i thal ba sdeb/ mig chu ser na sho rtsa'i thal ba sdeb// tshigs gzhi la babs rta lpags thal ba sdeb/ dri ma 'gags na sug pa'i thal ba sdeb// chu sri ba la gze ma'i thal ba sdeb rlung gi rims la dus khus 'phul la btang // ri thang mtshams su chang khyor re yis dbul// chang 'thungs gnyid log ga bur nag po yin// rlung ldan rims rigs kun la bsngags pa ste// khyad par ri thang mtshams kyi bdud rtsi yin/ ma smin ri thang mtshams gnyis rims la gces//de phyir mkhas pas 'di dus gzab par bya// bye brag bcos pa'i thabs la rnam gsum las/ babs sa gnas dang sbyar la bcos pa ni// ba sbyar babs dus lto dgug chu bskol btang // kha zas bsil phyogs mi btang smin par dka'// bsil thang phye ma mi bsten tsha ba rnyogs// snum bcud mi btang tsha ba rus la zhen// de nas pags babs ma nu bzhi thang btang // tsha ba che na 'bras gsum sle tres thang // 'di dus mi bsreg tsha ba khong du 'chor// drod bcud mi bsten rtsi ltar zhen par 'gyur// bsil phye mi bsten tsha ba skye lam 'gag / khyad par gtar ga bshal dang bsil bcud spang / tsha ba'i nad la bya 'chor rngul mi dbyung // de nas rtsar babs bzang drug ba sha ka / ga dur

262 zhu/grwa thang rgyud bzhi/kur sbyar zas skom bsil du bsten// 'di dus thang btang dang ga 'gag pas spang // snum bcud gab 'gyur bsregs na tsha ba 'dregs// myur shor ngan khrag rtsar zhen gso ba dka'// shar babs gi waṃ bsil gsum a ru ra// ka ra sbyar ba'i bsil 'jam phye ma bsten bsregs na gzer 'debs gtar na rjes mi chod// 'di dus rngul du gdon pa shis pa yin// thang btang rtsar zhen bcud shor me ru 'bar// ga bur mi btang rlung 'khrugs tsha ba 'thor// snod babs byi tsher tig ta gser me tog / thong nga ga dur dug nyung ka ra sbyar//rngul thang bsreg dang drod bcud shin tu gnod// snod du babs tshe thang bshal bsngags pa yin// don babs tsha ba rab 'bring bye brag gis// ga bur tsan dan gi waṃ gtso byas la// bsil gsum ga dur tig ta bong nga dkar/ hong len ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma bsdud// rlung mkhris bad kun khrag shas che ba la//me sbyongs rngul gtar cung zad bsten par bya// rngul grangs rlung 'khrugs bcud sngas tsha bar ldog / rus babs sre long bur zho tsho khus sad// zas kyis ngo bslang bsil gyis tshad gzhug gdon// bsil drags zas yin zungs 'dzad la rgal 'gyur// rlung 'phel gsar 'jam khrid la drug bdun bsreg /rim pa dus dang sbyar te bcos pa ni// bad gan dus su 'bras gsum ma nu bzhi// sle tres byi tsher tig ta dro 'jam bsten// rngul dbyung tsha ba'i kha brid gnyen ltar bsten// mkhris dus tig ta gser khyi me tog dang // a ru ra yi bsdus grangs btang bar bya// bzang drug gser gyi me tog ba sha ka / ga dur ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma bsten// mgo bo na na dpral rtsa kha phye gtar// chu lcag byas pas tsha sel skra mi 'byi// khrag dus ga dur tsan dan gi waṃ dang // bsil gsum ga dur ka ra'i phye ma gtud// khrag mkhris stobs che cung zad gtar zhing sbyang / bying 'thibs rngul gdon zas spyod bsil du bsten// rlung khrag 'thab dus dza ti snying zho sha / big pan thal ba bur dkar sbyar la btang //

lta nang g.yon tan gyi da/ 263ga bur rgyal blon gsum dang ltag pa sprad// dran med smra 'chal mi la 'dzin nam snom// zas byin khyim bu sos 'dzin mig rtsa grung // ga bur chang sbyar btang la drug pa bsreg / kha zas bsil drod spel btang sgog chab bsngags//skyed chung a so gtar la rgyal blon gsum/ dzā ti ka ra sbyar la btang bar bya//bcu gsum phan chad tsha ba'i ri thang mtshams chang gsar tsho khu bur zho sre long thang // sad mnas ngo bslang cha yis brid la glod/ skyu ru tsan dan ga bur big pan thal// kur sbyar tshad lhag skam phyir bsrings la btang // tsha ba thon nas gang 'phrod zas kyis gso// nad gzhi'i rigs dang sbyar te bcos pa ni// rlung rims dang po bu ram go snyod thang // dus bcud gsum dang sle tres chig thang dang // byi tsher ga dur sle tres sga thang btang // smin nas bzang drug sle tros big pan thal/ ka ra'i phye ma rus khus 'phul la btang // gtar bshal ga bur 'di la nye mi rung / bsil sha gsar pa mar gsar yos thug bsten// tsha ba chung na zhag dgu lon pa dang // 'dar bu'i ltag khung yer bu'i smon stong bsreg / ma thub srog rtsar lam don smyo ba na// dzā tig gul ru rta a ga ru// sgog thal bur dkar sbyar la rus khus dbul// rus bcud khu bar dzā ti btab la btang // ma thub gzhug chung lnga bdun sbyor ba bya// drug bdun an stong ltag pa'i sdud sgo bsreg / de ltar bcos pas ma thub srog rlung log / rtsa srun jam pa rtseg na 'chi ba yin// sna lon dran pa gsal la rtsa shed rgyas// chu gdang lce rlon rkang pa'i drod rnyed cing // snabs skams 'gog bla rna ba gsang na 'tsho// mkhris rims dang po tig ta byi tsher thang // byi tsher ga dur rtsa mkhris skra bzang dang // a ru ga dur tig ta skra bzang btang 5 smin nas ga bur gi waṃ tsan dan gsum// tshad stobs sbyar la bsil gsum li ga dur// tig ta dug nyung gser me bong nga dkar// hong len ba sha ka dang ka ra sbyar// tsha ba che la khyad par mig chu ser// 'bras gsum lham rtsa dur byin

264 sto/grwa nga da bzhi/thang bshal bya// khyad par leb rgan sna khrag 'dzag pa la// tsan dan mtshe thal dom mkhris sbyar la btang // smin ma'i bar du spra ba lnga yis bsdam// glo lu stodag zer lud pa dmar ba na// tsan dan dkar po gur gum cu gang dang //rgya skyegs shing thal ka ra sbyar byas la// tshos khus 'phul btang glo rtsa cung zad gtar// klad pa gzer na mu 'gram 'khyug rtsa bsreg / dpral ba'i rtsa la khrag rlangs thon tsam gtar// gla rtsi spang spos phur thal a ru ra// shug pa spang rgyan dkar sbyar 'tshogs steng bsreg / tha ma pho bar lam don thang bshal bya// de rjes dza ti shing kun ka ko la// bur chang btang la tsho khu chang 'jam bsten//de ltar ma bcos pho ba'i me shi nas// kha zas mi 'ju stong skyugs byed na 'chi//gong bzhin sna lon rtags tshang 'tsho bar nges// bad gan rims la dang po ma nu bzhi// byi tsher ga dur ba sha ka dang sga// gla sgang par pa ta yi smin thang btang // snang bar bya zhing nang nub chu bskol btung // smin nas bzang drug tig ta 'bras bu gsum// utpal ga dur ka ra sbyar la btang // 'bras bu gsum dang tig ta li ga dur// bsdus thang dron mo btang la rngul mang dbyung //'byang dka' tsha ba mi chag bshal gyis sbyang // khyad par rmongs bu'i rigs la ra dkar po'i// rwa ru bsregs pa'i gzhob dang bal tshi sbyar// lus kun byugs la ga bur rgyal blon gsum// khong du btang la zhu nas ba par dbyung //zab chol mang na ltag pa'i skra mtshams bsreg / skyugs su byung na tshigs pa dang po bsreg / kha lkugs ga bur rgyal blon gsum pa dang // dzā ti sbyar btang rkang mthil mtheb snying bsro// de rjes lce 'og rtsa la gtar bar bya// mkhal mar lam don gze ma pi pi ling / bu ram bsdus thang dron mos mkhal sna bslan// de ltar ma bcos mkhal ma'i zungs nyams te// rkang pa'i drod nyams dbugs thung sna chu 'ong // bla rtsa bros na mi thub 'chi bar nges// sna lon gong gi rtags tshang 'tsho ba yin// 'dus rims bcos thabs sbyi dang bye

zhu nang g.yon tan gyi da/ 265brag gnyis spyi bcos smin dang zhi bya gso ba gsum/ dang po smin byed dngas mar babs pa yis// pho ba drod nyams rtsa lam 'gags pa'i phyir// ci rigs nga bya nang nub chu bskol btung // 'bras sam yos thug spod bcas tsha ba btang // bca' sga byi tsher par pa ta gsum la/ gla sgang sdebs te bskol thang rtse 'jam dang // sle tres gla sgang rtsa mkhris sga thang btang // bad rlung che na ma nu ba'i thang ste// khrag mkhris che na 'bras bu gsum thang btang smozas spyod tsha grang gnyis spang dro 'jam bsten// de yi smin rtags jul g.yos phrum ser sangs// de 'og bar du zhi bas bcos bya ste// de yang bcos pa'i dus la gsar rnying gnyis// gsar dus nyes pa'i stobs kyis bcos pa dang //tsha ba'i stobs dang sbyar nas bcos pa gnyis// nyes pa'i stobs sbyar rlung mkhris bad kun gsum// gang shas che ba sngon la zhi bar bya/ cha mnyam bad mkhris rlung gsum rim pas bcos// rlung la sle tres mkhris la a ru ra// bad kun pi pi ling gi chig thang btang // cha mnyam pa la 'bras bu gsum thang bsten// zas spyod sman dpyad de yi gnyen por sbyar// tsha ba'i stobs dang sbyar te bcos pa ni// yul dus na tshod nad khams zas spyod kyis// tshad stobs che chung gnyis su 'gyur ba'i phyir// stobs che smin dus bsdad pa'i long med pas// zhag gcig snang byas nang par gsar sha sbyin// de yi nang par gser phud skyugs kyis drang // skyugs byas nang par hong len bshal gyis sbyang // de yis pho ba'i bad mkhris bsal byas la// ga bur rgyal blon gsum lnga bdun pa 'am// rin chen 'gas pa lus zungs tsha stobs sbyar// skabs su sman btang rjes la tshad lam bsal// snod tshad che na mngar ba'i sman gyis sbyang // stod gzer lud pa dmar ser gnas sbyar gtar// tsha ba'i rlangs gdon khrag bongs cher mi rung // stobs chung bya kro skyer pa pa to la// hong len sgron shing gla sgang 'bras bu gsum// bskol grangs btang rjes gtso bo

266 sa /grwa bang dab /brgyad pa la// gla sgang par pa ta dang dug mo nyung // pa to la dang rtsa mkhris bsnan la btang // zla gcig phar 'das rims rnying tsha ba rnams// sle tres pi pi ling dang 'bras bu gsum// thang mang btang rjes nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar// skabs su jul dbyung mig chu ser na sbyang // bshang gci phyen 'gags pa la bya kṛ dang // gze ma 'o ma bur rnying bskol ba phan// mdog sngo sha skam dang ga bde ba na tsha ba phyi ru byer bas chu lcag phan// rtsa khrid na 'phreng lci na cung zad gtar// tshigs ga'i rus pa na skrangs chu lums bya// rims rjes sna rtsa skrangs na gang nye gtar// gur gum ka ra mar gsar sna sman btang // brag zhun stag sha hong len dri chu byug / kor ler na zhing gzer na mtshan dugs bya// gshed med smad tshad skyes na smad 'dren btang // zungs zad ro smad drod bral 'jam rtsi bya// stobs med gting tshan ma thon rlung skyes na// tig ta'i sman mar sbrang rtsi sbyar la bsten// mdor na tsha ba nad zungs kun 'brel phyir//thor bu sna tshogs ma nges 'byung bas na// tsha ba spyi dang 'phrul te nad sna bsal//tha ma ri thang mtshams su zungs gso ste// 'dus rims yin phyir nges med 'khrul so che// legs par brtags nas kha zas rim gyis glod// 'drar snang slu brid 'phrang la ma shor gces// de nas 'dus rims bye brag gso ba ni//rgyun rims pa tol du nyung hong len gsum pa'i thang btang zhing // khyad par bad kun shas che sgrig cing skyug / mi 'ju yi ga 'gags na pon rgyam tsha'i skyugs kyis drang // mkhris babs mig chu ser na dur gyid sgron 'brum nd+ra ba'i nga bshal gyis sbyang // srin khros pho bar zug la go phyes bur ma ril bu sbyar bsad// rtag pa'i rim sa la hong len pa rtol glasga ba pa tra lnga pa sbyar// gar babs rtsa la ci ran rigs pas gtar// nyin gcig pa la gla sgang pa tol 'bras su mnim pa dus nyung sun 'bru ma brgyad pa btang // gtso bo thul mang dbyung 'ing chu lcag bya// nyin gsum pa la bca' sga tsan dan tig ta tres bzhi thang btang // bye dug spos dkar yung skyer

zhu khan ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 267brag zhun du gnyung nga nga 'bras gsum bcu pa sbrang dang sbyar la byin nyin bzhi pa la sle tres gla ging pa du gsum thang btang // slo tres brag zhun sbyar byugs mkhan chus bran// ru rta a ru 'o ma'i 'jam rtsi bya// tshigs pa kha bye zug gzer gang che bsreg / glad par babs na sna bshal btang ba 'am// chu tshan gla ril dugs bya nang rtsa sbyang // rjes la rtsa ba 'bras bu'i sman mar sbyar// kun la pa to la dang pu tse shel/ gla sgang shing mngar a ru ra dang lnga// pa tol lnga 'di'i thang phye gang rigs phan// rims gang cis kyang tsha ba mi chag na/ 'tsho dka' lag pa'i rtsa la lan 'ga' gtar// nyin gcig mi gtar bzhi po rang rang rtsa/gtar bas rims kyi tsha ba rtsad nas 'don// kun la ri thang mtshams su gzab pa gces// gnyan rims bcos thabs spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyi bcos dang po rtsa yi 'bros 'phrang bsdam// gnyis pa gnyen po sbyar bas bsad pa dang // gsum pas ro dbyung bzhi pas nad lhag bsal/ dang po rtsa yi 'bros 'phrang bsnam pa ni// mi dom mkhris pa gla rtsi bong nga dkar// rgu drus chos na brag zhun yung ba rnams// lo brgyad chu la sbyangs la khong du btang //smin byed thang dang ltag pa sprad pa shis// sdud sgo 'tshogs ma drug pa bcu gsum pa/ nang long 'phar rtsa spra ba bzhi lngas mnan/ des ni rtsa yi 'bros 'phrang 'gegs par byed// gnyen po 'dzim pa bong nga'i me tog dang // lhog dug a ru sha chen cha yis bskyed// dri chu'i ril bu sran tsam thebs 'ga' btang // lci rngul phyi tshad che na sod pa'i rtags// gzer bshal ro dbyung ma thebs skyar la sbyang / skyar yang mi 'jug srog rlung nyams te 'chi// legs 'khru mdog ser dri che ro thon rtags// mkhris pa thon chung mig ser sbyar la btang // 'byongs na mig spyin phral la dkar por 'gro// phye ma gi waṃ gur gum dug mo nyung // hong len tig ta skyer shun bong nga dkar// kyi lce gu gul lhum rtsa sgro puṣṭha// zhib btags dus bzhir chus 'phul tshad lhag 'joms// tsha

268 ༄/grwa nga byu /yang ga bur srog rlung ldog phyir spang // gnyan ma sod par gtar dang dkar mngar spang // 'bras thug yos thug bskol grangs chu grog btang // bye brag gar babs nad kyi dmigs brtags la// mgor babs dom mkhris gangs thigs gi waṃ dang // a byag bong nga ka ra sbyar la btang // 'tshogs ma sdud sgo mu 'gram me yis mnan// sna khrag 'dzag na gur gum dom mkhris dang // mtshe thal snya lo srad dkar kyi lce ba// rdo dreg ser po ka ra sbyar la btang // glor babs tsan dan gur gum cu gang dang // skyer shun shing mngar bong nga dkar po dang // ka ra sbyar btang drug mgo snod ka gtar// mkhal babs gla rtsi gur gum sug smel dang // skyer shun brag zhun nyi dga' a ru ra// shug tsher sbyar btang bcu ba'i rtsa nag bsreg / pho bar babs la spyi dang khyad par gnyis/ spyi ru pho bar babs pa'i rims rnams la// phag ril thal ba dom mkhris sbyar ba bsngags// gla rtsi dug nyung btsod dang li ga dur// dom mkhris bong dkar skyer pa'i bar shun sbyar// khyad par gnyan shas che na bsad rjes sbyang // phag ril srad dkar ho len de ba bzhi khyor ba re re so sor bsregs thal ba//dmar zal ba chus 'dam thags byas pa'i phye// ka ras kha bslang rims tshad kun la bsngags// khyad par 'dus rims rims smyon tre tre ho// gnyan rims pho bar babs pa'i bdud rtsi yin// mkhris yul rlung gis phrogs la kha ru tsha// dzā ti'i thang dang bur chang sdebs la btang // ga bur nag po chang du sbyar ba bsngags// ma zhus rgyu byas sgrog skyug zas mi 'ju// rgyam tsha bzhi thang btang zhing ma ru lcam ba ling gser ba'i thang bshal bya// rgyu mar babs na dang po bshal btang la// de rjes gnyen po thog rus rgu drus dang // gla rtsi chos sman bong nga dkar po dang // chu rtsa dri chur sbyar la btang bar bya// rims tshad dang po ma smin snyan gsan 'bebs// bar du tsha ba smin rgyas gzhi la gnon /tha mar gzhug rgyan thor bu'i zhabs tog byed// de phyir thor bu nad kyi bsal

zhu nang g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 269thabs gces// rigs pas tsha ba spyi dang 'phrul te bcos// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rims kyi tsha ba bal nad bcos pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gsum pa'o// / /

270le'u nyer bzhi pa/ 'drum pa'i rims btsos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la// drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus// 'brum bu'i rims la rgyu rkyen mtshan nyid dang // dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs ji ltar bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa// 'brum pa'i rims ni sbyi dang 'dra ba la / ngo bo tsha ba chu ser la babs nas// rus rkang lha ba'i gting nas skye bar byed// thor pa'am 'brum bu 'ong phyir ming du brjod//dbye ba nag po dkar po rigs gnyis te// nag po'i rigs gsum skrangs pa glang gnya' dang // khrag skam rtsel te zangs gzer sbru gu can// dkar po'i rigs gsum sha ra skya shar dang // rmog mgo spyi zlum sib bu kob tse'o// de yi rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// phyi rtags tshigs gzhi na la grang shum byed//lus spyir snyom la dang ga mi bde zhing // kha kha za zi 'ong la nyid pa skyur// khyad par mgo bo na zhing glo snying brdung // sha mdangs dmar la mthug cing lus kun brtse// mkhris pa skyug cing rus rkang 'chag snyam sem// dang po ma smin sngon tshul de ltar 'byung // bar du 'brum pa phyir thon bde snyam byed// tha ma bye brag rtags la dkar nag gnyis// nag po'i rigs la spangs pa glang gnya' ni// phyi ru mi thon zug che lus kun skrangs// chu ser nag po nyes kun 'dus las bskyed// khrag skam rtsel te shig ni dmar nag mthug / zangs gzer sbya gu can ni dkyil du skyong // de gnyis khrag dang mkhris pa las gyur yin// khyad par mgo na rtsa chu phyi yul tsha// dkar po rmog mgo spyi zlum che la 'chol// sha ra skya shar dkar la mthug pa ste// sib bu kob tse tsam tsem mthug kob 'byung //

cu/man ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 271bad rlung las gyur nad zug cham pa 'dra// tshad pa'i rtags chung ma log bcos mi dgos// de dag bcos thabs spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi bcos dang po ma smin sgru sgo dbye// nad rgyas tsha ba khong nas phyir la dbul// khong shor phyir drang tha ma 'brum rjes gsub// dang po sgo dbye sle tres 'bras bu gsum// tig ta ba sha ka dang li ga dur// bsdus thang dron mo phul gang nyi phyed btang // sman zhu rngul gdon bal dang phye yis phyi// spu sgo phyed pas 'brum pa phyir myur skye// nad stobs che ba rnams la thebs 'ga' bsngags// 'di dus dpyad mchog rngul las lhag pa med// chag tse phye thug 'o ma btab pa dang //'o zan dar gsar chu bskol chab tsha bston// nyin nub ma lus mi bseng drod la sgor// grang dang bser bus phog na 'brum pa ldog / bcud shor 'brum pa mi skye don la 'bab// gal te shor na sran khu sran tshod sbyin// de rjes tsha ba 'phul la thang phye gnyis/ dang po lug chung sgong thog lug sho'i thang // g.yer shing thang gis 'brum pa phyir la 'phul// phye mas tsha ba 'phul la rdo rtsi gnyis//rtsi sbyor tsan dan gi waṃ a ru ra// dza ti cu gang gur gum gla rtsi dang // bse ru ka ra sbyar la gangs chus dbul// rdo sbyor rgyal po sde bzhi mtshal dkar dang //gla rtsi tsha la kur sbyar chang gis dbul// thun grangs thun tshad tsha ba nad stobs dpag / rtsi yis don snod tsha ba sel bar byed// rdo yis chu ser skem zhing phyir la 'phul// nad stobs che na rdo rtsi ltag spyod mchog / 'brum bu ma thon lus spangs grang shum byed// nad 'bras shing mngar 'o mar bskol ba byug /'brum pa skye 'phro nang du log pa 'am / 'brum rdzogs slar log khong nas phyir drang ba// 'dzim pa nas tsam kur sbyar khong du btang // rngul dbyung de rjes rdo rtsi gang rung la// dngul chu ba'i nam bsnan la ltag pa sprad// thun bskyed drug yar btang bas phyir 'phul byed// 'brum pa rdzogs nas shi ba phal du med//tha mar nad 'go chogs nas rjes gsub pa// 'brum pa'i shu ba rnag cing rlan

272 ༄ /grwa nga da ba'i/che na// sha ru phur yog dres ma'i thal ba dang // lci ba ser ku'i thal ba btab pas skem// mthil ba'i ra thon dang sngon ma phal cher skams// gnyid chung g.yal mang sus 'dar shes pa yang // rtsa chu'i tsha ba bri nas kha zas glod//zhun mar gsar 'jam sha gsar mar gsar sbrang // dang po brid la tha rma ra lhug par btang // chang mangs rnags te 'brum shum za bas na// kha ngoms tsam las yog 'thung spang bar bya// 'di man kha zas bzang na bsrongs pa skyen// gdong pa'i shu ba gogs nas dri chus bkru// ra phag tshil bu tsher sngon sbyar ba byug / bye brag bcos pa'i rigs dang babs sgo sbyar// rigs bcos skrangs pa glang gnya'i 'brum pa la// bso ko glang gnya'i ko ba ser tsam bsregs// sran phye bsres pa spyi sman ltag sprad skem// skrangs pa che na gang nye'i rtsa la gtar// dur byin hong len spos dkar dug pus pa'i// ril bu ba chus 'phul ba'i bshal gyis sbyang // rtsel te shig dang zangs gzer 'dra ba la//bzang drug gla rtsi phag ril khu ba dang // ra khrag sbyar ba'i lcag mda' btang ba'am// tig ta dug nyungs hong len ba sha ka / gong gi rtsi sbyor spyi la bsnan pa btang // shin tu tsha ba che na ga bur bsnan// dkar po se 'bru skyu ru rdo sbyor bsnan// lus skrangs sman gyis ma thon bdun na 'chi// dmar thig 'brum par ma song lnga na 'chi// nag leb rnag tu ma song dgu na 'chi// skya shar zas bsdams drags na 'chi ba yin// 'brum rdzogs slar log las kyis 'chi zhes bya// babs sa gnas dang sbyar te bcos pa ni// snying la babs na snyo 'dar dngangs chung 'byung // rtsi sbyor spyi stengs ga bur bsnan la btang // ma thub smyo zhing 'tshig na 'chi ba yin// glor babs glo mang gzer 'ing rnag tu 'byung //sro lo shing mngar rtsi sbyor la bsnan btang / ma thub min pa 'gags na 'chi ba yin// mchin par babs na mig dmar mchin steng gzer// dom mkhris brag zhun kha che gur gum bsnan// 'thibs kyin khrag tu 'khru skyug 'chi ba yin// rgyu

zhu khanang ga yon tan gyi rgyud 273mar babs na mkhris pa 'khru phyug byed// btsod dang snya lo dug nyung bsnan la btang // khrag tu 'khru na snod rdol 'chi ba yin// de dag kun gyi 'dred du dngul chu this// mig tu byung na ga bur gla rtsi byug yang na 'ol mo se dang nu zho byug / dom mkhris ti tsha skyer kha ṇa ra gan dung // nu zho sbyar byugs 'jab 'jib sgro yis byab// ga bur gur gum chus bkru grod chus bdug / gre bar babs na phye tshod tshan mos bdug / shu dag ru rta rgya tsha'i gye ma gdab// tshar bong thang btang rta bangs khu ba btung // ma thub skyung bus ba 'ar rjes sman phye btab// sgang par babs na rgya tsha ru rta dang // nyi dga' gla rtsi bsdus thang btang bar bya// rgya tsha gla rtsi shu dag ru rta bzhi// chus sbyar gsang ba'i gce lus lhang par bskyal// de yis gdug pa 'brum pa'i nad 'joms byed//ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las 'brum pa'i rims bcos pa'i le'u ste nyi shu bzhi pa'o// / /

274le'u nyer lnga pa/ rgyu gzer gyi rims bcos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la// drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus// rgyu gzer rims la rgyu rkyen mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bshad du gsol// de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa// rgyu gzer rgyu ni rims tshad spyi dang 'dra// ngo bo mchin tshad bur du babs pa la// gnyan nad chu ser mkhris tshad bslang ba yis// rgyu ma gzer zhing 'khru bas rgyu gzer yin// dbye ba spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// spyi la don 'khru ba dang snod 'khru ba// stobs chen sto bas chung rnam pa ba'i ru 'gyur// bye brag dbye ba rgyu gzer rgyu 'khor dang // rgyu 'khrol rgyu skugs zhes bya ba'i ru bshad/ de rtags dang po mgo dang tshigs gzhi na// phrum ser khyer zhing rgyu ma na la 'khru//'khru ba'i bongs chung 'khru dus zug gzer che// dmar ser za khu srug po bee snabs 'khru// khyad par don 'khru zug che 'khru bongs chung // so khrag gzhibs dang sha khog bshal ba 'dra// snod 'khru dmar ser za khu be snabs 'khru// zug chung grangs nyung stobs lda na tsha ba che// grangs mang zug che stobs chung de las ldog / bye brag rgyu gzer bongs chung yang yang 'khru/ 'khru ba'i dus na khyad par zug gzer che// rgyu 'khor thun du bcad nas bongs cher 'khru// rgyu ma gtubs snyam zug che 'khrus rjes bde// rgyu 'khrol zug chung ldang dub med pa la// 'khru ba'i bongs dang rtsa chu'i tsha ba chung // rgyu lkugs mi 'khru sbo 'gag gtubs snyam byed// bcos pa'i thabs la gsar rnying dus dang sbyar// gsar pa'i bcos la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la bcos thabs nad stobs che chung gis// stobs chen nad la bcos tshul rnam pa bdun// snod kyi rtsi srung mkhris

༄gyis na nga g.yon tan gyi da 275pa'i me bsad cing // rgyu long rul sbyang nad dngos gnyen pos bsad//mchin pa'i zags bsdams 'khru ba'i kha dog sgyur// tha mar chu bo'i rgyun lam bcad pa'o// dang po snod kyi rtsi srung chig thub ri bong glad pa dom mkhris til nagagasum// mkhris pa'i me bsad gur gum cu gang utpal tigata ba le ka brag zhun drug la tshad stobs sbyar nas ga bur tsan dan gi waṃ gis kha bsgyur bdun pa gnyis// dus bzhi ltag pa sprad la btang bar bya// de 'og sbyong byed chig thub ra nu rtsa re ga dri churarnam pa gsum 'khru mdog blon dpar na bya rkang ser na du gzhung sku gan re ral za khu sbyi 'brum bee bas sug la gyis kha bsgyur rul dri sbyang // lan gcig lan gnyis gang dgos nad stobs sbyar sbyangs rjes gnyen po chig thub rang shi'i thod pa thog rus chos man dug pus gu drus chu rtsa gla rtsi brag zhun rnam pa gsum// thun chung grangs mang btang la dngos po bsad// shin tu zug che rgyu 'bas chu rdos bdug / bong nga dkar po kyi dkar po hong len gyi snyem chu 'khyags sbyangs pa'i sma 'dred btang //gzhang kha lug na shing leb kha sdom bya// de nas tshad stobs cung zad chag mngon nas// mchin pa'i zags sdom gur gum cu gang ba le tigata tshe tshigs lta rumatshal dom mkhris bragazhun dgu pa dang // 'khru ldog sgyur byed dpar na bya rkang tshos ser na dus zhung dom mkhris snabs su sprel thog rus sprug na re ral khrag rkang mkhu byi 'brum mi mkhris kun la ka ra sbyar bltag pa sprad la btang // zas skom nas sngon car brdungs tshos pa la// ba ra'i 'o ma bag tsam btab pa dang // ba tsha med pa'i chu grog bston par bya// dkar mngar dul skyur drod bcud mtha' dag spang // de nas tsha ba chogs na nad stobs bri// rtsa dal chu sngo drod chung pho long 'khrog / 'khru ba'i dri dang zug chung 'khru tshigs ring // 'khru ba sgra bcas chur skyur steng du lding kade dus gcod byed sman dang gsar bcud zas// rim pas spel te chu bo'i rgyun lam bcad// btsan thabs mi bcad cha yis brid pa yin// stobs chung nad la bcos thabs rnam pa gsum// rgyu rims dang po rtsa kha bsdam pa dang //

076 grwa nga dba'ibar du tsha ba rol du bsad pa dang // tha ma chu bo'i rgyun lam bcad pa'o//kun gyi gtso bo chig thub dkar po yin// dang po par pa ta dang khrag rkang gnyis// gtso bo cha mnyam gangs chu bskol grangs btang // bar du tig ta bong nga sro lo dkar// hong len bzhi po gtso bo'i sum cha sbyar// bskol grangs thang ngam phye ma chus sbyangs btang // tha ma tsha ba'i stobs chag bcad ran dus//skyer pa'i me tog gtso bo'i sum cha sbyar// ba yar 'o mar btab btang rgyun lam gcod// yang na rgu drus chos sman thod pa dang / thog nus rgyal po yin pas sum gnyis btang // gla rtsi dom mkhris a byag bong nga dkar// rtsi dmar chu rtsa brag zhun sum cha btang // 'khru mdog dmar na me tog bya rkang sdeb//ser po dug nyung za khu kyi 'brum sdeb// rgya shal re ral bee snabs sug sprel sdeb//gangs chu sbyar bas rul bsrung tsha ba bcog / 'khru ba'i tshigs ring tshad lhag bri ba dang // ka ra sbyar la ba 'o bskol grangs dbul// ro 'don 'khru ba gcod cing lus rtas byed/ bye brag bcos thabs rgyu gzer rgyu 'khor gnyis//spang rtsi hong len bong nga sum cu tig / khrag rkang sro lo par pa ta bsdus thang kartsa kha sdom dang mi 'drul sra bar byed// dmar zal ba yi 'o ma mar dkar bsdus// rgyu ma'i nang rtsi mi 'dzad 'dred par byed// khyad par rgyu gzer rgya bshal btsod khu la// gur gum utpal ka ra sra byed sbyar// ser po gi waṃ sgro pus sra byed sbyar// khrag tu 'khru na dom mkhris sra byed sbyar// rgyu 'khor chu rtsa dud khu thal khu 'dra// a ru mchu skung skyer shun ba le ka / gser gyi me tog sra byed sbyar la btang / khrag nag she rul 'khru na ba sha ka / sle tres sra byed sbyar ba'i bsdus thang btang // rgyu 'khrog dmar po 'khru na gur gum dang // dom mkhris kur sbyar bong nga'i chig thang btang // chu skya bee snabs sug smil ka ra sbyar// rgyu lhags a ru mchu sung ba le ka / bsdus khur gser gyi me tog sum cu tig / tig ta bong nga dkar po btab la btang // long rtsa gnyis gtar

——— — — — 4——2ngagrod pa'i chu dugs bya/de yis 'khrur ma 'jod ma 'juba'i chis bu ba gsum byi stengadu ma byag hong le dus pus dri chur sbyar ba'i nyan ba la btang / zla phyed phar 'das rgyu rims cing pa rnams// ma gris phye bdun nam ind+ra ba'i thang bsten / 'khru ba dri bcas dugs yo da bshal gyis sbya nga / phye thug 'bras dang chu gros bskol grangs rnam sa// bongs chung grangs mang btang zhing gnod zas bsrung tsha ba chogs nas bcad dus sleb pa'i tshe// cong zhi rtsi mar gan chung dang gsum / yang na me tog bya rkang sha nus bsdus ba 'o glad pa spyin dang 'bras yo sa phye//tshos par btsos la rtsi gur btang bar bya// yang na da trig ka ped mon cha rasmag dang ja rams 'bras thug btab pa 'am// yang na gtsod khrag rgod khrag sbyar la btang yang na tha rams bya zang bsdus khu la mag dang da trig ka ped mon cha ra zhib btags btab la rtse gur yang ya nga btang 'khru drags snod kyi drod shor grang 'byams na// se 'bru lnga sbyar rgyu long gsang la bsreg/kha zas lug dang ba lang ri dgas mi/rma rul gsar pa'i tsho khu bongs chung btang // gsar 'jam gla ba rgya skyegs shing thal sbyar// cong 'i'i rgyus bran kha sos bag re bsten// 'khru ba ma chod bar du zas spyod gzab/sa ga//sdo rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag ri rgyud las rgyu gzer gyi rims bcos pa'i le'u ste nyi shu lnga pa'o

— — — — — — — — —le'u nyer drug pa/ gag phyog bcos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la/ drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus gag lhog rims la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang / de yi rtags dang bcos thabs ba da du gsol// de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa rgyu ni khrag sa nas dug can srin bu bdun// zangs lta ra dmar jing phra la bltar mi mngon/ skad cig tsam la ma sgo rkang khyab rgyu nus/ de la rkyen ni rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus skyed byed yul dus zas spyod gdon rkyen gyis//srin 'khrugs lu sa la zos pas gnyan nad 'byung / de phyir dkar mngar gnod cing dus gis 'joms/ dbye ba babs sa ming gis tha dad de mgo la babs na klad gzer zhes bya zhing // gre bar gag pa ro stod gzer thung ste/ pho bar gnyan glang rgyu mar rgyu gzer la pags la me dbal tshigs la chen bu skyedaka nya la nya log bar babs lhog par ba da/ sha rus rtsar bee ma 'drul phyir 'bras zhes bya/ 'on kyang 'di ru gag lhog gnyis su bsdu/ lhog pa'i dbye ba 'byung ba nad gzhi rigs/ 'byung bas dbye na sa me chu rlung ba'i/nad ga'is dbye na dkar nag khra bo gsum// rigs kyis dbye na rgod dang ཿ ya nga rgod dang / yam bu yu rngo zhes bya bzhi ru bshad// gas pa pho mo bu dang gnyan gag bo / brtas pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye bras gnyis/ spyi ru ngos bzung phyi nang gsang ba gsu ma/ phyi rtags skrangs dbyibs 'brum pa chu bur 'dra/ nya sgrul sdo ma sdis rta bla sbal ltong dang // na chung nu ma lta ra spangs nyams nga 'jigs // kha dog dam ra ram nas sru ga khra bor skra ngas ka na lus sa phrum ser khyer dang tshigs gzhi na// ma rgo na kha kha 'byo 'dar snying mi dga'ata

lko' na nga rngo na tan gyi da 279— — — — ——— —————nang rtas sa rtsa chu res bya rgyun sra nga ba'i/ rtsa ni kro rgyug gting grims khong ma 'dar/ chu nag rlangs 'thibs ku ya 'khrugs nas 'ong / reg bya tshor med yang na bzod pa chung / 'in tu tsha'am shin tu grang bar 'gyur// rgyun srangasogs sprin 'byil dang ba spu 'o ga an stong 'gram 'phar skul mchan dmar this 'byung // sa sang rtags chag po nu ri shu dag gla rtsi gsu ma btang dngangs 'dar yin bye brag rtags la lhog pa gag pa gnyis / lhog pa'i rtags la sa lhog skrangs brtan sra/ skrangs mdog thor pa 'i mgo bo nag por 'ong / me lhog dam ra tsha mched rkyen mes tshig 'dra// chu lhog 'jam bsil chu bur chu sor 'dzag rlung lhog skya gsob mi brtan 'phar zhib byed// dkar po zugachung rtsa chu phyi yu la grang // nag po zug che rtsa chu phyi yul tsha// mi bo rtags 'dres zug gzer ldang dub byed// rgod ni 'bros rkyen nad drag skrangs pa rkyen/yang rgod khong du 'chor rkyen 'khor la 'phro/ yam bu skrangs pa 'bar 'bur yams thabs 'ong / yu mo sra brtan nad zug chung ba'am// yang na snyi la 'dol zhing 'gul ba'o// la la lhog pa gnyid po zhes su 'dogs// gag pa ngos bzung lce steng bad lan mthug / lce mchu 'gram dang lon phus sa thor pa chags spe ba skad 'gags zas dang skom mi thar khyad par pho gag skar chen shar ba 'dra / mo gas rgya ngo ra kha sbub lta bu ste// bu sag co chal gtor ba 'dra bar 'ong / gnyan gag ral gri sna ma 'i gzhung 'dra 'am dus sbal rgyab dang khro bo'i mig dang 'dra// mis la rme thogs phyi yi rtas sa la bzung // bcos pa'i thabs la lhos pa gas pa gnyis / zas spyod bsad sbyang ba'i ni spyi ru rgyug / khyad par lhog pa byug pa bsres pa sa bcos / byer zhud 'khyam sa dang chu ser log pa mnam / gag pa 'i bzhu bcad pa gsum gyis bcos / ya ra rdzong mar rdzong shor babs 'o 0 gnon gces // dang po kha zas dkar mngar rul myur spang // phye tshod dral thug chu gros bsten par bya/ spyod lam chags pa

rgyal ———sde sde ———— ——nyi no gnying dras shul dang / rta chon 'khro 'tshig chu gal mi sdus spang / bas da thabs ma thun pa sman gyis bsad pa dang / mi mthun gzhin ngo sa bsad pa ra bya ba dang // nus pa sngags kyis bas da pa rnam pa gsum / ma thun pa gla rtsi bzang drug gu gul nas / tsha na sa bur bi waṃ bsnam la btang / grang na shu dag thing kun bsnan par bya yang na a byag stag sha gu gul nag gla rtsi shu dag a ru sbyar la btang // mi mthun gnyen pos bsad thabs rkyang sbyor dang //gtso 'khor sbrag dang mang sbyor chen mo gsum// dang po sngon 'gro bsdu bsad log gnon ba'i / sngon 'gro rdzas dmigs pa 'i nas tsam nas da ra 'bru sa/sum kyi 'brumagacig rgyas yer gcis bzhi chu dang sbyar la btang / nyes pa'i kha gnon yo na tan brgyad dang lda na bsdu ba bur dkar chang sbyar phul gang btang / rlung gnon byer bsdud gnyen pos gsod pa bla bsad la stan dang sbyar tshad btang thabs gsu ma/ sman ri phyi 'dzim nad 'jim gsang 'dzim gsum/ phyi 'dzim ra dug rtsa ba dus brkos pa// nang 'dzim ma go dgu ma bo bdun lnga gsum la/ gsang 'dzim 'bras bu lo gcig skyes pa'o// rma med zhag bdun me yi sprin la bdug / sbyar thabs nas tsam ka ra bdar phye dang / lo brgyad khye'u dge slong dri chur sbyar/ btang thabs ma sod bar du bskyar zhing btang rngul dbyung sod rtags lus po sor mo rengs/ zug chogs skrangs tshams rngul chur 'byung ba yin// log gnon ming po bdun gyi sring gcig ma// rtsa ba me tog dbyar dgun dus dang bstun/ thun re bod tshwa sbyar bas sman log 'doms/ sod rtags med kyang gsum gyi re re gces/ sbyor ba 'di la dman lhag 'o ga gsum 'gyur// dman pa ma sod g.yag shor rta chad 'dra/tsāsbyor ba log pa g.yag med rta rgyug 'dra// de bzhin lhag pa g.yag sod bang lhag 'dra / de phyir 'di la mkhas pas gzab par rigs// gtso 'khor bcas la gnyen po yod med gnyis/ med pa 'dzim pa shu dag ra thug spre// mi

lta na ngag yon tan gyi da 281yi dbyi rus thal ba bzhi sbyar te// thun tshad nad sbyar dri chus sbyangs la btang //rngul dbyung sman nad byung na sod pa yin// ma sod skyar zhing sod na log gnon gces// gtso 'khor gnyen por bcas la btsan dug dang // a ru gla rtsi mu zi gu gul nag / bzang drug ru rta shing kun shu dag dang / dri chu sbyar ba'i ril bu sran tsam bya// dngul chu bsnan yang mchog tu shis pa yin ma sod bar du btang zhing rngul du dbyung / mang sbyor tshe gcig lus gnyis blangs pa'i shas// gtso byas gdug pa can gyi sha rnams dang / gla rtsi gu gul mu zi la sogs pa// rdo rtsi sngo yi dri sman sna tshogs dang // seng ldeng la sogs tsher ma can rnams dang // btsan dug la sogs dug sna tshogs tshan dang spyotshad du dus sman chagacig tsher na gnyis sman gsum dri pan cha ba sbyar te rtsi bzhin btags byas la// dri chus sbrus pa'i ril bur sngags dbang bskur// gnyan nad ma lus nad rigs kun la 'gro/ khyad par gag lhog 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin// sngags kyis bsad pa lcags kyi bya khyung bsgom// sngags chu blun cing skrangs kyi mtha' na rdog / oṃ nag po kā la rakṣa rbad rbad/ sod sod/ phyungs phyungs/ sru gri zangs zangs/ lcags kyi sder mos gnod byed 'byung po'i snying la zo// nā ga byi ra ya sod/ nā ga byi ma ling sod/ smra ba bcad de bzlas pas gnyan rnams gsod// tha ma ro dbyung rgyal blon thar nu chu rtsa hong len dri chus sbyang //bshal thebs lcag gis brabs la dag par sbyang / yang na bzang drug gla rtsi gu gul nag / shu dag mu zi stag sha sha chen dang // lhog dug thar nu chu rtsa dug pus pa// gser gyi me tog hong len gi waṃ rnams/ dri chu sbyar bas gsod sbyong chig chod byed// de nas khyad par lhog pa bcos pa la/ byug pa 'dzim pa mu zi stag sha ba// gla rtsi gu gul gnyan dug lhog pa gsod/ so thog kyi lce brag spos chu rtsa dang // spru rtsa khyi spyang mi brun skrangs pa 'joms/ rwa gzhob dud pa bya bal bya brun te// brag zhun shu dag dri chu kun gyi grogs// zhib la sla ba ma

282 ༄ grwa nga da bzhi/skams yang yang byug / skrangs tshad mi bshig 'bros sna non pa gces// ma non thog bu spu nan phying nan bya// byug pa khong sman gnyis kyis ma sod na//me yis bsregs la lung pa'i mdo sgo bgag / ri bo'i rtse la me rgya gdab pa dang // skrangs kyi tha ma dmag gis bskor ba dang // steng du gnam lcags dbab pa bzhi yis bcos// bsregs rjes khong sman byug pa bstun la bsad//thub pa'i rtags su skrangs bri zug gzer chogs// yang na rnag tu khugs na 'tsho ba yin// rnag tu khugs nas yan lag ba'i na du bcos// nad log byer zhud 'khyams dang chu ser log / byer la rtsa sha skyi rnag byer ba bzhi/ rtsa byer me btsa' gtar ga sbyongs kyis dgug / sha byer khra bo nag po'i chas kyis dgug / skyi byer pags la byer ba skam rtsis dgug / rnag byer khrus nan deb dang chings kyis dgug / zhud pa gdon bcos zho sbang sbyar bas bslang //yang na sbang ma byug pas bran la bdug / 'khyams pa don 'khyams rtsa drag rngam pa rgod// 'phrang bcad khong du bsdus la gnyen pos bsad// snod 'khyams dang ga mi bde 'khru skyug byed// bshal gyis sbyang ba log gnon dam pa yin// chu ser nag por log na smyo 'bog byed// mig ldog sna nas chu ser khrag 'dzag na// sna bshal btang zhing ga bur rgyal blon sbyar// drug pa bdun pa dkar nag mtshams su bsreg / de la skyed med las kyis 'chi ba yin//gag pa'i bcos thabs zhi bzhu bcad pa ni// i ba tshwa btsod 'dzim pa pho tshos gdab// bzhu ba tsha la rgya tsha mtshur gnyis gdab// bcad pa rgya tsha ru rta shu dag gdab// des ma chod na skyung bus ba 'ar rjes bsreg / gag pa gnyan tshad gre bar 'gags pa'i phyir// 'di la dpyad mchog sbyongs 'dra gzhan na med// nad log yar rdzong glad la shor ba na// sna nas chu ser 'dzag cing blab chol smra// de la sna bshal btang la chu ser sbyang // mar rdzong snying la shor na shes pa spyo// lce gzhung nag la ga bur rgyal blon sbyar// de la skyed med tshe zad
cu khanang ga yon tan gyi da/ 283spang bar bya// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gag lhog bcos pa'i le'u ste nyi shu drug pa'o// //

284le'u nyer bdun pa/ cham rims bcos pa/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la// drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad zhus// cham pa'i rims la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // de yi rtags dang bcos thabs bshad du gsol// de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa//cham pa'i rgyu ni rims spyi 'dra ba la// khyad par mi gtsang zas spyod kha zas 'dres// rdul tshub grib phog rkyen las 'byung ba yin// dbye ba gre cham glo cham rims cham dang // sna cham dag dang rnam pa bzhi yin no// de rtags dang po gre ba rkan mtshul tsha// bar du sna chu 'dzag cing mtshul pa 'gags// tha ma sbrid pa mang du bskud cing 'ong // glo cham dang po gre ba tsha zhing 'dzer// bar du glo mang mgo dang brang rgyab na// tha ma rnag tu lu zhing glo gcong 'gyur// rims cham mgo dang tshigs ga'i byin nya na// ro stod mi bde brla rked brdungs snyam byed// kha kha dang ga mi bde grang shum byed// srod la sha tsha mi lam za zi mang //de la drag shul bcud shor rgyas gyur na// cham pa skyur shor zhes bya shi ba mang //sna cham sna tsha g.ya' la sna chu mang // bcos thabs gre cham zas spyod gzabs pas 'tsho// glo cham a ru ra yi kham mur bya// sro lo shing mngar spang rgyan grang thang btang // gre ba tsha 'dzer li shi drug pa sbyar/ mjug tu cham rgan lud pa ma chod na// nyi shu rtsa lngas tsha ba'i gting bton la// bur dkar gsar 'jam bsil bcud glo rlung gso// cham rims snang bar 'dug la chu bskol btung //'bras bu gsum dang sle tres tig ta dang // ma nu hong len thang btang jul du dbyung // dri bzang bzhi dang zho sbyar cham pa sel// se 'bru skyu ru zho sbyar de bzhin no// ba lu da trig ltar bu tsha ba gsum// zi ra dbyi mong tsi tra ka cha
