zhu na nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 285gnyis// dri bzang bzhi la cha phyed ka ra sbyar// lud pa cham pa rgyas dang dbugs mi bde// 'joms par byed cing skad snyan yi ga 'byed// sna cham yo sa kyi rlangs pas bdugs na phan// chu 'phrul chab tsha phye tshod zho dar bsten//drag shul nyin gnyid drod bcud spang bar bya/ skyams nas rims sam 'khrugs su shor ba na// brtson pas rang rang gzhung bzhin bcos par bya zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las cham rims bcos pa'i le'u ste nyi shu bdun pa'o// / /

286le'u nyer brgyad pa/ mgo nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// lus stod gso ba'i skabs la ji ltar bslab bar bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol//zhes zhus pa dang // ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / lus stod dbang po'i gso thabs mgo dang mig / rna ba sna dang kha dang lnga ba drug / dang po mgo yi nad la rgyu rkyen dang // dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs rnam bzhir bstan// rgyu rkyen dud pa nyi tshan gnyid chag dang // chang mangs mang smras ngu ba drags pa dang // rlung tshub ma goms dris phog rgyu las 'byung // dbye ba gtso bo'i nad brgyad phal pa drug / dang po rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun dang // ldan pa'i nad gsum mgo yi srin dang brgyad// phal pa ma rlung men 'bras glog pa can//sku sbyi sbyi ther skra dkar rnam pa drug / de rtags rlung gyur mu 'gram zug cing gzer// dpral ba smin mtshams lug pa snyam du sems// rna ba 'ur zhing so dang 'gram pa na// rtsa 'khyug lta ba mi bzod sna chu mang // ldang dub na zhing snum dugs bsdams na bde// mkhris gyur rims 'dra mgo lus mig rnams tsha//du bas bdugs sem mtshan dus grangs na bde// khrag gyur rtse chung rgyangs la mu 'gram gzer// chang dang drag shul gnyid dang nyi tshan gnod// bad gan las gyur mgo lci zas mi 'im// skyug cing mig skrangs mtshan mo'i dus na bde//bad mkhris mgo nad me nyis dros tshe na// mgo lci dang ga mi bde chang nad che//bad rlung lci 'khyom zi la zas mi zhim// rlung mkhris gnyis ldan dpral mig

zhu khanang ga yon tan gyi da/ 287mur 'gram na// grang dro nges med phyed gong bkres dus ldang // rtsa rnams 'phar zhing bsil phebs gongs dus bde// mgo srin sems 'khrul stobs chung mi bzod na// snabs kyi mdog dmar rgya srubs steng du skrangs/ nges med nad ldang zas spyod phan gnod chung // gang langs rtsa 'phar sgra skad drag shul ldang // dkar nag 'khar gong bsregs la mchil mas brtag / ma rlung bu la shor ba mgo bo spangs// de bzhin then 'bras sra bar spangs pa dang |srin nad 'brum phran glog pas khyab pa dang // bad gan khrag mkhris chu ser skra rtsa srul// kor ler skra byi spyi bo ther po dang // lus drod mgor zhugs skra tshos skra dkar 'byung slo bcos thabs rlung las gyur pa'i mgo nad la zhun mar rjes la 'o ma dron mo blud/ sha sna mang brdungs 'u sus bran btsos bdug /mar sna tshogs dang ka ra sbyar la byin// rlung 'joms sman dang zhun mar sbyar ba 'am// ras bal sa bon shing tsha dza ti dang // gla sgang chu dron la btab sna sman btang // rgya srubs rnams su hor gyi me btsa' bya/ sdud sgo gsum dang 'phar rtsa gang langs bsreg / mkhris gyur mar gsar snum 'chos rjes la gtar// bsil ba'i skyug 'khrus sbyang zhing chu yis bran// tsan dan utpal rgya spos ru rta byug / ka ra gur gum mar gsar sna sman btang // khrag gyur 'bras bu gsum gyi thang btang la// gtar dang 'al 'al bya zhing chu lcag bdeg /bad gyur mar rnying snum rjes skyug tu gzhug / tsha ba lnga dang spyang tsher ba yis bdug / tsi tra ka dang sga skya sran phye byug / sprung byas la phug sbrang rtsi'i sna sman btang // bad mkhris mgond chu lcag 'tshogs gsang dbye// lo grangs chus bran bul tog btab la mnye// skems nas zhun mar byug cing se 'bru sbyar//bad rlung mgo nad gnyis ka ldan par bcos// rlung mkhris mgo nad rlung gyur lta bur gso// de rjes khyad par gtar ga mang du gdab// srin la gtar khrag dron mo snar blug la// nya rul shing kun byi tang ga dang gsum// ba chu sbyar

288 zhu/grwa thang rgyud bzhi/ba'i sna sman btang 'byung 'gyur// mar dang sbyar ba'i du ba sna ru bdug gla rtsi btsan dug shing kun ma ru tse// lang thang tse dang rtsad btsod phur mo rnams//sha tshil sbyar la bsregs pa'i du bas bdug / ma rlung rlung bcos byas rjes 'bras ltar gso// then 'bras nad la de yi gso ba sbyar// glog pa can la lcags kyi zhal zhal gdab// ba gcin khyim bya'i brun dang 'ba' cha bsku//yang na rta sbangs khu ba tsha btab byug / spyi ther kor ler skra 'byi sbyongs byas la//thur mas btsags te phag pa'i skang mar tshil// so ma ra dza skyu ru ra sbyar byug /sbangs ma ldong ros nal sham nag mtshur byug / yang na spangs ma ru rta thal tres til utpal 'o ma sbrang sbyar lde gu byug / yang na padma ge sar skyu ru ra//shing mngar til nag sbrang dang sbyar la byug / rtsa ba lnga dang til mar sna sman blug / skra dkar lug ru'i thal ba yungs kur byug / shing mngar stag tsher tsan dan pi pi ling // utpal skyu ru'i khu ba mar bskol ba'i// sna sman mgo bskus skra dkar glad nad sel// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mgo nad gso ba'i le'u ste nyi shu brgyad pa'o// / /

289le'u nyer dgu pa/ mig nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsung so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / mig gi nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen nad kun 'khrug par byed pa dang // khyad par sha rul tsong sgog chang skyur sogs// mig la gnod cing khrag mkhris skyed pa'i zas// bsten pa rtsa nang 'grims pas mig nad skyed//spyod lam drag shul mi theg khur ba dang // du ba bser bu kha ba mtshon la sogs// rkyen gyis phog pas mig nad skyed par byed// dbye ba mig chu'i nad dang mig chog dang // ling thog rab rib 'gribs dang rnam pa lnga// mig chu rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun dang // 'dus pa srin bu mig nad sgra ngan bdun// tshag po skam tshag gsher tshag gdung gyur gsum// de la rlung mkhris bad gan khrag dang bzhi// ling thog rab rib dbye ba'ang de bzhin no//'gribs la srod long phyi nang bar 'gribs gsum// phyi 'gribs sha lhag sha mdzer rtsa dra dang // sngo rib ling ros khebs dang rnam pa lnga// nang 'gribs chu 'khrugs rtsa mdangs nyams pa gnyis// bar 'gribs rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa bzhi// sum cu rtsa gsum mig nad dbye bar 'dod// de rtags mig chu'i nad la rlung gyur pa// mchi ma 'dzag cing rdul gyis gang snyam sem//'dzums par dka' dang dus med 'byed 'dzums byed// chu dang bad gan /pa rnag g.ya ṭā shāXs skra pag la/ chu ma// ༵ shā nā kā ga // 3sdo rdzu baṃ spya 'brum phran dmar pos khyab// bad kun las gyur 'brum phran dkar pos

290 zhu/grwa thang dba'i/gang / mig nang 'byar zhing g.ya' la zug chung bka 'dus gyur mig zhu dzi ma nang du zug / tsha skrangs mchi ma 'dzag cing mig mchu 'byar// srin gyur then bu sub 'dod g.ya' ba 'byung / byis pa'i mig nad sgra ngan so skye tshe// ma nad las byung dmar tsha 'byar zhing skrangs// lag pas mig dang sna nyed gso dka' yin// mig nad skam tshag bad rlung las gyur pa// mig skam tsub cing tsha la bser bu gnod// gsher tshag khrag dang mkhris pa las gyur pas//dmar tsha nyi ma mi bzod mchi mas khengs// gdung ba'i mig nad rlung gyur ldang dub byed// rdul gyis gang ngam bus snyam byed pa dang // mgo 'khor rna ba 'ur zhing mig dmar skrangs// mkhris gyur tsha grang dmar 'drul ser por mthong // me mdag gtor snyam mdzer thabs khyab pa yin// khrag gyur shin tu na zhing reg mi bzod// me nyi mi bzod mig dmar dmar por mthong // bad kun g.ya' skrangs mig gi 'bras bu zhu// gdung ba phal cher so dang mur 'gram dang // mkhur tshos mgo bo na zhing rib tshabs che// ling thog mig 'bras dkar nag steng dag tu// rlung gyur sngo srab mkhris pa thig le ser//khrag gyur mtshon gyis gtses 'byung dmar por 'ong / bad gan las byung mthug cing skya bas g.yogs// kun la zug che tsub cing mchi ma 'byung //mthong byed steng byung zangs gzer 'dra gso dka'// rab rib nad de mig chu'i nang du 'jug / de yang rim pa bzhin du 'jug 'gyur te// dang por zhugs tshe res gsal res mi gsal / gnyis par zhugs tshe thag ring chung mi mthong / nye 'ing gzir bltas legs mthong go log snang // steng 'og g.yas g.yon nye ring logs mi gsal// 'di dus rab rib ces bya gso ba sgrims/rlung gyur du ba rab rib skra shad dang // sbrang bu 'od mthong gzugs kun g.yo bar snang // mkhris gyur glog dang me sgron rma bya'i sgro// khrag gyur dmar la bad kon mun 'thibs 'gyur// gsum par zhugs tshe steng mthong 'og mi mthong //

sa khanang g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 291ras kyis mig bkab ltar mthong nad mdog snang // sngon po zhes bya'i rim pa bzhir phyin nas// rgyal mo khebs te long bar 'gyur ba yin// 'gribs pa srod long nag po lang ling khebs// sha lhag skya bo zug chung dal bus skye// sha 'dzer ra ril lta bur dmar la 'bur// de rgyas mdog nag rgya che mthug pa yin// rtsa yi dra bas mthug khyab de nyid do// sngo sgrub sgong bas lta bus khyab pa ste// ling ro srab dang mthug pas sgribs pa gnyis/ mthug po sbo ma tsha rdog mig gnyis spang // chu 'khrugs mtsho gnyis 'dres te snag tsha 'dra / rgyal mo'i rtsa mdang nyams pas nag sang 'ong // rlung 'gribs nyi ma mkhris 'gribs 'ug mig dang // bad tan zla ba 'dus pa 'ja' tshon 'dra// rtags las nad ngos ma 'dres so sor bzung // gso ba'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag ga nyis/ spyi ru sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi yis bcos// sman du gsal byed lde gu 'bras gsum mar// a ba bco lnga la sogs khong du btang / dpyad du snum 'chos khrus skyugs gtar ga bya ldong ros rgya mtsho'i sbu ba spang spos dung // gla rtsi utpal sug sprel skyer khaṇḍa// tsan dan gur gum rgyam tsha tsha ba gsum// ka ra sbrang sbyar byugs na mig gi nad// rab rib sha 'dzer tshag 'gribs nad kun sel//zas spyod tsha skyur rul sungs tsong sgog za// sne tshod lo bshur mar nag bur skug dang // du ba bser bu kha ba chags pa spyod// drag shul skang ches 'don pa la sogs spang / khyad par mig chu rlung gyur gur gum dang / mar rnying chur bskol sna sman mig brta bya skyer pa'i khaṇḍa nu zho sbrang sbyar byug / mkhris gyur 'brum pa bzhar rjes chu dron bkru/ ga bur dom mkhris yung ba a ru ra//nu zho sbrang rtsi sbyar la byug par bya// khrag gyur 'brum pa bzhar zhing gang nye gtar// btsod dang skyer pa rgya skyegs rgyan 'brum dang // utpal bskol grangs ka ra mig tu blug / bad gyur 'brum pa bzhar la nag mtshur dang / pi pi ling dang rgya tsha ldong ros dang // stang zil sprang dang sbyar la mig tu blug /

292 ༄gyi/grwa thang rgyud bzhi/'dus pa'i mig mchu rdzi ma phyis byas la/ skyer pa'i khaṇḍa ldong ros zangs phye dang // nag mtshur byi rug zangs nang sbangs khu blug / byi rug nag mtshur zangs nang bzhag pa byug / srin gyur ba snyi'am rta sbangs dugs byas nas//thor pa btol la nag mtshur rgya tsha dang // 'bras bu gsum dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba byug / mig nad sgra ngan ma nu'i skyug khrus bya// seng phrom nim pa hong len ser po gnyis// zangs phye nu zho sbyar ba mig la byug / chu ser rnag khrag gra mtshams las 'dzag na// a ru bul tog sprang rtsi dri chus bkru// de rjes ga bur dom mkhris skyer khan byug / skam tshag ti tsha ser po cu gang dang // mar gsar ka ra me long g.ya' blangs byug / yang na mi skra mar sbyar nus ldan bsregs/thal ba mar gsar me long g.ya' sbyar ram// rag dud mar gsar me long g.ya' sbyar byug / gsher tshag dpral rtsa mig rtsa sna rtse gtar// skyer pa'i khaṇḍa ra 'o sbyar ba byug / mig tshag kun la sag rtsi tsha ba gsum// yung ba dung dang ti tsha ser po dang // mar gsar me long g.ya' dang sbyar la byug / gdung ba'i mig nad rlung gyur 'bras gsum mar// smin ma'i steng dang ltag pa'i spu 'khyil dang // rkang pa'i rting pa'i dreg mtshams me btsa' gdab// khrag mkhris las gyur khong sbyang gtar ga bya// shing mngar skyer pa kuṇḍa ka ri yi// khaṇḍa ra gan dud pa na le sham// sbyar bskus dmar tshag gzer zhing 'drul ba sel//gsal byed dgu pa'i sde gu btang bar bya// bad kun skyugs byas nim pa 'bras bu gsum seng phrom ba sha ka khu dro 'jam blug / mar rnying tsha ba gsum dang sbyar ba bza'// ling thog khrag mkhris mtshon gyis gtses pa la// 'khrus sman gtar ga skyer khan dom mkhris byug / rlung gyur zhun mar bza' bdug sgog chab btang // bad kun las gyur nya phag sha yis bshig / kun la a ru bul tog dri chus bkru// yang na rdo mkhris dom mkhris ka ra btab// mtshe sbyin btsan dug zhim thig rgya chos blang // ling thog rnyings nas shu dag 'bras bu

༄ na ngag yon tan gyi da/ 293gsum// ru rta ka ra'i phye ma btab pas sel spangs ma 'gron bu ldong ros btsag yug rnam// rgya mtsho'i sbru ba mgo rus stang zil dung / khyim bya'i sgo nga sbyar bskus ling thog gcod// cu gang gur gum ga bur gla rtsi dang / lig pu mig btags ka ra sbyar ba byug / sbang lums byas rjes sbos su tshor ba dang kul cha'i dud pas bdugs rjes lcags skyus bshu spyo rab rib kun la shing mngar ra mnye gnyis// kuṇḍa ka ri utpal a ru ra// pi pi ling dang ka ra rgun 'brum dang spyo ra 'o ba mar 'bras gsum ba sha ka / bsdus khus rab rib sel bar byed pa yin// 'bras gsum shing mngar sbrang rtsi'i lde gu sbyar// nyal khar bza' zhing zla gcig phan zas bsten// skyu ru'i khu ba 'thungs na rab rib sel// ta bya shing mngar lcags phye ka ra srung // mar rnying 'bras bu sbyar bas rab rib sel// a ru sbrang rtsi rgyun du zas gong bsten// cong zhi bsil gsum utpal 'bras bu gsum// go snyod shing mngar brag zhun sbrul gyi sha / lcags phye a ba rnam gnyis ka ra sbyar/ yun du bsten na mig gi bcud len 'gyur//spangs ma gser rdo shing mngar na le sham 'o mar sbangs la du ba ma shor bsreg / lde gu byugs pas rab rib sel bar byed// spangs ma shing mngar bar skyur na le sham/ chur btags ril bu bdar bskus rab rib sel/utpal skyer pa'i khaṇḍa tsha ba gsum// ru rta a ru ra yis rab rib 'phyag / sgrul gyi ro gcig sdig pa'i ro bzhi rnams// nyi shu rtsa gcig 'o mar bsrul pa'i mar/khyim bya gsos pa'i brun gyi lde gu byug / mkha' lding bya rgod lta bu'i mig 'thob 'gyur// a ru ra dang dom mkhris rgya skyegs dang / gla rtsi bul tog chu gtsang 'khar snod sbyangs// mig tu btigs pas this g.yogs rab rib sel ling ro rtsa dra la sogs 'gribs kun gcod/ ga bur gla rtsi rgya tsha sgo nga la/ oṃ na ga sha ri rbad/ ga to sha ri rbad/ thug nan sha ri rbad su lhu/ sru ba bcad de sgong spris zhu bar bzlas// 'debs dus nyi shu rtsa re khong du btang // sman byugs

294 sto/grwa thang da ba /sngags gdab 'grib byed ma lus sel// nya phag sgo nga go snyod rgyun du bsten//rkang bkru 'bri mar phag tshil go stod byug / rkang rjen mi bya gnod pa'i zas spyod bsrung // srod long na le sham dang zho sbyar byug / ba lci mcher pa'i nang du pi pi ling // bcug bsregs grib skams sbrang sbyar lde gu byug / ra mchin dmar po zos na srod long sel// sha mdzer gsar dus khrag mkhris lta bur bcos// rnyings nas khab rtses phug la mtheb mos mnye/ sha lhag rtsa dra sha mdzer rgyas pa na// dang po khrus gtar sman gyis bcos byas la// dugs byas mtheb mos mnyes la btsag bus bshu// chu lcag byas te sprang mar byugs la bcing // de rjes a ru'i lde gu nus lda na bsregs// bar sgyur khu bar sbyar la grib skams bya// rgya tsha nyis 'gyur sbyar ba'i phye ma btab// dpyad byas bshul gyi nad lhag ma lus gcod / rab rib ling ro lde gu nus ldan bsreg / sngo rib ling ro srab mo chu 'byed bya// pa yag 'bras bu lug ru 'im thig le// 'gron thal nya mkhris sen rtsi 'dzib bu ka / khyi glad sbrang smyon sbyar ba blug rjes 'phyag / phyi 'gribs ma lus sel bar byed pa yin// nang 'gribs zas spyod khong sman dag la 'bad// bar 'gribs dpyad mchog thur mas dbye bar bya//de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi phyi rjes gsum// sngon 'gro nad dus rim gro dpyad dang bzhi// nad gzhi'i sngon 'gro dbyer rung mi rung brtag / dbyer mi rung ba lud pa cham pas btab// ma zhu 'khru skyug mgo gzer yod pa dang // lus la dgra dar spar kha li la babs// 'dus pa'i mig tshil zhu ba dbyer mi rung //phyi 'gribs nang 'gribs thur mas dbyer mi phyed// ma smin dus su bsal yang slar 'gebs spang // me zla nyi ma shar nub mi mthong na// dus 'das rgyal mo'i mthu nyams dbyer mi rung // dbyer rung de zlog chu nang zhag thigs 'dra// zla ba nya ltar gang ba dbye bar bya// dus kyi sngon 'gro rlung 'gribs lo gsum smin//bad kun lo gcig 'dus pa phyed dang gnyis// mkhris pa zla ba drug gis smin

sa khan nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 295pa'i dus// ma smin gnod pa'i zas kyis smin par bya// rim gro sngon 'gro chab gtor brgya rtsa dang // gral lnga 'don zhing lha mchod gnod pa bsal/ dpyad kyi sngon 'gro nad bshig bsal bla'i phyir/ lo ngar zhu mkhan tshang btsos rlangs dugs bya/ dngos gzhi cho ga gsang sa brdog thabs dang // bsal thabs sol tshad brtan bya legs nyes rtags / spyi don rnam pa bdun du shes par bya//dang po thur ma'i tshad dang bca' gzhi gnyis/ thur ma'i rgyu ni gser zangs ra gan gsum bra bo 'bri lce khodang gzong kha 'dra// srid sor drug pa rtse mo rgyal mo gang // zheng du de'i phyed mgrin pa gro mgrin tsam// srid du bar mtsho do dbus ri mo gdod// thur rten gru bzhi sbom la thur 'bas phra// chag tshad ldan pas skyon spong yon tan 'byung / lus kyi bca' gzhi gza' skar tshes bzang la// sprin med nyi ma 'de sar 'du long bsdams// snga dro shar bltas lo mthun g.yog gis brten// snam bu gtsang mas lag pa rked pa dril// sman pa mdun ngos nas kyi khri steng 'dug / g.yog gis rdo gnyis mi 'byed ngos su brdung // de yi sgra la nad pa mig bltar gzhug / gsang sa lha mi bdud kyi bu ga gsum// tshad dang ldan pa'i dar yes gsang mtshon te// gyes na nad mi sums la bsdus na 'byar// mthos na mi non dmas na mi sums pas/bdud las phyir bskyed btsan las gdong byol ba'i// thur rtse gang gi dbus su brdeg par bya// bdeg thabs g.yo na pas mig mi 'gul bar bzung //g.yas kyis thur 'bas gsang de bstan byas la// thur ma bzlog ste mtheb mdzub gung mos bzung // ma zhum brtan pas gsang du legs btsugs la//thur ma bya mi 'da' ba'i man ngag gis// mig gi dkyil du bsdigs la rnams kyis dbul// legs phugs pus zhes bya ba'i sgra byung nas// 'tshi med bal gyis mig la chu lcag bya// bsal thabs rang la gdung tshugs bltar bcug la//thur ma bsnyal te rgyal mo'i steng du btang // rgyal mo skya rib thur rtse mnyam par

296 cu grwa thang dba'i/'dod// phan ltar dril dang tsong ltar bshu ba dang // 'o ltar dbo dang sru ltar gzings pa yis// sgrib byed bsal la thur ma'i 'og tu sba mthor na bsdu zhing bros na dgug pa dang / shor na bslan zhing smas na khu yis gdab// sol tshad nyi ma gza' las thar ba bzhin/ phra rags gzugs rnams phral du gsal ba yin// 'o ltar bo na de dus mi gsal yang // nad chu dngas nas ga le phyi nas gsal// de 'og mi ldog brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ skad 'don glo lu dbugs bsdam gom 'ga' bcag / log na bsal zhing ma log brtan pa dang // chu bal glan la de stengs ras mas bcing // mal du bsnyal la thur ma dril te gdon// rngas mthor byas la mig de 'og ngos bstan// legs pa'i rtags la 'dod pa rnam gsum yo da// nags la kha ba babs 'dra 'dod pa yin// gangs la nyi ma shar 'dra 'dod pa yin// dpyad rjes zug med bde na 'dod pa yin// nyes pa'i rtags la mi 'dod rnam pa gsum/ phug dus khrag gis gang na de mi 'dod// sel dus rnyog nag langs na de mi 'dod// dpyad rjes zug gzer langs na de mi 'dod// phyir rjes zas spyod bslab dang log pa mnan/ kha zas mar dkar 'o zan 'tshos par btsos// skyo 'dur bldan mi dgos pa lto srung bsten// skom na chu grog bag tsam btung bar bya// sbrid pa glo lu snabs phyi mchil ma 'dor// ldang nyal la sogs drag shul kun la gzab//mig gi man ngag chu yin nan tan bskyed// zhag gsum lon nas bcings pa bkrol la blta zhag bdun lon nas kha zas cha yis glod// rlung shas che na de bas bag sngar glod// gnod pa'i zas spyod dug 'dra rgyun du gzab// log non 'grams dang 'gribs pa zhar ba gsum// dang po sha rus rtsa dang gdon 'grams bzhi sha 'grams ltag par zug dang mig mi theg / lus jul mgo lci rab rib mchi ma mang // ltag pas spyo dugs sku mtshams mur gong bsreg /nus 'grams mig 'bras yan lag tshigs gzhi dang / dpral ba mig rus na

zhu na ngag yon tan gyi da/ 297na 'tshogs ma'i steng // tsha ba gsum mam 'bru par dugs kyis bdug / rtsa 'grams mig dmar mi theg mgo phyed na/ ske mjing mi bde lus sbrid chu nan bskyed// dpral rtsa mig rtsa sna rtse la sogs gtar// gdon 'grams tshig pa za la lus po 'dar// rngul 'byung grang shum byed na bskud las bya// gzhan yang nyes pa gang 'brel sbyor bas gso/ spyod lam rkyen gyis nad log 'gribs pa la// sbrul sha a ba gur gum go ston dang // ka ra mar gsar lug mchin brgyangs pa btang / bsil gsum ga dur skyer pa'i khaṇḍa dang // nu zho ra 'o sbyar ba mig tu blug / gsal byed bdun dgu'i lde gu sbyar la btang // skyed med zla ba phyed nas bur log bskyar// zhar ba'i log non zug gzer bcag pa gces/ ga bur dom mkhris skyer pa mig tu blug / gang nye'i rtsa gtar chu lcag drag tu bya/ dom mkhris la sogs mkhris pa'i lcag mda' btang //bsil gsum 'bras gsum phye sbrang sbyar bza'// zas spyod bsil bsten drod bcud spang bar bya// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mig nad bcos pa'i le'u ste nyer dgu pa'o// //

298le'u sum cu pa/ rna ba'i nad gso ba/cide nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / rna ba'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen zas dang spyod lam gdon sogs kyis// 'du ba 'khrugs te rna ba'i nad skyed 'gyur// dbye ba rna ba nad dang 'on pa gnyis ta nad ni rlung mkhris bad kun khrag dang ba'i// 'dus gyur rnag 'dzag 'brum thor 'byung ba drug / 'on pa sgra bcas 'on dang rna pags 'gags// skam 'on ma rlung bu la shor ba bzhi// de rtags rna nad rlung gyur stong snyam sem// zug che grangs na mi bde gzhogs phyed na// mkhris gyur tsha bcas zug che mgo bo na// chu ser myur 'dzag gang reg 'brum thor rnag /rna ba nang 'grams khrag gyur lci zug che// bad kun las gyur mgo dang 'gram pa lci/ zug chung g.ya' skrangs rnyings nas rnag skam 'dzag / 'dus gyur kun gyi rtags ldan sgra mi thos// rnag mdog ska sla ma nges rgyun du 'dzag / 'on pa sgra bcas chu bshang rnga sgra thos// rna lhags 'gags na rna ba khengs 'thibs lci// skam 'on stong sang nag gam dmar ba'o// ma rlung byis pa so skye las byung tshe// ma rlung bu la shor bas rnag 'dzag 'on// gso thabs rlung gyur snum ldan drod dugs bya// sgog skya bca' sga shi kun mar sbyar btang // la phug skam po chang du bcos byas la// brdungs btsir khu ba rgyam tsha dro 'jam blug / yang na sgron shing sdong bsregs snum sbyar ram// rgyam tsha ru rta ra thug chu sbyar blug / de la skyed chung 'ba' sam sman mar sbyar// mkhris gyur ka ra mar dang bcas pa bza'// de 'og bsil ba'i 'khrus btang mngar bas dgang // ru rta a ru'i

stom na nga g.yon tan gyi da 299thang btang rna bar blug / khrag gyur de bzhin khyad par gang nye gtar// bad gyur pi pi ling dang mar bskol bslud// de rjes skyugs bya sgog skya la phug dang //sge gsher khu ba gang rung rna bar blug / rnag 'dzag red sbyang sman bskus bal nas phyi// yang na snum 'chos rjes la rna ba sbyang // ru rta la phug byang pa rgya tsha dang // sge gsher zhib btags dar tshags la bton la// 'bru mar sbyar te 'jam tsam spos la mnan// langs nas khyi bal ye lus rna bar btigs// khyi bal bag zan ras gsar legs par bgag / rna ba rngabs kyis drangs pas nad kun sbyong // rnag 'dzag pa dang rna pags 'gags pa sel// yang na rgya tsha shu dag gser phud bu// sgog skya ru rta cha mnyam zhib btags la// bal dril sgog chur bcug btsir khu ba blug / zhag gsum lon nas sbubs mas drang bar bya// 'brum thor skyung bus bzhar rjes pi pi ling // rgyam tsha ldong ros nye shing tsi tra ka / dan da sbrang mar sbyar ba'i reng bu gzhug / sgra bcas 'on la 'bru mar bsros la blug / de 'og shing kun shu ti skyer bar shun// kyi lce bong nga dkar po tsha ba gsum// yungs dmar ba'i 'gyur tsha bskol blug pas phan//rna pags 'gags na sgog skya la phug khu// 'bru mar sbyar ba ru rta rma bya'i mdongs// rgyam tsha btab la 'jam bsros rna bar blug / thur la sbub nyal nang par rngabs kyis drang // yang na gla rtsi shing kun kha ru tsha// ru rta la phug mug chos rma bya'i mdongs // 'bru mar sbyar la rnar blug rjes la bru// skam 'on shing kun ru rta gla rtsi dang // mug chos til mar sbyar blug bal yes phyi//dmar sang la ni gdon bcos bya bar shis// 'on pa kun la sgog skya la phug chu//ra thug chu dang rgyam tsha rgya tsha dang // ru rta gla rtsi shing kun mug chos 'bras//rnar blug ye 'us bru zhing rdzabs kyis drang // la phug bca' sga'i thal ba skyer bar shun// shing kun shu dag shu ti kha ru tsha// rgya tsha ru rta kyi snye ya bakṣa/ gro ga'i thal ba gla sgang 'bru mar dang // tshwa sings bzhi 'gyur lham khur bskol te

300 sa /grwa nga da bzhi/blug / g.ya' skrangs sgra bcas rnag 'dzag 'on pa sel// ma rlung gsang zhug rnag 'dzag bcos dang mtshungs 'ba' sam mar sbyar rnyings nas spang bar bya// zhes gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rna ba'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste sum cu pa'o// //

301le'u so gcig pa/ sna nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang sro nga chen po nyon cig / sna nad rgyu rkyen dbye ba bcos thabs gsum//rgyu rkyen zas dang spyod lam gdon rkyen gyis// 'du ba 'khrugs pas sna nad skyed par byed// dbye ba sna subs 'brum thor sha lu dang / rnag khrag 'dzag dang rnam pa lngar bshad do// bcos thabs rnag dang chu ser sna 'gags na//dbugs 'tshub mtshul pe shu la sna bshal btang // drod sman ltar bu shing mngar sbrang rtsi sbyar// gdong skrangs stod brgyangs mtshul pa 'gag pa sel//'brum bor byung na ti tsha mar dkar byug / dan da dur byin sdong ros lce myang tsha// tsi tra ka dang pi ling dang mar sbrang // reng bu sbyar la sna nang gzhug par bya// des ma sel na rna ba lta bur bcos// skam zhing tsha na gur gur zhun mar blug / sna la 'bras byung sna nad sha lu yin// brud dang gcod sman gtar lums skems kyis bcos// phal cher 'tsho dka' sngon gyi las nad yin//tshad ro rdzong la bros te rnag 'dzag na// skyugs rjes rgya skyegs shing kun byi tang ga / bu ram pi pi ling dang na le sham// lug thug gcin dang sbyar ba'i sna sman btang // yang na tsha ba gsum dang dug mo nyung // zi ra byi tang ga yi khu ba blug / thong tsher mgo sha rus pa klad par bcas// zi ra dkar po shing kun btab la bsdu// sga dang pi pi ling gnyis 'tshos kur gdab// lto stong bskol btang 'bras bu'i sman mar bya// sna nas khrag 'dzag de rigs rnam pa gsum//ser la sla ba glad pa las 'byung ste// smin dbrag mes bsdam rta pags sna sman btang // smug nag sne gzhi las babs sne sa bcing // nu ma rlig pa za 'og

302 zhu/grwa thang dab skud pas skyig / dmar la gdang pa rtsa kha bye ba yin// sna yi dbugs kyis gar sleb dpung 'dzum bsreg / sna ru bsur bdug thang dang lde gu btang // kun la mkhan skya 'am spru ma'i reng bu yi// mgo la gur gum dom mkhris zab 'gron thal// lde gu byugs la phugs su slob par brdzang // sna khrag phal cher khrag 'phel las 'byung bas// rtse chung gtar te 'ol kha bsgyur bar bya// zhes gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud la sa sna nad gso ba'i le'u ste so gcig pa'o// / /

303le'u so gnyis pa/ kha nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / kha yi nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi ru bshad// rgyu rkyen zas dang spyod lam gdon la sogs// 'du ba 'khrugs pas kha nad skyed par byed// dbye ba mchu snyil so lce gre ba rkan// mchu nad gre mchu sho re bad kun dang // gcen dang khrag rgyas kha shu drug tu bshad// so nad bad rlung khrag mkhris so 'bras srin lce nad rlung mkhris bad dan rtse lhag skrangs// rkan nad lce chung babs dang lce 'dra dang // rkan 'brum chu bur nus sbal rkan smin no// gre ba'i nad la rlung dang mkhris pa khrag / bad kun 'dus pa 'bras dang men bu 'o// sum cu tham pa kha nad dbye bar bshad// de rtags gre mchu mchu nad sha rmen skyes// sho re mchu gas bad kun skya tshos tsha// gcen ni 'brum thor na la tsha ba 'byung / khrag rgyas skug la sbom par skrangs pa yin/ kha shu mchu la shu ba chags pa'o// snyil nad g.ya' zhing 'drul la khrag rnag 'dzag / rlung gis so nad ber ba langs nas na// 'phar rtsa 'khrug cing grang mo bzod thabs med// khrag mkhris drod che rtsa rgyangs bcud zas gnod// bad kun so nad snyil 'drul dri mi zhim// so 'bras so rtsar spangs shing rnag tu 'gyur// srin nad tsha grang gang yang reg thabs med// ldang dub byed cing zug langs lhang lhang gzer// rlung gi lce nad tsub 'gags ro mi tshor// mkhris gyur 'brum pa dmar po tsha bas khyab//bad kun lce nad skya 'jam cher mi bde// lce lhag lce 'og lce 'dra skrangs te na//lce skrangs kha khengs chu 'dzag zas mi thar// lce chung babs pa ba yi nu ltar rgyas//

— kro ༄ tha rgyu ba/ ———— lkog 'gags zas skom mi thar snar 'ong skyug / de 'dra lce chung 'grams skrangs lce 'dra yin// rkan 'brum skan phugs 'brum bu chu ser 'dzag / chu bur rkan dkyil 'brum pa snyi la rdol// nus sbal na tsha med par skyed por spangs // rkan smin rkan las rnag 'dzag gyur pa'o// gre ba rlung gyur rna ba 'gram pa gzer//gre ba nang skrangs tsha la skam pa yin// khrag mkhris skrangs dmar tsha skye rnag tu 'gyur// bad kun skrangs mdog skya la ljan ljin mang / 'dus pa gra mas gang sem 'brum bu 'byung // 'bras nad phyi nang myur skrangs rnag tu 'gyur// men bu sra la zug chung smin mi byed / bcos thabs gre mchu brud la lcags kyis bsreg / seng phrom 'jib rtse 'bras gsum sbrang sbyar byug / sho re g.yas g.yon mtha' dras mkhris pa byug / dar gyis btsem sa la nyel srab spyin chus bsdam gad mo mi rgod bldan mi dgos pa bza'// then pa 'khrigs nasaskud pa bton la gso// bad kun a ru sge gsher thal ba byug / yang na a ru ra dang bu ram byug / yang na sbrang rtsi pa ṭha tsha gsum byug / srin lag g.yon gyi tshigs bar 'og ngos bsreg / gcen la khrag dbyung seng phrom lde gu byug /khrag rgyas skyu ru'i thang btang mchu rtsa gtar// kha shu brtol la khyi dbre lham mthil glan// snyil nad dom mkhris rgya skyegs ba sha ka / kyi lce hong len zhu mkhan ka ra mar / sbyar ba mkhur bkang sna yi sman du btang // gla sgang skyer pa bca' sga 'bras bu gsum// 'jib rtsi sbrang dang sbyar ba'i mkhur bkang bcang // skyer pa ru rta gla sgang shu dag btsod// pa ja hong len yung ba sbrang mkhur bkang / so nad rlung gyur snum ldan dugs kyis bdug / rlung 'joms sman dang zhun mar bskol bas bsreg / shing mngar til sbrang 'o ma mkhur bar bcang // 'phar rtsa mes mnan 'bras bu'i sman mar sbyar// khrag mkhris so nad skyu ru'i thang btang gtar// 'bras bu gsum dang ru rta ba sha ka / rgya skyegs skyer pa ka ra mkhur bkang bcang // tsan dan dkar dmar lde

zhu/mnang ga yon tan gyi da 305——gu phyi nas byug / bad kun so brud bul tog sbrang rtsi byug / yang na cong zhi sbrang sbyar ltar bu byug / so 'bras srub ga rgya tsha nal sham byug / snyil nad ltar bcos ma phan brud la bsreg / so srin rta sbangs phur mo sru dugs bya// shing kun nag mtshur ru rta byi tang ga / sa rdzi ka dang mar sbyar mkhur bar dgang //tig ta thang phrom sag rtsi sha tshil lam// ra tshil sbyar ba 'khar gong mes bsregs bdug / yang na thang phrom sgog skya mu zi dang // gu gul nag po gshul tshil de bzhin bdug / sha tshil shing kun byi tang ga glan bsreg / bye stag bu ram ril bu so steng bzhag / rna drung srin lag phyi khrig rus mgo bsreg / rlung 'brel btsan dug drod sman mar btsos bdug / khrag mkhris 'brel na gang nye'i rtsa la gtar// lce nad rlung gyur mkhur bkang sna sman btang // mkhris gyur mngar bas mkhur bkang lce rtsa gtar// bad gyur ske tshe tsha gsum sbrang sbyar byug / lce lhag phyed bcad lcags bsregs thal sman gdab// lce skrangs spyang lce sbal pa'i sha khus bdug / ma phan lkog mar dugs bya smin nas dbral//de shul rgya tsha ru rta shu dag gdab// de 'og drod bcud bsten pas then mi ldang // rgya tsha thar nu sngo yi tsha ba gsum// srub ka gze ma phur thal sngon bu dang // rtsa mkhris thal ka rdo rje so ma ra// sre mong sha dang dur byin dar btsags phye dri chu sbyar ba 'jam tsam sros la mnan// lce la byug cing ras la bskus la glan// zug skyes gyur nas lce yi rtsa la gtar// lce lhag ldib 'then skrangs sogs lce nad sel// lce chung babs na spyi bo'i sku 'then bsreg / ru rta rgya tsha shu dag na le sham// g.yer ma'i phye gdab nya khu'i tsha bas bdug / khrag dbyung ma phan phyed bcad lcags kyis bsreg / lce 'dra khrag dbyung ya bakṣa ra gdab// rkan 'brum bzhar la bul tog phye ma gdab// chu bur rus sbal gnyis la khrag phyungs la// nag mtshur skyer pa'i khaṇḍa sbrang sbyar byug / rkan min dral la gcod sman phye ma gdab/ rkan dang snyil nad bad kun khrag

306 ༄cu/grwa nga da ba'i/— ——— ————'phel phyir// mkhur bkang rnon pos sbyang zhing gtar mang gdab// gla sgang ya bakṣa ra lce myang tsha / skyer shun ldong ros sbrang rtsi'i mkhur bkang bcang / pa tol bca' sga sle tres 'bras bu gsum// tig ta kyi lce sbrang rtsi'i mkhur bkang bcang // ru rta shu dag star bu 'bras bu gsum// tsha ba gsum dang rgya tsha bul tog mtshur// sbrang rtsi'i mkhur bkang g.ya' 'drul rnag 'dzag sel gri ba rlung gyur rlung 'joms sman mkhur dgang // khong du bsten zhing ril bu mur bar bya// khrag mkhris mngar bsil mkhur bkang mang du gtar// bad gan 'dus pa tsub pa'i sman gyis bcos// gre 'bras men bu'i dugs lums gtar rjes bsreg / rna shal 'og thong me btab ro mi ldang // gre ba'i nad kun sri ru btso bsreg thang // mngar ba'i thang dang ril bu kha mur bsten// nya khus bdug cing sgang rtsa skyor gong gtar// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las kha nad gso ba'i le'u ste so gnyis pa'o// //

307le'u so gsum pa/ lnga ba bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / mgul nad lba ba rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi ru bstan// rgyu rkyen zas dang spyod lam gdon la sogs// 'du ba 'khrugs pas lnga ba skyed par byed// dbye ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun tshil// 'dus pa'i lnga ba g.yang lnga byur lnga brgyad//de rtags rlung gyur mgo mang khong stong zhing / mkhris pa'i lba ba phur tshe chung la snyi// khrag lnga drod bcud drag shul rkyen gyis skye// bad kun sra mkhregs dal dus skye bar byed// tshil lnga skye 'gag skye 'bri che ba ste// 'dus pa'i lnga ba dbugs sub ngar ngar 'byung // g.yang lnga bde ba dbyibs legs bkra shis ldan// byur lnga mi bde mi sdug bkra mi shis// bcos pa'i thabs la sbyi dang bye brag gnyis// phyi bcos tsha ba sman chang phye ma dang // dpyad dang sngags dang loganon drug gis bcos// dang po g.yag rgod ol mdud sogs sna tshogs//tshwa sna sug sprel zi ra sle tres rnams// zhib brdungs btsos te lto ru bsten pas 'joms// sman chang ol mdud rnam pa sna chogs dang // sman sga nya sha bzang drug shing tsha dang // lnga tsha ru rta utpal chu la bsdus// chang sbyar mnan te langs nas skom du bsten// phye ma ol mdud sna tshogs bzang po drug / lba tsha shing tsha rgyam tsha tsha ba gsum// a ru kur bur rtas bsgyur chu skol dbul// yang na ol mdud rnying pa rgya tsha dang // lnga tsha tig ta spang rgyan ba sha ka / ka ra sbyar ba lho stong bsten par bya// go bo'i stod khog g.yag rgod rta dang rkyang // spyang ki so bya la sogs gre sna tshogs// tsha ba gsum dang brag zhun lba tsha dang // bur

308 sto/grwa thang da ba'i dkar sbyar ba lto stong chu bskol dbul// zla phyed bsten pas wa ba rtsad nas 'byin// dpyad du dpung ske rna rgyab lnga rtsa gtar// rna shal 'og dang lnga mgo yan stong bsreg / sngags bcos smra bcad bzlas te phyi nas gdab/ oṃ nag ta rag ta pus pa ta su hā// chu la bzlas te khong du btang bar bya// oṃ mi ti mi ti shag krug su hā/ oṃ kha khug ma la rab nan/ oṃ dmar mo dzin du dzin du hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa su hā/ thog mar dgu pa lnga brgyad de rjes sbrel// bzlas thing btab pas lnga ba thams cad 'joms/ log non lnga ba shin tu bcos dka' sra// tsha thur rgyab la rul bcad 'bras ltar gso// bye brag rlung lnga me btsa' snum dugs bya// mkhris pa'i lnga ba phug pas 'tsho bar 'gyur// khrag gi wa ba gtar dang bsil phye bsten// bad tshil lnga ba skyugs dang tsub 'chos bya//'dus pa'i lba ba kun gyis gso ba ste// g.yang lnga mi bcos g.yang lon bya bar shis// byur lnga gdon bcos rim gro rgya cher gyis// tshogs bsag de 'og gang la 'tsham pas bcos// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las lnga ba bcos pa'i le'u ste so gsum pa'o// / /

309———le'u so bzhi pa/ snying nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// don snod gso ba'i skabs la ji ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol//zhes zhus pa las/ drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / don snod nad kyi gso thabs bstan pa ni/snying dang glo ba mchin mtsher mkhal ma lnga// pho ba rgyu ma long gi nad brgyad las//thog mar don gyi rgyal po snying gso ba// rgyu dang dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bzhi// rgyu ni mya ngan sems 'khrugs yid mi bde// lto chag gnyid chag zhe snang drag pos skyed// dbye ba snying 'phyos snying gzer snying tshad dang / snying chu snying 'thibs snying gi srin bu dang // snying nad kha le nag po zhes bya bdun//de rtags snying 'phyos mgo na brjed ngas che// shes pa 'phyo zhing don med snying mi dga'/ res 'ga' ma dris mar yang mu chor smra// res 'ga' dris kyang de yi lan mi ldon// mi snyan tshig gis dngang zhing shu yis 'debs/ dbugs thung gnyid chung snying nyid stong ngam sem// snying gzer nad la rlung gzer khrag gzer gnyis// mgo 'khor stod gzer rngam pa thung la che// mig rtsa rgod cing kha lce skam la tsub// khrag gzer lce skam phur pa btsugs ltar gzer// 'bur tshugs lta zhing rngam rgod zhe 'khun byed// snying tshad tsha ba rgyas dang 'khyil ba gnyis// rgyas pa myos 'thibs mig dmar ro stod gzer// snying mchu sna skam brang rgyab me btang 'dra// tsha ba snying la 'khyil ba tsha myag byed// snying 'phar gri yis btubs snyam lce skam thung // snying la chu ser babs na smra ba mang / khong

310 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/'dar gnyid chung snying rdung g.yal stong g.yo// glu dang rgod la dga' zhing tshig pa za// snying 'thibs brjed ngas che zhing sems las che// dang ga mi bde gnyid che rdo brdzangs sem// srin gyur mig mdog nag cing ljan ljin 'dzag /snying 'phar mun 'thibs sog les 'bran snyam sem// kha le nag po rtsa stong tshad pa che// smra nyung spro thung rdeg 'dod 'bur tshugs lta// mgo bo phyed na na ngos kha yor 'gyur// bcos thabs dang po snying la rlung zhugs pas// 'bras bu'i mar ni bza' byug 'jam rtsir btang // dzā ti kha ru tsha yi sman mar ram//rus chen lo mar 'bras bu'i sman mar la// shing kun dzā ti kha ru tsha dang sga//sle tres go snyod bur rnying btab la btang // btsan dug a ru gla rtsi ru rta dang //shing kun shu dag dza ti gu gul dang // bu ram sbyar ba'i ris bu thabs ldan bsten// drug bdun snying stod snying logs me thur bya// bud med smra brjod mi nyan kha yeng spang / rlung gzer dza ti go stod zho sha'i thang // phye ma de steng ru rta li shi dang // ka ko la dang shing kun bu ram sbyar// snying gsang mdun rgyab gang du babs pa bsreg / khrag gzer zho sha sle tres a ru'i thang // phye ma tsan dan a gar snying zho sha / ge sar gnyis dang dzā ti ka ra sbyar// a so rtse chung gtar la drug bdun bsreg / bcos 'phyis snying nang khrag gis gang ste 'chi//snying la tsha ba rgyas na snying rtsa gtar// ga bur bdun dgu nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar// tsha ba 'khyil na ga bur snying zho sha / dza ti cu gang dom mkhris ka ra sbyar// thong rtsa a so lce 'og rtsa la gtar// snying gi chu ser se 'bru'i phye ma sbyar// dkar nag mtshams dang sdud sgo bdun pa bsreg / 'bras gsum seng ldeng mar gyis chu ser skem// snying 'thibs skyugs bya chu bskol mang du btang // se 'bru dbyi mong tsha ba gsum gyi thang // rgyam tsha drod sman kha ru tsha thang btang // shu dag shing kun rgyam tsha kha ru tsha// dong gra sug sprel ya bakṣa ra dang // la la phud dang drod sman sbrang sbyar btang // snying srin byi tang ga dang shing kun dang // ma ru

༄gyu/man nga yon tan gyi da 311rtsedang sgog skya lang thang rtse/ dzā ti zho sha spru ma'i khu bas dbul byi tang ga dang ru rta ba chur sbyar// snying gi srin nad tsha g.ya' gzer 'khyug sel// kha le nag po skyu ru ra yi thang // rgod kyi lto stong pa yi tsha ba btang // zho sha gsum gyi mar sbyar snying rtsa bsreg / ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las snying nad gso ba'i le'u ste so bzhi pa'o / /

312——le'u so lnga pa/ glo nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / don lnga'i blon po glo nad gso ba la// rgyu dang dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs ba'i// rgyu ni rlung mkhris bad kun khrag dang chu// rul skyur zo mar/ tsha dang du ba dang // cham pa 'grams dang drag shul rnams kyis bskyed// dbye ba thang po skya rbab tsha ba dang // chu thor thes po glo gcong glo rgyas dang // bung tshang can dang rnam pa brgyad du bshad// de rtags rlung glo thang po rgyun du lu// 'gogs dka' spu gsog gongs dang tho rangs mang // skya rbab glo mang mig lcibs rkang bol g.yo// tsha ba tsha subs tsha gzer gnyis su dbye// tsha subs rtsa chu tsha la ro stod rgyangs// lud pa tsha bro lbu chung mkhris pa 'ong // ston dus drag shul drod bcud shin tu gnod// tsha gzer nyal ba mi bde dbugs kyis theg / lud pa dmar ser lu zhing skabs su gzer// chu thor ngal chu glo la shor ba ste// stod rgyangs mgo na mig sprin ser por 'ong // dang ga mi bde glo mang rngam pas theg / sha skam rngul med gtam bar bcad cing smra// gzhug tu lud pa sha skyo glo las 'dzag / thes po lud pa sngo ljob mang du lu// gyen la dbugs theg ro stod lci la khengs// lud pa thon rjes cung zad bde snyam byed// glo gcong sha skem shed chung 'gul mi nus// byi la'i mgul 'dra zas sman phan skyed chung // glo rgyas mig dmar lce mchu mkhur tshos skug / skad 'dzer stod rgyangs rngam rgod lud pa dmar// bung tshang lud pa she rul rnag tu 'byung // yang na sngon po sbru ba can gseb tu// nya mig lta bu'i rnag dang 'dres par lu// spyir na glo ba bad kun yul yin pas// dbyar

zhu/mnang yo na tan gyi da 313dus bde la dgun dus na ba dang // nyin par bde la mtshan mo na ba yin//de rnams bcos thabs rlung glo bsil bcud bston// mngar gsum dza ti shing tsha sug sprel thab ling gi yang ku ba mar du gu 'bras bu'i sman mar sbyar// gso ba dka' la bzhi lnga me yis bsreg / glo nad skya rbab star bu'i dza ti sug sprel dko la shing mngar mi ru lha sa zang gi lde gu dang // cu gang gur gum li shi sug sprel shing mngar mdu lcags sbrang gi lde gu bya mig lnga pa bsreg / tsha subs tsan dan bsil gsum utpal nga rgyan 'brum shing mngar dang brgyad dang a ru gi 'gur gum cu gang shing mngar rgyan 'byam sro 7spang na 'bu su hang dang bcu pa dang // a krong star bu cu sang gur gu ru rta shing mngar tsa gyitsher brgyad dang mar gsar sha gsar bsten// tsha gzer de bzhin bcos shing gtar ba bzang // bshal dang chu lcag nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar// chu shor nad la shing mngar yu nga ba gsum// sngon du btang la de rje glo skyugs bya zhing mngar 'dam bu ka ra li ga dur// cu gang gur gum dom mkhris tsan dan rnams// ka ra sbyar ba btsod kyi khu bas dbul// rjes la sro lo ga dur 'dam bu mtshal/bcad 'byor gur gum ka ra 'o mas dbul/ wa la sogs pa'i glo ba sna tshogs btang // bad kun glo sbubs zhugs pa'i thes po la// spyang tsher ri zo dur byid khu bar rgyam tshab ling btab pa'i gas kyis pho ba glo sgrubs bad kun sbyang // star bu pa sa lud pa gyen du drang // rjes la sku la lnga mnu sgang gdur sgegasher ba ru'am cu gang ming tsha sug sprel bslang sbrang ngam// pi pi ling gi lde gu bsngags pa yin/ sha gsar mar gsar sbrang rtsi ldan pa btang // thes po la sogs glo nad rlung ldan gang /ba 'o bzhis thog rlung dus btang bar bsngags/ glo gcong glo mig lud pa'i gcong 'dril bas// a grong lums sam sman chu chu lums bsten/ de nas star bu pañdza sa gyen du drang / lud pa skya sngo skam po mang thon 'tsho// ma thon lums dang 'dren sbyor skyar la sbyang // skabs su cu gang lde gu sbyar ba'am// phye ma ba 'o sbyar ba ri lug gi / glo ba ma sungs rgyangs te btang bar bya// gla dgo

314 sa༅grwa thang rgyud ba'i/—ba sha gro chang yos chang bsten// glo rgyas rtse chung drug 'go mang du gtar// lud pa dmar na rgya skyegs 'bri sog btsod// sro lo dkar po'i bsdus thang yang ya nga btang // tsan dan da ra dam ra cugang gur gum ba spang sro lo bong nga byi utpalasgyudu bcu gcig phye ma thang des dbul// rjes la gtar zhing nyi shu rtsa lnga dam ra sa sum dang tshal bsnan la sbyar// cis kyang skyed chung sprug por byer srid pas// sprug po'i khrag bshal bcos thabs bsngags pa yin// khrag tu brdol na puṣṭha sran ma 'i me tog skyer pa'i me rtog gur gum dom mkhris tshos khu4spyor ram// kur sha pa ni lnga'i thalabadom mkhris gur sum mtshal zab thal mdongs thal lnga rma bya ba bzer bya mtshal phug ron sgro 'gron bu phur mo'i la ba'i sbyor bsngags// mang du gtar zhing ro ston chu yis bran//zas skom bsil bston spyod lam drag shul spang // bung tshang rnag nyung bskams pas sgoms sam blta// a krong tsan dan du ru rta ltar bu bsil gsum shing ma ngar gyi tsherabacu pa zangs thal mu zi sha ru na ma srolo ma grong sbyar ba dang // klad pa wadang srin bya'inu zab la srolo cu gang spang rgyan ra bu'i sbyor ba rnag skems glo gso'i mchog / nyi shu rtsa lnga la dor gsum dang do mkhris man ngag ldan pas sbyar// rnag bungs che 'am bskams pas ma skoms na// ltar bu pañtsa pa yag ba bul tos la cha 'khar pom na ngag ldan pas drang // rnag khrag 'dres na shu mo za sman ba mar gyis 'bri mog gi rtsi slangs la rgya skyes sa dang zang yar 'o ma gul do do shu mo za tshoms gcig li shi ka ra sbyar ba mchog / cu gang a krong ka ra a ru ra// bong yar 'o sbyar ri 'u'i glo ba rgyangs// glo gso khrag tu lu la bsngags pa yin// wa glo 'o mar ya ru cu gang mu zi dom mkhris shing mngar sprang bong yar 'o ma sbyar zho de bzhin shis// khrag med rnag tu byung na rnas gas byis sbyang ba mchog / sgong spris sbal sgong lta bu'i rnag yul 'thon// de rjes glo gso khrag tu byung na bcad// rnag gzhug ma thon zangs thal wadang srin bya'i da pa mu sa gar ma rtsi lo ling rla ngar bsregs pa dang spen ma ru'i lab spangs rgyan thar nga sbyor ba dang //nyi shu rtsa lnga ltag pa sprad la skam// rlung dang ldan na sro lo'i ze dal ma ru nyishu'i sman

ga /man ngas yon tan gyi rgyud/ 315ma ra'i bzang drug spa ling pang sman mar sbyar slo mang mi 'gog cu gang bzhi pa ngamangar ra bu ru rtas bcad// ces gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las glo nad bcos pa'i le'u ste so lnga pa'o// / /

316———le'u so drug pa/ mchin nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / btsun mo lta bu mchin pa'i gso thabs la// rgyu dang dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bzhi// rgyu ni tsha skyur zas dang drag shul skyed// dbye ba leb rgan rgyas dang ldem bu dang / dug thabs chu shor rkun bu 'or lhung dang // kha lud gzhung rengs mchin grum nag po dang // mchin nad hal skem mchin dri dkar nag dang // gnad mchin rtsa byer mchin rlung mchin rgud dang // rlan grangs glang dgur grang sbos bco brgyad do// de rtags mchin nad leb rgan rgyas pa de// mchin steng rtsib thung g.yas g.yon sbo zhing na// lus dang 'tshogs ma lci zhing ro stod gzer// steng bton sdib snyam 'og bcug 'bugs snyam byed// tsog pur 'dug na thur la 'then pa 'dra// sha ser mkhal rked mi bde sgyid pa 'khums// mchin nad ldem bu na ba mi tshor bar// gnyid med khong snyom lus lci zas mi 'dod// khrag 'bros sha dang rus pa khad kyi skam// dug thabs mig dmar gdong sngo rtsib steng zug / pho mchin gang snyam 'ju dka' thos tshe na// brun skam bol g.yo mur gong mthil bzhi ser// gzhug tu mchin pa rul nas dud khur lu// chu shor khong sbo ro stod brdzis na phan// rgal rengs rme chin pa 'phyongs shing g.yal mi thon// pho mchin stongs snyam dros drags mgo bo na// thun bu rkang pa grang la ro stod gzer// mig gis yas lcibs mi thegs nyam chung snya// stod gang dpung mgo gzer la ske rtsa rengs// kha zas zos na bag re phan snyam byed// 'or lhung gnyis las mchin khrag rked par lhung // rked pa 'khor zhing 'gul na zug che

༄khan ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 317gzer// rkang par lhung la dpyi sbrid skam khol byed/ rked pa tsha la chu rgyus na bar 'ong // kha lud glo dang pho bar lud pa gnyis// glor lud stod rdzings mig dmar mchan 'og gzer// khrag tu lu zhing skabs su rnag khrag 'dzag / pho bar lud na bsdams shing gzer nas na// dgye dgu mi shes tsha tseg sgrog pa 'ong // ldang dub che la gsus pa ltar mi mngon// gzhung rengs rkang lag rengs la lhu tshigs na/ dgye dgu mi shes stod gzer ltag pa dgye// mchin grum nag po lus kun brdungs snyam byed// rkang bshal 'gul na mi bzod dgur por 'gro// hal skoms lus po za 'dar gzhogs g.yas lci/ mi dang chung zhing 'dzur la skom dad che// mchin dri dkar po nyen sna g.yas g.yon na gnyid che kha skam rtsib logs gzer nas na/ mchin dri nag po srog rtsa snying mi bde// khong pa stong sbos snyen snar 'dril nas na// gnad mchin rtsa byer stod gzer thal gong na// stod gang pho mchin mi bde rtse chung rings/ glo byung mchin pa 'phyongs la bzod thabs med// byad smug sna khrag 'dzag cing ci zos gnod// mchin rlung g.yal byung rjes la mchi ma 'dzag / pho mchin 'dres snyam byed cing na la 'phyongs// gongs dang tho rangs na zhing grangs na skyig /mchin rgud zas zos rjes la mchin pa na// nyam chung chu dron skyug la g.yal mi phyin// mchin pa rlan grangs pus mo grang zhing za/ stod gang glo skam lu zhing dgye dgu dka'// glang dgur lus skrangs byad sbos lce mchu skya// mgo 'khor skra na za la sna shu 'byung // grang sbos khong pa grang la byad sha sbos// bcos thabs mchin nad leb rgan rgyas pa la// gi waṃ skyu ru ra yi thang btang la/ ra sa ya na dong ga dur gyid hong len khron bu ma rtsa ra nu re lcag ra pa ru'i bshal btang ru thung gtar// mkhris chen dom mkhris brag zhun ma ru mar gsar sbyor ba rgyan 'brum thang gis dbul// tsha ba zhen che ga bur bdun pa sbyar/ nyal ba'i rngas smad kha zas bsil du bsten// mchin nad ldem bu a du bar myur tshe tres tig ta bong nga hong len kum

318 ༄ /grwa nga dab rtsa rong gdur byin sbyar ba'i thang khrus bya// g.yu rnying cur ni ga bur li shi tsan dan domamakhris gla gan 'bum gser bzag zhun gur gum le ru spru yang ku lnga pa sbyar// dug thabs snang byas gser phud ba sa khur bul tog btab pa'i skyugs kyis drang // g.yu rnying gur gum li utpal sar gsum bdun pa rnyi ba'i mi tos sum cu)ga seng ldeng zhing tsha'ithang gis dbul// rjes gcod gi waṃ tsan dan dkar dmar re ral sngon bu mtshal bcadasbyor gnyis dang brgyad pa ba 'os ded mchin pa chu shor rwa gsum ba le'i thang /ru thung rtse chung mchin mkhris 'dom rtsa gtar// glo dang sdongs na cu gang lde gu sbyar// rjes la tshigs pa lnga dang dgu pa bsreg / mchin nad rkun bu a so gnyis la gtar// ba le ka )tres ru rgyan 'byam bong nga hong len ti ta glasgang dugazhungakyi rtse dur gyid khron bu yi bshal btang phran bu gtar// mchin pa 'or du lhung ba gnyis ka la// 'bras bu gsum gyi dur byin ho len khron bu bshal btang byin long gtar// dmar gsum phye ma dar ya kun mi dom mkhris brag ston gyi thang btang //mchin khrag glo la lud na ba le ka sa ru ru snam rtsa dur byin dong sa thang khrus bya// glo rtsa ru thung gtar zhing bsil sman btang // pho bar lud na ru thung 'dom rtsa gtar// ra gsum dur byin hong len gyi bshal dang ba le ka glasang rgun 'brum hong lenaya ji thang btang // mchin pa gzhung rengs dur lcags thang du btang // ru thung drug mgo pho gdung gtar bar bya// bya brun sbang skam dugs kyis gzhung bshul bdug / ba le ka thang brag zhun cur ni btang // mchin grum nag po 'bras bu gsum thang btang // jul dbyung rtse chung gtar zhing sngon bus mduzangs rgyan 'byur gyi sbyang // mar gsar so ma ra dzabasil gsum i du 'ad bu thing mngaralcags sprang dang sbyar ba'i lde gu btang // rjes la sha srubs tshigs dmig gar babs bsreg / mchin nad hal skem a bi ṣa par pa ta ca lce yi thang // sngon bu'i bshal btang ru thung phran bu gtar// lums rjes sman mar sbyar la dgu pa bsreg / mchin dri dkar po mchin mkhris 'dom rtsa gtar// ba le ka dang kyi

zhu na ngag yon tan gyi khyud/ 319lce'i grang thang btang // gur gum li shi sug la ka kau la da byin par pa ta spang spros mo za sbrang ste brgyad pa'i lde gu sbyar bar bya// mchin dri nag po brag zhun thang btang la ru thung gtar zhing rjes la brgyad pa bsreg / gnad mchin rtsa byer ru thung rtse chung gtar// 'dom rtsa a so byin gzhug long rtsa gtar// ba le'i thang btang 'bras bu gsum gyis sbyang // de ltar mchin nad tsha ba de rnams la// kha zas bsil bsten rul skyur drod bag spang // tsha ba choms na gsar bcud drod la dbab// rjes la tshigs pa brgyad dgu gar babs bsreg / mchin rlung thong tsher mchin pa spod bran btang // bur dkar mar gsar ting khrol spod ldan mur// ra gsum mar sbyar dgu pa kha gsum bsreg / mchin rgud de 'dra se 'bru da lis btang // a ru 'bri rkang gze ma'i sman mar sbyar// mchin nad rlan grangs de bzhin mchin gsang bsreg / mchin pa glang dgur 'bras bu'i rgyun bshal btang // se 'bru lnga pa skems sman sbyar ba bsten// kha zas khye'u rjes la me yis bcad// mchin pa grang sbos da lis se 'bru sbyar/ lnga dang drug pa nyen sna kha gsum bsreg / de ltar mchin nad grang ba drod kyis bcos//gsar 'jam lug sha la sogs drod la bgor// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mchin nad gso ba'i le'u ste so drug pa'o// / /

320le'u so bdun pa/ mcher nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / mcher pa'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa ba'i ru bshad// rgyu ni ma zhu rlan grangs drag shul skyed// dbye ba mcher nad tsha ba khrag sbos dang // mcher rlung mcher pa'i bad kun blugs pa lnga// mcher nad tsha ba chang 'thungs dros tshe sbo// lce khra dbugs rgod mchu dang gdong pa smug / rkang lag sbrid cing g.yon gyi rtsib thung gzer// khrag sbos de 'dra bzhin mdog sngo'am ser// khong lci sbo 'khrog byed cing ma mchu 'phyang // mcher rlung lus skrangs sbo 'khrog 'ju stobs chung //sgrogs pa'am 'og rlung thon na bde snyam byed// mcher pa'i bad kun mchu la bad gan chags// grang dang rgongs dus sbo la g.yon ngos gzer// rlugs pa sbo 'khrog phyi sa mi thub 'chor// bcos thabs mcher tshad li shi ka ko la// sug smel gur gum tig ta gser me tog / sle tres ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma btang //ka ko la dang gur gum a ru// ka ra sbyar btang mcher pa'i rtsa la gtar//khrag sbos nad la ma nu pi pi ling // sug sprel shu dag dong gra na le sham// kha ru tsha dang shi tsha rgyam tsha dang // bu ram sbyar btang ngar gdong mcher rtsa gtar//mcher pa'i rlung dang bad kun gnyis ka la// shing kun kha ru tsha yi bsdus khu btang // da lis sug spel shing tsha kha ru tsha// zi ra tsha ba gsum dang bu ram sbyar// mcher pa'i steng dang bcu gcig kha gsum bsreg / blugs pa'i nad

kho khan nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 321la ka sho kun da dang // rgyam tsha kha ru tsha yi phye ma btang // bsreg pa gong bzhin mdzo dang rtol sha byin// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mcher nad gso ba'i le'u ste so bdun pa'o/ / /

322le'u so brgyad pa/ mkhal nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / mkhal ma'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu ni rdabs dang mi theg khur dang bteg / rlan la 'dug dang chu yi las byas 'byung // dbye ba mkhal rlung mkhal gcong 'or lhung dang // mkhal tshad chu shor mkhal grum da rgan bdun// de rtags mkhal rlung rked pa 'phyongs nas na// nad dmigs mi rnyed rna ba 'on par 'gyur// mkhal gcong smad grang rked pa 'khor bar na//rkang pa bshal la dpyi dang rked par zug / chu sri bcud blugs bshul sha khrid nas na// 'or lhung mkhal rked na zhing za 'phrug byed// 'gro 'dug byas tshe pus mo'am bol gong skrangs// mkhal tshad chang 'thungs 'gro 'dug byas tshe na//chu kha tsha zhing sha nus bar na 'khyug / mkhal 'grams byer rgyas lhung ba rnam pa gsum// stod du byer na ltag chu'i 'gram gnyis na// ske sgyur mi shes dgur por 'gro ba yin / bar du rgyas na mkhal rkyen 'khor 'ing na// dpyi steng 'brel mtshams rtsa nag sbo zhing gzer// glo dang sbrid pa byung tshe bzod thabs med// tshigs pa kha bye med pa skyog por 'gro// smad du lhung na rkang pa bshal zhing sbrid// brla sul byin sul pus mo'i tshigs mtshams na// mkhal grum skad pa man chad thams cad na// glo dang sbrid pa byung tshe dpyi mig zug / sgal pa rengs shing 'jing pa sgyur mi shes// nam stod na zhing nam smad bde bar tshor// chang dang drod bcud zos rjes tsha ba skye// da rgan tshigs pa phyir don dgur por 'gro// bcos thabs dang po mkha' rlung gze ma'i chang // rtsa ba lnga

zhu na nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 323yi sman mar 'jam rtsi btang / reng bu bya zhing bcu bzhi rtsa nag bsreg /mkhal gcong thong tsher mkhal ma mar btsos btang // gze ma lca ba ra mnye zan chang la// chang bsings bsnur te bu ram sga dang mar// btab ste tshos par btsos la dro 'jam btang // rtsa ba lnga'am ra gsum sha sna gnyis// sga dang bre ga'i mar la pi pi ling // cong zhi sug spel sle tres kha tshar gdab// ra mar sbrang dang sbyar la btang bar bya// 'ba' sam mar la da byin smug po dang kartsangs pa mchil pa phug ron lang thang tse// cong zhi tsha ba gsum dang 'bras sna gsum// zho sha gsum dang dzā ti sdig srin dang // sug thel bre ga bu ram sbyar la btang // khyad par gcin snyi sa bon 'dzag pa gcod/ mug smrel tsha ba lnga dang tshwa sna lnga// sdig srin lcam pa 'bras gsum bur sbyar btang // dugs dang me btsa' drod dang bcud kyis bcos// 'or lhung 'bam po seng ldeng sman mar la// tshwa sna tshogs tshad sprang dang sbyar la btang // bong bu 'phyi ba rta rkyang sha sna bsten// za 'phrug g.yer ma shu dag yung ba dang // mar rnying phag tshil byugs la nyi mas bsreg / pus mo bol gong skrangs tshe chu tshan bya// mkhal tshad nad la mkhal ma zho sha dang // gur gum skyer shun sdig pa ka ra sbyar byin gzhug long rtsa gnyis la gtar bar bya// mkhal ma'i zags chu khrag tu byung srid na//mkhal rtsa 'grams sam mchin khrag babs pa yin// bsil gsum brag zhun dom mkhris ba sha ka / shing tsha ba lu ka ra sbyar la btang // ru thung long rtsa gtar zhing chu lcag bya// chu shor skyu ru ra yis khrag phye gtar// dmar po bzhi thang tsan dan gur gum gla brag zhun tig ta mkhal ma no btsod tshos zhumakhan ya ru shug tsherabacu gcig sbyar// gi waṃ gla rtsi gser gyi bye ma dang // bsil gsum sdig srin lcam pa 'bras sna gsum// bre ga ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma btang // stod du byer na lums bya ltag rtsa gtar// bar du rgyas na mchog tu rtsa sbyong shis// smad du lhung na gtar dang chu lums bya// kun la tsha ba chogs na sman mar sbyar// gang du

324 sa /grwa thang dab /zug pa'i steng du me btsa' gdab// mkhal grum sngon bu ru gun 'brum zangs rtsi'i bshal btang chu lums bya// rtsa nas sbyangs nas se ldeng kha dmar po ba chu ra sman gsum zang khrag pang bsgar ba'i phye ma sbyar/ bsil gsum zho sha gsum dang 'bras sna gsum/ chu ser sman gsum gser gyi bye ma dang // sdig srin bre ga sbrang gi lde gu dang // bdud rtsi me tog 'bru sna'i rlangs lums bya// byin gzhug long rtsa khrag dang sbyar la gtar// tsha ba chogs nas srung chang yongs rdzogs sbyar//seng ldeng sman mar sbrang dang sbyar la btang / chu ser 'or sgo kun tu me btsa' bsreg / da rgan nad la bdud rtsi lnga yis bdug / rtsa sbyongs byas la 'ba' sam sman mar sbyar// sug smel shing tsha zi ra pi pi ling // ru rta bre ga bu ram ril bu btang / tshigs pa'i steng 'og me thur gor bus brdeg / ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mkhal nad gso ba'i le'u ste so brgyad pa'o// / /

325le'u so dgu pa/ po ba'i nad gso ba/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / pho ba'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan/ rgyu ni ngal dub rlan grangs bza' ches dang // kha zas mi 'phrod pa las gyur pa'o// dbye ba pho nad tsha ba grang ba gnyis// tsha ba pho bar 'grams babs 'khrugs babs dang // dug thabs gnyan rlung pho ba sur ya dang // mkhris pa lud dang mchin khrag lud pa'o/mchin khrag lud pa 'dril dang ma 'dril gnyis// grang ba rlung dang ma zhu lcags dreg nyen// me nyams rdo skran dmu rdzing srin dang 'bras// tsha grang bdun dgu pho nad bcu drug go / 'on kyang rlung dang bad kun mkhris pa khrag / dug thabs pho log rgud pa stong bu brgyad/ mdor bsdus phyi ma le'u gzhan du gsal// de rtags pho rlung sbo zhing stong sgreg dang // 'brab pa bzhin du na zhing stong skyugs byed// yang na sgra bcas 'khrog cing 'khru ba yin// pho ba'i bad gan 'tshing sgrog zas mi 'ju/ bsil zas 'ju dka' zos rjes jul grangs na// zas la 'khren cing 'byar bag skyug pa dang // yang na kha zas ma smin rtsam pa 'khru// pho bar mkhris pa lhung na 'khru 'am skyug / khrag lhung tsha ches grang ches gnyis ka na// pho ba dug thabs mi 'ju dang ga 'gag / mid pa na la brang tsha chu tshan skyug / sha 'bros gsus rtsa bkra la zos thog skyug / pho log sbo ldeng zug che ldang dub byed// pho ba rgud pa sgrig mang bcud mi 'ju// sbru bar skyug cing nyam chung chang 'thungs bde// stong bu deng nge brjed ngas med par na// bcos thabs pho rlung shing kun kha ru tsha// pho ba ris dang se 'bru bu ram

326 zhu/grwa thang da ba'i/sbyar// sna tshogs rus khur shing kun kha ru tsha// thal tsha btab btang dugs bya pho gsang bsreg / mar rnying tsha ba gsum dang tshwa sna gsum// sbyar bas rlung gis skyug pa gcod par byed// 'khru na la phud dong gra khyor pa re// ka ra 'o ma mar du bsdus la btang // pho ba'i bad kun shing kun kha ru tsha// sman sga sbyar la dong gra'i thang gis dbul// pho ba drod chu kha zas mi 'ju sel// se 'bru sug sprel rgyam tsha la la phud// shing tsha zi ra bca' sga pi pi ling // lce myang kha ru tsha dang bu ram sbyar// drod skyed zas 'ju pho ba'i gzer zug sel// go stod na le sham dang kha ru tsha// ka ra sbrang sbyar bad kun skyug pa gcod// byi tang ga dang sgron thing tsha ba gsum// 'u su bskol khus bad kun 'khru ba gcod// pho gsang mdun rgyab me yis bsro bar bya// pho ba'i mkhris pa g.ya' kyi'i phyugs kyis drang // de rjes lham rtsa a ru'i bshal kyis sbyang // pho ba'i khrag nad cu gang bde byed sbyar// star bu'i dung thal sbrul sha rgya tsha dur byin kyi sbyong btang ru thung gnyis la gtar// pho ba dug thabs thar nu srub ka ba// ri sho rgyam tsha'i skyugs bya de 'og tu// ma nu maṇḍa ka ri sug smel dang / gur gum li shi ka ra sbyar la btang // se 'bru bzhi sbyar pho log ka ko la// sug sprel shing tsha da lis yi pi ling // zi ra na le sham dang ka ra sbyar// kha ru tsha dang rwa gzhob bsdus thang btang // pho ba rgyad na a ru ru go snyod zir nag pol la phud shing pho b.ris thal tsha ra tsha rgya tsha sung tshab mi ling ra ma'i cur ni sbyar// pho ba stong bu da lis tshabagasum shing tsha bur ma cur ni sbyar// pho ba zas 'ju byed pa'i gzhi yin pas// zas spyod drod bsten se 'bru da lis shis// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las pho ba'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste so dgu pa'o// / /

327le'u bzhi bcu pa/ rgyu ma'i nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / rgyu ma'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu ni zas dang spyod lam mi 'phrod pas// 'du ba 'khrugs te rgyu mar babs pa'o// dbye ba rgyu khrol rgyu 'khril rgyu 'gyings dang / rgyu 'gags rgyu gzer rnam pa lnga ru bstan// rgyu khrol rgyu mar rlung zhugs blug blug zer// skabs su khrol zhing chu ru 'khru ba ste// rgyu mkhril rgyu ma rlung gis gcus pa yin// 'og rlung mi thon 'khril zhing ldang dub byed// rgyu 'gyings rgyu mar bad gan be snabs rgyas// rgyu ma lci la na 'gyung dri ma 'gying // skabs su na zhing bad kun bee snabs 'khru / rgyu 'gags khrag dang mkhris pas dri ma 'gags// tsha 'dril gzer zhing dri ma mi ril 'dra// rgyu gzer gzer zhing thur du bshal ba yin// bcos thabs rgyu 'khrol zhun mar dngas ma btang // tsha ba gsum dang rgyam tsha lce myang tsha// kha ru tsha dang bur dkar chu bskol dbul// tsha'am gyo mo bsros pas rgyu ma bdug / rgyu 'khril la ni shing kun kha ru tsha// rgyam tsha tsha ba gsum dang bu ram sbyar// chang bskol 'phul btang tsha bsros dugs kyis bdug / 'jam rtsi btang zhing mdun rgyab gsang du bsreg / rgyu 'gyings tsha ba lnga dang tshwa sna sbyar / lham rtsa'i bshal btang rgyu 'gags ni rus drang // rgyu gzer mkhris phye bdun pas bcad par bya// mas gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rgyu ma'i nad bcos pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu pa'o/ / /

328le'u zhe gcig pa/ long nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / long gi nad la rtags dang bcos thabs gnyis// dang po long nad grang sbos grang 'gyings dang // tsha rnyongs 'ju skems rlangs pa can dang lnga// grang sbos 'ur 'khrog grangs rjes lte zur na//rkang pa chur bcug sbu ba skya bor 'khru// res 'ga' phyi sa skam zhing sdom par byed// long nad grang 'gyings sbo zhing dri ma 'bying // long lci skabs su skya bo zas mdog 'khru// long nad tsha rnyongs kha skam skom dad che// sbo zhing thug rngul byed la phyi sa 'gag / long nad 'ju skems sbo 'khrog ci zos na// nyam chung kha skam mkhal rked 'chad snyam byed// rlangs pa can ni gzhung pa rengs shing na//rked pa dgur por song nas 'gyur mi shes// bcos thabs grang sbos ya bakṣa ra dang // kha ru tsha dang rgyam tsha star bu yi// phye ma zho kha chu yis 'phul btang bas// gzer sbo rlung gis phyi sa 'gags pa sel// 'u su star bu shing mngar ya badzi// kyi lce drod sman phye ma chu bskol dbul// sbo 'khrog gzer dang 'khru ba sel bar byed// 'jam rtsi sgog skya zhing kun tshab gsum par rnying reng bu zhun mar btang ba bsngags// grang 'gyings shing kun shu dag ru rta dang // tsha la kha ru tsha rnams gong mas bskyed// bsdus khus sbo 'gying long gi grang ba sel se 'bru tsha ba gsum dang tshwa sna bzhi// bur dkar sbyar bas sbos pa 'joms pa'i mchog / a ru gla sgang shu dag tsi tra ka / pu shel ba chu bsrun pas rtug 'gags sel// long nad tsha rnyongs 'bras bu sa sum gyi thang / ba le ka yi thang btang long rtsa gtar// 'ju skems da lis bdun sbyar bshal gyis sbyang / rlangs pa

༄ khanang ga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 329can la se 'bru'i phye ma sbyar// bcu gcig pa dang long ther lte 'og bsreg /ces gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las long nad gso ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// //

330le'u zhe gnyis pa/ pho mtshan gyi nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// gsang nad gso ba'i skabs la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol /zhes zhus pa dang / drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so / kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / gsang ba'i nad la pho mtshan mo mtshan gnyis//pho mtshan nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu ni chags pa spyad drags gra mas reg / bshang gci khu ba'i shugs bkag btsir las 'byung // dbye ba pos zin 'brum pa bdud 'dra dang // sbubs 'byar gra ma can dang rnam pa lnga// sos zin rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun 'dus// pho mtshan nad rigs rnam pa dgu ru ba 'ad/ de rtags pos zin rlung las gyur pa ni// rtag tu 'greng dang pags pa 'gas par byed// mkhris gyur dmar por spangs la tsha ba skye// khrag gyur 'brum pa nag po khrag bcas 'dzag / bad kun g.ya' jing skrangs la lci ba yin//'dus gyur rlig skrangs rnag dka' kun rtags ldan// 'brum pa can ni 'brum pa mang pos khyab// mdud 'dra pags pa phyir log skrangs shu 'byung // sbubs 'byar kha zum gcin 'byung 'chu zhing 'gag / gra ma can ni gra mas gang sem na// gso thabs pos zin gsar dus gtar ga gdab// ni ru has drang bsil ba'i byug pa bya/ smin nas brtol la mar sbrang til bskol byug /spangs ma seng phrom ldong ros btsag yu ga rnam// ba bla nag mtshur sug sprel skyer khaṇḍa// rgya tsha rgyam tsha ha re ṇa ga'i phye// sbrang sbyar byugs pas sos zin rma

lta na ngag yon tan gyi da/ 331'tsho khyed// rdza gsar 'bras gsum bsregs thal mar sbyar byug / rlung gyur seng phrom mar dang sbyar la byug / mkhris gyur ga bur tsan dan ldi gu byug /khrag gyur ru rta ba sha ka yis byug / bad kun las gyur smyu ru sbrang rtsi byug /'dus pa yin na rma spyi'i gso ba sbyar// 'brum pa bzhar la sos zin lta bur bcos// mdud 'dra snum byug mnye zhing snum pas bdug / sgrubs 'byar spu gus brgyang zhing dral la gso// gra ma nas phye go stod mar btsos dkri// zhes gsungs so/bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las pho mtshan gyi nad gso ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //

332le'u zhe gsum pa/ mo mtshan gyi nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / mo mtshan nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen nyal po mang du spyad pa dang // khrag 'dzag bu btsas rjes la zas spyod log / de yis mngal nad ma lus skyed par byed// dbye ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun 'dus//de rtags rlung gyur mngal nang tshor med bee ma// zla mtshan sla zhing sbu bcas nyung du 'dzag / chu kha snyi zhing sems can yod snyam sem// zla mtshan blugs sam 'khyil dang skran du 'dril// kha 'chus khu ba rlon zum har po sogs//mngal nad mi bzad du ma 'byung bar byed// mkhris gyur zla mtshan ser nag dri ma che// tsha 'brab tsha ba skye zhing rnag tu 'dzag / khrag gyur zla mtshan mi 'chad rtag tu 'dzag / bad kun g.ya' grang zug chung spyin pag 'dzag /'dus pa las gyur nad kun byed par bshad// de ltar mngal nad kun gyis bu mi 'dzin// bcos thabs mngal nad phal cher rlung yin pas// snum 'chos 'jam rtsi dugs kyis gso bar bsngags// de 'og 'chus pa bsrang zhing kha zum sbyang // rtsa sbubs 'jam pos mngal nad kun sbyangs te// go stod shu dag rgyam tsha pi pi ling // zi ra nas tshig thal ba ba sha ka / la la phud dang tsi tra ka rnams ni// chang dang mar btsos mngal nad gzhang 'brum sel// ra sna gze ma ba sha ka bskol bslud// rgya spos kuṇḍa ka ri ru rta dang // rgyam tsha thang shing khu ba mang du bskol// ye 'u la byugs mngal nang gzhug par bya// mkhris gyur seng phrom ru rta ba sha ka / khu ba ye'u la byugs mngal du btang // nye shing

༄7mnang g.yon tan gyi da 333khu ba 'o ma mar bskol khur ka ra mnye nye shing shing mngar rgun 'brum dang //ba le pi pi ling dang ka ra sbyang // mngal khrag khu ba'i nad sel bu skyed mchog /gze ma nye shing 'o ma sbyar ba 'am// shing mngar sbrang rtsi skyer pa pri ya sku//'bras bkrus chur sbyar mngal khrag 'dzag pa gcod// bad gyur bu ram chang dang a ru'i chang / pi pi ling dang a ru lcags phye sprang // nag mtshur rgyam tsha a byag 'bras bu gsum// sbrang dang sbyar bas bad kun mngal nad sel// tsha ba lnga dang ba gcin mas btang bya// mkhris la shing mngar 'o mar bcas pa dang // rlung la se 'bru zhun mar sbyar ba gtang / ldan pa gnyis 'brel 'dus pa kun gyis gso// kun la ru rta rgya spos 'bras bu gsum// shu dag shing kun ra mnye hong len btsod/ shing mngar nye shing yung skyer la la phud// sman mar mngal nad khu ba'i nad kun sel/ gdon 'joms mngal chags dus zos bu 'chi gsos// zhes gsungs so/bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mo mtshan gyi nad gso ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa'o/ //

334——le'u zhe bzhi pa/ skad 'gags gso ba/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// thor nad gso ba'i skabs la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol//zhes zhus pa dang / drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so //kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / thor bu'i nad la skad 'gags yi ga 'chus//skom dad skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba dang // glang thabs srin nad 'khru skyug dri ma 'gags// gcin 'gags gcin snyi tshad 'khru dreg nad dang // grum bu chu ser rtsa dkar pags pa'i nad// phran bu'i nad dang rnam grangs bcu dgur bshad// dang po skad 'gags nad la rgyu dang rkyen// dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi// rgyu rkyen zas dang spyod lam gdon la sogs//'du ba 'khrugs pas skad 'gags nad skyed 'gyur// dbye ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun dang // za byed tshil gyur nas chad bdun du bshad// de rtags rlung gyur skad la 'phel 'grib che// gre ba gra mas gang snyam tsub la tsha// mkhris gyur gre ba tsha skam tshig mi thar// khrag gyur drag shul bcud gnod gre ba dam//bad kun mgul pa 'gag la skad dma' 'dzer// zad byed du bas bdugs dang brud snyam sem/ tshil gyur skad 'gags tsho ches las shes bya// das chad gre ba na la skad mi phyin// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi bcos cu gang zhing mngar spang rgyan dkar// ru rta rgyan 'brum ka ra sbyar la btang / a ru cu gang shing mngar spang rgyan dkar// sro lo sug spel mi sha ka ra sbyar// bsil gsum shing mngar rgun 'brum zhing tsha dang // spang rgyan ka ra

zhu mnang ga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 335skad 'a sa gas kun la phan// bye brag rlung gyur 'bras chan bu ram mar// sbyar zos rjes la chu tshan btung bar bya// snum ldan dugs bya 'o thug mar btab bslud// mkhris gyur ba la rgya shug dri bzang ba'i// rgyam tshar bcas bskol sna yi sman du btang / shing mngar zhun mar 'bras thug bcas pa bslud// spang rgyan shing mngar bong dkar gsum thang cu gang mar btab btang // khrag gyur skyu ru'i thang btang skyor gong gtar// bad gyur tsha ba lnga dang ya bakṣa// a ru ra dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba sbyin// nas thug pi pi ling dang bcas pa bza' sel dka' skyug sman rnon pos sbyangs rjes bsreg / zad byed las byung du ba sna sman btang // shing tsha sug smel drod sman cu gang dang // ka ra rim bskyed sbrang sbyar lde gu btang // tshil gyur nyams smad zas sman tsub bcos bston//das chad sha kha ra dang sbrang rtsi sbyar// mngar ba'i sman dang lhan cig bskol la btung // zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las skad 'gags gso ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// / /

336——le'u zhe lnga pa/ yi ga 'chus pa gso ba/de nas yang drang slong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / yi ga 'chus pa'i nad la rgyu rkyen dang // dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa ba'i// rgyu rkyen zas spyod gdon gyis 'du ba 'khrugs// lce snying la zhin yi ga 'chus par 'gyur// dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa ba'i// de rtags rlung gyur ro bska mkhris pa kha// bad kun ro mngar 'dus pa ro dang bral/ gso thabs yid la 'thad pa'i zas gang yang // gang la phan pa'i sman dang sbyar la sbyin// phyi nang khrus sbyang 'bras bu 'o mar sbyar// dkar ba'i zas bston bska ba'i chus kha bkru// yid la 'thad pa'i du ba sna ru rngub// ba lu pho ba ris sga pi pi ling // rim bskyed shing tsha sug sprel ka ra sbyar / pho ba'i drod skyed yi ga 'byed par byed// la la phud dang da trig star bu sga// se 'bru rgya shug ka ra 'u su dang // shing tsha kha ru tsha dang pi pi ling / go stod na le sham sbyar yi ga 'byed// sug sprel shing tsha nā ga puṣṭha dang //tsha ba gsum gyi phye mas yig 'chus sel// tsha ba shas che cu gang bde byed shis/ bye brag shu dag ka ra nim pa'i chus// skyugs rjes chang dngas skar chu sbrang chang bsrud// 'dus pa'i nad la kun gyis rlon byas la// shu dag nim pa bu ram chu sbyar bslud// ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las yi ga 'chus pa gso ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// / /

337le'u zhe drug pa/ skom nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / skom pa'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa ba'i yis bstan// rgyu rkyen gyen rgyu'i rlung dang mkhris pa 'khrugs// bad kun skems pas skom dad skye bar byed// chang dang lan tshas bad mkhris skyes pa'am// tshad gung ngal dub spyad rjes skom mang 'thungs// khong tshad bsdus pas mkhris skyed skom dad che// dbye ba rlung mkhris bad 'dus bcud zad lnga// de rtags kha lce skam 'ing zas mi 'dod//lce nyul skad 'gags ngoms pa med par skom// rlung gyur mgo 'khor gnyid med mu 'gram gzer// sna dang lce yis dri dang ro mi tshor// mkhris gyur khong tsha kha kha kha dri mnam// bad kun kha mngal rlon bro zas mi 'ju// 'dus rtags kun ston bcud zad zas min dka'// bcos thabs rlung mkhris sel byed phal cher bsngags// phyi nang gnyis nas bkru zhing bsil bar bya// char chu sbrang rtsi sbyar ba skom du btung // chag tshe ka ra sbrang dang sbyar la bza' 'o ma skyur rtsabs sbyang gi mkhur bkang bcang // khyad par rlung gyur bu ram zho sbyar btang // mkhris pa las gyur mngar ba'i sman gyis sbyang // bad kun las gyur nim pa'i chu yis rlon/ skyer pa ka ra sbyang chu skom du btung // 'dus pa'i nad la skyugs rjes chu tshan bslud// bcud zad sha khu 'o mas gso bar bya// 'u su bskol khur ka ra sbrang btab pas// nad gzhi ci las gyur kyang skom pa sel//shin tu skom na btung 'os ma yin yang / thog mar skom bsal de rjes nad
gzhi ba//da// rtsi /sdu po zlo/ /ga// brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag i rgyud las skom nad gso ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa'o// / /

339le'u zhe bdun pa/ skyigs bu'i nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / skyigs bu'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen zas spyod gdon gyis rlung 'khrugs pas gyen rgyu'i bu ga 'gags te skyigs bu 'byung // dbye ba zas byung phran tshegs zung 'byung dang // chen po zab mo zhes bya rnam lngar bshad// de rtags zas byung rings thabs zos rjes 'byung // phran tshegs zas zos rjes 'byung mod la chad// zung 'byung tshigs ring zhu dus gnyis gtud 'byung // chen po shugs drag mig har tshig mi thon// zab mo lte ba'i 'og nas gtud 'byung bsang // nyam chung zungs zad glo rdol gis pa la//skyigs bu chen po shugs drag byung ba spang // bcos thabs dang po 'bru mar bsku mnye bya// tshabs che ba la phyugs khrus 'jam pos sbyang // dbugs mi bder bshad du ba brngub par bya// nu zho tsan dan sbrang rtse sbyar ba 'am// sprang rinas zan brun sbyar sna sman btang // bra'o byi brun brngos pa'i steng du nyal//grangs rjes mar byug lag pa'i snying rtsa mnan// gcig bgrang dbugs thub bsdams pas rlung 'khyims sel// ma tshor 'jigs skrag dngangs pa'i cho ga bya//chad dka' spyi gtsug 'tshogs sgo ske stong dang // tshigs pa brgyad pa nang long 'phar rtsa bsreg / ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las skyigs bu'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// / /

340—le'u zhe brgyad pa/ dbugs mi bde ba gso ba/de nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dbugs mi bde la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen ma zhu bad kun 'phel ba dang // lud pa 'phel bas dbugs lam bkag las 'byung // dbye ba phran tshegs mun can dbugs chad dang // chen po gyen dbyung zhes bya rnam pa lnga//de rtags snying ga rtsib logs rgyangs sam gzer// lto sbo dbugs god yang na gzha' bar 'gyur// phran tshegs 'grangs ngoms 'dug rjes drag shul 'byung /mun can glo mig bad kun 'gags pa yis// lud pa mang la gre ba ngar zhing 'jor// nyal na mi bde ro stod gzer snyam byed// dbugs chad bad tan glo mig 'gags pa yis// gyen rgyu'i mthu nyams dbugs 'byin mi bde zhing spyoskad dma' gzhug chad gsang gtam smra ba yin// chen po skad 'dzer mgul skam nga ro che// ) tshe dbugs rgod lud pa mang du 'byung // gyen 'byung bad kon dbugs rgyu'i lam bkag pas/ phyir 'byin bde zhing nang du dbugs thub dka'// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyi bcos rgyam tsha til mar lus kun byug / tsha ba shas che de spang chu dron bsrun//bkru sman skyugs sman 'jam pos bu ga sbyang / sbyangs pas ma dag nad lhag yag ru gu gul dkar nag gla nga rdo dreg spang spos shing tsha ha re spu ka bi tang ga gla rtsi pa cul du ba med pa'i ra bsregs pa'am/ yang na spos dkar dang ro nga ros yang na ya gar mar sbyar gyi dud pas bsal// rta 'am ba gsar lci khu sbrang sbyar bslud// shing mngar pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang // ba lci sbangs khur bu ram sprang sbyar sbyin// mar gsar zho spris rlan

༄cu gunangs yon tan gyi da 341gnas sha rnams bza'// nyes pa gang che'i shas dang sbyar rlung nas che na ma 'chosabyas ri bong gi khumar spa ling sbya ra ba bsrud/ tshe stong dang po bsreg mkhris ra dur byinagaser mi hong len gyis sbyang / 'bras na spa ling cu gang sga mar sbyar ba bsrun/ bad gyur gas bya mnu zur pa ru srung sbyar bsrud/ khrig gyur chung thong gtar la bcos// bye brag phran tshegs nad la bcos mi dgos// phyi ma bzhi la ltar bu skyu ru ra// ru rta shing mngar zho sbyar bad kun drang // de 'og mun can tsan dan cu gang dang //shing mthar ka ra dri chu bar pas dbul/ dbugs chad cu gang shing tsha sug sprel dang // pi pi slang dang ka ra sbrang sbyar btang // yang na a krong srung rtsi sbyar ba byin// chen po sgong thog sro lo dkar po'i thang // lo brgyad dri chu ka ras ro bsgyur btang / gyen 'byung ma nu sprang gi lde gu byin/ kun la skyor gong rtsa dang thong co gtar/ go chen go chung ske stong thur mas gseng // zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dbugs mi bde ba gso ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa'o// / /
