342—le'u zhe dgu pa/ glang thabs bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / glang thabs nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa ba'i yis bstan / rgyu rkyen ma zhu ba dang mi 'phrod zas// rngul grangs srin 'khrugs gdon las 'byung bar byed// dbye ba gnas dang nad rigs rnam pa gnyis// gnas ni don glang snod glang rtsa glang gsum// don la mchin glang mcher glang rnam pa gnyis// snod glang pho ba rgyu ma long dang gsum// rtsa glang phyi rtsa nang rtsa'i glang thabs gnyis// rigs ni tsha grang srin dang gnyan glang bzhi// tsha glang mchin mcher gnyis kyi khrag 'khyags dang 5 khrag dang mkhris pa pho long lhung las 'byung 5 grang glang pho bar ma zhu lhung ba dang // rgyu long nang du thur sel 'khyil las 'byung // srin glang pho long gnyis su srin 'dril la// gnyan glang pho ba rgyu mar gnyan babs pa'o//de rtags mchin glang g.yas ngos mchin stong gzer// rngul grangs rjes la nad ldang rtsa chu tsha// mcher glang mcher steng rtsib thung gzer ba dang // sbo 'khrog byed cing chu grang 'thungs na na// pho ba glang thabs snyen sna'i 'og tu na// rgyu ma'i glang thabs lte ba'i 'og tu na// long glang lte ba'i g.yas g.yon thad ker na// tsha glang rgyu rkyen tsha bas bslang ba dang // lus rngul bsus pa chung la ldang dub byed// khrag gam mkhris pa 'khru skyug rtsa chu tsha// khyad par pho ba long du khrag lhung na/ grangs rjes na zhing sgrog la skyug tshul ston// ro rgyab mchin dri sbrag cing tsha dum byed// mkhris par lhung na kha skam skom dad che// kha kha mkhris par skyug cing gzer 'byung sgreg / grang glang rgyu rkyen grang bas ldang ba la// sbo

༄khanang g.yo na tan gyi da/ 343ldeng ldang dub med par ther zug na// ma zhu bad kun skyug cing grang rngul byed//khyad par ma zhu mi phrod zos rjes ldang // rul sgrog mang zhing skyug la zos thog na / long du smug po 'thab pa'i glang thabs ni// thur rlung mi thon phar 'bor tshur 'bor rgyu// 'grangs dang mtshan mo'i dus su khyad par na// ltogs shing nyin po'i dus na cung zad bde// rgyu mar thur sel 'khyil bas phyen mi thon//gyen du 'khyil zhing sbo 'khrog hril hril na / tshabs che rlung gis gcus zhing 'khril na spang // pho long srin glang dkar mthor grangs rjes na// thu gur 'dril lam tsha la 'bugs snyam byed// ldang dub che la langs dus sran glags med// pho ba rgyu mar gnyan babs gris dkrugs 'dra// pho ba sgrims la nya 'bros ba spu ldo ga / rtsa 'jur rna ba sleb cing rdzi ma chag / phyi rtsa glang thabs lte ba'i zur gnyis 'phar// nang rtsa glang thabs srog rtsa gzer 'khrug 'phar//bcos thabs mchin glang grog zhing bsros pas bdug / dri chur brag zhun ba sha ka sbangs btang // gur gum cugang ba le tigata.utpal ru ma gi rab dun dang cu gang gur gum 'bya sug thel bragazhun tig tab ling tshal ka ra brgyad pa sbyar// ru thung rtsa la gtar la khrag shed bcag / mcher glang se 'bru rgyam tsha bzhi thang btang /ma nu se 'bru sug sprel bkol rgyar tsha tha ling ka ra drug pa chu bskol 'phul la byin/ yos sam sran phub dugs bya mcher rtsa gtar// de yis zhi dka' lham rtsam ru dur byinargya mtsha'i thang gis sbyang // snod glang gang yang dpyad mchog sbyongs yin pas//star bu dung thal sbrul sha rgyam tsha dang // dur byin bu ram dri chu'i ril bus sbyang // snod du khrag mkhris ma zhu lhung ba 'don// khyad par pho glang skyugs la rgyu ma bshal// long glang ni ru ha yis drang bar bya// tsha glang dugs gtar brag zhun ba ba le'i thang la dom ma khris gur gum btab thang ru brag zhun gla ri bong nga ma ma khris gur gum sug sprel spru ye ku li shi'i phye ru dur byin snam rtsa rgya mtsha'i stongs kyis bcos// mchin khrag pho bar lhung na star bu dung thal sogs kyis sbyang ba gces// ru thung gtar zhing

344 ༄༅ spu nga byu/yos sam chu rdos bdug / brag zhun dom rma khris gur gum utpal ba'i pa ka ra sbyar la btang // mkhris par lhung na g.ya' kyi'i dur byid rgya mtshasbyongs skyugs sbrag /rjes la se 'bru ba pa'i steng du gur gum dug zhung ga ra bdun pa sbyar bar bya// grang glang dugs tshabs sum thang shing kun tshugasum phye ma bsreg pas bcos// ma zhur lhung na spyang tsher dur byin rgyam tsha spa ling skyugs rjes drod sman 'a tshab gsum rgya tshal du sbyar// sprug po 'thab la ru rta drug pa dang // chu lo a bo'i dugs bsten ru thung gtar// lte zur gnyis bsreg ni ru 'jam rtsi spel// rgyu mar rlung mkhyil mes bsro bkru 'jam btang // shing kun kha ru pho ris sga bur ma bzhi pa'i phye ma chang gis dbul// srin la rgya tsha do ba'i rtsa ba'am// shu ti bu ram sbyar ba'i ril bu 'am// lang thang tse 'am thang phrom sgog skya 'am// dkar po chig thub dri chur sbyar bas 'joms// rta sbangs phur mo spru rtsa'i dugs kyis bdug /gnyan glang lhog dug gsum gang rung dang ba ling rgyam tsha dri chur btab gyi sbyor ba 'am//bya khyung ril bus bsad rjes rgyal blon thar nu chu rtsa sngon bu sbyar// rtsa glang rked pa bcag cing rtsa ba'i bcing // bshal gtar tshad sbyang me yis rlung lam dgag //dro du rdo dī // ngas zlo 'dres zung // nyung du bsdus la lag len gnyis su bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las glang thabs bcos pa'i le'u ste ba'i bcu rtsa dgu pa'o// / /

345le'u lnga bcu pa/ srin nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / srin bu'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan/ rgyu rkyen zas dang spyod lam gdon la sogs// 'du ba 'khrugs pas srin nad slong bar byed// dbye ba phyir gnas shig dang sro ma ste// nang gnas bad kun rlung mkhris khrag dang ba'i// bad kun pho ba rlung srin long na gnas mkhris srin so mig pags gzhang mtshan mar gnas// khrag srin rkang med zlum la dmar ba ste// khrag la gnas shing rtsa nang kun tu rgyug / gnyan nad kun gyi rgyu dang mdze nad byed/glad srin ya ma dkar nag de las byung // de rtags dkar dang mngar bag grang rkyen ldang // lto tsha ldang dub byed la tshig pa za// 'khrugs pa'i gnas kyis srin bu'i nad rigs dbye// ya ma dkar nag tsha grang nad stobs dpag /glog ltar 'khrug cing ko ler gzer ba yin// bcos thabs shig sro lo btsan bya rgod spos// ra dug mar nag sbyar ba mgo la byug / sha ba'i tshil dang sbyar ba lus la byug / yang na dngul chu mar sbyar gos la byug / byi tang ldong ros sod spos mar nag la// rgya ru da snya sgo la pa sgyu hā// brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas srog chags skye rgyun gcod// bad kun srin bu 'o ma la bsdus la// byi tang ga dang ma ru tse dang btsod// 'brum dang se 'bru ma nu skyu ru ra/ sge gsher sbrang dang sbyar ba'i phye ma btang // rlung srin bu ram la bsdus shing kun btsong / so ma ra dza ru rta ba ru ra// shu dag byi tang ga dang bu ram sbyar// tsha ba gsum dang shing kun sgog skya dang // 'o ma sbyar ba'i 'jam rtsi btang bar bya mig srin

346 ༄7grwa thang rgyud ba'i/— so srin rang rang gso bar bya// pags srin byi tang ga dang tsi tra ka / sgog skya g.yer ma do ba byi dug pa// spru ma phur mo zo mar byugs la mnye// ga'ang srin gla rtsi sgog skya lang thang tse// tsha ba gsum dang zo mar reng bu gzhug / sgog pa rgyam tsha gla rtsi byi tang ga / mu zi mar sbyar bcug la phying pas bsro// mtshan ma'i srin la chags pa spyad pas sel// ya ma dkar po skra bregs 'khyug sar dbug / ra yi glo khrag tshil pags dron mos g.yogs// ra yi snying dang mchin mcher zas su bza'// zhag gsum ru rta ra tshil 'o ma byug / rtsa sgo mes mnan srinas na du bas bdug / 'khyug tshabs che na rtsa de gtar la bsreg / ya ma nag po sbyongs btang gtar ga bya// ra yi glo khrag snag rams khri lud spyin//sbyar bas byugs la gtsug dang 'tshogs ma'i stong // thongs bzhag mngar gsum byugs te grod pas btum// dgu nas gshags la rngabs drang sbang 'jib bya// dugs bdug sha ba'i glo khrag tshil lums bya// glog ltar 'khyug la long gas nga mdun rgyab bsreg / gzer steng dras la me btsas 'tshos par mnan// kun la byi tang sa dang ma ru tse// gla rtsi thing kun sgog skya g.yer ma dang // thang phrom phur thal lang tang tse dang 'brum// gres 'bru spru ma dkar po tshig thub rnams// mngar gsum 'o mar sbyar ba khong du btang // sha ba'i tshil dang sbyar ba sna ru bdug / zo mar reng bu byas la mas yar btang // do ba'i khaṇḍa sbyar la pags la byug / bya khyung ril bu yun bsten srin kun 'joms//byi dug byi tang ga dang jim thig le// ke tshe lca ba sne'u 'bam po dang // shel sna bskol khur so cha pi pi ling // sa rdzi ka btab til mar mas yar btang // khu bar dur byid sbyar ba'i srin bshal bya// dkar mngar rgya sne snum pa'i zas rnams spang // zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las srin nad bcos pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu pa'o// / /

347le'u nga gcig pa/ skyugs pa'i nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / skyugs kyi nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen ma zhu snyen dang lcags dreg dang / khong 'bras bad skug srin bu steng rlung 'khrugs// mi sdug yul mthong rnams kyis gyen du skyug / dbye ba rlung mkhris bad gan 'dus pa ba'i// de rtags ma zhu gang zos de nyid skyug / snyen dang lcags dreg chu skyur bad gan skyug / khong 'bras kha zas kun la 'khyen pa ste// bad gan skug po rgya brtsol dud khu skyug / srin gyis srin skyug rlung 'khrug stong skyugs byed// mi sdug yul mthong dri tshor reg pas skyug / rlung gyur sbu can chu thabs skyug pa la/brang rgyab rtsib logs gzer zhing mgo bo 'khor// mkhris gyur kha kha ser po khrag can skyug / lus tsha skom dad che la mgo bo gzer// bad gan las gyur bee snabs bska mngar skyug / dang ga 'gag cing gdong skrangs brang kha na//'dus pa las ni kun rtags ston par byed// bcos thabs kun la smyung bya chu tshan btung // zas skom yang la 'ju sla cung zad bsten// zas zos rjes la chu grang gdong bkru gtor// khyad par ma zhu rgyam tsha gsum pas bzhu// nyen dang lcags dreg thal sman rjes la rlon// khong 'bras tsher sngon sngo yi tsha ba gsum//thar nu bsregs thal rgya tsha ser mtshur sbyar rgya bshal dud khu skyug la sprug po bzhin// steng rlung 'khrugs la me btsa' rus thang btang // srin la de sman mi sdug yid 'ong bzlog / rlung gyur tsha ba gsum dang tshwa sna gsum// zhun mar sbyar btang byug byas me btsa' bya// mkhris gyur sbyangs rjes 'bras kyi sbyor bas

348 ༄/grwa nga da bzhi bcad// bad kun skyugs rjes byi tsher sprang sbyar ram// se 'bru 'bras yos nas phye sbyar ba byin// 'dus pa'i nad la gsum gas bcos bar bya// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las phyugs pa'i nad bcos pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'o// / /

349le'u nga gnyis pa/ 'khru ba'i nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / 'khru ba'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang skyirtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa ba'i yis bstan/ rgyu ni ma zhu gnas skabs 'khru ba dang // pho ba'i me nyams rgyu long grang ba skyes// mkhris pa snod lhung mchin tshad thur du babs// dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa'o// ri de rtags ma zhu don med 'byings rjes 'khru// me nyams kha zas ma smin rgyun par 'byung // rgyu long grang ba 'khrog 'ur grangs na ldang // mkhris pa snod lhung ser po tsha bcas 'khru mchin tshad babs pa dmar sprug dud khur 'khru// rlung gyur sbo 'khrog sbya ba sgra bcas 'khru// mkhris pa dmar ser dri mnam tshor med 'khru// bad kun be snabs 'khru la lto lci sgrog / 'dus pa las gyur rtags kun ldan par 'khru// bcos thabs ma zhu me drod nyams pa la// snang bya yos thug sha gsar sga spod bran// bungs chung bsten zhing chu bskol chang 'jam bsten/da lis bdun dang rgod ma kha phye sbyar// tshwa sna tsha ba lnga dang la la phud// se 'bru shing kun bu ram ril bu btang // se 'bru shing tsha drod gsum tsha ba gsum//la la phud rnams drod skyed 'khru ba gcod/ zas spyod bsil spang gcan gzan spu dugs bsten// rgyu long grang ba long gsang mdun rgyab bsro// tsi tra ka dang sug smel tsha ba gsum// bu ram sbyar gtang lcam pa'i tsha ba btang / mkhris pa snod lhung mkhris phye bdun pa sbyar// mchin tshad thur babs bad kun sprug por bcos// rlung gis 'khru la snum dugs 'jam rtsi bya/ se 'bru tsha ba lnga dang kha ru tsha// shing kun bu ram sbyar btang zhun mar bsrun// mkhris gyur se 'bru

350 sto/grwa thang dba'i/bong nga bca' sga'i thang // rtsa mkhris gla sgang hong len dug mo nyung // tsi tra ka dang tshwa gsum bu ram sbyar// mkhris skran mig ser 'khru ba gcod par byed//gla sgang bong nga bil ba dug mo nyung // tig ta pa tra 'u su skyer khaṇḍa// sga dang 'bras bkrus khu ba sbyar bsrun na// khrag dang mkhris par 'khru zhing 'khrog pa sel// bad gan tsha ba lnga dang a ru ra// 'u su ga rnyi sha khu 'bras thug bsrun//shing kun shu dag hong len bong nga dkar// dug nyung pa tra gze ma tsha ba lnga//tshwa sna lnga dang til dang zho btsos thal// mar sbyar bad rlung ma zhu skran 'khru sel zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las 'khru ba'i nad bcos pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// / /

351le'u nga gsum pa/ dri ma 'gags pa gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dri ma 'gags la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang spyortags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen zas spyod gdon gyis 'du ba 'khrugs// rgyu long bshang lam skams nas dri ma sdom// dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun srin nad dang / thur sel log dang rnam pa lngar bshad do// de rtags rlung gyur 'khrog skam sha ril 'dra// mkhris pa rgyu zhabs na 'dril dam la mkhregs// bad gan lto lci sgrog cing bsus pa skrangs// srin gyur a long kha za ldang dub byed// thur sel log pa 'khrog snang phyen mi thon bcos thabs kun la ni ru ha yis drang // rlung la shu ti mkhris la lham rtsa ste//bad kun drod sman srin la byi tang ga / thur sel log na rlung sna rlung gis drang // a ru lham rtsa bul rtog bsdus pa'i thang // dri ma skams pa gang yang rlan par byed// zas spyod khong sman 'du ba spyi dang 'dra/ zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dri ma 'gags pa gso ba'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa'o// / /

352le'u nga bzhi pa/ chu 'gags gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / gcin 'gags nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa ba'i yis bstan// rgyu rkyen sgang pa'i kha nyid thur bltas pa'i/ ngos gnyis chu rgyu'i rtsa yod rgyu mar 'brel// de la zas spyod gdon gyis 'du ba 'khrugs// sgang pa'i rtsar zhugs gcin nad skyed par byed//dbye ba gcin sri ba dang gcin 'gags gnyis// sri ba rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa ba'i// 'gags la kha 'chus rlung 'khyil khrag dang spu// skrangs dang khu ba bshang ba de 'gags brgyad// de rtags rlung gyur yang tsub zas spyod kyis// chu sngo sgang pa pho mtshan na la gzer// mkhris gyur dmar ser tsha ba che la na// bad kun bsil zhing ska 'byar yu na du thogs// 'dus pa kun gyi rtags dang ldan pa yin// gcin bsdams lhang pa rgyas te kha 'chus pas// rgyu zhabs sgang zhing gcus snyam btsir na 'byung // thur sel gyen du 'khyil bas chu sor zug / nyung shas bshang gci gtong ba'i dus su 'byung // mkhal ma bsam se'i rtsa 'grams khrag 'khrugs pas// chu dmar khrag ro bcas 'byung rgyu zhabs na// kha zas spur 'dres sgang pa'i rtsar 'grims pas// zug chung snyi la chu 'dzim sgru nyag 'byung // sgang pa'i la 'am bshang lam bar du skrangs // sra zhing na la bshang gci phyen dbugs sdom// tshangs spyod pa 'am gcin bro nyal po byas khu ba gcin 'dres thal khu 'dra ba 'byung // bshang ba 'gags pa rtug pa gcin bsdams sam// bshang gci 'dres na gcin la bshang dri mnam//rde 'gags bad mkhris khu chu khrag can sru// bad kun la bsten chu btsos rlung

zhu khan nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 353gis sgril// sngon tshul pho mtshan gzhang kha bar rnams na// gcin 'gags sbre mnam lhang par sbo bar byed/ nad rgyas gcin 'byung dus na so 'cha' 'dar// 'khun zhing khu tshur bcang dang mtshan ma nyed// de yang 'chol sde zug de gnyis su srid// 'chol rdo gcin yang bar mtshams bcad cing 'ong //rta zhon drag shul rjes la khrag can 'dzag / zug de kha la zug nas rgyun du sdom//gting du zug na na gzer chu mi 'gag / de rnams bcos thabs rlung gyur chu sri la// rgya tsha sdig srin sug sprel kha ru tsha// nyi dga' bu ram chang dang sbyar la bskud// bsku byug snum dugs drod bcud zas kyis bcos// mkhris gyur nye shing gze ma pu shel tse// rgyan 'brum dur ba 'bras dang ba da ra// bskol khur ka ra sbrang rtsi btab pa bslud// gla rtsi skyu ru brag zhun chig thang btang spyo bad gyur rgya tsha sug sprel tsha ba gsum// sdig srin lcam pa chang dang sbyar la btang //bya rgod rus pa sug sprel tsha ba gsum// gze ma sbrang bskud 'dus pa kun gyis gso// kha 'chus rkang pa nas sprug lag pas bsrang // rlung 'khyil dugs dang byug pa 'jam rtsi bya// khrag 'gags chu tshan nang bcing long rtsa gtar//dmar po bzhi dang mkhris sna sbyar la btang // spu 'gags lhang pa'i kha nas mnye 'ing bzho// skrangs 'gags chu lums dugs dang gtar ba dang // mas btang gong mas skrangs pa bzhu bar bya// khu ba chags pa spyad cing mnyes la bzho// bshang ba 'gags pa ni ru ha yis drang // gang yang thon dka' chu thur gsang ba la// pho la mtho gang sbom phra gro sog tsam// mo la sor bzhi sbom phra nas sog tsam// rgyus mdes kha dril gsang du btang la dbyung // de 'us 'gags la sman shig dpyad kyis dbyung / de sman krung krung rnga mo bong rus dang // dbyi mong gze ma sman sga chang sbyar btang / rnon po gsum dang nyi dga' gla rtsi dang // so bya'i sgro gzhob chu ngan sbyar la btang / ze tsha rgya tshas sna drangs tshwa sna tshogs// gser gyi bye ma sdig srin 'bras sna gsum// nyi dga'

354 sto/grwa nga dab /sug sprel gla rtsi tsha ba gsum// spos dkar 'bu skyogs bur dkar chang sbyar btang / yang na ba tsha nag mtshur sman mar la// kha tshar btab btang zas spyod drod du bsten// chu 'gags kun sel khyad par rdo 'u bshig / rgya tsha sug sprel gla rtsi sdig srin dang // bong rmig bying bying thu lu chang sbyar la// oṃ tha tha shag shag tsir tsir tsheg tsheg rbad snyil su hā// smra ba bcad de rgyun du bzlas la byin// dpyad kyis dbyung ba rdo phran lam nas dral// sman gyis ma bshigs rnyings shing rgyas pa la// snum bskus dugs bya rta shing la bskyon nas// nad pa kha zas ma zos nyams smad de// pus mnyam nas kyi khri la par pas brten//gyid khung bkug la g.yog bcas ras kyis bcing // lag g.yas sor mo lte 'og g.yon nas btsir// g.yon pa'i gung mos ga'ang khar rdo 'u bsgug / chu rtsa srog rtsa srid rtsa las byol ba'i// mdun gsang zur gsang rgyab gsang gar khugs sar// de 'u btsal la btsags kyis legs dral te// cha dpyad sbrul mgo lta bus dbyung bar bya// chu dron nang bcing rma la sbrang rtsi byug / bu ram 'grangs byin nas thug mar bcas bslud// zhag bdun 'das nas gcin lam ma 'gyur na// rma de spra bas bsreg cing phying pas bdug / rta zhon nyal po ri shing 'dzeg pa dang // chu yi las dang rlan steng lo dus spang // zhes gsungs so//bdun snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las chu 'gags gso ba'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// / /

355le'u nga lnga pa/ gcin snya ba'i nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / gcin snyi'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen lan tsha mngar bsil lci ba'i zas rlan can mal 'dug bad kun tshil 'phel ba/ lhang par zags pas za khu skyed par byed// dbye ba bad mkhris rlung dang rnam pa gsum// bad kun za khu chu chang bur shing dang / gar po 'bras gye khu chu bye ma dang // bsil dang bags 'byung kha chu bcu ru bshad/ mkhris pa'i za khu nas tshig snag tsha dang // sngon po skyer khu btsod khu khrag 'dra drug / rlung gyur rkang zhag glang chen sbrang 'dra bzhi// za khu nyi shu gcin snyi'i nad rigs yin// de rtags sngon tshul mal stan gnyid la rtsi// jul mang dri mnam sku dang sen mo ring // kha mngar gre ba rkan skams bsil la rtsi// mthil bzhi tsha zhing gcin mdog rnyog can 'byung // gcin gyi shul la sbrang ma'i tshogs kun 'du// sngon tshul mi gsal mdog la nges ma yin// bad gyur kha zas mi 'ju dang ga 'gags// gnyid che lud pa mang zhing skyug par byed// mkhris gyur pho mtshan sgang par zug cing na// kha skam lus tsha 'khru zhing rims kyis 'chabs// rlung gyur gnyid 'phar gnyid chung dbugs mi bde// 'dar gzer zas la rngam zhing lud pa mang // kun kyang yal bar bor na thor pa bcu// kham phor rus sbal dgu po dra ba can// me dbal sran chung yungs kur ba da ra// sbu bcas khong 'bras zhes bya gnad steng 'byung / bcos thabs za khu bad tshil gtso bor bcos// 'bru rnying skam sa'i sha la sogs pa yi// yang zhing tsub pa'i zas

356 gyi/grwa thang rgyud bzhi/skom spyod lam bsten// ba gcin lci ba las byung kha zas bza'// ngal dub mang du spyad cing gnyid mi log / yang zhing tsub pa'i sman gyis dril phyis bya//yung skyer skyu ru gze ma'i bsdus thang btang // 'bras gsum chang sbangs skams phye sbrang sbyar bza'// bad kun las gyur za khu skyugs byas la/ seng phrom gla sgang a ru ra thang dang / pa tra byi tsher byi tang ga yi thang // seng ldeng skyer pa byi tang ga yi thang / gang rung sbrang rtsi sbyar la btang bar bya// mkhris pa'i za khu spyongs rjes sha khus brda// skyer pa skyu ru sbrang dang sbyar ba 'am// sle tres skyu ru sbrang dang sbyar la btang // dug mo nyung dang skyer pa tsi tra ka / 'bras bu gsum gyi bskol khu bsrud par bya// rlung gyur 'bras bu gsum dang sgron shing dang // skyer pa gla sgang mar dang sbyar la btang // zungs dang 'dres phyir shin tu gso dka' yin// bla gnyan thor pa gcin bskud rma ltar gso// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gcin snyi ba'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa'o// / /

357le'u nga drug pa/ tshad pa'i 'khru ba gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / rgya nad tshad 'khru rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang kurtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen me drod mi snyoms chung ba la// drod rlangs che ba'i yul sar chu mang 'thungs// zas tshod ma zin sha rin shing thog 'bru// bcud med zas kyis me drod phyir la bton// phyi yul drod rlangs tsha bas mchin tshad skyed// lus kyi chu khams thur bskyod 'khru bar 'gyur// dbye ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad gan ba'i// de rtags snying ga rtsib logs bshang lam zug / lus snyom khong pa sbo zhing zas mi 'ju// ma smin chur 'byam smin pa de las ldog / rlung gyur sgu ba sgra bcas bur khu 'dra// chur 'khru skabs su 'gag cing gong bur 'byung // gzer zhing kha skam ba spu ldang ba yin/mkhris gyur ser nag sngo la dri ma che// bshang kha tsha zhing lus rngul skom dad che/khrag gyur khrag tu 'khru zhing gzhang kha 'drul/ bad gyur skam 'byar gnyid che yi ga 'chu// bcos thabs ma smin dang po'i dus nyid du// nang nub chu tshan btung zhing snang bar bya// se 'bru bel ba da trig zur pa sga// 'u su'i thang gis smin byed 'gru ba gcod// bshang 'gyings byi tang ga dang 'bras bu gsum// pi pi ling bskol khrus btang ni rus drang // 'bras sam phye thug sga spod bran pa dang // lug dang ba lang skam sa'i sha gsar dang // dar gsar chang gsar bskol grangs me drod sbyar// zas spyod bsil drod mnyam zhing zas tshod bzung // gla sgang bong nga dkar po bil ba sga// shing kun dug mo nyung khu bsdus 'jam btang // bil ba 'u su gla sgang ba le ka / dong ga bskol grangs

358 sto/grwa nga da bzhi/khu ba bsrun par bya// 'khru ba ma smin mi bcad nyes pa che// stobs chung zas spyod gzab cing btang snyoms ba 'ag / rlung gyur bil ba sga dang pi pi ling //bu ram til mar sbyar btang 'o dron bsrud// mkhris gyur dug mo nyung dang bong nga dkar// 'bras khu sbrang dang sbyar la bslud par bya// bong nga dug mo nyung dang ba le ka / thal ba gla sgang 'bras khu sbrang sbyar bsrun// khrag gyur til nag ka ra ra'i 'o ma// yang na tsan dan 'bras khu sbrang sbyar btang / hong len skyer shun rgya skyegs pi pi ling // sman mar 'bras kyi thug pa sbyar la btang // bad kun las gyur bil ba a ru ra// sga dang gla sgang bskol ba'i khu ba bslud// pa tra gla sgang bil ba mon cha ra// sga dang 'u su bu ram dar bcas byin// bcos rjes gcin mang bshang ba nyung la ska/ phyen gyi sgra thon zas 'ju na dbyang rtags/ zas dang spyod lam gzabs pas 'tsho bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las tshad pas 'khru ba gso ba'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa drug pa'o// / /

359le'u nga bdun pa/ dreg nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dreg gi nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen khrag 'khrug byed pa'i zas spyod bsten// nyin par gnyid log skyid par 'dug pa dang // drag shul rkyen gyis nga khrag 'khrugs pa yis// rkang pa'i mtheb mo lag pa'i spu mor gnas//dang po khol bu rnying nas mched par 'gyur// dbye ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun ba'i// de rtags sngon tshul brla rked tshigs rnams na// g.ya' 'gul chag snyam tshor med lci ba ste// yang yang ldang zhing slar lci 'gyur ba yin//nad rgyas gsar dus pags pa khrag la gnas// skrangs dmar drod che sra la sngo thig bcas// shin tu na zhing bya smyung mang ba ste/ rtogs bla'i dus yin dus 'dir bcos pa gces// tha ma rnyings nas rtsa chu rus tshigs khyab// lhag par skrangs zhing mi bzod sra la hrem// gzhang kha rus tshigs chad pa snyam du sem//shugs rgyas zha 'theng 'di dus gso dkar 'gyur// khyad par rlung gyur gzer 'phrig 'phel 'grib byed// spangs la nag po sngon po'i thig le 'ong // mkhris gyur drod che dmar la reg mi bzod// khrag gyur tsha 'brab mdog dmar 'drul bar byed// bad kun las gyur g.ya' lci tshor ba med// bcos thabs rlung bcos ci rigs rlung bsal la// de rjes mang du gtar la nyung du dbyung //tsag tsag lhang lhang na sar jabs ru gzugs// skrangs che dmar la thur mas btsag par bya// rlung gyur ba gcin spos dkar 'o mas sbyang // de 'og slo tres bskol ba'i khu ba dang // 'o ma bskol ba ka ra btab la btang // rgun 'brum

360 zhu/grwa nga da bzhi/shing mngar ka ra mar bskol bsrun mkhris gyur nye shing stong len 'bras bu gsum/ slo tres pa tol 'o ma mar bskol bsrun/ gur gum skyer pa bskol la sbrang sbyar byin/ de 'og dur byin rgun 'brum 'o mar sbyar/ bad gyur 'bras bu gsum dang sbrang rtsi btang / gla sgang gur gum skyer bskol sprang sbyar bslud//nad stobs ldan na skyugs rjes tsub bcos bya// kun la 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba lnga// gca pa tra shing tsha ba sha ka / pi ling sku la cu gang byi tang ga / shu dag spang spos lcags g.ya'i lde gu yis// dreg nad gzer bcas ma lus sel bar byed// dur byin a ru rgyam tsha pi pi ling // bkru 'jam sbyor ba dreg 'joms sman mchog yin// nad skyon sol na phyi nas byug pas bcos// til mar sbrang rtsi gu gul thal tres btsod// bskol ba'i lde gu byugs pas dreg nad sel// khrag mkhris las gyur stag tsher shing mngar btsod// skyer pa tsan dan rgya shug pu shel tse// sran chung ka ra'i lde gu grang mo byug / shu dag ru rta dud pa ser po gnyis/ shu ti'i lde gus bad rlung dreg nad sel rnyings nas mas btang bkru sman snum 'chos bya// kun la bad tshil rlung khrag gtso bor bcos//zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dreg nad gso ba'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa'o// / /

361le'u nga brgyad pa/ grum bu'i nad bcos pa/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / grum bu'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang smortags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan/ rgyu rkyen rlan snum yul dang snum bcud zas dngas ma gnas su ma smin chu ser rgyas// sha rus rtsa rgyus la gnas grum bu skyed/ dbye ba sha trem rus trem rtsa trem dang // chu trem trem dkar trem nag rnam pa drug / de yi rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi rtags grang shum yun ring sha pags brtse gdong snum mgo bo rked pa dpyi mig zug / shed chung gyid skyur sha 'bros rngul kha snyi// rus tshigs sha dus 'khol zhing chu rgyus gyong // 'gul tshe lhag par na zhing skad ngan 'chor// chu dmar rtsa 'khyug phra mgyogs gting na rgyug / bye brag sha trem bad mkhris shas che ste// sha sbo mdog nag yan lag sbrid pa dang // glo snying mi bde sna khrag mang du 'dzag / sha rus 'byed snyam bem por byed pa yin// rus trem rlung gi shas che skom dad che// nus pa tsha ba skye zhing 'ju la skam// tshigs rnams gram zhing zug che 'gul mi nus// bsgul dang sgra cher mi bzod g.yang skyur sem// rtsa trem khrag gi shas che skrag mdangs nyams// glo snying mi bde ltag sha chad snyam byed// rtsa rnams sbos shing sra la na ba yin// chu trem chu rgyus gyong 'dar rengs 'khums skams// trem dkar chu ser dkar po grang shas che// trem nag chu ser nag po tsha shas che/ bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyi bcos dang po zhag lnga'i bar dag tu// bad kun chu ser sbyang phyir 'bras bu gsum// sle tres thang bsten chu bskol yang yang btung // de rjes tsan dan

362 ༄grwa thang da bzhi/dkar dmar gi waṃ dang // bzang dug chu ser sman gsum ge sar gnyis//tig ta sle tres spyi zhur 'bras bu gsum// gla rtsi spang rgyan be do ba sha ka / bong khrag ka ra sbyar ba nyi shu lnga// gung gnyis seng ldeng khu bas 'phul la btang //se 'bru lnga pa nang nub chu bskol btung // dngas ma gnas 'jog chu ser tsha ba skem// gla rtsi gur gum sga rgod gnyen po'i sman/ zho 'am bong khrag la sbyar lde gur btang // sman rjes 'bras bu gsum gyi rgyun sbyongs bya// sha sbos chu ba 'khums sam rus tshigs zug / ra mnye ba spru nye shing chu lums bya// rjes la spang spos mar dkar sbyar ba byug / tshigs mig chu ser grang thur sbyor bas gdon// kha zas 'bras dang chag tshe sran chan dang // khur mangs ba yi zho dar bskol grangs chu/ ja sogs bsil la yang ba'i zas skom bsten// nus skyur snum lci tsha sogs dug 'dra spang // me nyi nyin gnyid rlan grangs kun la gzab//tsha ba byang ba'i rtags byung sprang chang dang // ba yi rnam lngas chu ser chod lhag skam// skam sar mi rngul tsam du dal bar bcag / bye brag sha trem gze ma ba spru ba// shing tsha dong gra mar sbyar lde gu btang // lca ba'i khaṇḍa g.yer chu sga chu bsten// rus trem ga bur bzang drug tsan dan dkar// shing tsha ba le ka dang pu shel tse// bca' sga nag mtshur ka ra sbyar la btang // bong khrag dron mo gla rtsi sga sbyar ram// bu ram sbrang rtsi mar sbyar ting khrol btang // gtar bsreg mi bya rjes la bshul sha bsten// rtsa trem dang po ba le ka yi thang // de 'og g.yer chu bsdus thang btang bar bya// ru rta se 'bru shing tsha pi pi ling // sga skya a ru ra dang kha ru tsha// sbrang dang sbyar ba'i lde gu btang bar bya// gla rtsi gur gum a ru li dong gra// sbrang rtsi mar dang sbyar ba'i lde gu btang // rtsa yi drod 'chor gtar ga mi bya spang // chu trem 'bras bu gsum dang sku la gsum// 'u su tsha ba gsum dang tshwa sna gsum// sbrang rtsi mar dang sbyar ba'i lde gu btang // a ru rgyan 'brum 'u su sho mo za// tsha ba lnga dang sbrang rtsi mar sbyar btang // byin

lta nang ga yon tan gyi da/ 363gzhug tsha gtar tsha ba byang ba dang // bco lnga bcu drug dpyi mig gar babs bsreg / chu rgyus 'khums na bsku mnye drag tu bya// trem dkar chang nang shing tsha li dong gra// sbrang sbyar rtsa ba'i zan chang chu lums bya// ra mnye ba spru nye shing sbrang mar bsten// trem nag a ru chur bsdus zhag 'gar btang / gur gum bshal bya gze ma'i sman mar sbyar/ kun la skyed chung rus rtsa gtar ba dang 0'jib tu bcug la kha bcing lan mang sgril// rta la bskyon de gsangs la chu nad skyur/ zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las grum bu'i nad bcos pa'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa'o/ //

364le'u nga dgu pa/ chu ser gyi nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / chu ser nad la gyur tshul dbye ba dang sgortags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// dang po gyur tshul kha zas dngas ma de// mkhris pa dmar sgyur las kyis khrag tu 'gyur// khrag gi snyigs ma mkhris pa'i nang du gsog / mkhris pa'i dngas ma chu ser nyid du 'gyur//gnas ni sha rus don snod phyi nang khyab// khyad par sha mdangs bar dang tshigs bar gnas// tshad ni rang gi snyim pa bzhi ru bshad// dbye ba chu ser rigs dang 'jug pa'i sgo// rigs ni chu ser dkar po nag po gnyis// chu ser dkar po bad rlung grang bar sdongs/ chu ser nag po khrag mkhris tsha bar sdongs// 'jug sgo pags gram shar rgyas rtsa ru rgyug / rus zhen don babs snod du lhung ba'o// de yi rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi rtags za 'phrug thor pa leb mor 'ong // skabs su lus kun sbo zhing skrangs pa dang // sha mdog sngo la tsub cing 'brum pa 'ong // gra ma phub mas rig na za 'phrug byed//skra dang smin ma byi zhing 'drugs pa'o// khyad par chu ser dkar po rtsa chu grang //nam zhon rlan dugs chur zhugs grangs tshe ldang // lus dros drod bcud zos rjes bde bar mngon// chu ser nag po rtsa chu'i tsha ba skye// me nyis dros shing chang 'thungs ston dus ldang // chu ser pags gram khyad par za 'phrug byed//thor chung mang la phugs na chu ser 'dzag / pags mdog sngo tsub rgyang la srin thor mang // sha la rgyas na nya sgang shu ba 'byung // sha kun 'gul 'phrig spangs shing sbo ba yin// rtsar rgyug rtsa kun sbrid dang 'khyug pa dang / tsha myag tsha bar

༄cu smonang g.yon tan gyi rgyud 365grang bsil za ber 'ong // rtsa mig nang du srog chags rgyu ba 'dra// rus zhen rus pa lhang lhang na ba dang // tshigs dmigs na zhing brkyang bskum 'gro 'dug dka'// tshigs kha skrangs shing za la shu thor 'byung // don babs snying la chu ser zhugs pa yis// shes pa 'phyo 'dar stod rgyangs snying mi dga'//dngang shing tshig pa za la khro tshig byed// brang la srin thor sha bkra 'ong ba dang //lce la thor pa rgyun du 'ong ba yin// glor zhugs glo mang mig dang rkang bol skrangs// brang rgyab gzer la skad 'gags mtshul pa skam// mchin zhugs mig nas mchi ma rgyun du 'dzag / lus lci sna khrag 'ong zhing pho mchin na// mcher zhugs sbo 'khrog mchu nad rgyun du 'byung // mkhal zhugs rked pa dbyi dang brla sul na/ smad lci rkang pa sbrid cing rtsa kun 'khyug / snod babs mig ser tsha 'gyur sna glang ldang // skabs su chu sdom skabs su ser sprug 'khru// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la bcos thabs sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi// chu ser dkar nag gnyen po so sor bsten/ chu ser dkar po chang dang lug sha dang // mar rnying phyi ba rta bong sha rnams dang / bu ram chang sbyar gze ma'i zan chang dang smo ra mnye rtsa ba'i zan chang bur sbyar btang kaspyod lam rlan grangs bser bu phub las spang // sman du ra mnye'i rtsa ba gze ma dang // nye shing ba spru gong mas cha bskyed pa'i/ bsdus khu'i khaṇḍa sbrang dang bu ram sbyar/ bca' sga pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka / sug smel dza ti sbyar te btang bar bya// rtsa ba lnga dang seng ldeng 'bras bu gsum// zo mar bcas pa'i mar khu bu ram sbyar// bca' sga la sogs phye ma kha tshar gdab// grang ba'i chu ser ma lus 'joms par byed/ sbrang smyon cha yis goms pas brid la bsten//btsan dug a ru gur gum shu dag dang // ru rta shing kun dzā ti byi tang ga / tsi tra ka dang drod sman bu ram sbyar/ ril bu sran tsam bsten na chu ser skem mu zi 'bri mar nang du bsdus pa yis// mar nag mdog 'gyur sbrang dang sbyar

366 zhu/grwa thang dab la bza'// dpyad du gang babs gsang la me btsa' bya// chu ser nag po zas spyod bsil bas bcos// ba ra mdzo yi zho dar mar gsar dang // chab tsha ba lang ri dwags sha gsar bsten// chang dang mar rnying rul sungs bu ram spang //spyod lam bsil sar dal bar gnas par bya// sman du sngon bu snam rtsa a ru ra//thar nu re lcags chu rtsa byi tang ga / chu ser sman gsum ba chur sbangs pas bkru//de rjes rtsa bshal btang la chu ser sbyangs/ skyer pa se rgod seng ldeng ba ru yi//phye ma gu gul bcu dang sbyar la btang // ba yi rnam lnga seng ldeng sman mar sbyar//dngul chu'i ril bu bston pas chu ser skem// dpyad du gang la babs pa'i rtsa la gtar// bye brag chu ser sha pags rgyas pa la// sngon bu srub ka zho dang sbyar bas byug / so ma ra dza shu dag li shi dang // tsi tra ka dang mar sbyar byug par bya// srad dkar thal ba rta bong 'o mas byug / thal ka rdo rje g.yer ma mar sbyar byug / sbur pa dong gra 'o ma sbyar ba 'am/ ba ru ra dang sbrul thal mar sbyar byug / so ma ra dza ba bla ba gcin byug / ma phan rtsa sbyongs seng ldeng sman mar sbyar// rtsar rgyug gtar dang rtsa sbyongs rjes la skam// rus zhen lto dang rtsa nas sbyangs byas la// rtsa ba lnga dang mu ri'i sman mar sbyar// tshigs dmigs chu ser lta bur me thur bya// sha pags rtsa rus kun la chu lums bsngags// de rjes seng ldeng sman mar nad rjes bcad// snying la zhugs na sbal rgyab chig thub dang // gser rdo mtshal dkar pha waṃ long bu dang // tsha la bzang drug chu ser sman gsum dang // gu gul shing kun gla rtsi snying zho sha / ru rta skyu ru ra dang a ga ru// a ru ra dang ka ra sbyar la btang // snying rtsa gtar zhing tshigs pa drug pa bsreg / btsan dug ril bu seng ldeng sman mar sbyar// glor zhugs cu gang ru rta shing mngar dang // tsan dan rgun 'brum chu ser sman gsum dang / ga dur dmar po gsum dang sprang sbyar la// glo yi rtsa gtar tshigs pa bzhi lnga bsreg /mchin mtsher la zhugs rtsa ltos sbyang ba gces// gur gum brag zhun gla rtsi pi ba

zhu mnang g.yon tan gyi da 367ling // ka ra sbyar btang mchin pa'i rtsa la gtar// mkhal babs dmar po ba'i yi thang btang zhing // rtsa sbyongs rjes la rtsa ba'i sman mar sbyar// gang du babs pa'i gsang du me btsa' bya// snod du chu ser babs pa sbyongs kyis dbyung ta mdor bsdus chu ser 'phel bas nad 'gyur te// sha bkra glang shu srin thor khe ma dang // shu ba za skong za 'phrug chu ser byed// 'or dang skya rbab dmu chu chu ser byed// sur ya me dbal dreg grum gag lhog dang // snyongs pa'i tsha ba thams cad chu ser byed// mgo dang yan lag byang khog la sogs pa// rma yi nyes pa thams cad chu ser byed// 'bras dang mdze nad chu ser las 'byung bas// de phyir chu ser nad la bya ra gces// dngul chu mu zi seng ldeng so ma ra//thal ka rdo rje gu gul dkar nag gnyis// skyer pa brag zhun sngo yi tsha ba gsum//byang pa rtsa ba lnga dang bong bu'i sha / sprang rnams chu ser 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin// nad gang sdongs pa'i gnyen po sdebs te bsten// chu ser zad na sha dang pags pa skams// nyam stobs mi skye sha dang chang gis gso// zhes gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las chu ser gyi nad gso ba'i le'u ste lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa'o// / /

368le'u drug cu pa/ rtsa dkar gyi nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / rtsa dkar nad la gyes tshul rgyu rkyen dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa ba'i yis bstan// gyes tshul lus kun rtsa ba rtsas skyed de// sro ga gi rtsa bar gyur pa'i rtsa rigs gnyis// srog rtsa las byung rtsa nag gyen du gyes// klad pa las byung rtsa dkar thur du zug / nang rtsa don 'brel phyi rtsa yan lag 'brel// nang rtsa dar gyi dbyangs thag bcu gsum ste//rlung gi rtsa ba'i snying dang rgyu mar 'brel// mkhris pa'i rtsa ba'i glo long rmi chin mkhris 'brel// bad kun rtsa bzhi pho mcher mkhal sgang 'brel// 'dus pa'i rtsa gcig bsam ser 'brel ba yin// nang rtsa mi mngon don snod 'brel ba'i phyir// mgo skyon 'bab cing na lugs du ma ston// phyi rtsa sbu gu can gnyis 'ja' byed gnyis// ratna gnyis te rtsa rgyud drug tu bshad// spu gu can de ltag pa'i sdud sgor don// yan stong g.yas g.yon mtshon re thad dkar 'grims//tshigs pa lnga nas gzhung pa'i rtsa dang 'brel// bcu bzhi pa nas bsam se mkhal mar 'brel// gzhug chung dpyi leb mtshams brgyud dpyi mig don//byin brla'i phyi sul phyi long gung mtheb brgyud// gnyis ni bcu ba'i nas gyes dpyi steng don// brla rkang pus tshigs dar gdong thur bar 'grims// pir mgor 'brel nas gong dang rkang mthil 'dus// 'ja' byed ltag zur sru 'khyil gnyis su don// yan stong 'gram nas phrag brgyud dpung sogs mtshams// dpung 'dzum tshigs dmigs lug gzhug phyi mchan 'grims// gru

mnang g.yon tan gyi rgyud 369mo'i tshigs bskor lag pa'i mtheb por 'brel// ratna rtse mgo rna shal 'og tu 'thon// sgrog rus nang nub gru mo gzhu mchog bar// thur bar 'grims nas lag pa'i srin mtheb 'brel// phyi rtsa sha chu rus tshigs 'brel ba'i phyir spangs sbos skams dang zha rings byed par 'gyur// de la rgyu rkyen drag shul 'grams pa 'am// rims dug tsha ba rtsa la babs pa'am// mtshon gyis bcad brdungs rlung 'khrugs rtsar zhugs pas// de la rtsa dkar nad du 'gyur ba yin// dbye ba sbyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// spyi la rtsa dkar tsha dang grang ba gnyis// de yang dus kyis gsar dang rnyings par 'gyur// bye brag gnas dang 'du ba'i nad gzhis dbye// gnas ni mgo dang byang khog yan lag gsum// 'du ba rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa bzhi// de rtags mgo stod kha mig yon por 'gyur// mgo 'khor myos dang dran nyams tsog mi zug /gnyid chung skyug dang kha lkugs dbang po 'khrul// g.ya' za sgra cher mi bzod yan lag shal// byang khog smra mang 'dar rjes ngoms pa med// gzhogs gcig bem mam tshor bral skrangs sam snyam// dri chu blugs sam yang na rgyun gnyis sdom// me ltar tsha 'am yang na rdo ltar grang // gzhu ltar gug gam yang na rwa ltar dgye// thing ltar rengs sam yang na gyong ltar bsdus// ngo mtshar nad rtags du ma ston par byed// yan lag shal sbrid bem mam tshor ba bral//g.yo skams sha rengs 'khums sam ro ltar bog / mtshon phog g.yas g.yon stod smad sne snol skrangs// 'grams mtshon tshad babs mkhris ldan tsha bar 'gyur// rlung dang bad kun rkyen byas grang bar 'gyur/ rlung ldan 'dar g.yal kha skom shes pa 'khrul// mkhris ldan drod dang tsha ba zug gzer che/bad kun ldan pa drod chung g.yo zhing skrangs// 'dus pa'i mtshan nyid kun rtags ston par byed// stobs ldan 'chi la 'bring po bcos pas 'tsho tshabs chung yun lon rang bzhin 'tsho bar 'gyur// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi

370 ༄gyi/grwa nga dba'i/dang bye brag gnyis// spyi bcos gsar dang rnyings pa dus dang sbyar// gsar dus tshabs chen mthil bzhi bcu gsum pa// sru 'khyil pir mgo sor mo nyi shu bsreg / tsha ba shas che rin chen rdo rtsi sngo gser zangs yu rnying thog lcags byu ru nya skyos sa/dkar ga bzhi bzang drug gla rtsi/ 'bri ta sa 'dzin ma pa ka ra dkar sbyar chu grang 'phul la btang // yang na nya gyis bzang drug gi /tsan dan das ra dam ra ya ga ru bse ru gla rtsi ru rta ling shing tsha 'bras bu gsum sdig srin ga ra bye ma pa zir gnyis 'bri ta sa 'dzin nyi shu rtsa lnga'i phye ma sbyar// zas skom gsar bcud yos thug zho dar bsten// stod smad gar babs gnas sbyar rlangs thon gtar// tsha ba bri nas bur chang bdud rtsi yin// grang ba shas che gla rtsi bzang po drug / ba mkhal ru rta a ru bu ram sbyar// a ru grang bsings khu bas 'phul la btang // yang na a ru sman chen dkar nag ser// gla rtsi ru rta shu dag dri chus sbru// ril bu drod dus bsten na bdud rtsir 'gyur// drug bdun dkar nag mtshams bsreg gtar mi bya// kha zas drod bcud bur chang sman mer sbyar// rtsa nad rnyings pa bsdus sbyangs brta bar bya// da lis kyi lce shing mngar khaṇḍa la// gur gum sug spel 'bri ta sa 'dzin dang // gser bye nyi dga' sbrang sbyar nang nub btang / gla ril chang btsos dril bas rtsa nad sdud// de nas byang khog nang rtsar babs che na// lto sbyongs rjes la rtsa bshal bsngags pa yin// mgo dang yan lag phyir babs rtsa nas sbyangs// tha mar 'bri ta sa 'dzin a ru ra// da lis kyi lce shing mngar nyi dga' yi// sman mar sbrang rtsi bu ram ldan pa btang // yang na 'ba' sam sman mar drod bcud bsten// bye brag mgor babs phyi rtsa gla ril lums// yan stong 'gram dang sdud sgo spu 'khyil bsro/ nang rtsar babs na rdo 'i rgyal po ba'i dom dri mi/ /kau sdu ru/bo'i byi ༵ // shā gyi me ga /shā gdab/ /na gas ༵ ṭwāṃ ༵ nya sdu / // shor mdud gsum gdur / gzhogs rengs kha lkugs rtse mgo sor mo bsreg /

sa khan nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 371kha mig yo na ltag zur spu 'khyil bsreg / dar rtsa gnad 'grams mgo lci sna sbyongs bya// tsha ba rtsa rgyas rtse chung rtsa lto sbrag / rlung 'khrugs gur gum shing mngar sna sman btang // byang khog rtsa nad spyi gtsug sdud sgo dang // drug pa dkar nag mtshams dang sgrog rus shongs// yan stong 'gram dang ske stong sogs mthil bsreg / gser zangs thog lcags byu ru nya skyogs dang ⑪bzang drug tsan dan dkar dmar a ga ru// gla rtsi bse ru 'gron thal dom mkhris dang // rdo dreg ka ra a ru'i khu bas 'phul// gla ril lums bya rnyings nas tsa lto sbrag / snying la dzā ti ru rta a gar bsnan// glo la shing mngar rgun 'brum gla sgang bsnan// mchin par utpal brag zhun ba sha ka / mcher par ma nu pa rtol pi mi ling // mkhal mar btsod dang zhu mkhan rgya skyegs bsnan// pho bar ma nu rgyam tsha pa to la// rgyu long bong nga dug nyung gla sgang bsnan mkhris par tig ta dug nyung gser me rtog / lhang par lcam pa rgya tsha sdig pa bsnan//rang rang rtsa gtar rang sor rang gsang bsreg / yan lag rtsa dkar byer bsdu'i khaṇḍa la// tsha na ga bur grang na pi pi ling // ril bu mtheb tsam ra 'o sbyar la btang // gla ril bdud rtsi lnga yi lums su gzhug / gang babs rtsa gtar rnyings nas rtsa nas sbyang // sha skams pa la de rjes chu lums bya// 'bras bu'i mar la bzang drug sman ldan bsten// chu rgyus babs che glo lums chang rgan btung // rkang bshal bcu bzhi rtsa nag kha gzar dang // dbyi mig dpung tshigs phyi nang rkang mthil bsreg / lag shal sgrog rus gshong dang 'ja' byed gnyis// dpung tshigs phyi nang ratna lag mthil bsro// rlung ldan rlung gsang bsro zhing bcud zas bsten/ mkhris par ldan na lto sbyongs rtsa sbyongs btang //bad gan ldan la chu tshan lums dugs bya// 'dus pa'i nad la kun dang 'brel bar bcos/ gang zhig rtsa dkar nad tshul mi shes par// gza' phog zer ba'i sman pa blun po te/ thabs 'di rma rnams kun gyi log gnon dang //
rims dug bla gnyan nad kyi mde kha yin/ zhes gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rtsa dkar gyi nad bcos pa'i le'u ste drug cu pa'o// / /

373le'u re gcig pa/ pags pa'i nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / pags nad rgyu rkyen dbye ba bcos thabs gsum// rgyu ni srin dang chu ser 'phel ba la// gdon dang 'du ba 'khrugs pas pags nad skyed// dbye ba sha bkra glang shu mdzer pa dang // za kong shu ba srin thor ngo shig dang // khabs dang khye ma la sogs sgra yis brtag / bcos thabs sbrul nag pags pa nus ldan bsregs ba ru'i mar sbyar glang shu sha bkra sel// so ma ra dza ldong ros ba chu byug / phag tshil mu zi glang shu sha bkra sel// mdzer pa pags la drangs te btsod shel bsreg / za kong gang nye gtar la chu lums bya// za 'phrug rtsabs bkrus nim pa nag mtshur til// gi waṃ rtsabs dang sbyar ba'i lde gu byug / so ma ra dza shu dag tsi tra ka / li shi zo mar shu ba za kong sel// shu ba thang shing ru rta ldong ros mar/ yang na mu zi tsha phabs du ba byug / sngo yi tsha ba gsum dang ra dug pa/ thar nu chu rtsa mar dkar shu ba sel// srin thor do ba'i rtsa ba tsi tra ka / byi tang ga dang btsan dug sbyar ba byug / ngo khab khye ma sbrang btsod lde gu byug / rta dkar mig pa bsregs thal mar gsar ram// zi ra dkar nag yungs kur 'o ma til yang na skyer pa seng phrom sbo ha ti/ seng phrom spra tshil spos dkar pu shel tse/bu ram sbrang mar ba gcin bskol ba byug / the ba ngo khab khye ma sel bar byed/gdong pa padma zla ba lta bur 'gyur// ser po gnyis dang ru rta dug mo nyung //dud pa'i sde gus shu ba sha bkra dang // g.yan pa pags nad ma lus sel bar
374 ༄tsho/grwa nga rgyud ba /'gyur// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las pags pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa gcig pa'o// / /

375le'u re gnyis pa/ phran bu'i nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / phran bu'i nad kyi gso thabs bstan pa ni// nya log 'khru skyug byung na mtheb srin bsreg / 'dod chags rtse mo zhe sdang tshil bu dang // gti mug 'khor lo brje'i mkhris pa dang // bon po'i thal ba 'dre 'jigs thang chu dang | brtan po'i dreg pa dri can lte ba rnams// dri chur sbyar ba phyir byug khong du btang // yang na bya ze phag sna ngur pa'i sha / rdo dreg gla rtsi bul tog shu dag dang // sug smel chu grang 'phul btang gos kyis byib// yang na sbal pa sdig pa stag khra bo// gla rtsi dom mkhris gi waṃ dri chur sbyar// gur gum thang btang nya sul lcags kyis bsreg / skyug na ske stong drug pa nyen sna bsreg / sre long thang btang khru na lte 'og bsreg / kha zas bsil drod nad kyi zo dang sbyar// mes tshig rma la nya yi mkhris pa dang // dom mkhris sbal pa'i khrag dang sbyar la gdab// yang na bul tog brag spos phye ma gdab/ tshabs che ba la khong du ga bur dang // tsan dan gur gum gi waṃ mkhris sna btang // chu rug shod dang zho btsags sbang 'jib bya// chu la gnas pa'i mkhris pa mtha' dag dang // ga bur cu gang gur gum hong len dang // bul tog brag spos chu rtsa rma btsir gdab// khab bam mde 'u khong du shor ba la// ar bar skyur gsum gong mas cha bskyed la// khab len phye ma srin bal chu sbyar btang ⑪'gul du mi gzhug gan rkyal nyal la bsdad// srin gyis dril nas bshang sgor 'byin par 'gyur// sha 'am zan la sogs pas gnangs gyur na// rkang pa'i khrig ma gnyis nas lag pas bzung // rgyab tu kha sgrub khur la cung zad dgur//

376 zhu thang byu /rke rags rdo yis rkang mthil gnyis su brdog / de nas ro stod rgyab pas cur gyis 'byin// gre bar gra ma zug na sbrul tshil byug / nas phug thang btang ba sha kham cher bza'//gre bar rus pa zug na go bo yi/ gri ba gro chang nang sbangs khu ba byin// nya rus zug na so bya'i sha khu 'am// sram gyi sna dang mche ba'i khu ba btang // rna ba'i rwa nu'i dum bu mur bar bya// sdom dang sdig pa khong du song ba la// srad dkar ram pa chang sbyar khong du btang // chang nad sga g.yer tsha btags chang sbyar btang / phyi mkhris dron mo mid na chang nad 'byang // sha ba rna ba'i khrag gnyis dron mo la// tsha btab btang na chang nad gtan du 'byang //sngo sga'i tsha ba sman chu bston par bya// sne 'u lhags na rang gi dri chu byug / phying pa tsha chur btsos pas skrangs pa mnan// mthe bo'i sen mo ser tsam bsreg par bya// gnya' rengs ltag dgye tsha mar byugs la mnye// bse dri ti tsa shug thal rngul sar byug / rkang lag kha bas phyin na chu yis bgrang // rna bar srog chags shor na rgya tsha dang // shing kun mar nag dugs bsros tshugs tshad blug / nu ma skrangs na lho bkug thang gis sbyang // spen thal rna ba'i gzhug spu rgya tsha rnams// byis pa'i chu la sbyar la tho rangs btang // phigs nas dpyi nus bsregs thang lcag tu btang // zug che spang rgyan drod sman shing mngar lcag /nu ma'i tshabs dang spu 'gags skrangs pa sbyong / zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las phran bu'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// / /

377le'u re gsum pa/ 'bras bcos pa/denas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags/ lhan skyes rma gso'i skabs la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa dang / drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / lhan skyes rma la 'bras dang ga'ang 'brum dang // me dbal sur ya men bu rlig blugs dang turkang bam mtshan bar rdol dang brgyad du bshad// dang po 'bras la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu ni 'gram 'khrugs kha zas ma smin pas// ngan khrag rgyas te rlung gis bsgril nas 'byung // dbye ba gnas dang nyes pa'i rigs kyis dbye// gnas kyis dbye nas phyi 'bras nang 'bras gnyis// phyi la sha dus rtsa yi 'bras dang gsum//nang 'bras glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma dang // pho ba sgyu long gzhang dang sgang pa dgu// de rigs rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun dang // mtshon dang bye 'bras dbye ba bco brgyad bshad// de rtags phyi nang rigs kyis brtag pa gsum// phyi 'bras spyi rtags rtsa rgyud phra la 'dar// spangs pa sra brtan na zug chung ba la// lums 'dul kun gyis zhi bar mi 'gyur ba'o// khyad par sha 'bras nyung gsher 'khyags pa 'dra/ rus 'bras rus pa mdog 'gyur rtsi nyams zos// rnag chu sro ma khu tshigs 'byung ba yin/ rtsa 'bras rtsa thog skrangs shing 'khyug la 'phro// de dag gnad steng byung ba gso ba dka'// khong 'bras

378 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba /skran ltar reg pa sra ba 'am// mi mngon gting nub zas la mkhyen pa ste// smin nas gyen thur gnyis kur rnag rdol 'gyur// glo 'bras mid pa na zhing zas min dka'// snying 'bras dran pa mi gsal mun sros sem// mchin 'bras dbugs 'gag mgo 'khor skom dad che// mcher 'bras sbo 'khrog byed cing dbugs mi bde// mkhal 'bras chu sri btsir snyam rked pa na// pho ba lto sbo zas 'khren mid pa na// rgyu long zhu rjes na la skyigs bu 'ong // gdong pa rkang bol g.yo zhing 'khru bar 'gyur// gzhang 'bras gzhang kha na zhing 'gyen dbugs 'gag / sgang pa chu 'gags zug che chu so na// phal cher pho long mid pa'i 'brel mtshams mang // de phyir pho ba'i kha 'dzin gces pa yin// rlung gyur sbo 'khrog mi brtan mgo bo 'khor/ mkhris gyur dmar tsha myur rnag tsha ba skye/bad kun mdog skya sgrog cing zas mi 'ju/ khrag las gyur pa nu ma mngal du 'byung ku rab tu tsha la 'brum pa nag pos khyab// mtshon lam la brten rdo la thug la sogs// 'i zhing slar ldang rgyun du gnas par byed// bye 'bras bye sgong tsam sra zug med brtan// bcos pa'i thabs kyang de bzhin rnam gsum ste//phyi 'bras dang po gdul dang bar skyon bsal// sha 'u gso 'ing tha ma chen brtas bya// 'bras 'dul sha la mi rus nya yi sha / sru rtsa re lcag cong zhi dri chu'i lums// dus la pi pi ling dang ra mnye mnan// rtsa la mtshal dang tsha las bran la bdug / yang na ya la bdud rtsi lnga yis bdug nus la 'ba' cha'am rus sna sna tshogs lums// rtsa la bsil ba'i sngo snas gdul bar bya// kha zas phyogs med 'jig zas btang la bsheg / thul rtags skrangs shing hrem med mnyen la bde// de yi stong du me btsa' 'tshos par bsreg / yang na skrangs 'dus tsha 'khyug rnag smin 'gyur// rnag phug 'jibs khrus dul bcad 'byar gyis bcos// skyed med bar du sha ro skyon bsal ba// dngul thal rgya tsha ru rta byang pa ba'i// yang na bse zho btsan dug dngul thal dang // smug po sbal rgyab dom

zhu khan ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 379mkhris sbyar ba 'am// byang pa rgya tsha ru rta shu dag dang // thar nu 'brug rus sbyang smyon tsha ba gsum/ rma med thur mas sman lam gtod la gzhug / rma can reng bu'am shog bu la byugs dgab/ dam gyis sbyar la zhag gsum za ru gzhug / ser ga byung nas gson gshin mtshams su ba ngas/ 'bam po phug ron brun dang spang 'jibs bya// yang na so thog ze tsha sbrang sbyar bcad// chod pa dka' na lcags kyis non par bsreg / rus la stag sha lce tsha khab len gsum// sbrang smyon sbyar byugs chod dka' brud dam bsreg / gson gshin sprad cing byer na mgo ltar bcos// rtsa la 'bras bu'i thang rjes mang du gtar/rtsa 'brum tshan do 'phar rtsa me yis mnan// rtsa nas sbyang zhing khong nas rtsa kha bsdam// phro chad sha ro gong bzhin bsal bar bya/ rtsa kha shor na dom mkhris thal ba gnyis// spru 'bu bu ram ril bus rtsa kha dgag / spru rtsa zho dang sbyar bas rma kha g.yog / skyon sol dag nas bkrus la 'tsho sman gdab/ skams na zhos sbang rlon na phrum sar btang // sbos na phying mar brtse na snying co bya/ tha ma men chags brtas par bya ba ni// dur blug klad pa tsha dang sbang gar byug /khru gang 'og sa khur rtsa rus sna rnams// dri chur btsos bdugs then mi ldang par byed// khong 'bras smin nas gso ba dka' ba'i phyir// smin du mi gzhug gsar dus gso ba sgrims// dang po snang byas bong nga byi tang ga / dug nyung sgron shing pho ba ris bskol bslud// stobs che spos dkar dur byin a ru ra hong len drod sman ba chu sbyar bas bkru// yang na nim pa hong len 'bras bu gsum// shing mngar pa tol dur byin kyi lce ba// sran chung khu ba mar bskol sbyang bar bya// skabs su 'jam rtsi ni ru ha spel btang // kyi lce bsdus khur tig ta byi tsher bka tsan dan gla sgang utpal skyu ru ra lca ba ra mnye 'o ma mar bskol bsrud// brag zhun gu gul ba gcin mig la byug / ston ga'i 'bam po pos ma'i dbyi mong gnyis// khaṇḍa ra byas te sna ma tshig pa la/ bu ram btab

380 sto/grwa nga rgyud bzhi/bsres rgya tsha kha ru tsha// tsha ba gsum sbyar ril bu khye sus bsten// 'jam rtsir btang zhing phyi nas dmigs la byugs// drod la bgor zhing yang na 'ju bla bston// zhig rtags mthong nas gang nye'i rtsa nas drang // 'khru na sman thun bskyed pas khong 'bras 'joms// des ma sel na a ru ba chur bsdus// gong bzhin khaṇḍa sa tsha grang gang yang 'joms// tha mar se 'bru'i sbyor bas nad rjes bcad// khyad par brag zhun a ru spos dkar gsum// gzhir bzhag glo la cu gang shing mngar bsnan// tsan dan dzā ti skyu ru zho sha snying // mchin par ba sha ka dang gur gum bsnan/ mtsher pa pi pi ling dang li shi bsnan/ mkhal mar btsod dang sug sprel sdig srin bsnan// pho bar kha ru tsha dang bca' sga bsnan rgyu long rgyam tsha gser gyi me tog bsnan// sgang par sdig srin ga'ang la ni nus bsu// don snod gar babs rang rang rtsa la gtar// smin nas rang don nad de btang snyoms bzhag / nang nas smin tshe phyir 'byung rma ltar gso// rlung 'bras khrus btang rtsa ba lnga bskol bsrud/ khrag mkhris pu shel tse btsod 'bras bu gsum// shel ta shing mngar yung skyer spa shug 'bru// sman mar bza' byug gang nye'i rtsa la gtar// bad kun sbyangs rjes dur byin yung ba nas// skyer pa til byug bye 'bras me yis bsreg / mtshon 'bras mang gtar lums dang dul /cod sbyar// chu lums me btsa' shin tu bsngags par 'dod// ces gsungs bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las 'bras bcos pa'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //

381le'u re bzhi pa/ gzhang 'drum gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dgra ltar srog 'phrog gzhang 'brum gso ba la/rgyu rkyen dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bzhi/ rgyu rkyen khrus drags gzhang lam gci lus btsan stan srab tsog 'dug bshang gci phyen 'gag btsir/bzhin bsten thur sel rlung 'khrugs gzhang 'brum skyed// dbye ba bad rlung khrag mkhris skam gsher ro/ de rtags 'brum pas gzhang bkag thur sel log / nyes pa 'khrugs te drod chung yan lag na// rlung 'khyim khong sbo mgo 'khor yi ga 'chu// stobs chung sha skam mchil mang rus tshigs na// gcin mang bshang ba nyung zhing 'khru'am skam// chu sri mtshan ma na 'brab gzhang kha gzer// dri ma khrag bcas srul las grangs phyogs dpag / khyad par bad gyur sbo zhing me drod chung // yi ga 'chu zhing cham 'debs mchil ma mang ⑪gcin sri chu sor zug cing na la gzer 'khru mdog skya la bad gan bee snabs mang // khrag dang chu ser mi 'dzag 'brum pa dkar// g.ya' zhing 'phrug 'dod tshor ba chung ba la pags pa sen mo mig sprin gdong pa skya rlung gyur dri ma bshang skam tsha la 'tshag / sgra dang bcas shing ska sla 'dres mar 'khrusamago dang phrag pa brla dang rtsib logs dang // chu so na zhing dbugs god lus drod chung // pags pa sen mo gdong mig 'brum pa nag / khrag gyur 'brum pa byu ru 'ol se 'dra/ shin tu tsha zhing na la khrag mang 'dzag / mkhris gyur tsha ba skye zhing skom dad che/ lus rngul gzhang nag dmar ser dri bcas 'khru/

382 sa /grwa thang da bzhi/'brum pa dmar ser sngo la khrag sla 'dzag / pags pa sen mo mig chu sngo ser ljang // gzhang sor phyed dang lnga las gnyer ma gsum// phyir byung gsar pa gso ba bla ba ste// bar mar byung dang lo gcig 'das gso dka'// nang gnas 'dus pa lo 'das gso ba tsam// lus spangs gzhang rnag rims btab skyug pa dang // snying ga rtsib logs na dang lhan skyes spang / bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// dang po a ru ra dang byi tang ga / dug nyung tsi tra ka dang dar ba bsrud// a ru kuṇḍa ka ri tsi tra ka / gang rung rdzar byugs dar ba blug la bslud// dzā ti ru rta thal tres a ka ru// shu ti se yab thang shing ro smad byug / bshang gci 'gags na 'o ma mar gsar byug / gze ma ba spru thang shing khu ba bslud// chu tshan lus bcing spa 'brum zhun mar byug / bya brun pi pi ling dang 'ol mo se// yung ba ba gcin byug dang reng bu gzhug / mi skra byi la sbrul pags pon cha ra// mar sbyar dud bdug de dag gzhang 'brum 'jig / thor pas da dang gtar bas khrag ngan dbyung // ma zhig ltos sbyangs nyi ma lde ba'i sar// de'u 'don pa lta bur lus bcos la// blta dang bcad pa'i cha byad tshad ldan pas// thor pa bzhar zhing lcags dang mar gyis bsreg / de rjes ro smad sman mar byug par bya// g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab thor pa rim pa yis//zhag bdun bar bcad 'brum pa re re bsal// tsi tra ka btab zho bsnan dar ba btung / sha khu'am sran khu dar bar bcas pa bza'// dar ba 'jam tsub bar ma me drod dpag / dar bas gzhang 'brum nad bcom slar mi ldog / bye brag bad gyur rgod ma kha phye sbyar/ so cha dud pa pi pi ling dang mar// reng bu'am 'bru mar sbyar ba mas btang bya// rlung gyur se 'bru'i khu ba zi ra gnyis//la'i phud dang pa tra sga sbyar btang // a ru ba chur btsos phye bur sbyar sbyin//khrag gyur dri mnam zungs bsrung mi bcad bzhag / mtshal 'dra bcad de shal ma li yi shun// seng phrom btson dang hong len dug mo nyung // tsan dan shing

khanang g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 383mngar pu shel na ge sar// zhib btags 'bras bkrus chu dang sbyar la bslud dug mo nyung shun 'bras bu a byag dang // ge sar utpal seng phrom sman mar btang // stang zil tsan dan pu shel ra khrag dang // ka ra 'bras kyi chu bslud til nag gi / lnga 'gyur sha kha ra dang 'o sbyar byin// mkhris pa las gyur ind+ra bzhi thang btang // dug nyung bong nga skyer khan sprang sbyar bza'// spos dkar dong gra a ru khron bus sbyang // gzhang 'brum rlon la dug mo nyung shun mchog /skam la bse 'bras kun la dar ba mchog / bla gnyan gang byung nad gzhi brtags la bsal// shugs btsir stan srab nyal po bzhon pa dang // rlan grangs me nyis gdung ba rtag tu spang // zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gzhang 'brum gso ba'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa ba'i pa'o// / /

384le'u re lnga pa/ me dbal bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//rkya drang srong chen po nyon cig / me dbal nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen zas spyod gdon gyis khrag mkhris 'phel// chu ser tsha ba rlung gis bus pa'o// dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun mtshon las byung // gnas ni pags pa don snying rnams la gnas// de rtags rlung gyur 'dar brtse skungs gzer skyug / mkhris gyur tsha dmar myur mched kha kha skom// bad gyur g.ya' 'jam mgo rkang tshigs ga'i na// mtshon byung rims 'dra 'brum dmar tsha bas khyab// phyir byung mes tshig rma dang 'dra zhing mchen// nang gnas glo snying tsha gdung myos par 'gyur//stobs nyams gnas der tsha gzer skom dad che// bcos thabs thog mar gtar sbyang nad skyon bsal// de 'og byug pas me dbal zhi bar byed// shing mngar dug nyung so cha stod byung rlon// ra gsum kyi lce dur byin smad byung sbyong //sran chung nim pa hong len kyi lce dkar// shing mngar skyer pa'i khu ba khong du bsrun// sdum bcud mi btang gang nye yang yang gtar// nang skyon dag nas mu zi nag po dang // ra dug thar nu ldong ros lde gu byug / snag tsha ru rta gla rtsi chu ngan byug / rlung gyur shu ti gla sgang pi pi ling // shi kru 'u su sgron shing ru rta dang // 'o ma mar dang sbyar la byug par bya// mkhris gyur pad rtsa utpal ba le ka / rgyan 'brum tsan dan shug pa shel ta dang // shing mngar gser btsag 'o mar ka ra byug / bad kun 'bras bu gsum dang pu shel tse// 'dam bu ka ra shug pa btsod khu byug / mtshon byung bsil bas byug cing gtar ga bya// zhes
sa khan nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 385gsungs so/bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las me dbal bcos pa'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa lnga pa'o// / /

386le'u de drug pa/ sur ya'i nad bcos pa/denas yang drang slong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / sur ya'i nad la gyur tshul dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// gyur tshul zas spyod rkyen gyis khrag 'phel dang // mtshon khrag lus dang 'grams khrag gtar ma 'chun//rims dug tsha ba rtsar babs ma gtar bas// khrag ngan chu ser don snod rtsa mig 'dus// skrangs shing rnags na 'bras ltar 'gyur ba yin// dbye ba glo mchin mkhal ma pho long lnga// de rtags glo ba'i sur ya mchan 'og skrangs//stod gzer glo mang mchin pa mchin stengs skrangs/ stod gang nyal ba mi shes mkhal ma na// mkhal steng skrangs shing dri chu sri ba yin// pho long sbo 'khrog byed cing steng du spangs// kun kyang smin nas rnag khrag she rul 'dzag / skabs su gsog cing blo blong ldang bar byed// bcos thabs 'byed thang btang rjes mang du gtar// de 'og lto dang rtsa nas dag par sbyang // brag zhun 'om bu'i khaṇḍa mig la byug / bdud rtsi lnga yi lums kyis spangs pa 'dul// yang na me tog sna tshogs lums su gzhug / ma 'i 'bam po bya bra spru ma yi// lums kyis rnag tu bkug la smin nas brtol// sbang ma'i 'jibs bya hrem na lums dang spel//rnag 'byams dngul chu'i ril bus skem pa dang // gar babs gnas dang sbyar ba'i phye ma sbyar / 'ba' sam mar la rwa sna mkhris sna dang // bzang drug sbrang dang sbyar bas skom par byed// rtsa sgo rma yi steng du me btsas mnan// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las sur ya'i nad bcos pa'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa drug pa'o// / /

387le'u re bdun pa/ rmen bu bcos pa/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / men bu'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang ⑪rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen drag shul rkyen gyis 'grams pa'am// rlung khrag 'khrugs pa men bu la brten skrangs// phal cher ske 'jing mig zur sne sa mang // dbye ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun dang sha tshil rtsa dang 'bras dang brgyad du bshad// de rtags rlung gyur rgya che bus 'drar g.yo// mkhris gyur dmar ser drod che tsha la rnag / khrag gyur drod che tsha dmar rtsa thog 'byung // bad kun zug chung sra bsil skya ba yin// sha men sra la rgya che 'jam zhing snum tshil men mdog dkar bsil zhing 'phel 'bri che/rtsa men rtsa steng snyi la 'gul ba'o// 'bras phreng sra 'dril gting zug 'phel 'bri chung // kha cig rang bzhin zhi'am 'phel rgyas byed/ kha cig zug grod kha cig zug gzer che// la la smin dka' la la myur du rnag / sra la smin dka' nyung gsher 'khyags 'dra dang // 'bros shing 'phel rkyen 'gas pa spang bar bya// bcos thabs gsar dus nad stobs chung ba la// spra tshi' shog bu la bskus bsros la glan// rgyam tsha bca' sga tshan dos bdug cing mnye// ma zhi steng du me yis 'tshos par bsreg / nad stobs 'bring la brag zhun dri chu byug / yang na klad rul tshwa dang sbyar ba byug / a ru gu gul skyer pa ba chu btung spyo ma 'i 'bam po bya bras rnag tu dgug / rnyings shing rgyas nas snum 'chos dugs byas la// lto dang rtsas sbyang gang nye'i rtsa la gtar// chu ma tsi dang

388 sa /grwa thang dba'i/sgong thog brag zhun dang // bul tog dri chu sbyar bas byug par bya ma thub bsregs steng khra bo'i lums kyis gdul// rnag tu khugs nas 'bras ltar bcos par bya// zug chung rab 'phyang rtsa bar bcad la bsreg / bad rlung stag tsher seng tsher tsi tra ka / pi pi ling gi sman mar snum rjes sbyang // rgyam tsha sga mar byugs steng a sa sa bdug / khrag mkhris a ru rgya skyegs tsan dan dang //hong len shu dag sbrang dang sbyar la btang // kyi lce brag zhun hong len dri chu byug / sha chen gcan gzan sha sna btsos la bdug / tshil gyur gu gul bza' zhing bye rug bdug / sha then gong 'og bsreg cing gang nye gtar// 'bras phreng lums kyis btul la de rjes bsreg / ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las men bu bcos pa'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa bdun pa'o// //

389le'u re brgyad pa/ chag drugs gso ba/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / rlig blugs nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen zas spyod gdon dang thur sel 'khrugs// lam log rlig par zhugs te skrangs par byed/dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun tshil gyur dang / gcin las gyur dang rgyu blugs drug tu bshad/ de rtags rlung gyur blo bur gang rgyas na// mkhris gyur dmar zhing tsha la drod che rnag / bad kun zug chung grang zhing lci la sra// tshil gyur grang zhing 'jam la rnag pa dka'// gcin gyur rlig 'og 'khor skrangs skyal chu 'dra// rgyu blugs rlung gis rgyu ma dkrugs gyur te// sne sa rlig par 'phul la sbo zhing gzer// sgra dang bcas shing bcug kyang slar 'byung 'gyur/ bcos thabs rlung gyur shing mngar 'jam rtsi btang // snam dugs bsku mnye sman mar rjes la sbyar// mkhris gyur lums gtar smin gyur rma ltar gso// bad kun skyer pa sbrang bslud bco brgyad bsreg / lums dugs smin bya rnag nas rma khrus bya// tshil gyur bye rug brgyad pa'i lums kyis bdug / srubs med pags dral tshil phyung rma bkrus brtsem/ ldong ros sug sprel spos dkar pi pi ling //go phye til mar byug cing sdum dugs bya// gcin gyur lhung sar phug la rma ltar gso// sgo nga skrangs na rtsa yi thag pa bsreg / rgyu blugs rtsa ba lnga yis sman mar sbyar// 'jam rtsi dugs bsten nang bcug rgyu lam bsreg / ma zhi srin lag
390 sa gyi glu thang dab /rgyus pa bcad la bsreg / ces gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rlig blugs gso ba'i le'u sta drug cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// / /

391le'u de dgu pa/ rkang bam gyi nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / rkang bam nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa ba'i yis bstan// rgyu rkyen zas spyod gdon gyis bad kun khrag / 'phel bas sha nus khad kyis treb can skrangs// na ba'i zug gzer chung bas rkang bam yin// rkang lag rna ba mchu dang sna la mang /de yang rlan can yun du 'byung ba yin// dbye ba rlung dang mkhris pa bad kun gsum/ de rtags rlung gyur tsub cing skrangs mdog nag / mkhris gyur mdog ser tsha la rims kyis 'debs// bad gan lci la zug chung sha mdzer khyab//bcos thabs rlung gyur dugs gtar rgyun sbyongs bya// mkhris pa las gyur gtar dang bsil bas byug / bad gyur pi pi ling dang a ru'i thang // 'u su ṭwāṃ ha ti dang ṭwāṃ ngas kur byug / kun la 'bru rnyi snga zan dang sbrang rtsi bza'//ci sa ga/// rtsi /snyi/ nga po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rkang bam gyi nad bcos pa'i le'u ste drug cu rtsa dgu pa'o// / /

392le'u bdun cu pa/ mtshan bar rdol ba gso ba/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / mtshan bar rdol la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang //rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// rgyu ni stan srab tsog pur 'dug pa dang // bzhon stan rlan steng yun ring 'dug las 'byung // dbye ba rkyang pa ldan 'dus gsum du bshad// de rtags mtshan dbrag 'brum thor chu ser 'dzag / smin nas rnag khrag srin 'dzag 'tshor mi 'dod// zhi yang slar ldang bshang gci khu khrag 'dzag / rlung gyur kha mang sgru can sla ba 'dzag /mkhris pa dmar tsha bad kun las gyur g.ya'// rlung mkhris dmar mched bad rlung smin dka' nag / bad mkhris tsha skrangs 'dus pa nad tshabs che// gso thabs gsar dus gtar zhing thor pa brtol// rta sbangs dugs bya ni ru ha yis drang // rnyings nas ltos sbyangs chu tshan nang du spying // 'bras gsum byi la'i nus pa rma la byug / byi tang ga dang ra gsum pi pi ling // tsi tra ka dang sbrang rtsi mar sbyar bza'// sle tres sug spel byi tang dug mo nyung // ba ru a ru skyu ru spos dkar rnams// rim pas bskyed la sbrang sbyar bza' bar bya// dug nyung pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka / byi tang ga rnams 'bras bu gsum gyi phyed kun dang spos dkar mnyams te sbrang sbyar bza'// gu gul pi pi ling dang 'bras bu gsum// shing tsha sug sprel sprang rtsi sbyar ba btang // sman gyis zhi dka' bcad de bsreg par bya// zas dang spyod lam 'du ba'i rigs dang bstun// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mtshan bar rdol ba gso ba'i le'u ste bdun cu pa'o// / /

393le'u don gcig pa/ byis pa nyer spyod gso ba/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags/ byis pa gso ba'i skabs la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa dang // ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / byis pa gso ba nyer spyod de'i nad dang //gdon gso ba dang gsum du shes par bya// nyer spyod dang po bar dang tha ma gsum// dang po btsas dus shis dang mi shis brtag / bkra shis brjod cing lte ba bcad pa dang / rten 'brel bya zhing nu ma bsnun thabs bsten// shes rtags lugs 'byung skyes dang gan rkyal byung // lte ba stod dkris ngu skad drag po sgrogs / spyi bo ring la mgo sra 'tshogs ma chung / skra mtshams mtho la sha gtsang rna ba shog / kha lces nu ma drag 'jib 'dar zhing dngang // de 'dra gso bla mi nor bkra shis 'gyur// go ldog so bcas skyes pa ngan par bshad// skyes ma thag tu bkra shis tshig 'di brjod// bdag gi bu khyod snying las skyes pa yin//lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong gyur cig / tshe ring dpal thob ngan dgu thub pa dang // mi nor bkra shis bde skyid phun tshogs shog / de skad brjod de lte ba sor bzhir bcing // khrag ma thigs par bcad la pang du blang // spos chu dro 'jam lus kun dag par bkru// lce yi thog tu gur gum khyuḥyig bri// gla rtsi'i chu bslud sbrang mar sbyar ba byin// de nas ma yi nu zho bsnun par bya// nu zho skams na rigs bzang nad med cing // srog skyob bu ma shi ba'i nu ma bsrud//skabs su ru rta mar sbyar lte bar bsku/ de nas bar gyi bya ba zhag gsum nas//

394 sto/grwa nga da ba /lha gsol rta gzugs srung pa'i cho ga bya// zla phud btang zhing ming gdags rna ba dbug / zas dang spyod lam btsa' rdzis legs bskyang bya// dang po 'go ling bsten nam bsgrubs pa yi/ lha la gsol mchod bya zhing lha rten gzugs//slob dpon spyan drang srog mda' srog 'phang bca'// gnam rta bar rta sa rta sgo rta gzugs gtsang ma'i gos la shu dag gu gul dang // yungs kur du bas bdugs la bu la bkon// lag pa gnyis dang mgul du shu dag gdags zla dus gtor ma bshos bu chung blud btang // btsas skar lha 'am nye du las dras pa'i// snyan zhing shis pa'i ming ni kha 'cham gdags// sri 'u yin na thar thar zla ming spo// zla ba brgyad na rna ba dbug par bya// rna bshal mthe bos legs mnye dkyil srab par// rgya khab zab skud phug la snam gyis byug / khye'u g.yas la bu mo g.yon pa dbug / zas su bur sprang zhun mar rgyun du bsten// skabs su sha tshod mar sbyar sha nad sel// a ru ra dang shing kun tsha ba gsum// shu dag pa tra lce myang tsha rnams dang // ra dkar 'o ma mar bskol dbyangs can mar// blo 'phel dran gsal ngag tshig snyan phyir bsten// yungs kur shu dag rgyam tsha pi pi ling // ru rta ba spru mar bskol sman mar gyis/ tshe 'phel stobs bskyed gdon rnams 'joms phyir bsten / spyod lam mig la nyi ma'i zer mi btang // rkang mthil 'tshogs ma mi bsreg grangs mi gzhug / yon por mi zung bslang ba sngas pa min// me dang bya gcan 'go nad 'jigs skrag bsrung //skabs su bsku mnye nyi mas ran par bsro// tha ma'i bya ba so skye'i nad bsal ling / rta bkrol bya 'ing btang rag btang ba'o// rma bya'i spyi bor mdongs sgro skye ba dang // byis pa rnams la se'u skye ba'i tshe/ lus kun mi na ba ni cig kyang med// de dus sbrang rtsi a byag skyu ru ra'i// lde gus snyil byug myur du so skye 'gyur// a byag seng phrom ba le a ba se// rgya sran btsod khu mar dang zho la chu /bsdus pa'i mar nang ya bakṣa ra btab// so skye las byung nad kun 'joms

༄gyi khan ngag yon tan gyi da/ 395par khyed// sna la ya so skyes sam so bcas skyes// sbyin sreg bya zhing skem byed bcos par bya// byis pa zla ngo bcu gnyis lon pa dang / lha la btang rag btang zhing rta rnams dgrol zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las byis pa nyer spyod gso ba'i le'u ste bdun cu rtsa gcig pa'o/ / /

396le'u don gnyis pa/ byis pa'i nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig byis pa'i nad la rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// dang po rgyu ni rlung mkhris bad gan la// rkyen ni ma yi rkyen dang bu rkyen gnyis// ma rkyen ma yis zas spyod gang 'phel ba'i// ma yi rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun nad// bu la lhung dang mi gtsang gdon rkyen gyis// 'on long dig pa zha dgur shor sogs 'byung //'di rnams lhan skyes nad yin gsor mi nus// bu rkyen gdon dang spyod lam kha zas gsum// gdon rkyen mang yang byis gdon bcu gnyis yo da// las mkhan pho nya rgyal bsen gnyis kyis byed// spyod lam mi dang bu dzi ma bzo bas//lhung ngam sdabs sam sprugs dang bslang sngas dang // lte ba then dang ngus drags rlan drags dang / zas skom tsha ches bsil ches bston drags pas//gyis pa'i nad rigs nyi shu rtsa bzhi skyed// dbye ba lhan skyes nad dang blo bur gnyis// ma nad bu la lhung ba lhan skyes yin// blo bur nad la phra rags zhib tshegs gsum// rags pa brang dang glo mchin 'khru skyug dang // rims dang lte ba de 'u'i nad dang brgyad/ phra ba mgo spangs gre ba 'gags pa dang // mcher mkhris pho long sa zos zho ras brgyad// zhib tshegs mig dang rna ba kha nad dang //spen bu srog rtsa zho ras srin phol brgyad// brtag pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// 'tsho 'chi ltang gcod kha dmar gdags dang gsum// spyi rtags rtag tu ngu las nar shes bya// gang nar 'ju dang der mnan na ba dang // mig

༄7/mnang ga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 397'byed dka' zhing ngo nag dang ga 'gag / rtsed mo mi rtse dbugs mi bde ba dang // skad gnya' 'khun zhing sen mo rno ba'o / khyad par brang nad rgod g.yung tsha grang gnyis// brang rgod tsha ba brang dang ro stod skrangs// lus tsha nu ma mi 'dod ngu ba drag / mgo dang ro stod phyir 'don ltag pa dgye// rtsa dang 'phar sgo drag la a 'bras bzlog / kha lce skam la dreg pa chags pa dang //rting pa 'dzugs pa mi shes hreng hreng thung // brang de glo dang sdongs na lud pa lu// pho bar sdongs na mig ser stong skyugs byed// brang g.yung grang ba dbugs bde nyan nyon mang // kha 'dzum mi shes mjing rengs ro stod spyong //glo nad tsha gzer tsha subs thang po gsum// tsha gzer rtsa drims 'thibs che gting nas 'khun// dbugs thung glo lu kha mig btsums nas lu lud pa 'gog la snying gdung skyug mi shes// tsha subs 'gog tu mi 'dod drag tu lu//lus po tsha la rtsa dang 'phar sgo drag / glo bstud 'ong zhing brang dang ma la 'brad//rjes la lus jul 'khun zheng skyug tshul ston// thang po glo nad rnyings pa rlung ldan te drag tu lu zhing lud pa 'gog rgyu med/ mig dang mchu skrangs lce snyil dkar ba'o// mchin pa'i nad la tsha babs grang babs gnyis rgod babs tsha ba mchin sna phra la 'phar / rtsa rgyug chu tshan dbugs rgod pho stod grang //lus tsha g.yal bar 'dod la g.yal mi thon// mchu dang snyil la dreg pa nag po chags// mig dmar sna sgo skam la lce gzhung ser// re'u'i skad 'byin zhing rna rtsa nag la sbom// g.yung babs grang ba rtsa dal chu yang grang // lag pa 'jib cing lce mur stong ldan byed// drod chung mchin sna mi 'phar mdan shis 'phrug /nub mo ngu 'ing ngu skad phra la 'dzer// sha mdog sngo ser mchin sna srab la ring //spyi rtags tsha grang gnyis po gang babs kyang // mig sngo gyen ldog byad dang mthil bzhi ser// lus lci rngam pa ring thung ldang dub na// 'khun zhing snga dro bde la sgongs dus na// mchin pas pho ba mnan pas 'khru skyug byed// 'khru

398 sa༅grwa nga dab /ba'i nad la tsha 'khru grang 'khru gnyis/ tsha 'khru dbugs thung rtsa dang 'phar sgo drag / bzhin snum phyi tshad che la shes pa 'thib// 'khru mdog dmar ser ljang gu dud khur 'khru// grang 'khru dbang po gsal la 'phar sgo dal// 'khru mdog nu zho tsam mdog skya bor 'khru// rgyu long 'khrog cing sbru ba sgra bcas 'khru// skyug pa'i nad la tsha dang grang ba gnyis// tsha bas skyug pa nad rtags tsha bar 'byung //khrag gam mkhris par skyug pa tsha ba yin/ grang bas skyug pa zho 'thungs skyug pa dang // tsam pa ma zhu gang zos skyug pa dang // sbru ba bad kun skyug cing phyi rtags grang // rims nad me ltar tsha zhing 'phar rtsa rgyug / ngu 'tshig rngul 'thibs ba spu log pa dang // skom 'dod skyong zhing kha sna lag pas sub// lte nad lte mkhrang lte 'khor lte mkhregs dang // lte rnag ba'i ste dang po lte mkhrang ni /lte 'bur rkang pa sdud la skyong mi shes// grang nad rtags ldan ngu skad gcod sdom byed// lte 'khor skug por skrangs 'bur reg mi bzod// lte mkhregs sprug cing sra la treb bee na// lte rnag lte ba chad shul rnag zhugs nas khung bur zos nas rgyu long lug par byed / de 'u'i nad la phugs rde lam de gnyis//phugs de la yang 'phyo rdo zug rdo gnyis// lam de chu lam de 'us 'gags pa yin// dri chu mi thon mtshan ma chu rkyal 'dra// 'phyo rdo 'ong ba'i 'phro la 'phral du 'gag / chu yi gseb tu sha yi nal nol 'ong // zug rdo kha la zug na na la sri// phugs su zug na mi sri na la gzer// gang yang spyi rtags chu sri yang yang 'dzag / zug che khu tshur 'chang ngam 'bran cing ngu // mgo 'dar so sdem sgang pa rgyas par 'gyur// bu chung mgo sdabs rgya zhig skrangs pa na// rnag yod ba ji na du mar mer skrangs par byed// gre ba 'gags na skad 'dzer kha chu mang //mcher pa'i nad ni khong lci ldang dub byed nu ma sos 'debs bag re rngul du 'ong 0 mkhris nad rna rgyab sha mdangs ser la gdang / rtsa gsal lce skya sen mo nag la ring // kha zas byin na mi za 'dod tshul byed// pho ba'i nad ni sha
