rdzi lhanang ga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 399chung dreg pa chags// kha zas 'ju dka' pho ba skye 'bri byed// long nad 'khrog 'ur sgangs 'khun 'phel 'bri byed/ zas zos pho ba sgangs shing dri ma 'gag /zho ras nad la rlung mkhris bad kun gdon// rlung gyur nu zho sru bcas chu steng 'phyo// de yis pho ba sbo skyug bshang gci sri / mkhris gyur ser snang ro skyur tshad pa skye/ bad kun sngo nal chur 'bying ma zhus skyed// tshom bur chad na gdon ngo yo da pa yin// mig gi nad la sgra ngan phral tshag gnyis// sgra ngan mig dmar tsha 'ing mchi ma 'dzag / rna ba'i nad la ma rlung 'grams pa gnyis/ ma rlung rnag 'dzag 'grams pa rna rtsa skrangs// kha yi nad la btsa' thor bsen thor gnyis/bsen thor thor pa dkar la tsha ba skye/ then bu rkang lag 'khums nas skyong mi shes// srog rtsa'i chu ser mig skya sha ser skam// srin nad ldang dub che la skum sku mkhyed// mi skad khyi skad la ngu nad zug ldang // sha nad lce mur lag pa'i mgo bo 'jib// ser sha'i tshod ma 'dra ba rgyun du 'khru// phol nad 'phongs mirtsar skrangs rnag tu 'gyur/ 'tsho 'chi ltang gcod kha dmar gdags pa ni//rkang lag mthil bzhi dkar la hrid pa dang // rna ba skams shing mgo la 'byar ba dang // sna bug skams la ba rgya chags pa dang // mig gi mdangs shor khung du bros pa dang // ltag mig lta zhing 'dzum mi shes pa dang // lce ni skam zhing thung la so dreg chags// pho ba rdo ltar sra dang zos tshad skyug / dbugs thung gre ba gsog cing ngar ba dang // 'khru ba chu ltar 'brub dang nu ma shor mgo srubs bye dang pags mdog gser ltar ser// mi pags sbos dang pho ba chu yis khengs// mchin pas lte bar slob na mi 'tsho spang // mig lce la sogs dbang po'i bkrag ma shor// dbugs bde rtsa dal mthil bzhi dmar ba dang //nu ma zas la sred la sen mo 'drug / sman len gsos skyed che na blang bar bya'o//bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi bcos dus gsum zas spyod sman dpyad ba'i// zho 'thung dus na sman dpyad ma la bya// zas 'dres dus na

400 ༄cu/grwa thang dba'imakhya gnyis ka la// zho spangs zas za'i dus na bu la bya// zas ni yang zhing 'ju bla byin pa dang // spyod lam ngu ru mi gzhug grangs mi bya// sman gyis bcos pa i dang sbyang ba gnyis// zhi byed bzang zhing 'jam la 'ju bla ba//gar bur kha blangs mngar shas che ba sbyin// sngo thang bshal sman la sogs tsub mo rnams legs par bsdus khu 'jam zhing 'ju bla bsten// bshal rjes 'bras kyi tshod ma shis pa yin// dpyad kyis bcos pa gtar bsreg chu lcag 'dren// gtar ga gang thebs rtsa kha phye tsam ste// lo ma lon na lag mgo khrag thon gtar// me btsa'i spra ba sran ma phos pa tsam// gsum las mi mang skyi tshos tsam gyis chog / chu lcag skar chu bum par blug pas bsgrang // mas 'dren lo ma lon la reng bu bya/ lo lon pa la ni ru chu srang gcig / de nas lo re lon gyin srang re bskyed sman dpyad drag po mi bya 'jam pos bcos// bye brag bcos thabs brang nad tsha ba la// zas sman chu mda' gtar dang me btsas bcos//zas su sha mar gsar pa zho dar btang // drod bcud mi btang sman du ga bur dang // cu gang gur gum tsan dan kur sbyar btang // glo la ga dur pho ba sug smel bsnan// skrangs na chu mda' bran zhing drug mgo gtar// stod du skrangs na sbyi gtsug bya rog mig / tsa ra khung nas thur mtshon do ru bsreg / smad du skrangs na snying rtse dkar nag mtshams// glo la lnga pa pho ba snyen gsang bsreg /brang nad shin tu rnyings te sha mdog ser// khong snyom 'gul na na zhing ma la 'phyang // 'khun zhing nu ma tse gur bcad cing 'thung // de la tsan dan gi waṃ bsil gsum sbyar// rjes la tshigs pa bdun dang nyen sna bsreg / brang nad grang ba dzā ti sug sprel dang // la la phud kyi thang btang shing kun dang // dong gra kha ru tsha dang bur dkar sbyar zas ni bsil drod khre 'ur btang bar bya/chu mda' mi bya snum nan tshan do bya/ me ni gong gi steng du bzhi pa bsreg /'jing ba rengs na ltag pa bsreg par bya// mdor na sman gtar chu yis tsha ba

zhu na ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 401gdon// de rjes me yis bsreg pa mchog tu shis// tsha gzer glo la gso thabs zhi sbyang gnyis// hong len bong nga dkar po'i bsdus khu la// gi waṃ gur gum gla rtsi shu dag dkar/ sbrul sha ru rta'i phye ma ra la btang // a ru hong len dur byid bsdus khu la sha chen gla rtsi btab la 'khru ru gzhug / des ma thub na ga bur rgyal blon gsum// tsha subs nad la sman dang gtar gyis bcos// gur gum shu dag cu gang kur sbyar btang / shing mngar sro lo'i thang btang ga bur dang // li shi sug sprel 'bras gsum da trig dang // cu gang gur gum gi waṃ rgun 'brum dang // shing mngar ka ra sbyar btang dngul mang dbyung // gting thon dka' na cu gang gur gum dang // tsan dan dkar dmar bse ru shing mngar mtshal/ li shi sug sprel sra 'bras da trig dang // ltar bu ru rta sga skya pi pi ling // 'dam bu ka ra nas sngon 'bru bdun rnams// zho la btab kyin rgyun du bston par bya// snod ka ru thung khrag dang sbyar la gtar/ tsha subs gas nas lud pa rnag can la// bya pho tse tse star bu shing mngar dang // sug sprel ka ra sbyar bas rnag rnams drang // tsan dan bsil gsum bse rus rnag tshan skom// ro stod chus bran gsar 'jam zas kyis bcos// rlung glo thang po sman zas me yis bcos// sman ni da trig ka ra pi pi ling / mar gsar sbyar ba'i lde gu btang ba dang // cu gang zhing tsha sug sprel pi pi ling // mar gsar sprang dang sbyar ba'i lde gu btang // ga dur dzā ti shing kun bur dkar byin/ mar dkar bur dkar lug sha gsar 'jam btang // skyed chung lus skrangs spos dkar bshal gyis sbyang // de rjes gong bzhin tshigs pa bzhi lnga bsreg /mchin nad tsha ba zas sman gtar ba dang // bshal dang me btsa' chu yis bcos par bya// kha zas ma bu gnyis ka drod bcud spang // sha gsar mar gsar zho dar bsten par bya// sman du tig ta ba sha ka bsdus khur// brag zhun dul ma sbangs la mang du bsrud/ a ru skyu ru bsdus pa'i khu ba la// gur gum

402 zhu/grwa thang da ba'igasum btab kur sbyar bu la bslud// ga bur cu gang gur gum ru rta dang //ma nu 'jib rtsi ka ra dkar sbyar btang // yang na gur gum cu gang brag zhun dang // dzā ti dom mkhris tig ta a ru ra// ka ra dkar po sum 'gyur sbyar la btang // yang na gur gum gi waṃ a ru ra// ka ra sbyar btang skyed chung a ru ra//stong len dur byid bsdus khur gar sbyar btang / skyug na phus gdab 'gyings na reng bus bsu// dmar ser dri che ni ru lugs su sbyang // dkar sngo tsam pa zho 'khru myur du bcad// ru thung snod ka long rtsa khrag sbyar gtar// chu mda' pho stod tshigs pa dgu la bdeg / yang na sgang phug chu yis bkang la bdug de yis mchin sna mi 'phar tsha stobs 'i// mchin sna sgrul mig dgu dang bcu gnyis bsreg / tsha ba ma choms bsregs na me drod skyed// rjes la ma bsregs mchin pa sar mi khyol// des na bsreg pa'i dus tshod shes pa gces grang babs sman zas lums sbyang me yis bcos// sman du 'bras bu gsum gyi bsdus khu la gur gum cu gang bsings la btang bar bya// sga skya dza ti sug sprel bsdus thang btang // gla sgang gur gum gi waṃ ka ra sbyar// rgyam tsha gsum dang ltag pa sprad pa btang // yang na dzā ti sug sprel shing tsha sga// bur dkar sbyar btang ma bu gnyis ga'i zas// mar gsar phye thug sha gsar tsho khu bsten// sha mar rnying pa chang sogs bcud mi btang // glo dron spod bran rus phye snum ldan nam// me tog sna tshogs 'u mas kyis bdug par bya// dur byin lcam rtsa a ru sngon bu bsdus// thal ga so ma ra dza btab la btang // glor sdongs spos dkar pho bar ma nu btang // mkhris sdongs sga skya sman dang bu ram spel// nad stobs bri nas dgu dang bcu gnyis dang // lte zur mchin sna rtsib thur gnyis po bsreg / tsha 'khru zas sman gtar dang chu yis bcos// zas su phye thug 'bras thug tse gur btang // rjes la 9 gsar tsho khu 'o zan bsten// sman du rgyu rmi bsrung dang tshad pa gzhom // 'khru ba bskul dang bcad pa ba'i yis bcos//

zhu khanang ga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 403rgyu srung sa myag gla rtsi btab pa btang // nas rnying phye thug mar gsar rgyam tsha btab// rgyu ma mi 'drul sra 'jam 'dred par byed// tshad gcod ga bur rgyal blon gsum pa btang // yang na tsan dan dkar po chu la bdar// de la gur gum gla rtsi btab la btang // yang na ind+ra bzhi thang rgyun du bsten// dmar na brag zhun gser na gi waṃ btang // sprug na re ral ljang khu skyer shun btang smodud khu gla rtsi zungs khrag dom mkhris bcad// 'gying zhing 'khrul ma zug can tse gur 'khru/ bu gsum a ru bsdus khus 'khru ba bskul// tha mar tsha ba chogs nas bcad pa ni// 'khru gcod sman rnams 'bras thug btab la btang //yang na zho btsos btab btang gro phye sbyin// ru thung snod ka long rtsa gtar ba dang // chu yi lcag gis nya bzhi bsgrang par bya/ grang bas 'khru la bzang po bzhi po sbyar// dzā ti sug sprel da trig sra 'bras btang // yang na rgod khrag gtsod khrag btsos la btang / spyin chu da trig btab nas btang bas chad//chad dka' bcu gnyis pa dang lte ba bsreg / tsha bas skyug pa khrag 'byung ba la//'dam bu ka ra dzā ti tsan dan dmar// puskar gla sgang mtshal dang sprang sbyar btang // mkhris par skyug na lcags kyi khu ba btang / grang bas skyug na dzā ti sug sprel dang // da trig sra 'bras bu ram sbyar bas chad// sha gsar tsho khur la la phud btab btang / chad pa dka' na nyen sna spyi gtsug bsreg / zas su chang 'jam sha gsar brid la btang // zho skyug kuṇḍa ka ri tsha ba lnga/ sprang dang zhun mar sbyar ba sbyin par bya// kha zas mi 'ju mig ser bsus pa che// se 'bru lnga dang rgyam tsha bur dkar sbyar// chur skyug 'bras thug la la phun btab btang // tsam par skyug na smyung ba byas pas 'tsho// rims la 'bras gsum sle tres bsdus 'jam btang / tig ta ga dur bsdus grangs ma la sbyin/ rngul dbyung zhur ka ra chur sbangs btang / gur gum cu gang gi waṃ gla rtsi bzhi/ka ra sbyar btang stobs che ga bur bsnan/ glo mang rgyan 'brum cu gang chu

404 ༄cu grwa nga da bzhi/bsings btang // tsha rnyings bu gsum khu ba ka ras sbyang // de rjes cu gang bde byed chen mo sbyar// kha zas bsil bsten drod bcud dug 'dra spang // ri thang mtshams su khre 'ur sad cing btang // lte mkhrang nad la gla rtsi byi tang ga /ma ru tse dang smyug rtsi pi pi ling // phur thal sdig srin dri chus sbyangs la btang //zi ldi spur thal pha ma'i skra gzhob ba'i// byis pa'i chur sbyangs btang bas sel bar 'gyur// lte 'khor mkhan sbang spru ma lca 'bras dang // go snyod g.yer ma dron mor bsros pas bdug / klad rul mkhan phabs chang sbyar skyo ma byug /rnag tu khugs na phug pas 'tsho bar nges// lte mkhregs ma yi rgyab rtsa drug 'dus gtar// khrag la phag ril spyang brun gla rtsi dang // shing kun sgog skya sbyar byugs bya spus mnan// lte rnag dang po lte skam phye ma gdab// ma thub brag spos chu rtsa mkhris sna dang // gur gum sbyar ba rma la gdab par bya// rde nad gsar dus rgya tsha sug sprel dang // sdig srin lcam pa chang dang sbyar te btang // rde'u rgyas na tsha sbyor chen mos bshig / lam rdo 'gags na srubs min dral la dbyung // mgo bo spangs na rtsa 'phrang me yis bsdam// rgya chings byas la khong du bsil sman btang // dbug tu mi rung 'jam pos bcos pas thub// gre ba'i nad la gla rtsi ru rta dang // gi waṃ ka ra sbyar ba khong du btang // a ru dur byid gla rtsi'i ba la gyis sbyang spyo/ mcher nad g.yon gyi rtsib ma'i steng du bsreg / ka ko la dang a ru ra yi thang // mkhris nad rgyam tsha gsum pa ka ra sbyar// tsha ba che na tig ta kur btab btang / an stong bcu gcig bsreg cing mkhris rtsa gtar// pho ba'i nad la se 'bru ba'i pa sbyar// gyong dang bsil spang mdun rgyab pho gsang bsreg / long nad se 'bru drug sbyar long gsang bsreg / sa zos pa la gla sgang ser po gnyis// pa tra lca ba ba spu byi tang ga / bel ba tsha ba tra sna mdaX kau // //zlo tha//nga gā /sdu rlung // /gyur 'bra ṭwāṃ / pa/ ma ///nga ṭwāṃ

mnang g.yon tan gyi da/ 405sgang dang // rtsa mkhris hong len bskol ba'i khu ba bslud// bad kun rgyam tsha shing mngar pi pi ling // mar dang sbyar sbyin bong nga dkar po dang // gla sgang shu dag rtsa ba lnga bskol bsrud// zho ras gdon zhugs de yi gso ba sbyar// mig gi nad la gsal byed sman mar btang // skyer khan nu zho sbyar ba mig tu blug /rna ba rnag 'dzag ma bu bcud kyis gso// 'bras bu'i sman mar bcu gsum me yis bsreg / rna ba 'grams na nag mtshur ru rta dang // gla rtsi chu la sbyangs la rna bar blug / rgya skyegs ru rta'i khu ba khong du btang // btsa' thor sha tshil bsur bdug gla rtsi btang // spyi bo'i gtsug tu btsod kyi me btsa' gdab//bsen thor la yang gla rtsi khong du btang // shu dag ru rta a ru sprang sbyar sbyin//sa mtshur chu yi kha bru bsen mo bcos// men bu snyen sna'i g.yas bsreg dom mkhris btang // srog rtsa'i chu ser yan ston dgu bdun bsreg / srin la gla rtsi shing kun byi tang ga / sgog skya'i phye ma 'o mar btab la btang // dur byin sga skya byi tang ga yis sbyang // ma phan srin rta khrag yin gtar ga bya// sha nad sha dang khrag gi tshon ma sbyin// phol la tsan dan skyer khan sbrang sbyar byug / tsan dan ka ra chur sbyar khong du btang // ma zhi byug pas rnag tu bkug la dbug /ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las byis pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// / /

406le'u don gsum pa/ byis pa'i gdon nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / byis pa'i gdon la ngos bzung bcos thabs gnyis// dang po rigs rtags gso ba dka' bla bzhi// de rigs skem byed gzhon nu gdong drug gi / sprul pa skyes bu'i gzugs can rnam pa lnga// bud med gzugs can bdun te bcu gnyis bshad// des zin rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi rtags rtag tu ngu zhing dngang la 'khun// gnyid chung g.yal mang ma mchu so yis 'debs// ma la 'bran cing nu ma kha nas 'don// gnya' zhing mig ldog sbu bar skyug pa yin// bye brag rtags la skyes bu'i gzugs lnga la//skem byed mgo sdeb mig gcig mchi ma 'dzag / rngul mang skyig cing so 'cha' 'jing pa rengs// bshang ga sbar pos 'chang zhing zho mi 'thung // sa ga gnyid med dran nyams sbru bar skyug / nu ma lce la so 'debs gnam du blta// lug gdong 'khun sbo 'khru skyug rkang lag 'dar// glo mang mig dmar skyig cing khu tshur 'chang // khyi gdong lus 'dar rngul 'ong mig 'dzum zhing // skan sdebs 'khru skyug dri ma che bar 'ong // yi dwags dngangs shing 'khru skyug byed pa dang //glo lu g.yal mang kha kha sha lus skam// bud med gzugs can bya gdong tsha ba skye//'khru zhing lce skyog rgan la 'brum thor thong // srul mo 'khru skyug skyigs bu skom dad che// grang ba'i srul mo lus 'dar mig zur blta// rgyu 'khrog ngos cig tsha la ngos cig grang // srul mo long ba mig mi gsal la spangs/ 'khru skyug tsha skye glo lu zho mi 'dod/ ba'i na rgyas ba'i na mdzes tsha skye zas mi 'dod// lto la rtsa

༄7sa nang g.yon tan gyi da/ 407yi dra ba nag pos khyab// nam gru sngon por 'khru la skyigs bu 'ong // kha yo tsha ba skye la pags mdog sngo// nam gru skem po tsha ba skye ba dang // skra 'byid skad chung kha dog sna tshogs 'khru// las mkhan pho nya rgyal po bsen mo gnyis// rgyal po dngangs 'dar mig ldog tho rangs ngu// bsen mo bying 'thibs tsha skye srod dus ngu // gso ba dka' la srog 'dod yas 'dod gnyis// btsas skar ngan dang kha bub nam phyed btsas// ya rkan nag la kha dog sna tshogs 'khru// zas dang nu ma mi 'dod mtshan mo ngu // srog 'dod gdon de gso ba dka' ba yin// kha skam lce yis mchu la nyul ba dang // zas skom 'dod la byin na za rgyu med//yas 'dod gdon de gso ba bla ba yin// gso ba'i thabs la zhi dang drag po gnyis// dang po yas blud gtor ma 'i bas bcos// gnas mal 'khrus byug gdags bdug sman zas bdun// gnas mal gdon med dben par bgegs bskrad la// dong ga sgron shing a ba ka rañdza// nim pa lcam pa chu dron khrus kyis bkru// shu dag rin chen bse ru gnas gsum gdags// ba lang rus spu rwa pags byi la'i brun// ra spu yungs kur mi skra rma bya'i sgro// sran phub so ba mar rnying pha wang brun// hong len so cha thang shing a ba se// nim pa gu gul kuṇḍa ka ri gnyis// ra thug gcin sbyar reng bu'i dud pas bdug / rtsa ba lnga dang ra sna sku la dang // gla sgang tsi tra ka dang tsha ba gsum// ba spru shing mngar shing kun mon cha ra// sgron shing dug mo nyung dang byi tang ga / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba'i sman mar sbyar// khong du bza' zhing lus la byug pa bya// gdon 'joms stobs dang kha dog me drod skyed// kha zas sha chang khrag tshod spang bar bya//dkar gsum bza' zhing cha gsum gtor mas mchod// chab gtor btang jing gzungs chen gra lnga 'don// gtor ma 'dod pa'i gdon rnams de yis bsreg// ༵༵ lo ba sko dros zhes ga // zlo/ bya// drag sngags brab cing mnan

409le'u don bzhi pa/ mo nad gtso bo spyi bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags po nad gso ba'i skabs la ci ltar bslab par bgyi/ 'tsho mdzad sman po'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol/ zhes zhus pa dang // drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / mo nad gso ba'i skabs la bslab pa ni// dug gsum 'byung ba bzhi las grub pa'i lus// sngon las 'dod chags dbang gis pho mor snang // bsod nams dman pas za ma mo lus thob// nu ma mngal dang zla mtshan khyad par lhag / lus zungs phyi ma khu ba dkar dmar gnyis/ zla mtshan dmar po bcu gnyis lon nas 'dzag / mngal nang khu ba 'dzin zhing sha lus skyed// dkar po nu ma la rgyas gsos su 'gyur/ de la sngon las zas spyod gdon rkyen gyis// mngal nad lnga dang rtsa nad bcu drug dang // skran nad dgu dang srin bu'i nad rigs gnyis// mo nad gtso bo sum cu rtsa bzhi dang // phal pa'i nad brgyad ba'i bcu gnyis su 'gyur// skye ba dman phyir bud med lus la lhag / de yang sbyi dang bye brag phal pa gsum// mo nad spyi la dbye ba de yi rgyu//rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// dbye ba khrag tshabs rlung tshabs rnam pa gnyis// de rgyu dang po zla mtshan las byung phyir/ gsar ba'i dus na khrag tshabs zhes bya ste/ rnyings nas rlung dang sdongs pas rlung tshabs so// de rtags khrag tshabs spyi yi mtshan nyid ni// rten so man chad dus pa 'khol zhing na// rgyu zhabs tsha 'brab ro rgyab mchin dri gzer rtsa rnams tsha 'khyug shu ba 'brum phran 'ong // mngal khrag 'dzag gam 'khyil dang rnag tu 'gyur// rlung tshabs rus pa 'khor zhing snying mi bde// mgo 'khor mgo yi

410 sa༅/grwa thang byu ——nus pa grang sil byed// lus kun grang zhing sha mthang bar du na// sha rnams g.yo 'ing sbo la sbrid pa dang // mig 'grib spyo 'am 'bog gam brjed pa ngas//chu so rgyu zhabs bsdams zhing za khur 'bab// zla mtshan mi chod rgyun du 'byang bar byed// bcos pa'i thabs la khrus gsher bcud gsher gnyis// de la khrag tshabs khrus gsher dag gis bcos// khrus gsher la yang lto gsher rtsa gsher gnyis// lho gsher la yang chen po chung ngu gnyis// rtsa gsher nang dang phyi ru shes par bya// dang po khrus gsher khrus dang snum 'chos bya// dngos gzhi ha ri ta ka zhim shing dang // dwa tsha so sor bskol te grangs nas bsre sge gsher thing tsha 'ol mo khron bu dang // rgyam tsha tri byi ta rnams kha tshar gdab//slong dang sbyong byed gnyis su bcad la btang // lto gsher chung ngu garbha tsaṇḍa li//tri byi ta dang ha ri ta ka dang // shing tsha rgyam tsha sge gsher cha mnyam ste// zhib btags zhim thing bsdus khur btab la btang / lcag dang log gnon rjes gcod spyi dang mthun// zla mtshan 'khyil dang mngal skran bu ro rnag / khrag tshabs ma lus mngal skyon sbyong bar byed// rtsa gsher sngon 'gro sge gsher thang btang zhing // me tog grog zhing 'ba' cha bya bra rnams// gang rung chang btsos na sa rgyu 'bas bdug / khrus dang bsku mnye byas rjes byang pa dang // gser gyi bye ma shing tsha sug sprel dang // dkar rtsi mthing shun lo brgyad chu la bskyon//bya thabs lag len rtsa sbyongs spyi dang mthun// phyi yi rtsa gsher che 'bring chung gsum las// chen po rgya tsha zhing tsha kha ru tsha// bse ru rgya ru gtsod ru sha ba'i ru//dan da dur byin de ba dā ru dang // da byin bya rmi byi yi mjug sgro phabs// sug sprel rdo dreg dud pa bul tog rnams// bur smug sbyar ba'i ril bu mngal du bskyal// 'bring po sug sprel rgya tsha tsha ba gsum / dan da dur byid ya bakṣa ra phabs// ba spru shug tsher sprang dang bu ram sbyar// chung ba gur gum rgya tsha sug spel dang // byang pa dur byid bul tog bu ram sbya ra ril bu'am khu ba mngal

zhu na nga g.yo na tan gyi rgyud 411du gce 'us bskyal// rgyu zhabs dugs kyis bsro zhing lag pas mnye/ zug langs mi dngang 'gor na gce 'us drang // mngal khrag 'khyims dang mngal skran bu ro lus// mngal nad khrag tshabs ma lus sbyong bar byed// gnyis pa rlung tshabs bcud gsher dag gis bcos de la sha bcud chang bcud sman bcud gsum// sha bcud sbyar thabs lug thug tshon po yi// glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma lto tshil gzhang // lce dang ol ba men bu nam chod brang //ltag pa gung rtsib mjug thung rlig pa mig / 'brag dang rkang bzhag nya (2)gzhi zhib brdungs la// 'bri mar rnying pa phul do lung rdor bskol khol dus sha rnams btab la snar tsam btso// de nas gar chang phul do tsha ba gsum shing kun chu dang chu ma 'dres pa'i khrag / rim pas cig khol cig blug dkrug cing btso// de nyid sha phyi bsres te tsha bar byas// sum yar bsten zhing skom du gar chang bsrud// lus grangs bser bu mi btang rlung tshabs 'don// chang bcud sbrang dang bu ram gze ma'i chang // mar chang rus chang lnga yis rlung tshabs sel// sman bcud la ni khrag bcud mar bcud gnyis khrag bcud sbyor ba gnag lug sha ba yi// sha tshil khrag dang nus khu bsres pa la shing tsha btab bskol phog ste grangs pa dang // pag shun lhum rtsa rgyam tsha tsha ba gsum//btab ste 'jam bsros khye sus bsten bar bya// yang na bong khrag chu ma phog pa'i nang // shing tsha sug sprel sle tres sra 'bras srin/ rgyam tsha lham rtsa btab dkrugs khol ba dang / rus khu blug btsos khye sus khyor re bsten// mar bcud rtsa ba lnga yi man mar la// sprang dang bu ram kha tsha'i sman dang sbyar tho rangs phyi dro bsten pas rlung tshabs 'don// zhes gsungs so/bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mo nad gtso bo spyi bcos kyi le'u ste bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //

412——le'u don lnga pa/ mo nad bye brag bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / mo nad bye brag dbye ba de yi rgyu// rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa bzhi yis bstan// dbye ba mngal nad rlung mkhris bad kun khrag / 'dus pa rnam lnga gsang ba'i skabs su bshad// khrag tshabs glo snying mchin mcher mkhris pa mkhal// rgyu ma 'o ma nu ma gor pa bcu// rlung tshabs mgo dang nus pa snying mkhal ma// pho ba rgyu ma'i tshabs dang drug tu bshad// zla mtshan chu ser rlung gis byer ba las// rtsa nad ces bya tshabs nad bcu drug 'gyur// tshabs skran chu bur can dang hrem po dang // bee ma po men skran pho skran nag po dang // rtsa skran sa bon skran dang za khu dgu// zla mtshan chu ser rlung gis sgril ba la// tshabs skran zhes bya dbye ba dgu ru 'gyur// ma ra tse dang a so rnam pa gnyis// mngal gyi srin bu langs khros nad gnyis skyed//de rtags snying gi khrag tshabs ro ston gzer// rgyu zhabs tsha jing gtubs pa snyam du byed// glo yi khrag tshabs glo mang ro stod gzer// rtse'u 'greng yan lag sbrid cing kha gdong skrangs// mchin pa'i khrag tshabs mig sprin dmar ram ser//mchin pa'i steng dang mgo bo na ba'o// mcher pa'i khrag tshabs rgyu zhabs na 'ing gzer// phob 'khrog cing mcher pa'i steng du na// mkhris pa'i khrag tshabs nyam chung skom dad che// glo lu sha pags ser por 'gro ba yin// mkhal ma'i khrag tshabs 'doms g.ya' mo mtshan tsha// rked so man chad rus pa khol 'ing tsha// rgyu ma'i khrag tshabs tsha ling gtubs snyam byed// 'o tshabs zla mtshan

ra khan nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 413'o kha chu 'dra 'dzag / snying 'phyo chu so na zhing skyug snyam byed/ nu tshabs nu ma skrangs shing zug gzer che/ khrag tshabs gor pa lus lci 'gro mi shes/ rgyu smad khengs shing ldang dub na bar byed// mgo yi rlung tshabs mgo 'khor ling thog mod// rna ba 'on zhing rnag 'dzag so 'gram na/ dus pa'i rlung tshabs rus pa 'khol zhing grang // tshigs rkang tshang ra bem po bzod pa che/ snying gi rlung tshabs dran pa mi gsal zhing / mgo 'khor rna ba 'ur zhing smyo 'bog byed mkhal ma'i rlung tshabs rked tshigs 'khol zhing na// grangs na na zhing skad pa man chad bshal// pho ba'i rlung tshabs sbo 'dril ldang dub byed/ kha zas 'ju dka' bsil zas shin tu gnod rgyu ma'i rlung tshabs bsdams shing zla mtshan 'byang // mngal skran chu bur can ni rgyu smad sbo// zla mtshan chu ser dag tu 'byang bar byed// khrag skran hrem po rgyu zhabs ldang dub na// sha skran bem po mkhal rked 'chad snyam byed// pho ba rdzings shing zas skom 'jur mi 'dod/tshang ra mi theg rgyu chu sdom par byed/ men skran khrag nag 'dzag cing sha mi skye//chu ldang dub na zhing smad mi theg / pho skran rems pa lus sha skyer mi 'dod/smad bshal gzhogs lci dbugs rgod snying mi bde/ skran ro nag po mdog 'gyur tshigs gzhi skrangs// lus sha bem por byed cing mdze ru 'gro/ rtsa skran ling pa sha rus khol zhing na// sa bon skran ni sha rus 'jig snyam byed/ khrag skran za khu khong pa sbo zhing 'khrog / kun kyang byis pa chags ltar sra zhing 'dril/skabs su sbo zhing na gzer chu ser 'dzag / mngal gyi srin bu langs pas tsha ba'i nad// tshang ra nu ma g.ya' 'khol nu ma rgyas// sems 'phyo gnyid med 'gro 'dod skyes pa 'dod sha skam mo mtshan dri ma shin tu mnam 'khros pa de dus skyes pa ma phrad pas// mdzub mo shing bus phrugs pas srin khros te//mngal kha skrangs shing chu ser 'dzag pa dang // shin tu sra zhing na la mtshan ma sbo bcos thabs co nad skran dang srin bu gsum dang po rtsa nad bcu drug

414 gas/grwa thang da bzhi/bcos pa ni/ rlung tshabs drug po drod dang bcud kyis bcos// khrag tshabs bcu po bsil drod khre 'ur bcos// snying gi khrag tshabs a ru rgyam tsha dang |shing tsha'i thang gsher sbyangs rjes snying rtsa gtar// de 'og 'bras bu'i mar sbyar drug pa bsreg / glo tshabs lto gsher chung bas sbyang bya ste/ drug mgo gtar la bde byed 'bring po sbyar/ rjes la dmar gsum mar sbyar bzhi lnga bsreg /mchin tshabs gur gum shing tsha pi pi ling // a ru chang sbyar sbyangs la ru thung gtar// gur gum bdun sbyar rjes la brgyad pa bsreg / mcher tshabs rgya tsha shing tsha dur byin sbyang / se 'bru brgyad sbyar bcu gcig mcher steng bsreg /mkhris tshabs a ru khron bu gser me tog / thang khrus rjes la tig ta brgyad pa sbyar/ mkhris rtsa gtar zhing tshigs pa bcu pa bsreg / mkhal ma'i tshabs la shing tsha chang la bskol/ rgya tsha rgya ru ba spru tsaṇḍa li// kha tshar btab btang byin gzhug rtsa la gtar// rjes la rtsa ba lnga sbyar bcu bzhi bsreg / rgyu tshabs lham rtsa a ru'i thang gsher sbyang // 'om bu bdud rtsi'i dugs bdug bcu bdun bsreg / rnyan mo'i glo ba sga dang mar rnying btang // 'o tshabs 'bru sna'i dugs bya tsha mar byug / shing tsha gze ma ra sna sku la sga// spang rgyan dkar po bu ram sbyar la btang / nu ma'i khrag tshabs mtshal gyi nya dgus mnan// ba sha ka dang kyi rtse dkar po dang // a ru'i thang btang 'bru sna'i sman mar sbyar// rgyab rtsa gtar zhing gsum pa bdun pa bsreg / khrag tshabs gor pa 'bru 'am tsha dugs bya// sha ru 'ol mo rgya tsha chang sbyar btang / long rtsa yob gong rtsa gtar zas drod bsten// mgo yi rlung tshabs mgo yi nus khu dang / mgo sha glan pa grod par bas btsos bdug / 'tshogs gsang phye la sdud sgo gsum steng bsreg /mgo bcud mar chang 'bras bu'i sman mar bsten/ rus tshabs thong tsher tshang ra rus khu bsdus/ khu bar tshang ra'i sha btab tsha ba gsum// shing tsha sgyug shun tsong btab 'tshos par btso// nang par khye sus tshon re bsros kyin btang //

lta khan nga g.yon tan gyi bad/ 415dus chang sprang chang bur chang bsngags pa yin/ snying tshabs spre dom phyi ba'i snying gtso byas// snying sna tshogs tshad brdungs te grod par blug / dzā ti sug sprel shing tsha snying zho sha / rwa tsha dwa tsha a ru kha ru tsha// kha tshar btab ste chu la 'tshos par btso// de dang lug sha bsres te khye sus bsten/ 'bras bu'i mar sbyar tshigs pa drug pa bsreg / mkhal tshabs ra lug thug po'i mkhal ma dang //rta dang glang gi mkhal mas gtso byas la// mkhal sna tshil bcas gtubs te grod par blug / shing tsha dwa tsha sug smel a ru ra// rwa tsha spod sna ba spru mkhal zho sha / gze ma 'bras sna gsum btab btsos byas la// lug sha bsres te tsha ba khye sus bsten// yang na lug thong mkhal ma tshil dang bcas// shing tsha sgyug shun btab btsos grangs pa dang // tsong dang shing tsha tsha ba gsum btab btang //pho ba'i rlung tshabs bya bra'am bong bsregs bdug / se 'bru'i cur nis phyi ba gong mo btang // mdun rgyab mes mnan sgog skya'i sman mar sbyar// rgyu ma'i rlung tshabs thong tsher khrag nang du// rwa tsha dwa tsha shing tsha sug sprel dang // a ru sle tres spod sna 'bras phye sbyar// rgyu ma rgyangs btsos khye sus bsten par bya//rmi nga na bzhag sha tshil gtubs khrag dang bsres// smyug shun tsong dang shing tsha rgyam tsha btab/ rgyu ma rgyangs btsos khye sus bsten par bya// gnyis pa skran nad dgu yi bcos thabs ni// me tog sna tshogs chang du bsnan pa 'am// bya bra snum dang bsres nas 'bru sna'i lu mas// lus kun dril zhing tshang ra rgyu zhabs bdug / sga dang tsha mar sbyar ba'i bsku mnye bya// byi sa bya bra grog zhing drod dugs bya// se 'bru'i cur ni tsha ba'i ril bus bshig / long rtsa gtar zhing khrus gsher skran ro sbyang // rjes la pañtsa pha la'i sman mar ram// rtsa ba lnga sbyar tshigs pa bco lnga bsreg / bong bu phyi ba la sogs bshul sha bsten// gsum pa srin bu'i nad gnyis bcos pa ni// srin langs tsha ba'i nad la skyes pa bsten//dril phyis sa bon dngas ma thang du btang // srin khros 'bru 'am me tog byi dug
bdug / bye rug brgyad pa'i khu ba mngal du btang / zhes gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mo nad bye brag bcos pa'i le'u ste bdun cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //

417le'u don drug pa/ mo nad phal ba gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / mo nad phal pa mtshan ma'i nad dang ni/ bu ma phyin dang mgo mjug log pa dang // rog ma phyin dang snod lug khrag ma chod//nad gzhug las dang dug thabs gyur pa brgyad/ dang po mngal chags zla ba lon pa dang // pho mo gnyis kyi mtshan ma dod pa'i dus// pha dang ma la chags dang zhe sdang skye/ de dus mtshan ma'i nang du nying lo 'byung // sgyid skyur tshig pa za la mchi ma mang // dang ga mi bde zas skom sna tshogs 'dod// stong skyugs byed cing nad gzhi gar yod ldang // 'di la nyin gnyid mi log grangs mi bya// gang 'dod zas sbyin rta bong bya sha spang // drag dal mi bya skam sar ran tsam bcag / nad gzhi gang langs de yi gnyen po bsten// bu ma phyin la gson po gshin po gnyis// gson po nal bu dbyung dang btsar ma 'dod nal bu gdon thabs sman gnyis gsum dang lnga lto dgug rtsa kha phye la chang sbyar btang // thun dang yun dang sbyar la bu rtsa gtar/ zla bdun man chad thon par nges pa yin// btsar ma 'dod la phyi nang bar dang gsum// dang po nang gi snod nas ma 'gyur na// pho yi rmongs dang mo yi spyi skra gnyis// bsregs thal rgya ru gtsod ru bse ru gsum// zhib btags chang sbyar btang la dugs kyis bdug / yang na mde 'byin rgya ru mda' rgyud (rgyus1gsum// chang sbyar btang mi byi sa'i dugs kyis bdug / yang na sprang mar rgya ru sbyar la btang //yang na lha dang yi dgas gtor mas mchod smra bcad sngags stong zhun mar

418 sto/grwa nga rgyud ba /btab btang sbyin// oṃ greng greng ma hā greng badzra rje se sarba byi de su hā// bar gyi rus pa'i mig nas ma thon na// 'tshogs ma btol la mdzub mos drag tu 'then// thon dka' sen mo bregs la chang gis bkru// cha byad zla kham rgyab 'dras gsil de dbyung // phyi yi sha pags mig nas ma thon na// rked bcings sga steng bzhag la phrag pa mnan/ shi ro ma thon mda' rgyung rgya tsha dang 5 rgya ru gtsod ru chang sbyar dugs kyis bdug / yang na dur byin mde 'byin bya ma byi//rgya ru bur chang sbyar la btang bar bya// yang na rgya tsha dur byin sha ru'i thal//ba spru chang sbyar sbang skam dugs kyis bdug / yang na rgya tsha khyi rlig tsha ba btang // dur byid rgya ru rgya tsha mar dang sbyar// mngal du btang ste phying pa'i snum dugs bya// mgo mjug log gam rked pa 'jing pa ltebs// 'phongs nas 'ong na rkang pa bteg la sprug / mdzub mos 'phul te pho mdung phongs su brdeg / sngags la 'bru log byas te khong du btang // rog ma phyin na ri bong ril ma dang // rgya tsha rgya ru rmongs gzhob chang sbyar btang // sngags sam khyi rlig sbyor bas nges par thon// bu snod lug na chu 'jam 'o mas bkru// phyi nang slog la mdzub mos sleb tshad bsdigs// g.yer mas ig tu bcug pas tshud par nges// ma tshud phying pa'i yog thod phru mas dril/ de la rgya tsha glan te phugs su bskyal// rkang pa bteg la bsig cing mtshan khar bdug / 'phongs bstod nyal te 'gro 'dug langs pa spang // khrag thor bur chang ka ra chang sbyar bslud// ma chod rtsa khu byug dang chang sbyar btang / yang na nas tshig khu bar sbrang rtsi dang // dom mkhris skra gzhib btab nas btang bas chod/ yang na dom mkhris zhing tsha btab la btang // yang na gong mo'i sgro gzhob sbrang rtsi dang /ka ra lkogs pa'i thal ba sbyangs la btang // nya gzhi ro smad chus bgrang bcu drug bsreg / bsku mnye bsur bdug bur chang dus khu bsten// btsas rjes nad lhag 'dril nas zug skyes na// byi sa'i dugs bya g.yer ma chang sbyar

sa khanang g.yon tan gyi da/ 419btang / sbrang dang chang sbyar bur chang mang du btang / des ma zhi na sbang ma tsha bsros bdug / de rjes long rtsa gtar la mngal bshal bya// 'gyings rjes she rul khrag rnag byung ba na/ 'jigs pa mi dgos mngal bshal byas pas thon/ mo nad dug thabs btsas rjes sha mar rnying / nyin gnyid drag shul rkyen gyis mkhris tshad skyed/ rtsa rgyud phra mgyogs shed med skom dad che/ ro stod gzer phran 'pho zhing lud pa dmar// de la kha zas bsil drod spel la btang // ru thung snod ka mkhris rtsa long rtsa gtar/ a ru snam rtsa dur byid thang gis sbyang / btab seng tig ta'i thang btang ga bur ram/ gur gum bdun steng dom mkhris bsnan la btang / sman dang zas gnyis bsil drod so byas te// tsha grang spel bcos bcud la snga bar dbab/ ces gsungs bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mo nad phal pa gso ba'i le'u ste bdun cu rtsa drug pa'o/ //

420le'u don bdun pa/ 'byung po'i gdon gso ba/de nas yang drang srong yin las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so/ kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// gdon gso'i skabs la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa dang // ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / gdon la 'byung po'i gdon dang smyo byed dang // brjed byed gza' dang klu gdon rnam lngar bshad// 'byung po'i gdon la rgyu rkyen mtshan nyid dang // dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs lnga yis bstan// rgyu rkyen sdig pa mi dge'i las mang spyad// grogs med ya nga gcig pur bsdad pa dang // ya ga can la 'bags gtses brnyas pa dang // mchod 'os chag dang mya ngan gdungs la sogs// mi 'tshams lus ngag 'gal las 'jug par 'gyur// mtshan nyid 'byung po mi ma yin la sogs// lus ngag yid la zhugs nas spyod pa sgyur// dbye ba lha dang lha min dri za klu// gnod sbyin tshang pa srin po sha za dang // yi dwags grul bum byad stoms g.yeng byed dang // ro langs mtshun lha bla ma drang srong rgan// grub pa zhes bya'i gdon chen bco brgyad do// de rtags sngar bas dad dang shes pa dang // lus ngag yid spyod 'gyur zhing de spyod byed// blo sems mi bde spro thung shes pa 'phyo// khyad par lha gdon saṃ khya ta skad smra// tshig snyan gnyid chung bzhin legs gtsang sbra tshe// lha min sha chang la dad mig zur blta// khro gtum nga rgyal che zhing bab chol mang // dri za sgeg cing dri zhim rang la mgu// glu gar rtsed 'jo la dga'

zhu na ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 421rgyan dmar 'dod// klu gdon mdangs ldan mig dmar 'bur tshugs lta//dkar dang dmar 'dod lce myul kha sbub nyal// gnod sbyin ster la dga' zhing gsang gtam smra// sman pa bram ze la snang nya la sred/ tshangs pa kye zhes 'bod cing bstan bcos 'don// rang deg gzhan la gshe zhing rgod la dga'//srin po stobs ldan tshigs tsub dmar la rtsi// sha za ngo gnong skad dma' skabs su 'bog / don med ngu zhing sa 'bran 'brel med smra// yi dgas yi dgas spyod tshul byed pa ste/ mi 'am ci 'dar 'jigs shing zas mi 'dod//grul bum ngo nag dal 'gro rlig pa skrangs// byad stems shing 'dzin gcer rgyug gnas stong 'dug / g.yeng byed chu 'dod dngang tshig zas mi 'dod// ro langs bden smra gnyid che rgyan dga' 'dar// mtshun lha kha skam mig 'dzums g.yon gos gon// bla ma drang srong gan po grub pa bzhi// rang rang spyod lam kha zas de dang mthun// gang yang byis pa dang 'grogs gcer bur 'bud// skra brjes blo sems mi bde yun ring spang // bcos thabs sngags bzlas gtor ma sbyin bsreg dang // klog 'don mnyam 'jog bsnyen bsgrub tshogs bsags pas// 'byung po'i gdon nyid i bar byed pa yin// bya kro spang spos shu dag rma bya'i sgro// shing kun sprul pags sran phub byi la'i brun// cha mnyam du bas bdugs pas 'byung po'i 'byer// tsan dan gur gum sug sprel 'bras bu gsum// bya kro skyer pa sgron shing tsha ba gsum// gci pa tra dug nyung pu shel tse//yu ngas kur rgya spos shug pa pri yi ku// dbyi mong ru rta hong len bong nga dkar//spangs ma ldong ros gcin drug mar rnying la// sbyar ba khus 'debs sman mar zhes bya ste// bza' byug snar blug gdon las myur du grol// rig sngags gra lnga mchod phul bsgrags na phan// gtor ma rin chen dri sna 'bru sna dang // me tog 'bras chan khur ba dkar mngar rnams// lha dang bla ma drang srong grub pa dang ⑪rgan po lnga la lha yi khang par btang // lha la byang phyogs lha min nub tu sbyin//

422 sa grwa thang rgyud bzhi/dri za'i gdon la ba lang lam mdo dang / klu dang mtshun lha 'bab chu'i 'gram du sbyin// gnod sbyin chu gnyis 'dus pa'i gnas su btang / srin po lam mdo tshangs pa shar du mchod sha za la ni nub kyi khang stong btang ku gtor ma sbyin bsreg sman dud la sogs pa// khyad par rang rang 'dzin pa'i dus su bston// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las 'byung po'i gdon gso ba'i le'u ste bdun cu rtsa bdun pa'o// / /

423le'u don brgyad pa/ smyo byed kyi gdon gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / rnam shes smyo byed nad la rgyu rkyen dang // dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs bzhi yis bstan// rgyu rkyen snying stobs zhan la mya ngan dang // yid mi bde dang sems las tshes pa dang // zas spyod mi 'phrod gdon gyis rkyen byas te// nyes pa 'khrugs pas rnam shes rgyu gnas zhugs//yid de lam log dran nyams smyo bar 'gyur// dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa dang // yid gdung dug gdon las gyur bdun du bshad// de rtags rlung gyur sha skams sbru bar skyug / mang du smra zhing ngu 'bros byed pa dang //mig sprin dmar la kha zas zhu nas ldang // mkhris gyur khro brdog bsil 'dod mig chu ser// me dang skar ma mig sngar mthong bar byed// bad kun rlon zhing smra nyung yi ga 'chu// gnyid che snabs dang kha chu mang du 'dzag / 'dus pa las ni kun rtags ston par byed// yid gdung dran skyen dus ldang sems mi bde//dug gis mdangs nyams stobs chung sems 'khrul byed// gdon gyur gang gnod spyod par 'gyur ba'o// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis//dang po yid 'jug bu ga'i lam bsal phyir// bsku mnye lums bya skyugs khrus gtar bas sbyar// 'bras bu gsum dang ha re ṇa ga dang // sgron shing thal tres yu nga skyer pa:gnyis// rgya spos ru rta stag tsher pri ya sku // nā ga ge sar da lis dong ga btsod// se 'bru byi tang ga dang ka ko la// dbyi mong utpal tsan dan shug pa rnams// mar rnying dge ba'i sman mar zhes bya ste/ ro tsa bu bskyed lus

424 sto grwa thang da bzhi rgyas smyo byed 'joms// khyad par rlung las gyur la 'jam rtsi bya// bong nga zho gcig chang du spangs la btags// a ru drug 'gyur phye ma chu la bsdus// mar bskol bzang drug bu ram btab ste bsten// thabs dang mi ldan tshe yi bar chod 'gyur// yang na ga bur lnga pa dzā ti mnyam// ril bu byas te gcig gnyis gsum bskyed bsten// dzā ti'i mar dang rus chen sman mar dang // lo sha lo mar sha chen gar chang bsten// a ru tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka / 'u su la la phud dang kha ru tsha// rgyam tsha bu ram sbyar ba'i phye ma bsten// rlung gsang rnams su me dang thur ma bya// mkhris gyur da rdo dur byin gser me tog / a ru ra dang pi pi ling gis sbyang // tig ta ma nu ru rta ba sha ka / hong len gur gum skyu ru'i phye ma btang // snying rtsa gtar zhing tig ta'i sman mar sbyar// zas su lug sha rnga bran sha gsar bsten// bad gyur spyang tsher sge gsher po so cha ba yi 'o mar sbyar la skyug tu gzhug / tsub pa'i zas sman me thur bsten pa dang //'dus pa la ni kun gyi gso sbyar bya// yid dungs chos nor gtam snyan grogs kyis gso// dug la dpa' ser bong nga dkar dmar tsad// re ral yung ba dri chu'i ril bu bsten// gdon gyur byi la ra thug 'ug pa wa// gcin rtug mkhris sen spu pags spos sbyar bdug / ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las spyo byed kyi gdon gso ba'i le'u ste bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// / /

425le'u don dgu pa/ brjed byed kyi nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / brjed byed dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs gsum// dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun dug gdon lnga// de rtags byung tshul snying 'dar mgo bo 'jom// rngul 'byung sbo zhing stobs chung dus shing na// kha chu sna chu mang zhing nad langs dus// 'gyel jing so 'cha' rkang lag g.yob pa dang // sbu bar skyug cing mun par zhugs snyam sems// rlung gyur rkang lag 'dar rengs yang yang ldang // mkhris pa bzhin ser kha skam zhu dus ldang //bad kun tshigs ring khyad par kha chu mang // dug gyur nad rtags mi gsal shes pa 'khrul// gdon gyur sngar bas spyod pa gzhan du 'gyur// bcos thabs ni ru ha dang sna bshal dang // skyugs khrus rno bas bu ga dag par sbyang //'ug pa bya rog bya rgod zer mo sbrul// khyi spre rta yi chu sgro brun dud bdug / ba ser mkhris pa'i khu ba sna sman btang / shu dag ru rta mar rnying sbrang sbyar byin/bog yun ring na sor mo nyi shu bsreg / 'jam rtsi bur chang btang zhing rlung gsang bsro// srog rtsa myos byed gsang la me thur bya// bye brag gso ba spyo byed dag dang 'dra// spyir na smyo byed brjed byed gang la yang // khrag mkhris tsha ba'i phugs bcas bcos mi len// de phyir tsha ba dag par sbyang bya ste// de 'og zas sman drod bcud me thur bya// phyo dang brjed byed phal cher gdon gyur pas//bskang bshags khrus gtor bden bdar zhi bas bsten// chu gtor klu chog gtor mas brid la bcos// tha ma drag po'i las kyis mtha' ru bskyal// zhes
426 sa〉/grwa thang rgyud bzhi/gsungs so/bdud mi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las brjed byed kyi nad gso ba'i le'u ste bdun cu rtsa dgu pa'o// / /

427le'u brgyad cu pa/ gza'i gdon nad bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / gza' yi gdon la 'dzin dus brtag thabs dang / bsrung ba bcos thabs phyir mi ldog pa'o 'dzin dus tshes ba'i brgyad dam bcu gcig dang / bco lnga bco brgyad nyi shu gnyis dang lnga// nyi shu dgu dang rgyu dus brgyad la 'dzin// brtag thabs spyi dang khyad par spang blang brtag / spyi rtags bzhogs shal mig rtsa spung ba dang // kha lkugs kha sle ngu dang spyod par byed// khyad par brtag pa me gza' chu gza' gnyis// me gza' gzhogs g.yas la phog lce g.yas thung // tsha ba che zhing sen mo gzhob rog 'ong //chu gza' g.yon la phog cing lce g.yon thung / lus kun drod dang bral zhing chu rgyus spyong // spang blang brtag pa nyi shu dgu la zin// phog ma thag tu skyug cing shugs pa dang // snying gar chu lcag rgyab pas mi dngang dang / mig 'dzum mi shes drug cu yar 'das pa gsos kyang sos par mi 'gyur spang bar bya//bsrung ba rang dang nad pa srung ba gnyis/ rang gi srung ba ke tshe gar khra men//rmigs po'i sha la sngags bzlas lus la bcang // oṃ ba ra tsakra rā hu la su hā/oṃ rtu su li khru su li ting bri du su su me me shig shig su hā// oṃ stum po li skum po li ting sgom tum snye su su me me shig shig swā hā/ glo la ma brjed gnas pas gza' gdon thub// nad pa'i srung ba ring bsrel kur phra men// rma bya bya rog snying khrag lus la bcang // gu gul dkar nag yugs sa'i dor rta la thum po byas la g.yon gyi ngos su gdags// bzang drug gla rtsi sgog thal mar gsar byug / rgyu dus nad pa'i mal du phug ron gzhug / oṃ tri khyed spyo sdod

428 ༄khya/grwa nga da bzhi/pa'i gyang ngam thog la bris pas thub// bcos thabs btson du bzung dang dngangs su gzhug / zas dang spyod lam khrus chu gza' chog bya// zin pa'i mod la btson du bzung bya ste// yugs sa'i zhabs mas nad pa'i mgo phur la//ke ta bzlas shing gu gul du bas bdug / gu gul chur sbyangs sngags btab khong du btang // sgog thal gangs thigs rdo mkhris dri chu sbyar// lus la byugs pas 'khor la 'phro mi 'gyur// de nas dngangs su gzhug pa me gza' la// nyi grib mtshams su nad pa tsog pur bzhag / steng nas chu rdza bdun gyis bskud la bran// rgyab nas dung 'bud bros na sngar shul dbul// chu gzas zin na mtha' ma me yis bskor// bros na mda' bkang dri thogs rgyob sod bsdigs//des kyang ma sos nad pa thongs kur ba 'ag / 'og tu sog 'bol steng du gos bting la// dung 'bud pa dang bskyur ba dus gcig bya// kha zas chang dang mar rnying sha khrag spang // sbrang dang mar gsar zho dar dkar chos bston//spos dkar sbrang dang sbyar ba khong du btang // spyod lam mi gtsang sgrub 'dzem me nyi spang // mi yis mi lab mi col snyan tshig smra// khrus chu ga bur gi waṃ bzang po drug / tsan dan gla rtsi spos dkar dri chus bkru// yang na de rnams sgog skya nus ldan bsregs// chang dang sbyar la lus kun yang yang bkru// rnam 'joms la sogs khrus chus bkru ba bsngags// gza' chog gtor ma sbyin dang byad dgrol gnyis// gang yang dang po klu chog rgyab bcos la// de rjes dkar gtor gcig dang dmar gtor gcig / sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs gu gul gyis// nad par bdug cing ke ta mang du bzlas// oṃ ke ta ke ta swā hā/de rjes sngags kyis gza' la gtor ma sbyin// smrang gis bkrol la gtor ma skyel du btang // de shul nad pa de dang rgyab sprad la// ste'u shug pa la bdeg gtam kha dri// de yi nub mo gza' yi byad dgrol te// sla nga chu yis bkang pa'i kha gdang du// gza' brgyud gzugs la kha dog so sor bsgyur ra du gza'

༄na nang yo na tan gyi da 429nyi ra sumados dmar po phyag na padma bsnams pa/ lhor phur bu ra po gti/ nub tu bdakar po kumud byang du lhag pa ser po utpal shar lhor mi dmar da par po medapung/ lho nub tu rā gulanas po bum pa / nub byang du pa ba sangs dkar po pa / byang shar du spen pa sngon po dbyug pabasnams pa'o/ kha gdangs chu yi nang du bstan la ba 'ag rang rang ming dang snying po bris la glan// nad pa byad thag btags la gzugs dang sprel// sla nga'i phyogs bzhir mar me ba'i btang la/ yi ke ta ke ta rā hu la swā hā/ brgya rtsa bzlas la byad bkrod byad thag bcad// yag she phaṭa/ dur shaṃ phaṭa/ se shaṃ phaṭa/ phag shaṃ phaṭa/ phe shaṃ phaṭa/ pher shaṃ phaṭa/ shar shaṃ phaṭa/ trag shaṃ phaṭa/tsa shaṃ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa bzlas shing nyi ma zla ba dang // mig dmar lhag pa phur bu pa wa sangs// spen pa rā hu la brgyad smrang gis bkrol// byad thag bcad de chu yi nang du bskyur// rdza snod byo la tho rangs chu gzhung bskyal// rgyu dus brgyad la gza' chog thebs re bya/ mi ldog thabs la zin nas zhag bdun nas/ klu brgyad byas te zin dus rgyu phyogs su// bung bu phug ron blud du byas te btang //nad pa sos rjes pha waṃ cho long dang // kur phra men dang bzlas yungs ske ru gdags// de yis phyir mi ldog par nges pa yin// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gza'i gdon nad bcos pa'i le'u ste brgyad cu pa'o// / /

430le'u gru gcig pa/ gdug pa klu'i gdon nad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / lan cig lnga brgya tha ma'i dus tshod du// bskal pa'i cha nyams 'byung ba'i bcud shor bas// mi rnams za thang bri nas dbul por gyur// sa gnyan rlogs nas spang mtha' 'ing du 'phru// chu gnyan dkrugs nas ne'u sing rdzing du bskyil// thing gnyan gcod cing rdo sa nyan rtsa ba 'degs// mi gtsang 'thab gzhob shan dmar 'jol nyog spyod / ban bon nus pa sgrub pa'i long med nas// gnyan sa dkrugs pas dgra rnams thul la re// de tshe klu gnyan sa bdag lha srin 'khrugs// reg mthong kha rlangs bsam pa'i dug 'phros pas// tsi tsi dzwa la 'bar ba'i bskal pa dar// mthong bas skyug bro bsams pas skyi 'jigs shing // thos na ya nga rang ro rang gis mthong //tshe 'di'i gnyen 'dun kun dang gson 'bral byed// de 'dra'i nad kyi gso thabs ngas bstan gyis// drang srong chen po ma yengs gus pas nyon// 'di la rgyu rkyen mtshan nyid dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs lnga ru shes par bya//rgyu ni lus la gnas pa'i chu ser la// de rkyen sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin pa//phral du gdon dang phog thug byung ba 'am// zas spyod dbang gis 'du ba 'khrugs gyur pas// chu ser nag po lus la rgyas pa yin// mtshan nyid sha pags rus tshigs rtsa khrag don// chu ser bsrul bas lus kun ma rungs byed//mi bzad gso dka' mdze yi nad du bshad// dbye ba gnas dang rigs kyis bco brgyang ra gyur// zhugs tshul gnas kyis dbye na skyi pags rtsi// mdog stobs sha tshil chu ba rtsa dang khrag / chu ser dus tshigs lha ba glad rkang khu//don la zhugs pas dbye ba bcu dang brgyad// rigs kyis dbye ba rkyang pa ldan

༄khan nga yon tan gyi rgyud 431'dus bdun// thod 'dra zlum po glang shu mu dum war// ri sha'i lce dang pags mdze gcig pu dang // 'brum phran sha bkra 'bras byer ser ga dang // shu ba kha brgya pad ma dkar po dang / 'brum bu g.yan pa pags pa sbyags pa dang /'ol se 'dra dang sum cu rtsa drug go / brtag thabs dang po nad ngos bzung ba dang :/ gso tshe spang blang mu ba'i ra brtag pa 'o// ngos bzung rtags la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyis brtag / phyi la sngon tshul rmi lam brtag pa dang // mtshan nyid lus ngag yid la brtag pa'o// rmi lam chu dang shing dang ne'u gsing dang / sbal ljong nya sbrul 'bu sbrang sig sdom sogs/lus la 'byar dang gseb na 'dug pa dang // g.yag mdzo gcan gzan rnams kyis ded pa dang / mi thong sgo 'phrang 'dzul dang g.yang la lhung // nyi nub sa sros ser ba babs pa dang // mda' dang sgo nga lha khang lder so 'gul// bud med dag gis lus zungs 'byin pa mi/ lhas tshor dus te gdon gyis 'debs pa'i rtags// lus la brtag pa bzhin la 'gyur ldog byed// bkrag phrogs pa 'am yang na skyes pa dang // don med khrag skye sna khrag 'dzag pa dang / pags pa res 'gas res tsub tsha 'am grang // g.ya' zhing phrug 'dod shu thor chu bur 'ong // 'gul 'phrig pho mchin mi bde rus rkang na// gsang tshigs gnad pa'i rma rnams yu na ring gnas / ngag la brtag pa 'gyur ldog mang ba ste//yid la brtag pa snying 'chu mi dga' 'pho// khro tshig 'gro 'dod gong rtags gsang bar thub// rang tshor dus yin gdon gyis thebs par nges// nang gi brtag pa rnam rtog ci 'dra yang // bzhin nyid me long 'dra ste bkrus la brtag / me tog yod sar chu mi 'chags par skam// skya sprug dmar sogs sha mdog 'gyur ba la// sha pags bteg nas mthe bos mnan rjes 'ong // sna gong mkhur tshos smin dbrag rnams su mang // me tog skams na dus las 'das zhes bya// gsal bar ston pa dbang po mig yin te// mi gnod pa yi rtsa dang gnod pa'i rtsa// gdon rigs 'jug tshul lus kyi zhugs sa dang // thub

432 zhu/grwa thang — /— da wadang mi thub lo grangs brtag par bya// gsang ba sman gyi sgo nas brtag pa ste//mu zi gu gul shu dag gla rtsi bzhi / srub ka lo mar mnyam la ras su phur// dri chur sbangs la zhag gsum skom du btang // dri chu khrag dang chu ser sna tshogs dang // rang gi mdog las gnod dang mi gnod brtag / bye brag brtag pa dug dang gdon rigs dang // zhugs tshul babs sa nyes pa'i rigs kyis brtag / dang po dug gi sgo nas brtag pa ni// lci 'thibs sa dug yang zhing g.yo ba rlung / tsha srag me dug grang 'ing bsil ba chu/ gdon rigs dbye ba rtsa ba yan lag gnyis// yan la ga the brang 'gong po skyi la 'bab// dam sri pags pa sa bdag sha la 'jin// gnyan rtsa ba spu rigs drug chu rigs 'dzin// rtsa gdon rgyal rigs yid dug gtsug nas 'jug / rje rigs mthong ba'i dug ste rtsa nas 'jug bram ze kha rlangs dug ste lag pa g.yon// dmangs rigs reg dug rkang pa g.yas nas 'jug / gdol pa ma che ba'i dug can rkang pa g.yon// mjug tu klu yi rgyal po don la 'bab// 'jug tshul rnam pa lnga yi sgo nas 'jug / ku re kyal ga'i tshul du zhugs pa dang // longs spyod re 'dod tshul gyis zhugs pa dang // mi gtsang snol gyi sgo nas zhugs pa dang // do rdo bsad pa'i sems kyis zhugs pa dang // las kyi rnam smin tshul du zhugs par brtag / babs sa gnas kyi sgo nas brtag pa ni// skyi dang pags pa rtsa dang mdog la zhugs// stobs dang sha tshil chu ba rtsa dang khrag / chu ser rus tshigs lha ba glan par zhugs// rkang dang khu ba don la zhugs par brtag / don ni snying dang glo ba mchin pa dang // mcher pa mkhal mar zhugs pa brtag par bya//mdor bsdus bcu gsum gnad la ngos yis bzung // nyes pa'i sgo nas mdze rigs bco brgyad brtag / rlung mdze thod 'dra mkhris mdze u dum war//bad kun las gyur zlum po glang shu gnyis// rlung dang mkhris par lda na pa ri sha'i lce// bad rlung las gyur pags mdze gcig pu dang // 'brum phran sha bkra 'bras byer ser ga drug / bad mkhris las gyur shu ba rma kha brgyad// pad

zhu na nga g.yon tan gyi da 433dkar 'brum bu g.yan pa pags myags drug / 'dus pa las gyur 'ol mo se 'dra 'o// nad 'di 'og nas rkun bur 'jug pa'i phyir/ mi gsal 'khrul so mang bas brtag pa gces// phyi nang gsang rtags gsum gyis gtan la phob//nya rtsa rlung gdon 'a zig par no ra re// sha 'bur srin 'bur gting 'bur no ra re// sha sgang nya sgang chu sgang no ra re// sha pags skyi dang rus ro no ra re//kha yo mig sle ska sla no ra re/ nad dang khams 'dus gdon gsum no ra re kyal ga re 'dod rnam smin do rdo ba// 'di dag 'phrang la ma shor ngos bzung gces// zas skom spyod lam gnas mal gos la sogs// dri dang reg pas 'gos phyir bsrung ba gces// gnyis pa spang blang mu bzhir brtag pa ni//mkhar brgyad rtse nas bcom pa dang // snying po ba'i la zhugs pa dang // rtse mo gsum la zin pa dang // tshigs chen mkhar nas phab pa dang // dug bzhi lus la rgyas pa dang // mdangs gsum yal dang spu gsum byi chu gsum bo dang rgya mtsho rlabs// glo snying mchin mcher mkhal mar rgyas// mthil bzhi'i rlangs pa yal ba dang // sa bdag the ba chags pa rnams// gso ru mi rung spang bar bya//de 'dres pa ni gso ba tsam// rgyal po'i pho brang btab pa la// 'bras bu smin pa'i rtags med na// de ni gso ba dka' ba yin// dmangs ni grong ga yan pa la// rtog pa sna tshogs grangs mang yang // gong las bzlog pa gso ba bla// lnga pa bcos pa'i thabs la rnam pa gsum// gnod pa bsrung zhing zhugs pa dbyung ba dang // tha ma lum pa'i dus su tshe bsring ba'o// dang po gnod pa'i dus su bsrung ba ni// ma rungs gdug pa 'dul mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon// mthu stobs bdag po phyag na rdo rje yi/ snying po bzlas pas klu yi dug rnams sel//sa rdo sku la bdud rtsi'i bcud len gyis/ chu ser mi skye gdon rnams thub par 'gyur// bar du zhugs pa'i dus su dbyung ba ni// sngon 'gro rgyu rkyen chu ser sbyang ba dang // dngos gzhi gdug pa'i dug nad gzhom pa dang // rjes gcod kor le nad kyi gdon thabs dang // gang dgos rten 'brel mdangs stobs

434 ༄2thang da ba gdab pa dang // nad thon ma thon btang ran bzung tshad bstan// dang po nad kyi rgyu dang gdon gyi rkyen// chu ser lho dang rtsa nas sbyang ba ni// khrus dang bsku mnye sngon 'gro spyi dang 'dra// ba chur dur byin lhum rtsa 'bras bu gsum//sngon du bsdus khur chu ser sman gsum dang // gu gul byi tang ga btab rgyun sbyongs bya// yang na 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba lnga// dur byid nanda dong ga bya kṛ dang // hong len shu dag bong nga tsi tra ka / pa tra shi ri khan da btags lde gu// mar du bskol la lto sra'i bkra sman sbyar// de rjes rtsa nas sbyang ba spyi sman la// chu ser sman gsum gu gul gla rtsi lnga// gdon dang chu ser sbyang phyir mde kha bsgyur// glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma sha dus rtsa// gang babs nad steng khrid pa'i nang yan sbyar// btang thabs lcags dang log non rjes gcod rnams// sbyong byed las lnga'i mdo ru shes par bya// ra ba ba'i la lan re sbyang ba gces// rgyu rkyen med na 'bras bu ga la 'byin// gnyis pa gdug pa'i dug nad gzhom pa la// zas dang spyod lam sman dpyad rnam pa bzhi/ kha zas dkar dang mngar gyi rnam pa dang // rul skyur tsha dang sngo tshod 'jig zas spang //'bru rnying gas ra sha skam yib phye thug dang // chab tsha bsings po brda bro chu grang bsten// spyod lam chags pa drag shul nyin mo'i gnyid// mi gtsang gnyan pa'i thub chod kun la 'dzem// sman sbyor thang phye ril bu lde gu dang // sman mar lnga las dang po thang sbyor ni// seng lding nim pa sle tres pa to la// byi tsher lnga yis chu ser rang sa ra skem// seng ldeng chig thang mdze nad 'joms pa'i mchog / phye ma cong 'i sbal rgyab chig thub gnyis// bee snabs gru ba'i rdo rgyus ma rdzir// gser dngul zangs 3 gas rdo dang tsha la mtshal// bzang drug chu ser sman gsum 'bras bu gsum// gu gul gla rtsi mu zi tsi tra ka / gser gyi me tog ma nu ru rta dang / seng ldeng ka ra sbyar bas chu ser skem// kyi lce ming can ser nag brag spos pa// gla rtsi gu gul ru rta seng ldeng dang // spos dkar ka ra sbyar ba dri chus dbul// grang shas che na a ru btsan dug bsnan// klu gnyan sa

lta khan nga yon tan gyi da/ 435bdag dug nad 'joms pa'i mchog / ril bu'i sbyor sde bya khyung rin po che//dang po bya khyung rnam lnga sbyar ba ni// sha rus rgyus pa snying khrag bya khyung lnga// ba'i gcig sum gnyis phyed dang sum cha sbyar// a ru btsan dug rim pas zhib par btags// de nas bsres la skam 'thags 'thems par bya// lo brgyad bdud rtsis chu thags nyin gsum bya// byang ba'i tshad ni gnag la 'tsher bar 'ong // gla rtsi ril bu byed kur chur sbyangs btang // gi waṃ nag po tshan de tsha grang bsgyur// gu gul nag po gdon gyi gnyen por gces// 'bru lngas dbang bskur ting 'dzin ldan pas gza'// tshes bcu'i bar du re re nyi shu gnyis//sum cu gsum gsum nub mo sum yar btang / zhugs pa'i dus nas lo ru bsten par bya// de la bde skyed med na sha gnyis phri// lo dus bsten pas mdze rigs bco brgyad sel// klu yi dug nad ma lus gtan nas 'joms// rin chen sbyor ba dngul chu dug phral dang // mu zi seng ldeng khaṇḍa bzang po drug /chu ser sman gsum gu gul bya khyung sbyar// klu yi gdon 'joms chu ser rtsad nas skem// khyad par dngul chu star bu mu men gser// sgron shing de ba dā ru a ru ra// gu gul dkar nag gla rtsi so ma ra// thal ka rdo rje dag dang bzang po drug / tsan dan dkar po gi waṃ dri chen rnams// ril bu gcig gnyis gsum du bskyed la btang / 'di yis las kyi rnam smin yin srid kyang // tshe 'di'i mdze nad nges par shol thebs 'gyur btang thabs log gnon rin chen sbyor sde ltos// lde gu'i sbyor ba lcags phye tsi tra ka / skyu ru byi tang ga dang pi pi ling / sprang sbyar lde gus mdze nad rgyas pa 'joms// seng ldeng lca ba ra mnye cha mnyam pa'i// khaṇḍa sprang sbyar bzang drug byi tang ga / chu ser sman gsum drod sman tsi tra ka / kha tshar btab pa'i lde gus mdze nad 'joms// mu zi a ru sbrang sbyar cha mnyam ste// lcags g.ya' bsgos pa'i lde gus mdze nad 'joms// sman mar seng ldeng tig ta che 'bring sbrang // bzang drug chu ser sman gsum kha tshar btab// chu ser skem zhing lus stobs rgyas par byed//

436 sto/grwa nga ri'idapyad du gang zhugs rtsa gtar rlangs pa dbyung // khyad par dpral rtsa chu ser gdong rtsa gtar// gsum pa kor le nad kyi gdon thabs ni/ gdong la lud na byang pa rgya tsha dang // dur byin srub ka spru ma gze ma dang // cu gang chang dang sbyar ba drod phab bsnan// langs nas byugs pas gdong bshal chu ser 'don/ thag chod lug sug thal ba mar dkar byug / kor ler sbrid bem btsags la rngabs ras drang // yang na dri chus bkrus la byang pa dang // dur byin rgya tsha sngo yi tsha ba gsum// gong ltar bsnan la byugs te nyi mas bsreg / yang na sngags kyis chu ser drang bar bya// sha ro btsags kyis dral la za sman gzhug / skyon dang bral nas rma la 'tsho sman gdab// smin ma byi na phag tshil zer mo'i khrag /tsha dang ldong ros ba la rkang mar dang // kham bu'i rtsi dang sbrang sbyar byugs pas 'tsho// mtshul pa 'gags na sna sbyongs yang yang btang // gre ba 'gags na gtar dang de sman sbyar// bzhi pa rten 'brel mdangs stobs gdab pa ni//mi khyi ra rta mngal khrag lnga la la gyi shaganyis mi dang rgya'i tshil gnyis gla rtsi gyu dag shing kunanuzi sgog skya spru rtsa dri can drug / btsan dug tsan dan mar khu sbyar la byug / sha gnyis nag po gsum dang rta bon po// dri gsum gzhob gsum du bas bdug par khya// bdud rtsi ril bu nyin mo gsum yar btang // dri chu'i rten 'brel sman 'ju gdon nad sel// dang ga 'gags na se 'bru ba'i bdun sbyar// de yang khyad par bya khyung za dus bsten// tha ma btang ran bzung tshad bstan pa ni// dang po sman gyi sbyor ba bsten pa yis// je bde song na nad zhen chung ba yin// nad kun slongs na gdon zhin 'bring po yin// phan gnod med na gting zhen che ba yin// lo gcig lo gnyis gsum gyi bar du sgrim// bar du mang bsten bde dang nyung bsten bde// gang ma bde ba de las bzlog la bsten// nad mgo chogs rtags snying rtsa seng ba dang // lus yang khams dngas dang ga bde ba dang // sna khrag 'dzag dang dri chu khrag tu don// zhugs sar chu ser 'dus shing rnag khrag 'dzag / klog shu bud dang rtags rnams khad

༄6 lhan ngag yon tan gyi da/ 437kyis nub// mi lam lus las srog chags 'thon pa dang // khrus byas bshal byung sna khrag zags pa mi// gnod pa'i rmi ltas nub dang skams bsregs phyir//lus la me 'bar nyi ma shar ba 'byung // mig rtsa sangs khugs chad btul gang byung rnams// gdug pa klu yi gdon dang bral ba'i rtags// de rtags mthong na ril bu re re dbri/ phri bas mi bde snon 'brid shes par bya// bsnan pas bde na ma thon da dung bsring // phri bas bde na nad kyi rtsad thon pas// lo dus bar du ma brjed rgyun par bsten// de yis mi ldog phyi rjes chod pa yin//lus zungs nang du gyur phyir thon dka' bas// brtson pas dar drag ngang gis skugs bsring gces// spyir na nad 'di sngon gyi las ngan te// rgya dang lam 'phrang bsal dang nye'u 'don dang // chab gtor tshogs 'khor dge slong bzhi grwa dang // bka' bklag sdig sgrib sbyang zhing sems bskyed bsgom// khams gsum sems can thams cad pha ma yin// pha ma'i lan chags bu yis sbyang don du// spyi dang sgos dang yang sgos sems bskyed la// lus ngag yid dang longs spyod sbyin blos btang // lus sems nad gdon rang bzhin ma grub phyir// bdag med stong pa'i don la rgyun du blta// tha ma lum dus sbyongs dang ṭwāṃ /kā ༵ /shā/ 'a /da sna sag /dro /lha bu sman mar bsten// de yis nad kha bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gdug pa klu'i gdon nad gso ba'i le'u ste brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa'o// //

438le'u gya gnyis pa/ rma spyi'i gso thabs bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// rma gso'i skabs la ci ltar bslab bar bgyi// rma zhes bya ba'i rgyu rkyen gang las byung // ngo bo rgyu mtshan ci las ming du btags// de la gnas pa'i sa dang dbye ba du// rtags dang bcos thabs log gnon rjes gcod rnams// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa dang / drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / rgyu rkyen rlung dang mkhris pa bad gan la// zas spyod mi 'phrod gdon gyis rkyen pa yis// lhan cig skyes pa'i rma ru 'gyur ba yin// mda' rdo gri mdung rwa shing mche ba me// lus la gnad pas blo bur rkyen thar 'gyur// 'dzag pa dri nga tshor ba sdug bsngal bcas// lus las phral du nyams shing rma ba la// pags pa sha gdan ral phyir rma zhes bya//gnas sa pags pa sha dang chu rgyus rtsa// tshigs dang rus pa don snod brgyad la gnas// dbye ba lhan cig skyes dang blo bur gnyis// lhan skyes rma la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// phyi ma rdol dang nang rma za khu dang // bar ma zug pa zhes bya gsum du 'gyur// bye brag phyi nang 'bras dang gzhang 'brum dang // me dbal sur ya then bu rlig blugs dang // rkang bam mtshan bar rdol dang brgyad du bshad// blo bur rkyen gyi rma la rigs dang gnas// rigs kyis dbye na bshas bshags bcad pa dang // rnam par bcad dang rab tu 'phyang ba dang // lhung dang drugs dang phug pa brgyad yin no// gnas kyis dbye na mgo dang byang khog dang // yan lag rma dang gsum 'dus ske rma bzhi// de rtags gso ba

zhu khan ngag yo na tan gyi rgyud/ 439dka' bla brtag pa dang // gnad la song dang ma song brtag pa dang / red dang ma red brtag pa rnam pa gsum// gso dka' ba la gnas dang rang bzhin rkyen// rma gnas mig dang rna ba so dang sna// mur gong rtsib logs brang dang lte ba dang // nu ma mchan khung rlig pa nus mgo dang // rgal tshigs chu rgyus las byed tshigs mtshams dka'// rma yi rang bzhin thur du phugs 'chas dang // zug rngu lus dang nya khros chu rgyus rul// rtsa chad tshigs 'khor 'bu zhugs rus mdzer yod// nang skyon ma sbyangs red bcas gso dka' yin//rkyen ni snum drags zas dman smyung bar 'dug / nyin par gnyid log nyal po spyad pa dang // bsgul bskyod sngas pa 'tsho ba dka' bar bshad// de las go ldog rma ni gso ba bla// gnad du babs pa gsos kyang 'tsho mi 'gyur// gnad la song ba sha tshil rus pa dang // chu rgyus don snod rtsa gnad rnam bdun te//sha gnad spangs shing byer la khro ba yin// tshil bu'i gnad la song na lhog thabs skrangs// dus gnad na zhing rus tshad rkun bur skye// don gnad zug gzer che zhing gzi mdangs 'chor// snod gnad drag por sbo 'khrug dri chu sdom// rtsa gnad rtsa tshad skye zhing 'du ba 'khrug / mdor na sgo gsum gnad la phebs par 'gyur/ gnad la ma song zug med dang ga bde// lus yang bya ba'i las la blo mi ldo ga / rma red rtags la spyi dang khyad par gnyis// spyi rtags rma kha rgyas dang zhum pa dang // shin tu sra snyi mtho 'am dma' ba 'am// tsha 'am drod med dmar nag sngo 'am skya// dri mnam 'drul 'ing 'tshor mi 'dod pa'o//bye brag red dang 'grams dang byer pa dang // ba 'a' spyo dus zan can dang rnam pa drug / de la 'du bas red dang zas spyod red// 'du ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun bzhi// rlung 'gyur sngo nag dmar sprug skya ba la// pags pa rtsub tseg gas snyam rnag chu sla// mkhris gyur dmar la tsha 'brab zug gzer che//myur du 'drul zhing rnag chu mang du 'dzag / khrag gyur mdog dmar tsha 'khyug

440 sa grwa nga da ba /khrag tu 'dzag / bad gyur zug chung 'dran 'drod mang la skya// zas kyis red pa zas red skom red gnyis/ zas red rma skams sbos sam 'jig par byed//skom red lus rngul rma gsher rnag chu mang // spyod red nyi lhags gnyid chags 'jigs pa lnga// nyi red rnag sngo rma hrin gnyer ma 'byung // lhags red sngo skya grang 'brum 'ong ba yin// gnyid red dbang po mi gsal zas mi 'dod//chags red rma kha 'bye zhing khu tshigs 'ong // 'jigs pas skrangs thing grogs 'dod rma kha skam// 'grams pa zhe snang drag shul nyi ma rta// zas dang gdon gyis 'grams pa rnam pa drug / zhe sdang khro 'tshig chu ser tsha ba skye// drag shul drag por skrangs thing khrag tshad skye// nyi mas 'grams na rma skams chu bur 'ong //srug por skrangs shing rnag mdog dmar rtsa 'byung // rta 'grams 'gro 'dod mdog skya rngul zhing tsha// zas 'grams rma mdog log la tsha ba skye// gdon 'grams tshig pa za la thor pa yong // byer pa pags pa sha tshil rtsa rus tshigs//pags byer pags 'og rnag chus zos pa ste// sha byer nya sul bye nas rnag byer la// tshil byer dreg dang pags pa byer ba yin// rus byer sha nus bar du rnag zhugs pa// tshigs byer phyi tshigs nang tshigs 'khor ba 'o// rtsa byer rtsa la chu ser gram pa yis// 'khyug cing skrangs la rtsa 'brum 'byung ba yin// bzha' la sha rus tsha grang rnam pa bzhi// sha bzha' ba ni sha 'u skyer mi 'dod// nus bzha' rus pa'i steng nas sha mi skye// tsha bzha' rma kha shi la rlangs pa che// grang bzha' drod bral rma kha shi ba 'o// spyo la sha khrag nus pa rnag smyo bzhi// sha spyo sha 'u mthug sbob rma khar lud/ khrag spyo smug nag reg na khrag nag 'dzag / rus spyo rus steng sha 'u mdzer thabs skye// rnag spyo rnag chu mang la rma kha mtho1 rus zan rus pa las dang zug ju las/ rnag sha ma thon rma yi nus zan ba'i//rus pa'i rus zan rma kha mtho la sbo rnag chu 'chad du mi 'don sro ma can//zug rngu'i rus zan kha bye phongs su chags// rnag mdog tsan dmar mi chad

khanang g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 441khrag can 'dzag / rnag gi rus zan skrangs pa skya la bee ma// rnag la skye 'bri che la dri ma mnam// rma yi rul zan rma yis sman mi 'ju/ yang na rma kha phyin nas rlon par 'gro// red 'byongs skyon med dmar zhing rig mi bzod/ rnag rme dog skya 'jam sha 'u 'brum phran bcas// rma kha lcags g.yas bskor zhing bla gnyan med// gso thabs skrangs gzhom red sbyang sha 'u gso// zas dang spyod lam 'phrod dang mi 'phrod bsten// dang po bar tha kun tu shes par bya// dang po rma gsar zhag gsum sbang mas gdul// chang 'gag sbang mas rlung 'dul chu ser 'jib// bsings po'i sbang mas rma yi bad kun sel// chu nas bton pas khrag mkhris tsha ba 'joms// drags na rma 'byer sha 'u rlig pa 'phyin//byad dang mthil bzhi chu rgyus 'drul bar byed// nang btol tsha ba sdud cing rul myags mched// de phyir sbang ma gnas dus shes pa gces/ de 'og skrangs pa shor na 'jib 'dul bya// bsil 'jibs drod 'jibs rma yi tsha grang dris// 'on kyang rma rnams phal cher tsha ba ste// 'di la grang ba 'byung ba nyin skar bzhin// bsil bas blug cing byug dang bdugs byas na// me la chu ltar skrangs pa 'i bar 'gyur// tsha rgyu mkhris pa khrag la gnas pa'i phyir/ gang nye gang rgyas rtsa la khrag shed smad// mi ngan rten bral gnod mi nus dang mtshungs gnad la gzems la ju tses 'al zhal bya// rus steng rnams la rus la thug par brdeg / gnad kyi steng du pags pa 'then la gtsag / mer dang stong sogs chu ser 'dus sar shis// de steng chu yis tshugs tshad spreng bar bya//rjes la bsil ba'i zhun nan shis pa yin// yang na rngabs rwa btsugs te 'bur ba dang // btsags bus dral te chu ser yang yang gzhib/ ju tse zabs ras sha pags chu ser 'dren// phral du zug gcog skrangs pa rnag mi 'chor/sngas na 'phar zhing gdon skrangs 'byer bas spang // kun gyis zhi dka' rtsa 'am lto nas sbyang / rgyu nyid rtsad nas 'don phyir dpyad mchog yin// zug

442 sa༅/grwa nga rgyud ba'i med skrangs pa sra la rlung che na// chur gnas sha yi lums kyang bsngags pa yin//sra brtan zug chung bad rlung 'joms pa yi// sman gyis byugs steng dro ba'i dugs kyis bdug / de 'og 'bru btsos btags pa'i lde gus 'joms/ na tsha zug gzer che na zar ma til// cha mnyam brngos phye 'o ma sbyar ba byug /shug pa ru rta rgyam tsha zar ma til// phabs dang rjen phye zho btsos zhun byas na//zhi dka'i spangs pa gang yang rnag tu 'gugs// bar du red sbyang spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi bcos 'ba' cha'i lums dang rus pa'i zhun// yang na dug sna ri cas ri co kyi lce ngas ra na gye ra ra nas sbyar ba'i lums zhun nan phrod sbyar// yang na sa yi nan gyis rma gan gdul/ rma yi red sbyang dur byin dan da dang //yung skyer nim pa shing mngar pa to la// rgyam tsha til gyi lde gus red pa sbyong //yang na ru rta dur byin yung ba rgya tshabazhi 'am dngul thal rgya tsha dur byin ra nu dom khris mtshal drug / 'a nye'i dang dur byin gcod sman sbang 'jibs sha ro gcod// yun ring 'tsho dka' sha ro lcags kyis bsreg / bye brag rlung gis red pa sbyang ba glu sbang tshab gsu snum bzhi ra nye nye thing lcaba'i chas bya/ bsil mi btang : thal ba'i skam byug padang // mkhris pa ga bur rma khris pa cu gang ka ra gdab/ tho mang ngam zho glan ga ra sa bya/snum mi btang khrag mkhris gdab dmar chas bya gtar ga bya byi byan dugs mi byadang bad kun red pa sngo'i tsha ba gsum mkhris bcad 'byor gdab sbang gar tshab gsum phabs glad pagayer ma zhi'i chas bya/ sdum dang sgo nga mi btang bdang// zas nya snyibs g.yum 'o btsags shachang btang 'ji ris ba rim skomangom mkhris rgya tsha phag mgo lis bu mig byug 'om bub lu shug pa cho sbyar glan/nyi ma mar shing mngar ra'i 'o ma byug nya lcibs glan lhags pas red pa mkhan sbang tsha bas sum ma 'brur zhun bya/ 'ol smom glan dang// gnyid ga bur chu byug chu rtsa bas bye zho glan dang chags pa mar nag spo dbran byug chang nga tang 'jigs pas red pa rku ri gu gul byug lo sbang glan grogs bsten pa sa sbyang// zhi ri nga bsil sman dang bsil chas btang yid 'ong gtam dang gros sa bsten drag shul sho mang glan sa tar sa byad la bar sdad nyi mas 'grams pa

sa khanang ga yon tan gyi da/ 443hong len nya bas bra 'o zho sbyar btang bdang rta ga ra'i nga btang 'ab ta sa 'dzin rta sbangasabyug dang zas bsil btang bcud ba mdang gdon gyis 'grams pa gug la gla rtsi mu zi spang spos chen yungs kar byugs pas gso// pags pa byer rma mkhris sa spu dang byer chu btsa sal skya ra gying deb bya tshil byer nga dugs bya la ba'i skam rtsi byug pa dang / rtsa byer 'phar rtsa bsreg khrag gtar dom mkhris ba seng thang btang mkhris nan bya rus byer ba byad dom mkhris ṣka ba seng ru rta tsher sngon gdab tshigs byer gug la 'khrus nan gyis bsdu bar bya/ sha bzha'achang dang lug shu btang rus bzha' khong du nga btang tsha ba gsum gyis bgru dom mkhris yung tshal ga dab tshabazha' bsil gyis ba spu ga bur ga dbagrang bzhal gsar bcud btang drod lums bya ba dang// sha smyos dul gcod gdab sa bsreg khrag smyos la khrag don gcod man ga dbadus smyos bsreg ga pa byad la na gdab rnag spyos btsa' gdab rnag dbyung bcad//nus pa'i rul zan khong du bya dang ri bong gi btang mi rus 'brug rus 'gron thal ru rta gdabades ma thon na dras la rus 'dzer gdon zug rngu'i rul zan khong du nya sha btang la zug ju 'byin pa'i zhun bya dul gcod sa dab rnag 'khyims pa 'don dang// rnag la ga bshal bya dang rma yi rul zan dbyung ma la no btsags na sman mig dab ba ru ra'i tshig gu gdab ma gyid na phum glan pa gdab sbang ma spang bar bya// de sogs rma red bla gnyan gang byung bsal//tha ma skyon sol dag nas rma rtsis gso// dang po gso gcod sgrags mar sbyar ba dang // de rjes 'tsho sman chig tshugs sbyar ba 'o// dang po li gri mtshal ser mtshuramadu so cha spos dkar spangs ma mar gas rabargyad dang bcad 'byor sngo'i tsha ba gsum mi dom phagamakhris sa sum bdun// rgya drus chu dom mkhris brag spos chu ma rtsi lnga pa gang 'dzom gso gcod byed// tha ma mkhris sbyor lug mkhris bdun chu phul la bsdus la bya'i ze khrig spos mi domanya mkhris stag dar ya kan sbyar ba mi rtsir bzang sngo sbyor dar ya gan char 'dab lnga pa skyerashun ba khur shel ta pa yag 'byu ka ra sbyar ba mi kun la bzang sha sbyor kyi rtse brag lcam stag phagal nga pa dkar po bcad 'byor chu brag spos mkhris mtshal dkar cu gang gur gu ka ra gsar rnyingakun gyi rtsi dang// sha stag sha dom mkhris brag thos gdab rus ba sang ma byag dom mkhris tsher

444 sa /grwa thang rgyud ba /sngon ba pags pa slang dreg rnyed phab sol gol dud pa bya bal ma rags ra sa dreg gi khur ma nga khur chung sum cu tig rma rtsir bstun// de rjes spen pa rtas par bya ba glen pa chags nas mar glan yang na shu dag rgya mtshatshab sa sum zhun mar rkang mar re bal btsos la glan pa dang //gdong pa'i pags mdog padma ltar mdzes ldong ros tshos bcad ba bla yung skyer nga sbyar byugs shing / mgo yi then pa skra lo skyed par byed ba lang rwa rus pa mig pa sru pags thalatil par sbyar ba byug go/ rma phyir zas spyod 'phrod dang mi 'phrod pa// rma gsar dus na khrag 'chor skrangs pa'i phyir/ chu dang tsam pa bkug ste sgyung bar bya//gnad med rma dron chang dang mar gyis dbab/ de yis zug chung rang 'byor byed pa yin/ rma rnams tsha ba skye ling zungs dma' na gsar bcud zas kyis lus zungs gso ba bsngags// zho yis tshan pa gcog cing kha zas len//'on kyang nan ltar rnag bungs che na gnod// rnga bran sha gsar sha 'u skye na yang // pho ba ngan zhing 'byang na de yang gnod// mar gyis rma red rtsa kha sdom na shis// chang ni khrag dang chu ser rnag skyed de/ rma bzha' chu rgyus rengs 'khums 'dul na bsngags// chu nyid tsha ba gcog cing dang ga 'byed//skrangs thor gdon dang pho ba ngan la dug / nya phag sha yis rma kun bshig par byed// mde 'u dam dang rma 'bras 'dul la btang // ri bong bya sha rma 'byer rus 'dzer 'gogs// sha rnying mar rnying nang grol sgo nga rjen rma rnams kun la gnod de spang bar bshad// rma yi skrangs dang tsha ba chogs pa dang // rnag sha thon sogs red 'byongs zas bcud sprug / bye brag bshus pa ma yan ga byangakhog ga yin yang pags pa bshus pa lam sa bdug tshal dom mkhris gur gur gdab pags pa sbyar te lha srab dang na chus sbyar/ de steng skya sbyor nga deb btang la bcing/ yang na pags pa sbyar telhal srab dang spyin chus sbyar/ de ste skya sbyor phying de ba btang la bcing/ yang na pa gas pa'i steng dumar dkar nga bsil ba'i sman byugs la gying pa btang ras kyis bcing pas sbyar zhing bshags pa sha gang yang gyen bur du bshags na phar tshur gnyis su skya ra gying pa sbyar te stod smad

༄tshol na nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 445du lu byas la bsdams gye la rig dab khar sbang rdo glan/ rlig pa ral na btsems la dpa labacing dugs lums spang sha nyil na dar da kyis brtsams nga deb btang / zhing byang gis bsdam// bcad pa'i rma shag yang zed du bcad na stod mad du gyi pa sbyar ga na bcos lugs bshags pa ba'i na dang rnam par bcad pa nus pa la zug par chad na hol ge spyin sbyar gyis ma bu btang de'i steng du skya spyor gying deb btang la bcings te 'thun// 'phyang ba bcad rus pa chod nas kham tsam lus pa de bcad nas kha dpugazhugacing lhung na khan pu gzhug la skya spyor dang nga deb btang de'i steng du shing byang ji drug btang 'breng pas ba ma bsnol mtshams su gu bsnol bas bcus la mar du ba de nas kha zhun dang tshul ba na bya rtsa da rnams sa mnan no/ drug pa bcing 'o rma bskol ba 'bras thug skam sa'i sha khu na ga na chag pa'aching bdang 'dra zhing phug pa'i chu ser drang tshod pa su pa dang byang khog phug pa gnyis rang rang gile'ur gsal/ yan lag sha ldam che sar bur du phug sa na/ mar shel ta'i ring bu gzhug rgyab nas lcag bya mi phugan tshur la gyi pas bcus la rma bcar la gdab/ mdor na migating du chu rami 'khyim par bya'o rnag phugs sa na dza ti pu 'i mar sbyar/ dza ti pu snam pa pa rto la yung skyerabaḥhong len tshil spangs btsod shing mang raka ra ma ru'i na mar bza'abyug rma nang thug khachung sa ting ring sug bcas rnag 'dzag sel lo7gis gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rma spyi'i gso thabs bstan pa'i le'u ste brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// / /

446le'u gru gsum pa/ mgo bo'i rma gso ba/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig po'i ye shes lags// yan lag dang po mgo la mtshon phog na// de la rtags dang bcos thabs ci ltar bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa dang / drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / yan lag lnga la gces pa mgo bo yin// de la gnas lugs phog sa brtag pa'i thabs//bcos pa'i thabs dang log gnon lnga yis bstan// dang po mi rigs mgo dbyibs bstan pa dang // sha dus glad pa rtsa yi gnas lugs bstan// mi rigs rlung mkhris bad kun ldan 'dus bdun// mgo dbyibs spyi ring ltag 'bur sogs ka dang // gru bzhi zlum po 'phred nyal spyi leb bo// de dag glad pa dus pa rim bzhin ngan/ de bzhin rnam pa gzer rtsa mang bar bshad//glad pa rgya mtsho'i gnas lugs bstan pa ni// sha glad mar glad bung tshang glad pa dang // phrum glad zho glad 'o glan chu glad bdun// mi rigs mgo yi dbyibs dang glad pa sbyar// de dag rim pas gong ma bzang bar 'dod// rgya dar smug la gdang pa gla nyel tsam// rtsa yi dra bar gtums nas gnas pa yin// 'on kyang mgo ril mig nag mtshul pa nyeg / snabs lud nyung zhing g.yang chu rma la bzang // mtshon phog dus na 'gyel bub za zi med// mi skyug mi lkug 'chal med bzang rtags yin// de bzlog zho dang 'o ma chu glad 'byung // glad khyim dus pa'i gnas lugs bstan pa ni// pho rus mo nus ma ning rus pa gsum//

zhu nang ga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 447de la sgang dang rtsibs dang mtha' ru 'gyur// pho rus gdung mthug lha ba chung la mkhregs// mo rus lha gdung snyoms shing srab la mnyen// ma ning rus pa lha ba che la gsob// ltag pa smin dkyil sor bzhi zhur po sgang // rus pa mthug mkhregs skyon la lha ba che/ de yi g.yas g.yon sor bzhi dus pa'i rtsibs gong bas srab la lha gdung snyoms pa yin// de yi mtha' ma rna ltag lhag ma rnams// lha ba chung zhi ji srab la skyon par bshad// g.yogs pa sha yi gnas lugs bstan pa ni// spyi gtsug sha ni bzhag sgor 'khyil 'dra gnyan// ltag pa'i sha ni nya ldang gzhibs 'dra gnyan// 'tshogs ma'i sha ni gzhu shul btang 'dra gnyan// mur gong sha ni lug mkhal brtsegs 'dra gnyan// de las gzhan pa mi gnyan 'dag g.yogs 'dra// 'brel ba rtsa yi gnas lugs bstan pa ni/ glad pa'i rtsa dang rus rtsa sha rtsa gsum// glad pa'i rtsa la 'tsho byed dar rtsa dang // phyi nang gzhan 'brel chu rtsa gnyis su bshad// dang po gnyan gyi re thag rnam pa bzhi// phyi nang rgyug pa tshangs pa'i skud pa'o// re thag bzhi ni rna ba'i phyi nang na// rtse nag gnyid log gnyis las gyes pa yi// dar steng shing lo'i 'dab ltar 'brel bar gnas// phyi nang rgyug pa ltag rus 'bur po nas//mkhur tshos byung ste slar log glad pa blangs// 'dus so gsum 'brel srubs la phyi nang brtsem sa// tshangs pa'i skud pa sha dus glad pa yi// rtsa gsum 'dus te spyi bo'i gtsug na gnas// gzhan dang 'brel ba'i chu rtsa phyi nang gnyis nang rtsa dar gyi dpyang thag bcu gsum ste// rje zhabs las byung ske yi nang nas rgyu//don lnga snod drug bsam ser 'brel ba yin// phyi rtsa ltag pa'i chu rtsa sbya gu can//ltag zur sgru 'khyil chu rtsa 'ja' byed gnyis// rna shal 'og shong ratna gnyis te drug / rkang lag rus tshigs chu rgyus 'brel ba yin// za 'gram steng na so rtsa ldan byed gnyis// rkan gyi dkyil na 'dom rtsa sum mdo ris// nyi shu rtsa gnyis chu rtsa'i gnad du bstan// rus rtsa mdung tshugs 'phred nyal 'khyam po gsum//
