448 zhu/grwa thang da bzhi/mdung tshugs gzer rtsa gtsug dang 'tshogs ma'i sgo// ltag pa'i sdud sgo g.yas g.yon gnyis te gsum// smin dkyil gnyis dang mkhur tshos sgo lngar 'byung //de las gzhan pa ma nges gar yang srid// rus pa ngan zhing gling dang rtsa phur mang phred nyal rna ltag steng nas sor bzhi na// bon po'i thod ces bya ba'i lha rtsa yod// 'khyam po bzha' khug khyi nyal byi sder gsum// 'dir gnas nges med lha ba'i gseb na gnas// rus pa bdar tshe bya ras sod pa gces// sha yi rtsa la nges dang ma nges gnyis// nges pa ltag zur ltag rtsa nag po gnyis// rna ba'i phyi rgyab mtshon gang phyi ljon gnyis// rna ba'i nang ngos nang ljon rnam pa gnyis// mur gong zur na ltag ral 'khyug rtsa gnyis// dpral ba'i dkyil na gser mdung dngul mdung gnyis// mtshul ba'i 'gram na mtshul rtsa nag po gnyis// mur gong thong na mthong byed mig rtsa gnyis/ mur 'gram steng na so rtsa 'phar ba gnyis// gtsug gi phyogs bzhir re thag rnam pa bzhi// de ltar nyi shu nges par bshad pa yin// don lnga snod drug dbang po sgo ba'i 'i rtsa// gnas la nges med brtags la ngos bzung gces/ gnyis pa phog sa bzang ngan 'bring po gsum// ngan pa sdud sgo bzhir phog 'chi ba'i gnas// chag tshabs che rung chung rung ngan pa yin// phred nyal srubs steng mig por mkhur tshos dang // za 'gram steng rnams phog sa 'bring du bshad// sha rtsa'i steng du chag tshabs chung na ngan// sha dang rus pa glad pa rtsa yi rigs// phyi bas nang ma nang ma gnyan pa yin// phog sa bzang ba dpral ba rwa ldebs gnyis// chag tshab che chung med par bzang ba yin// 'dir ma smos rnams phog sa 'bring du bshad// brtag pa'i thabs la mtshon rma phyi yul gsum// zug ju'i mtshon la mda' rdo gri dang gsum// mda' la wa lung bshol bskos gtam zug gsum//gri la bzhigs dang rdzogs dang bcad pa'o// rdo la gas pa chag pa 'thams pa gsum// gas la sbom phra ring thung rnam pa bzhi / chag pa steng chag 'og chag

༄ khan nga g.yon tan gyi da 449bcas nas chag / bcas par chag la zhom drum sdib rdol bzhi// 'thems la chen po chung ngu 'bring po gsum// de dag la yang rno phog rtul phog dang // nye phog ring phog shugs can shugs med dang // phar phog tshur phog ljid can ljid med dang brtag / tshur phog nye dang shugs che ljid can dang / rtul phog rus dang phrad par ma gyur kyang // de la phal cher nyes skyon 'byung ba mang /reg myang rma la brtag pa yod med gnyis// rma med pa la 'grams dang chag pa gnyis// 'grams la steng srubs zhig na gom pa 'khyal// mig 'dzum mi shes skyug cing mgo 'khor zi// bar gyi rgya ber de steng rtsa chu tsha// mig dmar sna khrag 'dzag cing dang ga 'gag / 'og gi mtsho 'khyoms dran med lkugs sam 'chal// rma med rus pa chag na reg pas sbyang / sgang shong mi snyom sa mnan na bzod pa chung // gsum ba'i 'das nas sha rus bye zhing mer// rma can brtag pa sha gdan chod ma chod// sha gnan ma chod ras tshangs bcug la brtag /gsum dang lnga yi bar du mdog mi 'gyur// dmar mkhrang reg na brtse ba skyon med de// skya srug sngo nag dul na chag rtags yin// sha gdan chod nas mig lam ma thogs na// khab mgo btang bas gas drugs 'then du 'ong / rus pa rtsi dang bral nas tsub na skyon// srubs kyi steng du khred khyed khral khral 'ong //lha ba 'thems sam mgo chag tshabs che na// thug thug byas pas gog skad 'ong ba yin// mig la thogs na gas chag dngos su gsal// lha ba 'thems na lha khrag tsim tsim 'dzim// gsum dang lnga nas thig le khye ma can// dmar sngo nag gro ser skya skug po dang // sngo nag skams na lha ba 'thems pa yin// 'og chag 'a nye'am be snabs lta bur dkar// tha ma dung gi mdog tu 'gyur bar bshad//sen mo'i mdog ltar sprug gdang nus skyon med// gal te the tshom za na sman gyis brtag khab len bul rtog ra bug chu khye 'bung nu zho byugs pas skyon yod na nag por 'groskyon med na rmi dog mi 'gyur ba'o/ kha sha bzha' dang sbos dang nya sgang dang / phyir

450 )gyi/grwa nga da bzhi/lhogs gsob dang skam dul chag pa'i rtags// nang re bzhin du rma kha mtheb kor bya// sha rus bye zhing mnan shul 'ong ba dang // gas sna chag sna bzod pa chung ba yin// sha rtsa ma thul ba la nges med pas// a sa nying nan spod lums glad zhun bya// bye sbos na zug bri na skyon mi 'byung // rtsa chu phyi yul sgo nas brtag pa ni/ rtsa rgyud drims mgyogs drag dang yang na ba 'a'// chu dmar ku ya rlangs che snyi'am sdom/ skra ni 'greng dang mtshams bye nyal ba dang // kor ler tshor med smin ma 'dzings pa dang // mig mi theg cing che chung yod pa dang // mig sprin khrag shig 'ong zhing 'dzums mi shes// sna khrag 'dzag dang sna skams sna gong rdul// lce skams ser la thos kyis dogs ltar smra// zas la 'jab zhing yang na tab hab jam// 'grangs dang bkres dus na zhing zos rjes skyug / gnyid 'thib ngur 'khun gnyid sad tshe na na// 'gro na 'dar zhing 'gyel bub 'khyom dang 'jab/ sran ma mi choms phrum ser khyer ba dang //g.yal 'dar bya smyung byed cing sbrid pa mang // mgo lci dang sa mi bde glo rdol byed// de rnams mgo skyon yod par shes par bya// bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi bcos brngan pa byin la brid pa dang // mkhar la 'obs kyis bskor ba'i bcos tshul dang // grong khyer me yis gzhom pa'i tshul bcos gsum// dang po brngan pa byin la brid pa ni// mtshon phog skra ba 'ar gar po rjen phye zho// spod sna mar nag btsos pa'i a sa sa bdug / lca 'brum g.yer ma go stod tshwa dang phabs/ chang 'gag sbang ma drod phab 'jibs su btang // khrag ngan chu ser 'jib cing rlung byer 'dul// zhu mkhan gla sgang spang spos mar nag bskol// tshan dos sbos 'khyug rtsa 'brum byung steng bdug /byer che glad pa mar chang tsha btab btsos// zhun gyis bdugs pas sha rtsa rems pa 'dul// dang po'i rma rgod zhun mar chang bis dbab// 'ag gsum lon nas rma la 'phul 'dren bya// khong nas 'phul ba sman dang kha zas gnyis//

sa khanang g.yon tan gyi da/ 451rlung can ma yin zhag gsum bsil du bston/ de nas gsar bcud rnam gsum rim pas btang // tha ma mi ldog gdengs thob sha chang sprug / de yis sha 'phel zungs gso sman bcud skyed// khong sman sbal rgyab gangs thigs gser rdo dang // gur gum mi dom mkhris pa a bi ṣa// a byag chu rtsa bu ram sbyar ba btang // shin tu skyon che rdo yi rgyal po bzhi/ khab len 'brug rus gser gyi bye ma dang // 'bri ta sa 'dzin re ral mi dom mkhris// gur gum a byag byang sems dkar dmar rnams// bu ram sbyar ba chang gis 'phul la btang // rma yi 'dren la rdo rtsi sngo dang gsum// rdo sbyor rgyal po sde bzhi ze tsha dang // gur gum dom mkhris ka ra'i phye ma gdab/ yang na rdo yi mang sbyor chen mo sbyar/yang na sbal rgyal gangs thigs cu gang dang / gur gum dom mkhris ka ra sbyar la gdab/ rdo sman kun la 'ju rtsi dar sman gces// rtsi spyor tshi ba phye ma khaṇḍa gsum// nags ma'i thang chus lha dus btson du 'dzin/ bye ma ga bur cu gang gur gum dang // dom mkhris hong len mtshal dkar ka ra sbyar// skyon che a byag tsher sngon dar ya kun// gong la bsnan te dgu sbyor rma la gdab// khaṇḍa ri dang klung gi rta pags pa re skon dar ya kun rnams dus btus la// sa med chu chod sna ma tshig par bcad// de gsum sprugs la rma la gdab par bya// yang na rgya tsha pad me ldong ros mtshal/ tsha la ser mtshur bul tog sprang sbyar btang //yang na ga bur cu gang rgya tsha dang // dom mkhris ka ra sbyar ba gdab par bya sngo sbyor tsher sngon rta pags a bi ṣa// re skon chu rtsa dom mkhris ka ra sbyar//gsum 'dus sbyor ba sbal rgyab mtshal dkar dang // ga bur gur gum dom mkhris shel ta dang // rta pags stab seng ka ra sbyar la btang // chu ser 'grongs chung man ngag sman rgya tsha byang ba thang rgod gsum bsnan/ kun la sbang ma 'jam po'i 'jib chas gces/ yang na dngul chu zangs thal mu tig dang //sbal rgyab dom mkhris tsha la a bi ṣa/ rgya tsha byang ba brag spos rma khong bsten/

452 sa /grwa thang da ba rtsa 'thud khrag gcod gas sbyor zhom pa srong // kha zhun sbang kogs mar dkar zho btsags shes// de ltar 'phul 'dren rim par bsten pa yis// dang ga bde zhing zug med khams snying seng // rma yi mdog legs rnag dkar 'jam par bzhed/ kha sha shi smyos skams sam sha dus bye// rnag sla tsha ba skye zhing dang ga 'gag / shes pa lci zhing mgo lus tshugs mi thub// gting skyon g.yos pa dras kyis rtsad nas dbyung // skyon thag chod nas rma la 'tsho sman cu gang gur gumamatshal dkar ma mkhris thing mngar chu rtsa brag spos tsha lag dab// rma skams sha 'u mi chags gsher rtsi bdu ra'i skang rma ra dang spang ma gdab// rma rlon sha 'u mi chags skam rtsi chu dang re ba la snum ldan gdab// sha spyos pags pa mi rgyu gcod sman dom mkhris karagadab// rma bzha' sha mi skye la rma sobs sha btang // de dag zlum chos rgyal po'i bcos tshul yin// gnyis pa grong khyer me yis gzhom pa ni// phog dus gnyis par chu ser mi 'du zhing // bdun 'das kha yan me yis thub par dka'// de phyir gsum dang lnga par bsreg pa bsngags// gdab thabs gas pa sdom pa gas stengs su// 'thems pa gseng dang bros pa 'gugs pa gnyis//lha khrag sprad la de steng gdab par bya// chag pa sbyor ba rma khar gsum tshoms gdab// gdab tshad chu ser rim pa gsum thon bya// rma med chag na de yi steng du gdab/ kun la zhag bdun bar du me lan re// de yis chu ser sdom 'dren skems par byed// glad pa 'dzag dang dar rtsa chod pa la// gser gyi tel bas snar tsam bsreg par gsungs// sha rtsa pags la rus rtsa par gyis bsreg / sha byer 'dus so gsum dang re thag bzhi// ltag ral ltag rtsa phyi nang ljon shing mnan// rtsa byer rtsa 'brum gang byung steng du bsreg / byer che 'dus so gsum dang chu mgo gnyis// an stong rna ba'i mdun rgyab rna shal 'og / spu 'khyil gnyis te bsreg dmigs bcu gsum mnan// nang rtsa byer na drug pa 'khor lo gsum// sngon bu dkar nag mtshams su gser gyis bsreg / gzhan yang sna

༄ khan ngag yon tan gyi da/ 453khrag ma chod smin dbrag bsreg / skyigs bu 'byams na kos ko spyi gtsug bsreg / mig lug de ngos rting pa'i 'dzum du bsreg / gzhung rengs ltag dgye rtsa nag ltag chu bsreg / lus sbrid za zi mang na lte ba bsreg / sgrog cing dang ga 'gag na bcu gnyis bsreg / dran nyams rkang bshal rtsa dkar nang ltar bsreg / sha ro rus ro dkar por song bar bsreg / de dag me bcos blon po'i bcos tshul yin// dra 'chos mkhar la 'obs kyis bskor ba ni/ dra dus gsar skyon gsum dang lnga la dra/ rnyings skyon nam log skyon gyi dus dang sbyar// dra thabs rma de steng bston sngas mthor bcug / skyon dang 'tshams pa'i dres khor bal gyis dril// bar med sor mos je drag mnan par bya//mdog log mkhrang dang sbrid par gyur pa yis/ dra ba sla zhing zug chung khrag mi 'chor// de dus dras btsags srab mkhreng rno ba yis chag skyon chung zhing gnad la nye ba la/ nya ral bong mchu bzhi shor gar 'os dra/ tshabs che mgo skyon nyid kyis srog 'dor phyir/ sha cher dras kyang de la nyes med pas// rta gab bskor te sha gdan chas par dra// khrag shor spra ba'am sru rtsa'i bral brul brdzang // dar thog rnag shor 'gyangs pa'i long med pas/ de yi nyin par gseng bug ci thon bya/ gsar skyon sha gsar glad pa rmar bcug cing // nang par bsal la rus skyon gang 'dug brtag / rtsa dang rus skyon ma gsal the tshom na// sman rgya tsha bul tog tshwa tshag po'i sbyar nas dar cig bzhag pas mdog mi 'gyuradus sa dog 'gyur/ khrag yin na rlangs pa'ong dang bzo yis rus skyon rtsa khrag de bar bzhag nas byas pas ma 'gyur na rtsa yin 'gyur na skyon yin pas so sor dbye// bshang khar mi bdar skyibs su bcad la brud/ lha bar sleb nas lha khrag chir gyis 'byung /rnag sla ser sngo rlangs che gcod sdom byed/ gang byung skyon yin brud cing rtsa ba bcang / bdar na med la bzhag na yod pa dang / phyogs re lha khrag med la phyogs re yod// lha mig ma tshang rus pa khye ma can/ ma bdar bzhag na lha ba

454 sto/grwa nga da ba /skam byer 'gro// gsob cing mang sla nag dang rlangs pa che// bzhag na bya wang rgyab 'dra gsher byer 'gro// de phyir bal yis phyis shing bltas la brud// rus pa nyung rlon bzhin du rlan mi 'bral// lha khrag dmar gdang zhag bcas snyoms par 'bab// skyon med gson dang phrad pas brud phro bcad// chu ser dar thog lhung dang chag skyon che// de dag 'og gdung sbrang gshog tsam du bdar//srubs zhig chings dang nan gyis bsdam pa gces// glad tshas rus bzang sprang 'dab khyab par bzhag / rus tshas sha bzang kha sha'i 'og tu sba// sha chos rnag bzang mi phyi chi re bzhag / rnag chos rlan bzang rma chas rlan ldan g.yog /gas sna ri thang mtshams dang rnag chu'i steng // seng bug byi'u nas zan mig tsam dbug / glad nyul btang zhing rnag khrag chu ser dbyung // de nas seng bug gro ga'i 'jibs tshangs gzhug / lha ro zho dang sbyar bas lha mig dgang //yang na rkang mgo mar sbyar lha mig dgang // sbang ma zho dang sbyar bas rma nang dgang // sbang ma phabs dang ldan pas kha sha g.yogs// phyi de nang par lha skyon thun bur btu// de dus lha bas sna bskyal phyir mi ldog / skyon thag ma chod bar du tshi ba gdab// rma chas sbang ma zho btsags kho na btang // bzo rdzogs rus pa'i skyon thag chod pa dang // tshi ba phye ma khaṇḍa gsum 'phrugs gdab// yang na ga bur cu gang gur gum mtshal// mi dom mkhris pa 'dam bu ka ra gdab//yang na re skon ru rta bsil gsum dang // dom mkhris mtshal dkar ka ra sbyar la gdab// zlum chos skabs kyi rma sman gang yang bzang // rma chas tshil bu mar dkar sbyar ba'am// chu rtsa rjen phye zho mar kur sbyar btang // sbang gar glad pa phabs su sbyar ba la// spang spos ga dur glas bran rma chas sbyar// dro dus grang mo grang dus bsros la btang // bzo byas zhag gsum bzhi nas glad pa yi//ldebs bzang mthil gyi rus pa skya la sprug / lha ba'i gdang snum kha rnag dkar la 'jam// kha sha mtho mkhrang dmar la snyoms pa dang // lus yang zas zhim

ro༅blonang g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 455zug med legs rtags yin// sha 'u rnam gsum zam thogs ldog mi srid//sbang gar mar nag bag phye sbyar bas g.yog / rma kha zum na re ral mar btsos brdzang / sha mdzer bye 'khyims byung na thur mas bsreg / skabs su dom mkhris ka ra'i chu yis bkru// sha 'drogs snying tsha glad zhun bag re btang / de rnams dra bcos dmangs kyi bcos tshul yin// bye brag bcos thabs sha rus glad rtsa ba'i/ sha la bshus bshags bcad brdungs rdzogs pa lnga// pags pa bshus na tsha la dul ma dang / dom mkhris btab pa sbyar te hol srab bcing //skya sbyor phying ded steng du 'chings mas bsdams// bshags pa phan tshun bcad pa'i yan man du// phying ba sbyar zhing sman gdab srad bus bsgrog / zho btsags sbang gar sbyar ba'i kha zhun bya// brdungs tshabs chung ba tshan dos thub pa yin// che na thur mas btsags la a sa sa bdug / de rjes phying ba snum ldan glan la bsro skabs su mkhris pa 'o ma sbyar la byugs// rdzogs la sbang 'jibs bya zhing rul gcod gdab// chu ser tshan langs me gdab rtsa phrang bsdam// rma yi rul gcod sha 'u gso sman gdab// rma kha khengs na re bal snum btsos btang // rus pa'i bcos thabs rma can rma med gnyis// rma med nus chag skra ba 'ar mar tshil byug / tshan dos bdug cing re bal snam ldan dkri//yang na skya sbyor deb btang rgya chings bya// khong du stab seng thang dang rdo sbyor bsten// chu ser 'dus na mes bskam btol mi rung // go log chag na sha dra rus bzo bya// rgya srubs shig na rgya chings bsdam pa gces// srubs steng me gdab khong du rdo sman bsten// rma can gas ring dbus su lha ngo sprad// gas sna'i steng du me btsas bsdam par bya// gas chung rnams la steng gdung blangs pas thub// sbos na 'og dung gtugs la gseng bug gtod// gsum gas ba'i gas gas kyi tshoms su bdar// steng chag steng gdung blangs la lha khrag sprad// 'og chag grum pa rgya bskyed mtha' nas sbyang / mtha' yi chag srubs

456 sa /grwa thang dba'i/rnams su gseng bug gtod// mthil rus dar 'brel btsan thon mi bya 'grams// sman gyis rus ro rang gogs byas la gdon sdeb pa gong ma sna btud 'og ma bdar// zhom pa mtha' dbus cha mnyam srab tu bdar// sgong rdol mtha' yi khad mnyam rus tshab gzhug / sha 'u chags nas 'phar gnon 'bros 'dred gces// zam thogs 'phar gnon phyungs la rma gseb btang //'thems pa lha ba steng blang gson dang sprad// lha ba 'thems tshabs che na 'og la gtug / sha med rus pa ther po lha khrag sprad// gzhogs dang wa lung lha khrag sprad pas thubaka bshol brkos 'grams sbyar bcad pa gas dang 'dra// de bzhin rdzogs pa grum pa lta bur bcos// gtam zug mtha' ma'i rus pa nas gang bzhag / de phyi 'obs su brus la gseng bug gtod// rus mdzer mde 'ur bcas pa ga le dbyung // glad pa'i 'tsho thabs mtsho 'khyoms thi btsan dang // dar ral phug dang rdzogs nas lug pa lnga// mtsho 'khyoms rgya 'chings bsdams la rdo sbyor bsten// glad pa sman sga bu ram sbyar la btang // sgo gsum mes mnan rjes la sman mar sbyar/ nus mdzer spri tsan gur gum chig tshugs gdab// khrag dbal chags na rgya tsha'i phye mas bzhu// sngo 'am rnag sha rul na stodas sla nga du rta dom mkhris drus ma tshal ngas g.ya'adza ti sug la phabs ru ra'i gcod sman gdab// dul gcod dar ya kun nam gur gum mam// ga bur cu gang gur gum dom mkhris gdab// glad spyi mer mer sbos na chu ser btsag / dar 'og glad pa'i steng du rnag zhugs na// gser gyi btsags bus phyungs na sdom sman mutig mi dom mkhris gi wang gur gum 'o ma 'dzin 'om bu'i bar zhun bur ma nu zho dar la gas la glanagadab// dar ral de bzhin yang na ga bur dang // dom mkhris bcad 'byor nu zho byugs la brdzang dar la sman byugs nas dgab/ steng du 'a nyes mnan/ de'i nga du chu rdos mthobar mnan/ tha mar rgo btsags btang/ de steng gying ba mar btsos btang la dam du dkritayang na sbal rgyab bdud rtsi dkar smug gnyis// re ral 'bri rkang me long thal

mi na ngag yon tan gyi khyud/ 457ba drug / glad pa 'dzag pa gcod cing rgya yis 'debs yang na bya yi ze khrag mu tig dang / byang sems dkar dmar bong bu ga ma yi// 'o ma me long g.ya' dang sbyar la byug / phug nas mde'u med na glad ngan sdugs// glad bzang rang sar 'khrigs nas chu mi 'byung // 'bring la dngas snyigs bye nas glad chu 'byung / de la mtshon lam ring thung rgyus mdes brtag / tshad dang ldan pa zha nye'i them bu rtse modang phyogs ba ra bug pa rgya khab migatsa phug la sor gcig phyi la zhug ge yong ba byas la btsugs/ dngas snyigs 'byed cing rgya yis 'debs pa'i smanasbal bgangs thigs bee snabs gru ba 'bri nga dom mkhris wang gur gum khur zho brag spos mi rtog zeng ba nye shing bu ram sbyar ba khong du btang rma la nga btsugs la zan dron gyis bskor/ 'bri mar sbru snyigs byungs pa dang sman sbyar ba gas la)la pas bskol/ nang du dro bsnyam byed na 'dzobacad/ na nub gnyis bsnad kyin bya rma ru bskol zhing khong du bsten par bya// de 'og 'dzag gcod sman gyis khyi gu mig ma bye ba re 'u mas ma ldags pa co ga zer po rnams byi glad pa la 'byongs par dkrugs la dngas ma grib skams byas pa dang sprul ba khab len rdo mkhris sa bur cu gang 'bri rkang dzā ti me rtos phreng ba brag spros dom ma khris la khris chen mar la bskol ba des rma ru bskol// tsheg sgra med na rgya yis thebs pa yin// mde yod gnyi ba ring na skam pas bsro// lcags g.ya'i drod kyis glad pa sdom par byed// mtha' mar gseng gtod nang du 'dren sman gdab// dus la bab nas mde'u phyungs shul du// mtshon dang mthun pa zha nye'i them bu la/ glo skar kha snyer ldan byas dug phyungs te// rtsi byugs gson gshin mtshams su sleb par bskyal// them bu rus pa'i bar du gro gas bsdam// them sngas them thag them tshangs ldan par bya//ga bur mu tig dom mkhris bcad 'byor dang // ka ra nu zho sbyar ba them bur blug / them steng dar dgab rma chas dzi khab g.yog / rnag nyung sha 'u skye drag nang du gzer// na ma re 'ing them bu nyams sbyar btung // lci la tsha ba skye zhing dang ga 'gag / chu ser phugs su las pas them bu bsring // glad mdzer skyes

458 sto/grwa nga rgyud bzhi/na gcod sman them bur 'bud// yang na 'khar ba'i thur mas bsreg par bya//them bu mi 'dod rnag chu sla dus dbyung // glad pa sha 'us khengs nas ma bde na// gting rnag lus pas bsregs la rnag chu gdon// rdzogs nas lug pa dar ral bcos dang gcig / kun la khong sman stang zil 'brug nus dang |sbal rgyab lig bu mig dang phag mgo rnams// chu 'thags byas te bu ram sbyar la btang // a byag shel ta spyi zhur re skon dang // ha 'u pa pa skug chung rtsi bzhin btags// sbrang sbyar btang zhing chags spyod drag shul dang // rul skyur sngo ngad 'jig zas spang bar bya// kha zhun mkhris sna sgong mar sbyar la btang // sha 'u mi 'chags g.yu mchong byu ru'i mdog / spyi mer che chung 'bring po bsil du bcos// sngon dmar gru gsum 'dra na rtsa rgyas gtar// khrag dang chu ser glad dum je mang 'dzag / blab 'chol smra zhing dbang po log par 'dzin// tsha ba skye zhing skom snyeg dang ga 'gag / rtsa shed shor na mi thub 'chi ba yin// 'dzag pa chod nas dmar ni sbya ge byas// chu rtsa khu ba 'dra ba'i glad chu 'ong // khams bde zug chung dang ga bde na 'tsho// pos nas then chags mi ldog brtan par byad ra ya gan dang tshil bu byugs 'byu sna'i lums bya 'bras bu'i man mar sbyar rtsa bcos pa la sha rus glad pa gsum// sha rtsa chod na rtsa rgyud gong 'og bsreg /thar nu sgong thog spru rtsa zho sbyar ba mang // sbru rtsa zho dang sbyar bas rma chas bya//'khyug 'phreng rtsa 'brum steng du tshan dos bdug / gtar dang me btsa' gang dgos rig pas dpyad// rus rtsa mdung tshugs chod na til dkar po// gla rtsi dom mkhris zho this rtsa mgor bsku// rgyu ring bkab la zangs tel 'od bsregs bdug / yang na da trig rgyan 'brum sbang bskus bsreg / phred nyal 'khyams po 'bri rkang bdun gsum dang // mon cha ra dang dom mkhris sgog skya sbyar//kun la dom mkhris li shi dar ya kun// khrag gnyis mtshal dkar ril bu rma la glan// leb rgal mar du btsos pas steng nas mnan// yang na ga bur cu gang

khanang g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 459gur gum dang // gi wang 'bri rkang dom mkhris 'gron thal dang // spru rtsa ram pa'i se 'u du ba gnyis// sngo khrag chod dang nu zho sbrang sbyar glan// me tog chags na rtsa kha zin pa yin// dbugs sdem skad drag dri ma 'tshir ba spang smonang shor bzung ba sbal rgyab re ral dang // brag spos sbang rtsi sbyar ba tel pas bsro// yang na rgya tsha byang pa dom mkhris glan// rtsa mnyen bya la dkar gsum zho smris sbyar// rtsa mgor bskus la rgyu ring steng du bsro// glad rtsa chen po chod na bcos su med// rtsa phran ga bur gur gum mi dom mkhris// bu ram sbyar ba glan stengs tel pas bsreg / rgya rtsa 'grams na gtar la bsreg par dang // sna nas spya 7byang ba kum bu re ral ga srin mtshal nur nyi dga' spab ling dri chu sbyar bas sbyang zhing sna khrag dbyung bar bya// phyi nang chu rtsa bcad brdungs rtsa dkar ltos// rdo ba'i mkhris bzhi rtsi bzhi sngo sna bzhi rdo'i rgyal po sde ba'i mi do bya rgod nya ga bur cu gang guragum tsan dan dmar po/ dar ya ken sa sha 'dam bu rkar spang do bo ril bu lde gu zho sbyar khong du btang // rtsa nad kun la bdud rtsi lta bu yin// rtsi gsum sngo gsum gur sumado ma mkhris 'bu/ gnyan ba rti mig spyi zhur khong nas sdom pa'i mchog / zug che blab chol smra la khrag mi chod/ yang na sna bug har gyis skams na 'chi// khrag chod rtsa zin me tog chags na 'tsho// ba'i pa bcos rjes log gnon bstan pa ni// gdon dang dpyad lhag zos spyod log pa yis// sha la ba 'a' khros byer ba gsum du 'gyur// rus la skam byer gsher byer gnyis su 'gyur/ rtsa la byer dang khrid pa gnyis su 'gyur// glad skyon bzha' sbos spyo lkugs bzhi ru 'gyur//ldog rtags dang po rlung gis sna 'dren pas// g.yal 'dar smyung sbrid grang shum byed pa dang // mgo lus lci zhing rngul mang dang ga 'gag / skom snyeg tshig pa za na ldog pa'i rtags// sha bzhe' rma skam mdog skya kha sha shi / a sa sa bdug cing khong nas zas skom brdeg / sbang ma shul tshil smod sna chang btsos glan//sha spyo ser smug rma kha mtho bar 'ong / khrag dbyung ga bur chus bkru ka ra

460 sa /grwa thang da bzhi/gdab// rma khong gnyis ka bsil gyis bcos par bya/ byer la skyi byer ba dang sha byer gnyis/ skyi byer sha pags bye zhing chu ser 'dzag / bul tog chus bkrus me med du ba gsum// chu rtsa mar dkar zho this sbyar bas byug / sha byer dang po rma yi tho skor skrangs/ de rjes srubs sna rtsa mkhrang skungs 'gyur te// tha mar mgo kun spangs 'gyur sha rus 'bye// ma bcos nang du thim nas byer khrid 'byung // de la thur mas btsags la a sa sa bdug / glad sna tshwa sbyar spod bsros zhun du gzhug / yang na rtsab bzhi yi lca ba 'ab po pa tang kun rtsab phabs dri chu sbyar la bsros pa'i lums kyis bdug / rtsa phreng mes bsdam skya sbyor spu deb btang / srubs steng phying pas mnan la 'chings kyis bsdam// nus pa skam byer spa bcad lta bu dang // mes tshig brag ltar byer ba rnam pa gnyis// bad rlung grang bas byer na spa bcad 'dra// lha khrag sprad la sman gyis cugang gur gum lishisa'i ze khrig mi dom mkhris pa dza ti 'o ma 'dzin pa sbyar btab pas lha ba bzung // khong du rta pags gnyis btang lug gi nga mgo rgyan 'byam bur ma mar ba nga / yang na dus pa nga btsos na zho ba bas rdo khris dom mkhris rer la khur zho cu gang pang gi gu byugs pas rus khugs bya// sha gsar chang gsar lha ba'i me drod skyed// mes tshig brag ltar byer na tsha ba yin// ga bur rgyal blon bzhi ga bur cu gang gur gum hong len ka ra/ yangan tsan dan sprug po hong len snur ba ra zhi sbyar la byug dang tsan dan sprug po rdo rgyus cugang dza ti gur gum du rta mkhris na nu zho sbyar ba byug go/ bdun// rma la btab la bsil ba'i chas su gzhug / ga bur rgyal blon gsum pa khong du btang / rtse chung gtar zhing zas skom bsil du bya// ma khugs khrag bkug rus pa bcad phugs brud//skam bros 'gugs pa'i sman brgyad cu gang gur gu li shi dom ma khris gdur 'o pa 'dzin kyi4bya'i ze khrag bu ram la ga blangs la lha steng ga dbaka rkang mgo dpyi sor bdus gsum mar tshil bsres la kha sha g.yog / ga mo lo nyi ga lon pa'u ga g.yag gi gson khrag gsum bur rnying sbyar ba lha sobs btang // gsher bros ba gan kha chu lta bu dang //

༄ gu na ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 461zhing thag langs pa lta bur byer ba gnyis// sha 'u skye drag gtses na khrag nag 'ong // cung zhig bzhag na bya wang rgyab ltar 'gyur// ba yi kha chu 'dra la rus sbal snying // dom pa la dang rtsangs pa'i glad pa gdab// phyi nas go snyod lcam 'bumasbang nye ma ra nag gi dugs bya khong du sdud sman ga ra mdog na le sha bu ram chang sbyarabatang // des ma thub na rma la 'dren rtsi rgya tsha gcod khrig gdab// sbrang chang btang zhing mgo la sman ru rta brag spos ba spa ling par na gyis byug / des ma khugs na brud la sbal khrag yang na rgya tsha ru rta shud ga dgyi mong gdab/ tshil nan spod nan bya gdabakathag langs khong du chos btang a sa sa bdug / gson dang sprad la dgu sbyor khaṇḍa sa bzung // yang na gnyis kur lha ba gson dang sprad/ gsher bros 'gugs pa'i sman rgya tsha kha ru tsha gur gum do mkhris 'o ma 'dzin pang bu ram bdun lha steng gdab// tshal nan spod nan bya zhing bye steng bsreg / 'greng bu 'dom rtsa gtar zhing yin la gtad// khra bor byer na rma nang sdud sman rus pa jul tsigatsig byed gyis na chu ra mi rnyed/ de la rer cu gang 'o pa bu'i rtog mngar gsum 'bri mar 5snyigasabyungs pa dang sbyar la bskol// rdo dgu rtsi gsum sngo lnga chig thub gnyis sprul rgyab gnyis ba'i cog la ma rdo da snabs bye mgo/ cu gang gur gu gisang / re ral brag spos 'bri ta sa 'dzin kyi rtse lug mig bu ram sbyar// khong du btang bas lha ba'i byer kun 'gugs// lha bros lhas mi slob na de rgyu gsum// legs par brtags la so so'i skyon dang dbral yang na dar thog tu rnag zhugs pas 'don/ yang na lha rtsa shor bas mar gyis bsreg yang nan dus skyon rgya cher yod pas shun dbye lha mig rnag gis gang na sngo la sob// ji tsam brud kyang lha khrag skams nas med// shed chung grang 'dar dang ga 'gags na 'chi// bros khugs rlan rnyed sha 'u skyes pa dang // kha sha dmar 'drub nad zo bde na 'tsho// gal te rus pa 'khrun ma chod gyur na// sha rus bar nas sha'u lce thabs skye// kha sha dre 'u nya sgang 'byung ba yin// sha dral dus mdzer phyungs la chags sman mngal khrag rgya drus dom mkhris gsum gdab// bzo lhag lus na skyung bus

462 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/chod par brud// rtsa skyon byer la sha nus glad rtsa gsum// sha rtsa byer na ske 'jing 'gyur ba dka'// 'khyug cing spangs la zug che gzer ba yin// rtsa steng mes mnan lums sna gsum me tos sna rtsags bdud rtsi lnga 'bya sna lnga gyis bdug /rus rtsa byer na lha ba bros pa yin// de la sman dang mar sbyar tel pas bskol//glad rtsa byer na chu ser dar thog lhung // rma dang sna sgo chu lam chu ser rgya tsha nutshamatsha gsum byang ba nya phyis dom ma khris sum nad ma tsher na mtha kṣa gsum sbyar la drang ka ma thub rus mthongs phye la rnag chu 'don// 'thor na gso dka' gcig tu 'khyil na 'tsho / dar btsags rnag phyungs rjes la gso sman gdab// dar stong chu ser lhung ba'i rtags ldan zhing // rma med ga 'an du rgyun du thig ler na//dogs sar skra bzhar chu lcag rgyab pa yis// rlangs dang drod che ma nan na gang na sar// sha dra rus bdar rgyus mdes rnag chu btsal// log non byed dus snying khams ma chung bar// lha ba byer ba gson gzhin sprod pa dang // glad rus mtshams nas rnag chu ci thon gyis// rtsa khrid pa la phyi khrid nang khrid gnyis// phyi khrid bshul sha khrid cing mjug rdo spangs// yan lag shal sbrid tshor ba chung ba dang // lus spyir tsha ba skyes na lums su gzhug / phyi nang rtsa sbyang ga bur nyer lnga btang // nang rtsar khrid na stod lci tsha ba skye// lus lci phrum ser khyer la dbugs mi bde// glo chung sor na nyi shu rtsa lnga la// mu tig nya skyogs mi dom mkhris pa bsnan// 'bras bu gsum gyi khu bas 'phul la btang // bsregs dmigs bcu gsum me yis mnan par bya// bye brag snying la babs na dzā ti lngasnying 'dar yan lag spru kha mig slo bskugs na ga bur du tsan nan a byag skyar sbyar la btangaglo la babs na cu gang lnga pa stod gzer dbugs thung rnga pa che na wang utpal rgyan 'brum srol dkar kar sbyar// mchin par babs na gur gum bzhi pa lus dang zhes pa bying miga'adzum da 'a na 'bri nga kaṇḍa ga rig ser gyi me rtog ka ra sbyar// mcher bar babs na li shi lnga pam chu 'phyang lus da la brkyang bskum mi shes na da lis ru rta li ga dur hong len ci//

kho〉khanang g.yo na tan gyi rgyud/ 463mkhal mar babs na 'bras bu'i sman mar dpyi ga glasgang zug tshang ra mi theg mang pa la dri chu sdam dgye dgu me shes na/ su sa la da lis zhi tsha sdig srin dom mkhris gser gye nga dngasbyar/ me gtar phye ma rig pas spyi dang sbyor// glad pa bzha' na shing kun khan tsha gsum pa btang // sha chang bdeg cing a sa ba yis bdug / sbos na tsha sbos rgyal blon khong du btang // hong len bsnan la rmar gdab zha nyes bsnan//rtse chung gtar 'ing rma chas zas bsil bsten// grang sbos bzha' 'dra srin bal mar btsos mnan// rnag sbos phug la nyul btang glad khrus byadang ga bde gnyidabro lus snyong 'dod mig srin dmar glo mang sbrang 'dab skya 'i skam pan seng bug du tshang bas rnag dar thos 'khyims pa yin kya 'u mdzer bas su skye bas rgya tsha phur mo'i lo mdan da ru rta gdab 'gagacig lto bkug la glad nyul btang des mthon na rgya tsha dom mkhris gur gum chang sbyar lhang sug tu ga/zangs spyag ce'u kha ba gyis btang des rnag chu khrid nas 'ong / gtong sa ma rnyed na 'dzag bdesar seng bug gtod la dbyung / glad mdzer chu mdzer mi bcad thur mar bsreg / smyo na gtsug mthil drug bdun snying ga bsreg / zho sha ga bur dza ti ag ru gur sum rgyatshasgo nga dang bdun sbyar kha zas bcud kyis gso// lkugs la glad lkugs rus lhags rtsa lkugs gsum// glad skugs ga bur cu gang gur gum dang / tsan dan mu tig nya skyogs dom mkhris dang // ka ra sbyar btang ltag rtsa gtar la bsreg /sna nas khrag dbyung lce 'og rtsa la gtar// chu chags byas te gan rkyal nyal ba la//yan lag bzhi nas 'then la rkang mthil brdung / des ma phyed na sna sbyongs rtsa sbyongs bstang / rus lkugs bzo bya rtsa lkugs rtsa dkar bcos// zhes ba du da// rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mgo bo'i rma gso ba'i le'u ste brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa'o// / /

464le'u gya bzhi pa/ ske'i rma gso ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// yan lag byang khog mgo la ma gtogs pa'i// ske yi rma la bcos thabs ci ltar bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa dang // drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / ske ni yar gyi mgo la mi gtogs te// mar la byang khog ston smad la 'di mi gtogs// yan lag rnam pa bzhi la'ang gtogs ma yin// ske ni rus pa'i mkhar la rtsa yi phrang //sha dang chu rgyus kun gyi 'dril sa yin// rus gnyan lha ba 'byer bas mgo dang 'dra// rtsa gnyan rtsa thigs gsog pas byang khog 'dra// sha dang chu rgyus gnyan pas yan lag 'dra// de phyir gsum 'gyur ske yi bcos thabs bstan// ske la rus pa'i 'phang long rnam pa lnga// ltag pa mkhar dang mkhar mtshams bya 'dabs bzhi// ltag pa mkhar mtshams rgyungs pa'i gnad yin te// rgyungs pa zin na ltag pa dgye bor 'gro// mgo lci kha lce skam la dri chu sdom// mig 'grib stod gzer sgyid 'khril yan lag phra// gso ba'i thabs med bdun dgu'i dus na 'chi// mkhar dang bya 'dabs rtsar zin gso dka' ste/ rgya tsha byang pa ru rta'i reng bu gzhug / rnag zhugs rus pa brud la lha khrag sprad// phying pa bag mdag sbyar bas kha sha ltem// mar tshil sgo nga sbyar ba'i kha zhun bya// hong len gla sgang seng ldeng grungs thang ngam// yang na btab seng shing mngar bsdus thang btang // ske yi rtsa la phyi rtsa nang rtsa gnyis// phyi yi rtsa la khrag rtsa chu rtsa gnyis//

khanang g.yon tan gyi da/ 465rlung khrag gnyis 'dom 'phar rtsa dag dang gsum// 'phar rtsa yol gong mid pa'i bar na yar// glo bu snying rtsa gser gyi skud pa yod// de chod rtsid bu so snying zin pa 'dra// zhag grangs bcu gcig tshun chad nang du 'chi// ol gong pa yi g.yas g.yon 'dabs na yar/ snying rtsa gnyid log rtse 'dra rnam gnyis yod// rtsa de rbad kyis chod na a cang che/ bsdabs kyang phog sngar 'gyel sngar 'grob yin// de nas phyir la phun re bcal ba na/ snying rtsa rtse nag rnam pa gnyis yod de// rtsa de chod par ma gyur bcos glag yod/ de nas phyir la phun re bcal ba na/ glo snying sdongs pa'i khrag rtsa rtse chung yod// de chod khrag mi chod de bor nas 'chi de dag btsan brdungs 'thems chod gso ba'i thabs//mod du gong 'og me rgyas gdab par bya// khrag ma thub na rma la rgya khyim bca'//mi dang glang dang khyi nag nya tsa mo// dom mkhris ka ra dkar po sbyar la btang ⑪rlung che nam zla grang dus sbang gar dang // zhun mar spod nan bag phye bong srus mnan// rma bug khol bton mkhris sna zho sbyar btang // tsha ba rgyas dang drod dus bskol zho dang // bag phye shing mngar sbyar ba gong bzhin no// ltag pa chu ba'i g.yas g.yon gnyis na mar// chu rtsa sbu gu can zhes bya ba yod// de'i phyir tshon gang chu rtsa sgril ma yod// de gnyis chod na g.yas g.yon sne snol byed//gnya' rengs smad 'phyes dri chu 'gags nas 'chi// sna shal 'og na chu rtsa ratna yod// de chod lag pa shal sbrid bya ba nyams// de dag bcos thabs gong 'og me rgyas gdab// rma la a sa snum nan tshan dos bdug / rma mched gla ril btsos pa'i lums su gzhug / gnya' rengs lag pa 'a na bdud rtsi'i lums dri chu 'gags na chu sman ni rus drang // nang co bcu gsum chod na dri chu sdom//yan lag bcud la bor snyam log par 'dzin// kha kha lce skam gdong snum mig sprin ser// mgo 'khor zas skyug mkhas kyang bcos su med// mdun gyi rgyangs sha las byed chod pa na/ a sa 'ol skom mar tshil drod phab mnan//

466 ༄7/grwa nga da ba'i/—hrom na a sa ba dang tshos lums bya// hrem med skrangs na gong gi chas dang 'dra//ol gong min pa sked du chad na 'chi// bshags na mkhris pa btab la rgyus pas brtsem// skyi dkar spyin chu bag mdag phying pa ltem// zas skom bsil la 'jam pa'i nur thug btang // yong gong rlung tho spangs na dkar nag mtshams// sngon bu spyi gtsug gser gyis bsreg par bya// ltag pa'i chu leb chod na a cang che// bshags kyang phog snga 'gyel sngar 'gro ba yin// lus po thag pas gcud la bor ba 'dra// mkhris sna rdo rgyus shu dag a nu'i thal// khur zho khye 'thung nu zho'i lde gu yis// chu ba'i nya g.yog skyi dkar spyin chus ltem//rma yi 'jib rtsir phrum sar btang par bya// nyal 'dres mi bya tsog bee bsdad la gso// mdor na dus pa mgo yi tshul du bcos// rtsa gnyan byang khog tshul du bcos par bya/ sha dang chu rgyus yan lag tshul du bcos// bsil 'jib drags na dri chu sdom par byed// drod lums drags na rtsa kha 'bu bar byed// me btsa' drags na chu rgyus 'khums pas na// de phyir gsum 'dzom bsil drod snyoms par bcos// tshes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las ske'i rma gso ba'i le'u ste brgyad cu rtsa ba'i pa'o// //

467le'u gya lnga pa/ byang khog stod smad gso ba/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// byang khog stod smad gnyis la mtshon phog na// de la rtags dang bcos thabs ci ltar bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa dang / drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / 'gro ba mi lus byang khog stod smad la// gnas lugs rtags dang gso thabs rjes bcad bzhi// dang po byang khog gnas lugs rnam drug ste// brten pa dus pa'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang // g.yog pa sha pags gnas lugs bstan pa dang // gnyan pa don snod gnas lugs bstan pa dang // sa bcad yul gyi gnas lugs bstan pa dang // 'brel ba rtsa yi gnas lugs bstan pa dang //rgya skar gseng gi gnas lugs bstan pa'o// dang po brten pa rus pa'i gnas lugs ni// sgal tshigs brang rus rtsib ma lha ru tse// sgrog rus dpyi dang sogs pa gzhug chung brgyad// tshigs la mkhar dang mkhar mtshams bya 'dabs gsum// de dag lus kyi gzhi rten gur phub 'dra// de la g.yogs pa sha yi gnas lugs ni// sgal 'dabs bshul sha nag po phyi nang gnyis// brang gi nu sha sta zur rta sha gnyis// mchan khung ba 'ag sha dkar nag rnam pa gnyis//thal gong gnya' sha gnya' 'khor gdar sha dang / sogs mthil 'bros sha de ltar sha rigs brgyad// 'byer zhing spangs pa'i gnad dus bstan pa ni

468 zhu/grwa nga rgyud ba'i/gnyan pa don lnga snod drug gnas lugs ni// snying ni rgyal po tshe srog sems kyi rten// bu lnga rgyal sras ma lnga blon gyi tshul// glo ma'i phang du snying ni bu thogs 'dra// mchin dri dkar po dar dkar yol ba 'dra// mchin pa brag g.yang gzar 'dra gyen du bslang // mcher pa mtha' mthug dkyil srab mkhur ba 'dra// mkhal ma g.yas g.yon spyad pa gdung 'degs 'dra// pho ba zas snod la phug sul bzhi 'dra// mkhris pa mchin 'dabs gser rkyal bkal ba 'dra/long ga gsum khyog gser sbrul lcag brabs 'dra// rgyu ma ston smad yur ba chus bkang 'dra// gnye ma long 'brel g.yang bzhag bskor ba 'dra// tshil shubs dkar nag lcags sbrul dkyus pa 'dra// lhang phug kha ni thur bltas chu rkyal 'dra// bsam se rtsa yi mdud pa sha then 'dra/ de dag gnyan pas 'chi ba'i gnad du bstan// bgo skal sa bcad yul gyi gnas lugs ni/ byang khog stod smad mchin dris dbye ba ste/ nyen rus 'brel mtshams tshigs pa bcu gsum par chu babs thig gdab mchin dri nag po'i yul/ tshigs pa brgyad nas rtsib ring gyen tshon gang / yol gyis bcad pa mchin dri dkar po'i yul// mchin dri khug pa brgyad dang bcu gsum bar// rtsib steng dkar nag mtshams te khra bor 'dod// stod smad don snod yul skal thig gis btsal// khad snyam stan la lus bsrang skyil dkrungs 'dug / mdun rgyab dpung 'dzum gnyis su gnam thig gdab// yan stong gzhug chung ske stong mtshan ma'i steng // mdun rgyab gnyis su ma 'drus gzhung thig gdab// stod na glo ba ma bu snying dang gsum// glo ma rgyab la snying dang bu rnams mdun/tshigs pa bzhi nas gyen bsegs chag gang sa// brgyad nas thur bsegs mdzub gang bcal ba'i sar// gru bzhir thig gdab de yi grwa bzhir bcad//dbus ma sum cha sum gnyis de dbus bcal// stag mgo sgang rtsibs bsham dang zags sna lnga// glo ba ma lnga'i yul du 'don pa yin// nu ma gnyis nas ske

zhu nang g.yon tan gyi da/ 469stong sor bzhi'i 'og / gru gsum thig gdab dbus na rgyal po snying / mdzo sna dang ni bya sgrub thugs khab dang // rte mig dgra lce bu lnga snying la bskor// glo bu snying gi yul du 'dod pa yin// nu ma gnyis nas phyir la sor gnyis bcal/denas ske stong ca ra khung du gdab/ glo ba ma yi mtha' chag gnas pa yin/yul thig de yi steng 'og stong par gnas/ nu ma brang dkyil thig tshad nyen sna nas// pho ba'i zur then de nas lte bar gdab// dpangs su sor brgyad zheng sor bcu gnyis te// zas snod pho ba'i yul du bshad pa yin/ nyen rus tshigs pa brgyad nas g.yas ngos su tshon gang dre mos gar sleb mchin pa'i yul// rtsib thung g.yon nas pho zur mdzub bcal ba'i/ zheng du sor lnga mcher pa'i yul du 'dod// pho gsang dbus nas g.yas su sor bdun na/dkyus su sor drug zheng gsum mkhris pa'i yul// lte ba'i gong 'og tshon re dkyus tshon brgyad/ long gi yul yin khrag long g.yas na gnas// srin long g.yon la tsam long dbus na gnas// de 'og tshon do rgyu stod rgyu smad yul/ de 'og ldang pa mdun la gnye ma rgyab// tshigs pa bcu bzhi'i g.yas g.yon sor bdun dang // dpangs su sor lnga mkhal ma'i yul skal yin/ bsam se tshigs pa bcu gsum 'og na gnas/ de ltar yul gyi thob skal so sor bstan//'brel ba rtsa yi gnas lugs phyi nang gnyis// nang rtsa srog rtsa dkar nag sdong po ste// sgal pa'i nang gzhung thang shing bslang ba 'dra/ de las yal ga'i rtsa phran kun tu gyes// tshigs pa gsum nas rtsa gsum mdun du byung // dbus kyi rtsa las snying ni 'bras bu'i tshul// sul gsum nang na rtsa lnga rlung rtsa dbus/rlung khrag 'dres pa'i rtsa bzhi phyogs bzhir gnas/ g.yas g.yon rtsa ni glo bu gnyis la zug / glo yi nang rtsa sog phon pags g.yogs 'dra// sob pas 'jug bla mang bas nad gdon dka'// srog rtsa'i yal ga rnam gnyis lag par rgyu// rtse nag gnyid log rtsa gnyis mgo la gyes/ bcu gsum pa nas rtsa gnyis

470 zhu/grwa nga dba'i/mchin par zug / mchin pa'i lung chen mchin dri nag por 'brel// de bzhin mcher pa mkhal ma bsam ser 'brel// bcu bzhi pa nas srog rtsa gnyis su gyes// sne sar don nas rkang pa gnyis la rgyu// de las gyes pa'i don snod nang rtsa rnams// 'bral 'brel mang bas thag pa 'dzings pa 'dra// phyi rtsa byang khog stod la snying rtsa drug / brang rus g.yas g.yon nu mdun tshon do na// snying rtsa phra khab thong gar khab btsugs 'dra// sgrog rus dkyil nas thur du tshon gang na// snying rtsa dngul gyi 'bu ru gzer btab 'dra// nu ma'i steng 'og tshon re bu rtsa yod// glo ba ma bu'i phyi rtsa nyi shu bzhi// glo ma rtsibs las byung ba'i tshigs 'grams gnyis// tshigs pa'i g.yas g.yon tshon re phun re na// kun tu rgyu ste bzhi pa'i thad kur gnyan// de la bzhir gyes gnyis ni brang du 'drims// gnyis ni ltag chu'i 'dabs nas mgo la 'gro// rtsa de mchin dri yan chad glo ba dbang // man chad mkhal ma'i rtsa yin bcu ba'i pa'i// thad kur mkhal ma'i rtsa nag ces su grags// de nas ba'i ra gyes gnyis ni dpyi steng don// brla sgang sne sa brgyud nas lhang par 'brel// rtsa gnyis mjug thung brla yi phyi sul rgyu// glo ma rtsibs las byung ba'i tshigs 'gram gnyis//tshigs pa ba'i pa'i g.yas g.yo na tshon rer gnas// glo ma sgang las byung ba'i nang rgyug gnyis// tshigs pa drug pa'i sor lnga'i sa na gnas// glo ma stag mgo las byung grog rked gnyis/ tshigs pa brgyad pa'i sor bdun sa na gnas//glo ma zags sna las byung sge dor gnyis// tshigs pa bcu pa'i chag gang sa na gnas// gle ma bsham las byung ba'i 'greng bu gnyis// nu ma'i thad drang sgrog rus 'og tu 'gro// glo bu thugs khab las byung phyir rgyu gnyis// nu mchan tshon re'i sa nas sgrog char 'gro// glo bu mdzo sna las byung bsnol ma gnyis// phyir rgyug rtsa nas sgrog char g.yas g.yon bsnol// glo bu bya sgab las byung gzer mgo gnyis / mchan 'og phyi nang gyen thur chag gang sar// glo bu dgra lce las

zhum na nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud 471byung zangs ma gnyis// mchan khung 'og nas rtsib rings steng du 'gro// glo bu rte mig las byung sngon bu gnyis / sogs pa me long dkyil gyi 'og na gnas//ma bu sgrog pa lung 'dzin khug pa gnyis// dpung tshigs chag gang u zur kha la bkal// tshang tshing las byung glo rtsa dung 'bud gnyis// dpung pa'i nang ngos chag gang sa na gnas// mchin rtsa sha ru mon ru rnam pa gnyis// nyen sna las byung nu mdun tshon do'i sar// yar la chag gang sa nas gnyis su gyes/ rtsa gnyis dpung pa rtsa gnyis rna rgyab rgyu// mcher rtsa bya rkang rta sha'i gseb na gnas// mkhris rtsa chu mig glo yi tshang tshing gseb// gser gyi ka ba dpung sogs bar na gnas// pho rtsa sbrul mig ka ba bong med gsum// sbrul mig nyen sna'i g.yas g.yon tshon re'i sar// ka ba pho dkyil g.yas g.yon sor gsum na// bong med lte pa'i gyen tshon gang na gnas// long rtsa lte zur g.yas g.yon tshon re na// rgyu rtsa de'i mjug sne khud gnyis na 'drims// rgyu long nang rtsa 'khyog mtshams rgyu tshil 'brel// bsam se'i rtsa ni dbyi nas sne sar rgyu// lhang pa'i chu rtsa srog rtsa srid rtsa gsum// mtshan dbrag bar gyi dbus dang g.yas g.yo na gnas// de ltar bshad pa'i rtsa rnams chad gyur na// phal cher 'chi zhing btsan gdungs thigs su 'gyur// rgya skar lta bu'i gsang sa bstan pa ni gsang la rang gsang mda' gsang phog gsang dang // dbye ba'i gsang dang rnam pa bzhi ru 'dod// rang gsang kha ni glo sbubs pho stod gsang // 'phongs ni rgyu long lhang mkhal rang gsang yin// mda' gsang stong gsang phyal mo gcur 'byin thub// mchin dri khug pa khra bos mdzub re thub// sgal 'dabs g.yas g.yon nu tshon gang gi 'og / rtse sor bzhi bzhi song yang don mi slobakustod du gang yang sor gsum don mi sleb// smad du gang yang sor gnyis snod mi sleb// gzhan yang lus kyi sdod lugs phog lugs kyis// gsang med sar yang gcur 'byin thub pa yod// gsang du phog kyang don snod sleb pa yod//

472 lja/grwa nga dab /phog gsang dbye gsang rnams su mtshon phog pas// mtshon phyir khrag thon gsang dbye mi dgos pa'o// dbye gsang stod la brang gi snying gsang drug / glo ma'i rgyab gsang ba'i dang bu gsang gnyis// ma bu gnyis rgyug zur gsang rnam pa drug / gsang sa bco brgyad rgya skar 'byed pa 'dra// de la brang gi snying gsang drug po ni/ dkar nag mtshams nas gyen du tshon gang bcal/ de nas g.yas g.yon gnyis su tshen re dang // phun re bcal ba dpal khab gsang sa yin// de steng tshon gang bcal ba thugs khab gsang // de steng tshon gang bcal ba bya rog mig / rgyab kyi glo ba'i ma gsang rnam ba'i ni// tshigs pa bzhi pa'i g.yas g.yon sor bzhi'i sa// glo ba drungs khud rnag gi 'bab sa yin// tshigs pa brgyad nas dgu pa'i thad ka ru// mdzub gang bcal ba sogs ya sor gnyis 'og / rgyab gsang ring mo glo yul rnag 'bab sa// bu gsang nu ma gnyis nas mchan khung ngos/ sor bzhi de nas thur du sor bzhi bcal// nu ma chag gang bu yi zur gsang yin// ma bu gnyis rgyug bcu gnyis bcu gsum mtshams// chag gang 'khyid gang mdzub gang bcal ba'i sa ba ma bcu gcig bcu gnyis bcu gsum bar// them kha dang po bar pa tha ma gsum// glo ba ma bu gnyis ma'i rnag 'bab sa smad kyi dbye gsang tshigs pa bcu bzhi nas// g.yas g.yon sor drug mkhal ma'i rnag 'bab gsang // lte ba sne dkyil dbyi zur mtshan ma'i steng // thig btab rgya gram lto ba'i spyi gsang yin// a long kha nas nang du sor bzhi na// gzhang gsang zhes bya nang gi rnag 'bab sa'o// 'on kyang stod smad dbye gsang ma yin ga 'an// rnag gi 'bab sa ma nges gar babs dbye// gnyis pa ngos 'dzin rtags la rnam pa bdun//dang po phog sa yul pa brtag pa dang / gnyis pa mtshon gyi bgrod lam btag pa dang / gsum pa nang du rdol dang ma rdol brtag / bzhi pa khrag ngan babs dang ma babs brtag / lnga pa don snod zin dang ma zin brtag / drug pa 'tsho

zhu nang g.yon tan gyi da/ 473'am 'chi ba'i la shan dbye// bdun pa mdor bsdus kha dmar gdags par bya// dang po phog sa yul la brtag pa ni/ mkhar dang mkhar mtshams gzhug rus gnyan pa ste/ rgyungs par ma slob mde 'u ma las 'tsho/ rgyungs zin ltag pa dgye la gyid pa 'khril/ smad 'phyes dri chu sdom na bdun na 'chi brang rus gnyan te lha byer 'bras su 'gro// bya 'dabs lha ru tshe dang dpyi sogs 'bring //sgrog rus rtsib ma nyen chung zug gzer che/ phyi bshul bcad na skrangs shing dgur por 'gro// bzhag sha dkar nag gsog la gzer zhing 'byer/ de dag rab gnyan sha gnad phyi ma 'bring / nang rtsa kun dang glo bur snying rtsa gnyan// glo ma mkhal rtsa 'bring ste rtsa gzhan tha/ snying dang glo bu mchin mkhal rgyu ma'i yul// phog sa'i sar ngan glo ma mcher pa dang / pho long sgang pa'i yul rnams 'bring po yin/ don snod yul min gsang stong phog sa bzang ⑪gnyan dang mi gnyan yul la bzang ngan shes/ de phyir dang po phog sa brtag par bya// gnyis pa mtshon gyi bgrod lam brtag pa ni/ phog pa'i sa la nges med gar phog kyang // gnad la rnyeg dang gnad med 'tshebs pa yod/ de phyir mtshon gyi bgrod lugs shes pa gces// sha bshags dus phug rtsa chod don snod zin// rim pas nyen che bzhi sbrags phug pa 'chi/ glo ba ma la steng 'og drang thad rma// rim pas 'tsho 'chi rkyen la rag las 'gyur// glo stod mtshon lam ring na nang rtsa rnyeg / mod la khrag gis 'byor na 'tsho ba yin// rtsa kha shor na lus kun bus ltar spangs// khrag gis byang khog khengs nas 'chi bar 'gyur// de phyir rtsa kha 'bud pa'i zas spyod gzab mtshon lam thung na rtsa kha mi zin zhing // chu ser ljid mi ltung bas mkhas na 'tsho// glo smad mtshon lam thung yang chu ser gsog / mtshon lam ring yang rtsa la zin pa nyung / de phyir don thigs gsog pas gso dka' sbyong she gsum pa nang brtol ma brtol brtag pa ni// nang brtol smrar bcug skad kyi mjug chad cing / 'gro ba'i

474 gyi grwa zang da bzhi/stangs zhan khong zhi dbugs mi bde// glo sor langs pas gang rgyab phyogs su 'khyog / kha zas mi 'dod zug che skra mtshams rngul// de dgu tshang na nang du brtol ba yin// gsang stong phog dang don snod ma zin zhing // khrag ma thor na mda' lam ring gyur yang // zug chung dbugs bde mdangs gsal 'gros ma nyams// tshad pa ma skyes zas zhim skad gdangs drag / de ni brtol ba'i ma brtol ba zhes bya// rtsa gnyan chod na ngoms nag gdong pa snum// lus lci skom dad che la dang ga 'gag / nyin mo gnyid dang zug che glo mang sor// rtsa thigs gsog pas ma brtol brtol dang 'dra// sha gnyan rus mnyan bcad brdungs zug gzer che// ma brtol ba yang brtol bar gol sa yod// sbo sgrog dri chu sri dang ldang dub byed// byang khog sman kyi nang brtol spyi rtags yin// ba'i pa khrag ngan babs pa'i rtags bstan pa// glang thabs na zhing khug ma nyen 'og gzer// tsog pur mi zug sngas la nyal mi shes// lus 'dar sku 'dab rngul zhing so dreg chags// grangs na zug che dros na bde bar tshor// zhag tu lon nas lce mchu rnyil bkrag 'chor// rtsa drims chu dmar stod dgu shed nyams bri//de rtags ldan na khrag ngan bab par nges// lnga pa don snod zin pa'i rtags bstan pa// don zin phog dus shes pa zi zhing 'tshub// gang zin tshigs gsang kha bye mnan na na// dbugs thung dgye dgu mi shes pang chos dgos//mod la rtsa chu'i tsha ba 'ur gyis skye// de dag don la zin pa'i spyi rtags yin//khyad par snying la mtshon phog bton dus 'chi// snying tshil brgyal 'bog dngang 'dar bzhin mdangs nyams// chu gtor khus gdab bsku byug 'o dron btig / de rjes grungs nas dran gsal gso glags yod// snying rtsa btsan pe 'dar dngang chung 'byung // rtsa thigs shor na snying la rnag chu gsog /srog rtsa chad phug rgyab pa'i mod la 'chi// btsan brdungs zug gzer che zhing 'dre log byed// lag pas sa 'brad tshabs chung 'tsho ba srid// glo phug glo lu mi

zhu na ngag yon tan gyi da 475shes za zi smra/ dbugs ni nyi mas tshig pa'i khyi dang 'dra// rma nas dbugs 'byung khrag sbru can du skyug / stag mgo zin na zhag bdun lo dus 'chi glo sgang bdun dgu rtsibs la dgu bcu gcig / glo bsham bcu bdun bcu dgu'i dus na 'chi// glo bu gang la phog kyang mod la 'chi// 'gor yang zhag gsum dag las ring mi sdod// glo rtsa chod na lud pa btsan dmar lu// rtsa steng khrid cing gzer la tsha ba skye// gdong snum dbugs mi bde la grang shum byed// rtsa thigs shor na glo la rnag chu gsog / khyad par tshigs 'grams stod du 'jing pa rengs// smad du mkhal rked na zhing rkang pa 'phyes// khug pa ldang dub sngon bu skyigs bus 'debs// gzer mgo skad mdzer mgo rma dung 'bud skrangs/rnol ma nyal dka' char bu sog dbrag gzer// mchin dri dkar po bcad na skad mi phyin// dbugs bsdam 'bur tshugs lta zhing yan lag g.yob// zug che sgrigs pa mang la zas zos na// tshabs chung mkhas pas mod du gsos na 'tsho// rtags tshang lnga la nad ldog bdun na 'chi// yol ba phug na stod khrag smad du 'chor// smad rlung stod du 'chor bas phral du 'chi// nag po mgo lci mig 'dzum khrag nag skyug / khus 'debs mig rtsa rgod la bar snang blta/'dug sar mi tshugs dgu yi dus na 'chi// smra 'dod zhe sa mkhas la 'gro 'dug byed// chang 'dod blud na yi gar mi yong ba// nag po btsan brdungs brtags de gso bar nus// mchin pa rtsi nyams gyur pas 'chi ba ste// tshabs che khrag tu 'khru skyug phog dus 'chi// bsdabs brdungs mig dmar mdog sngo 'khun bu 'byung // gdong snum mgul na rtsa rgyas ldang dub byed// tshabs chung gyur na mod dus gso glags yod// mchin rtsa btsan chod mgo dang dpung pa na// ngo gdong snum zhing mig sprin dmar por 'gro// mcher pa'i cha ga snying 'dar grang shum byed// khong sbo phyi sa 'gags te na na 'chi/ bsdabs brdungs mthil du phug na khong pa sbo// 'khru 'am rgyun 'gag g.yal sbrid mchu

476 lta thang dba'isnyil skya// gdong mig nag jig 'byung te mkhas pas 'tsho// mkhal ma gnyis la rtsi nyams gyur pas 'chi// mkhal thag chad na rkang pa sdud mi shes// khus 'debs lus dgrad zhag gcig lon nas 'chi// bsdabs brdungs mkhal tshil zin na lus po lci// rkang lag sdud dka' chu sri rna ba 'on// de ni mkhas pas 'tsho ba mang ba yin/ mkhal ma'i rtsa la song na rkang pa shal// dri chu sdom zhing rtsa rgyud khrid nas gzer// snod phug phyi rtags rtsib ma nang zug 'khru// pho ba phug pa mi sbo btsan thems sbo// ther phog 'tsho ste rjems la phog pa 'chi//de rtags glang thabs na la dri chu sdom// lus kyi stobs shor ci zos mi chags skyug / 'tsho snyam byed kyang bcu bzhi nyi shu gsum/ sum cu lnga la 'chi bdag lag tu 'gro/ mkhris pa phug na mkhris pa 'khru skyug 'chi// bsdabs brdungs mig chu sha mdangs ser por 'gro// mod dus ma bcos zhag lnga'i dus na 'chi/long stod lu gu mgor phog glang thabs na// khrag dul 'khru phyug dgu yi dus na 'chi// sring long srin bu 'khru skyug glang thabs 'byung // long ther sbo ldeng dri chu sri bar byed// de nyid mkhas pas gsos na phal cher 'tsho// rgyu ma phug na lus po 'dug mi tshugs// zug che mtshan ma nyed la tsha 'brab byed// rgyu ma bug pa du yod zhag re thub// ma phug lug pa bcos pas 'tsho ba yod brdungs sam bcad na kha kha tsha ba skye// rgyu ma gzer la 'khru zhing mig chu ser// gnye ma phug na srin bu gyen thur 'byung // has 'debs thal mo sdeb na gcig na 'chi//gzhang la phog na dri ma sdug gam sdom// nag po 'tsho dka' dkar po 'tsho bar 'gyur// sgang pa gnad phug dri chu sri'am sdugs// kha la song na 'chi ste ther la 'tsho// bsam ser song na lus sbrid gan rgyal 'gyel// 'dre ldog byed tshabs chung na 'tsho ba yod/ mcher pa rgyu long sgang pa bsam se sogs// rtsa rnams rang rang rtags dang khyad par med// drug pa 'tsho 'chi'i la shan dbye ba ni//rgyab pa'i mod nas dran pa nyams pa dang // brgyal 'bog dngang 'dar khrag

sa khanang g.yon tan gyi da/ 477tu 'khru skyug 'chi// mtshon phog gsum dang lnga yi bar dag tu/ cis kyang tsha ba mi chogs zug mi 'bri// ji ltar bcos kyang skyed med 'chi bar nges shed med tsha ba skye la dang ga 'gag / rtag tu 'khru skyug dri chu sri na 'chi/ mig mdangs nyams shing 'dzums dka' gyen du zlog / kha sna'i dbugs grang gdong la bag jul chags lus kyi stobs shor stan la 'byar ba na/ 'chi ba'i bya gtong gsum na 'chi bar nges/ don snod 'chi ltas 'chi dus gong du bstan// rtsa rgyud ma stongs zug gzer bar thag ring / sman dpyad bde skyed che na 'tsho ba yin// bdun pa mdor bsdus kha mar 'di ltar gdags/ nang du rdol yang khrag babs bungs chung na// nyen che bcos su yod par kha mar gdags// khrag babs che 'am don snod zin pa la/ 'chi ba'i bya gtong gsum gyis sleb ma sleb/ gsum dang lnga yi bar du shan mi phyed zhag lnga'i bar du bya gtong ma byung na// de la mkhas pas rtsal bzhi sprugs pas thub/ bya gtong sleb na 'chi bar kha mar gdags don snod ma zin khrag ngan ma babs na// nang rdol gyur kyang 'tsho bar kha mar gdags rtsa chen chod dam khrag babs che ba dang // gnyan pa don snod steng du mtshon lam ring / 'chi bdag bya gtong gsum la 'ong long med la chen 'da' bar kha mar gdags par bya// de bzhin phog sa gnyan dang mi gnyan dang / mtshon gyi bgrod lam zhag skeg 'chi rtags dang // bcos skyed sbyar la 'tsho 'chi'i kha dmar gdags// the tshom za na shan mi phyed par smra'o/ bcos pa'i thabs la rnam pa gsum yin te/ zug ju mtshon dang sbyar la bcos pa dang / phog sa gnas dang sbyar la bcos pa dang // ston smad yul dang sbyar la bcos pa'o/ zug rngu mtshon dang sbyar la bcos pa ni/ rdo dbyug brdungs dang g.yang lhung thibs 'og tshud// rma med byang khog stod smad phyi nang 'grams/ gzer zug che zhing dgye dgu dka' ba dang // rtsa chu tsha ba skyes na skug zil 'byung // de la thang

478 ༄/grwa nga da bzhi/gtar phye ma dugs la sogs// gang 'tshams bcos kyis 'tshams pa'i tsha rlangs bsad// sbyor ba 'grams bcos le'ur shes par gyis// gri 'am mdung gis bshags bcad phug pa'i rma// dang po a sa sbang ma'i chas su gzhug / de 'og hrem na zhun bya rnags na 'byar// byer na deb btang skyon sol rma rtsis gso// mda' yis phog la zug ju las ma las// zug rngu ma las rma khar a sa sa bdug / de yis khrag 'don rlung byer rma rems 'dul// sha gnad ma gtogs chas med kyi rmar bzhag / rma skams rtsa 'byor chu ser nang mi gsog /zug rngu las na sdod dam mi sdod bltas// sdod rtags zug chung ldang nyal bde na bzhag / mal bca' gos bkon stod la mnan thabs bya// sdod du mi 'dod dbyung bar bya ba ste// de la stor ba btsal dang dbyung ba gnyis// stor ba'i sa la phyi nang rnam gnyis te// phyi la sha sul rus bar mde stor na// de rtags yan lag dag dang khyad par med// nang du don snod so sor mde stor na// phyi rtags nang rtags gsang rtags gsum gyis btsal// phyi rtags snying srog bar du mde lus na// gzer ba mang zhing rgyab kyis nyal mi shes// bya thung byed 'dod kha bub bde bar tshor// glo ma'i sral na mde yod dbugs mi bde//sbrid pa mang la 'chag 'dod mchan 'og gzer// logs gnyis nyal ba mi shes tsog pur bde// ske rtsa 'greng zhing lag pa skyong bskum dka'// glo ba'i bu la mde yod lud pa dmar// rang gi lte ba mi mngon dgur na gzer// sngas smas nyal dka' dkar nag mtshams su na// srog rtsar mde stor skas la 'dzeg mi shes// mchin drir mde yod lus lci ngo snum 'khru// tsog pur sdad na mchin pa khengs snyam byed// kor ler langs na dpyang la btang snyam byed// mchin steng mde yod mchin pa glang thabs na// dgur 'gros pus brang 'cha' dang gcu mi shes// mcher la mde yod dbugs thung khong pa sbo// pho mchin bar na mde yod skom 'thungs na// lag pas mnye ba mi bzod glang thabs ldang // pho

sa khanang g.yon tan gyi da/ 479ba la yod mi sbo kha zas skyug / brang gi zhol la mde'u yod na sbo// mkhal mar mde yod chu sri glang thabs na// rkang pa 'khums nas yod ngos nyal mi shes//rgyu ma la yo da zas skom btang na na| mnye bar mi bzod them pa rgal mi shes//gom pa'i shugs chung dri chu sdom pa dang / zug gzer che zhing ldang dub byed na yod long la mde yod bslang na zos 'thungs bde// nang brtag bya mo nag mo'i sgong khrag mtshal// chang chu 'o ma byugs pas sprug ma 'tshub// mde'u nyal la rwa shing 'greng ba yin// sna rtse brang gzhung mtheb snying spra ba re// me phebs smra mi shes dang kor ler na// gsang rtags khyi dkar phag nag bya rog sha /srin bya'i sha dang chang sbyar lto stong btang // dogs sar lcags g.ya' sran tsam byung na yod// rus sbal phag rgod bya byi pho mo'i sha / chang sbyar tho rangs na ma lnga btang la// bzhi nas khab len ra thug chu sbyar byug / dar dkar shog bu bkab pas lcags g.ya' 'byung sgo ta zhig dung thal stag gi rtsib rus dang 0bya rog brun rnams chur sbyangs khong du btang / lcags g.ya' 'byung dang kor ler mgul na yong // 'don pa'i thabs la sman dang dpyad gnyis yin//gnad med lam thung ngos zin mde lag sprad// skam pas phyungs te yan lag lta bur bya// lam gnyan gting ring mde lag ma phrad pa// sman gyis dbyung ste bya ma byi yi sha / bya rog sha dang khab len sprug po dang // phag rgod mche ba nya sha chang sbyar btang // bya nag sha gsar til lto phyungs pa'i nang // so ba phul gang khram khrum brdungs pa dang // ldong ros bca' sga a ru btags pa blug /'tshos par btsos skams bsregs pa'i thal ba dang // nya sha sbyar btang phyir la 'byung bar nges// gi waṃ rtsangs pa'i sha dang da byid dang // rgya ru ka ra sbyar btang rma nas 'byin/ smon lcags rtse bdar lcags phye bye sgong gang / lcags 'byed rtsa sbyar chang bre phyed la bsdu// khaṇḍa byas te khong btang phyir 'byung byed phyi nas khab len sbrul tshil mi glad sbyar// reng bu rma ru bcug pas phyir la

480 sa grwa thang da bzhi/'dren// bya ma byi dang phag pa'i sha lhu re// chu bre gang la bum par btsos pa yi//rlangs pas rma khar bdugs pas phyir 'byin byed// phog sa gnas dang sbyar la bcos pa ni// sha gnad 'jibs lums zhun nan 'byar gyis bcos// rma gsar dang po a sa ba yis bdug / de nas sbang ma'i 'jibs su gzhug par bya// skrangs na bsil lums drod lums rig pas sbyor// skrangs dmar tsha ba che na gtar ba shis// tig ta hong len kyi lce par pa ta/ chu rtsa brag spos zho sbyar nan gyis mnan// grang skrangs sbang gar sga phabs pi pi ling // go stod g.yer ma lca 'bras mar tshil bskol// byugs la steng du hol ge'i 'jag gis dkris// sha gnad byer zhing skrangs pa gang la yang // glad pa nye 'u nas phye rkang mar dang // spod sna chang sbyar btsos pa'i zhun du gzhug / skrangs gsob mnan na gsog cing gzer ba la// zho dang sbang gar tshigs ma bag phye spyin//sgo nga dud pa sbyar byugs sgru deb btang // byer che phying deb bse khrab 'chings kyis bsdam// rus gnad 'jib rtsi sman brud me yis bcos// lha ba can rus rma kha che ba la// gur gum shel ta a byag dom mkhris sbyar/ reng bu rmar btang lug gi rkang mgo brdungs// zho dang sbyar ba'i 'jibs su gzhug par bya// de yis lha ba mi 'byer chu ser 'dren// rma kha chung na bsregs pas thub pa yin// sgrog rus rtsib dus chag pa bsregs pas thub// tshabs che skya spyor ching deb btang la bcing // rus pa'i rma rgan gser ram spra bas bsreg / lha ba 'byer na skyung bus bran pa dang / rma sman gdab sogs mgo bo ba'i na du bcos// gzhug rus mi bsreg bdud rtsi lnga yis bdug / yang na gla ril spa 'u bsros pas bdug / byin gzhug long rtsa gnyis la ci rigs gtar// rjes la rtsa stongs chu tshan bsngags pa yin// rked pa chag na skya sbyor phying deb btang //mi 'gul gan rkyal nyal la bsil bcud bston// a byag a ba gang rung srang gnyis la// cha bzhir bgos la cha gcig sbrang dang sbyar// cha gnyis ba mar cha

sa khan nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 481gsum 'o mar sbyar cha bzhi pa ni bu ram dkar po sbyin/ kun la na ma gsum gsum spel la btang / sked pa chag dang gshul sha chad pa dang / rma chen rnag khrag gsar rnying med par skem/ rtsa gnad me btsa' gtar ga sman gyis bcos dang po rtsa chad me yis mthud pa ni// rma kha che na rtsa rgyud gong 'og bsreg / chung na rma kha de nyid bsreg par bya// 'khyug 'phreng gang gzer a na tshugs su bsreg / nang rtsa rnams la spyi gtsug sdud sgo dang // rkang mthil mthe bong spu skyes srin lag snying // sogs dkyil drug bdun gser gyis bsreg par bya// mkhris sna gur gum mgyogs mes rtsa thigs bsdam// mkhan pa zhu mkhan rgya skyegs btsod khu bsdus// gur gum dom mkhris btab btang rtsa chad mthud// gur gum mtshal dkar dom mkhris li ga dur// gi waṃ shing tsha gser gyi bye ma dang // re skon mtshe thal sgro bzhib lhag ma'i rtsi/ ra khrag bsros pa'i nang du spru 'bru bsdus// rma khong gnyis kur btang bas khad pu gzhug / gang chad de yi don snod rtsa la gtar ngan khrag rtsa ru drangs te yang jigang gtar//rtsa chad chu ser phye mas bsad par bya/ gur gum dom mkhris me tog leb rgan rtsi// li shi shing mngar mtshal dkar dar ya kun// ka ra sbyar la lto stong btang bar bya// glo rtsa a byag shel ta spyi zhur dang // rgya skyegs mi mkhris gong steng mnan la btang / snying rtsa tsan dan dkar dmar zho sha gsum// mchin rtsa brag zhun mkhris chen gla rtsi bsnan// mkhal rtsa sug spel ru rta 'bras bu gsum//gong la bsnan pas rtsa chad sel bar byed rtsa yi rgyal po srog rtsa pa cos pa ni//lte thog sor bzhi mig dmar a so dang // sgrog rus gshong dang tshigs pa drug pa bsreg / long rtsa rtsa chen snod ka rtse chung gtar// li shi ka ra 'o ma sbyar la btang // rgyal blon gsum pa bsnan la btang bar bya// rtsa nad rnying pa bdun rtsi lnga yis bdug / rtsa sbyongs chu lums byas la nad lhag gdon// stod smad yul dang sbyar la bcos pa ni// byang khog stod la bcos tshul rnam gnyis te//

482 sto/grwa thang rgyud ba /bgrod sa lam dang sbyar te bcos pa dang // nyes byed dus dang sbyar la bcos pa 'o// bgrod sa lam dang sbyar la bcos pa ni// nang rdol khrag babs don la zin pa gsum// nang du rdol na rtsa khrag ma shor yang // mtshon phyir khrag babs zhal cig 'byung ba'i phyir// dang po mgyogs me'i sbyor bas khrag thigs bskam//gur gum rgya skyeg mkhris sna'i mgyogs me bya// drod chas bsten na khrag tshad skyed byed pas// rma kha mi skam chas steng ther srab bcing // tshad phran skyer mngon gtar phye rigs pas sbyar// zas spyod bsil zhing drag shul spangs pas 'tsho// nang rdol rtsa chad khrag ngan shor ba na me dang sman gyis rtsa la khad pu gzhug / gur gum phur thal mkhris sna'i mgyogs me bsten// khrag 'khyags zug gzer dugs mthang khugs kyis bcag / sbang gar g.yer ma tshwa phabs mar nag phye// 'tshos par btsos pa'i zan dron sla mo yi// a sa sa bdugs pas khrag 'dren zug gzer gcog / chu rdo brngos la bsings po'i kha phru btab// snye 'ur gtums la gang gzer steng du glan rta sbangs ser ga ma yi dugs kyis bdug / de ma 'dzom na yos dugs byas kyang btub// gla shing snying po bse ru 'o ma chur// bsdus khur dom mkhris ka ra btab la btang //khrag 'ju tsha ba mi skye zug gzer gcog / de ma 'dzom na 'o ma bskol ba la//dom mkhris btab btang khrag 'khyags 'ju zhing skem// a ru sge gsher rgyam tsha rgya skyag bsdus// khu bar dom mkhris btab btang gong bzhin no// 'tshabs med kha che nang rtsa ma chod cing // gsang du phog na khrag khugs mar 'dren shis//dku ltong nyen 'og spu gu snyim tsam bcug / pus brang bcas la sham bus dam du dkri// khugs shing steng du rma kha thur la bstan// kha chungs khrag thon chungs na thur mas gseng // dbugs bsdam khrag spu byung na khugs 'phro bcad//yon tan zug 'bri gso bla brjod mi lang // rma khar ma thon khrag bshal thur du sbyang // rgya tsha ru rta a ru lang thang tse// dur byin snam rtsa thang du btab la

sa khan nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 483btang // yang na rgya tsha dom mkhris bong nga dkar// mngal khrag khron bu dri chur sbyar la btang // khrag tshad khrag gsod thang dang phye mas bsad// thang sbyor gur gum dom mkhris dar ya kun// rgya skyeg btsod dang rgu drus ba sha ka / re skon hong len tig ta bong nga dkar// a ru ra rnams bsdus khu dro 'jam btang // ma nu sle tres ga dur dug mo nyung // bsdus khu dro 'jam khrag gzer gcog pa'i mchog / rgya skyag skyu ru ra dang ba sha ka / bsdus khur dom mkhris kha tshar btab la btang // khrag ngan tsha ba rol du gsod pa'i mchog / phye mas bsad pa khrag dus skems dang 'dra// khrag mtsho rtsa yi yur du gtar gyis drang //spyod lam gzab cing kha zas bsil gyis bcos// nang rdol don zin mod la ma shi na// dang po don thigs mgyogs mes bsdam bya ste// mi dom nya sogs mkhris sna gur gum dang // a ba a byag li gri'i mgyogs me bsten/ a ru gser mdog dom mkhris dar ya kun// gser jig rta yi mcher skam sha ru'i thal// sbrang bsgor phye ma mgyogs mes 'phul la btang // de ma 'dzom na dom mkhris li gri dang // 'gron bu'i thal ba ka ra mgyogs mes dbu' // don la zug rngu ma las rtsa ma chod// don snying rma la khrag 'byor byed pa yin// don zin dgye dgu mi shes pang 'tshos dgos// bzang khrag gtar gyis 'don pa dpyad mchog yin glo bu snying la rtsa chen yas babs gtar// glo ba ma la rtsa phran mas 'jog gtar/ don tshad rgyas pa bsil ba'i gye mas bsad/ glo la ga bur bzang drug tsan dan gnyis// shing mngar rgyan 'brum sro lo spang rgyan dkar// bse ru go dor ka ra sbyar la btang // ga bur cu gang dzā ti li shi dang // utpal shing tsha gas pa tra dang // padma ge sar hong len mon cha ra// chu srin sder mo a ru ka ra sbyar// snying la dzā ti li shi a ru ra// zho tha rnam gsum chu grang 'phul la btang // snying mi dran zhing 'bog na bya rgod snying / li shi zho sha gsum dang ti mu sa// bsdus pa'i thang btang bdun pa dkar nag

484 sa /grwa thang da bzhi/mtshams// gyid khung mthe 'ong spu skyes bsreg par bya// 'di la zas spyod khrag gi skabs ltar bsten// nyes byed dus kyi sgo nas bcos pa ni// dang po zhag bdun zhugs pa khrag gi dus// bram ze lta bur gtsang pa'i sgo nas bcos//bar du zhag bdun rgyas pa chu ser dus// dge slong lta bur spyod lam zhib mor bcos// tha ma zhag bdun smin pa rnag gi dus rgyal po lta bur zas kyis bcos pa 'o// dang po khrag dus zug gzer bcag pa dang // rtsa kha bsdam dang khrag tshad rol du bsad// nyes byed rtsar drang phyi tshan chu yis bcag / dang po gzer ba khrag rtsa don gzer gsum// dugs dang me btsa' gtar gyis bcag pa gces// rtsa kha bsdam pa spra ba mgyogs me gnyis// mgyogs me dar dkar dri med gtsang ma ru/ gur gum mi dom mkhris pa a byag phur// sgyug ma mtho gang btsugs la ras skud bskyigs// g.ya' chu gtsang la mdog 'gyur bangs su gzhug / drug bdun btang bas rtsa kha sdom pa dang / khrag gsod don rma 'byor zhing chu ser skem// mgyogs me bcu bzhi yan chad skom du bsten//nang rdol rtsa chod don zin khrag babs pas/ khrag 'phel mkhris 'khrug tsha ba rgyas 'gyur te/ chu dmar rtsa drims gdong snum rngam pa thung / nub gnyid mi phebs nyin par gnyid mi thub// kha rtse mchu skams so la dreg nag chags//zas la mi dga' skom dad shin tu che/ tsog pur mi zug sngas smas nyal mi shes//thal gong pa dang sogs dbrag spo zhing gzer/ khrag tshad rgyas pa zas spyod phye mas bcad// zas skom chag tshe ba ra mdzo yi zho// dar gsar mar dkar chu bsil bsten par bya// lan tsha sha chang drod bcud dug 'dra spang // spyod lam bsil sar sos dal drag shul spang / phye ma ga bur tsan dan dkar po dang //cugang gur gum li shis khrag rlangs gsod// mi dom nya phag khyi nag g.yag rog mkhris// zab chen 'gron bu'i thal bas rtsa kha sdom/ bse ru go dor gnyis dang ba sha ka / gtsod khrag re skon li gris khrag ngan skem// ka ra sbyar

zhu na nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 485ba ba'i yar drug yar btang // yang na dgu sbyor phye ma ltag pa sprad/ ga bur cu gang gur gum utpal mtshal// gla rtsi sug sprel stod nag ba le ka / ka ra dkar sbyar nang par lto stong btang // bse ru go dor tsan dan a ka ru// dzā ti 'gron bu'i thal ba a ru ra// li gri rgya ru ka ra srod khyer btang / ltag pa sprad pas yon tan gong dang mtshungs// nyes byed ngan khrag rtsa ru drang ba ni//smin dang dbye bar bya ba mi dgos te// snga dro gongs ka bsnad kyin khrag shed smad// smin dus bsdad na stag gdong sa stor 'dra// rtse chung dpung rtsa chu ser glad gcog rtsa// drug mgo ru thung gzer ba zug gcog rtsa// snod ka gsha' rings dang ga 'byed pa'i rtsa// sgang rtsa 'dom rtsa chu ser rtsad gcod rtsa// rgyab sgang sogs dbrag sgang rtsa drug mgo dang 5 nu 'jing brang gzer ru thung snod ka drang / yas babs mas 'dzeg tsha ba'i stobs dang sbyar// rnag mkhris lcags g.ya' chags na gtar gyis 'drongs// gtar skyed che na mang gtar nyung du dbyung // dmar nag gzha' ris mi 'drongs zo sbyar gtar// khrag mi chags shing chur 'gro gtar tshod bzung // mi 'drongs bungs ches gtar tshod ma zin na// rnag dus zungs zad mda' zad dgra byung 'dra// phyi yi tsha rlangs chu yis bcag pa ni/ zhag lnga lon nas skar chu grang mo yis// nyi dros 'phrul 'khor bskor bas skem pa bla// tsha ba phyi byer rang skoms tsha rlangs gcog / de ltar bcos pas tsha ba nad stobs bri// bde skyed che na myur du 'cho bar 'gyur de la skyed med zhag bdun 'das pa dang // bar du rgyas pa chu ser dus zhes bya// de la rgyu dang rigs rtags skam thabs bzhi// de rgyu bya chad bya thor thigs sdod dang / smug zil rnam pa bzhi las gyur pa ste// bya chad mtshon phyir khrag shor khrag babs te// gtar gyis ma 'drongs sman gyis ma 'chun dang // bya shor phyi rtsa gnyan po chod pa ste/ dus su me yis rtsa 'phrang ma sdoms gnyis/sngar thor phyir mi skye bas grang babs rgyu/ jigs sdod rtsa thigs don jigs

486 zhu/grwa nga rgyud ba /mde thigs gsum// nang rtsa'i thigs la kha shor ngu ba gnyis// rtsa bran kha shor sogs sbubs chu 'dzag 'dra// rtsa chen btsan brdungs khrag dang chu ser du//de gnyis sman gyis khad pu ma tshud dang // don rma dang por khrag 'byor ma byung bas// rma rus khrag dang chu ser thigs pa dang // mde'u lus sdod pa'i mal sa ma rnyed pas// 'gyar 'gyur skyon gyis khrag chu 'dus te 'thig / khrag tshad rgyas pa sman gtar ma choms pas// tsha ba rlangs 'khyims kha g.yam zil pa 'dra// de rnams phral la skye bas tsha babs 'gyur// des bskyed chu ser tsha babs grang babs dang // khrag babs pa dang chu ser rkyang pa 'o// tsha babs rtsa chu tsha la gdong pa snum// kha zas mi 'dod skom snyeg kha lce skam// lus tsha bya 'brum 'ong zhing glo long ldang // dbugs thung nyin gnyid mi thub nub gnyis yar// zug che za zi mang la gsang sa bye// glo mang lud pa'i gseb tu rnag 'brum 'byung // skams pas mi skoms rgya bshal gsang sgor dbyung // grang babs rtsa chu 'jam la gdong pa dkar// dang ga bde la lce rlon skom dad chung //sha yi drod chung 'dar dang grang shum med// dbugs bde nyin gnyid chung la nub gnyid phebs// zug chung blab chol mi smra gsang ma bye// glo nyung lud pa gtsang la lus po yang // de la gsang dbye mi dgos bskams pas skoms//tshabs chung chu ser dus kyang khrag dang bcas// de phyir gtar gyis 'drongs shing skem pa bla// khrag gi babs che don la zin pa de// khrag dus chu ser phying dril ma bcos na// zhag bdun 'das nas chu ser kyang par 'gyur// de nyid gtar gyis mi 'drongs skem pa dka'// de phyir tshabs chung dus gsum so sor bcos// tshabs che khrag dus chu ser ching dril bcos// chu ser skem thabs zas spyod sman dpyad ba'i// zas ni bram ze'i dus kyi steng dag tu// rna dgo ba lang sha gsar bsnan la btang // zungs 'an mngar gsum lde gas lus zungs gso// spyod lam ldang nyal drag shul skad cher smra// glo drag lu dang dri ma 'tshar

mi na ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 487ba sogs rtsa kha 'bud pa'i drag shul khrims ltar bsrung // sman gyis skem pa spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la phye ma lde gu sman mar gsum// khrag dang bcas pa'i dus su phye ma ste// chu ser rkyang pa'i dus su lde gus bskam// rnag tu khugs nas sman mar shes par gsungs// phye ma'i sbyor ba rnam pa gsum yin te// nyi ma lnga yi phye ma sbyar ba ni// bse ru dkar po go dor rnam pa gnyis/tsan dan dkar dmar a ru gser mdog dang // cu gang gur gum dzā ti gu gul dkar// thal ka rdo rje so ma ra dza dang // li gri dom mkhris zab 'gron phur thal ba// zhib btags ka ra dkar sbyar seng lding dang // shi la dza tu bsings pa'i dngas mas dbul// nyi ma lnga yis rgya mtsho skems pa ltar/ khrag dang chu ser rnag gi rgya mtsho skems/ rgyal blon dmag dpung bcas pa'i phye ma ni// mu zi rgyal rigs gser 'dra khyor ba phyed// da chu dug phral zho gcig ltar bu gsum/ 'dres par mnyes la bse ru go dor gnyis// rgya ru tsan dan dkar po a ga ru gur gum cu gang tig ta ba le ka / mi dom khyi mkhris hong len ba sha ka / dur thod dung 'gron thal ba ka ra sbyar// ba chu spru rtsa'i khu bas 'phul la btang / rnag khrag chu ser 'ag res skem par nus// rtsal chen bsdus pa'i phye ma sbyar ba ni// gtso bo pa ṭa hri la gser 'dra de// sa phral lcags snod me yi snying pos bzhu// a ru chur blug bsdus grangs me stobs sbyar//gtso bo khyor gang bse ru go dor gnyis/ tsan dan dkar dmar gnyis dang ag ru// ga bur cu gang gur gum dom mkhris dang // mi dom nya mkhris gri rus thal ba dang / 'gron thal sha ru'i thal ba dung thal dang // ta bya ra mnye nye shing a ru ra// a ba a byag re skon phur zab thal// ka ra sbyar ba seng ldeng khu bas dbul// mu zi phye ltar 'gam pa'i sbyor ba ste// khrag dang chu ser rgya mtsho tsam yang skem// sa rlan steng dang me nyi spang bar bya// mi 'ju hrem na sman dpyad chu bskol btung // 'gor ram 'byams na glang mig bsregs pa

488 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/dang // go snyod pi pi ling gi bsdus thang btang // de nas sde gu'i sbyor bas skam ba ni// ba 'am mdzo mar gsar bzhu sbu snyigs phyungs// sbrang rtsi bzang po chu bcad bsres pa la// rtsal chen 'dus pa'i phye ma btab la dkrug / de dag rkang ltar 'dag pa'i sbyor ba ste// zungs ngan lus stobs skye zhing rnag chu skem//'bri mar gsar pa sku snyigs byungs pa la// mu zi zhib btags btab nas dkrug cing bskol// ser ljang dmar nag mdog 'gyur ngad yal la// gong gi phye ma btab la legs dkrugs btang // khrag ltar btung zhes rnag khrag skem pa'i mchog / mu zi mar nag sbyar la dkrug cing bsdus// ting khrol tshad du phyin nas ngan yal la// phye ma btab btang sha ltar bza' ba yin// 'ag re la yang rnag chu phul re skem// seng ldeng chang du zhag lnga sbangs khu la// ra mnye nye thing bsdus la lug zho tsam// sprang rtsi chu bcad bsres te 'dres pa la// mu zi khyor phyed bse ru rgya ru dang // go dor mi dom nya phag bya rgod dang // phyi spre khyi mkhris tsan dan a ga ru// ba le ka dang chu ser sman gsum dang // ge sar gnyis dang gur gum sbyar la btang // de dag kun gyis skems par ma gyur pa'i// rnag tu gyur nas sman mar dag gis skam// sbyor ba rnag gi skabs su shes par bya// khyad par byis pa bad kun rang bzhin la// rus thal sig sne'i sbyor bas skam pa ni// gri rus dur thod sha ru 'gron bu dang // tsha ba gsum dang phur yog za 'og rnams// thal bar byas te chu ser sman gsum dang // ka ra sbyar ba chu bskol dbul bar bya// dar ma mkhris pa'i rang bzhin can dag la// rin chen rtsi sbyor dag gis skem pa ni// zangs thal byu ru mu tig mtshal dkar ba'i// ga bur bsil gsum tsan dan dkar dmar dang // mkhris sna ka ra sbyar ba gangs chus dbul// rgas dang rlung shas che ba'i mi rigs la// rwa sna'i sbyor ba dag gis skom pa ni// bse ru dkar nag rgya ru go dor gnyis//rna dgo gtsod dang rgod g.yung ba men ra glang ru ra lug thug po'i rwa la

zhu nang g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 489sogs// thal tshan me la ser tsam bsregs pa dang // bzang drug mi dom nya mkhris ka ra sbyar// dpyad kyis bcos pa gtar dang sbyang ba gnyis// gtar nyung chu ser tsha ba rtsad mi chod// gtar drags zungs 'dzad de phyir rigs la dris// sman gtar bcos gyis tsha ba ma bri na// dur byid tsha la bu rtse shel gyis sbyang // de ltar bcos pas tsha ba nad stobs bri// chu ser bsags rtags nub na thub pa yin/ de la skyed med bcu bzhi phar 'das pa// tha ma smin pa rnag gi dus zhes bya// de la brtag pa'i thabs dang bcos thabs gnyis// brtag pa'i thabs la rnam pa gsum yod de// phyi yi rtags kyis yod med la shan dbye//nang gi rtags kyis rnag gnas dmigs gsum bzung // gsang ba'i rtags kyis 'dra men nor sa bsal// dang po yod med la shan dbye ba ni// ro stod dgu la gnya' chag mig sprin ser// lus gcu gar yod ngos kyi dpung pa shal /rtsa dang chu yi tsha ba sangs mi srid// mgo na gdong pa jul la lus spyir lci// glo chung mang du yong zhing glo snying 'deg / skad kyi gdangs chag skabs su bag re 'khru / sha mdog sngo la lce snyil sen mo dkar // de rtags bcu ba'i tshang na rnag yod nges// rnag gi gnas gsum gar yo da dmigs bzung ba// ngam nag ro stod brgyangs thing skabs su gzer// gnyid che za zi mang la mig bol skrangs// kha dri nga ba rang gzhan gnyis das tshor// skabs su lud pa'i gseb tu rnag 'brum 'byung // glo thabs nang na rnag yod nges pa yin// glo rtsa gang yo da skabs su gzer ba dang // skabs su phrum ser 'ong zhing zhe 'khun byed//gang yod ngos la bya 'brum tam gyis 'ong // steng du bton na khyad par zug gzer che// glo sgrubs gsang du babs pa'i rtags gzhan med// tshang tshing skyi phur rnag yo da nges pa yin// bem tol ba spu'i thig dang sprugs pa'i skad// me tog sad mda' mi 'gyur rtags drug tshang // phyir babs dbye gsang rnag yod nges pa yin// bem tol dogs sa kun la snyoms par bdeg / g.yas g.yon

490 ༄/grwa thang dab /mdun rgyab stod smad 'drar snang bstun// stong skad rnag med gcor skad chu ser yod// 'dar skad byung na rnag tu smin pa yin// de nas gnyis pa ba spus brtag pa ni// skar chu grang mos nyi ma kha dros la// kha phru bran rjes chang gis kha phru btab// gos mi bkon par nyi ma'i zer la blta// ba sru gzings na rnag med chu ser 'tshub// bas ldags rjes ltar nyal na rnag yod pa'o// de nas gsum pa gzhal ba thig la brtag / mdun rgyab tshangs thig gnam thig 'grus med gdab// zur thig gnyis gdab gyed mar lan gnyis gdab// bcu gsum pa nas lte bar 'phred thig gdab// de steng 'phred la gnyis gdab phyed mar bcal// 'dren thig bcu drug zed thig rnam bdun gyi// bya rjes thig bar gar nyams rnag yod rtags gsang sa gtsang ngos dpe ru mtshon par bya// de nas bzhi pa sprugs pa'i skad kyis brtag / mi khyi chu sogs sgra skad med pa'i sar// khan mnyam stan la skyil mo krungs su 'dug / rgyan phog skra brjes lag pa spyi bor bsnol// dpung mgo gnyis nas dal bus je drag dkrog /mjug tu lan gsum drag tu sprugs la nyan// 'khrog skad rlung yin shang shang chu ser yod// rnyog rnyog rgya shal cug cug rnag tu nges// stod du sgra byung mang la smad byung nyung // des ma rtogs na logs la bsnyal byas te/ lag 'og sngas la gong ma dbyi steng bkab/ dpyi dang dpung pa nas bzung gong ltar sprug /sprugs pas skad ster gsang du lag mthil btang // thol thol khyil khyil be'u 'gul 'dra yod// de nas lnga pa gsang sar me tog brtag / dus med rgyun du gsang du gzer ba dang // sha yi mdangs ni ga 'an pas de na bzang // rtsib bar yangs la brtse zhing sbos la gsob// rdzi bar mi bzod ser ga dreg chung chags// gsang sar rnag gi me tog shar ba yin/ drug pa the tshom za na sad mda' btang // bya brun brngos phye nu zho sbyar la bsku// byi ba'i pags pa glan pas gsang sar smra// yang na sha khrag tshwa sna ba bong bu'i mdun bya ma byi dang po bya'i sha
