zhu na ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 491bya mtshal 'u'i ze khrag mngal khrig rgya tshadang shug tsher rnams// ba chu phul phyed ba lu'i me la bsdu// khyor gang khye sus bsdus btang sro los bdug / zhag gsum nang par gsang du rnag gis smra// khyad par yol dang skyi phur rtogs par nges// de ltar mi 'gyur rnag rtags drug tshang na// the tshom mi dgos btsags thur rgyab pas chog / mdog dmar phyi skrangs ba sru 'byi ba dang // se ba rgan po'i pags pa lta bur 'gas// yol nub rul myags gsang mchis de srog 'dor//gsang rtags 'dra min nor sa bsal ba ni// yod 'dra med dang med 'dra yod pa gnyis// de la yod yod 'dra la med pa ni// rtsib logs khrag sha dreg par chags pa yis// rtsib ma'i bar yang gzer sbrid drod che zhing // 'dar skar 'byung bas yod pa 'drar gyur kyang // rnag rtags gzhan med gtar phran chu chags gcun// de yis 'chun nas gong rtags nub na med// 'khyams su rlung thor gas na dkrog dkrog zer// yod yod 'dra yang rtsa stong chu mdog sngo//glo snying 'dar la mig dkar rna ba 'ur// gdong skya 'khrog pa'i skad la 'phel 'bri 'ong // de la sha chang sprugs pas chad na med// gnyis pa med med 'dra la yod pa ni// brang rnag rkun bu nyung zhing yu na lon pas// sha skam yod ngos phra bas med pa 'dra// yol bcad skyi phur dkrogs kyang skad mi ster// med pa 'dra yang rtags gzhan tshang na nges// de phyir 'dra min gol sa bcad pa gces// ngos zin bcos thabs sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi// glo rnag drang zhing skyi phur rnag rgya dbral// gsang du babs pa bsus la phyir la dbyung //dang po glo yi sgrugs su rnag zhugs na// dang po rnag gi skyugs kyis gyen du drang // de rjes glo ba sman dang zas kyis gso// dang po ltar bu ru rta skyu ru ra//shing mngar pa yag bul rtog pi pi ling // sbrang rtsi sbyar nas lto stong btang bas 'dren// de yis 'drongs dka' rgya tsha rgyam tsha dang // bul tog so cha so to'i gre ba dang // go bo'i glad pa rmigs pa'i khrag dang bdun// khye 'u'i chu la sbyar

492 ༄7/grwa nga byu/btang rnag rnams 'dren// yang na sprang rgod rgya tsha ga bur dang / cu gang 'bri ta sa 'dzin chang skyur sbyar// mdun rgyab bdud rtsi lnga po btsos pas bdug /des ma 'drongs na yungs kur mu zi dang // gu gul mar nag ras la bstim byas nas// bum nang mes bsregs du ba kha snar bdug / yang na ldong ros gu gul so cha dang // rdo dreg ru rta la cha sbyar la bdug / yang na mchu skung ldong ros yung ba dang // shing kun rgya skyegs zangs rdo pi pi ling // thing mngar gu gul gla rtsi po so cha// mi yi tshil sbyar du ba rngubs pas 'drongs// rnag thon pa yi tshad ni rnag shugs 'byung // bsko ba drags nas rnag zad khrag shor na// rtsa kha bsdam dang rnag rjes bcad par bya// dang po rgya skyegs ba 'o chur bsdus khur// dom mkhris gur gum sran pus btab la btang // yang na shing tsha sug thel pi pi ling // sge gsher rgya skyegs dom mkhris ma ru tse// ka ra dkar po sbyar la btang bar bya// rgya skyegs la cha bton pa'i khu ba dang // 'bre mog khu ba ba mar bton pa dang // bong bu'i 'o ma cha gsum phul dor mnyam// shu mo za ni pho tshoms gcig btab btso// chu chod li shi ka ra kha tshar gdab// nang re khyem bu re re bsten par bya// glo rtsa chad dam glo ba 'grams pa 'am// lud ba khrag bcas glo rnag gcod pa'i mchog / rnag rjes dmar po gsum gyi sman mar la// bzang drug zangs thal sbrang sbyar lto stong btang // glo rma gso zhing rma yi rnag rjes gcodaka kha zas ba yi zho dar skom sha btang // rjes la gro chang sro los bsings pa dang // lug sha gsar pas rlung sgo dgag par bya// rul skyur bshul sha drag shul rgyun du spang // bar gyi skyi phur rnag rgya dbral ba ni// phu yi rgyal bu mda' yi rnga mo dang // bar gyi sder chags klu yi sha rnams btags//bsdus pa'i tsha ba gsum yar zhag gsum btang / a krong rgod kyi btsos lums steng nas bdug / de yis skyi phur phyi nang gang nye rdol// ma rdol srid na tshe zad las yin spang // gsang du babs pa phyir la dbyung ba ni// gsang gi

zhu sa nang g.yo rna tan gyi da/ 493—dbye dus gsang dmigs dbye thabs dang // rnag gi dbyung tshad rnag spra rma chas dang // them bu bkru bshal zas sman spyod lam dang // rnag gi 'chad dus bstan dang bcu gcig go / dbye dus lnga bdun dgu la rgya bshal dbye// bcu gcig bcu gsum bco lnga chu ser dbye/ bcu bdun bcu dgu nyer gcig rnag gsang dbye// 'grams dang rtsa yi bya shor dbye dus med// gsang dmigs mi 'gyur rtags drug tshang ba der/ dbye thabs gza' skar tshes bzang snga skad dus// khad mnyam stan la lus bsrang skyil dkrung 'dug / lo mthun g.yog gis brten la rna ba bsdam// sbubs thur byid po'i mchu 'dras gsang sa yi rta gab sne bsnol med par drang por bdeg / pags pa sha rus nang rdol lag tshod myang // lag pa thur ma pags pa mi 'bral btem// dbugs bsdam rgyus mdes nyul zhing rnag chu gdon// dbyung ba'i bungs tshad dang po sum gnyis yin// rnag tshab chang phul gyed la thal bran btang // tha mar rnag spu chir gyis byung na bzhag / dang po za bzhis de nas zhag bzhis bya// rnag spra dkar 'jam dri med gso ba sla/ ser skya bska la dri med phal gso bla// dmar skya sngo skya dri med gso ru rung // skyer khu tshod khu 'dra na yun du sbyong // she rul dud ka dri che khrag ris can// rams khu 'dra dang sha khog bshal 'dra dang // skyang chu nyi mas tshig 'dra 'chi ba yin// them bu rma chas rim pas spel te bsten// thur ma bton rjes leb rgan ltab them gzhug / de steng a sa ba yis thengs 'ga' bdug / de rjes rnag ma zad bar phying 'byar bya// bar du gcus them nyung them re mos spel// gro lo sbang ro rnga gzeb hol ge dkri// tha ma zha nye'i 'phrul thebs gzhug par bya// skam chas 'bri 'u snum btsos btang la dkri// bkru bshal tsha na ga bur rgyal blon chus/ grang rnag chang 'jam rul chags bul tog chu// thun mong cu gang dom mkhris ka ra'i chu// khyor re cha byad 'tsham pas rma nang bskyal// rma bkab skyoms la de nas phyir la dbyung // lhag chad med na

494 ༄cu/grwa thang dab /them bu gzhon ba'i rtags// khrus drags blo yi drod 'chor grang 'byams 'gyur//khrus zhan rul chags rnag gi gzhug mi chod// de phyir dbyar gsum rgun bdun dus la bkru// kha zas dang po rnag tshad ma bri bar// ba ra'i zho dar ri dgas skom sha dang // nas thug yos thug la sogs bsil du btang // bar du rnag zad tsha ba chag pa dngag/ mar gsar lug sha gsar pa bur dkar dang //mngar gsum lde gu gsar 'jam bro med btang // tha ma rnag gzhug chad dka' sha yib dang // bur mar chang 'jam ting khrol bcud kyis gso // sman ni rnag tshad yod pa'i dus dag tu// dngul chu dug phral mu zi brtul ba dang //zangs thal 'bras bu gsum dang bzang ngo drug / ga bur na waṃ tsan dan dkar dmar dang // bse ru rgya ru go dor mkhris sna tshogs / ra mnye nye shing mngar dkar sbrang dang sbyar// khyem bu gsum gsum khye sus btang bas skem//yang na mu zi khrag ltar btung bas skam// rnag zad tshad stobs chag nas sman mar sbyar// 'bras bu gsum dang ra mnye nye thing gi/ khu phyung 'o ma mar du chu bcad la// rtsal chen bsdus pa'i phye ma kha tshar gdab// sbrang dang sbyar bas rnag rnams ma lus kun// stod smad phyi nang gang na gnas kyang rung // zhag gcig gis ni thams cad skems par nus// ar bar nyi shu ba chur 'ag lnga sbangs// 'o ma mar bsdus chu chod dngas ma la / dngul chu dug phral star bu ba chu dang // byis pa'i chus bshig mu zi khyor gang sbyar// ga bur bzang drug tsan dan gi waṃ dang// bse ru seng ldeng spyi zhur so ma ra// sgron shing zangs thal 'gron bu'i thal ba dang // rtsa ba ra rmi nye nye shing re na mtha ṣi dar ya kan lo ma a ba brag lcam stag sha gsum sbrang rtsi sbyar byas te// sum yar mtheb mo tsam re btang bar bya// rnag kun zil pa nyi mas phog bzhin skem// zhu rjes ba spu rngul tsam gos kyis byib// ma zhu chu bskol go thal rgya tsha shis// mgo 'khor kha gdong spangs na sha chang btang // rus tshigs 'bral snyam byed na pi pi ling // rgya tsha rgyam tsha

wu/man nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 495star bu'i bskol thang btang // tha ma rnag gzhug grang bar 'byams pa'i dus//lcags la dbang phyug sa bon a ru ra// zangs la dar mtshur mu zi'i thal bas bzhu// bse ru go dor gnyis dang rgya ru dang // gur gum cu gang dza ti tsan dan gnyis// shing tsha tsha ba gsum dang dbyi mong dang // dngul chu star bu ba chus bshig pa dang la cha 'khar po de rnams rtsi bzhin btags// a ru gser mdog chang du zhag lnga sbangs// khu phyungs 'o ma 'bri mar bsdus pa'i mar// sbrang sbyar nas gseb bzhag la sum yar bsten// grang rnag skem pa'i mchog tu shis pa yin// spyod lam drag shul nyal po bzhin pa dang // 'gengs 'degs bdeg sogs lag gi 'du byed spang // de ltar bcos rjes rtsa chu phyi tshad chag / lus yang dang ga bde la nyams shed skyes// rnag gzhug chad pa'i dus yin chad dus bzhi// shing rtsi kha 'bus char klungs gcig phebs dang //skam thag chad dang 'khyag pa ar la thebs// dus der ma chad 'byams pa zhes bya ste// log gnon rjes gcod nad du shes par bya// da ni byang khog smad kyi bcos thabs la// spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis su 'dod// spyi la bcos don rnam pa dgu yin te// zas kyis gzhi bzung dugs kyis gzer ba bcag /chas kyis drod bskyed 'dren gyis 'gags pa bsal// sman gyis don snod tsha ba bsad pa dang // gtar gyis ngan khrag rtsa ru dbyung ba dang // bshal gyis ma khris tshad 'or du bskyur ba dang // me yis rtsa 'phrang bsdam zhing sbos pa ga'i la// rnag khrag babs pa gsang du gdon par bya// dang po zas kyis gzhi ma bzung ba ni// smad ni gtso bor snod kyi yul yin pas// zas dang skom gyi sbyor ba shin tu gces// 'bras dang yos thug nyag gis 'tshos pa la/ mar gsar 'o ma sga skya btab pa dang // skom sha gsar pa gri tshags sga skya bran//bungs chung mi mang yang dang yang du bskud// bskol grangs chu grog mi mang skom du btang // 'o zan lto lu gong sgong tshon re byin// zas skom mangs na

496 ༄ grwa thang rgyud ba'i/—zug che skyug pa dang // rma mi 'byor phyir bshal rjes lta bur gzab// don la zas skom gnod pas spang ba chog / skom sha zho phrul chu grog tshod sbyar btang //bsil ches drod ches zas skom thams cad spang // gnyis pa dugs kyis gzer ba bcag pa ni// mchin pa rta sbangs mcher pa byi sa'i dugs// mkhal ma sbang skam pho ba tsha yi dugs// long la chu rde rgyu ma rdza bsregs dugs// dro la rgya che lan mang btang ba yis// zug chogs bde ba myu ra du ster bar byed// gsum pa chas kyis drod la btsa' ba ni// rma gas ra dus su a sa ba yis bdug de nas mar khu spod bran rnga rdzing btsos / rgya cher btang la ther sra ba steng du bcing // rma kha che na sbang ro tshom re glan// skam chas rlan dang mi 'bral gces pa yin// sbang ma la sogs drod 'jam spang bar bya// bzhi pa 'dren gyis 'gags pa bsal ba ni// na 'gyung sbo ldeng dri chu sri ba la// dur byid lhum rtsa mkhris sna bul tog phabs// dud pa tshwa dang ba chu'i mas 'dren btang //smad tshad dri ma khrag ro 'don par byed// phral du bde nus yang yang bstud kyin btang // lnga pa sman gyis tsha ba bsad pa ni// smad kyi don la tsha ba bcag pa dang // rtsa kha bsdam dang chu ser sgom pa gcas// dang po tsan dan gi waṃ bsil gsum dang // utpal drug gis don gyis tsha ba gcog / dom mkhris thing mngar a bas rtsa kha sdom// bse ru go dor 'gron thal phur thal bzhi// chu ser rnag khrag skem par byed pa yin// gtso bo de la kha sgyur sna khrid pa//mchin pa la ni brag zhun pri yang ku// tig ta mtshal dkar gong la bsnan la btang // mcher pa la ni gser gyi me rtog dang // a ru ra dang pi pi ling gsu ma bsnan// mkhal ma la ni sug sprel gla rtsi dang // sdig na lcam pa bsnan la ka ra sbyar/ de bzhin snod la tsha ba sel ba dang // nyams pa gso dang drod skyed kha sgyur gces// gi waṃ bsil gsum utpal snod tshad sel// dom mkhris rgu drus btsod kyis nyams pa gso// se 'bru pi pi ling gis me drod skyed// pho

zhus na ngag yon tan gyi rgyud 497ba la ni ma nu ru rta bsnan// rgyu mar dug mo nyung dang snya lo bsnan// long la kha ru tsha dang ru rta bsnan// mkhris par gser gyi me rtog dug nyung bsnan// sgang par sdig pa srin bu bsnan bya ste// ka ra sbyar ba 'ju' dka' chu bskol dbul//thun grangs thun tshad tsha ba'i stobs dang sbyar// pho bas ma 'chun tsha ba gsum thal ba// a ru ka ra sbyar la ltag pa sprad// drug pa gtar gyis khrag ngan rtsar drang ba// tsha ba skye zhing gzer 'gyung tsha 'brab byed// lte ba yan chad snod ka ru thung gtar// man chad rtsa bo che dang long rtsa gtar// mkhal ma byin gzhug phan skyed khrag mdog sbyar// snod la gtar ba drags na me drod 'chor//bdun pa bshal gyis mkhris tshad 'or skyur ba// sman gtar tsha ba mi chag chu mdog ser// ldang dub mang la kha kha dang ga 'gag / lhum rtsa dur byin a ru mchu skung thang // 'jam pos snod tshad sbyang ba gces pa yin// brgyad pa me yis sbos gzhil 'phrang bsdam pa// rtsa chad snod phug rtsa khrid gzer sbos na//dpyad mchog me dang 'dra ba gang yang med// rtsa chad pa la rma khar lnga bdun gdab// snod phugs 'tshebs pa med na rma kha bsreg / 'tshebs na mde phugs rma yi steng du bsreg / rtsa khrid gang 'phreng gang gzer steng du bsreg /sbo ldeng gzer na mdun rgyab rang gsang bsreg / dgu pa rnag khrag gsang du gdon pa ni// gyen thur dbye ba'i gsang sar 'don pa gsum// mgo na kha kha dang ga mi bde zhing // pho stod 'tshing sgrog skyug pa snyam du sem// ma zhu'i gnas na gnas te skyugs kyis drangs// gser gyi phud bu dong ga pi pi ling //so cha spyang tsher dus gsum rtas bsgyur drang / yang na bsil gsum nim pa yungs ker dang // 'bri ta sa 'dzin phur mo lo tsan gyi// khu bar btab btang rnag khrag lhung ba skyug / dri chu bsdams dang rgyu long gzer ba dang // tsha rum ldang dub byed dang ro smad snyi// zhu ba'i gnas su babs pa bshal gyis sbyang //da rdo dong ga sngon bu a ru ra// thar nu lham rtsa bul tog pi pi ling // chu dang ba

498 ༄cu grwa thang rgyud ba —chu chang bsings rta yi bsgyur// smad du rnag khrag lhung ba sbyong bar byed// rtsa chu tsha la kha skam dang ga 'gag / lda nga dub byed cing dri chu sdom pa dang // tsha 'brab che la brtse zhing reg mi bzod// rnag yul mthong la mer mer ltong lhong byed// gsang du gang babs sa der phyi nas dbye// dbye dus rnag spra khrus chas rjes gcod sogs// byang khog stod dang khyad par med par bcos// snod kyi phyir babs 'phongs su mdzu gus brtag / 'phrul gsang na zhing mi bzod mer sar dbug / smad kyi don snod bye brag bcos pa ni// mchin dri dkar nag gnyis la mtshon phog na// dang po dom mkhris ra 'o sbyar la btang // gtar spang tshigs pa brgyad dang snyen sna bsreg / phag sha sol ba bya po'i mgo tshod bslud// rnga bran sha dang mdzo yi zho dar btang // sgong spris rta khrag go stod skam nan bya// g.yer ma go stod spod sna dmar po gsum// skam nan bya zhing bud med nad g.yog spang // mchin dri nag po mkhris sbyor khong du btang // rtse chung ngar gdong lte 'og rtsa la gtar// snyed khung mes bsreg 'bras thug yos thug btang // spyi gtsug rkang mthil snum gyis byug pa bya// kha zas bsil bsten drod kyang cud zad bsten// mchin pa ru thung long rtsa bzhi la gtar//tshigs pa brgyad dgu 'tshogs dkyil mthe bong bsreg / gur gum cu gang ba le ba sha ka / brag zhun se 'bru mtshal dang a ru ra// ka ra sbyar btang me rtog khaṇḍa sbyar / kha zas spyod lam grang dro snyoms par bcos// mcher pa ngar gdong ru thung bzhi la gtar// go stod sle tres dug nyung bsdus thang btang /tshigs pa dgu pa bcu gcig bsreg par bya// 'phongs su la phug tshwa sbyar reng bu gzhug / sgog skya mar dkar bsdus khu tsi tra ka / go stod sdum bu rnam gsum btab la btang // kha zas drod bya skabs su lo mar byug / de la bcos skyed med na 'jam bshal btang // mkhal mar bcu bzhi pa dang rtsa nag bsreg /yob gong rtsa dang byin gzhug ba'i la gtar// kha zas drod la khong sman bsil

༄gunang g.yon tan gyi da/ 499du btang / chu bsdams rgya tsha gla rtsi sdig srin dang // nyi dga' 'o ma sbyar la btang bar bya// mkhal tshil zhu na gur gum bdun pa sbyar// ga bur rmar gzhug bsil ba'i nan gyis mnan// rnag zhugs zho sha gsum gyi sman mar sbyar// pho ba bcu gnyis pho gsang dbus ma bsreg / skyug na 'bras khur 'bras yos pu shel tse/ sprang rtsi sbyar btang se 'bru a ru ra// mar dkar ka ra sbrang sbyar ting khrol dang // tsha ba skyes na ru thung g.yas g.yon gtar// gso ba dka' na dong ga'i 'jam bshal btang // pho ther ral na rta rkyang rgyus pas brtsem// sha 'u skyed sman btab la dar gyis dgab// de steng phying pa mar btsos glan la dkri// lto tshil lug na drod phab nang du gzhug / ma tshud mtshams su rta rnga dar skud bcing // rgya tsha shing tsha btab pas tshil bu bzhu tshud nas rma chas gong ma bzhin du bya// tsha ba skyes na thang phye gtar phran dpyad//mkhris pa dom mkhris 'o mar sbyangs la btang // tshigs pa dgu bsreg gsha' ring ru thung gtar// tig ta dom mkhris gser gyi me tog dang // ru rta hong len rtsa mkhris bong nga dkar// skyer zhun ka ra sbyar ba'i phye ma btang // long la tshigs pa bcu drug bsreg par bya// srin la shing kun gla rtsi byi tang ga /lang thang tse dang 'bu skyogs ma ru tse// sgog skya 'o ma bu ram btab pa bsrud//tsha ba skyes na long rtsa gnyis la gtar dong ga sngon bu khron bu lham rtsa dang //sgron shing skyer zhun a ru ba ru sga// bu ram bsdus pa'i 'jam bshal btang bar bya// rgyu mar dom mkhris 'o ma sbyangs la btang // tsha ba skyes na rgyu ma'i rtsa lagatar// rgyu ma lug na chu dang chang gis bkru// de nas tsha ba gsum gyi khu btsags bkru// lto tshil drod phab nang du 'jug tshul bstan// gdong la chu gdab dngangs pas nang du 'drongs// yang na gre bar sgro bcug skyugs pas tshud// sha pags rta rkyang rgyus pas sbal 'gros rtsem// rma sman dar dang mar phying 'jag gis dkri// de rting gos phud bcug la dal bus skyom/ de yis rgyu

500 ༄gyi grwa nga byu'im rang sar 'drongs par 'gyur// 'chus sam 'khril na mi 'tsho 'chi ba yin//de nas zhag bdun bar du gan rkyal snyal// dri chu 'ong sar dong khung byas la btang // zas skom nur thug nyung shas 'jam pas bcos// gnye ma'i bcos thabs long dang khyad par med// lhang pa tshigs pa bco brgyad bsreg par bya//chu sri rgya tsha la sogs chu sman sbyar// tsha ba skyes na long rtsa gtar bar bya//gzhang la phog na tshigs pa bcu dgu bsreg / sbos na dugs bya tsha 'brab che na gtar// dri ma 'byung dka' reng bu ni rus bsu// bsam se rtsa rnams sgo phye tsam du gtar// phongs dang rkang mthil spyi gtsug drod dugs dang // tshigs pa bcu gsum pa la me btsa' bya// dang po bsil la tha ma drod du bcos// da ni tha ma log gnon rjes bcad pa ka 'byams rgyu 'byams rtags 'byams pa bcad pa gsum// de rgyu tsha 'byams ba'i dang grang 'byams gnyis// dang po don rma za kong song ba dang // rtsa kha 'bus dang rul chags them kha mthos//gnyis pa bsil sbyor thal dang kha zas dman// rgyu de drug gis rnag 'byams chad mi 'gyur// 'byams rtags don rma za kong song ba la// dang ga mi bde sha mdog sngo la skam// stod gzer rtsa chu'i tsha ba shin tu che// rnag mdog dmar tsa skabs su she rul can// de ni don gyi rma la 'dzag pa yin// rtsa kha 'bus pa rnag gseb rtsa 'brum 'byung // shed chung rnag la skye 'bri byed pa yin// rul chags dri che khu rtsigs can du 'dzag / mig sprin ser la dang ga skye 'bri byed//gsang phyis khrus 'an rnag sha ma thon pa'o// them kha mthos pas khrus chu lhag ma las// bsil sbyor thal ba rtsa dal chu mdog sngo// shed chung pho mchin mi bde sbo 'khrog byed// rnag mdog sngo la dri dang rlangs pa chung // kha zas dman pa rtsa stong dang ga bde/ rnag rma dog sla la lus shed chung ba 'o// bcad thabs don rma za kong song ba la// kha zas drod spang bsil la yang ba bsten// li gri a ba rgu drus phug ron rkang // dom mkhris rma nang chu yis bkru bar bya/ rtsa phran

༄lhun na nga g.yon tan gyi da 301—gtar zhing glo gso sman mar sbyar// rtsa kha 'bus na 'bras bu'i rgyun sbyongs bya//mkhris sna chur sbyangs rma bkru khong du btang // gang nye'i rtsa gtar rtsa 'phrang me yis bsdam// kha zas bsil bsten spyod lam drag shul spang / rul chags bul tog tsha la ru rta dang // a ru sbyar ba'i chu yis rma nang bkru// phag pa'i ze ba'i ye 'us rul chags brud// de rting ga bur tsan dan chu yis bkru// mu zi'i sman mar rwa sna'i phyi ma sbyar// them kha mthos na zhag gsum rnag kha bskyil//rtsib ma'i go bar tshigs bar phug la bcos/ bsil sbyor thal ba se 'brus me drod gso// lug sha gong sreg sha dang gsar 'jam btang / tshwa sna tshogs tshad bsdus pa'i khaṇḍa la// mar gsar mngar gsum sbyar ba'i ting khrol btang //kha zas dman la rta thong 'phyi ba'i sha / mi sha mar dang bu ram gar chang btang // rtsa ba lnga yi sman mar mchog tu phan// zhes gsungs so bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag mi rgyud las byang khog stod smad gso ba'i le'u ste brgyad cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //

502le'u gru drug pa/ yan lag gi rma gso ba/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// lus kyi yan lag bzhi la mchon phog na// de la rtags da/ bcos thabs ci ltar bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa dang / ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / yan lag rma la gnad dang spyi rtags dang // bcos pa'i thabs dang log gnon rnam bzhis bstan// gnad ni nya men rtsa rus chu rgyus lnga// de la dang po nya yi gnad bstan pa// phrag pa'i steng na nya sha nag po'i gnad// me long steng na 'bros sha khra bo'i gnad// sogs pa'i kha 'khor snar sha khug pa'i gnad//dpung pa'i nya la sul sgo bdun yod de// dpung tshigs mtshams nas sor ba'i lug gzhug gnad// lag ngar nya mo sdang la rgyus pa 'dra// nya sul dgu dang nya chen rnam gnyis yo da// 'khrig ma'i tshigs dang gru mo gzhu mchog nas//'khyid gang sor drug bcal ba nya snying gnad// lag mgo'i mtheb mdzub bar na gar sha'i gnad// dbyi yi sha ni rgya gram dag tu gnas// chang bzung steng gi sha rgod gnyan pa'i gnad// brla la sul sgo bcu gsum dar sbams 'dra//brla sgang sor gnyis sgang sha dkar mo'i gnad// gnyan gong sor bzhi sbal pa nag po'i gnad// byin nya sul med smyug ma spams pa 'dra// byin pa'i dkyil na nya mad rnam pa gsum// sre long steng nas 'khyid gang nya mo'i gnad// de nas sor drug bcal ba byin snying gnad// / de ltar nyi shu rtsa gnyis skrangs pa'i gnad// smin bu'i gnad ni skyogs ra'i tshigs mtshams nas// phrag gong sor

〉gyi mnang ga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 503dzad ——bzhi smin bu mgo sngon gnad// kyi khros sna nas gyen du sor lnga na// dpung pa'i rmin bu smug po gnas pa yin// pus mo'i ba zur tshigs kyi mtshams na yar//mtho gang bcal ba smin bu dkar po'i gnad// de nas sor gsum sbrul mgo gdengs pa'i gnad// de brgyad lhog thabs spangs dang srog 'phrog gnad//rtsa gnad rlung rtsa /zig rtsa gnyis 'dom rtsa// de la rlung rgyu ba yi rtsa dkar ni//dpung pa'i lug gzhug phyi mchan chu rtsa'i gnad// spu mo'i bar na rlung rtsa ratna'i gnad// pus mo'i gnyan gong rus rtsa snyed bu'i gnad// sre long phyi long bar na rgyungs rtsa'i gnad// mthe bong spu skyes rgyus pa spar mgo'i gnad//de bcu rlung 'phyo bya ba nyams pa'i gnad// khrag rtsa me long 'og gi sngon bu dang // u zur khug pa dpung nang dung 'bud drug / glo ba'i rtsa yin nang du thigs gsog gnad// skyogs ra'i tshigs mtshams gser gyi ka ba'i gnad//mnag chen mnyer ring mkhris rtsa skya ring gnad// mkhris rtsa de bzhin mkhris tshad skye ba'i gnad// snod ka ru thung brla nang rtsa bo che// mchin rtsa smad gsum de brgyad khrag 'chor gnad/ dpyi yi kha bzar mkhal rtsa na gu dang // brla sgang steng gi mkhal rtsa rus zhen dang // brla yi phyi zur mkhal rtsa rkang 'degs drug / brla yi phyi zur mcher pa'i rtsa nag gnyis// de brgyad bad kun grang ba skyed pa'i gnad// de ltar nyi shu rtsa drug khrag rtsa'i gnad// rlung khrag gnyis 'dom 'phar ba'i snying rtsa ni// rkang pa'i mthil na ga 'ag 'dra mthil 'phrog gnad// bol gong steng na mgul rtsa nag po'i gnad// nang long nang khud lcags kyi sran ma'i gnad// ngar gdong thur bar gser rtsa ka gdung gnad//dgab khung nang na dgab rtsa nag po'i gnad// sne rtsa khud na snying rtsa mig dmar gnad// lag mthil srin lag 'og na myur ba'i gnad// mdzod pu chung gi 'og na 'gul rtsa'i gnad// rus pa 'bor po'i steng na blta rtsa'i gnad// mar zur chu ba'i bar na bla rtsa'i gnad// gru mo nang khud a so li

304 grwa nga rgyud ba'i/ma'i gnad// mchan khung nang na snying rtsa rngul 'du'i gnad// de ltar rtsa bzhi khug par rgyus pa la// phyi ru 'bur bas gnad du bstan pa ste// stod du tsha ba 'chor zhing 'chi ba'i gnad// rus pa'i gnad la tshigs dang rus phran gnyis//tshigs chen bcu gnyis dpyi dang dpung pa dang // pus mo gru mo khrig ma'i long tshigs rnams// yar mar sor bzhi lha bar bcas pa ni// tshigs kyi khongs su 'dus te gnyan pa yin// rus lhag dpyi sogs lha nga long bu dang // sre long zan rtse spun mangs la sogs pa// nyi shu rtsa drug na zhing sbyong ba'i gnad// chu rgyus gnad ni nyid khung gru mo dang // 'khrig ma rting chu chu ba sbal mgo bcu//chu ba rgyab la rgyus pa mdun na gnas// 'a dang rengs par byed pas gnad ces bya// de yang rtsa dang men bu rab gnyan te// nya chigs 'bring yin chu rgyus tha mar bshad// rtsa las snying rtsa rab tu gnyan pa ste// mkhris rtsa rlung rtsa 'bring yin gzhan rnams tha// nya las byin snying sbal nag rab tu gnyan// brla sha 'bring yin nya sha tha mar bshad// tshigs la pus mo dpung pa rab tu gnyan//dpyi dang gru mo 'bring yin tshigs gzhan tha// rus lhag long bu sre long rab tu gnyan// dbyi sogs 'bring yin gzhan dag tha ma 'o// chu rgyus sgyid chu rab tu gnyan pa ste// gru mo 'bring yin gzhan dag tha ma 'o// tshigs dang chu rgyus chu rtsa rlung gi gnad// glo snying mkhris rtsa mkhris pa'i gnad du bshad// rtsa bo che dang mchin rtsa khrag gi gnad// mcher mkhal rtsa dang nya men bad kun gnad//de ltar gnad kyi gnas lugs shes pa yis// 'chi sbyong gso bla zha rengs kha mar thogs / gnyis pa gnad kyi spyi rtags bstan pa ni// sbyi ru mod la lhog thabs skrangs pa 'am// zug gzer che 'am rdos bu bcug pa 'dra// me ltar 'bar ram chu ltar bsil ba ste// mdor na lus ni gnad la phebs par byed//de dag gso dka' 'chi yang srid pa yin// khyad par nya gnad rnams la mtshon phog na// mod la tsha shing rma chas tshan mo phan// srug nag sngo khra dmar

wu man nga g.yon tan gyi da 305khra me lce ris// zug che rdo ltar sra la reg mi bzod/ rnag mdog dmar la rtsigs can skad gdangs zhan// men bu rnam brgyad zhar na bcos su med//btsan brdungs mod du lhog thabs skrangs pa dang // zug che tsha ba skye la smra ngag thung // nya sgang chu ser 'dzag cing dri mi zhim// rlung rtsa rnams la mtshon phog 'phyo 'dar byed// mig rtsa rgod cing g.yal dang skyigs bu 'byung // gnyid chung kha mig yo la ja log skrangs khyad par lug gzhug chu rtsa chod gyur na//lag pa bshal sbrid bya ba nyams par 'gyur/ rlung rtsa ra rgongs dang tho rangs na// dngangs shing g.yal dang skyigs bu btud nas 'ong // rus rtsa skyed bu dngangs shing lhog thabs spangs/ rkyal pa bus 'dra mgo na blab chol smra// rgyud rtsa ltag dgye so 'tham dri chu sdom// pir mgo dngangs 'dar zug che g.yang chu mi// glo rtsa sngon bu ngam nag skyigs bus 'debs 'dar zhing dngang la glo lu tsha ba skye// glo rtsa khug pa sogs phrag gzer ba dang / mgo na dpung pa bshal la 'jing pa rengs/ dung 'bud gsog cing gzer la bus ltar bi ngas// rkang lag mkhris rtsa bzhi po gang nyen yang // mgo na mig chu rma la bzhin rnams ser / kha kha dang ga mi bde skom dad che// lus lci rma chas tshan mo nye thabs med// brla nang co chen chod na khrag mi thub// chu dad che la smad 'phyes khong pa 'khrog / mchin rtsa mod la khrag mi thub pa la// smad lci sgrog skyugs khrag rul dri can 'dzag / snod ka ru thung khrag chod dka' bar 'gyur mkhal rtsa rma chas grang mo nye thabs med// smad 'phyes rkang pa bshal sbrid dbyi mig zug chu sri rna ba 'on la phrum ser khyer// mcher rtsa sbo sgrog rlan can nye thabs med// khrag rul 'dzag cing smad 'phyes rgyu long 'khrog / mgo na lus lce ngam nag tsha ba skye// snying gi 'phar rtsa gang chod khrag mi thub// gdong pa ser la g.yal mang 'bog tshul ston/ btsan brdungs skrangs dmar rtsa rgyud 'khrid cing na// rma 'khyims rtsa kha 'bud cing gzhan du 'byer// zhag gsum

306 rdzi grwa nga dab —lon nas tsha ba stod du 'chor / mgo na phrum ser khyer la mig rtsa grung // snaskam lce rtsa sngo la so dreg chags// dbugs thung glo snying mi bde skom dad che//khyad par mthil 'phrog myur ba stong skyugs byed// mgo na dngangs 'dar zug che snying ga gzer// blta rtsa brla rtsa de bzhin gnyid med bying // a so rngul 'du mgo na glo snying 'dar// pho ba mi bde skyug cing blab chol smra// snying rtsa mig dmar snying sprug rkang pa 'dar// snying rtsa nag po khrag 'chor skrangs par byed// ka gdung dgu nas khrag 'chor skyigs bu 'byung // 'gul rtsa byin rengs skyug cing sor mo 'khums// tshigs gnad mde 'u mi dam sdom pa bla//zhag gsum nang du sna nas tshigs chu sdugs// brkyang bskum mi shes zug che kha lce skam// mgo na sbyin pa skyur la stong skyugs byed// long bu la phog bco lnga bcu dgu la// mdog snum lus 'dar rngul 'byung shes pa 'gyur// zug gzer che na mkhas kyang thub mi 'gyur// sre long gsum na bshul rengs ltag pa dgye// lus rengs so 'tham glang thabs dag tu smra// bdun dang dgu las tshe tshad med de 'chi// dpyi dang sogs pa lha nga pran rtse rnams// zug che skrangs thing rnag thag ring bar 'gyur// rkang sleb zug ju ja 'das gdon pa dka'//lha ba nag po rus pa tsha bam 'gyur// chu rgyus bcad na rengs 'gyur rma gting nub// phug ba 'gas rnag chu rtsigs can bye 'phongs 'ong // gsum pa bcos pa'i thabs la rnam pa drug / nyes byed dus dang sbyar te bcos pa dang // phog sa gnas dang sbyar te bcos pa dang // rim pa shugs dang sbyar te bcos pa dang // dus gsum dpe dang sbyar te bcos pa dang / gnyan pa gnad dang sbyar te bcos pa dang // man ngag skabs dang sbyar te bcos pa 'o// dang po nyes byed dus dang sbyar ba ni// dang po zhugs pa khrag gi dus yin pas// dar ma mkhris shas che la 'ag lnga dgug / byis pa bad dan che la 'ag gsum ste/ rgas sam rlung khams can la 'ag gcig go / de yis skrangs pa mi rgyas khrag mi

lta nang ga yon tan gyi rgyud/ 507skye// zug chung gnad la mi nye khrag 'byor byed// rma chas spang ma bzang po legs bsros la// de la zho yi kha phru btab la dkri// rtsa 'am tshigs la phog na rgya skyegs bsnan// yang na sbang 'im mkhan pa sbyar bsros la lcam 'brum phabs dang g.yer ma'i thal gyis bran// zho yi kha phru btab la non par dkri 'phrod par gyur na ma sos bar du shes// de yis ma thub skrangs srid dmar sbyor bya// btsod zhun rams tshos rdo dreg dmar pos mnan// bar du rgyas pa chu ser dus yin pas// sha la skrangs shor gyur na gar po dang / bag phye 'bru mar smod btab a sa sa bdug / des ma thub na ser po'i sbyor bas gdul//yu nga skyer chu rtsa zhu mkhan rjen phye zho// zhun dang nan ni gang 'phrod skrangs la dris// yang na yung ba skyer pa chu rtsa dang // zhu mkhan ba bla sdong ros zhun nan bya// des ma thub na khra bo'i chas kyis gdul// yung skyer chu rtsa btsod zhun pho tshos rams// so thog wa sbyang gong mo sbri yi brun// ri bong ril ma'i zhun nan gang 'phrod sbyar// yang na wa spyang ri bong gong mo'i brun// grog zhing thal ba so thog grog tshang sa// sa zhag btsod rams zhu mkhan rgya skyegs dang // yung skyer chu rtsa sbang gar rjen phye sbyar// 'tshos par btsos la skrangs pa non par btang //cis kyang ma thub nag po'i lums kyis gdul// khyi lud re cag spyang tsher rtsa ba dang // dug gsum brun bzhi rgya skyegs gu gul rnams// rjen phye mar nag sbyar btsos zhun du gzhug / gang rgyas rtsa nas gtar zhing khong nas sbyang // thul rtags spangs pa'i mdog shor cung zad skya// zug bri gnyer chung 'byung ngam rnam tu khugs// rnag med spangs pa sngo skya na tsha che// glad rul tsha dang sbyar la khyab par byug / mkhan sbang lcam 'bru g.yer phabs 'jibs su gzhug / yang na tshos btsod zhu mkhan tsha ba gsum// sbang gar sbyar la rtse 'jam khyab par byug / tsha la drod che skrangs la bsil zhun shis/ tha ma smin pa rnag gi dus yin pas// rnag tu 'gro rtags skrangs pa'i mdog mi 'gyur// 'phar zhib mi

55 zhug nga dba'i byed brtan zhing sra la skreb// de rjes rnag g.yos skrangs mdog dmar la gdang // rkyal pa bus ltar mtha' dbus med par rgyangs// dros tshe gas ltar tsha 'khyug reg mi bzod// lus snyong gnyid med kha bla dang ga 'gag / de nas rnag tu smin nas mig sprin ser// chu ldog bsku dugs rtsa rgyud 'dar la srun/ skrangs pa mtha' nas 'jum zhing dbus su 'dus// skabs su ldang dub tsha 'khyug ba sru 'gyel// mtho bas skrangs pa kun snyoms rdzis pa'i tshe// 'bri mig srubs 'dra bu ga stongs kyis 'byung // spangs kyi gong 'og gnyis nas mthe bos mnan// rkyal chu lta bur rlung nyid phan tshun rgyu// rnag byer rus thog gram dang sul kha yan// spangs chung zug che lus rtsi dang ga 'gag / smin rtags mi gsal de la byer sdud gces// sga dang mar rnying tshil chen dogs sar byug /a sa sa bdug cing mtha' nas chu lcag bdeg / yang na tsha phabs glad pa byugs byas la// steng du byi brun sbang skam lums kyis bdug / yang na byi brun nu zho sbyar bas byug / de yis byer 'dus smin pa'i rtags tshang na// dbug thabs sngon du chang phul phyed btang te// mtha' nas bcings te gar babs legs myangs la// sha 'gros sbyar te lag nyams blang zhing bdug / rma kha bul dang rnag las sbyar bar bya// rgyus mde thur mas 'gags pa bsal zhing sbyang //rtsa chod khrag shor spu dang zor pa rdzang // rjes la leb rgan dar gyi them bu gzhug / rnag pra brtag pa dud ka ko rul dri// sla la sbru phran sir ba ngan pa yin// dri chung dkar 'jam gar ba bzang ba yin// zhag gsum bar du spang ma'i rnag 'jibs btang // deb chas ra mo sha dang mtshe yi khu// gar po sgo nga ba zho bag phye dang // 'bru mar sbyar ba ra ri med par byug / yang na ra mo 9 yi thal ba dang // lham rtsa yu nga ba chu rtsa ldong ros dang // bag phye sbang gar byugs te phying deb btang // pus rngo tshig mig rnams su phying pa brtseg / de steng mtha' nas 'jag gi deb 'chings bya / hrem na skabs su chas dkrol lums su

༄khan nga yon tan gyi da/ 309gzhug / 'byar gyis zug gzer skyes na 'bol chas bya// phog sa gnas dang sbyar te bcos pa ni// sha yi gnad la 'jib zhun nan gyis bcos rtsa yi gnad la me gtar sman gyis bcos// tshigs kyi gnad la deb 'chings phyogs kyis bcos// gnyen po'i bcos dgu spyi ru 'khrul ba gces// 'jibs kyis rma yi chu ser phyir la drang / zhun gyis rma yi spangs pa bzhu ba ste// nan gyis byer sbos skrangs pa rang sar mnan// me yis rtsa yi zug bcag 'bros 'phrang bsdam// gtar gyis khrag ngan chu ser phyir la dbyung // sman gyis rma khong gnyis kyi nyes pa bsal// deb kyis rnag chu byer ba gcar la gdab//'chings kyis nan dang deb gnyis rang sar gzhag / rgyogs kyis tshigs kyi 'phrul 'khor bsdam pa gces// dang po 'jib la tsha na chang 'gags spang ma mkhan paphabs yer ma lcam 'bru bsros pa bsil ba tshan lo sbyar ba'am kyi lce par pa ta lug ngal ra zho sbyar bsnyoms pal sings po'i nga mgyi lce gsum// zhun la phog sa 'du ba dus gnad bstun// phog sa yul dang sbyar na sha 'dul la is bdang// nya 'dul la nya ba sna tshos sa btsos pa na bu 'dul ba la na bu sna tshogs bcos pa dang rtsa 'dul la khrig rtsags btsos pa dang // nus pa la mi rta khyi'i nus pa btsos pa chu sal ma ba'i 'i ma sa ba dreg ba'i la zho btsos 'bru mar sbyar bas 'dul ba'o// gnod byed dus dang sbyar na rlung lasgrum bzhi tsha spod btsos pa mkhris pa'i tigatams kyi stong len zho btsos khrag la dmar po gsum bad gan lag yer mtsha ba gsum dbyi mong na gye dar bar btsos 'dus pa la bra bo'i zhun gyisaskrangs pa 'dul ba 'o// nyes byed dus dang sbyar na khrag dus zhun dmar po/ chu ser zhun ser po dang rnag dus zhun phur yo ga ru'i lab rjen zho bcas sam nag spyoragasum mo// thor bu nad dang sbyar ba'i zhun drug ste// rnag sna gsum zhugs khros pa rang sar 'dul ba la tsha phabs dpa byugs ) byi byan sbang skam btsos pa/ rtsa nad byer sdud la mkhan pam tshe spang spos ma btsos pa gnyan nad skrangs pa 'dul bal mu 'dzim pa ga sha shu dag pe rgyang gsum gyi byan gar po rnams rma gan 'bras 'dul ba lar

310 sa /grwa thang rgyud ba /cags mnya mi'i nus pa lcaṭa shing zug ju 'byin pa lar ril la tshil dri chur btsos pasabadug / nan la tshigs chen bam po bsgrang ba'i nan bkyi stong len bragazhun zho sbyar babyug / tshigs bar 'phrul sdom pa la ra khrag tshil mtshe bag gye zho chag pa gnas su sbyor//bal rtsod khrig tshe nab ga gye gar po sha gyer skrangs 'dul la brag zhun da pa dri chu naphyesbyar sul rnag gcar la 'debs pa sgong nye shing gar po rjen rtse sbyar rul myags 'thas byed la ru phur yog dris mgug par na ra'o rjen mar nag skyi byer srun pa'i nan la du dpa slang dreg mar dkar/ med ngan spangs 'dul bal brag zhun glad rulatshaphabs sbyar gnyan dang lhog pa 'joms pa 'a mu zi 'dzin pa stag sha kyi shu dag rwa sa nob spyang byan dri chu sbyar de yang na so nad khams nam zla yis// rta dang grang dro mthug srab shes par byos// me ni rtsa chad khan pu 'dzud pa'i me ri rma the bos rma nan na khrig phreng sar spra ba lngas 'bros pa'i lam 'gegs pa la mi dmar 5so khrag tshad stong la gnon pal mod la gong sor ba'i ra skrangs kyi sna 'don pa la byungs sna sul snar rtsa byer dbus su sdud pal ri bo'i la me rgyas dab a na'i zug gcog na gang zengs ra rus zan men pa 'drub pa la rma steng du chu ser ma sa mas gdab gtar ga skrangs kyi mgo gnon nasang nye lam du tsha rlangs gsod na gang rgyas la gzer ba'i zug gcog na gang khrid la khrag shor 'ol kha sgyur na rgyud gong 'og la rus bam nyes sel na gang lakhrag cas rma mdog 'byin na rma brud la khrig dbyung sman ni rtsa chad khad bu 'dzud pa'i sman la dbyar 5lo dgun rtsa ba'i re bu la gur gum dom mkhris nya mkhris 'bu byugasalabardzang / / khrag shor khong sped na mkhan skyer gur gum dom mkhris shing tsha re skon rtsa byer dbus su sdud na da lis kyi lce shing mngar khaṇḍa bzang drug rmi khris sna da trig tshos chu ser rnag skems la mu zi ba ru dor mkhris ma ba sa byag rnam par cu gang ka ra rma chen khong nas gso ba la sgo skya 'bras yo sa bya brag spos ka ra nga / sha ra na gcod la dur byin rgya tsha yung ba ru ba'i pa sha 'u bu ltar gso ba'i dom mkhris gur gum rgya drus brag spos tsha la tshal ka ra deb la gan lan sogs pa gas deb sbyags la 'jagasogs tsā de bsgrings la bong

༄cu/man nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 511sru re ba la ga gas sogs spu deb dang / gye ba la shog de brtsa da pa la shing deb rnag laphying deb rnam pa drug / de la 'og tu mo de bsteng du pho de bcugs mig 'khor bar yang deb bo// chings la skrangs pal chag chings ga pal gson chings rnag la 'ded chings dang // nyaga'i la ma da'achas chings dang tshigs la sdom chings de la bdun/sogs par 'khor lo gshog rgyangs chings su bcing ba la dpung pa nas ma na 'og tu blangs la bcing ste 'gyen shing yod da gnyis so dpung pa la ni sum sgrog 'dzum chings tem chan 'og nas len pa dang 'gyin thag nas len pa gnyis so/ gru mor bsnol chings ni steng 'og gnyis nas 'khris mar re lde chings ni yas len sa len bya//dpyi la rwa rgyangs dra ba chings su bcing / pus mo drug 'chings ni bsnol chings skyor chings gnyis long tshigs pon bu lhas ni yas len mas len gnyis so/ rgyu dar chen then dri zar sa la zheng tshan na gyi sogs dang rma med la sor gsum phal ral gnyis zan ru dang thamang na gcig gnas kyis sbyar// dmas na zug skye lhod na chas mi chags/ bcings nyes ther srungs shor na deb mi non/ dam du dril la phyi nang rang 'gros bcing skyorgyogs la rgyu dang dbye ba bskur ba'i yul// gzhug dus dbral dus dmas dang lhod pa'i skyon// nang tshangs bsdam tshan bsdam thabs nyes pa'i skyon legs pa'i yon tan rnam grangs bcu gnyis so// de rgyu gsom dang glang ma lcang ma sogs// drang bshon gcu mdzer med yang skam pa la// thig nas zhigs bston 'chus dang 'phra sbom med/ khong ldem shed snyoms tshad dang ldan par bca'// dbye ba rnam gnyis shing bzo rigs kyis dbye// bskur ba'i dus kyis dbye ba rnam pa gnyis// dang po tshigs rgyogs dang rkang la khra dang gnas ma nges pa la byi ze 'o// rgyogs la sgrom rgyogs tshems yod med sba rgyogs gyi dra nang dra bsil rgyogs 'khrul ma gsum/ khra la rus chag gnas su sbyor ba'i khra// sha yi steng 'phyang rang sar ldem pa'i khra// nya sul rnag 'khyims gcar 'debs khra dang gsum// byi ze sbang chod kha 'dzin byi ze dang // khrag shor rgya 'khyims bca'

512 ༄ grwa nga rgyud ba'i/rnaba'i byi ze dang // 'byin thabs zug ju dbyung ba'i byi ze gsum// bkur dus dbye ba bsil rgyogs dra ba can dang khong seng can drod rgyogs sgrom rgyogs pags pa ba ba dang // skam rgyogs rnag khrag 'dzas pa la gsher rgyogs dra ba khong sang can phyi rgyogs nang rgyogs dang // sdom rgyogs glod rgyogs rnam pa brgyad du bshad// bkur yul tshigs don rkang chag chu ba dgye// khrag shor yul stongs tshigs 'khor rnag la gzhug / gzhug dus rma yi skrangs dang tsha ba chogs// rnag sga rul chod dgos dus drug tu gzhug / rkang chag pa dang khrag shor ma gtogs pa / bam rul rnams la skabs su gseng ba gces// dbral dus tshigs thor rme la du tshud pa dang // rus chag 'byor 'ing tshigs kyi 'khor ba sdoms// chu ma dud chags dang rtsa la khad pu tshud// mi yi steng 'byor rnag gzhug chod pa dang // rkang lag zungs thub 'gro nus gyur na dbral// dmas skyon lhang skyog che la gong 'og skrangs// skom dad che la gnyid med stong skyugs byed// dang ga mi bde mgo na rna ba 'ur// de rtags ldan na shing chas cung zad glod// lhod skyon chag po tshigs 'khrul sor mi sdod// rnag khrag mi chod nad kyi zug mi chogs// chu ba'i sna 'bros chag bsnol ring thung byung // de la shing chas cung zad bsdam par bya// nang tshangs rnga ma ras sbod thems ldan gces// ya yo snyoms dang sdom pa 'dir rag lus// bsdam tshad dam sa lhod skyon dang bral ba ste//bsdam thabs mtha' nas bsdam 'ing dbus nas dgrol// nyes skyon lus dang ma 'tshams chag bsnol 'gyur// shing gi byer zug ma snyoms zug mi chogs//gzhug pa nyes na rengs dang 'khums par 'gyur// shing la khong seng med na tsha bam skye// de las log pa legs pa'i yo na tan te// btsa' rdzi bla zhing gsos pa myur bar 'gyur rim pa shugs dang sbyar nas bcos pa ni / dang po khrag shugs khrag tshad rma gsar gdul// gnyis pa mkhris pa'i shugs 'byung tsha ba bcag / gsum pa chu ser shugs las spangs pa gzhom// bzhi pa rnag gi

wu/man ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 513shugs la dbug cing bcad// lnga pa ma nges shugs la gang byung bsal// drug pa rlung shugs rma khong bcud kyis gso// bdun pa bad kun shugs las red pa sbyang // de dag man ngag skabs bzhin shes par bya// dus gsum dpe dang sbyar te bcos pa ni// dang po rma rgod skrangs pa zhun gyis gdul/ bar du rnag shor phug la thar gyis sbyang // tha ma sha gso then rtas ngar gyis gdags// zhun du gzhug la rma gsar skrangs pa gnyis// rma gsar dang po 'jibs kyis gdul bar bya/ sbang zhim legs btsir wa sbyang khyi yi brun// sbyar ba'i 'jibs kyis rlung 'dul chu ser 'jib// de 'og skrangs na nan zhun lums kyis gdul//dmar ser skya sbyor nag po khra bo lnga// kun la dbye bas bsil drod rnam pa gnyis// gang yang nan du sbyor na zhib btags la// tse 'jam bsros la lug zho tsam gyis byug / thog deb sru deb btang la 'jag gis dkri// zhun du spyor na zhib btags 'tshos bar btso// 'o zan tsam gyi mdag pa byugs pa'i steng //hel srab btang la dkris mas dkri bar bya// lums su sbyor na khram khrum brdungs la btso// chu chod hel ge'i khud du bstums la bdug / yang na grang mo kho na'i bsil lums bya// de ltar zhun du bcug pa'i yon tan ni/ rlung 'dul chu ser 'jib cing skrangs pa 'joms// khrag mkhris rtsa yi tshad pa 'don par byed// skyon ni brun gyis rtsa yi khad bu 'chor// spod gyis khrag mkhris rtsa rus tshad pa skyed// snum gyis nya yi chas 'dred bad mkhris slong // de phyir gang la gang 'tshams dus dang sbyor// bar du rnag bston thar gyis sbyang ba ni//'jibs dang khrus kyis rnag sha thon pa dang // skya sbyor ser sbyor dmar po nag po'i nan// bad mkhris khrag dang rlung gi bye brag sbyar// ya nga na rnag mdog dmar po sngon po dang // dud kha dmar rtsa skya bo'i rigs dang sbyar// yang na skrangs pa yod med la dam ra ser gyi chas sam yang na lham rtsa yung ba chu pa nga ros ra mnye'i thalab bag gar po'i nan sbyar ba'i// nan gyi skyo ma byugs te phying pa btang // nya

514 sto grwa thang dab sul phying ba'i grangs sbyar lus dbyibs bskun// tshigs la rus mgo khol bton tshigs mig dang // rus pa'i dbyibs dang sbyar ba'i gying pa btang //tshigs mig sul steng pho deb nyis rim btang // rnag 'khyims yang deb btang la 'chings gyis bcing / 'byar gyi yon tan rnag 'khyims gcar la 'debs//skrangs kyi byer sdud bye sbos rang sar gnon// rtsa yi kha 'dzin chag pa gnas su sbyor// tshigs bar 'khrul sdom chu rgyus 'them la 'debs// nyes skyon sngas na spangs 'byer rnag sha lngas// rnag lam 'gags na zug skye rul myags 'gyur//sbos pa hags ma byas na sul du 'byer// pags bye gzer ma btab na 'byor ba dka'/ de phyir dus tshod thabs la mkhas pas sbyar// tha ma men rtas ngar du gdags pa ni// 'o ma rjen gye mar dkar a sa sa mnan// spod sna mar sbyar phying ba re bal btsos chen pa'i steng du bkab la dkris mas bcing //g.yer mas chu ser 'dren zhing bad kun sel// rma tshad gcog byed rma gsar dus su shis// 'di dus mi btang rlung 'byer rma 'tsho dka'// gnyan pa gnad dang sbyar la bcos pa ni// nywa gnad rnams la mtshon phog a sa sa bdug / yang na tsha ba'i 'jibs su gzhug par bya// ma thub sbang gar mkhan chung lug sho dang // rga spod mar nag rjen phye'i zhun du gzhug / ma thub nywa sna sna tshogs nya rmang ma'i rgod g.yung rta bong ra lug ba glang mdzo dril gcan gzan bya khyi mi'i nya sha'abyamar dri chur btsos pa'i lums kyi gdul// des kyang ma thul tsha grang rnam pa gnyis// tsha 'khros yung skyer lham rtsa ldong ros dang // bag phye zho dang sbyar ba'i nan gyis mnan// yang na kyi lce dkar po par pa ta// lug ngal ba dang ra zho sbyar bas mnan// grang 'khros spyang ki la sogs gcan gzan sha / 'ug pa bya rgod drod can sha chang btsos// bag phye mar khu phabs spod zhun gyis gdul//khyad par dpung pa'i lug gzhug rnam gnyis la// mkhan sbang sga spod zho mar rjen phye'i zhun// gar po glad pa nya lcibs tshwa btsos glan// lag ngar nywa la sbang

zhu/mnang g.yon tan gyi da 515gar mkhan pa dang // lca 'brum ra zho mtshe khu'i zhun du gzhug / brla la sbang gar mkhan pa glad pa dang // bag phye chu rtsa sbyar ba'i zhun du gzhug / sbal pa nag po sbang ma chang 'gags dang // spru ma dud pa tsha phabs sbyar bas gdul//byin pa'i nya la 'dzo rtsi sbang gar dang // gong mo'i brun sbyar bsros pa'i nan du btang // glo snying mi bde tshigs pa drug pa bsreg / mgo bo na na a so ru thung gtar// 'bros sha gdar sha sgo nga ra phag khrag / gcin dang ra zho bong spus mnan pa dang ca gnya' sha 'jibs zhun spyi ltar bcos par bya// then bu'i gnad brgyad a dkar kyi lce nag / lcags phye so thog hong len ba sha ka / tig ta ra zho byugs te phying deb btang // a dkar kyi lce so thog lcags gye rams/zhu mkhan bag phye 'bru mar btsos sbyar mnan// yang na dud pa shu dag kyi lce dang // spang spos sbang gar sbyar bas byug par bya// ma thub men bu sna tshogs lums kyis gdul// khong du ga bur gla rtsi a dkar btang // rlung rtsa rnams la rtsa rgyud rlung gsang bsrung // rma la 'ba' cha a sa phabs dang spod// mkhan pa skum rnams bsros pas yang yang bdug / ma thub dzā ti shing kun spa pi ling //bca' sga rgyam tsha go stod mkhan pa phabs// bu ram glum nye dro bar bsros pas bdug / khong du gsar bcud gsum dang mngar gsum gyi// ting khrol shing kun cur nis btang bar bya// kha mig yo na spu 'khyil tshu rol bsreg / rlung khrag sdongs na bsil gtar rigs pas dpyad// khyad par rlung rtsa ratna bcos pa ni// chang 'gags sbang ma mkhan pa tsha ba gsum// lca 'brum mar nag tshil phran dron mos dril// yang na a sa 'ol gom 'ba' chas bdug / rma nas mtshon gang bcal ba'i gong 'og bsreg / smyo lab an stong 'dar na drug pa bsreg / dpung pa'i chu rtsa a sa'am dmar po'i lums/ rtsa rgyud gong 'og mchan phugs sgrogs rus gshongs// dpung tshigs lag mthil spra ba lnga yis bsrung // nus rtsa snyed bu phying pa snum ldan bdug / ma thub sbal nag lta bur

516 zhu/grwa thang dab /zhun du gzhug / blab chol smra na sne rtsa spyi gtsug bsreg / glo snying mi bde tshigs pa bdun pa bsreg / bshul pa rengs na sgang rtsa nag po bsreg / spar mgo gzhung rtsa sbang ma mkhan pa phabs// nas tshig zho dang sbyar la 'jibs su btang // gzhung rengs ltag dgye rtsa nag chu mgo bsreg / mgo bo na na 'gul rtsa nag po bsreg / so 'thams nang long rtsa dang gdong rtsa bsreg / lus po 'dar na dgab khung snying rtsa bsreg / snying rtsa'i rma rnams gser gyi khan pu gzhug / mig dmar a so li ga myur du bsrung / rkang lag mthil ba'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsreg / khong du thang dang ga bur bdun dgu btang // rgya skyegs tig ta tshan dkar par pa ta// ra zho sbyar la bsros pa'i 'jibs su gzhug /rtsa kha sdom zhing rlangs 'bor khrag ro 'ju// gang rgyas rtsa la gtar zhing ma thub na// rtsa rgyud gong 'og gtar te bsreg par bya// khyad par mthil 'phrog myur ba rnam gnyis la// mar tshil skra shad steng du chu rdos bdug / dreg kha 'khor ba'i phying ba snum ldan btang // rta sbangs zho sbyar rma la 'jibs su sbyar//mkhan sbang glad pa go stod tsha ba gsum// zho dang sbyar ba rgyab kyi 'jibs su btang // khyad par mthil 'phrog nang long bol rtsa bsreg / rgyu ma na na nya gzhug rgyu rtsa bsreg / rked pa 'khor na gdab rtsa bsreg pa dang // mgo bo na na pir mgo bsreg par bya// glo snying mi bde blab chol smra na 'chi// myur ba'i blta rtsa bla rtsa bsreg par bya// spangs na btsod zhun rams tshos spod sna tshogs//g.yer ma lca 'brum gar po bag phye zho/ 'bru mar sbyar ba 'tshos par btsos pas bdug / 'gul rtsa la phog skyug na an stong bsreg / byin rengs spar mgo ngar gdong chu ba bsreg / sor mo 'khums na sbang gar a sa sa bdug /gser rtsa ka gdung sne rtsa dgab khung bsreg / mdzod chung snying rtsa blta rtsa bla rtsa bsreg / ga bur bdun pa dzā ti mkhris sna btang // tsha ba 'a' bsil ba'i nan steng spu deb btang // blta rtsa bla rtsa rtsa steng spugs ngos bsrung // sbang gar

༄gyi khan nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 517bag phye zho spod mar sbyar glan// a so ba sha ka dang a ka ru// hong len tig ta kyi lce par pa ta/ spang rtsi bag phye ri tho shing mngar bsnan// 'dar na dngul mdung skyug na bcu gsum bsreg / dngul mdung bcad na sgrog rus 'phar rtsa bsreg / mgo na snying gdung rtse chung dpung rtsa gtar// mig dmar mkhris pa tshogs tshad khong du btang / lab mang mig rtsa spung na snying gar bsreg / snying rtsa kun la rtsa rgyud gong 'og bsrung // khong nas tsha ba'i 'bros 'ded shes par bya// rma khong gnyis nas rtsa kha bsnam pa gces// khrag rtsa rnams la khrag shor chu yis bgrang // spru ba zor pa thar brdzang gong 'og bsrung // rgya skyegs hong len gla sgang a ru ra// spang spos sbang gar sbyar ba bdud rtsi yin// sbang ma rgya skyegs thal gyis bran la g.yog / yang na zho btsag pa 'am bsil 'jibs bya//khrag rgyas rtsa yi gzhug ma gtar ba gces// ga bur dgu pa don snod kha 'dzin sbyar// khyad par glo rtsa rnams la gong 'og bsreg / dbyar gyi dus su sngo khu zho sbyar btang / dgun gyi dus su g.yer ma lca 'brum dang // spod sna bag phye 'bru mar byugs la dkrita ma thub a dkar so tog tshos btsod rams// tig ta ba le ba sha ra zho byug / hrem na a sa sa bdug cing 'jibs su gzhug / khong sman ga bur gtso byas glo sman sbyar// mkhris rtsa rnams la tig ta ra zho dang //sbang ma hong len sbyar ba rma la glan/ yang na tig ta hong len nad ma btsod//dug nyung ka ra zho sbyar nan du btang / gsha' ring gser mdung ru thung byin long gtar/ gser gyi me tog bdun nam tig ta'i thang // bzhin lud rma kha ser ba sel bar byed// mkhris rtsa skya rings la phog glang thabs na byin pa'i nang ngos nya mtsham rtsa gzhug bsreg / gser gyi ka ba dpung 'dzum mgo sngon bsreg / mgo na lug gzhug phyi 'debs rtsa gzhug bsreg / mkhal rtsa sbang skam 'ba' cha'i lums su gzhug / des ma thub na spod nan drod lums bya//khong du gsar 'jam lug sha gsar pa btang / rkang bshal brla yi phyi sul

518 zhu/grwa nga dab /rkang 'debs bsreg / dpyi mig gzer na tshigs pa bcu bzhi bsreg / rna ba 'on na mkhal ma'i rtsa nag bsreg / dri chu sdom na mkhal rtsa rus zhen bsreg /khrag shor mkhal khung zug na dpyi mig bsreg / 'gul dka' zug che tshigs pa bcu bzhi bsreg / rnag ma chod na chu rtsa thag gu bsreg / mcher rtsa skum dang glad pa mkhan pas gdul// gong 'og mes bsrung mcher rtsa ru thung gtar//ma thub sa myag grog zhing chu rtsa spru// so thog bag phye gar po zho sbyar byug / pho ba gzer na tshigs pa bcu pa bsreg / gnyid med 'o dod 'bod na ru thung gtar// pho long sbos na ma nu bzhi thang btang // brla nang rtsa chen rtsa kha yar mar bsreg / hong len brag smos dom mkhris sgo nga dang // bag phye sbyar byugs phying ba shing byang btang // rma la bsil 'jibs long 'khrog drod sman sbyar//glang thabs byung na ngar gdong mcher rtsa gtar// tshigs pa drug bsreg 'jing rengs spyi gtsug bsreg / sbos na ni ru chu 'gags sne sa'i rtsar// dri ma 'gags na dpyi mig bsreg par bya// mchin rtsa smad gsum skam chas bsil sbyor bya// khrag shor dgab rtsa bsreg cing mkhris thang btang // ru thung snod ka la sogs spyi bzhin bcos// tshigs la mde'u lus 'ag 'ga' lon nas dbyung // rnyi ba ring na skam pas bsro bar bya// tshigs chu khrag dang 'dres na gso ba bla// rma nang dom mkhris tsher sngon a byag dang // cu gang gur gum shel ta hong len gzhug / de yis chu ser 'dren zhing tshigs chu sdom// sgo nga bag phye gar po zho sbyar byug / ma thub btsod zhun bag phye tshos sbyar byug / tsha ba che na zho btsags kho na shis// kyi rtse hong len brag zhun zho sbyar byug / khong du bsil ba'i sman btang gang rgyas gtar// zhag gsum tshun chad chu mangs bsgrang bar bya// ma thub sbang gar mtshe khu bag phye zho// bya mtshal ze khrag phag pa'i sna khrag dang // ra rog gnya' khrag bong bu'i gzhug khrag rnams// byugs steng 'chings nan phal cher skam sbyor byed// lha ba can gyi rus la rma byung na//

khanang g.yon tan gyi da/ 519rma sman gong bzhin rma chas rus 'jibs bya// lha ba byer na mgo bo bzhin du bcos// pran rtse'i rus pa 'jibs zhun 'byar 'dul gsum// sbang ro zho dang nad ma phyi yi 'jibs// tshil bu mar dkar rtsid ba dreg gi 'jibs//bar du skrangs na so thog sa myag dang // go stod da lis bag phye zho yi zhun//zug che nas tshig ri bong ril thal dang // tig ta 'bru mar zhun gyis gyi rgyab gdul// rta sbangs zho dang sbyar ba dreg gi zhun// yang na tha rams nad ma g.yu los bya// tha mar rnag gi dus su 'byar 'dul bya// sa myag zho dang bag gye sbyar ba 'am// yang na chu rtsa zho dang bag phye byug / dreg la rta sbangs khu ba bag phye dang // 'bru mar 'bri mog byugs steng phying pa btang // dreg bzhi tshil gnad sran rtse rus ba'i gnad// tshil dang dus pa'i gnad du 'dres par bcos// chu rgyus gnad rnams rlan drod thems kyis bcos// chu chen chod na rta rkyang rgyus pas btsem// rma la rgyus gsum rta bong mkhris sbyar gdab/ rdo rgyus shu dag brag spos a ru ra// gla sgang bskol zho spyin chu bag phye byug / yang na gla sgang thal ba rgyus pa gnyis/ dom mkhris bag phye sbang gar chang skyur sbyar//rgyus pa'i sha brdungs bsres te byug par bya// rma yi gong 'og phying pa brtsegs la sbyar// de steng spa srab btang la gson 'chings dang / de yi steng du shing chas bskur bar bya// khong du ra yi glad pa btsos la btang // tsha skyes phag mkhris gi waṃ ka ra sbyar// rma khar skam chas rlan dang ldan pa ste chu phran chod na hel ge sdum med ni// spyin gyis zam bur sbyar te skyo ma byug / phying pa sbyar zhing gong thog a sa sa bdug / rma la rgyus pa gsum dang dom mkhris gdabakachu ba 'khros na bul tog tshwa phyes bzhu// 'bru sna chu rgyus tshogs tshad zhun gyis gdul// chu rgyus rul te rgyus ba ldan pa 'dra// ga bur dom mkhris brag spos a ru ra// rdo rgyus cu gang ka ra sbyar la gdab/ rgyus pa lnga rta phag lugs gsum gyi rgyus zing sa rdo rgyus dang zho sbyar bag phye dang / cu gang thal gyis bran la skam

520 grwa thang rgyud ba /nan bya// man ngag skabs dang sbyar la bcos ba ni// zug ju dbyung dang khrag shor bcad pa dang // tsha ba bsad dang chu gtung spangs pa gzhom// rnag bcad zug ba dbyung dang byung shor gzhug / chag pa bcing dang spyi don dgu yis bstan// mde'u yod brtag thabs btsal thabs 'don thabs gsum//brtag pa mda' chas g.ya' yod khrag 'jol med// rma dbyibs zur bzhi kha ma nyams pa la// mnan na mi bzod skad ngan 'chor ba 'am// tsher ma zug pa mnan 'dra kur gyi 'ong // yang na gting du lhang gi sbyin pa dang // rma rnying dus su chu dmar mi ldo ga cing // lcags g.ya' chags dang rtsa la lcam dral 'ong //skad phra byug pa skams skyen ba sru ldog / sha mdog dmar sngo yang na nag pa yin//mu zi ldor ros yung ba nu zho sbyar// byugs pas dngos su mdog 'gyur ba sru ldang // rma kha phyir log zug che skrangs pa dang // rnag mdog sngo dmar khu rtsigs can du 'byung // a ru chu rtsa'i reng bu rma ru bskyal// nang par nya skyogs 'khar ba'i nang du bzhi// g.ya' chags dngas snyigs bye na yod pa yin// btsal ba'i thabs la rma gsar phog lugs bsdad// rma yi dbyibs dang cha byad bstun te btsal/ rma med sra 'dril kur gyi 'ong ba'i sa// thur ma btang la lag nyams blang bar bya// chu treb rus treb mde treb rnam pa gsum//thing skad rus skad mde skad so sor brtag / rnyed dka' khab len mde 'byin dur byin dang // rgya ru dom mkhris sprang gi ril bu yis// rma byugs gang na yod par na zug lda nga // 'don thabs phog pa'i nyin par gdon par bya// ma thon phyi dus mi skyog skrangs pa 'chor// rnag tu khugs pa'i dus su dbyung bar bya// de yang sman dang dpyad kyis dbyung ba gnyis// sman ni khab len bee snabs ma rdzi ra// ba bla sbrang smyon shar bltas bye khungs sa// sbrul tshil sbyar ba'i lde gu phyi nas byug / khong du bya rog bya ma byi yi sha / bya rgod khab len ra mnye byi ba'i brun// chang sbyar btang pas rma ru 'byin par byed// yang na sprul sha khab

sa khanang ga yon tan gyi khyud/ 521len mde 'byin dang // lce tsha srub ka dur byin tsan dan dmar// dmigs su byugs te rngabs ras drangs pas 'drongs cis kyang ma thon sman gyis bzhu bar bya mi'i mjug to khab len sgrul sha chu rtsa snam rtsa ska rtsa go bo'i gre ba stag mo ma pa ya ru sbyar ba mi la gdab khong du btang bas dngos med du 'gro smo dpyad kyis dbyung ba thur rtags btsags skyon dral mngon dang mi mngon dam dang lhod pa dang // mi 'gyur sul 'phyos ring thung bar ma dang // spang rgal rnyi ba chad dang rus pa 'thams/seng ge kha dang skam chung gang ka mchu// 'phrul skam mde zhabs 'jab rtse mde gsor sogs| gang la gang dgos rig pas dbyad de dbyung // rtsa yi khrag shor chod dang rul ba gnyis// sbad chod shor na rtsa la khad pu gzhug / byang them bya dang mur la mnan pa dang // 'ol kha bsgyur dang khong du sba ba 'o//dang po rgya skyegs mkhan pa skyer pa mtshe'i// khaṇḍa mkhris pa gsum dang sbru ma'i 'bru// sgong thog sbyar ba'i 'dag pa rma la brdzang // yang na spru rtsa'i reng bu nya dom mkhris// gur gum spru 'bu'i lde gu byugs la brdzang / yang na khrag rkang zor pa dar ya kun// dom mkhris sbyar ba rma nang brdzang bar bya// yang na 'gron thal smyug shun thal ba dang / da lis mngal khrag mkhris pa gsum dang tshos// shing tsha bu ram sbyar la rma nang btang // dar bkab steng du bsil ba'i 'jibs su gzhug / gnyis pa rma nas sor drug gong 'og tu// de 'us mnan la ras kyis dam du bcing // de steng phying pa dam sbyar shing byang btang // de steng shing byang rtsa yis g.yas g.yon btang / ras kyis bsdams la rma khol gtod de gso// gsum pa ya thog ma thog me yis mnan// bzhi pa rtsa rgyud gong 'og gtar bar bya// khong du sba ba gong gi khaṇḍa la// gur gum li shi mkhris pa gsum sbyar btang / yang na 'bri sog zhu mkhan mkhan pa tshos// bsdus khur dom mkhris gur gum shing tsha dang / ga bur sbyar ba btang bas khong du sped//rtsa yi rma la rul nas khrag shor na/ dom mkhris cu gang nu zhos bkru bar bya//

322 zhu/grwa thang da ba'i/ga bur dom mkhris cu gang ka ra gdab/ lcags kyi ljang pas rma kha drag tu mnan// khong du tsha ba'i 'bros 'den gces pa yin// rtsa nad khong nas ma bcos them dmas kyang // khrag sba byung na gso dka' don med 'gyur// yan lag rma tshad rgyu rkyen dbye ba dang // rtags dang bcos thabs rnam pa ba'i yis bstan// tsha ba'i rgyu ni khrag dang mkhris pa ste// de yang rtsa dang rus la skye ba yin// tsha ba'i dbye ba sbyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyi la tsha ba shor dang 'khyil ba gnyis// rkyang pa ldan 'dus 'thab par skye ba lnga// bye brag khrag dang chu ser rnag tshad gsum// rtsa tshad rus tshad zug ju'i tsha ba drug / de rtags tsha ba stod du shor ba ni// grang shum byed cing mgo dang tshigs gzhi na// dang ga mi bde dbugs theg blo snying 'dar// gnyid che lus lci kha kha mig sprin ser// lce rtsa sngo 'ing skam la so dreg chags// rtsa grims chu dmar rma kha drod che ser// chu ser tsha ba rtsa sbubs 'khyil ba ni// rtsa 'phrig chu ser gzhogs la yang lci 'byung //phrag gong mi bde bshul sha na ba yin/ skrangs dang rma tshad skyes pa rkyang pa ste/de la rtsa chu tsha na ldan tshad yin// phyi yul na lugs tsha na 'dus tshad do//'thab tshad rtsa chu tsha la rma tshad skye// yang na rma grang rtsa chu tsha ba 'o/ bye brag khrag tshad mig chu skrangs pa dmar// bsil la mi dga' snying la dron mo 'dodakanub mo gnyid chung za zi mang ba yin chu ser tsha ba ldang dub 'dre ltar na//mig sprin chu dang skrangs ser tsha zhing 'khyug / rnag tshad rtsa ni 'dar ram srun pa la// dang ga mi bde gnyid chung ldang dub na// bla rdol byed cing skrangs pa mnan mi bzod// rtsa tshad gsum dang lnga la drag por skye// rus tshad bdun dang dgu la rkun bur skye// zug ju'i tsha ba drag shul rjes la skye// skar gyis zug ldang rma la khrag tsan 'byung // zas spyod dal zhing snyoms dus bde ba yin bcos pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la bcos pa'i thabs dang bsad thabs gnyis// bcos tshul rgyal blon dmangs dang bcas pa ste// rtsa

sa khan ngag yon tan gyi da/ 323tshigs gnad la rgyal po lta bur bcos/ rma chas bsil la gong 'og drod sbyor bsten// khong tshad bsil bcag nad la rnag mi 'jug / tsha ba drod sbyor bsten par 'du ba yin// nyen med 'tsho rkyen rgyal po'i bcos tshul lo/ nya men gnad la blon po lta bur bcos// 'phrang bsdam rma nas dbab cing khong nas bsal// rnag shor sbyong yang srog mi 'dor ba yin// rma nas dkrog cing khong nas bsad pa ni// 'tsho rkyen 'chi rkyen dmangs ltar bcos tshul lo/ tsha ba bos da thabs yar 'dren mar 'dren gnyis// tshad stobs chung na par 'dren 'jam pos bsad// tsan dan gi waṃ bsil gsum ba le ka / hong len tig ta utpal ba sha ka / ka ra sbyar btang rtsa phran mas 'dzeg gtar// stod shor stobs che yar 'dren thog babs bsad// ga bur rgyal blon bdun pa dgu pa sbyar// rtsa chen gang rgyas yas babs khrag shed smad// tsha ba 'khyil na bsil gsum ba le ka / gi waṃ dom mkhris seng ldeng ba sha ka / so ma ra dza ka ra sbyar la btang // gzer ba'i phyogs dang rtsa dmigs gang rgyas gtar// rkyang pa'i tsha ba rma la bsil zhun bya// khong du chu 'thung sman la rta byas la// tig ta spang rtsi utpal ba le ka / ka ra sbyar ba na ma bcag mal btang / ldan pa'i tsha ba rma la bsil nan bya// tsan dan bsil gsum gi waṃ li ga dur utpal ka ra sbyar ba khong du btang // rkang la long rtsa lag pa a so gtar smo 'dus tshad ga bur thing mngar ba sha ka / ba le ka rnams gong la bsnan la btang / rtse chung snod ka drug mgo la sogs gtar// 'thab pa'i tsha ba rma khong bsnol la gang tshaba'i stengadu bsgril gyis bsad cing sgrog grang ba'i steng du drod sbyar la bsad// khyad par khrag tshad dmar chas stong len chub shaka ba da thang btang la bo gtar// chu ser tsha ba ser chas 'bras gsum kyi rtse hong len stab seng brag mun thang btang la thur ma dang ra tses bsu// rnag gi tsha ba phug la 'byar skems bya// rtsa tshad ru ra hong len ba sha na re zhon shing ma ngar chos thang gtar me dang bsil gyis bcag / rus tshad la yar 'dren gyi

524 sto/grwa thang da ba /bsil chas chu dang mas 'dren gyi sman gyis bcag / zug ju'i tsha ba la tigata bsha stong na gyi nga sman gtar zas kyis bcag / khrag dus tsha ba stod shor yen la gtan// chu ser dus su bsil la bcud pa bsten// rnag gi dus su rgyal po lta bur zhug dang skom gsar pa par sbrang ting khrol gsar 'jam gyis gso// rma gan tsha ba mi chag sra zhing hrem// rtsa lto sbrags te ga bur nyer lnga sbyar// gang nye gtar zhing rma la dro ba bdug / tsha ba kun gyi rgyu ni chu ser khrag / de phyir gso dpyad gtso bo gtar ba mchog / chu 'thung skom ltar btung dang sman ltar btung // skom ltar btung ba rtsa sgo dgag pa ste// hong len myang rtsi spras dang yug gu shing //lcam 'bru chur sbangs skom du btung bar bya// yang na tshos btsod yung skyer spyi zhur dang smo sang rtsi tsan dan thod le kur rnams btung // sman ltar btung ba khrag dus chu ser rnag / khrag dus a bo hong len a byag dang // tsher sngon chu btung yang na tsan dan dkar// se rgod stab seng re ral chur sbangs btung //chu ser dus su stab seng yu gu shing // shel ta a byag pho rog nor bu dang // bu ram sbyar ba tshos khus 'phul la btang // khyad par gi waṃ bzang drug mkhris sna tshogs// ril bus rtsa yi chu ser skem par byed// sgong thog glang sna tha rams bya rkang dang // bu ram ril bus sha yi chu ser skem// stab seng tsher sngon khrag rkangs byag dang // re ral ril bus rus pa'i chu ser skem// de ba sum cu tig dang khur rtsa yi// thang gas chu rgyus chu ser skem par byed// sha ba kha sha bse ru bu ram gyi// ril bus tshigs dang pags pa'i chu ser skem// kham bu'i thal ba tha ram brag spos pa// ka ra'i ril bus chu ser skem par byed// thod le gar dang pha waṃ long bu dang // dar ya kun gyi bu ram ril bu yis// chu ser dus kyi skrangs pa 'joms par byed// rnag dus bse ru brag spos cong zhi dang //mu zi zho dang sbyar ba zangs la bsgos/ de bzhur phye mas rnag gi rgya mcho skem/ma nu mu zi rta pags re skon pa// khong btang lde gu byugs na skrangs pa 'joms//

zhu khan nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 525pha waṃ long bu ser sha lcags phye dang // sgo nga tshos byugs khong btang skrangs pa 'joms// bzang drug yu gu shing gis stod tshad srung / spa pi ling dang a bo 'oms yis// snod du tshad pa mi 'chor 'khru mi srid chu yi yon tan tsha ba gcog pa dang // dang ga bde zhing lus shed skye bar byed// gdon dang skrag thor pho ba 'byang na spang // lnga pa skrangs pa gzhom pa'i man ngag la/ gdon dang 'du ba gnas kyis spangs pa gsum// gdon spangs rma mdog log dang grang shum byed// chu bur nya sgang 'ong zhing skrangs mched rkyen// khrag rnag 'dzag cing she rul mnam pa la 'dzim pa stag sha mu zi kyi lce ba// shu dag spyang brun rwa gzhob dri chu byug / yang na grog zhing wa spyang ri bong brun/ khyi spu ra spu rwa gzhob khyi lud dang // sgog skya dri chur sbyar la byug par bya// yang na sgrul mgo sdig pa ma sbyin bsreg thal ba ba'i dang stag sha ba// ba lci chu ngan zhun pe spus mnan/ yang na nag po dgu dang bzhi sbyar bya bya rog dang khyi nag gi rma jug sru ra rog gi smog sru glang rog gi rmongs sru bong nag gi sprungs yug sa'i dor rta nas nag byabrasra nam sbang gar 'bru mar dang byi rtsen ga po bong nga nag po re lcaganag po'i thal ba thag pan khubarazho 'du bas skrangs pa rlung mkhris bad kun gsum/ rlung spangs skya la gsob cing rnag mi 'byung // 'phar 'ab byed cing tshigs khar skrangs pa yin/ de la rtsa 'phrang skrangs na me btsas bsrung // go stod lca 'bru kyi 'brum tsha ba gsum//sne 'u g.yar zhu za yi phyi mo dang // chang 'gags sbang ma sbyar la 'jibs su gzhug / yang na lca 'bru mkhan pa sle hres mtshan shu mo za dang lcam pa tsha ba gsum// tang kun mar nag sbang ma sbyar bas mnan// dmar po dgu dang ser po gsum sbyor bsngags byam tshal lu'i khrag ra ra skya'i sna khrig khyi rgya bo'i sna khrig bongabug pa'i zhug khrag mdzog mig bo'i sgrubs khrig /drug blom gyi rkan khrag na chung ma'i mngal khrig tshosabatsod gar po zho rjen ge mar nag sbyar ba dang sgonga'i char zig nya tsha ku ba kha bo sku mnye mdzo zhomarakhu sbyar shin tu stong sbos cu tsag a sa sa bdug / 'ba' cha mi sha mkhan sgru chang

526 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/btsos mnan// bad rkan skrangs pa che la 'i ba dka'// drod med mkhrang 'jam nya yi steng du skrangs// de la nye shing lham rtsa tsha ba gsum// go stod tsha phabs sbang gar rjen phye zhun// yang na srub ka dbyi mong tsha ba gsum// ma nu nyi dga' gar po zhun du gzhug / yang na ra dug re cag tang kun dang //shug pa mkhan pa bya bra'i lums su gzhug / yang na rma la bas kyi ser po bdun sbyor shis pa yin// mkhris skrangs dmar rtsa drod che reg mi bzod// rgya skyegs btsod dang li gri yug rnam mtshal// rta bong khrag dang sbang gar zho btsags mnan// ser po dgu yu nga gyer ma rtsar mnye ba bla nga ros nya phag mkhris sbang par sbya ra ba'i nan na dang lho skabs kyi dmar po bdun sbyor bya// gnas kyis thi ngas pa nya then rtsa tshigs bzhi// rtsa skrangs dmar mkhrang tsha 'khyug rtsa steng skrangs//dmar sbyor rgyas 'bring gsum gyis rtsa shed bcag / sbang gar sgo nga bag phye zhos ga'i byas// lug zho tsam pa rtse 'jam bsros la byug / rgya skyegs btsod rams yug rnam 'bru mar sbyar// ma thub rgya skyegs btsod zhun ser thig dang //rta bong khrag dang 'bru mar sbyar la btang // des kyang ma choms mngal khrag tshos btsod mtshal// spang spos ga dur ser thig 'bru mar sbyar// nya skrangs skya mkhrang drod med phyig por skrangs// skya sbyor rgyas 'bring gsum gyis nya 'khros 'dul ba la dang po ra khan pa spru ma sgo rong gsum dang sbyar/ des thubaskya sob tu ngas na go snyon dgyi mong la ba ma 'brum re ga tshab gsum ra des ma bu bsngon ngo rdo ltar sgrangs na tsha ba gsum mkhan pa sgrum da pa mi'i nga ma bya thod 'brum sbyar 'byug / glum nye lug zho sgo nga bag phye sbyar// rtse 'jam bsros pa rgya cher non par btang // tshigs skrangs mdog nag drod dang lhang skyog che// nag sbyor rab 'bring gsum gyis rus tshad bcag / pald po rtsa ji 'byamar sbyar la byug / des ma phan lhang skyog che na thab 'og sa khang sa'i so tog 'bru mar sbyar/ des ma thub rma kha bzha' ser nag du skrangs na so tog lcags phye rgya tho ri bong ril ma'i thal ba spang rgyan a ru sbyar la

lta dngag yon tan gyi da 327byug / sbang gar ra zho sgo nga bag phye dang / nas tshig gzhi byas lug zho tsam zhig byug / rtsa la brun gyis khad pu 'chor ba ste// dus la spod kyis tshad pa skye bar byed/ nya la snum gyis zhun nan 'dred pas spang / mdor bsdus spangs la tsha skrangs grang skrangs gnyis// tsha skrangs chas skam rlangs che tsha la dmar//gang dang nye ba'i rtsa la mang du gtar// thur mas btsags la chu lcags bzod tshad bdeg / yang na bul tog chus bkru rngabs ra gzugs// 'bur nas gshags la chu ser yang yang dbyung / de rjes cu gang hong len chu rtsa dang |yung ba spang rgyan gangs chu sbyar byugs la// kyi lce ba zho sbang ma sbyar la g.yog /des ma thub na kyi 'bur sgo nga'i ser// gro lo tsher sngon srad ma'i me tog dang //rnyi ba brag spos skar chu sbyar la byug / de steng sbang ma bsros pa'i 'jibs kyis drang / des ma thub na skyur gyis dag bkrus la/ byang pa mu zi rgya tsha bul tog dang // seng ldeng mar snying phag tshil sbyar ba byug / chang 'gags sbang ma bsros pa'i 'jibs kyis drang // de rjes skyi bsrung byug cing bsil nan bya//des ma thub na rtsa lto sbrags pas sbyang // des kyang ma thub khra bo nag pos dgug / grang skrangs skya gsob drod med mnan shul 'ong // lca rgod spru ma go stod bca' sga dang // shug pa mar nag spod sbyar bsros pa btang / yang na mtshe mkhan sbang bsros 'jibs su gzhug / ma thub lug mig lce rtsa srub ka dang // ser sha nya mkhris lcam pa sgo nga'i ser// ba chu me long g.ya' sbyar sbang 'jib bya// des kyang ma thub rgya tsha bca' sga dang // tshil chen byugs la steng du sbang skam dang / byi brun chang du btsos pa'i lums kyis gdul/ kyar mo'i spu gzhob pho rog skye ka dang // khra yi brun dang zar ma'i mar khu byug / de steng khra bo'i lums kyis rnag tu dgug / bdud rtsi'i thal ba glad rul tsha ba gsum//tshigs phye sbang gar 'bru mar zhun chen zho// shin tu rnag ma khugs la bsngags pa yin// drug pa rnag bcad pa yi man ngag la/ rgyu dang skye yul gnas rigs

528 sto/grwa thang rgyud ba'i bcad thabs lnga// tshigs bar las byed sha la mtshon lus dang // nya brdungs rtsa bzhir rma tshad rus la zhen// tsha ba'i lums sngas gtar phyis rnag gi rgyu// skye yu la rtsa kha shor dang sha rul myags// rul myags rus pa za skong gsum la skye//gnas sa sha sul rus dang tshigs bar gsum// de rigs tsha 'byams grang 'byams rnam pa gnyis// rlung rten rnag dang rnag la brten pa'i rlung //bcad pa'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la sman dpyad zas dang spyod lam bzhi// sman ni nu zi bse ru dom mkhris dang // cu gang rnam par a byag a ru ra// ka ra sbyar ba'i phye mas rnag rnams skem// yang na ga bur bzang drug go dor gsum/ utpal ka ra sbyar ba ba chus dbul / yang na mu zi cu gang dom mkhris dang // bse ru stab seng 'jib rtsi sbrang mar sbyar / rnag gzhug lag par 'bras gsum mar gyis bcad// rkang pa'i rnag gzhug rtsa ba lnga yis bcad// bzang drug rwa sna mkhris sna kha tshar gdab// dpyad kyis bcad pa deb 'chings khrus dang gtar// deb la pho deb mo deb yang deb gsum //sul sgo tshigs mig la sogs rnag yul sbyar// de steng mtha' nas 'ded 'chings dag tu bcing // khrus ni dang po bul tog chu yis bkru// bar du cu gang dom mkhris ka ras bkru// tha ma gur gum dom mkhris chu yis bkru// khyad par dmar sngo dud ka skya bor 'gyur// gtar ga tsha ba rnag mdog khrag sbyar gtar// kha zas dang po gsar la bcud pa bsten// tha ma rgyal po lta bur bcos pa dang // spyod lam drag shul bud med spang bar bya// khyad par rtsa kha shor na me btsa' dang // gtar ga sman ga bur cusang sram gyi khris shel ta tsan dan ma ra khu kaṇḍa ri skyer shun 'om bu'i bar shun ka ra sbya ra la btang gur gumado ma mkhris ka ra btson khus 'phul bdang rta pags bra spos sgong mkhris bag gye'i skyom byug steng 'gyi deb gyis rim btang ba'i chas kyis bcad par bya// rul myags khrus dur byin dan ros shi ri khan daser mtshur 'bru dom mkhris kyi ril bu rnag sugs skyal des mang du song na zas ga pa ste ba'i rna

rdzi man nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 529ba la dang dris la ljang la ba bla mkhris sna'o bag phye mar nag sbyar ba'i nan dang mi dang nya mkhris da lis ra pa 'dam bu ga ra 'om bu'i bar shun ka ra btab pa'i sman gyis bcad//rus pa za skong brud bsreg sman kyis bcad pa ba ru mu zi rnam par dom mkhris 'brug dus srung sbyar ba long du btang rgya tsha byang pa 'brug nus mtshal sbyar ba la sa dab nya sul rnag la sman nu zib nubs spos ra nye nye shing 'brum rtsi thul ba'i me tog ya ru snang sbyar khong du btang/mtshe khur mnye ca ngab ga lo byugasul dang 'tsham pa'i deb btang 'de dpa'i 'byar 'chings kyis bcad// bar rnag sman gi seng cha gcis nu zi gnyis cu gang dom mkhris ba ru cha phyed dngu chu byung mar lde gu btang bdang khrus dang 'chings kyis bcad// tshigs rnag deb 'chings rgyogs kyis bcad par bya// tsha 'byams 'go dor 'du co ga'i glad pa so bya'i khrag spang ma ma thing na phur yo ga la ba la ra sbyar rma khong gnyis rkar btang grang 'byams la khong du chos sman ru rta nga rgod bsnan lugazhadang nga btang sman dang zas kyis bcad// rlung la brten pa'i rnag rnams khong nas bcos// rnag la brten pa'i rlung la rma nas bcos// bdun pa rus la zug pa dbyung ba ni// phyi nas zug dang nang nas zug pa gnyis// phyi nas zug pa rnag chus rus pa zos/ sngo 'am skug gam nag gam spa bcad 'dra// de la rtsi nyam sa lha ba chung ba 'am//gting du ma zhen pa la spra bas bsreg / lha ba che dang ma gnan slob pa la//lcags kyis 'tshos par bsregs pas mtshams su dbog / rtsa dang bcas na zhun mar tel pas bkol// sha chung lha ba che na skyung bus brud// 'jibs dang nang tshangs kha zhun mgo dang mthun// nang nas zug pa rkang gas chu ser zhugs// zug che sha skam mdog sngo lhang lhang na// de la rus pa btol la chu ser 'jib// stab seng khu ba dom mkhris ka ra blug / dar dang mar tshil srin bal ras gzeb btang // rgod rkang stab seng dom mkhris rma rtsir gdab//sbang mar 'jibs kyis chu ser lhag ma drang // gal te spangs na a sa 'ba' chas bdug / deb 'chings bsdam zhing khong nas sman gyis gso 'bras bu gsum

530 sa /grwa nga dab /stab seng 'bam po'i min mar spos dkar brag spos yang ku myu ru skyer pa pang sbyar khong du btang spangs rgyas rnag chus sha dus rtsa rnams rul// lha ru 'chang dang tshigs chu 'bog kyang srid// nad zo dang ga bde na gso ru rung // stab seng thang btang yab mar sbyar btang bya brag spos sgog skya pang dang sbyar ba'i sman dang kha zas gong bsreg khyim bya skor pang nga yo sa nga btang ro lcags kyis bsreg dang bcad pas bcos rus pa skamapasa'i nyam sal gson gshin mtshams su gsos les bcad 'jibs dang kha na bya rus ro gsonagazhin ma tsham sa su ga pa dang rma rtsis zhun bya/ brgyad pa byung shor gzhug pa'i thabs bstan pa// 'chor sa shor rtags gzhug thabs bstan par bya// 'chor sa g.yas g.yon steng 'og rnam pa bzhi// dpung pa pus mo steng du 'chor mi srid//rgya tshigs 'khrig ma g.yas g.yon 'chor mi srid// gru mo long tshigs rgyab du 'chor mi srid// dbyi la phyir shor nang thor rnam pa gnyis/ shor rtags zug gzer cung zad tsam la ldang // mod du skrangs shing brkyang bskum bya ba nyams//gang thor 'bur skyong ring thung 'byung ba yin// dbyi yi stug thag sogs pa'i gnyen thag chad// bcug kyang mi sdod zha 'theng 'gyur ba yin// gzhug thabs ma skrangs gsar dus mod la gzhug / rnyings nas lums kyis sha chu brtul la gzhug / gang yang tshigs kha bral bar drag tu 'then shor ngos nus pa'i mgo nas nang du 'phul// tshigs kha bral nas gang shor ngos su bkan// ma bral bkan na tshigs kha 'chag cing 'gram// bral na ji ltar bkan bzhin tshud par 'gyur// yang na thag pas 'then la dbyug pa bdeg /sgra 'byung 'bur po nub dang rkyang bskum btub// zug gzer bri na gnas su tshud pa yin// brtan par bya ba deb btang 'chings kyis bsdams// na dang zug ma bri na skabs su blta// yid ches brtan par gyur nas bcud kyis gso//yun lon thor lang yod na me btsa' gdab/ de rjes 'chings dang rgyogs su gzhug par bya// dgu pa dus pa chag spugs bcing ba ni// chag lugs chag

cu nang g.yon tan gyi da 531rtags bcing thabs log gnon no// chag lugs ma la bu thogs chag pa dang //smyu gu kha dang sdum chag thugs pa ba'i// de yang rma can rma med gnyis su 'dus//chag rtags grang zhing 'khrog la 'gul mi nus// rlung can sgeg dang sdum chag grugs pa dang // rma can zas kyis ma theg gso ba dka' ka bcos thabs bcing dang khong sman phyogs kyis bcos// dang po bcos thabs 'then la rus khod mnyam// ring thung ma chag ngos dang bstun pa gces// nus pa phyir don rta bong ra lug gi/ 'o mas bkrus la tshil bus drod phab ste// ga bur tsan dan gur gum 'o ma byug / 'ag 'das khong du chang btang 'bam pos bdug / de yis drod phebs rus pa 'byor pa bla// drag tu 'then pas rus pa nang du 'gro//cis kyang ma tshud sog les brtungs la gzhug / nam zla sbyar te zho 'am gar po la// sgo nga ra khrag ra mnye mtshe yi khu// spyin dang bag phye lug zho tsam du byug /tshigs chen mtho re tshig phran mdzub re byug / rkang rnams la ni rkang dang mnyam par byug / yang na sgo nga ra khrag bag phye dang // hong len mkhris sna sbang gar sbyar ba byug / phying pa srab mkhregs spa deb srad bus dkri// de steng ras 'jag gson pa'i 'chings su bcing // lhod na 'khrul zhing dmas na gong 'og spangs// tshabs che ba la de steng shing chas bskur// sman du stab seng khu ba khong du btang // mar gsar 'o ma mngar gsum tshos khu ldan a ba a sgeg sbrang rtsi mar sbyar btang // rma can khol du bton la shel ta gzhug / ga bur dom mkhris gur gum tsan dan dkar// stab seng ka ra sbyar bas rus pa sbyor//'phrod cing bde na ma rung bar du bzhag / mi 'phrod na na gsum lnga bdun la dgrol// log non ring thung yo na po bcag la bcing / rnag gzhug ma chod nus pa zos pa na/ brud dang bsreg dang sman gyis gso bar bya// tha ma gnad kyi log gnon bstan pa ni// sha yi gnad la gzha' 'khros bam rul bzhi// rtsa yi gnad la byer khrid rgyas shor bzhi tshigs kyi gnad la bam dang 'khor ba

532 sto/grwa nga rgyud ba /gnyis// chu rgyus gnad la rengs dang 'khums pa 'o// dang po sha gzha' tsha ba 'a' grang gzha' gnyis// tsha gzha' kha snyi gting sra stong tshan skye// skrangs chu re gcin 'dra ba'i chu ser 'dzag / de la khong nas sman gyis 'phul bsang bskam pa la ga bur cu gang gur gum tsan dan ba ru do mkhris ga dur ho len rasangs chusadabul / rma la khra bo nag po'i chas kyis bslang // rma khar mi gtar gzhan du gang rgyas gtar// zug skyes rnag mang skrangs drod che na slong // grang ga 'a' drod dang spangs chung rnag chu nyung // dang ga mi bde gdong skya zug ma nges// khong du gsar bcud se 'bru lnga pa btang // rma la drod lums khra bo'i lums kyis bslang // rlung gsang sul kha rnams su me yis bsro// de yis ma slong sha chang bur mar sprug / slongs nas spyi ltar gang 'a 'tsham pas bcos// 'gros la rdo ltar sra dang lhog thabs gnyis// rdo ltar sra la tsha 'khros grang 'khros gnyis//tsha 'khros dmar mkhrang zug che reg mi bzod// drod che tsha 'khyug rtsa chu phyi tshad skye// de la dang po glad sbang sbyor ba bya// de rjes ser chas rong ros yu nga skyer ma sgo ngar gzhob bag drod ba byugs te thog deb btang gang nye gtar// des kyang ma thub skrangs na chu rtsa dang / brag zhun glad dul ra zho bag phye byug / de yi steng du phying pa chur sbangs btang // yang na skrangs dang sbyar ba'i chu btsags la//gangs chus bsgrangs rting bsil ba'i chas su gzhug / cis kyang ma thul khra bo nag pos dgug grang khros skrangs pa drod chung sra la skya// zug che phug na rnag med nyung 'khyags 'dra / sha sna chang du btsos pa'i zhug pa bya da spyang gi mi zug rtse phabs da sbyar yang na steng nya sha skyang rta bong ra lus nya sha 'byu mar sbyar ba'i lums su gzhug / yang na sngo yi rtsa ba lnga yis mnan ri'o spru ma spyang tsher re ga srubaka ba parabatags pa dri chur sbyar bas ma thub khra bo nag po'i chas su gzhug / des kyang ma thub tsha 'khros lta bur bcos// lhog thabs kha dog dmar srug skrangs pa che/chubar nya sgang dkar nag 'byung ba dang // drod che ba spu ldog cing tsha ba skye//

zhus na ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 333de la lcags gye'i so rtog ma gdu kyi mas rams zhu mkhan sprung gar 'bya mar bag je 'tshos par btsos pa'i zhun nam men bu tshogs gla rtsi dang dri chur bcas pa'i lums/ des ma thub na nag po'i zhun nan bya// chu bur byung na gnyen po'am skam rtsis byug / sha ru'i thal bdud pa bya bal ma nu zho 'bru mar byug yang na gyi lce lugang la ri skon dris dul sro lo'i thal ba de steng khra bo'am nag po'i lums su gzhug / rma rogs 'byung ste 'bros 'dod thor pa 'ong // de kyi snyi brag spos gas phye shud gsu gul gla rtsi rtog mu ri ra khrag dri chus byugayang nas spyang khyi phag go bo gong mo rog gi sgrun btsan dug gla rtsi ya ru dri chur sbyar ba byugs pa'i steng du shog bu bong spus mnan/ ma thub dmar ser nag po'i zhun nan dpyad de la li gri rgya skyag
