btsod ra tsag mtshal rta bong khrig gar po rgo 'bru par dang sbyar ba/ mu zi i khrag rkang gser lha tsher spos dkar sgro mo na gar po zhi sran dang sbyar ba/ lcags sospyos kyi zhi snag tsha rams rdo sol yung nag sar po zho rjen phye mar nag sbyar ba/ des kyang ma thul 'phrul sbyongs re cag dbyi mong spos dkar thar nu rgya tsha byang pa lo brgyad dri chur sbyar la btang/yang na thar nu byang pa a ru re ra'i sha chen gyis byer ba bsdud pa'i khaṇḍa sbyar la btang / yang na shi ri khan da sngon bu thar nu byang pab spa ling nyidas 'a ka ra dri chur sbyar ba bungs chung yang yang btang zug byung na me dugs bya log gnon yin// sha gnad bam pa tsha bam grang bam gnyis//tsha bam skrangs pa smug nag drod rlangs che// sha rul dud ga'i rnag 'dzag bee ma me na// de la a ru brag zhun hong len zho// byugs steng gro sog 'jag ma'i deb btang la// ras srab bcings la rma la sbang zho btang / skabs su mtshan chus bran la sa myag byug / gang nye gang rgyas skrangs kyi 'og tu gtar// ma thub bshal gyis sbyang ba log gnon yin// grang bam skrangs che drod chung skya la gsob// rnag chu nyung zhing zug gzer chung ba yin// de la bag bye gar po zhu mkhan go stod phabs spab ling tsha mar nag btsos pa'i a las bdug cing mkhan chus bkru1khong nas gsar bcud gsum gyis gso bar bya// dul la myags dang za rma zags pa 'o// myags pa sha ro rgyus pa bldan pa 'dra/ rma mched rnag mang she

534 ༄༅ grwa nga dba'i dul dri mi zhim// de la dang po sbang zhis rus myags bsal// bul tog chus bkru de rjes mkhris pas bkru// rul sol a ru brag zhun hong len zho// rma minabyugs la chu bya'i spu yis mnan// rma la nas tshigs mkhris pa brag spos dang /chu rtsa 'bru mar sbyar byugs tho mangs dgab// de steng ras phran srab mos lhod par bcing // yang na ser tig zho dang sbyar la btang // yang na thal sbyor sug pa bong nga dkar po re smon chu rtsa dres rnying phur yo sa thal bdakar por bsregs pa dang mar da ra ma khris mu zi'i skam rtsi byug / do mkhris gur gu cu gang mtshal brag spos tshal dul ma 7 rasbrang rtsi mar dkar byug dar das ba re ba la mdu btsos pa'i rma khong sman sta sha'i meto dom mkhris brtsad khus dbul khams gas ra bcud ting grol btang zas kyis rus myags gso//za rma dul snying 'dod pa'i rma yin te// khras rul 'dzag cing byi ba'i za 'phro 'dra// dri mi zhim zhing nub re log por mched// de la rams lo spru rtsa zho sbyar bcing // gang nye'i rtsa gtar rma yi khrag chod nas// mkhris sna chu rtsa brag spos tshig ma dang // nu zho 'bru mar sbyar ba'i kha zhun bya// zags pa bu ga mang po 'byung ba ste// skrad rul dud pa slang dreg mar dkar byug yang na skam rtsi thal ba byug par bya/ nam zla dro dus rma la 'bu byung na// bye dug rgya spos chu 'am phye ma gdab// rtsa nad byer la nye byer ring byer gnyis// nye byer rtsa rgyud khrid phreng na la tsha// rma kha ma skrang mkhan sbang tshig ma dang // glad pa sbyar bas byer pa bsdu bar bya// des ma 'dus na rtsa sbyongs btang bas sdud / ring byer rlung rtsa snying rtsa'i rtsa skyon gyis// sha sul rtsa dang tshigs mig la sogs su//g.yas g.yon stod smad sne bsnol skrangs par byed// de yang tsha grang gnyis su srid pa yin// de la byer dngos rma yi thad ker bsreg / ri bo'i rtse la gser gyi me btsa' gdab// dar ya kun shing mngar kyi brag spos kha nya do khyim khris da tris bragazhun gser jig ga bur tsha la btab pa mdzo 'os sbyangs la sbyin nam da lis bre snyed kyi lce phul gang shing mngar spyor gang rnams la bzang drug mkhris sna da trig tshos phug ron sgo nga'i gser this ra

lta nang g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 535ra lo sbyar ba'i khaṇḍa yis/ byer sdud rtsa kha sdom zhing khrag khong sped// ma 'dus rtsa lto sbrags nas sbyang ba mchog / khyad par tsha byer 'jibs lums gtar sman bsdu bzang drug tsan dan dkar dpar bsil gsum dom pa khris ga bur ka ra sbyar bas grang byer byug lums zas kyis bsdu bar bya// rtsa nad khrid pa phyi khrid nang khrid gnyis// phyi khrid rtsa yi skar mda' byi khrid du/ khrid pas rtsa la nang rtsa spangs med kyang // dang ga mi bde pho mchin na ba 'am/ mgo na stod gzer tsha ba skye ba 'am// rlung ldan skabs su 'dre ltar ldang dub byed// de sogs nad sna sna tshogs ston gyur na// stod smad g.yas g.yon kun du bya ra bya// skrangs sam tsha 'am dreg pa thor pa sogs// gar 'dug de yi steng du lums bya zhing // khong nas rtsa byer bsdu ba'i sman dar ya zhan gyi spyor ba btang bas// rnag mgo byung na phug pas 'tsho ba yin// khong nad yin snyam ngos ma zin na 'chi// nang khrid don la chu ser gsog pa ste// mgo lus snyi zhing stod gzer dang ga 'gag / glo mang glo yi rtsa dang gsang sa gzer// 'di yi rma la tsha ba mi 'dus pas// rma la gang 'tshams khong du skem sman ma bya'i sgrod ra tshon lnga go dor gsum bsil bzhis bur domam khris dar ya kun sa ra sbyar ba bsten// gang khrid sor mo tshigs pa'i gsang du bsreg / ma thub gnyis kur 'phrul sbyongs bsngags pa yin// rtsa nad rgyas la tsha rgyas grang rgyas gnyis// tsha rgyas skrangs che dmar 'khyug rtsa rgyud spangs//gang na gang mkhrang gang rgyas rtsa la gtar// khong du bsil tsan dan dkar dam ra bsil sa sum dom mkhris ga bur utpal ka ra btang rma la hong len tig ta kyi rtse padma ta mtshanadakar tshos ra zho'i grang 'jib bya// de ma thub na khra bos rnag tu dgug / grang rgyas nyung 'khyags rkyal pa bus pa 'dra// drod dang zug gzer tshad rtags chung ba yin// de la sul sgo rtsa 'phrang skrangs mtshams bsreg / gsar bcud shing kun bca' bzang po gsum bur ma phye ma khong du btang // rma la bca' sga mi zhun khra bos dgug / rnag tu ma khugs drod dang bral na spang / drod bral mtshams su

536 ༄cu grwa jang da bzhi/mes bskor pabs spod lca 'drum g.yer mgo stod 'bam po bur mchang 'gags sung bsros pa'idrod 'jibs bya// drod rnyed rnag tu khugs na 'tsho bar 'gyur// chu bur byung na skam rtsis dud pa ru nu zhi til ma ra byug dar 'chings bya dud pa tshigs ma sgos skya khyi ci da thal ba dri chu sbyar bas byugs par bya// rtsa nad shor ba rlung shor khrag shor gnyis// de yang stod dang smad la thor ba 'o// stod du rlung shor 'phyo 'dar rngam pa 'deg / g.yal dang skyigs bu 'ong zhing za zi mang // sa nyid yer stong skyugs byed na byug bdug bya// rus thang bur dkar gsar bcud khong du btang /des ma thub na rlung gsang me yis mnan// stod du tsha ba thor na phrum ser khyer//stod gzer dbugs thung kha skam so dregs chags// glo mang mgo na lus lci dang ga 'gag / rtsa grims chu dmar rma la skrangs med gzha'// ga bur tsan dan ji waṃ tshad stobs sbyar// rtse chung la sogs gtar zhing bsil chas spang //tsha 'jibs byas la rnag tu dgug par bya// rma khar thor na lba ba 'byung 'gyur te// kha lba gting wa gang du byung gyur kyang / rlung thor lba ba 'khyil zhing 'gul ba ste// za 'og phug ron ske ltar ri mo 'byung // phug na rlung thor khrag mi thub pa yin// dbug tu mi rung bdud rtsi lnga yis bdug / khong nas rtsa kha 'dzin pa'i thang phye btang // khrag shor lba ba dmar sngo reg na brtse// 'phar med khong nas sman btang chas bsil bya// rtsa nad kun la tsha ba dbab dkrog gnyis// tshigs gnad rtsa kha 'bus kyi dogs pa dang // stod du shor dogs med pa rma nas dkrog / rtsa gnyan btsan chod stod du 'chor ba'i phyir// khong nas bsad cing rma khar dbab par bya// tshigs gnad bam la tsha bam grang bam gnyis// tsha bam tshigs mgo bam sbos skrangs dmar rgyas// drod che lci zhing 'gul dka' dang ga 'gag / ga bur tsan dan gi waṃ tsha stobs sbyar//bsil gsum 'brug rus stab nga hong len ru ka ra sbyar ba'i bsil gyis rus tshad bcag cing gang rgyas gtar// tshigs mig chu ser cher rgyas phug shul bsreg / rma la

sa /mnang ga yon tan gyi da/ 537chu nan bsil ba'i 'jibs kyis drang // des ma thub na khra bos rnag tu dgug / grang bam rlung gis tshigs la chu ser skye// res tsha res grang res na res 'ga' bde/ skrangs drod gnyid chung gdong skya 'gul na na 'di la khong du gsar bcud rma la drod mi phyugs rkang mgo sna tshogs tsha ba gsum lha 'bum phabs chang du btsos pa'i rus zhun thur ma snum ldan khra bos gdul// tshigs 'khor ba la skam 'khor gsher 'khor gnyis// skam 'khor tshigs chu rlung gis g.yos pa yin// tshigs kha lhod la sbo zhing thug thug gzer// tshigs mdud 'grus la 'gul dka' rnag chu med// gnyid chung za zi mang la gtser lhang 'don//lus dang gdong pa sngo skya skabs su dngang // 'di la bcud btang snum ldan tshab gsum sa yer ma 'u sum tshe bas shing tsha mar khu sbang gar rjen ge'i spod lums bya// ma thub thur mas gseng shul me yis mnan// skya sbyor spod dang snum ldan nan 'byar dang // rgyogs kyis bsdam zhing rjes la 'bras bu gsum tsha ba gsum chu ser sman gsum snang dang sbyar ba'i sman mar bya// gsher 'khor zungs chu mtshon gyis dkrugs pa yis// rus pa'i tsha ba skyes te ldan chu bslang ba'i dang po zungs lam dog gzhan du 'gyur te rul lam rnag dang 'dres zhwa 'i ri ring 'dzag des nad ldog cing ldad pas3 da chu ste bgrang ba gces so/ de yis tshigs chu rul nas rnag tu 'gyur// rnag gis tshigs bar khengs nas tshigs mdud 'jig / de la rnag rjes la sngo skya dpar skya ser skya sna ring byung nachu ser gyi yin ga mi chad par bas na skye chu sgrings chen po thor nas snabs su byung na 'chi/ma spangs par dud khur 'khru na 'chi/ thu rul lam ga can na mnya mig byung na 'chi chu chad chur rnag rjes la jo skya sna zung ba byung na rnag chad pas de rnams kyi bye brag dbye// dang po zungs chu sman dom ma khris cusang chu char man gsum spyi zhur nga phul gyed dang sbyar 'i btang ba dang brag lhanam tshe skyer pa 'om bu so po'i kha dang rwa gzhob tshigs ma bag gye dud pa byin rnam sa byug snying deb btang 'chings sa rma ru shel ta'i reng bu gzhus pa'i chas kyis bsdam// ldan chu khong sman ga burabazang po gsum dom ma khris du rta hong len ker stab chang gis 'phul la/ ga bur cu gang hong len

338 ༄7/grwa nga dba'i/dom mkhris spos dkar ka ra'i chus khrus dang chas kyis bgrang ba la lcag ba ga ra mnye parapa ta tigataḥ snyim khris sna nga zho sbyar gas bye rlon gyi 'jibs bya'o/ de yis 'drongs na tshigs la rnag mi 'chor/ des ma thub na skye chu sman gyis bcad pa la dom mkhrisashel ta hong len chu char na gsum khyil zung nu nos ri'i bu byas la rmar brdzang ka ra sbyar ba seng ldeng stab nga chus 'phul la khong du btang ta mkhris sna rgya skyegs sgo nga bag phye sprang // zho sbyar byugs la steng du phying deb btang // mdo ru bsdus pas tshigs chu tsha grang gnyis// dmar ser dug can she rul tsha ba yin// sngo ljang 'o ma chu 'dra grang ba yin// gnyen po rma khong bsil drod gnyis kyis bgrang // de yis ma thub 'khor na phyi nang gnyis// phyi tshigs 'khor na mgo na sna khrag 'dzag / gnyid med tsha ba skye la za zi mang // dang ga mi bde dngang 'dar stong skyugs 'ong //so brtse nya sna 'a zig cing mdzub mo 'gul// brkyang bskum mi shes tshigs mgo bem la sbom// khong du stab seng brgyad 'brug rus ru rta gi /cu gang gur gum spos dkar 'i ru ka ra sbyar ba sangs chus 'phul la btang pas rus tshad bsad// rnag chu gang 'ong bsus la chu yis bgrang // khrag gam mkhris pa'i nan bya'i khrig ra rog gnya' khrag bo bu ga pa'i sa ga khrag ma la yum bog shug pa'i nga chu rnams bsres la sa sa par byus ma zisasnaram sa tshos mtshal brag zhun yu nga ba pang zho bas phye sbyar la byus sa pa'i steng phying deb rnag 'khyim dzi sa mi tu gyis brtsegs sum brtsegs btang // 'chings kyis bsdams la de steng shing chas bkur// nang tshigs 'khor na cung zad 'gul thabs med// dpyi la sogs pa'i rus mgo mtho mtho rdol// rnga dang rang 'thag la sogs skad chen sgra// nad pa'i gam du cung zad bya thabs med// gnyid med rna glu len zhing smre gcong 'don// kha lce skam zhing rings par za 'thung byed// tshogs chad she rul rnag 'dzag kha rma lhogs// khong sman gong bzhin kha zas bsil ba la// skabs su thor bu'i rlung sna zas kyis bslan// cu gang spos dkar ka ra'i chu yis bkru// sgong mkhris mtshe khu ra mnye bag phye dang // sbang gar ra zho sbyar

༄gyis nang ga yon tan gyi da/ 539la snyoms par byug / de steng phying pa srab mkhregs snyoms par ba hā nga // she 'am men dri'i 'jag gis sdom 'chings bya// 'chings kyis tshigs mal chas su gzhug pa gces// rma kha khol du brtol la nang re spo// kha zhun nam zla tsha grang dus dang bsnan// de yi steng du shing chas bkur bya ste// rgyogs mal bcud la bor ba gces pa yin// dus sbyar chu sru 'bru yi lding bcas la/ mal gyis lus po cham la dbab pa gces/ rtas nas kha zas rim kyis glod la btang //rnag chu chad dka' shed dma' yan lag gyong // sman mar sbyar la lus zungs brtas par bya// chu rgyus rengs sam 'khums par gyur pa na// brkyang bskum mi btub de la bcos thabs med// cung zad btub na dang por chu tshan spang //de nas me tog sna tshogs lums su gzhug / yang na spang skam rta rkyang lug ril lums// yang na phur mo tsan dan srug po dang // 'om bu chang du btsos pa'i 'u mas kyis bdug / mtshan mo lums la nyin par bsku mnye bya// sha mar bur chang bcud kyis khog nas dbul// de rjes bal tshi'i sbyor bas dril byas la//chang gar bzi ba 'thungs la rtser gyis rgyangs// cha yis ma 'grams je drag brkyang bskum bslab// so ru tshud na bkru byug bsro zhing mnye// 'grams na gang nye gtar zhing lums su gzhug / spyir na bsil gyis ma thub log gnon drod// drod kyis ma thub de yi log gnon bsil// log gnon dus tshod sbyor zhis man sku so gnad// dus men log gnon 'khrul sbyor rmongs pa yin rgyas ga/// rtsi /snyi/ nga po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las man lag gi rma gso ba'i le'u ste brgyad cu rtsa drug pa'o/ //

540le'u gru bdun pa/ sbyar ba'i dug bcos pa/de nas yang drang srong yin las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so/ kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// phyi yi rkyen las nad du gyur pa yi//dug nad gso ba'i skabs la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dug la sbyar ba'i dug dang gyur pa'i dug / rang bzhin dug dang rnam pa gsum du bshad/ de la dang po sbyar dug ces bya ba//lnga brgya dus kyi tha mar gyur tsam na// dus ngan dbang gis sbyor ngan sna tshogs byed// de dus mu stegs bsam ngan sbyor ba dar rkang gnyis srog la dug gi chan pas 'debs// de la rigs dang 'jug tshul ngos bzung dang // bcos thabs log gnon phyi rjes bcad pa drug / dang po dug rigs bskur ba'i rta yis dbye// mthong ba nyi ma'i zer la bskur ba dang // du ba rlung gi rdzi la bskur ba dang // 'goms pa sa yi rlangs la bskur ba dang // reg pa snum gyi rta la bskur ba dang // khong par zas la bskur ba rnam lnga 'o// de la dbye ba yul dang rdzas sbyor dang // nad kyi rigs dang ldang ba'i dus kyis dbye// yul ni rgya gar rgya nag dol po pon// mtshon cha gsal shing hos dang rtsi dang bzhi//re je la yang stong dang rtsa ba'i ra sbyor// rdzas sbyor rin chen rdo dang sha sbyor dang // rtsi sbyor dngos dang sngo las sbyar ba drug / rin po che la gser zangs 'khar ba dang // lcags dang dngul chu 'a nye las sbyor te// khyad par 'a nye dngul la sbyar ba mang // rdo ni sbal rgyab ti tsa cong zhi mtshal// mu zi pha waṃ long bu rnams la sbyor// sha sbyor sha khrag mkhris pa spu rus lnga/ sha ni tshe tshe ra dang

sa blonang g.yon tan gyi khyud/ 541mkha' lding bya// khyi dang sre mong byang pa nya sbal sdom/ sdig pa rtsangs pa la sogs sna tshogs sbyor// khyad par ra khyi bya dang byang pa mang // rtsi sbyor dug rigs kun gyi bcud bsdus yin// dngos la spyor ba bong nga nag po dang kubatsan dug ra dug gsum la sbyar ba 'o/ sngo la sbyar ba thang phrom 'ol ma se//zho sha gze ma dur byin thar nu sogs// sna tshogs kun la spyor ba byed na yang //gtso bor thang phrom pa la sbyar ba mang // de la ldan 'dus du mar 'gyur ba yin// mang por phye bas rtogs pa shin tu dka'// gnyen po log na slar nyid gnod par 'gyur// mdor bsdus tsha sbyor grang sbyor gnyis su 'dus rin chen rdo la sbyor ba grang ba ste sha rtsi sngo sbyor ha las gtso byas pa// grang bar mi srid tsha sbyor dug du 'gyur/ 'dres pa'i sbyor ba tsha grang 'thab par byed/nad rigs mdze dug spyo dug gri rgod dug / kha rma rgyu skams za rem ltag dgye dang // rgya nad rengs 'khums srin bu sna zan dang // srug po 'ju skems mkhris nad mig ser dang // rims nad rtsa byer nag po thog deg dang ku'akhyam po gza' nad gzer nad chu 'gags sogs ngo mtshar na lugs du ma 'byung ba yod/ ldang dus lo zla zhag gis byed pa'i phyir zhag dug zla dug lo dug gsum du 'gyur// 'jug tshul zer la bskur ba mdangs la 'jug / dzi la bskur ba rtsa sgo sna nas 'jug / rlangs la bskur ba sna sgo ba spu gnyis//snum la bskur ba ba sru'i sgo nas 'jug / zas la bskur ba so lam kha nas 'jug / de nyid dang po pho ba'i nang du 'bab/ dug de dngas ma la zhon nad bcas phyir// sgreg skyug zas la 'khren pas ma zhu'i tshul// dngas ma mchin pa'i gnas su khrag gyur bas// mchin pa ro stod na gzer rtsa rnams 'khyug /khrag las shar gyur sngo skams kor ler na/ sha las tshil gyur shed med gnyid mi snyoms// tshil las rus par gyur pas so sen na/ tshigs gzhi rus pa khol bur na ba yin/ rus las glad gzhung rkang du 'gyur ba'i phyir mgo 'khor

542 ༄/grwa thang rgyud ba /nyi ma mi bzod rkang rnams 'khyug / rgal tshigs kha bye btsir na phan snyam byed/glad gzhung sa bon dkar dmar gnyis su smin// skyes pa'i bcud 'dzag chags pa 'chor ba dang // bud med zla mtshan 'byam mam 'khyil bar byed//sa bon dngas ma mdangs gyur snying la gnas// mdangs 'phrog brjed ngas myos dang snying mi dga' mdor na dngas ma'i rta la dug zhon pas// lus zungs bdun dang dri ma kun la khyab// gnas kyis bsgyur ba nad rtags cir yang ston// rlung mkhris bad gan 'du ba 'khrug par byed// de phyir dang po bar dang tha ma'i dus// ngos bzung bcos dang rjes gcod zhin tu dka'//sbyor ba'i rigs dang lus kyi nad khams dang // kha zas rta yis bsgyur bas don la 'bab// snod lhung rus zhen rtsa ru rgyug pa dang / sha pags la sogs ma nges gar yang 'bab// brtag pa'i thabs la rnam pa gsum yin te// spyi rtags 'khrul med mi 'gyur ngos bzung dang // nad rigs babs sa so po'i brtag pa dang // mi 'tsho 'chi ltas brtags la spang ba gsum// dang po ngos bzung phyi nang gsang ba gsum// phyi rtags 'du ba gzhan dang rgyab sha bcad//nang rtags rtsa chu na lugs slong rkyen gyis// nad kyis ngos bzung gsang bas nges pa bskyed// dang po nam langs ma labs zas ma zos mchil ma ma dkrogs rang lugs chu gtsang blug / khar lding dug med 'bas su song na yod// rgya ru la byugs steng btab khol na yin// dkar gong mes bsregs steng du mchil ma blug / bcag pas nas re nag po song na yin// ba men rwa nang dri chu chang bsres blug / byi thur dkrugs pas 'ja' tshon 'dra na yin//yang na ba men rwa nang dri chu blug / ri bong sma ras dkrugs pas tshig na yin/nad pa'i dri chur mur gong skra bcug ste// 'ag lon nang par skam skyog tshig 'dra yin// ra med dngul leb so nang gtod la ba 'ag / nang par mdog nyams phyi ba dka' na yin chang khyor gang dang hu lu ka sbyar ba// srod la

zhu na ngag yon tan gyi khyud/ 543'thungs la mi smra nang par blta// lce snyil rkan la 'ja' tshon snang na yin/ rma bya'i mdongs gcig mar dril khyur mid bya// nang par chus bkrus mdog ma nyams na yin// de ltar phyi nas brtag thabs kun tshang na// yin par nges te med kyang nges med phyir// nang gi rtags kyis nad kyi ngos bzung ba/ rtsa rgyud ma nges ji ltar 'dug gyur kyang // 'gyur ldog mang la gdon rtsa 'dra na yin//chu mdog ma nges ji ltar 'dug na yang // 'khar snod kha sbyar sa 'og rlangs bsubs pas// sa rdo rin chen sngo yi phye ma 'am sbal sgong 'dra dang nag rings 'ja' tshon 'ong // yang na dngas sangs dug tu nges pa ste// zangs la byugs na nag por 'gro na yin// na lugs khong du song ba'i zla gcig nas//glo cham mod cing shed chung khams mi bde// zla ba gnyis nas yang yang ldang dub byed// gsum nas gang du babs pa'i gnas der na// bzhi nas zas spyod mi 'phrod rkyen gyis slong // de yang sbyor ba nad khams zas kyi rta// babs sa'i dbang gis rtags la nges pa med// 'on kyang phal che ba la 'di rnams 'byung // zas la bro med sgyid skyur tshig pa za/ lus lci stobs 'chor sha skam kha dog sngo// lce 'gas ba sgru brtse la sen rtsa thin/ mgo 'khor shes pa zi la gom pa 'khyor// mgo dang pho mchin kha 'khor ro rgyab na// sha sna 'gul 'a zig nyag gi rkang rnams na// me nyi bsil grib snyeg cing 'dug mi tshugs/ rngul dang tshad pa gnyid la 'phel 'grib byed// mig 'grib kha mngal g.yal dang sbrid pa mang // skabs su 'gru skyug dri chu sri pa dang // gsang gnas mi ldang skabs su snying mi dga'/ stod smad yan lag khol gur na zhing 'pho mig 'bras so dang rna ba mgo bo gzer// 'jing pa rengs dang gre ba mdzer ba sogs// nges med sna tshogs du ma'i rtags 'byung ste/ kha so rus pa na bas rlung dang 'dra// mig ser tsha ba skye bas mkhris pa 'dra// 'ju dka' g.yo tshul ston pas bad kun 'dra// rtsa 'khyug ro stod gzer bas khrag nad 'dra za

544 sa /grwa nga dba'i/'phrug sbyin la bem pas chu ser 'dra// grang shums tshigs gzhi na bas rims dang 'dra// khrag skyug pho mchin na bas sprug po 'dra// stobs chung sha pags skam pas sa bdag 'dra// de dag sbyor ngan zas kyi na lugs yin// khyad par rtsa dang chu gnyis rtag mi thub/ sna tshogs nad sna mang jing 'gyur ldog che//zos kyang mi phan sha 'bros lus stobs 'chor/ pho mchin mi bde cham 'debs snying mi dga' / don med na zhing byas med dar re 'drag / de bdun ldan na nges par gdon mi za/ phan gnod bsten pa nyal po rta sbangs dang // nya phag sha rul dang po sbyar ba'i rta// gtar khrag tsha bas ldang na nang rtags yin//nang rtags de rnams tshang na mi 'gyur te// rtags med ngos ma zin na gsang bar brtag / chu chung pa yi tsha bar nya phag sha / btab pa'i tshod mas ldang na nges par yin// rakṣa chur bsdus srod la khyor gang btang // khams 'khrugs lus zhi phum ser khyer na yin// re ral ba 'or btab btang skyug na yin//rnam yug tsan dan dkar po skyer zhun phye// spyi shur khus 'phul 'khru skyug gzer na yin// a ru spang rgyan se skyer bar zhun thang // btang bas tshigs gzhi bran tse na na yin/ shug 'brum shing kun gla rtsi 'bras bu gsum // ba chur bskol btang gar babs zug ldang yin// se god 'om bu'i thang btang chur btsos pas// 'dril na dug nad yin pa'i nges shes bskyed// kun gyis ma rtogs sdud sman btang bas gsal// bye brag brtag pa 'jug sgo rdzas rigs dang // nad rigs ldang dus babs sa'i sgo nas brtag / dang po 'jug sgo rigs kyis brtag pa ni// nyi zer du ba rlangs las byung ba'i dug / dang por mtshul pa tsha zhing mgo bo na// lus sbyir snyom la snyed skyur tshig pa za// tshigs ga'i byin nya na zhing phrum ser khyer// tshabs che g.yo skam 'a 'khums gza' phog 'dra/ reg pa dang po pags pa tsha sbrid za// phrugs rjes 'brum thor shu ba skrangs 'bur 'ong // de nas kha cig rtsa la byer bar 'gyur// kha cig lhog pa

khanang g.yon tan gyi da/ 545kha cig 'bras su 'gro// tha ma sha rul rtsa 'chad rus pa za// rdzas rigs sbyor ba'i sgo nas brtag pa ni// dbyig dug shed chung sha skems je sngor 'gro/ na tsha mi che pho bar zug cing grang / kha la g.ya' bro mtshan ma ldang mi 'gyur// mig ser sbo sgrog zho zos khrag du 'byang // rdo sbyor pho ba sra lci yan lag phra// gdong sbo tsha tshul ston la grang bar ldog / mchin mkhris pho mcher steng du skran du 'dril// sha sbyor pho mchin mi bde mig smin dmar// mig 'grib min pa lteb la gre ba 'dzer// khrag tu 'khru 'am lud pa khrag tu lu// mgo dang ske 'jing phyi sha nang grol sogs// gang btang der 'bab khol bur na bar byed/ sru sbyor rgyu zhabs srin bzhin 'khyug cing na// rgyu khrag 'dres shing nang rtsa gzer ba yin// rtsi spyor gzhogs phyed na zhing ngos sha skam// mgo rkang tshigs gzhi na zhing phrum ser khyer// tsha ba skye zhing mig 'grib mchin dri 'khor/ dngos las sbyar ba lce dang sen rtsa sbrid// mig 'grib so nag lce mchu 'gas pa yin// sngo sbyor ru shing na zhing chu ba rengs// lus grang snying 'dar sems 'phyo 'gro na 'bub// rang gis tshor bas kha mchu spangs snyam byed// mdor bsdus tsha grang sbyor ba rnam pa gnyis// tsha sbyor rtsa grims chu smug ku ya mthug / dus tshigs nya gzhi mgo na grang shum byed// ro stod pho mchin gzer zhing kha lce skam mchu 'gas so nag khong pa tsha 'khrug byed// shes pa zi la mi lam mang ba ste// gtso bor mchin mkhris gnyis la 'bab pa yin// grang sbyor sbo sgrog kha zas mi 'ju 'khren// rtsa dal chu sngo lce skya gdong pa g.yo// mjug tu skran du 'dril lam chu ru ldog / gtso bor ma zhu pho bar 'bab pa yin// sbyor ba 'dres pa pho mchin gnyis skar 'bab// grang yang tsha tshul tsha yang grang tshul ston// na lugs sgo nas brtag pa mdze dug ni// mdze khrag bse zhos phal cher gtso byas pas//'gul 'a zig za ber rtsa 'khyug dus rkang na/ gre ba mi bde sha sbo thor shu 'ong //rus la babs pa pho mdze skams nas 'chi// sha dang rtsar babs mo mdze rul

546 ༄/grwa thang rgyud ba /nas 'chi// spyo dug phal cher gong mo'i khrag dang ni// thang phrom pa yis sbyor ba'i gtso byas mang // stod rgyangs shes pa 'phyo zhing shu yis 'debs// 'dar zhing 'khrog rdeg kha nas sna tshogs 'don// yang na so 'cha' 'gyel zhing dran med 'bog / dri dug tsha bsings sgru ba rgya sho'i 'bru// 'dre 'dar glad pa gri khrag sogs la sbyor// rta sri chu sri sbab sri g.yang sri dang // lceb sri sogs kyis 'chi bar byed pa ste// skabs su mgo 'khor ldang zhing snying mi dga'//'khyags na stod sgang dran pa bag re nyams// g.ya' za rtsa srid 'gro snying 'dod pa 'byung // tig ta'i thang btang nyi ma la nyal bas// mig la 'od 'phro dri chu khrag tu 'byung // kha rma rgyu skams rin po che la sbyar// kha la rma 'byung zas skom za mi shes// rgyu ma skams na zug che dri ma 'gag / za rems ltag dgye lto che 'jing pa rengs// rgya nad rengs 'khums khrag tu bshal ba la// lag rkang rengs 'khums mi yis brkyang bskum dgos// srin bu sna zan rtag tu srin nad ldang // srug po 'ju skems sbyor ba 'dus pa'i nad// pho mchin mi bde khrag 'khru sna khrag 'dzag / sha skams shed med mchin pa rul nas 'chi// mkhris pa mig ser gi waṃ ga bur sbyar// mkhris yul rgyas nas mig sprin sha mdangs ser//rims nad rtsa byer rims kyi na lugs 'dra// nag po thog deg dug sbrul mgo la sbyar// mig sbrid glad dkyil gzer ldang bsus pa sbo// 'khyam po gza' nad phral du rengs kyin 'gyel// rkang lag bshal sbrid mig 'bor sha skam 'chi// gzer nad chu 'gags byang pa la sbyar bas// rtsa mig rgyu zhabs gzer la dri chu 'gag / gzhug la rtsar byer khrag skyug sna khrag 'dzag / de la sogs te sbyor ba sna tshogs las// nad rigs sna tshogs du ma 'byung bar 'gyur// ldang dus sgo nas brtag pa zhag gi dug / sbyor ba ma smin rno 'am rkyen phrad pas//glo bur langs te ma zhu lta bu 'am// sprug po'am rims ltar na ba phal che ste//phral du mig ldong lce mchu 'gas pa dang // rengs sam 'gyel zhing dran pa

khanang g.yon tan gyi da/ 547nyams kyang srid zla dug sha skams sen mo'i bkrag med ngal mchu skam so nag mig 'grib rna ba 'ur// khong sbo tshigs gzhi skug po'i thig le 'ong / zho 'thungs sbo zhing chang 'thungs za zi mang // lo dug sha skams mchin pa 'phyongs nas na// spro thung ngu snying 'dod cing rna ba 'ur// mkhal ma grang zhing lto che bag re rngul// srin bu ldog cing chang 'thungs lus nyam chung // so na rtsib logs 'pho zhing ltag pa dgye// gnyid med pho ba gzer dang za 'phug byed// babs sa gnas kyi sgo nas brtag pa ni// snying la babs na lce ldeb shes pa 'phyo// rngul che sbrid pa mang la shugs ring byed// glor babs sna 'gags g.ya' la sbrid pa 'byung // glo mang gre ba mdzer la skyigs bu mang // mchin par babs na mig zhu mchin dri gzer// mkhris skyug 'tshogs ma lci la kha chu 'dzag / mcher babs mchu na sbo zhing rtsib thung na// sna ldang grangs na 'gying zhing tsha na 'gyung // mkhal babs mkhal rked grang zhing mkhal rtsa khrid// rkang pa lci la chu sri rna ba 'ur// snod du lhung na sgrog sgyug zas mi 'ju/ rgyu long sbo 'khrog tsha 'gyung 'khru ba yin// shar babs 'gul 'phrig grims chung pags pa sngo// rtsa grims rtsa rnams 'khrid 'khyug sbrid pa ste/ chu ba la babs bshul rengs yan lag 'khum// rus babs tshigs pa na zhing mnyes na phan//tshigs kha 'khor skrangs brkyang bskum dka' ba dang // rus pa thams cad skam khol khyed pa yin// de ltar bye brag so so'i nad rtags rnams/ gzhan dang 'khrul phyir nges pa rnyed dka' bas// phyi nang gsang rtags gsum gyi bar nas 'don// de yis 'khrul med nges par gtan la phebs// mi thub 'chi ltas sha zad mur gong rdib// dang ga 'gags sam zas sgom zos tshad skyug / lce rnyil sen mo'i bkrag thor lus stobs zad/ 'brum pa nag pos khyab dang rngam pa thung // gnas lngar skrangs dang smyo dug sman mi len/ nang grol rul 'khru gson khrag 'khru skyug byed// de rtags ldan na mi 'tsho spang bar bya gso ba'i

548 ༄gyi/grwa nga da ba'i thabs la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ spyi la dug nad sman gyis gso ba dang //dug nad dug gis gso dang sngags kyis gso// dang po tsha sbyor grang sbyor rnam pa gnyis/ tsha sbyor gsar rnying lus zungs stobs dang sbyar// gang yang dang po sman gyis gzhi bzung la// zungs bzang gsar pa bsdu bsad sbyang pas bcos// zungs ngan rnyings na bsdu bsad chig chod bya// dang po tshogs bsags gnod pa'i gdon yang bcos// snga dro zas bsrung phyi dro nan tur bskyed// nya phag bshul sha sngo ngad rul skyur spang // ba lang rna dgo sha gsar khur mangs dang // 'bras dang yos thug ja dang chu bsil bsten// zungs ngan drod chung rgas la lug sha gsar// skam yib chang gsar tshod dang sbyar zhing btang // me nyi ngal dub nyal po bzhon pa dang / smra brjod rlan grangs nyin gnyid spang bar bya// tshad pa can la a ru gser mdog thang // grang ba che la 'bras gsum pi pi ling // khyor re snga dro zhag bdun bar du bsten// de yis 'du ba snyoms shing nad zungs 'byed// rngul chad lus yang dang ga bde ba dang / bya ba nus snyam byed na smin pa yin// de nas ma byer gsar la bsdu mi dgos// rnyings shing byer bar gyur na bsdu ba gces// sdud byed sman la spyi dang khye brag gnyis// dang po lug khrag 'o ma gnyis btsos la// de la lug ru kha tshar btab pas sdud// yungs kur bong nga re ral a ru ra// dza ti nā ga puṣṭha ba lang khrag / lham rtsa glan pa ma dul tshwa dang sbyar mi phyugs gson khrag ldum gsum bar zhun dang // chu chung yungs kur phye ma sbyar la btang // dkar po chig thub dbang po lag pa dang // yungs kur phag khrag bi ṣa ka ra sbyar/phag khrag dbang po lag pa yungs kur dang // glad pa sbyar te ma 'dus bar du btang ku 'dus rtags lus lci sgyid skyur dang ga 'gag / kha lce skam la pho ba tsha rub byed// de rtags med na ma 'dus sman thun bskyed// pho bar rus dugs rgyu zhabs bye dugs bya// mthil bzhi bsku mnye man ngag dug sna gsum ru

༄gyi khan ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 349bdun 'gyur dri chu'i ril bu btang / de yis 'dus nas gnyen po'i sman gyis bsad/ ma 'dus bsad pa ri dgas thang 'ded 'dra// byer ba mi gsod bcos dka' yun du sbyong / 'dus na me steng chu bzhin choms pa skyen/ bye brag so po'i sdud byed bsten pa ni/ dzā ti gur gum lham rtsa li shi yis nyes pa gsum la babs pa sdud par byed/ ma nu bzhi thang ston du byer ba sdud//gro sran bong khrag snod bzhir byer ba sdud/ mtshar 'brum mi do mkhris pa dbang lagabazhi pas yan lag byer ba sdud// phra men sbyor bar ma ra rta snying mkhal ma zho snying zhoshas tshigs la byer ba sdud// rgyal blon ga bur cu gang gur gum gsum gyis gre bar byer ba sdud// tig ta smre tres ga ra thegasum pas so la byer ba sdud// 'dus nas bsad thabs rnam pa gsum yin te// sngo sbyor rtsi sbyor rin po che dang gsum// stobs bzang tshad pa che la pho ba bzang // gnyen po bdud rtsi sngo sbyor bsngags pa yin// re ral hong len 'om bu spang rtsi do// 'khor du rnam par ser po khrag rkang dang // tig ta spang rgyan sku bzang gang ga chung // ra mnye bskol khu sum yar yun du bsten// tsha ba shin tu zhen che rnam par dang / re ral spang rtsi 'om bu hong len dang // tig ta gtso bo drug pa de yi 'khor//brag zhun bong nga zhib btags grangs sings bya// gang la babs pa'i kha 'dzin don la bzang drug lam ru rus la zhur la dom mkhris grogs dang bcas// 'ju tshon sbyar la ma brjed rgyun par btang / 'ju dka' skabs su rgyam tsha gsum pa bsten// tsha stobs chag gam 'on te snod du 'dus// a ru lcam rtsa dur byin bsnan la sbyang // yang na gtso bo drug dang spang rgyan dkar/ se skyer brag spos tha rams gang ga chung ta gang babs kha 'dzin snying la snying zho sha glo la sro lo mchin pa la gur gu ma phyir pa mkhal pa la tsi traka la yung ba rus pa la spyi zhur la 'bri ta sa 'dzin bcas pa thang du btang / yang na sngo yi mang sbyor thun mong pa/ gtso bo gnyen po grogs dang dmag mir bcas pa ni ga bo drug pa/ gnyen po zang nga gsum ma ba khur rtsa lnga/

550 sa༅/grwa nga dba'i/grogs gang ga chung stag sha lug mig byi tsher stod par pa ta khrag rkang bdun/ dmag mi sro lo re smon kyi de bsu ma cu)ga dar ya kan sgong thog lcang ma brgyad/ / phyag brnyan kha 'dzin se rgod skyer shun su ga ru gsum/ pri ya lcags gye sro 'o ma krong star bu dang bcas pa'i sbyor ba la//nad gzhi'i rlung la ru rta mkhris la gser bdakan la mnu khrag la bsha ka chu ra la nga ldengadon la bzang drug snod la dang po smin pa dang mgrang bskyes na btang bar du tshab 'byungadus su mi btang sbo 'khrog byed na 'byu tshab gsum bldan lam ru yu nga brtsal dom mkhrisa'akhyu ta rus pa la rdo bzhi mtshal dang// gre ba la lirsha spang rgyan ya ru gang la babs pa'i sna khrid sbyar// bsdus grangs yun ring sum yar btang bar bya// de la sogs pa'i sngo sbyor gang la yang // spa ling bragazhun gnyis kyis du ga'adon ba rus nus skyed ya nus lus zungs bsrung ba gces/ thang rjes 'khrur ma 'dod na grogs po snam rtsa dur gyi dam chu ring bsnan// gzer zug gang byung gtso bo drug gas bsdu// tsha ba choms dka' de rnams gang la yang // sbal rgyab mtshal dang rnam par kha tshar gdab// nad kyis sman blangs lus yang dang ga bde// snying rtsa seng na nad mgo non pa yin// yang na bslang nas phral du 'thab pa la// rjes la gong gi rtags ldan phal cher 'byung // bsrings kyin gnod na mi 'phrod spang bar bya//zungs ngan gas sam drod chung dang ga zhan// de la rtsi sbyor phye mas bcos pa yi//rgyal blon nyi shu rtsa bdun sbyar ba ni// bse ru mu tig lcags phye tsha la mtshal//a mṛ ta dang gi waṃ bzang po drug / re ral 'om bu se rgod skyer bar zhun//tsan dan a ru spyi zhur thong nga dkar// mi dom phag mkhris phya tshan rnam pa gsum// rin chen rtsi sngo dngos dang sha sbyor 'joms// gang rtags ldan pa'i gnyen po cha bskyed la// stag sha go stod kyi lce shing mngar tshos// yung ba gla rtsi dri chen brag zhun dang // mi sha lcags zhun phye ma ka ra sbyar// seng ldeng khu bas 'phul bas dug rnams 'joms// tsha ba che na de steng ga bur bsnan// yang na rin chen gnyen po brag zhun dang // tsha la a ru ra gsum rdo sbyor la// ze tsha rma

zhu man ngag yon tan gyi da/ 551bya'i sha dang pi pi ling // sha la ro tshan gsum dang mi ra'i mkhris// sngo la ldum bu gsum dang bong nga dkar// rtsi yi gnyen po gla rtsi bzang po drug / gang rtags ldan pa'i gnyen po cher bskyed la// de 'khor bse ru chos sman yung ba dang // dpa' bo dkar ser khyung sder dkar srug dang / 'om bu skyer pa spang spos zhing mngar chos// lcags phye seng phrom rnam bar so ma ra// mtshal dkar spang rgyan ram bu ka ra'i phye// ga bur tsan dan gi waṃ tsha stobs sbyar/ nang nub brag zhun khu bas 'phul la btang // yang na brag zhun gla rtsi rma bya'i sha /mi dang ra yi mkhris pa ro tshan gsum// re ral bong nga dkar po bzang po drug / de 'khor ga bur gi waṃ tsan dan gnyis// bse ru a ru ra dang chos sman dang // yung ba spang rtsi 'om bu skyer pa dang / kyi lce brag spos shing mngar hong len dang // sro lo seng phrom rnam par ba le ka / so ma ra dza spang rgyan gang ga chung // dpa' bo dkar ser khyung sder dkar thag dang // tsha la lcags phye mtshal tshos ram bu rnams// ka ra sbyar bas dug tshad rol du gsod// yang na mi dom spre phag rna tso dang // rma bya'i mkhris pa re ral ro tshan gsum// bse ru yung ba gla rtsi a ru ra// chos sman gi waṃ 'om bu thong nga dkar/ tsan dan dkar dmar skyer shun yungs kur dang // tsha la brag zhun gangs chus bsings pas dbul/ yang na dom dang rma bya'i mkhris pa dang // mkhris pa sna tshogs khyung sder a ru ra// sbal sbrul zer po'i stod sha mchin mkhris bcas// gi waṃ tsan dan gar babs bzang drug dang / gang ga chung rnams ka ra sbyar la btang // yang na mi phag phyi mkhris so ma ra// gla rtsi shing kun spang rgyan kyi lce dkar// re ral skyer pa sgog skya char nyung rnams ril bur byas pas dug rnams 'joms par byed sbyor ba de rnams kun gyi gnyen po ste// dug tshad rol du gsod pa'i dam pa yin// tsha ba thon dka' sman dred bsod ldan la//rin po che yi sbyor bas bsad pa ni// gser g.yu mu tig byu ru tsan dan gnyis/

552 lta thang da bzhi/rdo dreg cu gang gur gum utpa la/ ka ra sbyar btang yang na mu tig dang / nya phyis ru bse ru dkar po dang // gla rtsi mi dom mkhris pa tsan dan dkar/cu gang gur gum phye ma ka ra la// rlung mkhris bad kun khrag dang chu ser dang ⑪don snod gang la babs pa'i kha bsgyur bya/ khyad par dbyig la sbyongs dang dkar kun spang // rdo yi dug la mar nag mar rnying spang / sha yi dug la nya phag rul skyur spang // rtsi yi dug la gtar khrag tshod ma spang // dug gang gnyen po'i sman gyis ma sod par/ gtar dang me btsa' bshal skyugs byas gyur na ku nad byer stod la 'dzin zhing slong phyir spang / de ltar gnyen po sman gyis gso dus su// nad rlangs rlung la zhon nas rtsa mig 'khrug / gzer 'khyug skrangs dang tsha sbrid 'byung bar byed// gzer sar gtso bor drug po btsos la bdug / yang na re cag sho mang rtsa ba dang / spang rtsi do bo btsos pas bdug par bya// yang na gang na'i dngos po btsos pas bdug / lto ba spangs na mchod rten sru yis bdug / dus tshigs skrangs na byang ltas sa yis bdug / thur brkyang rlangs thon rtsar 'dus kha phye gtar ta gal tshigs rtsib ma gzer sar me yis mnan/ de ltar nad rlangs ma thon phyir gram nas//nad rems gso dka' ro mi thon pa yin/ bsad rjes nad mgo choms nas ro sbyang ba// spyi dang bye brag sbyang ba rnam pa gnyis// spyi ru nad gang yin yang bshal gyis sbyang // sngon 'gro mi ring khrus dang bsku mnye bya// steng rlung kha yan gzer 'khyug me yis mnan/ pho long srin khros ldang dub ril bus gdul/sna sel 'bras bu gsum dang pyi yang ku// lcam rtsa brag zhun skyer pa'i thang btang la// dngos gzhi a ru skyu ru dan da dang // dong ga byi tang ga la ril bu sbyar// dbyig dug la shing kun la ru tsha shu da zi ra nu rdo dug tsha tshal spa ling dug la gur gumado ma mkhris spos da ra dur dkar dug la ka spyid so ma ra dza srin ra mo dur gyi dka ra nad steng mkhris pa kha bsgyur bshal gyis sbyang skyo bshal 'phul chung

ga khan nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 553na a ru ra yi lcag / mchin pa na na brag zhun khu ba'i lcag / pho ba sgangs na rgyam tsha'i lcag gis brab// yang na a ru skyer shun so ma ra// dong ga bri ta sa 'dzin spang rgyan dkar/ lham rtsa bsdus khu dur byin btab pas sbyang // yang na thar nu dur byid rma bya'i sha / stong len tsha grang brag zhun gangs thigs bskur/ ril bu phye ma gang 'phrod rig pas sbyang / bye brag sbyang ba pho bar babs na skyugs rtsa la babs na rtsa bshal bya ba ste/ sha pags dus la babs pa rngul du dbyung / nad 'di zungs dang yun du zhen pa'i phyir// bsdu bsad sbyang gsum zungs sbyar ci rigs bskyar/ sbyor skor tshar re'i bar du lus zungs gso// zungs ngan nad rnyings bsdu bsad chig chod bya// a ru brag zhun bong nga rnam pa gsum// dpa' bo dkar ser tsan dan dkar dmar dang // cu gang gur gum gi waṃ chos sman dang / re ral yung ba dom mkhris se 'bru dang / se rgod skyer pa yungs kur phye ma sbyar/ brag zhun khu bas 'phul bas chig chod byed// yang na bong nga gsum dang a ru ra// gi waṃ bse ru dkar po tsan dan gnyis// dom mkhris gla rtsi tsha la re ral dang // yung ba 'om bu skyer zhun ka ra sbyar// brag zhun seng ldeng thang gis 'phul la btang /yang na a ru ra dang bong nga dkar// skyer zhun gi waṃ tsan dan bse ru dang //nad gzhi don snod kha 'dzin bcas par sbyar// chu gsum bsres pas 'phul te brid la btang // yang na mi dom rma bya'i mkhris pa dang // dpa' bo dkar ser khyung sder dkar srug gnyis// bong nga gsum dang re ral rgyam tsha rnams/tho rangs thun re gang chus 'phul la btang / tsha grang thun mong sel byed skyug na bsrung // yang na a ru ra dang bong nga gsum/ dpa' bo dkar ser khyung sder dkar sprug gnyis// se rgod dgu thub gla rtsi re ral dang // tsha la yung ba dom mkhris phya tshan gsum/ chos sman 'om bu brag zhun skyer pa dang / gi waṃ bse ru tsan dan dkar po rnams// nyes pa babs sa'i kha 'dzin rlung la ru rta

554 sa༅/grwa nga rgyud ba /ma khris la tis ta bad dan spa ling khrig la sa chu ra por don la bzang po lnga srog rtsa la ba sbyar byas te zug la mi skrag nad dang 'thab pa yin/ yang na gi waṃ bong nga a ru ra// gur gum cu gang tsan dan mkhris sna tshogs// sbal sgrul zer mo'i ston sha mchin mkhris bcas// sag rtsi phag tshil ka ra gangs chus dbul// yang na rma bya dom mkhris glang chen mkhris/ rim bskyed kun dang sbrul sha stod cha mnyam//a ru ra dang bong nga sbrul sha mnyam// bzang drug gang la babs pa 'gre log sbyar// brag zhun spyi zhur thang gis 'phul la btang // mchog tu zungs ngan sha zad nad la bsngags// rma bya'i mkhris pa tsad dang dgu thub dang // gla rtsi re ral rim pas log por bskyed// byi ku sag rtsi nya dang mi mkhris dang // lo brgyad dri chu'i ril bu byas la btang // de dag kun gyis sdu gsod chig chod byed// tsha ba zungs la rtsi ltar zhen pa'i phyir dar drags pa yis zhen pa mi sel bar// pho ba'i me 'chi tshad ro ldas pa'i phyir// thun bskyungs yun du bsrings la rol du bsad// skabs su rgyun bshal btang zhing nad ro sbyang //shin tu zungs ngan 'jam rtsi ni ru spel// rang bshal rang rngul byung na sbyang mi dgos// grang sbyor bcos pa byi brun pi pi ling // sga skya tsha la 'om bu sag ram rtsi// rgya skyegs bu ram sbyar ba chu bskol dbul// skabs su dur byin spos dkar pi pi ling // a ru sga skya sbyar bas nad ro sbyang // skya rbab skrangs na srad dkar rtsa ba bsnan// de rjes mu zi zangs thal 'gron thal dang // tsha ba gsum thal gong steng bsnan te bskam/ skran du 'dril na ze tsha ya bakṣa// tsha ba gsum dang 'gron bu'i thal ba bsnan/ tsha la a ru skyer zhun bul rtog sbyar// yang na 'gron zangs tsha ba gsum sogs thal gangs thigs bul tog tsha la mi rus btsa'// mi dom mkhris pa brag zhun yung ba dang // khur rtsa rnam snang gar babs bzang po drug / a ru chu bskol 'phul bas gsod cing sbyong / 'khrur ma 'dod na dur byin pi pi ling // tsha la ba chur sbyar bas nad ro sbyang // yang

zhum na nga g.yon tan gyi khyud/ 355na cong zhi 'phrul gyi thal sman sbyar// rjes la a ru dan rog ril bus sbyang //grang yang tsha tshul ston na tsha ba gsum thal ba tshad 'joms spyi sman sbyar bas sel// kha zas lug sha gsar dang skam yib dang // chang 'jam zas spyod drod la bsten par bya'o// bye brag bcos thabs 'jug sgo rdzas rigs dang // nad rigs ldang dus babs sa'i sgo nas bcos// dang po 'jug sgo'i rigs kyis bcos pa ni// dud pa nyi zer rlangs dugs rnam gsum la// gtso bo drug sbyor phyi ma'i thang steng du/ bong nga brag zhun bsnan pas dud pa 'joms// gtso bo drug gi lums kyis phyi nas 'dug / rjes la dmar po gsum gyi sman mar sbyar//nyi zer rlangs la bdun rtsi'i rlangs lums bya// kor ler na skrangs byung na thon pa yin// rjes la gtso bo drug gi sman mar sbyar// reg pa rma khong gnyis nas bcos par bya/ dri chu dri chen btsir ba'i khu ba la/ gur gum gla rtsi shing kun sgog skya sbyar// de yi khrus bya mu zi ga bur dang / so ma ra dza chu rtsa bul rtog dang // gla rtsi shing kun byang pa g.yer ma dang / dud pa zhib btags sbang gar sbyar la byug / yang na bzang drug mu zi gla rtsi dang / bong nga dkar po spos dkar a ru ra// bse ru ra lug rwa gzhob mar sbyar bsku/ kyi lce sngon bu spyang tsher lham rtsa sga// pi pi ling dang ze tsha sbra rgod sbyar// byugs pas mdze 'bras lhog pa sel bar byed mtshe dang ba lu shug 'bru tsan dan srug / gla rtsi a ru sngon bu 'bras bu gsum// tsan dan dkar po dbang po lag pa dang //snying dang sla gor zho sha ba le ka / chur bsdus mi tshil khyor gang sbyar la byug /a ru ru rta bong nga dkar po dang // mdze tsha dom dang ba lang mkhris pa rnams//rmar blug ra tshil 'jibs bya sha ro che// lcags bsregs me tog sgong ngas 'ag gsum mnan// de 'og mu zi dur byin thar nu dang // rgya tshil dkar po rus pa bsregs pas mnan// sha ro chod nas ra ru bsregs pa dang // pha ba gol gol rnying kun gsom thal dang / a mṛ ta dang sbyar la rma la byug / tsha ba'i rma

356 ga /grwa nga da bzhi/la mi bsreg bsil gsum dang // ga bur tsan dan gi waṃ a ru ra// gla rtsi lcags phye ra khrag sbyar ba byug / bzang drug tsan dan dkar dmar a ru ra/gla rtsi dpa' bo dkar ser spang rtsi do/ sro lo tig ta zhim jig ba sha ka / se 'bru shug 'bru skyu ru bong nga dkar// dom dang ba lang mkhris pa ka ra sbyar khong du btang zhing ra khrag ra sha bsten// rdzas kyi sbyor ba'i sgo nas bcos pa ni//rin chen spyi yi gnyen po brag zhun dang // a ru mu men mu zi kun la gces//khyad par gser la til dang zar ma bsnan// zangs la tsha la 'khar ba sgog skya bsnan / dngul chu'i gnyen por star bu ba chu btang // zha nye mdzo mar rna ba glang spu'i gzhob// yang na gser dngul zangs lcags mu tig g.yu// byu ru tsan dan dkar dmar rdo dreg dang // utpal cu gang gur gum ka ra sbyar//rang rang ngos zin gong gi mde kha bsgyur// yang na ra khrag ratna 'ag dgur btang // de 'og bse ru bzang drug a bi ṣa// utpal gla rtsi gi waṃ ka ra dang //ra yi mchin pa sbyar la btang bar bya// bong nga dom sbrul mkhris pa'i ril bu btang // rdo sbyor spyi yi gnyen por tsha ba gsum// ze tsha rgya tsha tsha la rma bya'i shakhyad par sbal rgyab ti tsha tsong zhi mtshal// mu zi'i gnyen por chang bzang pi pi ling / yu gu shing dang sgog skya sbrang rtsis bsgyur// yang na grang sbyor 'joms pa'i sman stengs su/ ze tsha rgya tsha bsnan pas 'joms par nges// yang na rgya tsha rgyam tsha kha ru tsha// ze tsha tsha la tsha ba gsum sbyar btang // sha sbyor spyi yi gnyen por dom mkhris dang // mi rta'i ro tshan dang ni stag sha ba// 'om bu bong nga dkar po tsha la yin/ khyad par ra la gur gum a ru ra// a bi ṣa gsum bya la gur gum dang // sre mo'i sma ra bya mo nag mo'i sha / khyi yi sha la dud pa bya bal ma// sre po'i sha la zhug pa srin bya btang // yang na 'bras bu gsum mam bzang drug sbyar// byang pa chu sbyar cha ga thong nga dkar// yang na 'bre mog khur rtsa ra khrag 'joms// nya la skyar mo sbal pa migs pas 'joms// sdom la srad

kho khanang ga yon tan gyi bad/ 557dkar sdig la ljong mo dang / migs pa sbal pa dpa' bo ser pos 'joms/gong mo mdze khrag tig ta spang rtsi do// ri bong mkhris pa dom mkhris phya tshan gsum// gi waṃ la ni khyi lud dri chen btang / spu la brag zhun gur gum ga bur bsnan// yang na rgya tsha rgya skyegs brag zhun btang // rus par ze tsha mu zi bong nga dkar/ mde kha spyi sman sbyar bas 'joms pa yin sba bye og dkar sha ni kun mi gces// yang na gi waṃ nya spre'i mkhris pa dang // gla rtsi brag zhun chos sman sbyar la btang / yang na sngo sbyor dgu yi thang gis 'joms de lar ra'i brag spos ha bo gsum skyer pa 'om bu mi ya nga ku gsum mar spang rgyan stag shagasum btang bas kha bsgyur sngo nga dang 'dra sbyar dug kun sgril sa dpar spyor 'joms par gyed sru la dud pa brang kun ltag spu'i gzhob// rjes la rnon po dur byid dung rgya tsha ltar bu'i bshal gyis spu ro sbyang // rma bya'i sgong dug bya mtshal mkhris pa dang // spu shud co ga'i sgo ngas 'joms par byed// rtsi dug gnyen por gla rtsi a bi ṣa// bse ru bzang drug chos sman gces pa yin// khyad par gla rtsi med du mi rung ngo // yang na lha yi bdud rtsis 'joms par byed/ dug dngos bong nga dkar ser dmar po gsum// a ru ha bo phya tshan yung ba dang // rgya tsha bul rtog dri chus 'joms par 'gyur// sngo sbyor gnyen por 'om bu lug mig pa// khur rtsa spra thog bong nga'i lo mas 'joms// yang na gser tig spra thog mug chos dang // gi waṃ bsil gsum bse ru gla rtsi dang / btsod dang ka ra dri chus 'phul bas 'joms// khyad par thang phrom re ral ba sha ka / yang na rgya lung sgog skya nu thos 'joms/ 'ol ma se la ba le ba sha ka / zho sha sug sprel cu gang tig tas 'joms// dur byin la sogs 'khru byed gnyen por ni// drod skyed bzhu dang ro sbyang gcod pa gces/ 'khru ba'i dug la bshal sman kun gnod de/ de phyir a ru lham rtsas bkru bar bya// sngo sbyor kun la re ral gces pa yin// na lugs sgo nas bcos pa mdze dug la// rtsa sbyongs bshal drag po btang rjes la ba shas

558 ༄/grwa thang dab /tshal bya lo brgyad dri chub tung thang ra zhun gi waṃ cha do 'du bong nga tigata bragazhun 'i mthig gangasachu'i bci sa la btang dngul na dbyung na lams gso bar bya'o phye rag pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltarabatang ril bul ra'i 'o ma stong la 'a lnga btang ya ru tha bya'i dong mu zi cong chi cusang kyi lce ra mi tshil nga bur ril bu byas pa'o sman rtsis ma zis pa tshogs dngul la dur gyi da sdong ros khyi'u da sor ga mar bug gi sgro dri chen ya ta sbrang po cher khri bur lo bco 4lon pa'i chu la sbyar bsabyu bcos// spyo ba'i dug la spang rgyan bzang drug sbyar/ sgog gcig sa mtshur gur gum ha bo dang // re ral rim bskyed ha bo sbya ra la btang // 'bras bu gsum po chang du sbangs khu btung // rus sna'i khu bar zhing kun pi pi ling //kha tshar btab btang drug bdun nu dbrag bsreg / 'bog na se 'bru sgog skya do ba'i 'bru// sman mar sbyar btang rjes la gong bzhin bsreg / dre rgod dug la bu mo lo lnga 'am// lo dgu lon pa'i don lnga dbang po lnga// nyung gzhi mar khu sbyar la sngags 'di gdab/ oṃ trig le hri su hā/ 'ag gsum lto ba bkug la btang bar bya// kha rma rgyu skams shug los rgyu zhabs bdug / krad rnying a ba rwa gzhob khur bkang bcang // a bi ṣa dang rma bya'i mkhris pa dang / sha gnyis btsos khrag sbrang smyon ril bu sbyar// za rems ltag dgye ldan chu bya yi khrag /gtsod khrag tsan dang gla rtsi sbyar la btang // rgya nad rengs 'khums dom mkhris a ru ra// shing rta mo gas pa sdig pa 'i gsum mdzo yi mar dang sbyar la btang // srin bu sna zan bya khyung ril bus 'joms// smug po 'ju skems sprug po spyi yi sman// mang sbyor chen mo ltag pa sprad pas 'joms/ mkhris pa mig ser dang po ra khrag khyi lud dri chen khu ba dang sbyar ba'i khrag bshal btang // de 'og skyerashun bub phul gyed sbyin chu ba smyol lan ba btang ba'i skyugs dang zhi byed sbyang dang ba chusalag bsris la sbyin ra'i rwa gzhob chu'i sbyangs la btang zhag ba na long rtsal gtar gyis bcos//rims nad rtsar byer sngo thang chen mo btang // de nas gye ma rjes la me yis bcad// nag po thog brdeg gnyen po gi waṃ te// sha sbyor spyi yi gnyen por

sa khan ngag yon tan gyi khyud/ 559sdebs te sbyar// 'khyam po gza' nad gnyen po gu gul nag / re ral a ru ra dang dud pa dang // gser skud rgya tsha ka sho gan ta dang / ra khrus lcam rtsa rgya sne bul tog 'joms// re re gnyis gnyis bzhi dang bdun du sbyar// ba yi chu la ril bu phye ma bya// ril bu bdun bdun glang chu chang gis dbul// phye ma phul re chang dang dri chus ded// mtshon cha gsal shing hos dang rtsi la sogs/ lo zla zhag dang phyi nang sbyor ba'i rigs// nad rigs mi 'dra sna tshogs gtong gyur kyang // 'ag bdun gyis ni nges par gsos par nus// sdud gsod sbyong ba chig chod byed pa yin// gzer nad chu 'gags gla rtsi bong nga dkar// chu sbur yung ba thal ka rdo rje dang // 'bre mog khur rtsa ra khrag sbyar bas 'joms// de 'og rtsa sbyongs rjes la chu sman bsten// ldang ba'i dus kyi sgo nas bcos pa ni//zhag dug gnyen po gong 'dra gzhan na med// zla dug bdud rtsi sngo yi sbyor bas sel// lo yi dug la rin chen rtsi sbyor bsten// babs sa gnas dang sbyar la bcos pa ni// snying la babs na mu tig cu gang gur gum re ral 'dam bu dbang lag zangang dkar dzo bdun pa 'am// tsan dan gur gum gdur tis ta snyi ba'i tog lnga dang sha sbyor ri bong gi snying te lo'i glan pa srig pa'i sgong sa bur rnam snang lnga pa sbyor// glor babs ga bur tsandan dkar da ra cu gang gur gum ba le ka sun 'brum rgya tsha byi tang ka dgu dang sha sbyor dom gyi gla ba'i snying sres pa dang 4na bya'i dpa hong na ga bur khru sang 'ogs dri chubargyad//mchin babs gur gum cugang tigataka ko la nal sar na gsu ba le utpal li shi zi yangaku shing tsha'i nga rma nga rabacu gnyis ga bur gur gum chagadu li khrimatshal tig ta ho len re ral gro chang sro lo sa bsings pa dgu mcher babs li shi gur gum cugang su ga sprel tigata rdo dregabasha ka stag sder dom mkhris gla rtsi mutpal ka ra dang sbyar ba'i bcu gcig se 'bru dgu shing tsha guragum pi spyi ling ka ko la ru rta bong ba dam khris chen yang na sbyor nas zan dang bu shudaglad pa ra'i mcher pa gla ba'i so ga sha ru rta ba ka ze'u'i snying ri snying rnam snang ga bur srig pa'ibyan bcu gnyis bsten par bya/ mkhal mar babs na da byid zho sha gsum gur gum

560 ༄cu grwa thang rgyud ba'i/sug sprel dza ti li zhi ko la rgya mtsho bas rsha la tse mtshe tshigs srin bu dug po nyung tha'i da rdo rje so ma ra dzadang bcu drug sbyar / snod du babs na bshal las lhag pa med// phye ma se 'bru sug sprel tsa tsha tsa ma tsha tres snar bum nu traka da tri sdig pa shing tsha yab la nga tang tshe rugar nyung ga 'i mar khu dang sbyar bsangs chus dbul bcu bzhi sbyar bas 'joms// byad par pho bar babs na se 'bru ming tsha lirsha rgya tsha che stod drug / rgyu mar babs na gla rtsi bong dkar po re ra 'dam bu bar cu sang mtshal drug pa sbyar / long du babs na sgog skya chis skyas byi tang sam ru gur gu ba'i ba sbyar// sgang par babs na sdig srin rgya tsha sus sprel gla rtsi nyi dga' ya ru drug pa sbyar/ ma khris par babs na ga bur gur sum cu ga tigata ba le ka shing mngar hong len bdun pa sbyar// sha dang pags la babs na rngul du dbyung // dbyung thabs gsum sbyor bzang drug gis don tshad 'phul tshab gsum gyis smod tshan 'phul 'bras bu gsum gyis phyi tshad 'phul bar byed pas sum du byas la gcig tho rangs chang gis 'phul btang bas la ma 'byed/ gcig snga dro rus khus dbul tshab 'gul bas bos dro bar gon gcig phyed chab chos dbul jul dbyung bar bya'o rgya sne'i sbyor ba shis du ba bya bal ma dang gu gul nas po cha mnyam de'i brgyad 'gyur rgya mdu sa sho na ta ba chu'i ril bu bya thorangs nga jis dbul nam bdun lon nas sne'u da tsos bas bdugs la rngul drag spyo dbyung ngo rngul rjes bal dang phyes phyi khams gso btang // nad zungs sbyar la gsum lnga ci rigs gdon// tshad rnying ba srur 'don pa'i dpyad mchog yin// rus zhen spra yas khol bur gram pa la// rngul gyis mi 'drongs rlangs lums byas la gdon tsha bcu na bdud lnga spang drung can la mi dus rtsams la ba bcas drung sgo dud khung ba ga zangs su bskol zhing khril ra rgyangs la gla lo ga spos kyin dbyung khams gso btang ngo / shin du gdon dka' rang byung chu lums bya// rtsa la babs na nang rtsa rtsa nas sbyang //phyi rtsar babs na rtsa kha phye tsam gtar// de rjes a ru g.yag mkhris nyung gzhi mar// cong 'i bu mo lo brgyad chus 'phul 'joms// gsum pa dug nad dug gis bcos pa ni// nang yan grogs po mtshon cha rnam pa gsum// rin chen

zhu mnang g.yon tan gyi da 561nang yan gser dngul byu ru zangs// mu tig g.yu drug grogs su rdo dreg lnga//gsod pa'i mtshon char bse ru bskur bas 'joms// rdo la nang yan gangs thigs chu de 'u// g.yu dang mtshal dkar cong zhi rnam pa lnga// tsha ba gsum gyi grogs la ze tsha'i mtshon// sha la nang yan bu mo re 'u khyi// bya mchin rma bya'i sha lnga brag zhun grogs// gsod pa'i mtshon du bong nga dkar po bskur// dngos la nang yan dug sna ci tshogs la// grogs su a ru mtshon du dri chu bskur//slong sdud ngo bos ngo bo 'joms byed pa// dper na srungs ma bdud du babs dang mtshungs// gtso bo ngos 'dzin gang yin sran tsam re// de bas ches na nang yan dgra la ldog / sbyor 'di sman dang ltag pa sprad kyang shis/ dug nad sngags kyis gso ba 'di lta ste/ oṃ ka li ku ku ri tad 'ung / 'bu 'dzu bha ti se dha na dha nyis/ bha gang lung / a na lhas/ rdos gang lung / lhas pa ri ka 'ung /lhas gang lha lhas/ ha ra ha ra me hūṃ khyi su hā/ srab bha ra lhas/ la hi ka ro a sbo ta ka ri pa ri na ho/ ma hā sgru ro/ ni lan kun dha to hor tsa/ ha ri rtsis/nan ti lhas/ oṃ shad de shad de su hā/ oṃ shed shed bi shed su hā/ oṃ krug le hri a hri kha/ nyi shu rtsa res rang nyid srung ba ste// brgya 'am stong gis gzhan gyi dug nad sel// btsan dug sha dug sbyar dug ma lus 'joms/ tsheg med gser gyis bris nas btags pas thub// drang srong rnams kyis 'di la gces par gyis// de nas gso ba'i log gnon bstan pa ni// zas dang spyod lam 'khrul nas log pa dang // gdon gyis log dang bla gnyan thor bu'i nad//'du ba log dang gcod du log pa'o// zas spyod log pa skyon nyid yon tan 'gyur// gsod cing sbyong ba ro mi ldas pa'i rgyu// gdon gyis log pa mo phywa rim gros bcos// bla gnyan thor bu'i nad sna gang byung bsal// mgo dang glan pa na na ga bur cu gang brag zhun tis ta i ru tsan dan dug zhung ba le bshadagu// sgong mar sbyar la ra mkhris chu yis dbul// skyes pa'i chu dang gnyen po ga mig mkhris ba sgru gla

562 zhu/rga zang rgyud bzhi/ lcam pa bzhi sbyar btang / yang na rdo sbyor gangs gas sprul rgyab tsha 'i cong ji cho lo nga 'brug rus drug pa btang bas sel// mig dmar tsha 'gribs byug sman ni ga bur gla rtsi sa rtsi mar dkar ya ru byug nu nodang skye ra pa byug chu lcag bya 'bras bu gsum skyer pa go stod mi 'bras ka ra ba mar gyi sman mar sbyar lagatar bas bsal// mig 'gribs dom mkhris glang rog mkhris pa btang // gre ba mdzer 'gags mcher pa ba'i nga mcher skam li shichu grang sbyar ba'i sbyor ba 'am// spang rgyan bong nga se ba'i mi tog 'phang ma'i bsdus nga aru gcig bsregs gcig rma bsregs pa'i bcis thang se rul khub sod bar zhun gla bcis pa'isbyor bas bsal// glo snying gdung na gi la shus pa g.yer ma sum sbyor btang // snying 'phyo stab seng chang du sbangs khu la// dzā ti btab btang bdun pa me yis bsnan// glo skam mang lu bur dkar spang rgyan cu gang li ga dur star bu ru rta 'byu sro losrin bya'i 'i ting khrol btang / mchin pa na na ba mkhal smug po'i thang //mkhal gzer pi pi ling dang zho sha'i thang // pho ba sbos na ru rta rgyam tsha shingatshagasum thang btang // pho log glang thabs nad la so bya dur gyid dom mkhris ma ru'i rgya bshal bya// yang na re ral gnyis ma ru gur gum 0ma tsha la tsha drug gam tshwa rgya tsha kha rutshar tsha thal tsha dri chu'i thang btang // pho bar 'dril na rgya tsha se 'bru sug sprel gyi thang dang ma ru go sto da mi mar nag la ba smol ba'i snums dugs bya// khrag tu 'khru skyug phya tshan cu gang dang // ga bur gur gum re ral rim pas bskyed// khye 'u 'thung ba'i nu zho sbyar la btang // chu 'gags gla rtsi gze ma'i bsdus thang dang // rgyun 'gags smad 'dren big pan khu ba btang // skyug gam 'khru na ba lci'i sbyor ba byamatshe'u skyong tshogang 'og sa be'u lo 'thung gi myi ba chur sbya ngas)btsas sa khur som ra dzabaskol babatang/ / 'khru ba 'byams na lug sha'i tsho khu btang // gzhan yang gcod sman sbyor ba gang shis bsten// sman zas 'ju dka' sbang skam bsros pas bdug /rgyam tsha pi pi ling gi bsdus thang btang // sha zos na na sha khu khrag skyugs bya thongs mo sha khu la tshwa sna tshos sa tshad btab la btang nang par ra khrig dron rngo tshugs tshad btang bas pas

mi mnang g.yon tan gyi na 563go rjes la se 'bru lnga pa sbyar ro/ / nad rlangs khol bur na na skyer khaṇḍa// rta yi phya tshan chur sbyangs yang yang btang // khol bur gzer 'pho ma nu bzhi thang btang / gnya' rengs ser sha'i thang btang gnya' shas bdug / yan lag rings na gla rtsi bong nga spang spos dza ti ba'i pa dang // bu mo'i chu sbyar ram pa'i bsdus thang btang //mtshan btsos sngo thang khu ba bran pas bdug / lhu tshigs sbrid na nyung khu ma btsosapa'i khub dang ra'i 'o ma nya khu rgod ga shag khu sbya ra ba bud med ma ma'i chus 'phul ba'i sbyor ba bya// pran rtse rus tshigs na na byu seg thang // chu ser skyes na ru rta tsitra ka bong nga dkar po yag mkhris bzhi pa dang // mdze 'bras 'brum pa tsan dan mar khu dang //pags pa tsha tsag byed na gangs chus byug yang na se skye rabar shun po ma ra byug gtso bo dug ga chu gas ga/ de sogs gnyid yar sna khrag 'dzag pa dang // rngul 'byams la sogs tsha ba spyi mdor 'khrul// ga 'an yang dbugs mi bde na khur bskur zhing // ro stod mi bde rdo ba 'phang ba dang // ro smad na na rta zhon 'dur ba dang // rked pa na na sa phad 'khur la sogs// lus sbyongs 'jam pos rtsa nad rang sar 'grems// 'du bar log na rlung mkhris bad kun gsum// bcos gzhug phal cher pho ba'i me drod 'chor// mchin tshad skye 'ing long du rlung 'phel byed// de la drod skyed btang dang 'jam rtsis bsal// rjes la thor bu'i rlung skyes gnyid med cing // g.yal 'dar bog myos 'phyos par 'byung srid na// rus thang tshos khu bur chang bsku mnye bya// kha thal zungs zad rlung gyur tsha bar ldog / de bas zhu 'khyags sa mtshams zin par gyis// bcos nyes pa'am sngon gyi las dbang gis// phal cher dmu skran gcong du log pa mang // skran du log na rgya tsha rgyam tsha dang // shing tsha mdze tsha big pan tsha ba gsum// ru rta a byag sro lo a ru ra// chang sbyar gsum yar btang la bshig nas sbyang // yang na 'bras bu gsum dang se 'bru dang // skyu ru shing tsha dbyi mong tsha ba gsum// spang rtsi bu ram sbrang dang sbyar la btang // dmu chur log

564 sto/grwa nga da ba'i/na dang po mgo skrangs dus/ re ral ri sho khyi glad ra 'o sbyar/ khong du btang dang phyi nas byug pa dang / gca pa tra rgya ru tsi tra ka / dom mkhris 'bras kyi chu yis sbyangs la btang ka mtshe yi thal ba ra mar sbyar bas byug / chur smin sbyang byas se 'bru skyu ru ra// 'gron thal shing mngar rgya tsha pi pi ling / shing tsha a ru sbrang dang nyung ma las// sbyar ba'i ril bu gsum gsum btang bas skems//dmu skran gso ba'i skabs dang 'khrul zhing bcos// bcos rjes phyir mi ldog pa'i rjes bcad thabs/ zas spyad gang 'phrod bslang jing sman dpyad bskyar//sman dred nad la mi bsko sbyor ba spo// gang phan sman de skyor na sman rta bsgyur//dug nad lus la lo zlar 'dres pa'i phyir// yang yang bskyar la tsha ba rtsad nas 'don// zhen che ba la sbyangs rjes chu tshan bya// 'bring la khri lums tha ma rngul du dbyung // zas spyod gnod pas mi ldang rtsad thon pas// a ru bong nga dom mkhris brag zhun bzhi// chu bsing zla ba phyed bsten ldas mi srid// de rjes btso bo drug dang dmar po gsum// 'bras bu gsum dang se rul sman mar la//bzang drug mngar gsum sbyar la btang bar bya// de yis lus rtas phyir mi ldog par byed// yang na spang rgyan dkar po'i sman mar la// mngal khrag phag tshil ril ma sprang sbyar btang // nya phag bshul sha dul skyur dang po'i rta// rta rgyug chags spyod lo dus bar du bsrung // de yis tshe srog mtha' ru phyin par nges// zhes gsungs so//bdud ri snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las sbyar ba'i dug bcos pa'i le'u ste brgyad cu rtsa bdun pa'o// / /

565le'u gya brgyad pa/ gyur pa'i dug bcos pha/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/rkya drang srong chen po nyon cig / gyur pa'i dug la rnam pa gnyis yod de/ mi 'phrod pa yi dug dang sha dug go / dang po rgyu dang rtags dang gso thabs gsum// rgyu ni gnyis te ngo bos mi 'phrod dang // dngas ma ma zhu zungs su ma smin pa'o/ ngo bo mi 'phrod chang gsar zho ma langs| ser sha yungs kur mar la brngos pa dang // khyim bya'i sha 'am zho dang 'o rlon dang // la phug sgog skya yungs kur lo ma 'am/ nya dang sgo nga 'bru mar so ma 'am// la phug rnams su mi 'phrod de dag rnams// snga ma ma zhu phyi ma zos pa 'am/ bsres te zos sam lhan cig zos pa yis// mi 'phrod nus pa 'thabs nas nyes pa 'khrugs yang na mi 'phrod kha zas ma yin kyang // ma goms dus min ngo bos 'ju dka' bas// ma zhu dngas snyigs 'dres te rtsa mig byer// lus zungs bdun po rim kyis 'grib par byed// de rtags rtsa ni phra la gting na grims chu mdog dmar ram smug la ku ya chad// sha mdog sngo skam mig 'grib mgo bo na//skabs su lus brtse brang rgyab rtsib logs gzer/ sgrog cing khong sbo 'ju dka' zos rjes na// tshigs gzhi na la rkang bol bsus sha sbos// mi 'phrod zas zos 'khru 'am skyug tshul ston mdor na pho ba grang la mchin pa tsha// rlung ldan sbo sgrog mgo 'khor mkhris par ldan// khong tsha 'khru dang khrag gis gzer 'khyug byed// bad gan lus snyi mgo na 'ju dka' 'khren// chu ser ldan pas g.yo skrangs tshigs gzhi na// sna tshogs nad rtags 'byung bas brtag par dka' ma rtogs log rtogs phyogs rtogs ma yin par phra zhib sgo nas ngo bo nyid rtogs kyis bcos thabs gzhi bzung bsdu bsad sbyang bas bcos dang po

566 grwa nga da ba'i/—se 'bru bzhi 'am da lis bzhi// ka ra sbyar ba nang nub chu tshan dbul// drod skyed be snabs sbyong zhing bu ga gso// gso ba'i sman zas smin par byed pa yin//bsdub 'o ma lan tsha sbyar ba dang // spos dkar phag khrag star bu ka ra sbya ra//srod dang tho rangs ltag sprad byer ba sdud// 'dus rtags khong snyom lus lci mchil snabs mang // kha zas mi len stobs chung de dus sbyang // nad stobs che na 'dus nas gnyen pos btang // gi waṃ utpal bsil gsum dug mo nyung //tsha la hong len spos dkar so ma ra// ya ru dom mkhris brag zhun bong nga ser//shu dag dkar po ka ra sbyar byas la// tsha ba'i dus su bskol grangs chu yis dbul// gzhi 'dzin gang rung tho rangs chu bskol dbul// yang na gnyen po bong nga da ra po ma ma khris sbya tshan gsumatshad gcog tsan dan tig ta bras zhun gsum kha 'dzin cugang gur sum ba ling gsum// ka ra sbyar ba gzhi 'dzin ltag pa sprad// de rjes gang dang nye ba'i gnas nas sbyang // nad stobs 'i ba'i rtags ldan kha zas glod// zhi dka' sdud byed bskyar la 'dus nas sbyang // ma 'byongs nad lhag gnyen pos bsad par bya// nyes pa gang che zas sman gnyen po sbyar// rtsa la 'grams che lto sbyongs rtsa dang sbrel// mi 'phrod dngas ma sa nas su ma smin dang //smug po byer dang 'grams 'khrugs rims rnyings rnams// sbyar dug cha mthun gso thabs 'khrul zhing bcos// sha yi dug la rgyu rkyen rigs dang rtags//bcos pa'i thabs dang rnam pa lnga yis bstan// de rgyu sha rlon bem dang yul phyogs kyi// sa la dug yod rlangs pa phog pa yin// de rkyen sa rlan steng du bzhag pa dang // btsos pa'i dron mo rlangs pa bsubs pa dang // dkar skyur dbre dang nyi zhur phog pa dang // 'bru dang tsam pa sngo gseb las pa dang // be log shan pa'i khrag gis phog pa'i rkyen// zhag bdun 'das nas dug tu 'gyur ba yin// de rigs sha dug sha nad gnyis su 'dod// rtags la spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// spyi rtags mig mi gsal la 'bras su ldal// pho ba sbo 'gyung

zhu nang g.yon tan gyi da/ 567glang thabs na ba dang // min pa lteb la skad 'dzer shes pa zi// mgo bo 'khor la rkang pa gtad mi tshugs// bye brag sha nad mgo dang tshigs gzhi na/gtso cher 'khru 'gyur srog la nyes pa chung / sha dug gre ba 'gags la skad mi thon// zas skom mi thar shed bral mig mi mthong / de ni mod du srog 'phrog gso ba sgrim// zug med skyug cing rtsa la nad ma babs// 'chi bdag khar tshud cis kyang lhogs mi 'gyur/ bcos pa'i thabs la dang po ma zhu'i dus bar du dug rgyas tha mar bla gnyan bsal// ma zhu'i dus su bsdus la sbyangs rjes bsad// ma bsdus zhu nas rtsa don la 'bros phyir// se skyer bar zhun lug ru yungs kur dang // gson khrag sbyar btang rtsa ru mi 'bros 'dzin// de rjes mgyogs po'i rta dur byid dus su bskos pa la dpa' bo tshos dang hong len skyon/ rnon po rgya tshabaskur ba sna khrid 'gron bu gla rtsibacas pas sbyang // de ltar ma yin mi thags gyen du ldog / 'og nas bsu 'ing ske la rdo grang bdug / sbyangs rjes nad lhag 'og gi phye mas bsad// bar du dug rgyas 'phrang bsal dug rlangs bsadakadang po gre ba 'gags pa'i 'phrang bsal ba nyung gzhi rtsa ba chur sbangs kha ru btig / yang na btsod khur cu gang tsha la dul// shing mngar zhib btags btab la gre bar btig / yang na mtshe skyong khru gang 'og gi sa chu bsings khu bar cu gang spang rgyan dkar// star bu shing mthor btab la gre bar btig /yang na cu gang spang rgyan bong nga dkar/ tsha la dul ma a ru chu sbyar btig /gre ba ma skams yang yang bsten par bya// ske la chu bdug ske rtsa skyor gong gtar gsod sman gi waṃ dom mkhris a ru ra// yung skyer bong nga ser po brag zhun dang // bye 'u la phug zhib btags chur sbangs pa// dug rlangs tsha ba 'joms pa'i mchog tu bshad// bee skyes khaṇḍa so ma ra dza dang // gi waṃ bong nga dkar po btab la btang // yang na ba lci sa la ma lhung ba// ba chus sbyangs khu re ral bong nga dkar// lcags phye bye 'u la phug cha mnyam gdab// nyis 'gyur chus

568 ༄7grwa nga rgyud ba sbangs dang po'i tshad du bsdu// gla rtsi kha tshar btab la btang bar bya / yang na sba bye'i sha dang phya tshan gsum// re ral gla rtsi 'om bu bong nga tsan// gi waṃ bzang drug brag zhun a ru ra// zhib btags chur sbang yang yang bsten par bya// yang na nyung ma a ru'i khaṇḍa la// rgya tsha gla rtsi bong nga kha tshar btab/ ril bu lo brgyud dri chur sbyangs la btang // btsod dang rta sbangs bsings pos bran pa'i khur// me sprin bzang po sbyar ba gnyen po yin// kun la tsha ba che na ga bur dang // tsan dan gi waṃ sbyar btang gang babs gtar// grang ba rgyas na rgya tsha da lis dang // stag sha bsnan te sbo 'khrog dugs kyis bsro// brgya stong sngags kyis ngar gdags sman nus skyed// 'thung ba ma shes khyem bus yang yang btig / cis kyang gre bar ma thar sbubs thur gyis// pho bston phugs te sgang phug blug ste btang // 'di dus bkru sman mi btang dug dang mtshungs// tha mar bla gnyan thor bu bsal ba ni// rgyun 'gags mug chos so ma ra dza btang /'dren bya chu 'gags gong rmig chu par nyi da 'a so bya'i sgro la bsings po gro tsam la sbyar ba'i sbyor ba bya// mig tsha 'grib na ga bur skyer ba byug / chu dugs gtar ga lcags khu 'jam bshal rshas// sha pags sbrid na spang rgyan dkar po dang // cu gang gur gum btang bas sel bar byed// pho ba sgangs na da lis rgya tsha stag shagasum pa btang // glo mang 'gog dka' ru rta spang rgyan dkar// star bu tsha la lo brgyad chur sbyangs btang // kha zas phye thug 'bras dang yo sa thug dang ⑪bskol grangs ba tsha med pa'i chu bsil bsten// dkar dang mngar bag sha dang rul skyur spang // grang shas che na gsar 'jam sgog chab btang // spyod lam /shā /pa nā kā ṭwāṃ rlan dang // skad chen smra dang mya ngan sems las spang //bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las gyur pa'i dug bcos pa'i le'u ste brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// / /

569le'u gya dgu pa/ rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i dug gso ba/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / rang bzhin dug la rgyu dang mi rgyu gnyis// sngon gyi dus su lha dang lha min gyis// bdud rtsi 'dod nas rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/skyes bu skra ser mig nas me 'bar ba// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can don te tshangs pa yis// hūṃ brjod pra yas rgyu mi rgyu la thim// mi rgyu bong nga btsan dug spyang dug dang // ra dug bse shing thang phrom rta sru sogs// rgyu ba khyi smyon sbrul dang sdig pa dang // srin bu ba yi dug la sogs pa yin/ de la dang po mi rgyu thong nga'i rigs/ rkyang par song rtags lce mchu ber la tsha// ser ga 'gas dang mdog nag kha dbugs grang ku 'gul na mun sro dran pa nyams shing 'gyel// rkang lag na jing rengs te gyen la ldog / pho ba sbo zhing khong pa gtub snyam byed// dang por gson khrag dron mo khyor gang btung // chu nang gcing ngam steng nas rgyun du blug / de yis rtsa ru mi 'bros pho bar 'dzin// de rjes bul tog yu nga ba a ru ra// chur sbyangs bsrun na phral du de srog ster// yang na a ru ra dang bong nga dkar// ha bo dri chus sbyangs btang 'i bar byed//yang na a ru bul tog bong nga dkar/ phya tshan zhib btags chur sbyangs btang bar bya// sbyor ba kun la sngags kyis ngar btags pas/ sman kyi nus skyed dug dbal gsod par nus// mi mkhas rmongs pas bong nga rkyang 'ded byed// sman gyis dug ded srog rtsar shor te gsod// man ngag 'di ldan las dbang min pa 'tsho// thang phrom dkar nag nad med lus stobs 'khyol//dbang po 'khrul nas mig sngar sna tshogs mthong / smra ba 'chal zhing gtad

570 sto/grwa nga da bzhi/med bud med 'dod// de la slo tres re ral ba sha ka / zhib btags zhun mar la sbyar btang bas 'joms// bse shing rta spu phyi nang gang reg skrangs// gre ba min pa pho ba gang skrangs kyang // rma yod snyam sem zug che hril hril na// ra sha ra khrag dri chus bse shing 'joms// 'bru mar tshil mar phag tshil rta spu 'joms// de nas rgyu ba'i dug gi gso thabs la// dang po khyi dug mtshan nyid rtags dang ni/ gso ba'i thabs dang rnam pa gsum yin te// mtshan nyid khyi de 'on long kha chu 'dzag / kha gdangs mgo bo smad cing mjug ma phab//'khyom zhing phyogs med kun tu rgyu ba yin// de yi sos zin rtags la gsar rnying gnyis// gsar dus rma nas khrag nag 'dzag pa dang // rma mdog srug nag mi sdug ra ri 'ong / skrangs shing rma yi nang du then bu chags// rnyings nas mgo bo na la grang shul byed// 'phyo 'dar snying ga na la skabs su 'thog /me long chu mthong dngangs la khyi spyod byed// dug langs rgyas pa'i rtags su bshad pa yin// bcos pa'i thabs kyang gsar rnying dus kyis sbyar// sos zin mod la kha dang rngabs ras drang // sor bzhi'i gong du ras 'jag bsdam par bya// zhag lon pa la rma de lcags kyis bsreg / de 'og zhun mang bskol ba rma nang du// rgya tsha skyer shun dud pa btsod kyis byug / yung skyer bong nga gla rtsi mar gyis byug / de steng rta sbangs zho sbyar rma 'jibs bya// de rjes ldang ngam mi ldang chu la brtag dang rma tshul pa khyi 'dra ba dang chu ba du byibabyung snyam pa byed pa dang dngangs na ldang ba yin no mi ldang ba la 'og gi gnyen po bsten// ldang bar gyur na mche ba brang krad dang // dud pa dri chu sbyar btang dug zhin bslang // langs nas lus sbrid khol bur na ba dang // khyi mthong tshig pa za la bshul sha na// de la gi waṃ dza ti pha bang long // bur dkar ba'i 'gyur chu grang 'phul la btang //yang na gi waṃ bzang drug thang phrom pa// ba spru gla rtsi ka ras kha slangs btang //rgya spos seng phrom shu dag hong len dang // ba ja sug sprel gur gum zhun mar

khanang g.yon tan gyi da 571sbyar// bza' byug mi skra yungs kur bur rnying gi/ du bas bdugs pas rma dang skrangs pa 'joms// zla drug tshun chad 'ag bcu'i sman re bsten// zhag bcu phar 'das zla lo lon pa 'am// dug lang rtags ldan drug bdun me yis bsdam// dur byin tong len dha du ra yis sbyang // gur gum dud pa ka sho kun ta dang // rgya sne ba chu'i ril bu dri chus dbul// yang na pha waṃ long bu rnam pa gsum// bzang drug gi waṃ tsan dan a ru ra// bu ram dkar po ba'i 'gyur sbyar la btang // nad mgo choms nas rgya spos na le sham// sug sprel ru rta shing mngar sprang rtsi dang // zhun mar sbyar ba'i lde gus nad rjes gcod// then pa skrangs na rus rnying 'ba' cha dang // nya lcibs sbyar ba'i lums kyis mnan pa dang // khol bu na sar hor gyi me btsa' bya// me long khyi skad chu rgal zhe sdang spang // de yis khyi dug gis zin 'tsho bar nges// sbrul dug mtshan nyid rtags dang bcos thabs gsum// mtshan nyid gdengs ka can dang lus 'khyil dang //khra bo go dha'i bu bzhis 'du ba 'khrugs// rtags la zin tshul rigs dang dug shugs gsum// dang po bldags dang sos zin bcad dang btsir// de rigs rtog pa'i dug dang skrag pa'i dug / mche ba'i dug dang rnam pa gsum yin te//sbrul dug khrag la brten te til mched 'dra gdengs ka can shugs khrag nag 'dzag pa dang // lus la srin bu 'gro sems men bu skye// mgo lci rma snabs tshil mang mig 'byed dka'// tshigs bye snyam sems lus tsha skyigs bu 'byung //'khru snyi snying ga rgyab dang rgal tshigs na// lus 'khyil khrag dang lus sems tsha ba skye// skrangs rnags rims 'debs lus kun khyad par tsha// khra bo khrag dang mdog skya grang rims 'debs// go dha'i bu yi shugs la kun rtags 'byung //zin dus dbugs thung skyug cing snying gzer spang // gso thabs rma yi gong du ras kyis bcing // lus 'khyil ma yin gsum po'i rma bsreg bya// rngabs ra ku bas rma nas khrag gzhib dang // khyi dug ltar du byug bdug rma chas bya/ khrag

572 sto/grwa nga da bzhi la gnas phyir rma dang gang nye gtar// gu gul bzhi dang rgya spos lnga pas ni//khyi sbrul srin bu ba yi dug rnams 'joms/ bye dug rgya spos thang shing ka rañdza/yung skyer 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum// ba gcin btags te btung dang rma sman bya// ba sbrul srin bu sdig pa'i dug kun sel// gla ba mkhar gsil gdugs thogs sbrul sogs 'byer/ sdig pa'i dug reg tsha zhing na la mched//de ni sbrul zin gso ba ji bzhin no// srin bu'i dug la nad rigs gso ba gnyis// dang po sbrul las gyur dang mchu sbom gnyis// sbrul gyi sha dang lci ba kha chu las// skyes pa'i dug can srin bu rkyang 'dus bzhi// zos rjes tsha g.ya' spangs shing shu ba 'byung // rlung srin zug che mkhris srin tsha la mched// bad srin grang 'byams 'dus pa sbrul shugs 'dra// gso thabs bdug byug khong sman sgrul ltar gso// rlung mkhris bad kun sbyar ba'i rma chas bya// de ba'i na ba dug dbye ba bcu drug kyang // nges med dug can ba ni gcig tu 'dod// sos zin tsha la skrangs shing shu ba rnag / mkhris gyur chu bur tsha la rims kyis 'debs// bad kun grang skya g.ya' la grang rims 'debs// rlung gyur tsub nag dus tshigs na bar byed// bcos thabs mkhris gyur gnad steng gtar khrag dbyung // gnyis po rma stong bsregs rjes dug sman byug / sbrul gyi gso ba 'dir sbyar ba dug 'joms/ bil ba rgya spos tsan dan utpa la// bca' sga nim pa ru rta pi pi ling / lcang ma chu srin sder mo po so cha// ga bra shing tsha sbyar byugs ba dug 'joms// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i dug gso ba'i le'u ste brgyad cu rtsa dgu pa'o// / /

573le'u dgu bcu pa/ gas pa gso ba bcud len/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so/ kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// rgas pa gso ba'i skabs la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa dang / drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / tshe zad gas pa'i nad las bsring ba yi// bcud len gyi ni cho ga bshad par bya/ 'di la phan yon gnas rten bya thabs bzhi/phan yon tshe ring na tshod dar la 'jog / lus mdangs stobs skye dbang po dran pa gsal// blo rno skad mdangs ldan zhing ro tsar byed// de gnas sa gtsang dpen zhing nyams dga' la/ chu shing 'dzom zhing bar chad med par sgrub// rten ni ha cang gas pa ma yin pas// me nyi chags spyod lus sems drag las dang // dul skyur rjen ngan tshwa sogs spangs byas la// tshes grangs bzang la lha mchod khrus byas 'jug / bya ba'i thabs la gtsor sgrub zhor spyad gnyis//gtso bor sgrub pa snum bcos dugs byas la/ ma ru skyu ru rgyam tsha pi pi ling //shu dag bca' sga yung ba byi tang ga / bu ram ba chur sbyar ba'i khrus kyis sbyang ⑪ma sbyangs bcud len ro tsa sbyor byed pa// dri btsas tshos ltar byas pa don med 'gyur// lha min khrag de bcud len mchog yin pas/ shun pa phral la zhag gcig chang nang sbang // khu btsags dngas ma nang bar ran tsam bston//rjes la 'o ma zhun mar skam sa yi/ sha khu nad dang gang 'phrod bskol la bsrud/yang na sgog skya zhun mar sbyar lde gu nas snod bdun gsum bzhag pa'i zhag grangs bston/ rlung shas can gyi tshe 'phel ring 'jog yin/ brag zhun

574 sa /grwa thang da ba'i/mdog nag sa med ba gcin bro// snum 'ing kha bska snyi ba lcags gyur mchog /gser dngul zangs lcags sbyar te 'o mas dbul// yang na nad dang gang 'phrod sman cha mnyam// lcags kyi snod du bcug la tshad ldan bza'// 'di la pon sne rgya sran rtag tu spang // sa steng brag zhun ma bcom nad yod min//khyad par tsha shas can gyi tshe 'phel mchog / tsi tra ka dang sbrang rtsi mar sbyar ba//zla ba gcig tu 'phrod pa'i zas dang bsten// tshe ring lus rgyas me drod 'bar bar 'gyur// bad gan grang nad can gyi tshe gnas so// de dang ba chur sbyar bsten mdze nad 'joms// a ru bar skyur 'bras bu'i sman mar gyis//dbang gsal stobs skye 'dus pa'i nad sel te/ na tshod dar la 'jog pa'i dam pa yin// rtsi ba'i dngas ma lnga yi bcud blangs pa// sa yi dngas ma brag zhun sha yi gsos// rdo yi dngas ma cong zhi rus pa'i gsos// shing gi dngas ma bu ram stobs kyi gsos// me tog dngas ma sprang rtsi mdangs kyi gsos// rtsa yi dngas ma mar dkar bcud kyi gsos// shug 'bru ba lu mtshe dang mkhan pa bzhi// rgun mi skams pa tshe yi gsos su 'gyur// 'di yi bcud longs srog gcod nad dgu grol// gas pa'i rtags nub bcu drug lta bu'i lus// seng ge'i rtsal la glang po lta bu'i stobs spyo rma bya'i mdangs ldan mgyogs pa spyang shes rta// tshe srog nyi zla gnyis dang mnyam par 'gyur// de yi sbyor thabs chen po chung ngu gnyis// dang po cong zhi bre gang zho gcig chur// bsdus pa'i khu ba bregang rtsigs ma bton/ bdud rtsi bzhi dang brag zhun bre phyed phyed/ gud gu dbasdus pa'i khu ba khyor ba re// 'o ma mar srang sum cu chu bcad la// bu ram sprang bre do sbyar thod bzang thug / bee ro tsa na oṃ/ badzra sa twa hūṃ/ ratna mi ta tre/ a mi ta lha khyu/ kurma badzra ā/ rigs lnga yab yum byang sems 'phro 'du bya// zla ba yar ngo'i tshes gcig nang par bza'// gro gong rgyun bsten rngul ma byung tsam bcag / chung ba cong 'i phul gang spang mer bsregs// chu nang

lta na ngag yon tan gyi rgyud/ 375bton te 'o ma bre gang dang // mar srang gsum btsos lug zho tsam gyur la//brag zhun bzhi nam bdud rtsi bzhi khyor re// sprang phul sum cha bur srang gsum dang sbyar// dar tsam btsos te snod bzang bcangs la bsten// cong zhi lcags rdo cha mnyam mngar gsum sbyar// thod par blug la rang nyid yi dam bsgom// zlo las snod de rin chen gzhal yas khang // nang du ā las bcom ldan tshe dpag med// oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a bra ta shu ā yun ra ṇi pu ku ru ye su hā/ spro bsdus phyogs bcu'i tshe bkug bum par bstem bsnyen pa khri bskyal 'chi med bdud rtsi'i tsher/ ril bu bdun lnga gsum la sbags btab bsten// nad gdon sdig sgrib dag ste tshe 'phel bsam// ra mo sha yi rtsa ba sos ston brkos// btubs la sa bshal khu ba thim par btso/ grib skams drus phye sum cha bsres pa yi// dang po tsha ba zan chang zan dron bya// 'dris goms phye zi ram shag chig chugs bza'// chu ser sel zhing mchog tu tshe dbang 'thob//me tog sna tshogs bsil drod cha mnyam la// mngar gsum sbyar te gro gong rgyun bsten na// khyad par mdangs ldan 'du snyoms rgas pa sel// mu zi gser 'dra sa med brtul byas la// a ru ra dang cha mnyam mngar gsum sbyar// sran ma se ba nam zhor bskyed la bza'// khrag tu 'khru na man ngag sman gcig ste dngapo dri ma mig can gcig 'ong de sgrub skams byas pa dang bsres la btang ba gces// drod skyed chu ser nad dang mdze nad sel// cong zhi sa dug bton te 'phrod sman sbyar//mngar ba'i rta bskyon thur mgo re re bsten// yang na drus phye pi pi ling sbyar la//tsha ba zan chang zan dron bsten par bya// gcong nad kun zhi stobs che tshe 'phel mchog / mar nag shing rtog sha mo bsrung ba gces/ dri chen bzang drug a ru mngar gsum sbyar// ril bur bsten byas yang na dug bton la/grib skams drus phye sbal la zan chang bsten// gdon sel tshe ring mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlob// so ma ra dza til nag mdze rgyas 'joms// byi tang ga dang go
