576 sto/grwa nga dba'i/phye bca' sga gsum sprang mar sbyar zos gas pa'i nad las grol// de dag zla gsum zla drug lo gcig bsten/ bcud kyis len gyi 'bras bu 'grub par 'gyur// g.yog 'khor mi ldan zhar la spyad pas kyang // gong gi 'bras bu ci rigs thob par 'gyur// 'di bar nad gzhan skyes na bar gcod de// nad gso de rjes sngar gyi bcud len bsgrub// ces gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rgas pa gso ba bcud len gyi le'u ste dgu bcu pa'o// //

577le'u go gcig pa/ rdo tsa bar bya ba/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// dmar khrid lag len man ngag rgyud 'di yi// ro tsa'i skabs la ci ltar bslab par bgyi/ ro tsa zhes pa'i don de gang la bya// ro tsa'i nad de don snod gang la gnas// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol/ zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas bka' stsal pa/ kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes/ ro tsa zhes pa 'dod pa spyod nus shing /rigs rgyud bu tsha spel bar byed pa ste// de la gtso dang yan lag rnam pa gnyis//de yang las dang nyon mongs pho mor snang // skyes pa pho ni ro tsa'i gtso bo ste//skyes pas 'dod pa spyod par ma nus na/ bud med brgya yis bskor yang don mi 'grub// skyes pa'i khu ba skyon med 'phel gyur na/ bud med bu tsha 'phel ba btsal du rung // de phyir ro tsa'i gtso bo skyes pa yin// de yi yan lag za ma bud med de// sa bon 'dzin zhing spel ba'i gzhir 'gyur gyi// pha yi rabs rgyud bu mos mi zin pas// gtso bor mi 'gyur kun la spyad btub kyang // las dbang bsod nams dman la bu mi 'byung // de la bu med btsal thabs yan lag gces// dper na sa bon med pa'i zhing sa dang / zhing sa ngan la sa bon btab dang mtshungs/ don snod spyi de bsam se'i nad du bshad/bcud kyi dngas ma sa bon dkar dmar rten// de phyir pho mo gnyis po'i thun mong nad// de la gtso bo skyes pa'i ro tsa la// sbyor ba dngos gzhi dgos ched rnam pa gsum// sbyor ba gang zag gnas grogs sngon 'gro 'o/ gang zag skyes bu rtag tu yul bsten pas// bu med yal ga med pa'i shing dang mchungs/

578 sa /grwa bang da bzhi/reg mthong sogs la bu 'dra gang yang med// de phyir de yis de 'dod de la 'bad// de yi gnas khang nye 'khor rdzing bu dang // padma nags tshal bsil grib snyan pa'i sgra// rlan bsil yid bder gyur pas ro tsa nus// grogs ni dar bab mdzes sgeg rgyan dang ldan// ngag snyan tshig 'jam yid 'ong spyod tshul shis// ston 'gro snum 'chos khrus kyis sbyangs byas la// ni ru ha dang 'jam rtsir bcas la btang // dngos ga'i skams pa gso dang blugs pa bcad//gso la zas dang spyod lam sman dpyad ba'i// zas ni ka ra bu ram sprang rtsi dang // sha khu 'o ma zhun mar 'o spris sogs// ro mngar mdog dkar yid du 'ong ba la// stobs 'phel nyams rtas byed pa gang yin bsten// spyod lam mig ltas 'o byed 'khyud pa dang // yid 'ong gtam dang 'dzum gyis 'grogs par bya// sman ni sha yi rgyal po da byid de// lus kyi stobs skyed khu ba 'phel mchog yin// de la sbyar thabs skyin gor cog grong dang // dgu sbyor bcu gsum pa dang lnga pa'o/ skyin gor rtsa ba lnga dang 'bras bu gsum// da byid sprug po bre ga lug thug 'bras// chu dang 'o ma mar bsdus khu ba la// rgya tsha sug spel bca' sga pi pi ling // bu ram sbyar ba nas gseb nus pa bskyed// cog krong rtsa ba lnga yi sman mar la// da byin skug po dza ti til dkar nag / thang phrom pa rnams kha tshar btab la btang // yang na da byin skug po til dkar nag /rtsangs pa'i sha rnams mchil pa'i khog par gzhug / kha brtsems mar du btsos la skams btags phye// gong gi mar khu btab la bu ram sbyar// dgu sbyor da byin sprug po dzā ti dang // mi dang byi la sum gyi mjug to dang // cong zhi mu zi brag zhun thang phrom pa// khral khrol brdungs te mchil pa'i khog par blug /dar skud kyis brtsem mar gyi nang du btso// mar de bu ram sbyar la sha skams btab// khye sus dus na khyem bu re re bsten// de rnams kun gyis lus stobs skyed byed cing // mkhal ma'i drod skyed sa bon zad pa gso// bcu gsum pa ni

wu/man nga g.yon tan gyi da/ 579da byin sprug ser gnyis// sum gyi sha dang brag gi rtsangs pa dang // khyim bya phug ron mchil pa nas zan mgo / gtsang nya bang phrom dbang po lag pa dang // nye shing pa dang cong zhi bu ram sbyar/ khu ba zad pa phral du skyed byed de/nub re la yang bud med brgya spyod nus// lnga pa'i sbyor ba cong zhi dmar po de ba yi 'o mas 'dam btags byas phye dang smo dbang po lag pa mchil pa'i mgo bo dang // thang phrom pa dang da byin sprug ser gnyis bu ram spyor ba khye sus chang gis dbul// gzhan yang ra thug 'bras bu 'o mar btsos/ ka ra til bsres zos na de dang 'dra// pi spa ling dang skyu ru ra khur sbyangs// ka ra sbrang mar sbyar zos 'o ma btung // brgyad cu lon pa'ang kun la spyod par nus/ zhi spris zos gting ka ra 'bras bcas zos// gan po yin yang gzhon nu lta bur spyod// dpyad du khrus la 'bad cing bsku mnye bya// khu ba blugs na 'phel dang nad dug gdon lus rgyas khu 'phel bud med rab tu gdung / de la chags pa spyad pas ji bar nus// nad kyi grang rlung mkhal ma'i drod nyams pas// rtsa kha ma thub chu dang sdongs nas 'dzag / bcu gsum bcu dgu nang long gdong ngos bsreg / bong sha sum sha da byin sman mar sbyar// tsha ba tshwa sna'i ril bu chang gis dbul// dug byung phyi nang gsang rtags ngos bzung la// de yi gnyen pos bsad cing lus zungs bsrung // gdon yin rmi lam bud med 'dren par 'gyur// mo phywa rim gro rten 'brel sngags kyis gso/ dgos pa nad med lang tshor ldan pa yis// dus tshigs rnams su nyal po dgag pa min//phral du sems dga' bu tsha'i rgyud skyed cing // stobs ldan bud med kun la thogs med 'gro// 'dod yon kun las chags pa mchog tu grags// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las ro tsa bar bya ba'i le'u ste dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa'o/ //

580le'u go gnyis pa/ bu med pa btsal ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / ro tsa'i yan lag bu med btsal ba'i thabs/de rgyu gdon dang 'du ba ro lus dang // bu rtsi btang dang mo gsham rnam pa lnga/dang po mo rtsis phywa las brtag par bya// zhi dang drag po sngags kyis gdon de bcos// 'du ba rlung mkhris bad kun rnam pa gsum// rlung gis zla mtshan ser la dus min 'jag / har por yong sem skabs su sdom zhing sbo// mkhris pas tsha 'brab dud khu rnag tu 'byung // bad kun bsil zhing zho kha chu 'dra 'dzag / rlung la nang nub cha sge gsher thang btang zhing / 'ba' cha 'bru yi dugs kyis rgyu zhabs bdug / de rjes phyi yi rtsa gsher reng bus bsal// de 'og rgyu bcud gze ma'i thang btang la mar bcud sbyor bas phyi rjes bcad par bya// mkhris pa bad kun me tog dugs kyis bdug / de nas khrus gsher chen mos khong sbyangs la// de rjes phyi yi rtsa gsher mngal skyon bsal/ de rting rgyu bcud sbyor bas phyi rjes bcad// mngal du bu lus bu ro nad ro lus// nad lus bu bcas rjes la khrag ro lus mngal kha 'chus pas mngal nang khrag skran chags/ gang yin gyur kyang bu chags bzhin du 'dril// skabs su rgyu zhabs mkhal ma tshigs pa na// mngal khrag dmar rtsa'am res 'ga' nag por 'dzag / de la nang nub sga skya'i thang btang la// bya bra grog zhing dag gis rgyu zhabs bdug / de nas a ru dwa tsha rtsabs shing gsum/ so sor bsdus nas bsres pa'i khu ba la// dur byin khron bu 'ol mo rgya tsha dang / shing tsha btab la khye sus dus na btang // ma thebs rgya tsha phru dreg 'ol mo dang / sha ru'i thal ba

mi na nga g.yon tan gyi rgyud/ 581rim skyed chang sbyar btang // yang na tsha ba gsum dang a ru ra// rgyam tsha dwa tsha lham rtsa so sor bsdu// khu ba bsres ba dur byin 'ol mo dang / rgya tsha shing tsha btab la tho rangs btang // zug gzer skyes na rdo dang 'bru dugs bya// ma thags srid na rgya tsha chang sbyar btang // bu ro mngal skran rnag 'bums khrag tshabs dang ku mngal kha 'chus te bu med bu skyed do// de rting phyi yi rtsa gsher chen mos sbyang // de 'og rgyu bcud gze chang phyi rjes bcad// lo gcig bar du drod bsten zas spyod gzab// bu rtsi btang bas chad dam rtag tu 'byang //nang dang phyi yi rtsa gsher rim pas sbyar// de rjes gze ma'i chang dang khrag bcud sbyar// mo gsham mngal khrag mang la mdog mi 'gyur// zla ba re zhing dus thog 'byung ba ste/ de la thabs kyis btsal bar nus ma yin// des na mtshan ldan grogs su btsal bar bya'o// zhes gsungs nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes de sman pa'i rgyal po'i sku'i lte bar thim par gyur to/bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las bu med pa btsal ba'i le'u ste dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// / / bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las lag len dmar khrid man ngag gi rgyud ces bya ba rdzogs so// / /de ltar grub pa'i rgyud chen 'di nyid la las go bla bar bzung / 'ga' zhig gis rtogs dka' bar mthong / phal cher gyis zhib tu ma dpyad/ kha cig ni gleg bam mthong ba tsam gyis skrag pa skye bar snang zhing / rgyu des sngon chad 'grel pa mdzad pa'ang cher ma byung 'dug pas/ yid ches su rung ba ni g.yu thog pa'i mchan bu ste/ de la'ang gser mchan thog mchan zhes smar zong gi dbang du byas par grags kyang / ding sang phal cher phan tshun 'dres shing mi 'dra ba kho na ma gtogs yid ches su rung ba dmigs kyis bsal rgyu cher mi snang bas/ sngar gyi yig snying rnams sor bzhag nas/ snying po bsdus pa rtsa

582 zhu/grwa nga da bzhi/'grel/ dzi na mi tra'i gzhung chen/ stong thun chen mo'i skor/ gces phreng /drang srong gi sgos bcos/ klu'i rgyud bzhi man ngag dang bcas pa/ mi'i khog pa stod smad/ dmar byang dang them byang / shel gyi me long / sko rags dkar po/ me lce phreng ba/ gso ba lam sgron/ bdud rtsi ldon shing sogs rtsa ba'i khungs gang brnyed rnams dang sgo bsnan nas 'bad pas dag par bsgrubs pa yin la/ de las mtha' dag ni ha cang mangs ches shing mi dgos ka med du'ang mi snang bas gzhung mi mdzes par dogs nas ma bkod/ sgrub byed a kur drug sbyor zhes sogs mchan bu ma gtogs gzhan mas dpyad dka' ba'i rigs rnams ma chad pa byas/ de'ang yig phreng gi srubs la bris na khul dog por 'gro zhing 'dren 'tsheg lta bus gzhung 'thor bar dogs pa dang / ka tho bsgrigs na rtogs dka' bar snang bas na mjug mtshams ji lta bar tshig sna cung zad gtungs te dkyus kho nar che chung dang mtshams kyang phyed par bkod pa 'dis kyang man ngag rgyud 'di nyid yongs su dar ba'i rgyur gyur cig /yar rgyab chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal ja de// blo gros rgyal po'i dbyu gus bskul ba'i tshe// gso rig bstan pa'i lo rtog rgyas byed pa'i// mi zad chos kyi char ba 'di bab pa// shu bha ma stu sarba dza ga ṭwāṃ//
༄7//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dum bu bzhi pa phyi ma'i rgyud ces bya ba bzhugs so//

584le'u dang po/ reg pa rtsa la nad ngos bzung ba/de nas ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'tsho mdzad sman gyi bla beeḍūrla 'od kyi rgyal po des ting nge 'dzin de las bzhings te thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i sman gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// snyom par zhugs ma thag tu sku'i gsang ba las 'od zer kha dog brgya stong du ma phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi sems zhum pa dang skrag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad bsal/ lus dang tshe la bar du gcod pa'i nad dang gdon thams cad zhi bar byas te slar sku'i gsang bar 'dus pa las/ sprul pa'i ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba zhig zin las las sprul te mdun gyi bar snang la bzhugs pa las/ gsung gi sprul pa drang srong yid las skyes zhes bya ba des ston pa la phyag dang bskor ba byas nas 'di skad ces zhus so// kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags// rgyud sde ba'i la bslab par bya 'o gsungs pa las// rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud man ngag rgyud dang gsum//dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i don du gsungs lags na// da ni phyi ma'i rgyud la ci ltar bslab par bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol//zhes zhus pa dang / phrin las kyi sprul pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes des 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes// rgyud bzhi'i tha ma phyi ma'i rgyud la bslab pa ni// nad dang gnyen po gso ba'i thabs gsum las//gso yul nad la ba'i brgya rtsa bzhir gsungs// rgyas par phye na stong dang nyi brgya yod// mdo ru bsdus pas bcos dgos brgya rtsa gcig / gso byed

sa khye ma 'a zin zu sa kyi na 585gnyen po stong dang bcu gnyis te/ mdo ru bsdus pas sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi// sman la zhi sbyang 'i la bsil drod gnyis/ sbyong byed kun la drag dang 'jam pa gnyis// dpyad la 'jam tsub zas la phan gnod gnyis/ spyod lam drag dal zas sman spyir 'gro 'o// de ltar gnyen po bcu yis nad kun 'joms// gso thabs lag len gsum brgya drug cu yod/ mdor bsdus brtag thabs gso tshul bcos thabs gsum/ brtag thabs reg mthong gnyis kyis nad ngos bzung // 'khrul gzhi gal 'gag bzhi yis dpyad phrang bsal// gso tshul dgu yis nad dang gnyen po sprad// gso thabs lag len bco brgyad nad dpung gzhom// sum cu rtsa gsum lag len snying por dril//'di dag phyi ma rgyud kyi sdom tshig yin/ drang srong rnams kyi sems la de ltar chongs// zhes gsungs so/ de nas drang srong yin las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags/ rig mthong gnyis kyis nad kyi ngos 'dzin pa// rig pa rtsa la ci ltar brtag par bgyi/mthong ba chu la ci ltar brtag par bgyi/ gal 'gag bzhi yi 'khrul so ji ltar bsal// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa las/ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes// dang po reg pa rtsa la brtag pa ni// nad dang sman pa brda sbyor 'phrin pa rtsa// sngon 'gro zas spyod bslab dang blta dus bstan// blta gnas mnan tshad blta tshul shes pa yis//tha mal rtsa la rtsa rgyud gsum du brtag / dus bzhi'i rtsa la khams lnga 'byung ba rtsi//ngo mtshar rtsa bdun nad med mi la blta// nad dang nad med 'phar ba'i grangs las dpags / spyi dang bye brag rtsa yis nad ngos bzung // 'chi rtsa gsum gyis 'tsho 'chi kha dmar gdags// gdon rtsa glo bur ye 'drog rim 'gro 'bogs// tshe rtags bla yi rtsa la brtag pa ste/ spyi don bcu gsum reg pa'i mdor bstan yin// dang po sngon 'gro zas spyod bslab pa ni// sha chang la

586 sa /grwa nga da bzhi/sogs drod bcud drag po dang // 'ju dka' bsil ches nad gzhi 'khrug pa spang // 'grangs ches ltogs ches nyal po gnyid chag dang 5 smra brjod sems las 'gro 'dug spangs te brtag / de yis 'du ba rnam gsum mi 'khrug gsal// glo bur du yang dbugs mal tshud pa dang // rtsa dpangs rkyen gyis ma bteg gces pa yin/ blta dus mkha' la nyi shar klungs ma phebs// nang dbugs dron mo phyir ma rgyus pa dang // phyi dbugs grang mo nang du ma shor ba//mal nas ma 'gul kha zas ma zos pa'i// gdags sribs dbugs snyoms rtsa mal gnas dus blta// blta gnas mkhrig ma'i gnyer ma dang po nas//mtshon gang mar bcal rus pa 'bur po'i ldebs// tshon kun chag gsum ma 'drus snyoms par ba 'ag / ci phyir 'phar rtsa kun la yod mod kyang // don dang nye na phu chu 'brub dang mtshungs/ ring ba thag ring 'gron po'i gtam dang 'dra 'tsham pas rgyang grags dbyar skad bzhin du gsal// thams cad rgyu bas tshong dus brgya srang bzhin/ don snod der mi rgyu bas 'gal zhe na//rlung khrag kun tu rgyu bas tshong dpon bzhin// bcu gnyis ma 'bres pha tse'i re so 'dra// bla rtsa mar zur chu rgyus gseb tu brtag / mtha' nas sdud phyir 'chi rtsa bol la brtag / mnan tshad tshon gyis pags pa kun gyis sha chag gis rus pa non tsam gsal bar mnan// ci phyir zhe na rtsa dbyibs la phug 'dra//sha rngabs zab mi zab las byung ba yin// blta tshul lag pa'i sor mo ma grangs pa'i// 'jam zhing mnyan la drod dang mthun pa yis// pho rtsa g.yon dang mo rtsa g.yas su brtag / dang po nad pa'i lag g.yon sman pa'i g.yas tshon gyi 'og tu snying dang rgyu ma'i rtsa/ kan gyi 'og tu mcher pa pho ba'i rtsa// chag gi 'og tu mkhal g.yon bsam se brtag / nad pa'i lag g.yas sman pa'i g.yon pas blta// tshon 'og glo long kun 'og mchin mkhris rtsa// chag 'og mkhal ma g.yas dang lhang pa brtag / mo la tshon rtsa gnyis po g.yas g.yon ldog / ci

sa khyem 'azin las gyi da/ 587phyir glo snying g.yas g.yon phyogs med kyang // snying gi rtse mo de ltar bstan pa'i phyir// gzhan rnams gnas kyis bskal phyir gong ltar nges// tha mar rten gyi rtsa rgyud rnam gsum ni// pho rtsa mo rtsa byang chub sems rtsa gsum/ pho yi rtsa ni sbom la rags par 'phar// mo yi rtsa ni phra la myur bar 'phar/ byang chub sems rtsa rgyud ring 'jam la mnyen// pho la mo rtsa chags na tshe ring la mo la pho rtsa chags na bu dpal che// gnyis kur byung chub sems dpa'i rtsa byung na/tshe ring nad dkon yas byams mas sdang ste// drung gsum dgrar ldang mtha' phugs rabs kyang chad// pho rtsa nang phrad phal cher bu mang ste// mo rtsa nang phrad bu mo phal cher mang // byang chub sems rtsa pho mo gang phrad pa// de yi dbang gis gcig 'byung de nas min// dus ba'i khams lnga'i 'byung ba rtsi ba ni//dang po dus don khams dang rtsa ru sbyar ma bu dgra grogs bzhi yis skor mgo rtsi// dpyid dang dbyar ston dgun bzhi dus mtshams lnga/ dpyid zla gsum ni shing rtsi kha 'bus dus// rta pa dbo dang nag pas nam tshod 'dzin// bye'u co ga rang skad 'byin pa'i dus// bdun cu rtsa gnyis zhing khams mchin rtsa rgyu//co ga'i skad ltar phra la grims par 'phar// lhag ma bco brgyad sa khams mtsher rtsa rgyu// dbyar zla gsum ni 'dab rgyas char gyi dus// sa ga smon dang chu stod nam tshod 'dzin// bya yi rgyal po khu byug skad 'byin dus/ bdun cu rtsa gnyis me khams snying rtsa rgyu// khu byug skad ltar sbom la ring bar 'phar/ lhag ma bco brgyad sa khams mtsher rtsa rgyu// ston zla gsum ni rtsi thog smin pa'i dus//gro zhun khrums stod dbyug pas nam tshod 'dzin// bye 'u 'ur pa gshog sgra 'byin pa'i dus// bdun cu rtsa gnyis lcags khams glo rtsa rgyu// byid po'i skad ltar thung la tsub par 'phar// lhag ma bco brgyad sa khams mcher rtsa rgyu/dgun zla gsum ni sa chu 'khyags sgang dus// smin drug mgo rgyal gsum gyis nam tshod 'dzin// sha ba nag po ngu skad 'don pa'i dus// bdun cu rtsa gnyis

588 zhu/grwa thang dba'i/chu khams mkhal rtsa rgyu/ thing ril skad ltar 'jam la dal bar 'phar// lhag ma bco brgyad sa khams mtsher rtsa rgyu/ nyi ma gar log dbyar dgun 'bring por rtsi// dus mtshams bco brgyad phrag bzhi bdun cu gnyis// sa khams mtsher rtsa dar zhing rgyu dus der// nas zan skad ltar thung la 'jam par 'phar// de ltar dus bzhi khams lngar phye nas ni// da ni ma bu dgra grogs skor mgo // thing me sa lcags chu lnga ma bu bskor// me chu sa shing lcags lnga dgra grogs bskor// ma bu dgra grogs 'byung ba brtags la rtsi// ma dang rang rtsa dar na rab tu bzang // grogs rtsa grog 'byung bu rtsa dbang thang che// dgra rtsa dgra 'ong yang na gso dka' 'chi// ngo mtshar rtsa bdun khyim phywa 'gron phywa dang ⑪dgra sgyu grog phywa gdon phywa bstan pa dang // me chu go bzlog bu rtsa brtag pa 'o//dang po bying jing 'thibs na mi gtsang rtsa// thugs shing 'thibs na mya ngan 'ong ba'i rtsa// 'brub cing brgyal na brid dngangs 'ong ba'i rtsa// skyer tsher 'dra na sdug bsngal thar med rtsa// chu tshan khol 'dra mi kha 'ong ba'i rtsa/ me lce chad 'dra nor god 'ong ba'i rtsa// de dag gang yang rang rtsa dar dus su// rang gi rtsa la gang byung rang la 'ong // ma rtsa ma zhang bu rtsa bu tsha la// grogs rtsa nor la dgra rtsa dgra la 'ong // 'gron phywa ga'i ba gang brtse gcig la brtag / mchin rtsa glo snying mtsher mkhal gang drag pa/ gzhi la yod dang lam du zhugs pa dang //nye bar sleb dang phyin la khad pa dang // 'gron dgra 'ong ba rim pas brtag par bya// yang na ma dang rang rtsa gzhi la gnas// bu rtsa lam zhugs dgra rtsa da lta sleb/ don gnyer 'grub bam mi 'grub brtag pa ni// snying mchin mkhal rtsa drag par 'phar ba gsum// dgra 'ong don 'grub stong log byed pa yin//dgra rtsa mi grub grogs rtsa byung na 'grub// dgra phywa phar rgol glo rtsa drag na thub//mtsher rtsa drag na mi thub dgra g.yul mtho/ dgra yi rtsa la dgra rtsa byung na thub//rang la dgra rtsa byung na thub mi 'gyur// tshur rgol de dang 'dra na dgra yis

sa khyem 'azin las kyi da/ 589tshugs// rang dang ma rtsa dar na tshugs mi 'gyur// grog phywa nor bdag rtsa la bltas pa yis// mchin rtsa drag na nor 'phel god mi 'ong // snying rtsa mtsher rtsa zhan na god ka 'ong // grog gi rtsa la grogs rtsa byung na rab/ ma rtsa 'bring yin rang tha ma yin// bu rtsa grog med dgra rtsa grog dgras khyer// gdon phywa shing rtsa gnyan dang rgyal por bzung / me rtsa btsan bdud lcags rtsa rgyal po dkor sa yi rtsa la sa bdag ma por bzung // chu rtsa klu dang klu srin dam srir bzung //ma yi rtsa la pha ma'i chags 'drer bzung // bu yi rtsa la bu tsha'i zhang 'drer bzung // dgra yi rtsa la dgra bo'i rbad 'drer bzung / grogs kyi rtsa la nor gyi phyi 'drer bzung // rang gi rtsa la grogs kyi god 'drer bzung // me chu go bzlog pha na bu la blta// mchin rtsa tshang na mi 'chi ma tshang 'chi// ma rtsa dar na mi 'chi gun na 'chi bu na pha yi rtsa la bltas pa yis/ snying rtsa tshang na mi 'chi ma tshang 'chi// bu rtsa dar na mi 'chi gud na 'chi// ma dang bu mo'i rtsa yang de ltar blta// khyo na chung ma'i rtsa la bltas pa yis// mchin rtsa ma tshang 'chi la tshang na 'tsho// chung ma na ba khyo la rtsa bltas pas// mkhal rtsa ma tshang 'chi la tshang na 'tsho// yang na khyo grogs chung ma dgra ru rtsi// dgra grogs rtsa dar mi 'chi gud na 'chi// sbrum ma'i rtsa ni 'bur la 'dril bar 'phar// mkhal rtsa g.yas pa drag na bu pho skye// g.yon pa drag na bu mo skye bar 'gyur/ bu yi rtsa la ma rtsa bu rtsa byung // btsas nas gso bla dgra rtsa byung na dka'/ nad dang nad med 'phar ba'i grangs bstan pa// nad med tha mal rgyun rtsa sman pa yi// phyi nang dbugs la lan lnga 'phar bar 'dod// de yang lan grangs brgya yi bar dag tu// che chung ston smad drag dal bying rgyas dang // sdod 'then thang lhod med par 'phar bar 'dod// de las bzlog pa nad can rtsa yin te/ mang 'phar tsha ba nyung 'phar grang ba yin// 'on kyang nad med rtsa rgyud mu tig 'phreng // gong rgal ma tshang sdod 'then la sogs pa/ nges med srid phyir gong

590 zhu grwa thang da bzhi/du gtan la dbab// gzhi rtsa ma rtogs kha mar log par 'gro// pho mo bu rtsa ma shes tsha bar 'khrul// byang chub sems rtsa grang bar 'khrul ba dang // ma tshang gcod sdod 'chi rtsar 'khrul pa yod// rgyus med rnams la thog mar dri ba gces// nad ngos bzung ba spyi dang bye brag gnyis// sbyi rtsa drug gis tsha grang la shan dbye// drag rgyas 'dril mgyogs drims mkhrang tsha ba'i rtsa// de yang spangs tsha grangs tsha skugs tsha gsum// spangs dang grangs kyi tsha ba 'khrugs rims gsar// skugs kyi tsha ba rnyings pa'i tsha ba yin// grang rtsa zhan bying gud bul lhod stong drug / snyugs grang gsar la grangs spangs rnying par 'dod//bye brag brtag pa rnam pa gnyis yin te// rtsa rgyud so sos nad rigs dbye ba dang // tshon kun chag gsum rgyu ba bcu gnyis kyis// stod smad don snod bye brag gar babs brtag / dang po rtsa rgyud so sor brtag pa ni// rlung gi rtsa ni rkyal stong skabs su sdod// mkhris pa'i rtsa ni phra la grims par 'phar/ bad kun skya bo'i rtsa ni bying la rgud// rlung tshad ldan pa'i rtsa ni stong la rgyug / bad mkhris ldan pa kha bying gting na grims// bad rlung ldan pa'i rtsa ni stong la dal//bad kun sprug po sbom khengs kun rtsa zhar// khrag gi rtsa ni 'bur la 'dril bar 'phar// chu ser rtsa ni 'dar la rgyu ba dka'// srin rtsa 'khyig cing zheng du leb mor 'phar// 'khrugs tshad rtsa ni sbom rgyas 'bur la 'dril// 'grams tshad rtsa ni phra mkhrang grims par 'phar// rims tshad rtsa ni phra la mgyogs par 'phar// sbyar dug tsub spun 'chol pa mngon mi btub// sha dug rtsa ni phra mgyogs zhan bying rgyu// ma smin tsha ba phra mgyogs rlung ltar g.yo// rgyas tshad rtsa ni drag la grims par 'phar// stongs tshad rtsa ni stong la rgyug pa ste// gab pa'i tshad pa rtsa spangs dma' la grims// tshad pa rnying pa phra la grims par 'phar//rnyogs tshad rtsa ni phra mo gting na rgyug / rma tshad rtsa ni sbom mkhrang mgyogs par 'phar// zug ju'i rtsa ni zhar zhing lcam dral byed// mgo chag sha nus glan pa

༄7khye ma 'a zin las kyi da/ 591rnam pa gsum// gang la skyon yod tshon kun chag gi rtsa rim bzhin drag cing grims la 'dar ba 'o// rnag rtsa 'dar ram yang na tsha la spun grang rtsa ma zhu gsar pa sbom la mkhrang // ma zhu rnying pa shed chung rtsa rgyud phra skran gyi rtsa ni 'an cing 'ar bar 'phar dmu 'or skya rbab phra bying gting na dam/ skyug na ston zhan 'khru nad rtsa smad zhan// 'on kyang rtsa la nor ba'i phrang drug ste/ khrag rtsa rlung rtsa rkyal byed nor ra re// rgyas tshad stongs tshad rgyug byed nor ra re bad kun khrag gon bying byed nor ra re/ de dag stod sman don snod gar babs nad// mtshon rtsa gnyis kyis glo snying stod nad brtag / kun rtsa gnyis kyis pho mchin bar nad brtag / chag rtsa gnyis kyis mkhal rked smad nad brtag / gdags sribs rtsa yis don lnga snod drug brtag / yar zur don lnga phyir rgyu gdags kyi rtsa// mar zur snod drug nang rgyu sribs kyi rtsa don snod phal cher cho rol mi 'byung zhing // don tsha snod la grang ba 'byung srid kyis//snod tsha don la grang ba 'byung mi srid// stod smad gnyis kyang de bzhin shes par bgyi/ de dag ma 'dres phra zhing phyed par rtogs// 'chi rtsa rgyud 'gyur ma tshang sdod pa 'o// rtsa rgyud 'gyur ba dar lce rlung bskyod 'dra// khra yi mjug rtse thigs zags chu gzhug 'dra// nya mo jam 'dra mchil pa sgum 'thu 'dra//stobs can blo bur nad la rtsa sdogs phra// yun rings zungs zad nad la rtsa rgyas 'brub// grang la tsha ba tsha la grang rtsa byung // glo tshad sha dug bad mkhris pho khar 'dril// 'di bzhi nad med rtsa byung 'chi ba yin// ma tshang 'brel 'byor phyi yi rtags la dpag / snying rtsa ma tshang lce nag 'bru tshugs blta// glo rtsa ma tshang sna zhom nang spu log / mchin rtsa ma tshang mig zlog smin ma 'tshom// mtsher rtsa ma tshang mchu 'phyangs nyen sna sdib/ mkhal rtsa ma tshang sgra chad rna ba 'byar//zhag gcig gnyis gsum lnga dang brgyad na 'chi// sdod la na sdod 'chi sdod 'dre sdod gsum// na dus gang na'i rtsa sdod na sdod yin// 'dre sdod nges med

592 zhu/grwa thang dba'i/drag dal byed pa ste// grangs dus nges par sdod pa 'chi sdod yin// 'dre la yas sbyin nad la sman gyis bcos// de byas skyed med cis kyang 'chi bar 'gyur// nad bying rkyen gyis gab dang gdon gyis sbas/ rtsa med gyur kyang nges med pha'i cher 'tsho// gdon rtsa rtsa rgyud mi snyoms 'gyur ldog mang // nges med sdod 'then lcam dral byed pa ste/ snying gi rtsa la lha bsrungs rgyal po brtag / glo ba'i rtsa la klu bdud klu btsan brtag / mchin par sa bdag dam sri dri mo brtag / mtsher par dri pho gnyan dang sa bdag brtag / mkhal ma g.yas la klu dang gnyan du brtag / mkhal ma g.yon pa mtsho sman klu bsen brtag / tshe ring mi sgrung g.yas la pho gdon bzung // chung thung mi sgrung g.yon la mo gdon bzung // rlung gi nad la dkor bdag rgyal po gnod// glo tsha gzer la btsan bdud klu btsan gnod/ rims dang mkhris nad ma mo byang sman gnod/ dmu skran 'bras lhog klu gnyan sa bdag gnod// ngos zin bon dang mdos dang bskrad pa dang // byin rlabs bka' bsgrag bsod nams bsag la sogs// yul lugs sbyar te gang la 'tsham pas bcos tshe'i rtags bla yi rtsa la brtag pa ni// sems la rang dbang ma thob phyir bltas pas//ma rig srid pa'i lus ngan blangs pa yis// tshe srog rten du bla rtsa 'khyam po byung // bla rtsa gnas na bla tshe mal na gnas/ bla rtsa 'gyur ldog byed na tshe mi brtan// bla rtsa bros na bla tshe yar te 'chi/ tshe chog 'chi bslus khugs pa srid pa tsam// yar mar chu rgyus 'og nas mi rgyu na// ban bon yin na bsrung ma bdud du babs// skye bo yin na zor kha klu gnyan 'gras// pho la g.yas pa 'khyig sdod pha spun 'chi// g.yon pa 'brub cing sdod na bu smad 'chi// gnyis ka 'khyig sdod rang nyid gri ru 'chi// thengs gcig sdod na god ka kha yogs 'ong // bud med g.yas pa 'khyig sdod khyo phyogs 'chi// g.yon pa 'khyig cing sdod na pha ming 'chi// gnyis ka 'brub cing sdod na bu khyo 'chi// stong brgyal

zhu ma 'a zin las kyi rgyud/ 593god 'ong thang 'khyig kha smras 'ong // mal mi thub na gdon gyi rtsa yin te sbom 'brub pho gdon thung tsub mo gdon bzung // bla rtsa snyoms par lan brgya 'phar ba ni// lo brgya thub ste lnga bcus lnga bcu thub// de bzhin 'phar res lo re thub par bshad// de ltar rtog pa'i sman pa nyan pa 'dra// shes pa ma yengs gcig tu bsdus la spro// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las reg pa rtsa la nad ngos bzung ba'i le'u ste dang po'o/ / /

594le'u gnyis pa/ mthong ba me long chu la ngos bzung ba/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes// mthong ba me long chu la ngos bzung ba//sngon 'gro blta dus snod dang gyur tshul dang / tha mal nad chu 'chi chu gdon chu ste// sa bcad rnam brgyad chu brtag mdor bstan yin// dang po sngon 'gro blta ba'i nub mo nas// ja dang dar ba chang dang sings po sogs// chu mdog 'gyur phyir ha cang mang ba spang // skom par mi sdad nyal po spyod pa dang //'gro 'dug sems las chu 'khrugs spang bar bya// nam phyed phan chad zas kyi chu pho la// nam smad nad chu bsags te blta bar bya// blta dus mdog rlangs ku ya brtag pa'i phyir// zhogs pa snod la nyi mdangs byung dus brtag / snod kyi khyad par chu mdog mi 'gyur ba'i// kur yol 'khar gzhong lcags dkar snod du brtag / rdza zangs ra gan dmar yol mdog 'gyur spang // 'on kyang 'jag sog dkar pos brtag tu rung // gyur tshul zas skom pho bar dngas snyigs snye// snyigs ma rgyu ma'i nang tshud ska sla bye// sla ba rgyu grog rtsa nas lhang par 'dril// dngas ma mchin pa'i gnas brgyud khrag tu 'gyur// khrag gi snyigs ma mkhris pa'i gnas su gsog / mkhris pa'i dngas ma lus kyi chu ser 'gyur// mkhris pa'i snyigs ma chu yi ku yar 'gyur// rtsa mig 'grims nas lhang pa'i nang du gsog / de phyir chu yi kha dog zas kyis sgyur// ku ya khrag mkhris gnas nas 'byung ba'i phyir// lus la tsha grang gang yod chu la gsal//dper na tshong pas tshong dus gtam brjod bzhin// tha mal nad med gnas pa'i chu bstan pa// kha dog 'bri mar bzhus 'dra ze dri mnam// rlangs pa che chung yun ran me tog snyoms// ku ya stoms khyab spris ma ko chu tsam// rlangs

kho khyem 'azin las kyi da/ 595yal dus na mtha' nas sgor mor ldo ga / log rjes dkar ser dngas pa nad med yin// de bzlog nad chu spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi la brtag pa'i dus gsum brtag tshul dgu// dus gsum tshan de ngad yal grang ba gsum// tshan de'i dus su mdog rlangs dri me tog / ngad yal dus su ku ya this la brtag /grangs nas ldo ga dus ldog tshul log rjes brtag / dang po tsha ba dus kyi kha dog ni// lu ma'i chu ltar sngo la sla ba rlung // ser na mkhris pa dkar na bad kun nad// dmar na khrag nad rgya shal chu ser yin// smug la dugs na bad kun sprug por brtag / chu mdog 'dres na ldan dang 'dus pa'i nad// mar nag 'dra na rims dang mkhris pa rgyas// dmar ser ska dugs 'grams sam 'khrugs chu yin// chu mdog nag gam 'ja' tshon 'dra ba dug / rlangs pa che na tsha ba rgyas pa'i chu// chung la yun ring tsha ba gab bam rnyings// rlangs chung yun thung bad rlung grang chu yin// res che res chung tsha grang 'dres par brtag / dri ma dugs la dku na tsha ba che// dri ma med dam chung na grang ba yin//zas kyi dri mnam gang mnam de ma zhu// sbru ba sngo la che ba rlung yin te// phra ser sangs pa rkyen na mkhris pa yin// spu ba mchil ma 'dra na bad kun nad//dmar na khrag nad 'ja' tshon 'dra na dug / phug ron khra yis gtor 'dra byer ba'i nad// ku ya spu dang 'dra na rlung gi nad// bal 'dab chur skyur 'dra ba khrag mkhris yin// spu rtse 'dra ba bad ken grang ba'i nad// sprin 'dra glo nad rnag 'dra de nyid yod// bye ma 'dra na mkhal nad yod pa yin// steng 'og bar gnas nad kyang de ba'i na brtag / ku ya zho thi 'dra bas chu steng khyab// rlung gis lus zungs tsha grang dkrugs pa yin// mthug dang srab las tsha grang shes par bya// kha dog chu mdog gang byung de ltar ro// bas ma srab na grang ba mthug na tsha// blangs bzhag btub na zhag rgod ces bya ste// mer bsregs bsur dri byung na bcos mi dgos/ spyis ma dum bur chad na skran nad yin//

596 sto/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/spris ma'i gzugs las gdon ngos bzung bar bya// ldog dus rlangs ma yal bar ldog pa tsha// yal rjes grangs nas ldog pa grang ba yin// rlangs yal ldog pa dus mtshungs tsha grang snyoms// ldog tshul chu la srab mthug med pa la// gang srab mtha' nas ldog pa grang ba yin// gting nas longs por ldo ga pa tsha ba gsar// mtha' nas shar shar ldog pa rnyings tshad yin// sna la ku ya ldog na tsha grang 'thabaka tsha ba byer dang grang ba 'byams pa dang // gdon shas che ba'i chu gsum ldog mi 'gyur// log rjes kha dog nad gzhi'i chu mdog blta// ska na tsha ba sla na grang ba yin// bye brag mdor bsdus tsha chu grang chu gnyis / tsha ba'i chu ni kha dog dmar ram ser// ska la dri dugs rlangs pa che yun ring // sbu ba phra ser sangs rkyen spris ma mthug / ku ya chu yi dkyil du ling gis 'dril// drod rlangs ma yal ba la tsha log byed// log rjes smug la gar ba tsha chu yin// grang chu kha dog dkar ram sngo la sla// rlangs dang dri ma chung la sbu ba che// spris dang ku ya srab cing grangs rjes ldog / log rjes sngo la sla ba grang chu yin// kha dog dkar sngo ku ya mthug pa'i chu// ltar snang grang yang gting na tshad pa yod//dmar ser dri chu ku ya med pa ni// ltar snang tsha yang ngo bo grang ba yin// tsha chu ldog bul grang chu ldog pa skyen// tsha ba gab pa'i nad du shes par bya// tsha chu me tog med na khong shor bying // grang chu me rtog med na grang ba 'byams// tsha chu this ma mthug na lus zungs zhu// de bzhin grang chu mar ma zhu bar nges// lar na stongs tshad khrag tshad dmar por 'khrul// bad kun smug po chu ser skug por 'khrul// mkhal ma mchin pa mtsher gsum dmar por 'khrul// gab tshad bad rlung grang ba sngon por 'khrul// de dag ma 'khrul nad ngos so sor bzung //'chi ba'i chu ni khrag 'dra ko dul mnam/ bcos kyang skyed med tsha ba'i 'chi chu yin// de bzhin ku ya sangs nas mi ldog 'chi// sngo zhing dri rlangs bro ba med pa la// bcos kyang mi 'gyur grang ba'i 'chi chu yin// tshogs pa chad 'dra rlung

༄khyem 'azin las gyi da/ 597gi nad kyis 'chi// chu rtsa chad 'dra mkhris pa'i nad kyis 'chi// mtshal chad 'dra na khrag gi nad kyis 'chi// 'o ma mi 'dra bad kun nad kyis 'chi// snag tsha chad pa 'dra na dug gis 'chi// mkhal nad med par khong nas chu log na 'du ba khong rul zhes bya 'chi ba yin// gdon chu gang btang ngos de shar du rtsi/chu de srid pa'i rus sbal gan rkyal gnas// mgo bo lhor bstan thig bzhis sa dgur bcad// g.yas gsum lha sa mi sa gdon gyi sa// g.yon gsum dur sa khang sa zhing gi sa// dbus gsum pha mes rang dang bu tsha'i sa// ling tshe dgu po'i sa de gzugs brnyan brtag / ldog skyed ldog sna ring dang mi ldog dang //nya mig srubs 'dra sbru ba gang byung ba// lha sar byung na bsten pa'i lha bsrungs bcos// mi sar byung na dri pho dri mo gnod// gdon sar byung na srid pa'i spyi 'dre gnod// pha mes sar byung chag 'dre rbad 'dre gnod// rang sar byung na grogs kyi god 'dre gnod/ bu tsha'i sar byung zhang nye ma sru'i 'dre// khang dur zhing sar byung na de nas gnod// gzhan yang shar du byung na rgyal po gnyan//lho ru byung na btsan dang ma mo gnod// nub tu byung na klu bdud klu btsan te//byang du byung na mtsho sman klu srin gnod// shar lhor byung na rgyal po btsan dri mo//lho nub mtshams su btsan bdud nag thug gnod// nub byang mtshams su klu bdud klu srin gnod// byang shar sa bdag rig 'dzin bcos par bya// 'on kyang log rjes nyi ma'i mdangs shar tshe// 'dra ba'i gzugs la gdon gyi ngos bzung ba// rma bya'i mdongs 'dra nag rmug gnod/ ba dan 'phyar 'dra 'gong po gnod// lcags sgrog 'dra na lha mo gnod// mdung rtse 'dra na pho lha gnod// ra skyes 'dra na dgra lha gnod// shug pa 'dra na yul lha gnod//padma 'dra na ma lha gnod// 'od skor 'dra na rgyal po gnod// tsig khung nyi shar 'dra na btsan// dar lce 'dra na klu btsan gnod// sdig pa 'dra na klu bdud gnod// sha ru 'dra na yam shud gnod/ gal te 'dra na the brang gnod// me

598 ༄ grwa nga rgyud ba /long 'dra na mtsho sman gnod// tam bu ra 'dra bdud mo gnod// nya dang dung 'dra sa bdag gnod// chu srin sbrul 'dra klu gdon gnod// na bun sprin 'dra mi gtsang langs// mda' 'phang 'dra na dri pho mo// mig mangs 'dra na zhing 'dre gnod// phur pa yungs kur phur kha gnod// thod pa 'dra na klu gtan gnod// ma he 'dra na dam sri gnod// de rnams gnod pa sa dgu'i phyogs las dpag / lha sar 'dre ngo byung na 'dre lhar rdzu// 'dre sar lha ngo lha 'khros 'dre ru gnod// ldog tu mi 'dod dkor phywa btab ste blta// des ma gsal na gdon ngo yib ces bya// spyir na don nad rtsa gsal snod nad chu// 'tsho 'chi'i la shan rtsa yis 'byed na yang // tsha grang la shan chu la mthong bas gsal// de phyir mkhas pas chu la brtag par bya'o/ gal 'gag bzhi yis 'khrul so bsal ba ni// man ngag rgyud kyi tsha grang gal mdor ltos// zhes gsungs so// de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// nad dang gnyen po spyod phyir gso tshul dgu /'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa// kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes// nad dang gnyen por sprod phyir gso tshul gces// gces pa'i don la zhus pa legs na yang //bshad pa'i rgyud du legs par bstan nas yo da// drang srong chen po lta rtog 'thems par gyis// de ma yin na mun khung rdzas gtor 'dra// dpe la lus pas dgos dus sleb mi 'gyur// rgyud bzhi'i lta rtog 'thems nas don longs na// mun khung mdzod du nyi shar ji bzhin gsal// gser g.yu'i sgrom bur lag pa bcug pa ba'i na// rang la nam dgos dus na spyad pas chog / ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las mthong ba me long chu la ngos bzung ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// / /

599le'u gsum pa/ thang gi sde tshan bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// lag len bco brgyad nad kyi pung 'joms pa'i// rkang grangs lag tu blang thabs ci ltar bgyi// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pas/ ston pas gsungs pa/kye drang srong chen po yin las skyes/ gso thabs lag len rkang grangs 'di lta ste// lag tu blang ba'i gnyen po sman dpyad gnyis// sman la zhi sbyang gnyis te zhi byed la// thang phye ril bu lde gu sman mar lnga/ sde tshan lnga zhes spyi ru grags pa yin// 'on kyang thal sman khaṇḍa sman chang gsum// sde mtshan brgyad kyis zhi byed sbyor ba bstan// zhi byed log gnon rin po che dang dgu/ blo bur thug phrad sngo sbyor sde dang bcu/ de yang sde tshan lnga ru ma 'dus med// sbyong byed las lnga'i sngon 'gro snum 'chos dang 1 bshal skyug sna sman 'jam rtsi ni ru ha/sbyongs kyi log gnon rtsa nas sbyang dang bdun// dpyad la gtar bsreg dugs lums byug pa lnga// de yi log gnon thur ma'i dpyad dang drug / spyi ru sdoms pas rgyas bshad nyi shu gsum// mdo ru bsdus pa'i lag len bco brgyad 'di//nad kyi dgra dpung 'dzoms pa'i mtshon cha yin// de rnams lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni// dang po zhi byed sman gyi sde tshan bstan/ kye drang srong chen po ma yengs gus pas nyon// thang sbyor sde tshan tsha sel grang sel gnyis// de la tsha ba sel ba'i sde tshan ni// mi thod rnying pa 'brug rus tig ta gsum/ sum gnyis bsdus grangs mgo nad sel bar byed// lcags phye skyer ba'i bar shun 'bras bu gsum// khu ba grangs btang mig nad sel bar byed du rta a ru ra yi khu ba

600 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'i/yis// rna ba'i rnag khrag zug gzer 'joms par byed// skyer pa mkhan skya bsdus pa'i khu ba la// dom mkhris btab btang sna khrag 'dzag pa gcod//nag mtshur seng phrom a ru'i grang thang gis// mkhur bkang kha yi khrag nad zug gzer 'joms// bong nga shing mngar spang rgyan dkar bsdus khur// cu gang kur sbyar skad 'gags tsha skams sel// so phag bsdus khur 'u su ka ra btab// mkhur bkang kha lce gre ba skams pa sel// tsan dan dzā ti snying zho sha yi thang // bsdus grangs snying gi tsha ba 'joms par byed// sro lo shing mngar rgya skyegs ga dur thang // glo yi khrag tshad gzer dang lud pa sel// brag zhun ba le ba sha ka bsdus khur// gur gum dom mkhris btab btang mchin tshad sel//li shi gser gyi me tog a ru ra// thang gis mtsher tshad sbo 'khrog sel bar byed//a ru ra dang rgya skyegs zhu mkhan btsod// mkhal tshad gzer khrid rgyu long smad tshan sel/ lo brgyad dri chu rgya snag pho tshad sel// snya lo btsod dang bong nga dkar po'i thang // dug nyung bong nga ga dur ba le ku'i// thang gis rgyu long snod tshad ma lus sel// de la ka ped 'bras btab tshad 'khru gcod// gze ma lcam pa sdig srin chu 'gags sel// ba spru ra mnye gze mas mngal tshad sel//'bras gsum thang gis rims 'khrugs tsha ba'i nad// gsar rnying ma lus sel zhing smin par byed// ma nu kuṇḍa ka ri sle tres dang // sga skya'i thang gis rims tshad smin par byed// bad gan skya sprug stongs tshad khrag gzer sel/ tig ta sle tres gser gyi me tog dang // byi tsher thang gis rims tshad lci thibs sel//tig ta hong len skyu ru ba sha ka/ khrag 'khrugs tsha ba rol gsod dngas snyigs 'byed// a ru sdum bu bong nga'i bsdus khu la// tsha la btab btang sbyar dug sha dug sel// ma nu ru rta pu shel ba sha ka / bsdus grangs sprug po rgyas pa'i phral zug gcog / seng sdeng a ru ra dang kyi lce ba// skyer pa'i thang gis chu ser tsha ba skem// tig ta kyi lce bong ngas mkhris tshad 'dzoms// 'bras bkrus khu bar

sa ma 'azin la sa kyi da/ 601pu shel sbrang rtsi btab// rtse gur btang bas skyugs pa gcod par byed bil ba mon cha ra dang da trig dang // skyer pa'i me tog dar bar btab byas te//rtsegar btang na 'khru ba gcod par byed// so ma ra dza bong nga dkar po yi/bsdus thang dug gis skyug pa gcod par byed// gur gum dom mkhris tshos thang khrag skyug gcod// spru rtsa skyer pa mkhan skya ram pa tshos// bsdus khur gur gum dom mkhris mi mkhris dang // spru ma'i 'bru dang sran ma'i me tog btab// khrag shor ma lus khong du sped pa'i mchog / dbang po lag pa sle tres tig ta yi//thang gis yan lag kor le'i tsha ba sel// sle tres brag zhun a rus dreg nad sel// shing mngar tsan dan gla rtsi ga dur bzhi'i// thang gis rtsa yi tshan pa sel bar byed / ba spru skyer pa sle tres a ru ra// bsdus khur gu gul dkar po zho gnyis btab// sha mdangs chu ser pags pa'i nad kun sel// tig ta byi tsher dzā ti skyu ru ra'i// thang gis mig ser pho ba'i zug gzer 'joms/ se 'bru go stod sbrang btab dang ga 'byed// a ru'i chig thang pho ba'i mkhris pa sel// skyu ru'i chig thang khrag ngan 'byed cing skom ba nu'i chig thang chu ser nag po skem// ba sha ka yi chig thang khrag nad sel/ 'u su'i chig thang smug po skom dad sel// lcags khus mchin tshad mig nad shu ba sel// gla sgang ga dur sro lo dkar po yi// chig thang glo yi tshad pa ma lus sel// seng lding chig thang chu ser skem par byed// sle tres chig thang rims nad ma smin 'byed// btsod dang spang rgyan chig thang 'brum nag sel// brag zhun chig thang dreg nad chu 'gags sel// chu rug thang gis rgyus pa'i tshad pa sel// stab seng chig thang rus pa gas pa sbyor// tig ta'i thang gis bad kun tshad pa sel// /grang sel bca' sna rgyam tsha a ru ra// tshan mos drod chung grang ba ma lus sel// pi pi ling bsnan sman ma zhu ba 'ju// sga dang shing kun bsdus pa'i khu ba la// kha ru tsha btab snying rlung sel bar byed// sgron shing gla sgang shing kun a ru ra// rlung

602 lta/grwa thang dba'iḥrims grang rlung kha gdong g.yo ba sel// se 'bru pi pi ling dang sga bdus khur//'bras yos sprang rtsi kha tshar btab pa yis// 'khru dang skyug pa sbo sgreg skyigs bu sel// da lis sug smel sga thang lce mchu dkar// snying 'dar mchin rgud ma zhu ngal ba sel// kha ru tsha dang zi ra spa pi ling // shing tsha la la phud dang pho ba ris// thang gis kha zas mi 'ju skyugs pa sel| shing tsha kha ru tsha dang tsha ba gsum// 'o mar btab btang grang sel 'khru ba gcod// sug smel zi ra dkar po pi pi ling ka 'o mar bsdus thang gnyid med yer ba 'gugs// sgog skya srang bzhi chu bo brgyad 'gyur bsdus// chu du 'o mas rlung skran rlung rims dang // gzugs 'khums la sogs rlung nad ma lus sel// a ru bsdus khur dong gra btab byas nas// nang re btang na skran mkhris mig ser sel// thal tsha ya bakṣa thang sbos pa sel// kha ru tsha yi chig thang pho log 'joms// rgyam tsha'i chig thang ma zhu gsar pa 'ju// rgya tsha'i chig thang dri chu 'gags pa sel//rdo thal chig thang pho ba'i bad kan bshig / sga yi chig thang drod skyed ma zhu 'ju//srad dkar chig thang mcher nad dmu rdzings sel// ba spru'i chig thang smad kyi grang ba sel// sog tshigs chig thang chang ma zhu ba 'ju// sogs ya'i thang gis sha ma zhu ba 'ju// nas bsdus thang gis dang ga 'gags pa 'byed/ sre long thang gis thor bu'i rlung sna gnon// de sogs khu ba'i sde tshan sbyar ba'i thabs//grang thang khu ba thon par sbang ba gces// bsdus thang kun la khu ba sum gnyis bsdu// tsha sel grang btang grang sel tsha mor btang // tsha grang 'dres pa'i nad la dro 'jam bsten// zas dang spyod lam nad dang mthun pa gces// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las thang gi sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// / /

603le'u bzhi pa/ phye ma'i sde tshan bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / phye ma'i sbyor sde tsha sel grang sel gnyis// tsha sel ga bur rgyal po'i sbyor ba dang // gur gum bdun pa blon po'i sbyor ba dang // gtso bo brgyad pa rje 'u'i sbyor ba dang // sna tshogs dmangs kyi sde tshan rnam pa ba'i// tsha ba stobs rgyas rgyal po ga bur sbyar// de rigs mang dang stag zil shel dang gsum// mang ni ser la sna ring mnyen la yang // yang na dkar 'jam kha ba bsgongs pa 'dra// 'jam la bsil bas rlung ldan tshad pa sel//stag zil mdangs ser sul mang pho cong 'dra// mang bas tsub bsil tsha ba kun la rgyug / shel ni dkar la kron te 'khyag pa 'dra// zhin tu bsil bas rgyas tshad rkyang pa 'joms// ga bur de la sbyar ba'i thabs drug ste// mi rgod lta bur chig pur rkyang rgyugs dang // dpa' bo lta bur mtshon cha bskur ba dang //btsun mo lta bur 'jam sdebs btsal ba dang // skyel ma lta bur dgra zun sbrag pa dang // dmag dpon lta bur 'khor gyis bskor ba dang // rgyal bu lta bur tshogs su 'don pa 'o// ༈dang po ga bur cu gang chur sbyangs pas// rgyas tshad stobs chen thog babs gsod pa'i mchog / gnyis pa de la mtshon cha bskur ba ni// 'khrugs la tsan dan rims la bong nga dkar/ kha bsgyur ka ra sbyar la gangs chus dbul// ga bur rgyal blon gsum pa zhes bya ste// 'khrugs rims tsha ba rgyas pa rol du gsod// gsum pa ga bur rgyal blon gsum pa la// gur gum si waṃ bsnan pas lnga pa dang // gla rtsi dom mkhris bsnan pa'i bdun pa ni//'jam pas rlung mi 'khrug cing tsha ba 'joms// bzhi pa ga bur chang dang sbyar

604 sa༅/grwa nga da bzhi/ba ni// ri thang mtshams su rlung tshad dus gcig 'joms// lnga pa bdun dgu bcu bzhi sbyar ba ni// bdun pa ga bur tsan dan dkar po dang // gi waṃ cu gang gur gum stong len dang // tig ta ka ra dkar po bzhi 'gyur sbyar// stod gzer 'khrugs tshad rgyas pa sel bar byed// dgu pa ga bur tsan dan cu gang dang // gur gum dom mkhris tig ta li ga dur// hong len rgya skyegs ka ras 'grams 'khrugs nad// stod gzer lud pa dmar ser dud khu 'joms//bcu bzhi pa ni ga bur bzang po drug / tsan dan bse ru utpal a ka ru// gla rtsi ga dur tig ta ka ra sbyar// rims rgyas lus lci dran nyams 'bog lkugs sel// drug pa ga bur nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar/ ga bur bzang po drug dang a ka ru//tsan dan dkar dmar utpal ge sar gnyis// ru rta zi ra dkar po ba le ka /shing tsha chu srin sder mo pu shel tse// spang spos rdo dreg dmar po 'bu su hang //tsha grang 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum// kha bsgyur ka ra dkar po drug 'gyur sbyar// don snod sha pags rtsa rus tshad pa dang // 'grams 'khrugs rims dug tshad pa gsar rnying dang // dreg grum me dbal byang khog thigs zags rnag / lus la gnas pa'i tshad pa ma lus 'joms// khyad par tshad rnying byer ba gting nas 'don// blon po gur gum bdun pa'i sbyor ba ni//gur gum cu gang gi waṃ gtso bo la// dzā ti a ka ru dang snying zho sha / ru rta sdebs pas snying gi tshad pa sel// shing mngar ru rta rgyan 'brum a krong ba'i//sdebs pas blo ba'i tshad pa sel bar byed// utpal ba sha ka dang pri yang ku//brag zhun sdebs pas mchin pa'i tshad pa sel// gser gyi me tog li shi a ru ra//pi pi ling sdebs mcher pa'i tshad pa sel// sug sprel brag zhun shug pa tsher ma can// a ru ra sdebs mkhal pa'i tshad pa sel/ dom mkhris brag zhun bong nga dkar po dang // spru yang ku sdebs pho ba'i tshad pa sel// ind+ra bzhi sdebs rgyu long snod tshad sel// shing mngar li ga dur dang re skon pa// dom mkhris

sa khyi pa 'a zin las gyi rgyud/ 605sdebs pas rtsa yi tshad pa sel// spyi zhur 'dam bu sbal rgyab gangs thigs bzhi sdebs pas rus pa'i tshad pa sel bar byed// sle tres dzā ti sgog skya'i thal ba dang / gu gul sdebs pas rlung gi tshad pa sel// tig ta gser gyi me tog dug mo zhung // bong nga dkar pos mkhris pa'i tshan pa sel// bse yab se 'bru ma nu 'u su dang // ltar bu sdebs pas bad kun tsha ba sel// hong len ba sha ka dang re skon pa// spang rtsi do bo sdebs pas khrag tshad sel// de ba gser gyi me tog li ga dur// par pa ta sdebs rims kyi tshad pa sel/ kun la ka ra dkar po ba'i 'gyur sbyar// gur gum bdun pas tsha ba'i nad kun sel//tsan dan bsnan pas tsan dan brgyad sbyor te// de steng ga bur bsnan pas ga bur dgu// tsha ba tha ma 'bring rab sel bar nges// ༈rje 'u gtso bo brgyad pa'i sbyor ba ni// bsil gyi gtso bo gi waṃ tsan dan dkar// rtsi yi gtso bo cu gang gur gum gnyis// thang gi gtso bo tig ta ba sha ka / sngo yi gtso bo hong len bong nga dkar// ka ra dkar po bzhi 'gyur rta la skyon// don snod glo mchin khrag mkhris 'khrugs rims kyi tshad pa gsar rnying ma lus 'joms par nges/tsha stobs che na de steng ga bur bsnan// glo mang sor na shing mngar a krong bsnan/ glo 'gogs dka' na star bu ru rta bsnan// lud pa dmar na mtshal dang dom mkhris bsnan// ser na dom mkhris gser gyi me tog bsnan// dud khu li ga dur dang gla rtsi bsnan/ skya sob dzā ti sgog skya a kur bsnan/ gnyan gzer gla rtsi gu gul nag po bsnan/ rims rgyas mig chu ser la za zi mang /de ba gser gyi me tog par pa ta/ ga dur a ru bsnan pas 'joms pa yin ༈sna tshogs kha 'thor dmangs kyi sbyor ba ni// a ka ru dang dzā ti snying zho sha /cu gang spos dkar ru rta a ru ra// nā ga ge sar ka ra sum 'gyur sbyar a gar brgyad pas snying la mtshon phog dang / 'grams 'khrugs phyo lhags nu mchin gzer ba 'joms// tsan dan dkar po bsil gsum li ga dur// sro

606 sa grwa thang da bzhi/lo rgyan 'brum shing mngar tsan dan brgyad// ka ra sbyar bas glo tshad rnag khrag sel// star bu ru rtas 'gogs dka'i rnag rnams 'dren// gi waṃ gur gum utpal ba le ka / tig ta brag zhun ru rta ba sha ka / gser gyi me tog ka ra gi waṃ dgu// mchin pa gnad 'grams mchin khrag rgyas pa dang // mchin tshad bad kun srug po rgyas pa sel// a ru ra dang li shi gser me tog / spang spos nā ga ge sar pi pi ling // tshe ldum ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bdun// mcher pa gnad 'grams tsha rgyas sbos gzer 'joms// a ru ra dang gur gum sug sprel dang //brag zhun tig ta mkhal ma zho sha dang // seng phrom btson dang rgya skyegs shug tsher can// ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu pa ste// mkhal ma gnad 'grams chu sri rked pa 'khor// bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed// brag zhun gla rtsi gur gum sug spel dang // dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra// ga dur ka ra cha mnyam brag zhun dgu// pho ba'i khrag mkhris tshad pa sel bar byed//dom mkhris gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung // gla sgang bong nga dkar po ba le ka /re skon ka ra sbyar ba'i mkhris phye bdun// rgyu long gnad 'grams khrag mkhris tsha 'khru gcod// cong i se 'bru sug sprel pi pi ling // ma nu gur gum ka ra cong zhi drug / bad kun brang tsha chu tshan skyug pa 'joms cong 'i 'o mar 'dam btags grib skam bya// gi waṃ bzang drug utpal tsan dan gnyis / gla rtsi gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung // tig ta bong nga a ru ba sha ka / ru rta pi pi ling dang ka ra sbyar// cong zhi bsil sbyor dug dang skug po dang // gab tshad tshad rnying ma lus sel bar byed// cong zhi se 'bru ba'i dang a ru ra// dzā ti rme nu 'u su skyu ru ra rgyam tsha sga dang bur dkar sbyar ba yi// cong zhi'i cur nis smug po 'thab pa dang // ma zhu bad kun dang ga mi bde sel// ru rta skyu ru se 'bru ba sha ka / sug sprel pi pi ling dang ka ra sbyar// ru rta drug pas smug po 'thab pa'i nad// glang thabs sgrog skyug pho khar zug pa sel// tig ta gser

sa khyem 'azin las kyi da/ 607gyi me tog bong nga dkar// ru rta rtsa mkhris hong len par pa ta/ skyer shun ka ra sbyar ba'i tig ta brgyad// mkhris tshad mig chu sha mdangs ser ba 'joms//spos dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma ra// ru rta ba sha ka dang 'bras bu gsum slo tres brag zhun ka ra gu gul bcu// dreg grum chu ser kor ler tsha 'khyug 'joms// gur gum li shi gi waṃ bse ru mtshal// tsan dan gla rtsi 'jam 'bras bong nga dkar// ru rta 'bras bu gsum dang ka ra sbyar// gur gum bcu gsum mchin rgyad sbyar dug dang // mkhal ma gnad 'grams chu sri tsha sbos dang // ya ma nag po'i srin nad sel bar byed// gur gum cu gang utpal ba le ka / tig ta a ru mtshe sdum ka ra sbyar// gur gum mchog bdun mchin nad gsar rnying dang // mchin pa gnad 'grams khrag rgyas mig ser sel// bsil gsum tig ta ba le ba sha ka / padma nā ga ge sar pi pi ling // star bu stong len zi ra pu shel tse// ka ra sbyar bas cu gang bcu gsum ste// glo tshad lud pa rnag khrag lu ba 'joms// bsil gsum brag zhun tig ta pi pi ling // a ru mtshal dang ka ra cu gang brgyad// mchin khrag rgyas dang sprug po'i tsha ba sel// bsil gsum utpal se 'bru pi pi ling // shing tsha ka ra bzhi 'gyur cu gang bdun//tsha grang cha snyoms dang ga 'byed par byed// rgun 'brum shing mngar glo nad rnying pa sel// tsan dan gi waṃ tsha ba gab rnying sel cu gang bde byed chung 'bring chen por bshad// cu gang gur gum gi waṃ ka ra sbyar// blon po gsum sbyor byis pa'i tshad nad sel// bsil gsum tsan dan ka ra gsum 'gyur sbyar// li shi bzhi pas gre ba'i tshad pa 'joms// li shi cu gang shing mngar spang rgyan dkar// ru rta a ru ra dang ka ra sbyar// li shi drug pa lo brgyad dri chus dbul// glo nad gre ba tsha skams skad 'gags sel/ chu srin sder mo bsil gsum ba le ka / utpal rdo dreg ga dur pi pi ling / ka ra sbyar ba'i chu srin sder mo dgu// snod du tsha grang 'thabs dang skug ser 'joms/ tsan dan

608 sto/grwa nga rgyud ba /dkar dmar hong len ba le ka / padma ge sar nā ga puṣṭha dang // bcal sga spang spos dug nyung gser me tog / bil ba par ta dza ti 'bras bu gsum//sug sprel ka ras bud med rims btab dang / btsas rjes tshad pa skyes pa sel bar byed// ga bur bsil gsum dzā ti tsan dan dkar// gi waṃ ga dur se 'brus 'bras mtshal// shu mo za dang ka ra bzhi 'gyur sbyar// kri ka han zhes byis pa'i rims tshad sel/ utpal cu gang gur gum ba le ka / star bu shing mngar rgun 'brum skyu ru ra// ka ra sbyar ba'i utpal brgyad pa ste// mchin khrag pho bar rgyas pa sel bar byed// ba le ka dang utpal ba sha ka / thing mngar cu gang a ru ka ra sbyar// tshad pa kun sel pho mchin tsha ba 'joms// rgyan 'brum cu gang gur gum shing mngar dang // gla sgang shing tsha se 'bru ka ra sbyar// glo yi nad dang dbugs mi bde ba sel// kyi lce dkar po spang rtsi do bo dang // spang rgyan dkar po'i phye mas lhog pa 'joms/ /grang ba sel ba phye ma'i sde tshan la//rgyal po se 'bru blon po da lis dang // rgod ma kha phye rje 'u'i sbyor ba dang // sna tshogs kha mthor dmangs kyi sbyor ba bzhi// ༈dang po rgyal po se 'bru'i sbyor ba ni// se 'bru shing tsha pho ba ris dang gsum// kha zas mi 'ju skad 'gags dbugs mi bde// khyad par mchin pa na ba rnams la phan// de steng kha ru tsha bsnan se 'bru ba'i// sbo 'khrog skran dang ma zhu skyug pa sel// se 'bru shing tsha sug sprel pi pi ling // bur dkar sbyar ba'i se 'bru bzhi pa ste// pho ba'i ga'i 'dzin me drod gso bar byed / nad gzhi ci las gyur kyang dang ga 'byed// de steng dong gra bsnan te tshad ldan sbyar// se 'bru lnga pa bad kun zas mi 'ju//pho ba'i grang skran skyug dang yi ga 'chus// snying rlung mkhal ched nad la mchog tu phan/ yang na gur gum bsnan pa'i se 'bru lnga// tsha grang 'thab pa'i kha 'dzin me drod gso// se 'bru shing kun sga dang kha ru tsha// star bu lnga yis ma zhu mchin rgyad sel// tshad ldan sbyor bas snying cu bad rlung 'joms// se 'bru kha

lta ma 'azin la sa kyi da/ 609ru tsha dang tsha ba gsum// rgyam tsha drug gis pho ba'i me drod skyed/ kha zas ma zhu 'ju zhing be snabs sbyong // se 'bru shing tsha sug smel pi pi ling // de nyid gzhir ba 'ag brgyad pa'i kha bsgyur ba// sga dang dza ti gur gum ka ko la// tshad ldan sbyar ba'i se 'bru brgyad pa 'dis// pho mchin stod kyi bad rlung snying skran 'joms// rgyam tsha kha ru tsha dang pho ba ris// bca' sga sdebs pas ma zhu gsar rnying 'jus bca' ska byi tang ga dang tsi tra ka / 'jam 'bras sdebs pas pho ba'i me nyams gso// ma nu 'u su star bu se yab sdebs// se 'bru brgyad 'dis bad kun sprug po sel// rgyam tsha gser gyi me tog a ru ra// dom mkhris sdebs pas ma zhu mig ser sel// cong zhi rgod brtul rgyam tsha a ru ra// bya thal sdebs pas nyen skran thal bar rlog / 'gron bu dur thod sha ru'i thal ba dang //tsi tra ka sdebs dmu rdzings skom par byed// shing kun kha ru tsha dang pho ba ris//bca' sga sdebs pas pho long sbos pa sel// shing mngar cu gang rgun 'brum zi ra dkar/ sdebs pas glo nad grang ba sel bar byed / dza ti shing kun kha ru tsha dang sga// sdebs pas snying gi bad rlung grang ba sel// a 'bras sa 'bras 'jam 'bras sdig srin sdebs// se 'bru brgyad pas mkhal rked grang ba sel/rgya tsha lcam pa sdig pa pho ba ris// sdebs pas grang ba chu 'gags sel bar byed//shing kun gla rtsi thang phrom byi tang ga / sdebs pa'i se 'bru brgyad pas grang srin sel// da trig ka ped tha ram pon cha ra// sdebs pas 'ur 'khrog tsam pa 'khru ba gcod// shu dag 'u su dbyi mong tsi tra ka / rgya tsha ya bakṣa ra kha ru tsha// se 'bru'i cur nis ma zhu lcags dreg nyen / me nyams sbo sgrog dmu skran 'khru skyug dang // mkhal rked chu sri grang nad stod la phan// se 'bru tsha ba gsum po gzhir bzhag ste// da trig shing kun dbyi mong kha ru tsha// se 'bru brgyad sdebs grang nad ma lus sel// rgyam tsha lce myang tsha dang kha ru tsha// thal tsha sdebs pas phob sbos pa sel// 'u su ma nu se yab slo tres ba'i/ se 'bru brgyad sdebs

610 sa /grwa thang da bzhi/srug po gab pa sel/ rgya tsha sug sprel sdig pa lcam pa bzhi// sdebs pas mkhal nad grang ba chu 'gags sel// shing tsha sug sprel zi ra dkar nag sdebs// se 'bru brgyad 'dis bad rlung glo nad sel// shing tsha bzang po gsum dang la la phud// sdebs pa'i se 'bru dgu pas me drod rwa 'khru ba gsar rnying ma lus gcod par byed// zi ra nag po dbyi mong tsi tra ka / la la phud dang sug spel kha ru tsha// sdebs pa'i se 'bru bcu pas me drod nyams// kha zas mi 'ju sbo sgrog grang skran 'joms// dzā ti ka ko la dang kha ru tsha// rgyam tsha shing tsha dbyi mong tsi tra ka / a ru ra dang la phug sa bon sdebs// se 'bru'i cur nis bad rlung ma zhu sbo// pho mkhal bu btsas grang ba rgyas pa 'joms// grang nad ma lus se 'bru'i phye mas sel// pho ba'i bad kun sbyong zhing me drod skyed// dang ga 'byed cing kha zas len par byed/ de phyir phye ma kun gyi rgyal por bshadakaganyis pa da lis blon po'i sbyor ba ni spyo da lis na le sham dang shing tsha dang ⑪sug sprel bca' sga pi pi ling dang drug / tshad ldan sbyar bas 'khru skyug dbugs mi bde/ ga'ang 'brum skran dang skya rbab glo nad sel// zi ra sdebs pas stod tsha sman grang 'joms/ kha ru tsha sdebs grang rlung spyi la phan// dzā ti sdebs pas snying rlung 'joms par byed// star bu sdebs pas lud pa 'gogs dka' 'dren// da trig sdebs pas grang bas 'khru ba gcod// da lis shing tsha sug sprel ka ko la zi ra pi pi ling dang na le sham/ 'khru skyug ma zhu lcags dreg snyen skran 'joms// pho ba'i zug gzer 'joms shing yi ga 'byed// da lis tsha ba gsum gyi gco bo la// shing tsha sug sprel zi ra kha ru tsha// da lis brgyad 'dis bad gan grang ba sel// rgyam tsha lce sbyang tsha dang kha ru tsha// thal tsha sdebs pas pho ba sbos pa sel/ dza ti sug sprel zi ra nag po dang // ka ko la sdebs snying rlung sel bar byed// ma nu sle tres rgyam tsha pi pi ling // sdebs pas ro stod rdzings pa sel bar byed/ rgya tsha sdig pa lcam pa sug smel sdebs//

sa khye ma 'a zin las byi da/ 611da lis brgyad 'dis mkhal nad chu 'gags sel/ shing tsha sug sprel zi ra nag po dang / la la phun sdebs 'khru ba gcod par byed// dza ti sug sprel ka ko la dang ni// rgya tsha lnga tsha dbyi mong tsi tra ka / sdebs pa da lis bcu pa'i cur nis 'dis// grang nad kun sel lhag par bad kun 'joms/ kun la ka ra dkar po'i rta dang sbyar/ rje 'u'i sbyor ba gnod sbyin god ma kha// ka ra dang bca' sga tsi tra ka / byi tang ga dang a ru pi pi ling // dar sbyar ma zhu sbo sgrog 'gyings pa 'joms// khyad par pho ba'i me drod skyed pa'i mchog / de la rgyam tsha gser gyi me tog sdebs// dngas ma ma zhu mig ser sel bar byed// se 'bru sdebs pas khyad par dang ga 'byed/ kha ru tsha dang shing kun na le shamakasdebs pas lhag par pho ba sbos pa 'joms// na le sham sdebs lhag par me drod skyed// rgya tsha rgyam tsha kha ru tsha dang sdebs/ khyad par ma zhu 'ju bar byed pa yin// thal sman sdebs pas skran rnams thal bar rlog / ༈sna tshogs kha 'thor dmangs kyi sbyor ba ni// sug sprel nā ga pu ge sar dang // la la phud dang sga btsod pi pi ling // ka ra sbyar ba'i sug sprel bdun pa ste/ bad kun pho bar 'gyings dang lud pa lu// dang ga mi bde skyug pa sel bar byed/ sug sprel sga dang rgyam tsha pi pi ling // gla rtsi sdig srin lcam pa 'bras sna gsum//bur dkar sbyar ba'i sug sprel bcu pa ste// mkhal ma'i grang ba de nad chu 'gags sel// sga dang shing kun ma nu kha ru tsha// bur dkar sbyar ba'i sman sga ba'i pa ste// mkhal rked rtsib logs zug dang dbugs mi bde// skyigs pu kha gdong g.yo ba'i nad rnams sel// ru rta ma nu bca' sga a ru ra ka ra sbyar ba'i ru rta bzhi pa ste// bad rlung pho mchin skran dang mtsher nad 'joms// shu dag ru rta bca' sga kha ru tsha// tshad ldan ka ra sbyar ba'i shu dag bzhi// ma zhu skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba dang // bad rlung stod gzer skya rbab ga'ang 'brum 'joms// shing kun ma nu ru rta a ru ra// dong gra ka ra sbyar ba'i shing

612 zhu/grwa thang da bzhi/kun lnga// snying ga mtsher nad rtsib logs gzer ba 'joms// shing kun shu dag bca' sga kha ru tsha// ru rta ma nu zi ra a ru ra// shing kun brgyad pas drod chung lcags dreg nyen// sbos shing gzer 'joms mchog tu me drod skyedakashing kun shu dag se 'bru tsha ba lnga/ shu ti se yab 'u su ya brga// ma nu zi ra rgyam tsha la la phud// a ru lce myang tsha dang kha ru tsha// ti mu sa dang bur dkar srang brgyad sbyar// shing kun cur nis lho sbos yi ga 'chus// kha zas mi 'ju gdong spangs dbugs mi bde// stod rgyangs lud pa mchin mtsher rtsib logs gzer// mkhal rked rkang lag skrangs dang dri chu sri// skran dang skya rbab dmu rdzing skyag pa sel// byi tang ga dang shing kun ma ru tse// bca' sga gla rtsi phur thal pi pi ling // bur dkar sbyar ba'i byi tang bdun pa ste/ pho long srin nad ga'ang 'brum ma lus 'joms// da trig se 'bru shing tsha pi pi ling //bca' sga ka ped tha rams mon cha ra// na rams bur dkar sbyar ba'i da trig dgu// 'ur mkhrog sgreg cing 'khru ba gcod par byed// da trig smag dang tha rams lo tsan smod// btsod khrag lug mur da trig bdun pa ste// tsha grang rtas bsgyur 'khru ba gcod pa'i mchog / ya bakṣa ra se 'bru pi pi ling // shing kun bca' sga star bu rgyam tsha rnams// ka ra sbyar ba'i ya bakṣa ra bdun// gzhang gzer sbu ba be snabs 'khru ba gcod// shing mngar 'bras dang se yab byi tang ka / go stod 'u su tsha grang rta yis bsgyur// shing mngar drug pas skyug pa gcod pa'i mchog / byi tang ka dang sgog skya ma ru tse// so ma ra dza dres 'bru phur thal dang // gla rtsi tsha grang rtas bsgyur srin sman mchog / khong srin ltor btang mgo srin sna nas bdug / gzhang srin mas btang pags srin phyi nas byug / rgyam tsha la la phud dang a za mo// pi pi ling dang sga rnams cha rim bskyed/ kun dang mnyam pa'i a ru bsregs pa'i thal// bu ram sbyar ba mngon sum me dang 'dra// de sogs phye ma gang yang sbyar ba'i thabs// tshad med cha mnyam gtsor

sa ma 'a zin las kyi rgyud/ 613smos thun tshad bskyed/ tshad bshad tshad bzhin sbyar ba gces pa yin// rwa rnams gang gtong thal tshan rtsi hrog bsreg / rwa dang shing sogs gang sra sna la brdung // rlan can snum pa'i rigs rnams phyi la bzhag / sman nus zhib las 'byung bas rtsi bzhin btags// tsha sel thams cad ka ra drug 'gyur sbyar/grang sel thams cad bu ram bzhi 'gyur sbyar// sman nad 'dres yod 'chol par sbyar du rung // cur nis tres sam phye ma'i ming du bshad// tsha sel thams cad chu bsil bskol grangs dbul// 'ju ba dka' na de yang chu bskol shis//grang sel thams cad chu bskol tshan mos dbul// zas zhu sman la sman zhu zas btang gces// rul skyur sngo ngad 'ju dka' kun la spang / zhes gsungs so/bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las phye ma'i sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// / /

614le'u lnga pa/ ril bu'i sde tshan bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / ril bu'i sde tshan tsha sel grang sel gnyis// tsha sel dug sman dngul chu ma gtogs pa'i// sgos kyi tsha sel ril bu med na yang smosman nad gang 'phrod ril bur dril du btub// grang sel ril bu bi ṣa nag po dang // gla rtsi ru rta shu dag a ru ra// snying khrag rus pa rgyus pa sha dang lnga//tshan du sbyar te dri chus ril bu dril// bya khyung rnam pa lnga yi ril bu 'di// srod dus lnga bdun dgu rnams rim pas btang // pho log srin nad gnyan gzer gag lhog dang // khyad par chu ser mdze nad 'joms pa'i mchog / de la dzā ti sdebs pas snying rlung sel// kha ru tsha sdebs pho ba'i me nyams gso// 'gron bu'i thal ba sdebs pas skran rnams bshig / da lis sdebs pas skya rbab sbos pa 'jil// sha ru'i thal ba sdebs pas dmu rdzing skom// gu gul gag lhog gnyan gzer sa gdon 'joms// shing kun sdebs pas grang rlung ma lus 'joms// byi tang ka dang sdebs pas srin nad sel// rgya tsha rgyam tsha lce sbyang kha ru tsha// tsab ru tsha dang rwa tsha shing tsha dang // mdze tsha thal tsha ya bakṣa ra dang //tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum po rnams// thun gsum cha mnyam bu ram ril bur dril// nyen skran mngal skran khrag skran thal bar rlog / tsha ba gsum dang sug sprel a ru ra// 'u su g.yer ma zi ra kha ru tsha// mtsho tsha shing tsha tig ta go stod rnams// bu ram ril bus ma zhu nyen skran 'joms// go bo bya rgod so

sa༅khyem 'a zin las kyi da/ 615bya grum pa sogs/ gre ba mtha' dag g.yag rgod rkyang gi sha / bzang drug tsha ba gsum dang tshwa sna gsum/ go stod la la phun dang zi ra nag / bu ram dril ba'i za byed ril bu ste// skran nad tsha grang med par thal bar rlog / 'jam 'bras sa 'bras bsil gsum a ru ra/ dzā ti la la phud dang pi pi ling stebaca' sga utpal btsod dang tsi tra ka / ka ped mon cha ra dang da trig dang //se 'bru tshad ldan bu ram ril bu byas// gu ling 'bras kyi ril bus bad rlung rgyas// stod tsha smad grang 'khru ba gsar rnying gcod// da lis dbyi mong garnyi pa tra dang // nā ga puṣṭha ge sar pu shel tse/ dwa tsha ya brga ra bzang po gsum//mar chang bu ram ting khrol ril bu dril// da lis 'ju byed ril bus skya rbab 'joms// gur gum ma nu ka ped byi tang ga / pa tra srung sbyar ril bus skya rbab dang // sha ser mchin nad rlan grangs sbos pa 'joms// da lis dbyi mong pho ba ris dang sga// byi tsher pu tse shel dang dri bzang bzhi/ bu ram ril bus mchin skran dbugs mi bde// lud pa gzhang 'brum rtug skams 'joms par byed// tsha ba lnga dang bu ram ril bu yis// rtsib logs gzer dang snying 'dar yin 'chus sel// sug spel shing mngar rgyam tsha tsi tra ka / tsha ba gsum dang lce sbyang kha ru tsha// bu ram ril bus grang sel skran rnams 'joms 'bru pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar// ril bus ma zhu skyug pa sel bar byed dur thod sha ru spen ma'i thal ba gsum// tsa bya a ru'i ril bus dmu rdzing skem//dbyi mong sug sprel sdig pa tsha ba gsum// rgya tsha sbrang rtsi'i ril bus chu sor zug / me nyams mkhal rked dpyi mig gzer ba sel/ zi ra bca' sga shing kun sbyi tang ga / rgya tsha sbrang sbyar ril bu so steng bzhag / srin 'joms yun bsten so yi bcud len 'gyur/ de sogs ril bu gang sbyor zhib btags la//

616 grwa nga rgyud ba /rta med thams cad rlan gyis 'dam brtags bya// zhib nas sran ma phos pa tsam du dril// dug gis gtso byas sran ma chung shos tsam// rta dang sbyor na ma slas dril btub la// lug ril tsam dang ser ba nus tsam dril/ chung ba min la che ba pur bar bya// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las ril bu'i sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// / /

617le'u drug pa/ lde gu'i sde tshan bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / lde gu'i sde tshan tsha sel grang sel gnyis tsha sel so ma ra dza a ru ra// bsil gsum 'dam bu shing mngar lcags kyi phye/ka ra mar gsar lde gu byas pa yis/ slo mchin tsha ba rnyings rnyogs sel bar byed// tig ta gser gyi me rtog bong nga dkar ma nu pi pi ling dang ba le ka / sbrang rtsi'i lde gus mkhris pa'i glo nad dang / chang nad mkhris par skyug dang mgo nad sel// gur gum mtshal dang mkhris pa sna tshogs dang / ge sar gsum dang mar gsar sbrang la sbyar/ glo mchin zla mtshan rma rnying sna khrag gcod// brag zhun a ru ra dang ba sha ka / gur gum sprang rtsis mchin khrag dreg nad sel// tsan dan utpal gur gum skyu ru ra// ka ra sbrang sbyar mkhris skyug glo nad sel// rlung ldan mar gsar bad ldan ga dur sdeb// ya ru rgya skyegs btsod dang 'bri mog rtsi// bsil gsum 'dam bu shing mngar li ga dur// ka ra mar gsar sprang gi lde gu yis// lud pa she rul rnag khrag glo rdol sel//'bras bu gsum dang a ba lcags phye dang / go stod shing mngar mar gsar ka ra sbrang / lde gus mig nad dmar tshag rab sgrub 'joms// bse ru mkhris pa'i lde gus glo rnag skem// tsan dan dmar po skyer pa a ru ra'i// lde gus tshad rnying chu ser ldan pa sel// mtshal dang rgya skyegs dom mkhris lde gu yis//rtag tu zla mtshan 'dzag pa gcod par byed// cu gang gur gum li shi a ru ra//sug sprel mar gsar lde gus rab rib sel// tshad nad rnyings rnyogs dug nad 'i bar byed// bsil bzhi tsan dan dkar dmar ru rta sprang / mar gsar lde

618 zhu/grwa nga rgyud ba /gas bu chung glo nad sel// mchin pa sna tshogs ma dul gur gum dang // mar gsar sprang sbyar mig nad mchin nad sel// grang sel tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum// tsi tra byi tang ga dang li ga dur// rim pas cha bskyed lcags phye spos dkar brgyad// srung sbyar mig ser skya rbab gzhang 'brum 'joms/ rgya tsha gla rtsi sdig srin tsha ba gsum// mthing shun mo de nyi dga' 'bras sna gsum//bu ram mar sbyar mkhal nad chu sri sel// shing tsha sug smrel drod sman cu gang dang // ka ra rim bskyed mar gsar sbrang lde gu// bad kun glo nad 'jab 'jib lu la bsngags// ma nu ru rta sge gsher 'bras bu gsum// ga dur pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsi sbyar// dbugs mi bde dang bad rlung glo nad sel// se 'bru shing tsha sug sprel tsha ba gsum// kha ru tsha dang ru rta tsi tra ka / gze ma bur sbyar skya rbab rlung tshabs dang / mkhal ma pho ba rgyu long grang ba sel// de sogs lde gu'i sbyar thabs sbrang chu bcad// bu ram chur bsdus mar gyi sbru rnyings phyungs//sman kun zhib btags bsres la 'dres par dkrug / ka ra la sbyor zhib tu btags la gdab// 'ju tshod lon tsam khye sus bsten par bya// zhes gsungs so//bdud snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las lde gu'i sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// / /

619le'u bdun pa/ sman mar gyi sde tshan bstan pa/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/kye drang slong chen po nyon cig / sman mar sde tshan tsha sel grang sel gnyis/ tsha sel tig ta hong len ba sha ka / spang rtsi kyi lce khu ba byungs pa yi/ dngas ma ba mdzo'i 'o ma mar gsar la// sbyar ba'i mar khur gur gum ge sar gsum// ka ra srung sbyar mig ser skya rbab dang // chu ser pags nad tshad rnying rlung ldan 'don// tig ta kyi lce ba dang sum cu tig / ba le ka dang 'bras bu gsum gyi mar// mchin mkhris snying gi tsha ba rnyings pa sel// tig ta nim pa hong len pa rto la/ skyer pa byi tsher kyi lce par pa ta/ bskol khur gla sgang rtsa mkhris dug mo zhung // tsan dan pi pi ling rnams phye mar sbyar// de la mar phyungs sbrang sbyar mdze nad dang // sha bkra me dbal khong 'bras mtshan bar rdol// ga'ang 'brum skya rbab skom dad mgo 'khor sel// tig ta gser gyi me tog ba sha ka /skyer pa'i rtsa ba brag zhun ba le ka / kyi lce par pa ta dang sum cu tig / byi tsher dug mo nyung dang pu shel tse// 'bras bu gsum gyi mar la ka ra sbyar// tshad pa rnyings rnyogs rnams kyi bdud rtsi yin// de dag tig ta rab 'bring tha mar ro//'bras bu gsum bsdus 'o ma mar la bsdu// chu chod dngas ma lcags phye a ba sbrul// gur gum go stod mdung rtse gsal byed dgu// mig 'gribs rab rib dmar tshag skam chog sel// seng ldeng kyi lce 'bras bu gsum gyi mar// sbrang rtsi chu ser sman gsum pi pi ling // sbyar ba seng ldeng lnga yi sman mar te/ mdze nad dreg grum lus la rgyas pa sel// seng lding gur gum thal ka rdo rje dang spyoso ma ra dza kyi lce a gar nag / skyer shun mar la sbrang sbyar seng ldeng drug / chu

620 sto/grwa thang dab /ser rtsa tshigs pags la rgyas pa dang // dreg dang grum bu mdze nad sel bar byed// a ru chang sbangs sha dang bsil gsum dang // shing tsha shing mngar bca' sga ge sar gnyis// ga dur mar khu sbrang sbyar 'bri rkang mar// glo nad rgyas dang rus rlung snying tshad sel// ba gsar dmar ser chu dang lci ba dang //'o ma zho dang mar la sbrang rtsi sbyar// ba yi rnam lnga'i sman mar mchin nad rnying //tsha ba rlung ldan chu ser skya rbab 'joms// a gar tsan dan gu gul snying zho sha /rgyan 'brum mar la ka ras kha blangs pa// zho sha'i sman mar rnying gi chod pa 'joms// sro lo a ru'i mar la cu gang dang // shing mngar sprang sbyar sro lo'i sman mar te// glo rnag 'byams dang glo yi tshad pa sel// tsan dan dkar dmar sle tros dug mo nyung // gla sgang maṇḍa ka ri kyi lce ba// hong len spang spos skyer shun skyu ru ra shug pa'i mar la bsil gsum ka ra sbyar// tsan dan mar gyis glo snying mchin tshad dang / rims snyo stong skyugs tshigs gzhi skrangs pa sel// 'bri mog tshos btsod a ru ra yi mar// ka ra sbyar bas glo tshad rnag khrag skem// gur gum mtshal dang ge sar rnam pa gsum// mkhris pa sna tshogs mar la ka ra sbyang // rtsa dul bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag gcod// grang sel a ru bar skyur phyed ma skyung / bsdus khu dngas ma mar phyung bu ram sbyar// dzā ti kha ru tsha dang pi pi ling // sug sprel bca' sga kha tshar btab pa yi// 'bras bu gsum gyi sman mar gas ka sra/ mig dang rna ba so dang sna yi nad// mgo nad rtsa byer rnag 'byams rlung nad sel// khyad par snying la rlung zhugs 'joms pa'i mchog / ra mnye nye shing lca ba ba spru ba// gze ma 'bri mar rtsa ba lnga yi mar//tshwa sna gsum dang sle tres bzang po gsum// bca' sga pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar// mkhal ma'i grang nad rlung tshabs sel bar byed// 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga bsres pa 'ba' sam zhes bya stod smad kun la bsngags//'ba' sam de nang da byin lug thug 'bras// mar la cong zhi bca' sga pi pi

sa sbya ma 'azin las kyi bad/ 621ling // sle tres rgyam tsha sug thel bre ga dang // bu ram sbyar ba da byid skyin gor te// ro tsa mkhal nad za khu 'dod nyams sel/ sgog skya a ru sga yi sman mar la// rgyam tsha kha ru tsha dang pi pi ling // mug spel bu ram btab pas dar rgan dang // rgyu long mkhal rked nad dang rlig blugs sel// sgog skya sung brgyad 'bri mar cha mnyam sbyar/ bcu gnyis nas kyi gseb tu nus pa bskyed// rlung nad ma lus kun sel bcud len 'gyur// ba spru pi pi ling rtsa 'bri mar sbyarakamo sham bu rnyed mchog tu skyigs pu sel// se 'bru 'u su dong gra tsi tra ka / pi pi ling gi mar dang bu ram sbyar/ bzang po lnga yi sman mar bad rlung rgyas// skya rbab gzhang 'brum mcher nad dbugs mi bde me drod skyed cing lus sha rgyas par byed bud med bu med la yang bu rnyed 'gyur// gze ma chang sbangs tshad ldan chur bsdus pa'i// mar la kha ru tsha dang tsha ba gsum// rgyu long sbo 'khrog mkhal rlung gzer ba 'joms// de sogs sman mar mtha' dag sbyar ba'i thabs// 'tshos par btsos la khu ba yang yang gdon// khu phyin dngas ma chu bre gsum du bsdus// de la bzhos thog 'o ma bre bzhi blug / dkrug cing btsos pas chu de 'o mar stim// de la tsha sel ba ra mdzo yi mar// grang sel 'bri dang lug mar rnying pa gzhug / 'o ma mar la thim par bsdus byas te// chu chod dngas snyigs bye nas mdzub mos tshugs/ mer bcug sgra med tshigs ma dril du btub// chu chod tshad yin thal na nus pa 'tshig / ma chod pho bas mi chun nus ba chung // tshad ldan phog la khu ba gud du bzhur// de la kha tshar sman gdab mngar gsum sbyar// 'dres par dkrugs la tho rangs kham re btang // rlan grangs bser bu 'ju dka' drag shul spang / sman ma zhu na rgyam tsha bzhi thang btang // sman zad rjes la zas kyis lus zungs gso zhes gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las sman mar gyi sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //

622—le'u brgyad pa/ thal man gyi sde tshan bstan pa de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes byis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / sde tshan lnga yi nang du ma bstan pa'i// thal sbyor khaṇḍa sman chang sbyor ba gsum// grang ba'i nad la thal sman mchog yin te//tsha ba'i nad rnams khaṇḍa sa sel bar byed// sman chang rlung nad bad mkhris ldan pa sel// sbyor ba 'di gsum gsang phyir gud du sbas// dang po thal sman sbyo ra ba bstan pa ni// spyi ru rno 'jam bar ma'i sbyor ba dang // bye brag kha 'thor mi 'dra du ma bstan// dang po rlung mkhris bad kun nad gzhi sbyar// rlung dang lda na la 'jam po'i sbyor ba ni// sgron shing dur byin dan da 'bras bu gsum//pa tra snge ka dang ya bam// rgya tsha kha ru tsha dang tsab ru tsha// shing tsha thal tsha pi pi ling sku la// tsi tra ka dang tsha ba rnam pa gsum// 'o ma zho mar 'ag rkang tshil gyis sbru// mkhris par ldan la bar ma'i sbyor ba ni// hong len btsod dang zhu mkhan kyi lce ba'i// 'jam po'i steng bsnan ba ra'i zho yis sgru// grogs med bad kun rkyang la rnon po sbyar// rgod g.yag rwa phye sngo yi tsha ba gsum// shu dag shing kun 'jam po'i steng du bsnan// gcan gzan sha rus khu ba chang gis sbru/ kun kyang gar sla gzugs btub phang lo bya// ma spyad par blugs kha bcad mtshams bsnan la// 'dag pa byugs la bye mas bar mtshams bcad// bong mes 'tshos par bsregs pa'i thal ba de// grangs nas zhib btags phye ma ril bu rung // bu ram ka ra sprang gi rta la bskyon// ma zhu 'ju zhing pho ba'i me drod skyed// nyen dang skran ba thig bad kun lcags dreg 'gogs// skya rbab 'jil zhing thor dang dmu chu skem// man ngag grogs kyis bsgyur bas nad kun

༄ khyem 'a zin las kyi rgyud/ 623'joms// bye brag cong 'i 'phrul gyi thal sbyor la chung ngu bar ma chen po rnam pa gsum// a ru tsha la rgyam tsha pi pi ling // bong nga dkar po cha mnyam nyis 'gyur gyi/ cong zhi mu zi ril ma tsam zhig sbyar// zhi ga'i kong bur blug la 'dam gyis sbyar// sol ba'i me dbus bcug la 'tshos par bsreg / mu zi'i dri sangs tshos pa'i chod yin 'don// thal ba zhib btags ka ra sbyar ba ni//ma zhu bad kun nyen dang lcags dreg dang // rdo dug dbyig dug bad mkhris smug po'i skran// pho ba'i nad kun tsha grang med par 'joms// de steng bzang drug rgya tsha pri yang ku// bsnan pa cong zhi'i thal sman 'bring po ste ma zhu la sogs stobs rgyas ldan tshad 'joms// chen po tsha ba lnga dang a ru ra// rgya tsha rgyam tsha thal tsha kha ru tsha// mdze tsha zel tsha lan tsha 'gron bu dang // bya rgod gre ba sum dang chu bya dang // nya dus kun gyi nyis 'gyur cong zhi sbyar// gong bzhin bsregs thal grang skran thal bar rlog / tshwa bsregs sbyor ba ba tsha med pa'i tshwa//sngo jing ro mngar ldan pa khyor ba do// ba zho bre gang god sha mtheb tsam sbyar//btsos dkrugs chu chod phrul por song ba dang // rdzar blug du ba mi 'chor kha bcad la// bong mes 'tshes par bsregs pa'i thal ba de// star bu pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar/ ma zhu nyen dang lcags drag khrag skran bshig / ga bur nag po'i thal sbyor phag ril dang // srad dkar hong len de ba shing sngon bzhi//gtso grogs du ba ma shor so sor bsreg / thal ba dmar zal ba chus 'dam thags bya// ka ra sbyar bas ma zhu ba yi rims// gzer thung gnyan rims mig ser sel bar byed// khyad par pho bar rims babs bdud rtsi yin// big pan srad dkar snya lo kyi lce ba'i// du ba ma shor bsregs thal rlung rims sel//chang sbyar ri thang mtshams kyi bdud rtsi yin// rin po che yi thal sman sbyor ba ni//gser thal dang po sbrang gshog tsam du brdungs/ de nas brud la lab leb med par btags// tsha la mu zi til dang zar ma sbyar// ril bur dril la kong

624 zhu/grwa nga da bzhi/bur sol mes bsreg / zangs thal zangs bsregs yang yang btab kyin brdungs// sbrang gshog tsam gyur sen pos dum bur btubs// sings pos g.ya' 'don tsha la mu zi sbyar// kong bur blug la kha bcad 'tshos par bsreg / dngul thal dngul chu star bus bsheg pa dang // tsha la mu zi sbyar ba gong ba na bsreg / lcags thal seg bdar bdar phye zhib tu btags// tsha la a ru mu zi 'dag pa bya// kong bur bsregs pas thal bar 'gyur ba yin//kun la gnyen po chung na mi tshos bskyed// mdze nad dug 'joms byang khog rnag khrag skem// mtshal thal rdza yi ga 'u kha sbyar la// mtshal de jib btags ga 'u'i nang du blug / snyoms par brdal la bar mtshams 'dag pas byug / bye cha/sa bar btsangs rlangs pa thor mi rung // steng du chu byugs 'og nas me yis bsreg / tshos tshad 'og ma'i sham de skya bor 'gro me bcad grangs nas kha dbye dngul chu dril// thal bas sha ro ma lus gcod pa'i mchog / 'a ru dung dang 'gron bu thod pa rnams// sol mes dkar por ma song bar du bsreg /tsha ba gsum dang grwa 'og phur mo dang // sgog skya btsan dug phag ril sgro la sogs// sla ngar rdza sgrub du ba ma thor bsreg / thal ba de rnams phal cher rnag chu skem// cong 'i rgod 'dul sol mes chos par bsreg / dkar por song nas chang ngam dar ba'i nang // sor thon tsam gyis ngad bsad phye mar 'gro gag pa sha ro nyen skran lcags dreg gcod// ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las thal sman gyi sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// / /
