625le'u dgu pa/ khaṇḍa'i sde tshan bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//rkya drang srong chen po nyon cig / khaṇḍa'i sde tshan sbyar thabs bstan par bya//dang po 'ba' sam khaṇḍa sbyar ba ni// sngo sman thang sman bsil kun khaṇḍa sbyar//rtsi sman mkhris sman kha tshar btab pa yis// tsha ba'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad sel// sngo yi khaṇḍa bsil gyi sngo sna tshogs// brag zhun khaṇḍa sbyar bas tshad pa 'joms// rma rtsi'i khaṇḍa re skon brag spos pa// ri dang klungs kyi rta pags dar ya kun// bser kha ba mos ma phog rtsa lor bcas// khaṇḍa rma rnams kun gyi rma rtsir bzang // re ral gsum dang bcad 'byor rnam pa gnyis rta pags re skon srol gong dar ya kun// a bi ṣa dang tsher sngon chu rtsa dang // sngo yi tsha ba gsum la khaṇḍa bya// gur gum cu gang mkhris sna kha tshar gdab// sha nus mgo dang yan lag rma kun gso// bshal sman khaṇḍa dur byin thar nu dang // sngon bu khron bu lhum rtsa tsi stag mo// dan da dong ga shi ri khan da dang / a ru mchu sung ba chu khaṇḍa bya// 'jam la rno ste mchog tu dmu chu sbyong // thar nu khaṇḍa btsas chod rtsa ba brkos// dur byid 'phrod tsam hong len chu dug pa// khu ba legs bton khaṇḍa bdud rtsi zar// mi skyug mi 'gying mi 'byams chu mi gnod// nam zla tsha grang na so rgan gzhon med// mkhris pa'i khaṇḍa mi dom phag pa glang //g.yag dang phyi mkhris mtshe tshos brag spos pa// khaṇḍa ra gur gum kha tshar btab pa yis// sna khrag glo khrag mngal khrag rtsa kha shor// khrag tu 'khru skyug ma lus gcod par byed// brag zhun khaṇḍa brag zhun chur sbangs la// sa med khu ba legs btsags ma 'dregs bsdu// pho ba mchin pa mkhal tshad mig nad dang 0

626 zhu grwa nga rgyud bzhi/chu 'gags skug po dug tshad sel ba'i mchog / ba gsar dmar ser chu la khaṇḍa bya// skya rbab 'or nad dmu chu mdze nad dang // dbyig dug tshad rtogs chu ser ma lus sbyong // star bu'i khaṇḍa 'bras bu btsos byas la// rus pa phyungs la khu ba khaṇḍa ra bsdu// glo nad bad kun khrag skran 'dril ba bsheg / shug pa'i 'bras bu khaṇḍa bu ram sbyar// rkang lag chu ser tsha ba thams cad skem// ra mnye lca ba'i khaṇḍa bu ram sbyar// mkhal rked smad kyi chu ser grang ba 'joms// seng ldeng khaṇḍa mdze la mchog tu phan// sdum bu zangs rtsi'i khaṇḍa sa mkhris nad sel//skyer pa'i khaṇḍa mig nad bdud rtsi yin// 'bam po'i khaṇḍa sa khong 'bras bzhig par byed// do ba rta sbangs spru rtsa'i khaṇḍa la// byi tang ga dang shing kun tsi tra ka / dug sna sbyar bas srin thor ya bkra sel// de sogs khaṇḍa'i sde tshan sbyar ba'i thabs// sa bshal khrim khrum brdungs btsos khu ba bton// rnga mas legs btsag gtsang ma'i rdza nang bsdu// ma 'dregs krug cing skyo ma sbu nag can// de dus phog la thigs gcig rdo steng blug / de grang dril du btub na tshos tshad yin// mtha' yi 'dregs pa mi btang drod bur btsa'// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las khaṇḍa'i sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// / /

627le'u bcu pa/ sman chang gi sde tshan bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / sman chang sde tshan sbyar ba'i thabs bstan pa//sprang gi chang la kyang khug yongs rdzogs gsum// sbrang chang rkyang pa sbrang rtsi bre gang dang / chu bre drug bsres btsos la rnga mas btsags// bre dor du nas chu bre gang blug la// ngan bsad bzar bus phyar te 'o drod tsam// phabs rdog snyim gang gris dras rnga mar phur// cong zhi'i gting rdo lding thag shing la gtod//sug sprel thun gcig btags la btab ste mnan// zhag dus bsros kyin zhag gsum bar du ba 'ag / langs na skyur mnam sbu ba phyir gyis 'ong // de la tsha ba gsum po kha tshar btab// sgongs dang tho rangs ja sun tsam re bsten//rlung tshabs chu ser sdongs nas tshigs byer sel// rus tshad mkhal tshad rlung ldan chu ser 'don// khug pa chu ser rlung ldan bu ram bsnan// yongs rdzogs chu ser tsha ba seng ldeng bsnan// me tog kun dang khyad par g.yar mo thang //btus skams bum par bsdigs la chu yis bsing // khu ba bzhur te sbrang rtsi phul gang sbyar// 'o drod tsam bsros 'ag gsum mnan la bzhag / puṣṭha'i sbrang chang zhes bya sbrang dang mnyam// bur chang nas dang gze ma gro dang gsum//btsos te langs pa'i glum la bur chus bsing // rlung nad ma lus sel bar byed pa ste// khyad par glo snying mkha' rus rlung tshabs 'don// yang na nas chang bu ram sbyar ba yang // bu ram bur chang zhes bya rlung kun 'joms// mar chang sbyor ba chang nang bu ram sbrang // mar dang go stod pi pi ling du sbyar// rtse 'jam 'ag gsum mnan pas grang rlung sel// rlung tshabs mgo dang mig la

628 sa /grwa nga dba'i bros pa 'don// gze chang gze ma nas bsres glum nang du// gze ma chur bsdus khu bas bsings pa ni// rus tshigs mkhal ma'i rlung dang chu ser 'joms// khyad par rlung tshabs mkhal mar babs pa 'don// rus chang sbyor ba gzhug chung rus pa 'am/ thong tsher dus pa bubs gcig zhib brdungs la//mchan bsres glum la bu ram chus bsings pa// rlung nad kun sel rus pa'i rlung tshabs 'don// sro lo'i chang sbyor sro lo chur sbangs pas// gro chang bsings pa glo tshad rlung ldan sel// tig ta'i chang sbyor nas dkar ser tsam brngos// de yi glum la tig ta a ru ra'i// khu bas chang bsings tshad rnying rlung ldan sel// kyi lces bsings na tsha ba chang 'thung yin// de bzhin snying la dzā ti rus chang sbyar// glo yi nad la rgun 'brum bur chang sbyar/ bad gan na le sham gyi 'bru chang sbyar// lhang ba'i grang ba rgya tsha'i tsha chang sbyar// chu sar nad la seng ldeng sgrungs chang sbyar// dug nad zungs zad gtso bo drug chang sbyar//gzhan yang nad dang gang 'phrod sman chus bsings// yang na sman phye chang sbyar mnan pa yis// pho ba'i drod skyed rlung gnon nad sel 'gyur// zan chang sbyor ba ra mnye lca ba dang // gze ma lcam pa yos bsres phyer btags la//zan dron phabs bran langs nas chang du bsing // rnyings nas mnyes la bu ram sga dang mar// btab btsos ltor bsten grang rlung ma lus 'joms//khyad par mkhal rked gzer dang rkang lag bshal// tshigs gzhi skrangs dang da gan rna ba 'on// grang bas chu 'gags smad kyi drod shor sel// rked pa man chad grang rnag 'byams pa gcod// ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las sman chang gi sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// / /

629le'u bcu gcig pa/ rin po che'i smon ba'i sde tshan bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / zhi byed rgyal po rin chen sbyor sde bshad/ thang phye ril bu lde gu sman mar sogs// yang yang bsten pas sman 'dred nad ma thon// zhi byed kun gyi log gnon rin po che// khrag mkhris bad rlung bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad// mgo dang byang khog yan lag rma rnams dang // dmu 'or mdze 'bras gag lhog gnyan nad dang // klu gnyan rgyal po la sogs 'byung po'i gdon// rin po che yis mi sel 'ga' yang med// nad gzhi med pa'i mi la bcud len 'gyur// sbyor ba tsha sbyor grang sbyor rnam pa gnyis// rin chen tsha sbyor gser dngul zangs lcags bzhi// sbrang gshog tsam du brdungs la dum bur btubs// zhi ku'i kong bur blug steng dngul chu blug / de steng tsha la mu zi blug par bya// de yi kha ru lci thal dam par brdig / de steng 'dag pas kha bcad sol mes bsreg / thal ba mu zi gu gul so ma ra// shu dag tsi tra ka dang tsha ba gsum// re skon seng ldeng 'gron thal zhib par btags// dngul chu zho phyed star bu gcig gis bshig / a ru chang sbangs khu ba ba chu gnyis// khaṇḍa ra btsos mi gong ma rnams dang sbyar// ril bu sran ma tsam dril tho rangs dus/lnga bdun dgu bskyed chang gis 'phul la btang // dreg dang thum bu 'bras dang sur ya mdze/ rtsa nad tsha skran dmu 'or grang rnag skem/ rin chen grang sbyor bsten thabs sbyor ba dang // log gnon gsum las bsten thabs rnam pa

630 ༄gyi grwa nga rgyud ba'idagu// g.ya' phyi dug 'don 'jam btsal sna khrid dang // ba thig dang rtsa kha dbye dang snod btang dang // phyi bsrung ba dang nus pa bskyed pa'o// dang po tsha ba gsum dang dngul chu gnyis// gla hel nang du g.ya' ma thon bar mnye// de rjes ba chur btags la g.ya' khu 'don// dug 'don cong zhi dri chur skams skams btso// 'jam btsal pi pi ling dang pho ba ris// cong zhi nag mtshur bul tog rnam pa lnga// nad gzhir bstun te tshad ldan sbyar bar bya// sna khrid la cha dbyi mong nad dang sprod// tsha grang sa nyen por gang shis kha lo bsgyur//bshig pa dngul chu star bu log por btang // mchil ma ba chus 'brum bu med par mnye// rtsa kha 'byed pa tshwa rdor g.yer mas bya/ snod btang ba ni zangs kyi thal ba sdeb// zangs thal med na lus la jul mi 'chags// ril bu'i sngon du zhun mar 'ag 'ga' bsten// phyi bsrung tsha grang sbyar ba'i mar gyis byug /nus pa skyed pa ril bu chang gis dbul// sha chang lhor bsten skabs su ba spur dbyung // bston thabs ma shes sbyor ba dug tu 'gyur// snod ngan seng ge'i 'o ma bzhos dang mtshungs// sbyor ba chig thub dang ni kun rgyug gnyis// dang po mu zi 'gron thal a ru ra// sug smel gser gyi bye ma byang sems gnyis// kun dang star bu mnyams te sbrang dang sbyar// rnag dang chu ser dmu chu skem par byed// glad pa 'dzag gcod rtsa nad byer 'grams sel// bzang drug tsan dan dkar dmar 'bras bu gsum// spos dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma ra// dom mkhris ru rta sbyar ba'i ril bu yis// tsha rnyogs 'bras dang sur ya rtsa nad sel//btsan dug a ru mu zi gla rtsi dang // shu dag ru rta gu gul bzang po drug / spos dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma ra// srung sbyar ril bus mdze 'bras gag lhog dang //dmu 'or skya rbab skrangs pa ma lus 'joms// bzang drug gla rtsi tsan dan dkar po dang // bse ru'i gi waṃ chos sman a ru ra// brag zhun bong nga dkar dmar phya tshan gsum// khyung sder dpa' bo ser po dom mkhris dang // tig ta

lta ma 'a zin las byi da/ 631ma nu ru rta skyer bar shun/ ka ra sbyar ba'i ril bus dug tshad 'joms/bsil gsum gi waṃ gla rtsi bong nga dkar/ ru rta brag zhun gser gyi me tog dang // bye 'u la phug nyung ma'i khaṇḍa la// ril bu dril bas sha dug sel bar byed// bsil gsum tsan dan dkar dmar ba sha ka / hong len skyu ru'i ril bus 'khrugs tshad 'joms/ gi waṃ bong nga dkar po a ru ra// gser gyi me rtog bsil gsum tig ta sbyar// ril bus rims kyi tshad pa sel bar byed//sbal rgyab mdung rtse gangs thigs cong zhi dang // tsha la gla rtsi'i ril bus 'brum nag sel// btsan dug gla rtsi gu gul a ru ra// sbal pa nag po shu dag ril bu yis// lhog pa'i nad rigs ma lus 'joms par byed// btsan dug rgya tsha thar nu a ru ra// ru rta khyi yi mche bas gag pa sel// spang rtsi re skon a bo gang ga chung // dug nyung dom mkhris brag zhun rgyu gzer sel/ de la sogs te nad gang gnyen po dang // dngul chu sbyar bas gso dka'i nad rnams sel gser dang rgya ru rgya skyegs rgya tsha dang // snag tsha sbrul dang stag sha bul rtog dang // mdzo dre'i rgyungs pa sbyar bas skye rgyun gcod// kun rgyug dngul chu mu zi star bu dang // rgya byin sbrang la sbyar ba'i lde gu la// ra mnye nye shing sbyar bas bcud len 'gyur// bse ru go dor 'gron thal re skon dang / zangs thal mar gsar byang khog rnag khrag skem// ya bakṣa ra 'gron thal tsha ba gsum//dgo ru thal tsha shing tshas dpu chu skem// btsan dug gu gul rma bya'i mkhris pa sbyar// byug dang lhor btang mdze nad 'joms par byed// thal ka rdo rje seng ldeng so ma ra// spos dkar sbyar bas chu ser nad kun skem// 'gron thal brag zhun sle tres dreg nad sel/ dom mkhris gu gul so ma ra dza sbyar// khong du btang dang rmar byugs 'bras nad sel// bso 'bras dngul thal dar mtshur sha ro gcod// log non bying 'thibs bzang drug ka ra sbyar 'khru na bzang drug zangs thal sbyar bas gcod kha la rma byung rgyu ma gzer ba dang // pho

632 zhu/grwa thang rgyud ba'ibar mi 'ju skran du 'dril ba na// gnyen po'i sman drug bskol thang tshan mo btang // yang na phye ma chu bskol tsha mos dbul// zangs rgyugs don la star bu ba chu btung // mgo 'khor kha gdong g.yo zhing so snyil na// sha chang zhun mar sgog skya bsten par bya// rus tshigs 'bral snyam byed na pi pi ling // rgya tsha rgyam tsha star bu'i grang thang btang // bsten thabs dgu ldan log pa 'byung mi srid// ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rin po che sbyor ba'i sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// / /

633le'u bcu gnyis pa/ sngo rgyur gyi sde tshan bstan pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// zhi byed sde brgyad rin chen sbyor ba rnams// gso bya'i nad la mi sel 'ga' med kyang // nam zhig lnga brgya'i dus su sleb tsam na// dbul po'i nad pa rnams kyis bsrur mi theg / mtha' 'khob yul du btsal bas rnyed pa dka'// thag ring yul du btsal bas nad pa 'chor / de phyir sa la skyes pa'i sngo rnams kun skyes tshad mthong tshad sman du sbyar thabs zhu// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye ma legs so drang srong yid las skyes/khyod kyis zhus pa'i gtam la de ka bden// lnga brgya dus kyi mtha' mar slob pa'i tshe// skyes tshad mthong tshad sman du ma 'khol na// nus ldan dkon pas btsal du ga la rnyed// dper na lha dang klu yi nor bu 'dra/ rnyed kyang dbul po'i nad pas ci la theg / dper na zong med tshong dus 'khyam pa 'dra// de bas mtha' khob dbul po'i nad bsal phyir// byams pa'i sems kyis sngo yi sbyor ba bstan// 'on kyang nus pa rtsi bas sngo rang che// ga bur nyid kyang zil gyis gnon par nus// sngo mi skye ba'i yul ni cig kyang med// de la gces pa'i yan lag bdun ldan dgos skye sar skyes dang dus su btus pa dang / skam srad legs dang so ma rnyings pa dang / dug 'don 'jam btsal phrod par sbyar ba 'o// skye sa sa gtsang nyams dga' bud nas bcags bkra shis yon tan ldan zhing sa gzhi bshin/ gangs can 'bigs byed bsil drod rang gnas skyes// nyi zla'i stobs ldan skye sar skyes zhes bya/ btu dus rtsa ba yal ga

634 sa /grwa thang dab /sdong po gsum// sdong po'i rigs yin rus rtsa sha nad sel// ston ga rtsi skam dus su btu bar bsngags lo ma zho dang myu gu rnam pa gsum// lo ma'i rigs yin snod rkang lha nad sel// 'dab rgyas char gyi dus su btu bar bsngags//me tog 'bras bu rtse mo rnam pa gsum// 'bras bu'i rigs yin mig don mgo nad sel// ston ser smin pa'i dus su btu bar bsngags/ kogs pa bar shun tshi ba rnam pa gsum// shun pa'i rigs yin pags rgyus yan lag sel kha 'bus dpyid kyi dus su btu bar bsngags// bshal sman rtsi skams nus pa gting 'gro'i dus// smyugs sman kha 'bus gyen 'dren dus su btu// khyad par zla ba yar ngo'i dus bzang la/ gtsang ma'i byis pa khrus byas mdzes par brgyan// gzungs sngags rten 'brel snying po ba zhing btu// dug dang phral brtsa sdong pags rkang dug / yal ga'i tshigs dug ngar pa lo ma'i dug / me tog gos dug rus pa 'bras bu'i dug / zho rkang tshi ba gsum la dug med de//dreg pa pags dug sha gdan bar shun dug / dug phral sman ni 'jam zhing 'ju ba bla// skam srad gang yang btu dus rma phab la// bsil sman grib lhags drod sman me nyis skem// bser gyis ma zhig me nyis ma gdungs pa// du ba ma phog gzhan gyi dri ma gos// rang gi nus ldan yon tan dpag tu med// so ma rnyings pa lo dus ma lon pa// dus 'das nus pa 'chor phyir lo dus spo/'jam btsal gsum ste sbyor bas 'jam pa dang // kha 'dzin 'jam dang gnyen pos 'jam pa'o// sbyor bas 'jam pa rigs mthun mang sna sprad// kha 'dzin 'jam pa pho ba don snod rnams// gang la babs pa'i kha 'dzin bcas te bsten// gnyen pos 'jam btsal sngo rnams thams cad kun// rlung 'bud pho ba'i me gsod lus zungs skem// de phyir rlung gnon sha chen bur rnying ste// pho ba'i me gso se 'bru pi pi ling // lus zungs rgyas par byed la a ru ra/ de rnams ma 'dzom khaṇḍa shis pa yin/ phrod par sbyar ba gnad gsum shes pa

cu ma 'a zin las byi rgyud 635yis// bsil drod ma 'dres mthun sdebs sbyar byas te// tsha sel grang sel gnyis su shes par bya// tsha sel thun mong ba dang kha sgyur gnyis/ thun mong sngo sbyor rgyal po btsun mo sras// blon 'bangs dmag dpon dmag mi chibs par bcas// rgyal po zla ba bsil ba'i bdud rtsi ste// btsun mo re skon sro lo 'jib 4sras// blon po sgong thog pa dang par pa ta// tig ta spang rtsi hong len sha lang 'bangs// blon 'bangs drug po nad rigs kha bsgyur te/ thun log sbyar ba nad 'joms dmag dpon yin// dmag mi bsil ba'i sngo sna gang tshogs sbyar/ 'di rnams chibs pa gangs kyi chu la skyon// ma smin gab tshan sum gnyis bsdus 'jam btang // tsha ba rgyas pa'i dus na chu bsil shes//rnyings tshad bsdus grangs stongs tshad ngad yal bsten// kha bsgyur sngo sbyor bdun pa sbyar thabs ni// hong len spang rtsi re skon kyi lce bzhi// gtso bo rgyal po sde bzhis gzhi bzung la// blon po spun mang nad steng kha bsgyur ba// de ba sngo sprin skra bzang rims tshad sel// stab seng rta pags ri tshos 'grams tshad sel// sro lo sgong thog bong ngas 'khrugs tshad 'joms// thong nga a bo re ral sbyar dug 'joms// 'om bu sgong thog bye 'us sha dug 'joms// gang ga chung btsod bong ngas tshad 'khru 'joms// sran ma g.yer shing btsod kyis 'brum nag sel// chig thub stag sha ming can gag lhog 'joms// a byag dug pus spru cos gnyan gzer 'joms// ma nu lug chung khur tsas sprug po sel/ stab seng a byag srol gong mgo nad gso// rnam par khrag rkang 'bam pos yan lag gi / chu 'thung tshad pa gcog par byed pa yin// rgu drus spang tshan sbu ru dar ya kun// byang khog don 'byor khrag skom rtsa chad 'thud/ phur thal stag sha 'gron bu'i thal ba yis/ byang khog rnag khrag chu ser skem par byed/btsod dang 'bri mog lug chung khrag tshad sel// rtsa mkhris bong nga skyer pas mkhris tshad sel// bse rgod skyer pa spa 'brum chu ser sel// mtshan dkar snyi

636 sto/grwa thang dba'i ba rgod spos rnyings tshad sel/ sro lo sug 'dra spang rgyan glo tshad sel// rtsi 'u sum cu tig mtshe mchin tshad sel// rgod spos byi tsher khrag rkang mcher tshad sel// shug tsher byi tsher nyi dgas mkhal tshad sel// khur rtsa snya lo 'jib rtsis pho tshad sel// snya lo bong nga btsod kyis rgyu tshad sel// de ba yu nga ba skyer shun sha tshad sel/ lug ru brag spos snyi bas rtsa tshad sel// stab seng se rgod gang chung rus tshad sel// thang phye pho ba'i me drod tsha stobs sbyar// phye ma ka ras kha blang gces pa yin// grang sel dbyi mong da lis star bu dang // cong 'i rgod btul bzhi yis gzhi bzung la// de la la phug 'jom dang pi pi ling // kha bsgyur pho ba'i me drod skyed par byed// sran ma phabs dang bul tog tsam pa 'ju// lce tsha za 'brum 'dzim sbyar sngo ngad 'ju// ze tsha bya thal srub gas skran 'dril bshig / byi zung ze tsha ba sprus rdo skran bshig / mdze tsha ba sgru pa yag mngal skran bzhig / lce tsha srub ka 'gron thal dmu rdzings skem// lca ba ba spru ra mnyes skya rbab 'joms// bre ga rgod krong rtsi 'us glo nad sel// se rgod 'jib rtsi drod sman mchin nad sel// lca ba ba spru gze mas mkhal nad sel / bre ga spa 'brum ra mnyes chu ser sel// ra mnye nye shing sha nus grang rnag gcod//kun la bur dkar rta sbyar chu bskol dbul// gzhan yang rtsa ba drug dang lo ma lnga// me tog gcig dang 'bras bu rnam pa ba'i// tshwa gsum thal ba gnyis dang bu ram sbyar/ chu tshan 'phul bas grang nad ma lus sel// mtha' 'khob yul gyi sngo sbyor sdun ngag 'di// sems la long la byams pas 'gro don gyis// zhes ba byed// snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las sngo sbyor gyi sde tshan bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// / /

637le'u bcu gsum pa/ las lnga'i sngon du 'gro ba tham 'chos/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / las lnga'i sngon 'gro snum 'chos rung mi rung ⑪bsten thabs legs nyes de yi log gnon no// snum rung gas theg stobs chung sems las che// lto skya khrag zags khong tsub khu ba zad// rlung che mig 'gribs sbyang ba dgos la btang // mi rung me drod chung ba ma zhu 'khru/ dreg grum dbyig dug yi ga 'chus pa dang / bad kun skyug nad skom dad che la spang kabasten thabs spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// dang po 'bru mar zhun mar rkang mar tshil// lus dang mgo bsku 'jam rtsi khong du btang / rna ba mig dang mkhur bkang sna nas dgang // nad dang ji ltar 'tsham pa bzhin du sbyar/bza' ba'i thun tshad me drod 'ju stobs dpag / chung 'bring chen po rim pas bskyed la btang // rtag tu lto skyid snum la goms pa la sngon la tsub 'chos byas la de rjes bsten/ lto skya khong tsub snum gtong lan tshar sdeb// snum 'chos kun la chu tshan 'ju rtsi yin/ sngo ngad rul skyur rjen zas spang byas la/yang zhing dro la 'ju bla cung zad bsten// bud med drag shul mya ngan mang du smra/rta zhin nyin gnyid chu rlung dud pa spang / khyad par sman mar la sogs zhi byed snum// lto stong zas dang ma sbrags rkyang par btang / tshe ring me drod skyed cing dran pa gsal/ blo 'phel 'dod la zhun mar bsten par bya/ rlung 'phel lto sra mkhrang 'dod 'bru mar phan// drod che bu btsas rjes dang rtsol bas dub/zungs zad rtsa sbubs 'gags la rkang tshil phan/ rma dang mes tshig rus tshigs na ba dang // lho mngal rna glad na la tshil mchog phan/ zhun mar dgun dus

638 ga /grwa nga da ba'i/'bru mar dbyar btang bsngags/ rkang tshil dbyin dus nyin mor bsngags pa yin/ sbyong byed snum 'chos tho rangs zhun mar btang // khong snum bar bsten de nas mi phan 'dred// brta bya byis pa gas dang skyid par 'dug /snum 'dris me drod chung dang skom dad che// stobs chung sos dus sha khu yos thug 'bras// sbrang dang bu ram zhun mar sbyar te btang // 'ju bla dang ga mi 'gag stobs skyed mchog / de dag zos rjes zas gong zas bar du// snum bsten lus kyi stod smad bar la shis// snam legs khong snum gyur tshad rlung bder rgyu// bshang ba mi sri drod che snum mi 'dod// phan yon mdog stobs dbang gsal gas ka sra/ snum drags gyen thur snum 'byung dang ga 'gag /dpyid pos 'bru mar bsten na bad mkhris slong / dgan dus tshil bston lus 'khyags ma zhu skyed// log gnon bkres skom dugs bya skyug tu gzhug / sran ma so ba dar rnying dngas chang bsten/ zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las las lnga'i sngon du 'gro ba snum 'chos kyi le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //

639le'u bcu bzhi pa/ las lnga bshal gyi skor/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / las lnga'i mchog gyur bshal la brtag pa dang |btang thabs skyon yon rnam pa bzhi yis bstan/ dang po rung dang mi rung na dgazhi brtag / ran dang mi ran dus tshod brtag pa dang / thub dang mi thub lus shed brtag par bya// rung ba rims 'khrugs tsha ba smin rgyas dang /dug dang snod tshad ma zhu skran nad dang // skya rbab dmu chu bad srug chu ser mdze// dreg grum srin nad rab rib rma rnying sogs/ phyi nang phal che'i nad la bsngags pa ste// khyad par mkhris pa'i nad la mchog tu bshad/ mi rung dgun dus zungs zad gas pa dang / gdon can sbrum ma rlung nad me drod nyams// gzhang nad thur sel log dang skyug lang can// zug ju khong du lus la btang mi bya// ran dang mi ran dus tshod brtag pa ni// nad gang smin 'dus bshig slong rgyas dus sbyang 1 de ltar ma yin sngas na nad mi 'drongs dus su ma sbyangs phyis na brtas par 'gyur// de phyir sbyang ba'i dus tshod shes pa gces// thub dang mi thub lus shed brtag pa ni/ zungs zad stobs med zas kyis bor ba dang / rtsa yi shed shor srun sdod sbyongs mi thub ci phyir mi de'i nad la srog gnas pas/ sbyongs zhan nad slong slar yang dang ga 'gag /sbyang ba drags na nad srog gnyis ka 'joms/ de phyir bkrus sman mi btang dug dang mtshungs// de 'dra 'jam rtsi ni ru ha spel bsngags// btang thabs sngon 'gro dngos gzhi phyi rjes gsum// sngon du 'gro la ring dang nye ba gnyis/ring ba'i sngon 'gro blo bur nad min la thang dang phye mas byer bsdu 'dril ba

640 sa /grwa nga da ba'i/bshig / zhen pa 'grogs dang gab pa slong ba dang / ma smin smin par byas la btang ba bsngags// nye ba'i sngon 'gro gza' skar tshes bzang la// mkhan pa sbang ma chu 'jam bsros pa yis/ lus kun dag par bkrus rjes mar gsar dang // 'bru mar tsha grang nad dang sbyar byas te/ lho ba ma gtogs bsku mnye 'them par bya// rlung shas che dang lto ba sra ba la// zhun mar ltor btang a ru mchu ring mur/ 'jam rtsi mas btang rlung ga'i la bad mkhris bslang //mdor na bshal dgra rlung yin de 'dul gces// shin tu nye ba gtong gong zhag gcig nas// gro sran sngo ngan nya phag rul skyur dang // 'o ma la sogs gang gnod zas kyis bslang // gtong nub za tshod rdor thal med pa btung //de yis nad slong lto snyi rlung kha gnod// dngos gzhi sman gyi sbyor sde btang tshul dang // lcag dang 'don tshad log gnon rnam pa lnga// sbyor sde kun tu rgyug pa'i spyi bshal dang / thor bu nad kyi sgos bshal rnam pa gnyis// dang po sna sel ded dpon kha 'dzin gsum sna sel a ru mchu ring lham rtsa dang // chu ma rtsi dang rgyam tsha pi pi ling // bsdus thang dro 'jam nam dgung btang byas pas//'khru nus rgyu 'khrog ci yang med dang gsum// de las lho ba sra snyi dpags byas te// ded dpon thun tshad che chung shes par bya// ci phyir zhe na lto sra thun chungs pas// nad slong phyir mi thon te nyes pa che// lto snyi thun ches mi chod lus zungs 'joms// des na lto ba brtag phyir sna sel gces// lto snyi mi skyug rno 'jam grogs su 'gyur/ ded dpon a ru mchu ring dan rog dang / thi ri khan da dur byin rnam pa bzhi/ a ru ra ni thal tshan gseb tu gdul// dan da rog po lce gdon phye la gdul// shi ri khan da mar dkar nang du gdul//dur byin rkang shun dug phral yos su gdul// cha mnyam zhib btags ril bu dril ba yis// rno la drag ste stobs ldan nad kun 'joms// yang na thar nu dur byin a ru ra// lham rtsa sngon bu khron bu shi ri khan// dan rog dan khra dong

sa ’ ma 'azin las kyi da/ 641ga ba chur bsdus// sna ma tshig pa'i khaṇḍa rno la 'jam mi skyug mi 'byams snyen dang rlung mi skye// nad dang sbyar nas drag zhan zo yis 'khru// dgun dus sbrum ma gas dang zungs zad dang / lam ga'i 'gron po la yang btang du btub//gtso bo de la 'khor gyis kha bsgyur ba// tsan dan a ga ru dang snying zho sha /sdebs pas snying gi tsha ba sbyong bar byed// tsha la shing mngar rgyan 'brum a krong sdebs// glo ba'i nad rnams 'khru bar byed pa yin/ gur gum ba sha ka dang brag zhun sdebs mchin pa'i tsha ba 'khru bar byed pa yin// ya bakṣa ra thal tsha pi pi ling // sdebs pas mcher nad 'khru bar byed pa yin// lcam pa sug sprel dbyi mong sdebs pa yis// mkhal ma'i nad rnams 'khru bar byed pa yin// ma nu rgyam tsha pi pi ling dang gsum/ pho ba'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin tig ta gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung // sdebs pas mkhris pa'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed// snya lo btsod dang kha ru tsha sdebs pas/ rgyu long snod nad sbyong bar byed pa yin// byang pa sdig srin spos dkar sdebs pa yis// rtsa nad thams cad sbyong bar byed pa yin// dbyi mong srub ka byang pa sdebs pa yis//mgo skyon rtsa nad sbyong bar byed pa yin// li ga dur dang dom mkhris nyi dga' sdebs// stod kyi rtsa nad thams cad sbyong bar byed/ rgya tsha sdig srin sug sprel sdebs pa yis// smad kyi rtsa nad thams cad sbyong bar byed// se rgod bar shun dbyi mong so ma ra// pags pa'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// me tog lug mig bil ba a 'bras sdebs// mgo bo'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// a pa a ru ra dang lcag dreg sdebs// mig gi nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// ga bur tsan dan gi waṃ sdebs pa yis// tshad pa'i nad rnams sbyong sna/ rnams byi/ /ba/ rab byed ling /zlo sa ṭwāṃ //ma sde/kā// tsha /kā 'a ci dres dring zlo spos dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma ra// sdebs pas chu ser nad rnams sbyong bar

642 sa grwa nga da ba /byed// khyung sder re ral bong nga dkar po sdebs/ dug gi nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin/ se yab 'u su pus kur sku la sdebs// bad kun srug po'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed/ dbyi mong srub ka shu dag sdebs pa yis/ skran gyi nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// sla gor zho sha sngon bu pad me sdebs// dmu chu'i nad rnams spyong bar byed pa yin// nim pa rgya tsha dzā ti pha la sdebs//skyug pa'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed pa yin// zar ma shu zur zom rtsi sdebs pa yis// pho long sbos pa'i nad rnams sbyong bar byed/ dzā ti pi pi ling dang na le sham// gyen log rlung dang rgyu long 'khrol ba sbyong / byi tang ga dang g.yer ma ma ru tse// sdebs pas srin nad ma lus sbyong bar byed/ gur gum dbyi mong so ma ra ja sdebs// dreg gi nad rnams 'khru bar byed pa yin// ru rta mu zi rgya tsha sdebs pa yin// sha rus rtsa yi 'bras nad sbyong bar byed// a sho gca 'ol mo ya bakṣa// sdebs pas bu snod nad rnams sbyong bar byed// mi rus btsa' ma ya bakṣa ra sdebs/ tsam pa mi 'khru nad rnams sbyong bar byed/ ba spru sdebs pas sbrum ma'i bu mi 'chor/ chu ma rtsi dang sdebs pas smyug mi srid// dngul chu dung thal rgya tsha sdebs pa yis// mi skyug mi 'gying myur du 'bigs par byed/nyang rtsi sbas dang sdebs pas 'byams mi srid/ dri chu chu rug sdebs pas chu mi gnod// nyi dga'i 'bras bu sdebs pas kha mi skom// kha bsgyur sum cu gnad kyi man ngag bdun// 'di ldan nad yul 'byin par the tshom med// thor bu na dkyi sgos bshal bstan pa ni/ thar nu dus bskos ba chur btul ba dang //chu rtsa khron bu hong len gser me tog / 'khrugs rims rgyas pa'i tshad pa sbyong bar byed// thar nu chu rtsa re cag rtsa ba gsum// gag lhog rgyu gzer gnyan glang gzer thung sbyong // dur gyid hong len tsha la ltar bu yis// bad kun sprug po'i tshad pa sbyong bar byed// khron bu tsha la pa tol mkhris nad sbyong / dur byin ltar bu dung thal sbrul gyi sha / rgya tsha bu ram sbyar ba'i ril bu yis// khrag

sa ma 'a zin las kyi da/ 643mkhris ma zhu glang thabs sbos pa 'joms shi ri khan da sngo yi tsha ba gsum/rgya tsha bu ram ril bus skran nad spyong // dur byin sgron shing bca' sga lcags phye dang / ba chu sbyar bas skya rbab sbyong bar byed/ dan da dur byid shi ri khan da dang / thar nu khron bu lham rtsa re cag pa// dong ga sngon bu rgya tsha chu ma rtsikazangs dreg pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar// ril bus 'or dang dmu chu sbyong bar byed// a ru skyer zhun so ma ra dza dang / spang rgyan 'bri ta sa 'dzin dong ga lhum// bsdus khur dur byin btab pas dug nad sbyong // dur byid hong len rgya skyegs tsha la dang // 'gron thal gla rtsi'i ril bus sha dug sbyong // dur byid dan da mtshal dang pi pi ling // rgya tsha rgyam tsha a ru ra dang sga// byang khog nang du khrag babs sbyong bar byedaka ma rtsa a ru mchu skung cha mnyam ste/ nyi dga' shing mngar rgyam tsha pi pi ling / bskol thang ma zhu gsar dang rims nad dang //lhag par pho mchin nad rnams sbyong ba'i mchog / a ru mchu ring ba ru skyu ru ra//lham rtsa dur byin spos dkar ba chur bsdus/ rgyun sbyongs dreg dang grum bu chu ser dang // rnyongs tshad rnyings tshad lus la zhen pa sbyong / btang tshul thang phye ril bu sman mar bzhi// gas dang zungs ngan rnams la bskol thang shis/ de yis btang bzhag ran par tshod zin 'gyur// zungs bzang nad rgyas phye ma ril bu shis/ de yang skyug pa rnams la ril bu btang / shin tu lto sra skyug lang yod pa la// sman mar sbyar te gsangs la rgyun sbyongs bya// sman dren yi ga bsdar la zas dang sdeb// gtong dus tho rangs sman la shis pa brjod// sman btang kha bshal mngar ba cung zad mur// 'drul bsrung mi smra mi nyal tsog pur 'dug / 'og rlung glod la nad gdon 'khru bar bsam// lcag ni bshal thengs gnyis gsum khrus pa dang // dang ga mer ba sangs nas chu bskol btang // sngas na skyug la phyis na nad mi khrus// rlung shas che na nus khu'i lcag gis bskul// zungs zad mi la bur khu'i lcag gis 'phul// tsha ba smin rgyas

644 sa /grwa thang da ba'i/dus su gangs chu'i lcag / chu ser tshad rnying nad la ba chu'i lcag / khru ba'i shugs dal a ru mchu sung lcag / thun mong lcag tu rgyam tsha'i chu bskol shis//shed chung shes pa zi nyog stong skyugs mang // bsku mnye bsur dud rus khus rlung sna mnan// 'don tshad grangs dang bungs dang kha dog las// grangs tshad sum cu nyi shu tha ma bcu// bungs tshad bre gsum bre do bre gang la// kha dog chu dang bad gan mkhris pa gsum// rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi tshad yin pas//nad kyi stobs dang lus shed rjes dpags la// shed che nad ma zad na lcag gis bskul// nad ma dag kyang zungs zad lcag 'phro bcad// nad dag chur khru ji ltar 'dug kyang bcad// log gnon rgal ba mnan dang stor ba btsal//'gyings pa drang dang 'byams pa bcad pa dang // srog gi bya ra bzhag dang rnam pa lnga skyug na rdo grang sker bdug dri zhim mnam// spyi bo'i skra 'then gdong du kha phru gdab// phrag pa gnyis nas mnan zhing rgyal bskyod gzab//sman tsub thun ches rlung ma non pa dang // nad las byung dang sman sun yi ga bsnar// smra 'gul gdon dgu skyug pa'i rgyu yin pas// sman tsub dus su brkos shing gdul legs gces/ thun ches thubs su bcad la zhu rjes mnan//rlung ma non la sngon 'gro 'thems pa gces smo nad las byung la chu ma rtsi mchog yin// sman sun yi ga bsdar la gsangs te btang / mi smra mi 'gul tsog pur 'dug pa dang // gdon las byung la 'drul bsrung bskud las bya/ bshal stor ba la sman stor nad stor gnyis// sman gtor zug med skyar la btang bar khya// nad gtor na 'gyu byed na myur bag btang // 'gyings pa pho bar rdzing la hrem pa ste/ pho bar dugs bya bcag cing ni rus bsu// g.ya' kyi ma dang sngon bu cha mnyam ste/ zhib par btags la bskol khu phul gang btang //bshal skyug gnyis 'byung pho bar nad mi lus// 'byams la tsha 'byams grang 'byams rnam pa gnyis// sman ro lus dang nad kha bye ba bzhi// tsha 'byams

sa ’ ma 'a zin las kyi da/ 645dmar ser dri che rtsa chu tsha/ byin nya chus bsgrangs ri skon skar chus bcad/grang 'byams dri med chur 'khru tsho khu 'am zhun mar da trig shing tsha btab pas gcod/ sman ro lus la rgyam tsha'i chu bskol btang / nad kha bye na mi bcad lus zungs gso/ mkhris pa'i rtsa kha bye na myur du bcad smo ind+ra bzhi thang dom mkhris btab pas gcod/ thun mong spyi ru 'bras kyi thug pa 'am/nas thug sha gsar tsho khu gang rung la/ sbyin dang da trig ka ped pon cha ra/mag dang tha ram btab la rtse gur btang / kha skom mi btang de yis chod par nges/ srog gi bya ra'i gnad ni rnam lnga ste/ thor bu'i rlung skyes sna ma non pa dang / sman dang nad du ma 'phrod gzer ba dang / sgyug pa mnan pas glo rtsar shor ba dang / srin khros glang thabs nad du song ba yi/ nad la srog gnas bton na 'chi ba 'o/ khrus bzhin mi bde stong sgyugs byed pa dang kushed chung shes pa zi la nyog nyog byed/ thor bu'i rlung yin sur bdug bsku mnye bya/ dus thang me btsas sna bslan sbyongs 'phro bcad/ rung dang mi rung dus tshon ma zin na/ nad dang dpyad du 'dzol bas gzer zug 'byung / tsha grang brtags la gnyen po bsil drod bsten tshad gzer ma nu ru rta'i grang thang btang // bsil gyi dugs dang phyi ma gang shis dpyad grang gzer cha mnyam thang btang drod dugs bya/ bshal sman glor shor glo mang ro stod gzer gro pags gtar ga phye ma skems sman sbyar/ srin khros pho log byung na gnyen pos bsad/ zungs ngan nad ma thon yang gcod pa gces// ci phyir nad thon zungs zad srog 'phrog byed/ phyi rjes bcad pa sbyong ba tshar chod nas/ 'bras sam bye thug g.yo su ma byas pa'i tsha rdor bag shas yod pa kyang kyang pos/ khams gso sman ro 'don zhing nad lhag 'den/ de rjes sla dang bar sa ska ba dang / tsho khu zan dron rim pas cha yis bskyed/ khyad par tsha rjes grang rjes rnam pa gnyis tsha ba'i rjes la gsar dang rnying pa gnyis

646 sa /grwa thang da ba'i/rims 'khrugs tsha ba gsar pa'i bshal rjes rnams// chu grog nas thug zho phrul bsil gyis bcad/ tsha ba rnyings pa rnams la bsil sha gsar/ tshil med tsho khu ja dang bskol grangs chu zhi phrul la sogs bsil bcud zas kyis bcad//grang rjes lug sha gsar rnying tsho khu dang // chang 'jam zhun mar zan dron drod kyis bcad// cha dang bags kyi rim pas bskyed la btang 5 tsha rjes drod kyis bcad na me ro 'phel// grang rjes bsil gyis bcad dam bza' ba drags//pho ba'i me 'chi ma zhu dmu skran skyed sbyongs nyes skyon la drag zhan rnam pa gnyis// spyongs drags zungs zad rlung skye me drod 'chi// de la zas sman drod bcud me yis gso// sbyongs zhan nad de bslang nas ma dag pas// dang ga 'gags la zas skom 'jur mi 'dod// nad kyi stobs skyed bad mkhris 'phel bar 'gyur// bkres skom rgyam tsha se 'brus me gsos la// zungs bzang sngon 'gro byas la sbyang ba bskyar// zungs ngan ni ru ha dang 'jam rtsi spel// sbyong legs nad kyi rtsad chod bad mkhris dag / lus yang khong pa'i drod 'bar yi ga 'byed/ bkres skom dus 'byung bshang gci bde bar 'byin/ zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las las lnga bshal gyi le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //

647le'u bco lja pa/ las lnga skyugs kyi skor/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / las lnga skyugs la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi dang tuphyi rjes bcad dang phan yon bstan pa 'o// sngon 'gro nad gzhi rung dang mi rung brtag / sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro nye ring rnam gnyis bya mi rung zungs zad rlung che chu rgyu 'gags// mig 'grib srin nad gzhang 'brum sha dug rgyas/gis ches gzhon ches gdon can rnams pa spang / rung ba ma zhu nyen skran lcags dreg chags// dug dang glang thabs khrag mkhris pho bar lhung / mgo nad dang ga 'gags dang srin bu ldog / khyad par bad kun nad kun skyugs kyis sbyang // sbyor pa'i sngon 'gro nye ring bshal dang mthun/ phral du ma zhu mi 'phrod zos pa dang sgo bad mkhris rgyas dang ma zhu'i gnas su 'dus// rgyun du lto snum sngon 'gro bya mi dgos/ dngos gzhi sman sbyor btang thabs lcag dang tshad// log pa mnan dang rnam pa lnga ru bshad// dang po sman spyor gtso bo kha 'dzin gnyis// gtso bo ri sho spyang tsher dur byin gsum/ bye ma la skyes kha 'bus sos dus brkos// shu dag rgyam tsha pi pi ling dang sbyar// 'jam po khu ba drag po ril bu dril// kha 'dzin ma zhu ba la bca' sga sdeb rlung ldan so cha mkhris ldan gser phud bu/ skran la dbyi mong dug la bong nga dkar/ 'bri ta sa 'dzin byang khog rnag khrag 'dren// glo yi nad la shing mngar sdeb par bya//btang tshul nam langs dus btang kha bshal la// mi smra mi grangs tsog pur 'dug par bya// skyug na lan 'ga' zlog pas nad la brko/ bskos drags thur du 'chug pas slong dus skyug / de nas mgo dpyangs pus mo pho gsang

648 sto/grwa nga da bzhi/gtem// sla ngar bzed la nad kyi kha dog blta/ lcag tu spyang tsher ri sho dur byid bsdus/ rgyam tsha shu dag pi pi ling dang sbyar/ chu bskol ngad yal tsam dang spel gyin btang / sgro 'am sor mos gre ba ma gnad drangs/ skyug pa drag zhan lcag la rag lus pas/ lus zungs nad stobs sbyar la thon tshad gdon//gdon tshad skyug pa'i nad la bzhi drug brgyad/ bungs tshad bre phyed gang dang do yin te/ kha dog bad kun mkhris pa chu dang gsum// rim pas tha ma 'bring rab tshad du bshad/ log gnon thor bu'i rlung dang mkhris kha shor/ sprug po'i mtsho dang glo yi rtsa kha rdol// sman gyi dngas ma mig la bros pa'o// mgo na stong skyugs byed cing shes pa nyog / bsku mnye bsur dud sre long thang gis bzlog / mkhris pa kha shor thang btang bsha' ring gtar// mtsho brdol ba la dugs dang phye mas bcad// glo rtsa 'grams na sman gyis rtsa kha bsdam mgo na mig dmar gtar dang chu lcag bya// bcad ran rjes kyi cho ga bshal dang mthun/ zas dang spyod lam de bas lhod pas chog / gu gul gla sgang mar gsar du bas bdug / sman ro sbyong phyir rgyam tsha'i chu skol btung // skyugs legs dbang gsal lus yang dang ga bde// kha dri zhim zhing mchil snabs lud pa dag / ces gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las las lnga skyugs kyi le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// //

649le'u bcu drug pa/ las lnga sna sman gyi skor/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / las lnga'i sna sman zhi dang sbyang ba gnyis/ zhi byed mi rung phan yon btang thabs gsum// sna sman mi rung rims gsar 'phral du rmas// ra ro snum 'thungs rnams la spang bar bya// phan yon sna nyid glad pa'i sgo yin phyir/ mgo dang nam tshong yan chad nad la mchog / khyad par gur gum zhun mar ka ra sbyar/ mgo rlung khrag 'thab gzer nad 'khyug pa 'joms// shing mngar skyu ru ka ra zhun mar sbyar/ rna ba mig dang za 'gram glad nad sel/ la phug khu bas rna ba mgo nad sel// rta sbangs sna khrag glad khrag so srin sel// zhun mar nam tshong yan chad rlung nad 'joms btang thabs snga dro gongs dus gan rkyal nyal// sngas smad mgo dpyangs thigs pa lnga bdun blug / dar cig nyal rjes dud pa bser bu spang / sna sbyongs spang dang phan yon sbyor ba dang // btang ba'i tshul dang log gnon lnga yis bstan/ mi rung rlung gis mgo 'khor rab rib dang // rdzi 'khor so nad rnag khrag 'dzag la spang / phan yon cham rgan mtshul par zhen pa dang // tshad pa gag lhog rdzong la bros pa dang / mig dmar mdze nad chu ser gdong la lud// mgo chag rtsa byer chu ser lhung ba sel// sbyor ba 'gron bu bong nga dkar po dang // sug pa sga skya bzhi po bsregs thal dang // byang pa rgya tsha dri chur sbyar bar bya/ yang na 'bri ta sa 'dzin rgya tsha dang // shu dag ru rta shing mngar ba chu sbyar// btang thabs snga dro snabs sbyangs gan rkyal nyal// 'phul byed sngas la mgo dpyangs thigs dgu blug / rkan nas byung na 'gag ces byas la bzlog / bya rdzogs

650 /grwa nga da ba /skad cig grangs brgya'i bar du nyal// thebs dka' du ba sug phye sna nang bud//tshag ya' snabs mang byung na langs la phyi// de rjes chu ser rnag sogs gang yod dbyung // gre ba mtshul pa dag phyir chu bskol btung // spos dkar mar gsar bsregs pa'i du bas bdug / log gnon khrag shor mgo stod chu yis bran// sman dang me btsa' gtar sogs rigs pas dpyad/ ma thebs mig dmar mgo dang dpral ba gzer// sna rtsa dpral rtsa gtar rjes chu lcag bya//zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las las lnga sna sman gyi le'u ste bcu drug pa'o/ //

651le'u bcu bdun pa/ las lja 'jam rtsi'i skor/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / las lnga 'jam rtsi rung dang mi rung dang //sbyor ba btang thabs phan yon nyes dmigs so// rung ba rlung skran lto sbos tsam pa 'khru// khu ba zad dang zla tshan 'byams pa dang / rgyu long mkhal rked grang ba rgyas pa dang // stobs chung smad srin rlung nad kun la btang // mi rung dmu 'or nad dang yi ga 'chus// dug nad mchin pa rgyu long snod tshan dang // tshil ches ma zhu bad tan rgyas la spang // sbyor ba sben 'byam bkru 'jam bkru ma slen// rlung rkyang mkhris pa bad kun ldan la sbyar// dang po lug sha 'bri yi 'o ma mar// ru rta de ba dā ru pi pi ling / rgyam tsha a ru ra sbyar slon 'jam yin// gnyis pa chur gnas sha khu ba 'o mar/ gong sman dur byid sbyar ba bkru 'jam mo// gsum pa skam sa'i sha khu ra 'o mar// gong sman so cha snar ba bkru ma slen// mar rab sha khu 'bring la 'o ma tha// sha grogs 'o ma 'o grogs mar nyid gces// kha 'dzin rlung la shing kun kha ru tsha// bad gan ldan la sga dang pi pi ling // mkhris par ldan la sle tres kyi lce ba// skran la rgya tsha srin la byi tang ga / pho long sbos la ru rta sdeb par bya// btang thabs khyor gang phul gang phul lu phyed// 'o drod tsam bsros drod pa gce 'u yis// sgongs dus bshang bsal lus kyis bcas byas la// grod pa'i dbugs bton ma gnad bcug la btang // gan rkyal nyal la rkub tsos rkang mthil brdung // rkang mtheb nas bzung gnam du bteg la bsig / sngas smad 'phongs gtod gan rkyal ma grangs gnyal// slen 'jam dbyung dus nyi nub srod dus yin/ de ma byung na

652 sa /grwa nga da ba /ni ru ha yis bsu/ rlung shas me drod che la bskud la btang / de ma yin na lcag lan btang bar bya/ phan yon rlung gnon bad mkhris nad zhen slong /btang drags yi ga 'gag cing me drod 'chi ni ru ha spel gnod med nad kun 'dren/ de phyir zungs ngan nad rnying gso dka' la// gcig dang gnyis spel lan mang btang bas chog / ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las las lnga 'jam rtsi'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //

653le'u bco brgyad pa/ las lnga ni ru ha'i skor/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / las lnga ni ru ha la spang yul dang / phan yon sbyor ba ji ltar btang tshul lo/ spang yul gzhang lug 'khru ba 'byams pa dang ltatshad gsar me nyams sa bon 'dzag la spang / phan yon spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyis// dang po smad du mtshon phog rtug skams dang // glang thabs smad tshad dri chu bsdam pa dang / lto sbos srin nad skran gsar rims rnying dang / khyad par nad stobs che la rnon po bsngags/ gcin snyi tshan pas 'khru dang gso dka'i rims// dreg 'or khu ba zad pa 'jam pos sel/ sbyor ba bar ma rno 'jam rnam pa gsum// bar ma dur byid sug pa bul tog phabs// byang pa dud pa ba chu bsings snyigs sbyar// mtshon phog mkhris pa glang thabs dbyi mong dkar// smad tshad lham rtsa lto sbos mug chos sdeb/ srin la sgog skya grang la pi pi ling / nad steng kha bsgyur rnon po re lcag bsnan/ 'jam po a ru ra dang seng phrom btsod kyi lce dur byin lham rtsa ba 'o chu/ btang thabs bre phyed phul bzhi phu lu do/ 'o drod tsam bsros 'bru mar cor cig blug / grod pa bkang la gce'u tshad ldan gzhug / sngas smad rgyar la seng bug snum byugs te/dbugs bton ma gnad dal bus sor bzhi gzhug / cung zad phyir bsnur grod pa btsir la btang // 'gror ma 'dod na g.yas g.yon steng thog gcu lhag ma cung zad rlung yod mi btang bzhag / gce'u bton la phongs su ras lto ba ga / gzhogs g.yon 'og bcug lan gnyis lan gsum bzlog / ma bzlogs mi thebs drags na la rgal 'gyur/ mi thub tsog pur 'dug la snod

654 zhu/grwa nga dba'i du btang // skyo 'dur gong bu col le byung na thebs// ma thebs chu ru log na skyar la btang // sman ro bda' phyir rgyam tsha'i chu bskol btung // 'ag gcig lto skyung smad nad kun 'dren ma chog / ces gsungs so//bdud rtse snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las la sa lnga ci ru ta'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// / /

655le'u bcu dgu pa/ spyongs log gnon rtsa sbongs/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / sbyongs kyi log gnon rtsa sbyongs bstan pa la/sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang phan yon no/ sngon 'gro nye dang ring ba rnam pa gnyis// ring ba nad gang yin pa'i gnyen po dang // 'bras gsum cha mnyam bsdus thang gongs dus btang / byis pa dge slong mkhal nad yod pa la// da byin brgyad sbyor phye mas rtsa lam sbyang / nye ba gza' skar tshes grangs bzang ba la// mkhan pa sbang ma chu 'jam bsros pa yis// lus kun dag par bkrus rjes rtsi mar dang // 'bru mar spang spos sbyar bas lus kun byug / khyad par spyi gtsug mtshan pags tshigs rnams mnye// g.yer ma nyi dga'i thang gis rtsa kha dbye// pho mo sprad dang ra yi wa gdong dang // nyi dga'i 'dab tshod tsha g.yer btab pa btang // dngos gzhi sna sel mdung sman byang pa dang / sbyar tshad sna khrid btang thabs thebs pa'i rtags// lcag dang log gnon rnam pa dgu yis bstan// sna sel sug smel sdig srin rtsa khu byug / nyi dga' tsha grang rtas bsgyur myur du 'bigs/ mdung sman rgya tsha li shi sdig srin mtshal/ lcam pa gong gi rta sbyar nad slong 'khrug / byang pa'i cho ga dang po bzang ngan brtag / dug dbyung 'jam btsal zug chung nad 'drongs che// bzang ba dmar khra kyi tsher srad gseb gnas// than che ston ser grir shi bzang ba yin// ngan pa ser khra yog mo lo gseb gnas// char che nam gzhug chad dus shi ba ngan dug ni bar gshog dkar po zug che dbyung / 'jam btsal ba ni sbur mgyogs grogs dang sdeb/ de ma 'dzom na cha ga'i mgo bo btang / yang na yos sam dri chur

656 gsu/grwa thang da ba'i/btul ba shis// byang pa mgo rkang chad na nad 'drongs chung // bzang zhing mgo rkang tshang na bcu gcig dang // ngan rnying mgo rkang med na bcu bdun btang / sbyar tshad byang pa rgya tsha sdig srin mtshal// gur gum ha thig dar mtshur rtsi bzhin btags// chang gi ril bu sran phos tsam du dril// yang na rgya ru bya ma byi rus dang // byi zung 'ol mo se dang rnon po gsum// sug spel mtshal gyi ril bus rtsa nad sbyong / sna khrid glo snying mchin mtsher mkhal ma dang //dug dang chu ser nad la sogs pa yis// gang shis sman dang sdebs pas nad thog 'khrid// yang na mdung ba'i sman dang sbyar la btang // btang thabs gongs mo nyi dga'i 'dab tshod btang // srod 'khor sna sel nam gung mdung sman btang // tho rangs dus na rtsa sbyongs ril bu dgu/ tsha grang sbyar ba'i rta yis 'phul la btang // nyi shar dus su phal cher thebs pa yin// de dus ma thebs ril bu bdun bsnan btang / nam thebs dus na ril bu lnga lnga yis//snga ma zhu zhing phyi ma bsten par bya// de ltar ril bu thubs su bcad btang bas/byang pa'i dug nad dus gcig mi 'byung ste/ nad pa zug chung 'gags pa'i dogs pa med// yang yang mnan pas mi thebs mi srid cing // 'drongs cher 'byung bas ma 'drongs bar du btang // de ltar mi shes ril bu dus gcig btang / byang pa'i dug langs chu ser dus gcig 'phul// chu 'gags zug che rang sdug 'chi yang srid/ thebs rtags lus sbrid nad gang yod sar na//rgyu zhabs tsha rum mtshan ma tsha zhing 'phreng / chu ngan thigs pa thon dka' yang yang 'byung / lcag tu de dus sings po gsar gleg gis/ yang yang bskul bas rtsa lam chu lam 'dag / tsha ba shas che ja 'am chur khu btang // nad zhen che na skabs su mdung sman spel// gang nar lde'u chang bran bsros pas bdug /sang seng rkang pa mi rkyang drod la bsgor/ de ltar lus ma grangs par dugs bsten bya// rtsa khrus mi chad nad 'dag the tshom med/ lus grangs chu ser

sa khyi rmi 'a zin las kyi da/ 657'gyings na nad mi thon/ zug che lcag ma brabs na nad mi 'byongs// de phyir lcag dang dro ba shin tu gces snod gcig mtshan ma'i 'og tu rgyun du bzed//skabs su sngas khar phru ba'i nang du bsag / ser po skug po rnag khrag sru sogs 'byung // nad 'drongs sman 'phro bcad la lcag 'ga' bdeg / log gnon drug ste rgal ba mnan pa dang // stor ba btsal dang 'gyings pa drang ba dang 0gzer ba bcag dang 'gags bsal 'byams pa gcod// ma thebs skyug na mnan thabs bshal dang 'dra// stor nas ci yang med na de rgyu gdon so rnyings gdul drags thun chungs sman rta log / gang yin de yi gnyen pos bstor ba btsal// 'gyings nas pho ba dzings na bsku mnye dugs/ chu bskol lo brgyad dri chu thengs 'ga' btung // rgyu zhabs mtshan ma zug che dugs kyis bsro// des ma chogs na chu ser 'gyings pa yin/ rgya tsha sdig srin drod sman chang sbyar btang // yang na dwa tsha mar gsar ril bu mid/ des ma chogs na byang pa tsub pa yin cha ga'i mgo bo gsum dang thar mgyogs dang smo bong nga dkar po chang dang sbyar la btang / ma chogs rlung yin dus snying tsha ba btung ⑪de dag rnams kyis mi chogs ga la srid/ 'gags na sa bon 'khar dang spu 'bums 'ches/ khrag sha de'u sa 'gags mtshan ma mnye zhing bzho ma phan rgya tsha ru rta shu dag dang // pho ba ris khu gce 'us sgang par skyal 'byams pa lus stobs bzang na mi bcad bzhag / bcad dgos chos khur dom mkhris btab la btang / ma chod dri chu rang log dom mkhris bcad/ rjes gcod grang ba shas che gsar 'jam dang // lug sha'i tsho khu zan dron rim bskyed btang / tsha ba shas che skom sha'i tsho khu dang / bskol grangs chu dang chab tsha zan dron btang // ma grangs bcad cing zla phyed zas spyod gzab/ phan yon sman dang nad du shes par bya/ dang po byang pas rtsa yi chu ser 'dren// rgya tsha sdig srin rtsa lam 'byed par byed/ gur gum rtsa mnyen mtshal gyis dngas

658 ༄ /grwa thang da bzhi/snyigs 'byed// dar mtshur nad sdud ha shig gting du 'khrid// nad ni bu rtsi btang dang skye phro chad// bu ro lus dang mngal skran khrag tshabs byer// khrag mkhris dug sogs tsha ba rnying pa dang // dreg dang grum bu 'bras dang za 'phrug dang / mgo chag rtsar byer rma rgan 'tshor mi 'dod// sur ya dmu chu rtsa skran chu ser rgyas// da rgan mdze nad rtsa 'grams thams cad sbyong // sa bon blugs pa ma yin kun la bsngags/ khyad par rtsar babs nad kyi gnyen po'i mchog /ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba men ngag gi rgyud las sbyongs kyi log gnon rtsa sbyongs kyi le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// / /

659le'u nyi shu pa/ dpyad lnga gtar gde nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dpyad lnga'i mchog gyur gtar ga'i brdog thabs la// cha byad brtag pa thabs dang skyon yon lnga// dang po cha byad rno mnyen ldan pa'i lcags// mgar ba mkhas pas sbu gu'i sgro 'dra'i dbyibs//rtse rgur tshes gnyis zla ba lta bu 'am// ltag nyal so drang brang ba can dang ni//sta ri'i kha 'dra kun kyang srid sor drug / thar 'byongs ngar ldan brdungs thems bdar legs pa// rno tshad gyen du spu shog nus pa ste// gze dang mi gze de la rag las pas// btsags legs rtag tu lus la bcang bar bya// brtag pa rung dang mi rung nad gzhi brtag / ran dang mi ran dus tshod brtag pa'o//gtar du rung ba'i nad gzhi 'grams 'khrugs rims// skrangs pa rma dang dreg nad sur ya dang // me dbal chu ser mdze nad la sogs pa'i// tsha ba khrag mkhris las gyur gtar ba'i nad// mi rung gdon can zungs zad sbrum ma dang // btsas rjes skya rbab gcong chen me drod nyams// mdor na bad rlung las gyur nad la spang // 'on kyang khrag ma phyed dang rims ma smin// stongs tshad dug ma gsod dang gnyan tshad dang // zungs zad tsha ba yin yang gtar mi rung // bad rlung nad kyang khrag mkhris sdongs na gtar// dog dang rtsa mdud bla gnas sar mi gtar// dus tshod thog ma bar dang tha ma gsum//byang khog khrag babs don la zin pa dang // khrag ma chod dang rgyas 'khrugs smin long med// dus la mi bsdad brtson pas thog mar gtar/ bar du

660 sa /grwa thang dab /gtar dus gzer dus grang shum chad/ rtsa rgyud lci sbrid rgyas pa'i dus na gtar// khrag phyed ri mo med na dus la phebs// de ltar min na thang gis phye la gtar// khrag mkhris ngan khrag rtsa mig byer ba dang // zas kyis tsha ro bskyed la tha mar gtar/ gtar ba sngas na rlung skye cha ba 'byer// phyis na ngan khrag rtsar 'grams ro mi thon// tsha stobs che na rtsa don rnag tu 'drul// gtar thabs sngon 'gro dngos gzhi phyi rjes gsum/ gtar ba'i sngon 'gro ring dang nye ba gnyis// ring ba ma smin smin par bya ba dang / nad khrag zungs khrag thang gos dbye bar bya/ thang ma btang bar gtar na zungs khrag 'chor// nad khrag mi thon rlung skye tshad ro ldas// nye ba'i sngon 'gro me nyis dros par sro/'drul bsrung gnyal sogs yab cha sta gon bya// dngos gzhi gnyal thabs gdab thabs gdab dmigs dang / khrag spra dbyung tshad log gnon bstan pa'o// gnyal thabs dpral rtsa ltag rtsa 'tshogs gsang rnams// smin steng thig gas bskor la shing bus gcu/ rtse chung gnyis la mchan khung ga shar bsdams/thong rtsa thi gas sko bskor rgyab nas 'then// rtse rtsa pag skam dar dril bar du btem// dpung rtsa lug gzhug 'og tu thi gus bsdam/ a so drug mgo sgang rtsa ru thung dang // gsha' ring la sogs dri khung sor gsum gong // kyor gong phran bu rgyab rtsa drug 'dus sogs// spran rtse'i bar rtsa 'khrig ma'i gong du bsdam/rtsa bo che la dpus nang mdzub gang sar/ sgab rtsa rta 'thur byin gzhug lham sgrog steng // long rtsa gdong rtsa yob gong byin skyog dang // rgyu rtsa la sogs long bu'i steng du bsdam/ sgrubs kyi rtsa rnams rtsa rgyud shing bus gcu gang yang gnyal stan steng du gnyal thag gis// pags pa ma 'chus rtsal mnyam 'then la bsdam/ sbrid chil rtsa rgyud ltang gis byung na sdoms/ ma sdoms mi thebs 'chus na khrag mi thon gnyal rjes rtsa rnams lag pas mnye zhing bsrub sha sbyin rtsa rnams rgyas pas thebs pa bla/ gnyal ma thog tu mi gtar thebs pa

sa khye ma 'azin las kyi da/ 661dka'// gdab thabs rtsa ma 'chus par mthe bos mnan// cung zad thur du then pas rtsa mi 'gyur// phal cher gnyal 'og sor gsum 'og tu gtar/ glo phug sgang gshags dol chod nyis len dang / lhag kha la sogs gang bde gang goms gdab/ de yang rtsa chen rnams la sgang gshags bya// rtsa phran pag kha shin tu phra ba bcad/ gnad steng rtsa la nyis len bsngags pa yin khrag pas rlangs phan rma kha che bar bya// rma chungs skrangs dang khrag gi rlangs mi thon/ rtsa kha pags kha mnyam na legs pa yin/ rus steng rtsa la sta ri so yis gtar/rtsa steng mi 'gyur 'phred btsugs bem brdol bdeg / ltag rtsa sdud sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyen sor gsum rtsa steng thig gdab gtar rjes me yis bsrung ku'atshogs gsang sku mtshams sor bzhi gyen du gshag / mur gong 'phar rtsa skra yi gseb tu gtar/ rtse chung mas kyi sor bzhi bcal bar gtar/ ru thung gzhu mchog sna nas sor bzhir gtar/ byin gzhug rting pa'i gyen mdzub gang du gtar/ gtar ma thog tu mi glod khrag mi thon/ mgo ske long rtsa gsum la glod mi bya// gzhan dag khrag chad dus na cha yis glod/ gdab dmigs gnya' rengs 'gyur dka' ltag rtsa gtar/ bad mkhris mgo nad chang 'thung dros tshe na/ dpral gzer 'tshogs kha lci zhing mig mi theg / 'tshogs gsang dbye zhing gser mdung dngul mdung gtar/ mig dmar ling thog mod la mig rtsa gtar/ sna nad sna rtse rna ba rna rtsa gtar snying tshad skom dad smra dka' lce rtsa gtar/ so mig sna 'grams nad la ltag ral gtar/ so nad so rtsa rtse chung dpung rtsa gtar/ glo lu snying tshad myos shing dbugs mi bde skad 'gags yol gong bar gyi thong rtsa gtar/ glad srin byang khog khrag babs don la zin/rgyas 'tshogs glo 'grams so la khrag tshad rgyas spangs long 'bras nad kun la rtse chung gtar/ stod gzer glo tshad mgo na dpung rtsa gtar glo tshad stod rtsi dbugs thung gzer che la/ drug mgo sgang rtsa gnyis la gtar bar bya/ glo

662 zhu/grwa nga da ba snying mchin dri brang rgyab sprags shing na// don snod thun mong nad la snod ka gtar// glo snying khrag rgyas glo snying 'dom rtsa gtar// mig ser lus lci dang ga 'gags pa la// mkhris rtsa gsha' ring phran bu gnyis la gtar// mchin mcher mchin dri 'grams 'khrugs gzer ba dang / sprug po tsha ba'i skran la ru thung gtar// skad 'gags gcong thabs lu la sgang rtsa gtar// ro stod pho mchin mchin dri 'khor zhing na// mchan 'og gzer la glo mchin 'dom rtsa gtar// khrag mkhris nad la mchin mkhris 'dom rtsa gtar// pho mchin khrag nad rgyab rtsa drug 'dus gtar// rgyu long mtshon phog 'grams dang rlig pa skrangs// smad lci gzhang 'brum mngal nad rtsa chen gtar// gzhung rengs ltas dgye dbyi skad 'khor ba dang // mngal khrag 'dzag la gyid khung sgab rtsa gtar//mcher pa gnad 'grams shu ba za kong dang // mkhris nad chu ser 'or la rta 'thur gtar// mkhal 'grams mtshon phog rked pa smad mi theg / rkang bshal byin pa 'gas snyam dpyi mig gzer sur ya mngal khrag 'byams la byin gzhug gtar// smad du mtshon phog glang thabs mngal khrag 'dzag / dri chu 'gag la long rtsa gtar bar bya// rgyu mar khrag rgyas mgo skyon snying la babs//snying nad cis kyang ma phan rgyu rtsa gtar// rkang pa'i mthil dang bol skrangs tsha 'brab byed// chu ser nad la gdong rtsa yob gong gtar// mdor na stod nad rtse chung sgang rtsa gtar/ smad kyi nad la long rtsa byin gzhug gtar bar gyi nad la snod ka ru thung gtar// ro stod nad la sgang rtsa drug mgo gtar// nu 'jing brang nad snod ga ru thung gtar// snying tshad snod ka lce rtsa thong rtsa gtar//glo tshad drug mgo sgang rtsa spyor gong gtar// glo snying gnyis 'doms rtse chung 'doms rtsa gtar// mchin pa'i tsha ba ru thung sgang rtsa gtar/ mcher tshad rta /spyi/ tshad sna/ / sdo nga phra/ ta/ ga//so/ dro/ nga ga dri rwa sgo la kā sdo byin //// /

sa khyi ma 'azin las kyi da/ 663pho mtshan 'gram rtsa gtar// rgyu long long rtsa dku 'grams byin skyog gtar/sha yi tshad pa glo mchin rtsa la gtar// rus pa'i tsha ba mkhal ma'i rtsa la gtar//pags tshad chu ser mchin mkhris rtsa la gtar// zug che glo rtsa bying 'jibs ru thung gtar// dang ga 'gags na bad mkhris rtsa la gtar/ 'on kyang gang nye gang rgyas gtar ba shis tsha ba stobs ldan rtse chung yas babs gtar/stobs chung nad la rtsa phran mas 'jog gtar// tshabs che'i nad la rtsa phran mang gtar bas// rtse chung la sogs rtsa chen gtar ba bsngags/ de ltar ma yin gtar dmigs ma shes pas// smad khrag stod du drangs bas lus zungs 'chor// stod khrag smad du drangs na me drod 'chi// khrag pra shugs drag sla la ser dugs sbo// bya wang rgyab 'dra sbya ba dkar ba dang // be snabs rnag mkhris chags na nad khrag ste/ zug chogs skyed che nad 'byang bla ba yin// dmar nag ri mo byung na thang rjes gtar// rnag mkhris chags na lus zungs gso zhing gtar// dmar la ska na phan med gtar skyed sbyar// rlung khrag nag cing rtsub la sku ba dmar mkhris pa'i khrag ni ser sla rnag dri mnam bad kun khrag ni dmar skya ska la 'jam/ mtshal khu tshos khu 'dra ba zungs khrag yin// de rnams cung zad tsam yang gtar mi rung / dbyung tshad nad thon zungs khrag byung na bcad// zungs ngan khrag zhabs med kyang ran tshod bzung // don gzer zug gcog khrag gzer dbyung ba dang / 'ol ka bsgyur gsum bzang khrag yin yang gdon// zungs zad rlung ldan ngan khrag yin yang bzhag /rgyas 'khrugs gzer dang byang khog khrag rgyas dang / yan lag skrangs shor bungs skyed khrag shed smad/ de ma yin la mang gtar nyung du dbyung / sbru ba khrag dmar rgyus g.yogs gtar 'phro bcad// zungs ngan gtar tshad rnag tu 'ong ba 'am/ gtar khrag chu dang 'dra na gtar tshod bzung / rnag la bltas nas mang du gtar ba yis// zungs 'dzad gso dka' dmu chur 'gyur ba

664 sa /grwa nga da ba /yod// log gnon khrag ma thon dang ngan khrag med// khrag ma chod dang skrangs 'thog rlung skyes drug / dang po lus grang mtshon rtul 'grangs drags brid//gdon dang 'grul sna kha chungs pags pa 'chus// gnyal ma thog gtar gtar ma thog tu glod/ de dag khrag mi 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pas// rgyu bcu spangs na gtar ga jugs dogs med// rtsa chen gtar yang ngan khrag med pa na/ rjes de bor la rtsa gzhan g.yar byas te// nang par gtar bas nad khrag 'byung ba yin// tsha ba lam chad rtsa stongs khrag med na// khong khrag spyir la 'phul ba'i man ngag gces// khrag ma chod na rtsa rgyud chu yis bsgrang // phying pa chur bcug glan la dkris mas bsdam// skrangs na tsha mar khyi gzhib byugs la mnye des ma thub na a sa ba yis bdug / khrag gis bog na bsur bdug kha phru gdab//tshabs che ba la gson khrag sobs su bslud// gtar rjes rlung skyes bsku mnye bu ram mur/ bur chang rus thang 'tsho khus rlung sna slan/ phyi rjes gnyal dkrol rma kha mtheb mos mnye rdo grang glan zhing bal dkri 'gro 'gul gzab/khrag ngan skye bas chang bsings mi btang bsrung ta gtar skyon dman lhag log dang nyes pa bzhi/ gtar zhan khrag ro mi thon nad gzhug lus/ mchin skran skug po mdze 'bras sur ya skyed// byang khog yan lag chu ser rnag tu 'gyur/gtar drags zungs 'dzad rlung skye me drod 'chi/ grang skran skya thab dmu chur 'gyur ba mang / log pa mi rung nad la gtar ba 'am/ nyes pas sha gdan gnad dam chu rgyus bcad/ gnad la song ngam 'phar rtsa bcad pa yis//sman pa'i lag dgras bya nyes bsad pa yod// de phyir skyon la mkhas pas gzab par rigs/ gtar legs yon tan rtsa nad ngan khrag spyong // gzer ba zug gcog skrangs pa rgyu nas 'joms/ 'drul ba rtas byed rnag chu rtsad nas gcod// rma yi mdog 'byin khol bu'i nad rlangs 'don// sbom po 'bri la skem po sha rgyas byed// nad dngos phyir 'byin dpyad mchog gtar gar
kho ’ ma 'azin las kyi da/ 665bshad// ces gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dpyad lnga gtar ga'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// / /

666le'u nyer gcig pa/ dpyad lja me btsa'/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dpyad lnga'i me btsa' spra ba rung mi rung // me dmigs gdab thabs phyi rjes phan yon bdun// spra ba ston zla gsum gyi dus bzang btu// ma chad shig med brdungs la mkhregs par dril// rtsa ba brtan skum rtse rno me len myur// tshigs pa'i mkhar la mdzub mo'i rtse mo tsam// mgo dang yan lag mdun la mtheb chung tsam// rtsa sgo 'gegs la leb mo ril ma tsam// 'bras dang skran la a ru ra tsam bya// byis pa'i snyen snar sran ma 'phos pa tsam// me btsa' gdab tu rung ba'i nad ga'i ni// ma zhu me nyams skya rbab dmu chu skran// grang mkhris mgo dang yan lag chu ser dang // 'bras dang lhog pa stongs pa'i tsha ba dang // spyo byed rjed byed rtsa nad thams cad dang // tsha rjes phal cher me yis bcad pa ste// mdor na bad rlung las gyur grang ba kun//rtsa nad chu ser me yis bsreg pa bsngags// mi rung mkhris tshad khrag nad thams cad dang // dbang po'i sgo dang pho mo'i srid rtsar spang // me dmigs nad kyis bstan dang sman pas btsal// nad kyis bstan pa na ba'i dmigs yod la// mnan na phan snyam phyed la mtheb rjes 'ong / rtsa 'khyug rtsa nad gar langs dmigs su gdab// sman pas btsal ba don snod gsang rnams te//yan stong tshigs pa dang po rlung gis gsang / smyo 'dar 'phyo lkugs nad la gdab par bya// gnyis pa mkhris gsang grang mkhris nad la gdab// gsum pa bad kun gsang ste grang rlung dang / glo snying mgo stod bad mkhris rgyas la gdab// bzhi pa glo ma lnga pa glo bu'i gsang // glo la rlung dang bad gan zhugs

zhu ma 'a zin las gyi da/ 667la gdab// drug pa srog rtsa bdun pa snying gi gsang // 'byo 'dar smyo 'bog bad rlung nad la gdab// brgyad pa mchin dri dgu pa mchin pa'i gsang //sgrog skyug mchin dri 'khor dang grangs tshe na/ mchin skran mchin par bad rlung zhugs la gdab// bcu pa mkhris gsang ma zhu mig ser dang / mkhris pa'i skran dang me drod nyams la gdab// bcu gcig mcher gsang sbo 'khrog 'ur la gdab// bcu gnyis pho ba'i gsang ste me drod nyams// nyen dang lcags dreg skran gyi nad la gdab// bcu gsum bsam se'i gsang ste khu khrag blugs//mngal skran sems 'phyo grang rlung rgyas la gdab// bcu bzhi mkhal gsang mkhal ma'i grang nad sel/ bco lnga don snod spyi gsang grang rlung sel// bcu drug long gsang 'ur 'khrog skran la gdab// bcu bdun rgyu ma'i gsang ste rgyu skran dang // grang rlung sbu ba be snabs 'tsho la gdab/ bco brgyad lhang pa'i gsang ste de'u nad dang // grang bas chu kha sra rnyi'i nad la gdab bcu dgu khu ba'i gsang ste 'byams blugs sel// nyi shu thur sel rlung sgo'i gsang yin te// phyen mi thub dang 'gags pa'i nad la gdab// mdun gyi me dmigs sko stong ca ra khung // srog rtsa snying dang 'dom pa'i gsang yin te// snying 'chus skyigs dang gre ba 'gags la gdab/ nu ma'i dkyil thad brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams// 'phyo 'dar snying mi dga' la gdab par bya// nyen sna'i rtse nas mtshon gang nyen gyi gsang / de 'og mtshon gang kha gsum skran gyi gsang sgode 'og mtshon gang kha gsum me mnyam gsang // nyen skran me nyams grang rlung rgyas la gdab/ lte ba'i g.yas g.yon mtshon re long gi ther/ de nas g.yas g.yon mtshon re long phugs gsang // long skran sbo 'khrog 'tsho ba 'byams la gdab// lte 'og mtshon gang kha gsum rgyu stod gsang / de 'og mtshon gang kha gsum rgyu smad gsang ba rgyu mar grang rlung zhugs dang 'khru la gdab// de 'og mtshon gang kha gsum sgang pa'i gsang / grang bas chu kha sra rnyi sel bar byed

668 sa /grwa nga da bzhi/mgo dang yan lag mdzub tshugs gsang dmigs ni// sdud sgo spyi gtsug 'tshogs ma'i 'dus so gsum/ rlung gis mgo 'khor 'gyel bug nad la gdab// spyo lab 'bog na ltag pa'i sru 'khyil bsreg / rlung rims smra mi shes la ma mchu'i thog / thog nad smra mi shes la phyi long steng // gyen sor bzhi yi chu ba'i bar du gdab rims nad ngu lab 'dre mthong lag pa yi// 'khrig ma'i sor bzhi chu ba'i bar du gdab/ pho mtshan mi ldang sa bon lug pa la// nang long thad drang gdong gi chu bar bsreg / rkang bshal 'gro ba dka' na lag pa yi/ gung mos gar sleb brla yi phyi bsul bsreg / bud med bu btsas skrangs la ol 'dzum bsreg / ltag pa rengs sam rlig pa skrangs pa dang // spyo skugs rkang pa'i mthe bong sru skyes bsreg / mig tshag 'bog la rting pa'i dreg mtshams bsreg / rgyu long pho glang nang long 'phar rtsa bsreg / dngangs dang skyigs bu skyug la ske stong bsreg / mchu nad srin lag g.yas g.yon tshigs mgo bsreg /so nad rna drung srin lag rtse mo bsreg / sna khrag ma chod dbugs kyis gar sleb pa'i// dpung pa g.yas g.yon mgo la me btsa' gdab gdab thabs btso bsreg bsro dang sdig pa bzhi/ 'bras dang skran la nyi shu yan chad btso/ bad kun chu ser snying rlung bco lngas bsreg / rlung srin rtsa chu spra ba lnga bdun bsro/byis pa'i me btsa' spra tshugs re yis bsdig / bu btsas bshal rjes rtsa chad 'thun pa gsum/ ha cang bsregs pa drags na nyes pa che spra ba bzhag la me sbar skyabs 'gro bya// me phebs thal ba mi 'gul thun kyis gdab du ba chad nas spra lhag khab mgos bseng / sum gnyis mched nas spra ba gcig la sbar//tsha ba rgyun ma chad na tshos pa skyen/ bsreg legs khod snyoms ya yo med pa dang / chu bur phra mos mtha' bskor na tsha med/ tshos tshad mdun btab rgyab tu ker rtse na// rgyab btab mdun du na zhing skyug snyam byed// tshos pa yin pas spra ba bsreg 'phro bcad tog thon spra ba yar na phan cher 'dod/ phyi rjes me

sa khye ma 'a zin las kyi da/ 669shi spra grangs mtheb rgyas gdab/ gom pa 'ga' bcags de nub chu mi btung /bcags pas lus rtas chu 'thungs me dbal gsod snod la zas zos rjes la me mi gdab// phan yon tsa yi 'bros 'phrang 'gegs par byed/ a na'i zug gcog nga nad kha yan gnon ma zhu 'ju zhing nyen skran bshig par byed 'bras dang rma gan sha ro ngan pa gcod/ skrangs pa'i mgo gnon chu ser 'dren skem sdom/ don snod sgo bsrung drod skyed dran pa gsal/ gso dpyad gzhan rdugs phal cher me yis gso// zhes gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dpyad lnga me btsa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o/ //

670le'u nyer gnyis pa/ dpyad lnga dugs/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dpyad lnga dugs la rung dang mi rung dang //bya ba'i thabs dang phan yon rnam pa bzhi/ dang po bad rlung ma zhu glang thabs dang / chu ser khrag 'khyags tshad pa'i gzer la bsten// mi rung skya rbab kṣa ya nag po dang / bal nad mdze dug dmu chu nag po dang / tsho ches 'brum thor zos rjes spang bar bya// bya ba'i thabs la bsil dugs drod dugs gnyis//bsil dugs 'grams 'khrugs tsha bas gzer ba la// skar chus bdeg gam grod par blug pas bdug / rims 'khrugs tsha ba byer rnyings skar chus bran//mig la mtshon phog btsan spangs chu drod bdug / sha dug gre ba 'gags shing tsha ba la/ bong nga dkar po gangs chu drod bkang bdug / rgyu gzer bong nga zhu mkhan chu sbyar bdug / khrag mkhris tsha glang chu rdo grang mos bdug / tshad gzer chu rdo byang ma'i lcags kyis bdug / yang na tshan dang zho sbyar grang mos bdug / sna khrag skar chu 'dag pa nag pos bdug / so yi khrag tshad rlung spangs 'dag pas bdug / dreg nad tsha 'brab sle tres ba rtsis bdug / drod dug ma zhu glang thabs tsha bsros bdug / mtshon khrag 'khyags la chu rdo bsros pas bdug / mchin khrag 'khyags la grog zhing yos kyis bdug / mkhal ma grang gzer chu sri sbang skam bdug / bu btsas rgyu 'bas tshang ra mkhal rten gzer// byi sa shar bltas chang bran bsros pas bdug / smug po 'thab pa'i glang thabs a 'o dang // chu lo zhu mkhan chur sbangs btsos pas bdug / dug dang khrag gan pho bar lhung ba 'joms ma zhu grang skran phug ron brun bsros

༄gyi ma 'a zin las kyi da/ 671bdug / grang nad langs la so phag rdza bsros bdug / srin glang spru ma'i rtsa lo bsros pas bdug / gzhang srin phur mo rta sbangs bsros pas bdug / grang bas gzhang lug snum kong bsros pas bdug / rlung gzer phying pa snum ldan chu rdos bdug / mkhal rked grang la dbyi spyang spu dugs bston/ pho ba rgyu long grang la lag mthil bdug / tshigs sul chu ser shag ma chang bran bdug /yang na sbang skam grog zhing bsros pas bdug / grang bas chu 'gags 'ba' cha bya bras bdug / stongs tshad rlung gzer mkhar gong srin can dang / dus rnying chang gis bran la bsros pas bdug / yan lag chu ser lug ril chang bran bdug / nad zug phral gcog dpyad mchog dugs su bshad/ ces gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dpyad lnga dugs kyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ //

672le'u nyer gsum pa/ dpyad lnga lums/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang slong chen po nyon cig / dpyad lnga lums la rung dang mi rung dang |bya ba'i thabs dang phan yon rnam pa bzhi rung ba yan lag rengs 'khums zha ba dang // 'bras dang lhog pa rma rnying rma gsar skrangs/ tshabs dang rgur po sha rus chu ser g.yos// rlung nad ma lus kun la bsngags pa yin// mi rung rims 'khrugs tsha rgyas skya rbab dang / nyams chung dang ga 'gags la spang bar bshad// mig dang khur tshos dreg ba'i rlig pa dang // lto ba snying ga'i gnas su lums mi rung // bya ba'i thabs la chu lums bcing lums gnyis//chu lums spyi mthun las grub chu tshan zhugs// 'grams dug tshad rnying byer zhing zhen pa dang // 'bras dang rma rgan sur ya rtsa nad dang / rengs 'khums rgur po sha skams 'don par byed// de ma grub na bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga// rlangs lums chu tshan bcings pas gong bzhin 'grub// mi rus tsa ma rlangs lums chu tshan gyis// tsha rengs rlung ldan 'grams pa'i zug gzer 'joms// mkhan pa bul rtog phabs sbyar chu lums kyis/ rma gan spangs dang 'a rengs sel bar byed// bcing lums tsha sel grang sel rnam pa gnyis// tsha sel mgo chag rtsa byer 'bru sna'i lum// kyi lce mdzo lci zho sbyar tsha skrangs 'joms// rtsa byer me tog sna tshogs lums kyis gdul/ rtsa dkar gza' phog mkhal rtsa 'grams byer la//bdud rtsi lnga 'am gla ril chang btsos lums rtsa 'grams skrangs rengs mkhan pa sru ma mtshe// spang spos dri chur btsos pa'i lums kyis gdul/ tshad snyongs byer ba mtshan dang sro lo'i lums/ mdze dug ra ril gla rtsi dri chu'i lums//

sa khye ma 'a zin las kyi da/ 673dbyig gi dug la mchod rten na bza' dang / khru gang 'og sa dri chur btsos lums bya/ grang sel yan lag spangs pa rnag 'gugs na/ sbang skam byi brun 'tshos btsos lums su gzhug / mde 'byin ra ril byi brun dri chu'i lums ra dug spyang tsher ri sho spyang brun dang // sbang gar btsos pas chu lhog grang skrangs 'dul// yan lag chu ser skya bab sbos pa la rta rkyang bong bu'i glo dron lums su gzhug / then 'bras phug ron ril ma chang btsos lums 'bras 'dul mi yi rkang mgo nya yi sha / spru rtsa re cag chang btsos lums su gzhug / rdo skran 'dul la spyang tsher rtse tsha dang / mkhan pa lca 'brum byi brun sbang gar dang // sga spod sbyar te btsos pa'i lums su gzhug / rus trem tshabs nad mi rus ba sgru'i lums/ rlung 'phyos snyo 'bog tshabs rlung snying sna'i lums/rims gzhug rkang dang dus pa na ba la// khru gang 'og sa dri chur btsos pa'i lums// dus tshigs gzer na rus sna chang btsos lums/ rlung spangs 'ba' cha chang du btsos pa'i lums/ lums kyis tsha rlangs chu ser ba spur 'don/rlung 'dul skrangs 'joms skem po sha rgyas byed/ ces gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dpyad lnga lums kyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o/ //

674le'u nyer bzhi pa/ dpyad lnga byug pa/de nas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dpyad lnga byug pa rung dang mi rung dang // bya ba'i thabs dang phan yon rnam pa bzhi// rung ba lus lhub khrag dang khu ba zad/stobs chung rgas dang mya ngan sems las che// mig 'grib gnyid med rtsol bas dub pa dang // rlung nad kun la snum byug bsten par bya pags nad 'brum thor skrangs la lde gu byug / ma zhu brla rengs dbyig dug yi ga 'chus/ dpu rdzing bad kun nad la snum byug spang // bya thabs sdud sgo drug bdun mthil bzhi la/ mi zhun byugs mnye skams nas phye yis phyi// rnying rlung 'dre chags 'bras nad 'joms par byed/ bsku mnye kun la de ltar shes par gyis//'bru mar de bzhin gnyid med rlung rnams 'joms// blo rno dran gsal 'dod la zhun mar byug / smyo 'bog brgyal ba'i nad la lo mar byug / chu ser za 'phrug rta rkyang bong tshil byug / mkhal ma nyams chung sa bon 'dzag pa la//sram mam da byin tshil bus rked tshigs byug / shig sro mang la sha ba'i tshil bu byug / khyi rma red la khyi yi tshil bu byug / glang shu phag tshil mu zi nag po byug /gdong pa'i 'brum shul ra tshil 'bri mog byug / shu ba rma rgan tsan dan mar khu byug / mig 'grib bya rgod phag pa'i tshil bu 'am// 'bri mar go stod sbyar bas rkang mthil byug / rlung nad rus zhugs gting nas lhang lhang na// bca' sga 'bru mar sbyar ba'i byug pa bya// gnyid med gla rtsi mar dkar mgo lus byug /ldeg mu zi ra dug mi khyi'i brun// shu dag rwa gzhob dri chus lhog pa 'joms//mu zi tsha phabs du ba mar rnying sbyar/ lde gu byugs bsregs shu ba sel bar byed//

lta ma 'azin las gyi rgyud/ 675bye brun gser rdo nu zhos rnag sna 'dren// rnag med skrangs dang zug gzer gcog par byed// srad dkar thal ba rta bong 'o ma sbyar// rma rgan rnag 'dzag 'bras thabs song ba sel// til phye chur khur btab bskol dreg nad sel/shu dag so ma ra dza 'bras bu gsum/ slo tres ba lci sa myag tsha skrangs sel/dud pa yung skyer ru rta dug mo nyung // dar bas shu thor khe ma pags nad sel/yungs dkar shu dag rgyam tsha seng phrom gyis// gdong bkrud ngo khabs khe ma 'brum thor sel// 'om bu a ru ra dang dri chu sbyar/ dug nad yan lag skrangs pa sel bar byed tsan dan kyi lce hong len gangs chu sbyar/ khrag gzer pags nad tsha ba me dbal sel// skyu ru utpal mar gsar lus kun byug /rngul 'byams rims nad tsha ba gyi shor sel dud pa ru rta chu rtsa re cag thalasatsha phabs zo mar lkogs shu za 'phrug sel// sbrul nag pags pa du ba ma shor bsregs// phag tshil sbyar byugs sha bkra bas ldags sel// sngon bu srub ma zho sbyar za 'phrug sel byug pa'i phan yon tshe ring dbang po gsal// zhes gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dpyad lnga byug pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //

676le'u nyer lja pa/ dpyad kyi log gnon thur ma/denas yang drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/kye drang srong chen po nyon cig / dpyad lnga'i log gnon bur ma'i dpyad mchog la// rung dang mi rung nad gzhi brtag pa dang / cha byad dbyibs dang gsang sa dbye ba dang / cho ga bdeg thabs lag tshod 'chi rtags dang / log gnon phan yon bsten pa bcu gcig go / thur ma 'phang du rung ba'i nad gzhi ni//rlung dang bad rkun grang ba ma zhu skran// dmu chu rlangs 'khyims sha bem spangs pa dang / khrag dang chu ser rnag dang tshigs chu sogs/ gso dpyad gzhan rdugs phal cher thur mas gso/ rlung nad mgo rlung snying rlung glo rlung dang spyomachin mtsher pho mkhal rgyu long mkhris pa'i rlung / sgal pa dus chigs rlung zhugs thur mas gzhil/ snying rlung spyo byed chu ser bad ldan bzhi/ bad kun grang ba me drod nyams pa dang / nyen dang lcags dreg mgo la bad kun rgyas/don snod tshigs la bad kun rgyas pa rnams/ sman dpyad drod kyis ma sel thur mas gso/ ma zhu snyigs ma rang sor lus pa dang / bad kun bee snabs rgyas pa thur mas bzhu skran nad glo snying mchin mtsher mkhal ma dang / pho long mkhris pa rgyu ma lhang pa mngal/ rtsa skran bcu gcig bad rlung las gyur pa'i// grang ba'i skran la thur ma mchog yin te/ khrag mkhris las gyur tsha ba'i skran rnams kyang / bcos rdugs tshad chogs rnyings nad thur mas bshig /dmu chu grang ba'i zags chu 'khyims chu btsag / rlangs 'khyims mgo la bad kun rlangs 'khyims dang / byang khog stod du bad rlung rlangs 'khyims dang /glo snying pho bar rlangs 'khyims thur mas gseng / sha la chu ser bems dang

sku ma 'azin las kyi da/ 677skrangs pa dang // mgo dang byang khog yan lag chu ser dang / rnag khrag zhugs pa thur mas dbyung bar bya mi rung shin tu gas dang byis pa dang // sman pa'i sgo ba mi nyan rkyen ma 'jom// mchin mtsher skran zags tsha chu tsha skran rgyas//snying sogs don snod 'grams sam tsha ro yod// khrag mkhris las gyur tsha ba thams cad dang // srog gnas gnad steng thur ma spang bar bya cha byad dbyibs tshad mgar ba mkhas brdungs pa'i// nas 'dra glo snying tshigs pa mkhal mar bsngags// sbal mgo 'dra ba mchin mtsher rgyu long la// chu gri 'dra bas yan lag cur 'byin bya// mdung rtse 'dra bas yan lag rnag la sbyar/mthogang dbal ldan pho ba'i cur 'byin bya/ leb chu kha yis mgo la btsag par bya// sbubs thur sbal mgo 'dra bas snying chu btseg / byin po'i mchu 'dras byang khog rnag gsang dbye/ ga khas dmu chu btsag cing rlangs 'khyims gdon// zangs thur bra 'a 'dra bas mig 'gribs bsal// kun kyang mgo 'og lus shong thur zhabs rig / phra la mkhrang ba srid sor drug pa bya//gsang sa thur lam rnam pa bzhi yin te// don snod yul dang rtsa gnad shes pa yis// spyi dang bye brag gsang sa bstan pa'o/ dang po don snod yul sa ma shes na// gang la nad zhugs dpyad kyi dmigs mi phyed// rtsa gnad ma shes dpyad la 'jol mi nus// sman pa'i lag dgra spang phyir rtsa gnad gces// de phyir byang khog yul tshad yid la zung // gsang la dbye gsang me gsang thur gsang gsum/ rnag khrag chu ser dbye gsang byang khog gsal// me gsang me btsa'i 'bru bshag nad du bstan// thur ma'i gsang la sbyi dang bye brag gnyis/ sbyi gsang yangs dang shin tu yangs pa dang / dog dang shin tu dog pa rnam pa ba'i// yangs pa'i gsang la thur ma g.yul thabs thub// shin tu yangs pa rgya gram thub pa yin// dog pa gnyan thog gnyan babs zhes bya ste// nad kyis gnad kyi go 'phrog de la bya// shin tu dog pa gnad kyis nad go phrogs// bur

678 sa /grwa nga dba'i/lam gcus la btsal zhing brdog dgos pa'o// bye brag snying la gsang sa bcu gcig ste// nu steng mtshon gang bcal ba snying gi stod// snying srog 'dzom pa'i gsang ste snying drung sel// nu rgyab mtshon gang srog rtsa myos byed gsang // srog rtsar rlung dang chu ser zhugs la phan// thur du mtshon gang snying rtse snying chu btsag / brang ngos mtshon gang bcal ba snying gi logs/ chu ser bad rlung rlangs pa 'khyims pa'i gsang // de nas dkar nag mtshams su mtshon gang bcal// glo snying 'dom pa'i gsang ste grang rlung sel// tshigs pa bdun pa kha gsum de dang 'dra// srog rtsa'i gsang sa drug po kha gsum ste// g.yo na ngos bya 'dab bar du nad btol bya bya rog mig nas phyir mtshon gang bcal ba'i rtsibs bar gong 'og go chen go chung gsang // ske stong ca ra khung dang rnam pa lnga// glo snying mchin gsang stod du rlangs pa 'khyims// snying 'chus stod khengs dbugs brtseg nad la dbye// glo la gsang sa nyi shu rtsa gnyis te//sogs 'dab rtsib ma'i go bar rnam pa gsum glo yi sgang la skran zhugs gsang drug yin// mchan 'og rtsib ma'i go bar rnam pa gsum/ glo ba bya 'dab skran zhugs gsang drug yin// brang gi rtsib ma'i go bar g.yas g.yon bzhi// glo ba bu la skran zhugs gsang brgyad yin// glo yi rgyab gsang tshigs pa bzhi lnga gnyis// kha gsum rlung dang bad kun nad zhugs gsang // tshigs pa brgyad pa mchin dri'i gsang sa ste// chu skyug pho mchin brang la thur ma 'phang //mchin mcher gnyis la gsang sa brgyad yod de// nu ma thur tshon do bcal mchin dri'i mtshams// de 'og rtsib ma'i go bar rnam pa gsum// g.yas kyi dang po pho mchin bar gyi skran bar pa mchin ther mtha' ma mchin bsham skran// g.yon ngos mtsher skran de bzhin shes bar bya// rgyab kyi tshigs pa dgu dang bcu gcig pa// kha gsum rlung dang bad gan grang ba'i gsang // mkhal ma'i gsang sa nyi shu rtsa gcig ste// tshigs pa bcu bzhi pa dang g.yas g.yon du//
