sa ma zin las kyi da/ 679mtshon gang bcal ba mkhal ma'i rtsa nag ste// de nas mtshon gang bcal ba mkhal 'bras gsang / de nas mtshon gang bcal ba mkhal tshil gsang //gzhug gu chung nas snag po che yi steng // mdzub gang bcal ba dbyi yi 'khor mig yin/ mkhal 'bras steng nas bcal bas sor drug yod// de nas phyogs bzhir tshon re dbus dang lnga// byin brla'i phyi sul chu ser 'bab gsang yin// de rnams kun gyi mkhal ma'i grang rlung sel/ mkhal tshil mkhal 'bras steng du mkhal skran 'bab/ gsang dang nad dmigs mthun na thur ma 'phang // pho ba mi 'gyur gsang dgu cur 'byin gnyis/ tshigs ba bcu gnyis pa dang gsang bcu gnyis// nyen sna'i sna nas thur du mtshon gang bcal// g.yas g.yon mtshon gang kha gsum nyen gsang yin/ de 'og mtshon gang kha gsum skran gsang yin// de 'og mtshon gang kha gsum me nyams gsang // pho dbus g.yas g.yon mtshon do bcur phyin nas// mchin rgyas pho ba'i yul phyogs thur ma spang / skran dang nor phyir lag mtshon ran par bya/tshigs pa bcu gsum bco lnga bu snod gsang / skran zhugs grang bas bu mi chags la phan/ lte ba'i g.yas g.yon mtshon gang long gi ther/ long du bad rlung grang ba zhugs la phan// de nas g.yas g.yon mtshon re long skran gsang //tshigs pa bcu drug pa dang gsang sa lnga/ lte 'og mtshon gang kha gsum rgyu stod gsang / de 'og mtshan gang kha gsum rgyu smad gsang / tshigs pa bcu bdun pa dang bdun du bshad/ rgyu zhabs ther du dpyi yi kha gzar nas// chag gang bcal ba smad kyi dbye gsang ste/ de dang tshigs pa bco brgyad 'bras bu skrangs// grang bas chu kha sra snyi sel bar byed// yan lag tshigs chen bcu gnyis chu ser rgyas// tshigs mig chu ba'i bar na gsang dmigs yod// rus la gtug dang bcur 'byin gang 'os dpyad// thur ma'i dbye ba tsha thur grang thur gnyis// tsha thur gsum ste tsha thur rkyang pa dang // tsha thur gyi ni grang thur

680 sa /grwa nga da bzhi/tsha thur sbrag / dang po thur ma bsregs nas bdeg ba ste/ 'bras dang lhog pa lnga ba rnag la bya// gnyis pa me btab rjes la thur rkyang brdog / the tshom bcas pa'i rnag gsang 'byed la sbyar gsum pa thur bsregs steng du me 'debs pa// 'bras dang lhog pa rma rgan skran la bya// grang thur gsum ste grang thur rkyang pa dang // grang thur gyi ni tsha thur grang thur sbrag / dang po thur ma rkyang par brdog pa ste// dmu chu dbug dang mig 'grib rnag gsang dbye// gnyis pa thur shul me yis gdab pa ste// rnag kha 'khyims dang tshigs chu phug la sbyar//gsum pa thur ma grang mor btab rjes la// 'khyag pa rdo grang chu yis bran pa ste//sha bee ma tsha skrangs mgo yi chu btsag dang // tsha skran tsha ro rnying pa yod la bsngags// phal cher spra ba gcig btab thur ma 'phang // de shul me yis bsreg pa shis pa yin// lus kyi cho ga khad mnyam stan steng du// skyil dkrungs bcas la lag gnyis pus mor glan/ cu med drang por 'dug la g.yog gis bsten// de la mdun rgyab thur ma 'phang bar bya// pho thur zos rjes rgyab nas pus mos bsten/ khyi tshugs mgrin bkug ske stong thur ma 'phang / lag rgyangs ka ba la bsten smyo thur 'phang // drang por langs la dbyi mig thur ma 'phang // rkang pa brkyang la pus mo'i drug bskor 'phang // de bzhin gsang gsal nad phrang brdog tshul rnams gang la gang bde shes rab rigs la dril// bdeg pa'i thabs la sbyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyir ni g.yas pas hun gang mtshams nas bzung / g.yon pa'i gung mos gsang dmigs gsal mtshon te/ de rjes bur rked nas bzung drang por dbul// pags thags hun re skud kyin dal bu yis/ sha dus nang rdol don gyi lag tshod myang kuyin dang mtheb tshon phyi rtags bstun la 'phang / lag tshod thur 'dzin 'ug pa thug phrad yin pho rog gcer mthong thur tshod brtags la bzung / yang na dang po pags la ko then bya// bye brag g.yul thabs phred bcud rta dgab

༄ khyim 'a zin las kyi da/ 681dang // thod skor rgya gram cur 'byin rnam pa drug / bu skor ma la mi gnod pa dang bdun/ ma skor bu la mi gnod pa dang brgyad// dang po thur ma drang thad 'phang ba ste// mgo dang rgal tshigs rgyu smad gsang la bya// gnyis pa thur rtse g.yas g.yo na gcu ba ste// mchin mcher mkhal ma la sogs phal la shis/gsum pa thur rtse thur bstan 'phang ba ste// ske stong glo snying nyen gsang gsum la sbyar/ bzhi pa thur rtse gyen la bstan pa ste/ me nyams gsang dang mdzod chung rnag 'tshol sbyar// lnga pa thur rtse phyogs mtshams bskor ba ste// pho dbus skran dang rnag 'tshol ba la sbyar/ drug pa thur ma cur phyin 'phang ba ste// pho ther mdzo mig brla yi 'og tu shis// bdun pa byang khog thur ma 'phen pa rnams// don dang snod la gnod med 'phang la bshad// brgyad pa gnad du zhugs pa'i nad la 'phang // de yang mig dang snying chu mchin skran dang //mkhal skran skyi phur rnag la sbyar bar bya// thur ma'i lag tshod spyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi yi lag tshod pags la sra ba ste// sha la snyi ste byol gyis 'gro ba yin//rus la thug na stugs kyis rdugs par 'gyur// de la rtsib ma'i go bar btsal te dbul// nang du rdol nas thur rtse byol gyis 'gro/ yid la thur ma rten gyis rdugs snyam byed// nad pa bzhin ldog skad ngan 'chor ba gsum/ thur ma tshad du sleb pa'i man ngag yin/ mi rdugs phyol phyol 'gro na btang bas chog / dog cing 'then yang sran bzod zo slangs btang // sran mi bzod na de las dbul thabs med/ bye brag don la nye na shes pa 'khrug / lus 'dar mig bzlog thur ma 'phar ba yin/ gzhan rnams des chog snying chu btsag pa la// thur rtse 'phul snyam byed na snying pags sleb chu lcag dbugs bsdam sor gcig sdud la dbul/ srog rtsa thur ma'i logs las 'phar ba ste/ glo la sna bag har cing glo chung 'ong / mchin mcher skyug mer byed la kha chu sdugs/mkhal ma na zhing mkhal rtsa 'bral snyam byed/ don rnams tshur snyeg bya tshang

682 sa /grwa nga da bzhi/sbrul zhugs 'dra/ mchin mcher mkhal ma gsum la 'bros snyeg med// snod rnams phar 'bros yol ba rlung den 'dra// dal bus 'phul bas rim gyis 'bros par 'gyur/ mgyogs na 'bros long med par snod la 'jug / pho ba phyi yi dar sha phugs pa dang // pho ba'i bar na stong pa sor gcig yod// de nas pho ba'i rtsar slob yid tsam sra// skabs 'dir mchin pa'i ja log 'byung ba yin / nang rdol nas ni yangs par phyol gyis 'gro// rgyu long pags pa thags nas byil byil 'gro// slob na skyug log na 'gyur tsha 'brab byed// skran dang phrad na reg pa sra ba la// thad kur gzer zhing a na zer ba 'ong /gsar dus mtha' skor rnyings nas rma mang gdod// rnag dang dmu chu rlangs 'khyims dngos su gsal// mgo dang yan lag tshigs mig rus la thug /bshul sha'i thur ma tshad dang lag tshod bstun chag gang nang rdol 'phar nas dbul thabs med/ yan lag cur phyin tshigs par bkrul la gdon// 'chi ba'i rtags la nad gzhi slob pa dang // gnad la nye dang thor bu'i rlung skyes gsum// dang po gnyis ka lag tshod skabs su bstan// khyad par rtsa gnad spreng dang rabs kyis 'ong / de yang nad pa nyid la dris pas gsal// rlung skyes g.yal dang dngang 'dar skyug par byed log pa tsha log grang log rnam pa gnyis// tsha log 'ag gsum gnyis la 'byung ba ste// tsha grang 'khrul lam skran nad tsha bar log / grang log sbyad byas rjes la 'byung ba ste// thor bu'i rlung skyes bsur dang byug pa dang // bur chang rus khu bcud bsten rlung gsang mnan// thur shul khrag babs 'khyags te dugs kyis bsro chu skran rdol bas snod 'grims byer skrangs na// de la drod sman sbyongs dang skoms kyis bcos// de rtags bcos thabs rang rang skabs ltar bya phal cher bsil dugs sbyar ba mchog tu bsngags// don snod gnad la zin na rma bzhin bcos// thur ma'i phan yon rlung kha gnon pa dang // grang ba'i drod skyed skran

zhu ma 'a zin las kyi da/ 683bshig ma zhu 'ju// rlangs pa 'khyims pa gseng zhing sha bem gseng / rnag khrag chu ser dmu chu phyir la 'byin// de dag thur ma byas pa'i phan yon yin//dang po thur ma'i rung yul ma shes na// dpyad kyi la 'da' mi shes khyad mi thon/gnyis pa mi rung spang yul ma shes na// thur log byung na rang skyengs 'char kha 'ong // gsum pa thur ma'i dbyibs tshad ma ldan na// lag tshod mi skye sman thal skyon gyis phog / bzhi pa thur ma'i gsang sa ma shes na/ lam 'gags nad dang dpyad du phrad mi byed/ lnga pa thur ma'i dbye ba ma shes na// nad dang dpyad du 'dzol zhing thur log 'ong // drug pa thur ma'i cho ga ma shes na/thur lam 'gags nas gnad rnyeg gnas mi skyol// bdun pa bur ma'i brdog thabs ma shes na// nad dang mi phrad gnad las 'byol mi nus// brgyad pa thur ma'i lag tshod ma zin na/ kha thal sman pa'i lag dgras phung bar 'gyur//dgu pa thur ma'i 'chi rtags ma shes na// gso shi'i bya ra med pas tshad mi skyol/bcu pa thur ma'i log gnon ma shes na// gso dpyad nad pa'i srog gi bskul mar 'gyur// bcu gcig thur ma'i phan yon ma shes na// dpyad mchog thur ma'i gdengs med spyod mi nus// de bzlog de yi yon tan yin par bshad/ces gsungs so//bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las dpyad kyi log gnon thur ma'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o/ //

684le'u nyer drug pa/ rgyud bzhi'i mjug don bsdus pa/denas drang slong yid las skyes kyis drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la 'di skad ces zhus so// rkya drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags/ rgyud bzhi'i mjug don bsdu na gang du 'dus// 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol// zhes zhus pa dang / ston pas 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes/ mda' gsha' phang pa bkang yang gtad sa mde rtse gang // so nam dus ba'i ra btsal yang mdo don lto rgyab gnyis// rnam grangs du mar phye yang 'bras bu thub par bsdu// de ba'i na rgyud dang yan lag gnas skabs mdo// du mar brjod kyang mdo don rnam pa gnyis// nad dang nad med bya ba hril gyis dril// nad med don du rgyun spyod dus spyod dang //bcud len ro tsa bzhi ru shes par gyis// zas dang sman gnyis thun mong spyi ru sbyor// na dpa'i bya ba gzhi brtag gso ba gsum// nad la bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir phye na yang // tsha grang gnyis su ma 'dus nad gzhan med// ngos bzung brtag la stong dang nyis brgya yang // blta reg dri bar ma 'dus brtag thabs med//reg pa rtsa la 'tsho 'chi dpyad pas rtogs// blta ba tsha grang chu la mthong bas gsal// slong rkyen gar babs na lugs dris pas shes// gso byed gnyen po stong dang rtsa gnyis kyang // sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi ru ma 'dus med// zhi sbyong gnyis su ma 'dus sman ga 'an med// bsil drod gnyis su ma 'dus zhi byed med// drag 'jam gnyis su ma 'dus sbyongs ga 'an med// 'jam tsub gnyis su ma 'dus dpyad gzhan med phan gnod gnyis su ma 'dus zas gzhan med// drag dal gnyis su ma 'dus spyod lam med// gso thabs lag

sa khye ma 'a zin las gyi da/ 685len sum brgya drug cu yang // ngos bzung gso tshul gso thabs gsum du 'dus// kye drang srong chen po de ltar shes par gyis nad ngos thams cad lta reg dri bas bzung / ltar snang lnga phrugs tsha grang 'khrul so bsal bcos tshul dgu yis nad dang gnyen po sprod// lag len bco brgyad nad kyi ngo bo gzhom/ le'u drug pas mdor bstan rtsa ba bzung // bshad pa'i rgyud kyis gso rig spyi khog khrol// man ngag rgyud kyis gang byung nad rnams gso/ phyi ma rgyud kyis lag len mdo don dril// zhi byed thams cad sde tshan lnga bzhin sbyor sbyong byed thams cad las lnga'i nang bzhin skyongs// dpyad rnams gang byed dpyad lnga'i nang bzhin spyod/ rlung mkhris bad kun gsum gyis spyi khog phub/rang rang nad kyi gso thabs mde khar thogs// dug dang bad kun tsha ba rnyings pa gsum/ gcig la gcig phan rtags dang bcos thabs 'khrul/ ma zhu nyen dang me drod nyams pa gsum/ gcig la gcig phan rtags dang bcos thabs 'khrul/ 'or dang skya rbab dmu rdzings rnam pa gsum// gcig la gcig phan rtags dang bcos thabs 'khrul// de bzhin skran dang khong 'bras bcos thabs 'khrul// 'bras dang sur ya rma rgan rnam pa gsum// gcig la gcig phan rtags dang bcos thabs 'khrul// 'khru nad rgyu gzer tshad pas 'khru ba gsum/ gcig la gcig phan rtags dang bcos thabs 'khrul/ dreg dang grum bu rkang bam rtags bcos 'khrul/ rims la ma smin stong tshad gces par zung // 'grams dang 'khrugs la rgyas tshad gces par zung // dug dang skug po rnyings tshad gces par zung / bad mkhris nad la gab tshad gces par zung // tshad pa kun la zhu 'khyags gtso bor zung // pho mtsher mkhal nad bad zhan gtso bor zung / glo mchin mkhris pa tshad pa gtso bor zung // snying srog long la rlung nyid gtso bor zung / khong nad kun la pho ba gtso bor zung smotshad nad bsil gyis ma thub log gnon drod grang nad drod kyis ma thub

686 sto/grwa nga rgyud ba'i/log gnon bsil// tshig 'di dpe la ma bzhag don la long / don 'di yal bar ma btang sems la 'chongs// man ngag kha khyer ma byed don la long //sman dpyad shes lo ma byed rtog dpyod gzobs// mi srog tshong len ma byed gdengs ldan slob// lag 'dzud ma snga nad kyi skad la dris// dpyad snying ma che sman pa'i lag dgras phung // ri thang mtshams su spyang ste khra 'dras dgos nad zo len dus glen te lug 'dras dgos// nad gnya' gcog dus bsdar te wa 'dras dgos// dpyad log byed dus dpa' ste stag 'dra dgos// zhes gsungs so/ de nas drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// ro nus zhu rjes sbyor ba mi dgos pa'i// gcig gis nad sel sman mchog yod dam med// sbyar ba'i sman la gang gang mchog du 'gyur// de bzhin zas spyod kun gyi mchog gang lags 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos bshad du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so// kye drang srong chen po yin las skyes// khyod kyis zhus pa'i don la lan med na// nyan thos 'grog pa'i gol sar shor ra re// de phyir dris lan bshad kyis gus pas nyon// nad rnams kun la a ru ra nyid mchog / rlung la rus khu bur rnying sgog skya mchog /mkhris par tig ta gser gyi me rtog mchog / bad kun na le sham dang sbrang rtsi mchog / khrag la ba sha ka dang hong len mchog / bad kun skug po'i nad la cong zhi mchog / ma zhu ba la kha ru tsha nyid mchog / skran gyi nad la rdo thal bsregs khu mchog / dmu rdzings nad la dar ya ka nyid mchog / skya rbab nad la da lis lcags phye mchog 'or gyi nad la srad dkar ba chu mchog / gcong chen nad la sha chang 'o ma mchog / rims la par pa ta dang gla sgang mchog /'khrugs la tsan dan dkar po hong len mchog / tshad pa kun la gi waṃ mchog tu bshad// dug la a ru ra dang nyung ma mchog / sha yi dug la byi 'u la phul

lta ma 'a zin las kyi da/ 687mchog / gnyan nad kun la gu gul gla rtsi mchog / mig la skyer pa'i khaṇḍa 'bras gsum mchog / kha yi nad la mngar gyi khur bkang mchog / snying gi nad la dzā ti pha la mchog / glo ba'i nad la cu gang mchog tu bshad mchin pa'i nad la gur gum brag zhun mchog / mtsher nad ka ko la dang drod sman mchog / mkhal ma'i nad la sug sprel mchog tu bshad/ pho ba'i nad la se 'bru mchog yin no// gcin snyi skyu ru ra dang yung skyer mchog / chu sri rgya tsha gser gyi bye ma mchog / skyug la 'bras yos 'khru la dug nyung mchog / glo la a krong kuṇḍa ka ri mchog / glo rdol rgya skyegs sran ma'i me tog mchog / skom pa'i nad la so phag bsregs khu mchog / rtsib logs gzer la puskar sku la mchog /gzhang 'brum dar ba srin la byi tang ka / glang thabs thang phrom khong 'bras 'bam po mchog / dreg la sle tres grum bur bong khrag mchog / chu ser dngul chu mdze la seng ldeng mchog / smyo la mar rnying brgyal la chu phru mchog / gnyid med 'o ma skog nad nya khu mchog / mes tshig rma la si ra nyid mchog / rus chag sbal rgyab dul gcod dngul thal mchog / khrag gcod spru 'bru rma la dom mkhris mchog / sbyar sman rgyas tshan ga bur rgyal blon mchog / rims kyi nad la de ba lnga sbyor mchog / 'khrugs kyi nad la ga bur bdun pa mchog / rnyings tshad kun la nyi shu rtsa lnga mchog / tshad pa kun la gtso bo brgyad sbyor mchog / tsha grang 'dres la cu gang bde byed mchog / ldan tshad 'byed la ma nu bzhi thang mchog / khrag ngan 'byed la 'bras bu gsum thang mchog / dug nad kun la mang sbyor chen mo mchog / dang ga 'byed la se 'bru bzhi pa mchog / me drod skyed la rgod ma kha phye mchog / grang nad kun la se 'bru brgyad pa mchog / skran nad kun la 'phrul gyi thal sman mchog / sprug po'i nad la gnyen po bdun sbyor mchog / snying rlung nad la btsan dug sman mar mchog / chu 'gags nad la tsha spyor chen mo mchog / mig gi nad la gsal byed dgu pa mchog /

688 kho /grwa thang da ba'i/gnyan srin nad la bya khyung lnga pa mchog / khrag nad dpyad mchog kun la gtar ga mchog / mkhris pa'i nad la khrus dang sbyang ba mchog / bad gan nad la skyugs dang me btsa' mchog / rlung gi nad la bsku mnye 'jam rtsi mchog / 'bras kyi nad la lum dang me btsa' mchog / zas byi mchog tu nas rnying tsam pa mchog / skom gyi mchog tu thong dkar rtse mo mchog / mi jul bcag pa spyod lam mchog yin no// de ltar nad gzhi rnams kyi sman gyi mchog / bshad pas mthu stobs nus pe phul du phyin// zhes gsungs so// de nas drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// da lta dus bzang spyod pa btsun gyur kyang // lnga brgya'i dus na nad ngan dar ba'i tshe// de dus bdag ga 'an srung thabs yod dam med// med na gzhan gso rang la mi 'byung ngam// yod na 'gro ba'i mgon pos bka' stsal 'tshal// zhes zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes bden no khyod bden ngas bshad gus bas nyon lan cig lnga brgya'i tha mar bab dus na// 'byung po rnams kyis blo bur ye 'grogs gtong // ma mo mkha' 'gros nad ngan yams su 'bebs/mu steg gdug pas rdzas kyi sbyor ba byed/ de dus bdag gzhan srung ba thin tu gces// dang po 'byung po'i gdon tshogs srung ba ni/ ga bur bzang po drug la sogs pa yi/ gla rtsi shing kun gu gul shu dag sogs// dri dang ldan pa'i sman ni thams cad dang skyo ba bla ldong ros mu zi bya rgod spos// sa rdo sngo sman dri can thams cad dang / bse dri can dang gshul chags sha rnams dang 5 bya gcan ra lug la sogs sems can gyi// spu brun chu dang sen mo mkhris pa dang //sbal sbrul nya dang ljong mo la sogs sha/ 'bru sna dug sna khrag sna kun bsags la // zhib tu btags la ril bu dril byas te du bas bdug dang khu ba bsku ba dang / khong du btang bas 'byung po thams cad 'byer// steng gdon 'og

༄gyi stem 'a zin las kyi rgyud/ 689gdon kun dang rims rnams thub khyad par rims srung sbyi dang bye brag gnyis// spyi ru srung thabs sngags dang rdzas gnyis te// dang po rang nyid mthu stobs bdag por bskyed/ yi hri de ba le kha phur/ a ti phur/ bi phur sod/bi hub sod/ mur ya sod/ ku ma ra ya sod/ la tsi sod/ brta bca sod/badzra pa ba pa ba sod/ hri de hri de sod/ ti ka snye na sod/ ma ma du ru sod/pu tsa yo gi ni sod/ brgya rtsa brgyad kyis rgyun gyi yi dam bya// yul phyogs yod na sum brgya bzla bar bya nad pa gso na sum yar ma chag bzla// oṃ mug thum sarba mug thum/ te tsa mug thug the phur sod/ ni phur sod/ bya rkang sod/nad sod/ rims sod/ dal sod/ yams sod swāhā/ sum yar brgya rtsa mchil ma srin lag gis// rkang mthil dri ma sdur la sna sgor byug / rdzas srung btsan dug chos sman gla rtsi dang // shu dag gu gul mu zi bya rgod spos// sgog skya dri chen chu yis ril bu bya// nang re sum yar gong bzhin shes par bya// btsan dug gla rtsi mu zi shu dag dang // gu gul dkar nag gnyis dang sgog skya yi//khrol bu'i bum bu sker btags sna sgor bdug / de yis rims nad bskal pa'i me 'bar yang // rang lus rdo rje 'dra ste cis mi tshugs/ lto stong sems zhum dus su nad dri bsrung // 'grangs ngoms srung bas dpa' skyed de dus blta//dus thug bdud rtsi gnyis kyis sgo dgu bsdam// srung ba mi ldan rims nad bag med 'chos// dmag gdong gcer bur ral kha byed dang mtshungs// khyad par tsha rims srung ba ni rang yi dam du bsgoms la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshes sa pa dgrabacom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo bla ma 'od kyi rgyal pol phyag 'tshal lo bdagacag rims nad thams cad las bsrung dug sol/ skyab tu gsol/ med par mdzad du gsol/bugs pa sangs par mdzad du gsol/ ta du sgru/ ba ba ma sgyu ma sa bya ti ta ha na han ba na swāhā/ zung ma bu zung ma bu sod/ lang lang ling ling sod/ me na sod/ lam lam sod/dbal sod/ tsha ba mi'i dbal sod/ brgya rtsa brgyad ba sal snar gdab/ ga bur bzang drug tsan dan ba ru/ ya ga ru/ utpal gla ga dur kar dri chu'i ril bu na pa ri btang ngo smo dbur dzā ti

690 sa /grwa thang dab /tsan dan snar bdug godang 'bru ma pa srung /ba ni tsan dan gla shing kun shu dag mu zi dri chu khong du btang/ tsan dan ri gur gum mu gu gul sgog skya dri chu lus byug gla rtsi shing kun gu gul rdo dreg skyer pa ga skya'i dubs bdug lha ga wan mji ku par sab ta ga ta ya sa nga tad ta sa ta bhā ga tan ti/ sa sa tan na spya hā/ ta spya sgru/ 'am me sham sham sham yas hwa sra na lab sa ra gdags nang rab gso gag lhog srung dang ba ni bya khyung du ba smon sal 6lhangalhang tser car krita kro ta/ shag shag shel shel/ bum bu / pe du bee du/ lhog pa'i bu srun bdunadang / 'bras gyi bu su gsum dang / mdze po ha mjo po ha da ho da ho bya kri bya kri/ mugs da po chig bdud ྅hā/ nang re bzlas/ phag sna dang 'dzim pa shu dag gu gul gla rtsi mu zi phur pa gdags bya khyung ril bu khong du btang ngo rgyug zer srung ba ni rang shi'i rjod pa chos sman dri chur sbyangs la btang /ga bur btsan dug gla dza ti sgog skya spang spos yu ngas bar shud ga rnams mgul du bta sa/ ta spya sgru/tsa pa ma ru ru ā shug na yu na brum ni sam pu ku nus bdag la srungs shi ces nang ralabargya rtsa ba sa so cham pa bsrung ba ni/ me lo dkar po she sa hūṃ phaṭa ces ba sa shing snara'abud do/ rang gis srung ba'i dam tshig ma thub par// rims 'gos drang srong bka' la yid mi ches// gzhung bzhin spyod dang bslus na nga rang shes// rdzas sbyor dug gi srung thabs rnam pa gsum// du ba sna sgo reg pa chu sgo bsrung //rlangs pa nyi zer bsrung ba gnyis ka gces// zas la bskur ba khong srung 'di nyid la// char ma'i nyung ma khu tshos byas pa dang // a ru gser mdog yungs ker sum cha mnyam// sgog gcig chus sgru ril bus zhag re thub// chag tshad ngos 'dzin zhu long med par skyug / zas la bskur ba khong srung 'di nyid la//char ma'i nyung ma khaṇḍa byas pa 'am// 'dred byed mi dang sha ba'i tshil gnyis 'khren byed yungs ra rdog po sum cu dang bya ra ba gla ril ma tsam don snod sgo srung la bzang dru dang tshab gsum bun rem nang ga sman gsum pa'i pa'i smad ga ra mdog bras zhun ma btsam re sbyar/ ril bu bzhi lnga tshes gcig nang par nas// rtsa kha phye la zhag dgu re re bskyed// snga dro'i zas bsrung lto 'jam drod bcud bsten// rdzogs nas nang ma gsum du rtsa kha bsdam// de yis lo re'i bar du nyams nga med// sman

sa ma 'a zin las kyi da/ 691mchog rgyal po kun gyi gnyen po rnam rgyal 'jigs nad gang rnyed dang // bya ra ba dang 'dred byed 'khyen byed gla sgo gagacig zhung gzhi cong gi bdun cigasum gyi ra khu/ yungs rkar dang / don snod sha dus rtsa yi sgo srung bzang drug 'a pa rtol du gzhung spa ling sdig na/ bdu yung ba/ ji zhur/ 'bri ta sa 'dzin nga mngar ba ru ri skon dang // rlung mkhris bad kun khrag dang chu ser srin rnams la tres/ tig rta/ ma nu'u su/ bshakatshol so ra seng nga / ma ru dang byi tang ga sogs 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i kha gnon gnyen po dang // dbyig dug srung dang 'joms pa'i gnyen po ga ra g.yu zangs lcags du tig byu ru dngul bdun sran tsam/ tsha la mu zib du bragazhun bzhi thun redang 0 rdo dug srung dang 'dzoms pa'i gnyen po sprul ba gangs gas mtshal cong zhi bzhi po bun gyi sum cha re/ zel tsha rgya tsha tsha lagasum bun re dang / rtsi dug srung dang 'joms pa'i gnyen po dug sna gas tshad nas tsam ri/ gla ji chos na ha bo bong nga gsum thun dang / sngo dugasang dang 'joms pa'i gnyen po no sha gsum thar nu dur gyid nga zim 'ol ma ba mkhal gze ma rnams ril ma tsam ri/ mug chos lug mig za thog khur ya ji ṣi ri ral rnams thun redang / sha dug srung dang 'joms pa'i gnyen po bu mo lo bco lnga lon pa'i mchin pa/skyes pa grir zhi ba'i lha khyi gu mig bye ba dang ri'u rgya bo zho 'bung sha phag khri'i mchin pa/ bya 'tsha lu dang tha bya'i rnams ma dul ba ril ma tsam re/ mi rta khyi'i spya tshan byi'u la phug ba gye'i sha mi ra nya phag dom mtsha' lu rnams kyi mkhris pa rnams bun dang // dug nad spyi 'joms 'khor gyi dmag mi nga sder dkar sprug bong nga dkar dam ra rtsad rgya thub yug shing gang chung spang spang rgyan spang spos brag spos zhum bu go stod stag sha rgod skyer shun ya bo rnams thun re dang // tsha ba sbyi bcos sman bur tsan dan gi waṃ gsum na ri/ rgyas par gyed na na kun tshogs par bas 'bring du byed na sdo rtsi rdzobazhi'i srung gyed ba ga lag na rnams rtsi bzhin btags// dar la btsags la nyung ma'i khaṇḍa yi// ril bu sran phos tsam dril grib skams bya//tshes gcig nang ma gsum ni dri chus 'phul// de yis zla ba re re'i bar du thub/gso yang rang grol sman gyi rgyal po yin// char nyung 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba

692 ga /grwa nga da ba /lnga// gtso bo drug la sman mar tshul bzhin sbyar// de la gong gi sman rgyas 'bring ga rung ngam/ bkun rin po drug bzang drug tshan gsum bong nga gsum khyung sder da yung ba btsan dug rnamasaḥphye kha tshar btab// mngar dang sbyar la ston zla tha chung btang smozad ma'i dri chen dri chu bar pa gnyis// 'khar gzhong nang du chos sman gsum sbyar la// ras gtsang snod blug mkhan gseb zhag bdun bsru pa// grib lhags skams phye thun bdun chang gis 'phul/ dug rigs ma lus ma shi'i bar du thub// kun la zas dang spyod lam 'jig rtsi bsrung nad dang sbyor ba 'jig rtsi byung na bskyar// du ba rlangs pa rims dri sna nas 'jug / de phyir kun las rgyal ba'i rtsa sgo bsrung // ga bur dri chu cong zhi lag mthil sbyar nang ma bdun du snar rngub de rjes la/ dza ti gur gum nā ga ge sar dang // spang rgyan tsan dan dmar po'i du bas bdug / khegs rtags mgo lus lci 'dar phrum ser khyer/ dug gdon rims rnams srung ba'i mchog tu bshad// ba spu'i sgo srung tsan dan mar khu dang // zo mar rtsi mar shing mngar mi tshil rnams//bsdus khu drod ma rmi la ba'i nang dag tu dzā ti gur gum gla rtsi spang spos dang /spang rgyan sbyar te lus kun bkrus rjes byug / yang na gla rtsi phag tshil sbrul sha dang sdig srin mu zi ra khrag bse mar khur// yang na ga bur bsil gsum tsan dan dang // gla rtsi chos sman phag tshil ra khrag byug / ba spu'i sgo 'gegs lus sbrid lci ba yin// reg pa nyi zer rlangs kyis nyams mi nga // zhes gsungs so// de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// rgyud 'dir ma tshang gso dpyad mi bdog gam// de skad zhus pa'i don la lan gsungs pa// bde gshegs rnams kyis sprul pas 'gro don du rgya gar yul du sman gyi sbyor ba gsungs//rgya nag yul du me btsa' rtsa sbyongs gsungs dol po'i yul du gtar ga gtso bor bstan/ bod kyi yul du rtsa chu'i brtag pa bstan// lha yi 'khor la gso

ga ma 'a zin las kyi da/ 693dpyad 'bum pa gsungs drang song 'khor la tsa ra ka sde brgyad/ mu stegs 'khor la dbang phyug nag po'i byu nang pa'i 'khor la rigs gsum mgon po'i skor// gso dpyad rgyud 'dir thams cad 'dus par bstan/ 'dir ma 'dus pa'i gso dpyad gzhan med de// 'phags pa'i thugs rje phyogs ris med mod kyang // gang zag mos pa'i mthong snang so sor shar dper na mkha' la zla ba gcig shar na/ chu yi skyogs rer zla ba re re bzhin gcig tu gsungs kyang so sos du mar go/ zhes gsungs so/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rgyud bzhi'i mjug don bsdus pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o/ //

694le'u nyer bdun pa/ rgyud yongs su gtad pa/de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so/ kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// dang po nad shugs ma rdzogs sngon tshul dus// gso ba byas kyang lam nas mi zlog cing // bar du nad rgyas gnyen pos phral mi choms// tha mar yan lag bcu gnyis ldan gyur pas/ nad las mi grol srog ni zad par snang // gzhan dag de las go bzlog 'gyur ba'i phyir//gso rig sman gyi dgos pa ci zhig bya/ 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal pos the tshom sol// zhes zhus pa las/ ston pa rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ drang srong chen po de la rtog mi 'tshal/ nad la bzhi rgya rtsa bzhir grags pa la// brgya dang rtsa gcig ltar snang phral gyi nad// ma bcos rang gar bzhag pas 'tsho ba yod smo 'on kyang bcos na myur du bde ba ster// dper na 'gyel bub lag nas 'then pa 'dra// dang po sngon tshul che bar byung gyur kyang //ma bcos rang gar lam nas bzlog pa yod// dper na mkha' la sprin 'thibs char 'bab pa// blo bur sangs nas than par 'gyur ba 'dra/ brgya dang rtsa gcig kun brtags gdon yin pas// de ma bcos par sman dpyad len mi 'dod// gdon bcos sman med gyur kyang 'tsho ba yod// dper na dpung pa g.yar ba'i btson bu 'dra// brgya dang rtsa gcig yongs grub tshe yi nad// ma bcos 'chi la bcos na 'tsho ba yod// de yang dang po bar dang tha ma gsum//tsha ba'i sngon tshul lam nas mi zlog pa// gnyen po grogs kyis len du mi ster phyir// stobs chung grogs med gsar dus mi zlog med// bar du nad rgyas gnyen pos choms pa dka'// dper na zhwa yi gdong du rags brtsigs pa//

༄༷ rma 'a zin las kyi da/ 695'ar la khyer yang zhar la mnan pa yis// chu shugs zad nas rags kyis thub par snang // de bzhin nad rgyas gnyen po 'thabs pa yis// mi choms 'dra yang bstud na nus pa thob// grang rgyas lci ba gnyen pos choms dka' ste/ go mtshon bcas pa'i tshong pa dpung bcas 'dra// brgya dang rtsa gcig gzhan dbang sngon gyi las/ bcos kyang mi thub 'chi ba'i nad yin pas/ de yang bsdu na srog gcod nad dgur 'dus// tsha ba la la 'das dang ma 'das gnyis// dper na me long thab tu bcug pa 'dra ma zhu chus sleb zhu nas des mi bzlog / grang ba gting nas 'khar dang ma 'khar gnyis// dper na sdum bu dang ni sdong rgan 'dra/ dang po tshos bla gnyis pa chos mi 'gyur// rlung nad srog rten chad dang ma chad gnyis// dper na skon pa nang gi bya dang 'dra// ma shor zin la shor na zin thabs med// zungs zad nad la de srog gnas pa ste/nad bcom gyur na srog kyang 'jig pa'i phyir/ dper na rmang gis ma thub rtsig pa 'dra/ rnam par 'tshe ba gdon gyis bla khyer ba// 'tsho ba 'dra yang nges par 'chi ba ste// dper na rgyu ma phug pa'i mi dang 'dra/ 'tsho ba'i tshe las bsod nams gsum zad pa smo nad grol rtsa shor 'byung ba 'gag pa'i phyir//dper na nam gzhug chad pa'i char pa 'dra// gshed du babs pa tsha grang gnyis 'dom pas gcig bcos gcig skye gnyen po kun mi len/ dper na thag chod mi la gros 'debs 'dra// sbyor ba mtshungs pa rgyu rkyen gnyen po log / gang bcos grogs kyi thog tu bab pa ste dug zin mi la btsan dug blud pa 'dra// gnad du babs ba srog gnas bcom pa ste/ srog rtsa chad pas bcos thabs ci la rnyed/ gras kha btsan po dgra la shor ba 'dra/ drang srong chen po the tshom skye mi rung / gso byas ma byas mnyam por bya mi rigs/ 'tsho 'chi kun la man yod ma yin te/ kun tu sman med ces smra de ma yin/ me steng chu blug me sod ga la srid/ de yang dman na sod pa shin tu dka'

696 sto/grwa nga rgyud bzhitsam pas ltogs pa mi sel ga la srid// chu yis skom pa mi sel ga la srid//gag lhog gso ba med par su bder 'gyur// chu 'gags sman dbya da med par ci la thon// gnyen po med par dug za su yis nus// mchog sogs nus pa lung las grags bzhin sel// de phyir gso ba the tshom bcas mi bya// zhes gsungs so// de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so//kye drang srong chen po rig pa'i ye shes lags// mi na gnas dang na ba gso dgos pas// dgos pa'i thabs la 'brel pa yod dam med// 'brel med chos la spyad pas ci zhig 'grub// mar 'dod bye ma btsir bar mi 'gyur ram//'di la sman pa'i rgyal pos bka' stsol zhig / ces zhus pa las/ ston pas gsungs pa/ kye drang srong chen po yid las skyes// thabs dang thabs byung 'brel pa ci ste med// 'gro ba'i lus 'di 'byung ba bzhi las grub// gso bya'i nad kyang 'byung ba bzhi yis bskyed// gnyen po'i sman yang 'byung bzhi'i ngo bo nyid// lus nad gnyen po bdag nyid gcig par 'brel// gnod bya gnod byed rten dang brten par 'brel// gso bya gso byed bsod nams las kyis 'brel// rin po che dang klu yi rgyal po 'dra// mi shes shes byed gso rig thabs su 'brel// thabs las byung ba 'du ba snyoms par 'brel// 'du ba snyoms pa nad med bde bar 'brel thabs dang thabs byung de las byung bar 'brel//ci phyir don byed nus phyir rag lus phyir// zhes gsungs so// de nas drang srong yid las skyes la sogs pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu sdebs nas ston pa la bstod pa/ kye ston pa 'tsho mdzad sman pa'i rgyal po nyid// ston pa'i thugs la ma rig mun pa med// rtog med spros bral rig pa'i ye shes nyid// thugs rje'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i mun pa sel// thams cad 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud thugs las byung // mnyam nyid chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa'i sku la sgros rgud bsnyel ba med ku gsal stong spros bral beeḍūdma 'dra'i sku// sku yi 'od zer

sa khyem 'a zin las kyi khyud/ 697'gro ba'i nad rnams sel// tha snyad ma rmongs bshad rgyud sku las byung skyomatshan dpe longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo ston pa'i yon tan zad cing 'phel ba med/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas sman gyi bla yon tan 'od zer 'gro ba'i sdug 'phongs sel/ man ngag rgyud ni yon tan nyid las byung kurin chen 'byung ldan sku la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa'i zin las gang yang thogs pa med// zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi rdzogs rgyal chen po/ zin las 'od zer 'gro ba'i nad gdon sel/ phyi ma rgyud ni phrin las nyid las byung spyodapa' bo sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa'i gsung ni 'gag med tshangs pa'i gsung // gcig la kun go 'khor tshogs 'dod pa bskong ⑪gsung gi 'od zer 'gro ba'i ngag sgrib sel// rgyud bzhi'i zhus lan ston pa'i gsung las byung // gsal dag padma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes mngon par bstod do/ de nas ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis rgyud la bsngags pa 'di ched du brjod do// e ma ho drang srong yid las skyes// rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud 'di sa bon 'dra// 'di las ma skyes gso dpyad yod ma yin/ sku yi bshad rgyud bar snang nyi zla 'dra// tshig don ma lus sgrib med gsal bar ston man ngag yon tan rgyud 'di nor bu 'dra// dgos pa ma tshang ba ni gcig kyang med// phyi ma zin las rgyud 'di pha lam 'dra nad kyi steng du thogs pa yod ma yin// rig pa'i ye shes nam mkha'i mdzod dang 'dra// dris pa'i lan la zad mi shes par ston/ gsung sprul yid las skyes ni seng ge 'dra/ zhu ba'i tshig la zhum zhing skrag pa med thams cad 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di khyung lding 'dra/ nad kyi g.yang sar nyams nga bag tsha med/ yid du 'ong bas khu byug gsung snyan 'dra/ 'gro ba gang gis thos pas spro ba skyed/ kun tu dkon pas u dum wa ra 'dra// thos mthong spyod pa skal ldan re re tsam nyi ma'i 'od kyis zla skar zil gnon bzhin/ rgyud rgyal 'di yis gso rig kun zil

698 ༄gyi/grwa thang dab gnon// 'di ni sngags med pa yi srung skud yin// 'chi bdag bdud sde zlog pa'i 'khrul 'khor yin// nad kyi dgra dpung 'joms pa'i dpa' bo yin//'du ba 'phel zad snyoms pa'i spyi pa yin// dus min 'chi zhags gcod pa'i 'khor lo yin// nad kyi zug gzer gcog pa'i tho ba yin// sdug bsngal 'dam nas 'dren pa'i lcags kyu yin 'chi ba'i srog skyobs mi 'jigs sbyin pa yin/ 'chi ba slong byed bdud rtsi bum pa yin// drang srong rnams kyis 'di la gces par zung // zhes gsungs so// de nas yang drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'di skad ces zhus so// kye ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes lags//rgyud kyi rgyal po gsang ba man ngag rgyud dus kyi mtha' ma ji lta bu la gtad mi bstan sba ba'i snod ngan gang la gsang / gsang dang gtad pa'i skyon dang yon tan gang // 'tsho mdzad khyod kyis bdag la lung ston cig / ces zhus pa las/ ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ kye drang srong chen po khyod nyon cig / gtad pa'i snod la bzang ngan ci ste med//snod ngan rnams kyis gdams pa'i bcud mi thub// dper na seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma de// rin chen ma yin snod ngan phal par blug / snod kyang chag la 'o ma'i bcud kyang 'bo// de phyir gsang ba'i snod ngan 'di lta bu slob dpon gsang zhing rang che 'byin pa dang // thabs kyis brku zhing gzhogs slong byed pa dang / drin med khyad sod byed la shor ra re// g.yo sgyus 'gro ba'i nor la 'jab pa dang ta nga rgyal dregs pas bcings dang snying rje med// tshe 'di gtsor 'dzin lag tu shor ra re// gser g.yu rta khrab yon gyis mi slu bar kha 'jam brid po'i lag tu shor ra re/ de ltar skal med snod dang mi ldan na//chu srin gre bar rin chen tshud pa bzhin// bskal pa 'khrugs kyang kha ru mi dbyung gsang // srog ser gtad dang dug sbyor la sogs pa mu stegs chos dang rig pa 'di mi rje// rdzun lung mo shen gser 'gyur bzo yi rigs/ kha

ga khyi ma 'azin las kyi rgyud/ 699shags tha snyad chos dang 'di mi rje// de ltar snod ngan rnams la ma gsangs skyon// gdams pa ma thub spel bas mkhas khyad med// dug dang 'dres pas kun la phan mi thogs// khong du rul bas gdams pa'i mgo mi thon/ dam tshig nyams pas phyi ma ngan 'gror lhang / de phyir shin tu songs shig drang srong rnams// rgyud 'di gtad par bya ba'i snod ldan ni/ dam tshig ldan pas bla ma spyi bor 'khur/ nor dang srog la phangs med gtong phod nus shes rab che bas tshig don 'gal 'brel 'byed// byams sems che bas gzhan don gtso bor len/ chos la brang btad g.yo sgyu zol zog med// sman pa'i rgyu drug tshogs pa'i skal ldan la// drang srong chen po'i rgyud 'di gtad par bgyi//des kyang mnyes pa'i yon gyis mi sru na// sbyin par mi bya dam par 'dzin mi 'gyur// de ltar snod ldan gcig las gcig brgyud nas/ rgyun mi chad par 'gro don byed par bsngo// snod dang ldan pas rgyud 'di sus 'chang ba tshe 'dir btsan rgyug phan dar 'jom pa dang / 'gro ba spyis khur dpal grags thob pa dang / byi ma byang chub go 'phang 'grub par sngo// 'gro kun nad kyi sdug bsngal bral ba dang / dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen las thar bar bsngo/ nga yi bka' btsan byin che dar ba dang / ji ltar bsngos pa'i smon lam 'grub par bsngo// zhes gsungs nas drang srong rig pa'i ye shes de bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla beeḍūdma 'od kyi rgyal po'i sku'i gsang bar thim par gyur to/bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud las rgyud yongs su gtad pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud ces bya ba sangs rgyas sman gyi bla beeḍūrla 'od kyi rgyal po'i byin rlabs las sprul pa'i ston pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes dang drang srong yid las skyes kyis zhus lan du mdzad pa gso dpyad kun gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba yongs su rdzogs so// //

700 sa /grwa nga da ba de ltar grub pa'i gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs chen po dpal ldan rgyud bzhi zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ mtha' bzhi'i sman pa rnams dang mkhas pa mi dgu la sogs pas srol phye zhing dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i gzhung 'grel che chung bar ma dang bcas pa kun gyi nang nas mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces shing rgyal mtshan gyi tog bzhin mtho la/ khyad par du gangs can pa rnams kyi yul dus dbang po'i sgo dang nye bar 'tsham pa 'di nyid kyi snyan grags dang zin las phan bde'i rtsa lag rmad du byung ba'i tshul dang bka' dring dag ni sus kyang gzhal par mi nus pa lkog na mos ma sgribs pa 'di lags mod/ 'on tu zin kyang sman pa sngags bon tog tse pa rnams ni rang bzo kho na la mkhas shing gsung rab la dbang za bas/ lo tshogs dang gang zag 'ga' zhig gis tshong dus kyi 'o ma ba'i na rnam par bslad cing pa dro mon gyi zhus dag 'ba' zhig la yid rton la/ rgyu des don dang don ma yin pa rnam par ma phyed cing spang blang 'jug ldog 'khrul bas/dang por mkhas pa'i slob dpon mi bsten/ bar du thos bsam mthar mi skyel/mthar zin las dbang thang la re ba'i sman pa sha stag tu gyur ba mthong nas ri khrod du sdod ma nus shing grwa sar yon tan mi gos pa 'ga' zhig gis yig sna phran bu mthong ba dang / sman ngo 'ga' re shes pa dang / lag len gcig gnyis mthong ba tsam la brten nas sman pa byas pas/ ding sang gi dus na chu 'dren pa dang mgo mkhan/ sde 'don dang mig 'byed pa/ rkang nad pa dang sngags mkhan zhes sogs nad sna re re sel ba la sman pa zur pa re 'tshol dgos shing / bcos lugs de dag rnams kyang gzhung che ba rnams nas 'byung ba rnams ni nam yang mi zab la/ khyad par du nged kyi pa'am mes po sogs la mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan byung ba'i man ngag chig brgyud ma gtogs spel ma stong ba 'di 'dra ba rnams zab po zhes sgrogs pa dag gis nor 'dzin gang ste/lus can rnams nyams thag cing sman dpyad kyi bstan pa rin po che yang shing rta

sa ’ ma 'a zin las gyi da/ 701'dam du bying ba ltar song snang bas yin lhag par byung na'ang / bstan pa dang sems can la phan bde skyed par byed pa ni kho bo cag 'dra ba'i gnas ma yin zhing rngo thogs par yang lta ga la zhig de lta na'ang lhag bsam dang rgyal ba'i phrin las ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas byi ba dang glang chen gyi dpe ltar bsams te/ gzhung lugs yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra ba nyid sbyang ba rnam pa gsum la sogs pa'i byi dor legs par byas te rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la bkod pa ltar kun gyi spyod yul du rung ba byas na/ blo dang ldan pa rnams spro ba 'phel te phan bde'i rtsa lag tu 'gyur ba'ang srid do snyam pa dang / nges shes 'dren byed nas 'byung ba'i lung bstan kyang dus la bab bo zhes yid la brnags nas/gtso bor g.yu thog pa yab sras kyi phyag dpe dngos sogs snga rab pa'i dpe dag por byed pa 'ga' zung brnyed pa dpang du btsugs/ zur mkhar ba'i rgyud bzhi rnam dag yin ngo shes pa la'ang gtugs/ bye brag du rtsa bshad phyi gsum la 'grel pa snga phyir byung ba ji snyed cig dang / man ngag rgyud la khungs thub kyi 'grel pa mi snang bas g.yu thog pa'i gser mchan dang / cha lag bco brgyad kyi nang tshan skor tshoms bcu gcig dmar khrid yig chung / gab pa bco brgyad sogs dang phan tshun sgo bsnan slar yang so ma ra dza che zung / gsang tig sgron ma/ ja log dang yang log me chu go ldog rin chen srungs pa/ bla dpyad bu ti/ sha mo las dkyus sogs rgya nag nas snga 'gyur du byon pa rnams dang / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa/ de'i rang 'grel/ zla zer/sbyor ba brgya pa/ gces pa grub pa/ 'tsho ba'i mdo/ dngul chu grub pa'i bstan bcos sogs phyis rgya gar nas 'gyur ba rnams dang / bi ji'i pu ti kha ser/ sgron gsal gdams pa sum cu/ bdud rtsi snying po che chung / rdzong phrang 'phrul gyi lde mig yan lag bzhi pa cha lag dang bcas pa sogs bod du snga phyir byung ba'i gzhung lugs che chung rnams dang / bdud rtsi bam po bdun pa/

702 sa /grwa nga da bzhi/bdud rtsi mchog gi lung / bdud rtsi bum pa/ snang gsal shel bum sogs gsang sngags rnying ma la grags pa'i sman dpyad sogs te/ mdor na gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir grags so tshal gyi sman dpyad phra mo dang bcas pa phal cher la bla thabs ma yin par so sor zhib tu brtags/ gzhan yang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs rgyud sde rin po che 'grel pa dang bcas pa rnams dang / gser 'od dam pa dang dkon mchog brtsegs pa sogs mdo sde/ lung gzhi dang phran tshegs sogs 'dul ba/ gdags pa'i bstan bcos dang mdzod rtsa 'grel sogs mngon pa ste nang don rig pa rnams dang yang mi 'gal ba'i gzhig pa btang / sgra snyan ngag ming gi mngon brjod/ lugs kyi bstan bcos/ rtsis dkar nag rtog ge'i tshig don/ rig byed yan lag dang bcas pa/ brda'i bstan bcos sogs tha snyad kyi gtsug lag rnams dang sgo mi bstun du mi rung ba rnams la'ang zhib tu dpyad/ gzhung 'di nyid kyang phan tshun sbol te khungs dang rgyu mtshan rnam dag dang 'brel ba'i dpyad pa gsum dang ston pa bzhi'i sgo nas lan cig tsam ma yin par legs par zhus shing gtan la phab pa yin pas/ mkhas blun bar ma dang bcas pa kun gyis yid ches kyi gnas su mdzad 'os pa yod mod/ 'on te sman pa phal cher ni brda dang tha snyad las logs su gol zhing / mkhas pa gzhan rnams ni gso ba'i phyogs la gzigs pa lhod pas/ brda don phrod pa'i grogs kyis ring du bskal te chig zhus kho na'i byed pas ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtogs pa dang / the tshom gyi dbang du gyur pa 'ga' zung srid na kho bo cag gi nongs par zad kyi/ rig gnas la dpyod pa'i blo chung zhing lung rigs ltar snang gi rjes su 'brangs te lugs ngan dug can gyi rigs la brten pa rnams kyi gzhung dang ma mthun no zhes sangs mthon por sgrogs pa rnams ni gzhan gyi nyes par gor ma chag pas/ phyogs re tsam ma yin par gzigs pa zab pa rnams kyis so

sa tshem 'a zin las kyi da/ 703sor khye ste tshar bcad pa dang rjes su bzung ba mdzad du gsol/ zhes yul mtha' 'khob dgas po'i cha las la thog zur mkhar du byung ba'i sman pa a bochos rje zhes bya ba'i rigs dus cho 'brang dang chos lugs mtha' dag gis byin gyis brlabs shing / gtsug lag kun la mi phyed pa'i mos blo thob pas phyogs tsam mthong nas dang du len pa zur mkhar ba a bo chos rje gnyis pa'am blo gros rgyal po/ ming gzhan legs bshad 'tshol zhes bya bas ring mo zhig nas bsams pa'i don rdon po /spya nyid legs par grub pa yin no zhes zhus dag las bzlo/ ༵ / ṭwāṃ bye dris cho / kun ma 'dres thugs chud cing // dug gsum rgyu dang 'bras bu'i na dka rab sel 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ sngon med sman pa des khyed srungs/ 'di na byang chub spyod pa la// dang por 'jug pa'i lam po che// gso ba rig pa zhes bya ba skye dgu kun gyi bdud rtsir gyur//gzhan don bsgrubs pas rang gi don// sde bzhi cig car 'grub nus pa'i/lugs bzang gser gyi shing rta zhig / drang srong chen pos legs par drangs/'on te tshul min 'dam rdzob kyis/ bying gyur slar yang 'dren nus pa'i khyu mchog kha lo par bcas pa// ding 'dir lhags so grogs dag kwa / thar pa chos nor 'dod pa'i srog shing drang po la/ sa brgya dang lnga bcu drug gi rtsibs bkra zhing // dum bu bzhi yi mu khyud rab mnyam 'khor lo can/ yan lag brgyad ldan shing rta che khyod da longs shig / sngon tshe bgrod pa'i lam bzang ngang gis nub sgros ngan gya gyu'i gtam gyi nags tshal rgyas mi shes 'dam gyis phyogs kun gang gyur te/ cha tsam min par nub 'di su yis bzod// 'jogs na mthon po'i khri la ngal 'tsho zhing / bskyod na ji ltar 'dod pa'i gnas su skyel/ lugs gnyis nor 'dzin yangs por spyod pa 'di//gangs ri'i khrod kyi shing rta gcig pu lags// bstan pa'i khur gyis gdung bar

704 ga glu nga da bzhi/mi nus snying stobs kyis lhan po dag kyang 'dren par rtsom zhing yan lag tshang / khrims gnyis gom stabs yangs por spyod 'di thu mi'i rigs// mi yi khyu mchog yar rgyab chos rgyal yum sras lags 'di yi rnam dkar mdzad pa'i cha tsam yang / khong du shong ba 'di na su zhig bgrang // des na gzhan gyi khur du ma gyur pa'i// don chen 'di ni de yi zhar las so// kun la thun mong kha zas lta bu yi gleg bam 'di dag mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// gsar du rtsal to nges na mi dbang 'di 'gro ba kun gyi bde ba'i byed po lags// de lta'i shing rta chen po ni// 'dren byed khyu mchog dang bcas pa'i lam bzang 'byed pa'i kha lo ba// lus stobs rdzogs ldan zur mkhar ba// tshig don gnyis ku'i gzugs kyi cha// ma dag dri mas sbags rnams kyang // khrud byed yan lag brgyad ldan gyis/ yid 'ong byed po'ang gzhan yod min/ sngon chad 'di ltar bgyid do zhes/ du mas ngal brgya lhur blangs kyang / bya rog lnga par gyur pa bzhin kun gyi dpal du ma gyur to// dam pa'i 'dun sa rab yangs pa rgyal po'i khab bzhin chos skyong ba'i// rgyal chen gling du bsgrubs 'di dag / phyogs kyi 'gron po'i rna rgyan gyur/ gang zhig byang chub spyod pa yis/ rgyal ba mnyes par byed 'dod rnams/ mgyogs 'gro bzhin pa'i mchog 'di la// legs par 'dzegs shig thar 'dod kun// de yi rjes su yi ge pa/ dge 'dun rnam rgyal zhes bya te/ mal lugs mchog gi rtser phyin pas//sgo gsum nye bar btud de bris// gseg gcod 'dzin pa thams cad kyi//zur phud rang grol dpal 'bar sogs// mched bcas drug gi dag pa'i blos//phyi mo ji bzhin legs par bskos/ gzhan yang lus ngag yin gsum dang //zang zing rnams kyis phan btags pa kun kyang bro nad ma mchis shing kasman pa che mchog brnyis gyur cig / ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar/ de srid rgyud 'di rab gnas nas bstan pa rin chen rgyas pa dang / 'gro ba'i

sa khye ma 'a zin las kyi da/ 705sdug bsngal sel bar shog / gang yang 'di na dbang phyug rmongs pa'i gnyid kyis myos pa du ma dang / phal cher khyab 'jug smyon pa'i spyod tshul gsal por ston pa mang zhig snang // kun gyi rgyud la bslab pa ster ba'i byed po gcig pu lhags yod kyi// ri mor byas pa'i snang brnyan bzhin du da ni bag yod gnas par gyis// de ltar bsam don yid bzhin grub 'di bdag 'dra'i spyod yul ma yin kyang // gso rig bstan pa nub par phangs shing nyams thag rnams la byams pa'i blo// legs par gzigs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje lags mod da dung kyang // khyod dang lhag bsam srog bzhin 'dzin rto byang chub bar du skyab tu gsol// 'di yi ljon shing sprug la ba// brag kha rgyal grong rdzong sogs nas// gso rig bstan la cher dgongs te// slong ba yang dag tshim par mdzad// ces bya ba yang la thog zur mkhar ba legs bshad 'tshol gyis so/rgyal ba snan mdzad ston pa gang de yi// bstan pa rgyas par byed pa'i bdud rtsi mchog / skye dgu'i yi ga bde bar rab 'byor te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog / ces pa 'di nyid/ rgyud bzhi'i par sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung zhing gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bsam don grub par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyal dbang kurma pas bka' drin du stsal ba bden pa'i tshig tu byon pa lags pas/ slad nas kyang sman pa rnams kyis kha ton du mdzad pa zhu/ ye rnyarmā lha tu pra lha wā nye du rnye tha sdu thā ga rto lhu ba nga ta/ te tha thu yo ni ro cas waṃ ba dī mahwa shra ma ṇaḥ//shu lha mas sarba dza ga // / /
